text_cln: William Newman Aged about forty two Years on his Oath says that he Intermarried with Jane his Wife at Shoreditch Church about 14 Years Ago by whom he hath one Child now living Named Mathew aged about Eighteen Months says he served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr Lewis a Copper Plate Printer in Durham Yard in the Parish of St Martins in the fields in the County of Middlesex after he was out of his said time Apprenticeship he never rented House paid Taxes or otherwise gained any subsequent Settlement

Christr. Boothman aged abt. 32 yrs. upon Oath says he intermarried with Margt . his Wife at Mayfair Chapel upwards of Eight years ago says before his intermarriage & whilst he was a Single Man he lived a hired yearly Servant with Lady Bingley in Henrietta Street Cavendish Square in the Parish of St. Mary Le bone in the County of Middx. at the yrly. Wages of fourteen Pounds for Twenty Months & never Rented ten Pounds a yr. or paid Parish Taxes

Hannah Lant aged about 23 Years upon Oath says she was never Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Richard Murth Esqr . in the House of Mrs. Powell in East Street near Red lion Square in the Parish of St. George the Martyr by Queen Square in the County of Middx for two Years at the Yearly Wages of Seven pounds for the first Year and Eight pounds the Second Year quitted said Service about the 14th. day of March 1765, and hath not since Rented house or paid Taxes.

Elizth- Proctor aged about twenty eight Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of John Proctor gone from her with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St- Mary Lambeth about eight Months ago by whom she hath one Child now living named John aged about five Months as also another Child by a former husband named Ann Leonard aged two Years and nine Months and whose Father was a Watchman and never gained a Settlement in England to her Knowledge or belief And this Examinant further saith that her present husband named Jno- Proctor Rented and lived in a house in Little Elbow Lane in Thames Str - in the parish of Saint Michael Royal London for six Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of thirteen pounds hath quitted the same about six Months ago since which time this Examinant her husband hath never gained any other subseqt- Settlement either by Renting house paying Taxes or orwise howsoever

Ann Finn who goes by the name of Ann Cockran aged about Thirty four Years on her Oath says she never was Married was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year says she Rented and lived in a house in Plow Court Feller Lane in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn London for Nine Months at the Yearly Rent of Sixteen Pounds & Paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about five Years ago since which time she never Rented House paid Taxes or done any other Act wherby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Rose Page upon Oath Saith she is the Wife of Job Page by whom She has one Child (viz) Mary aged 10 Weeks & that she has been Informed & verily believes her sd. husband rented a house & pd. Sevt & Lot for Several Years in Foregate Street in the New Church Parish at Worcester & has not since he quitted the sd. house Rented ten Pounds a year Paid Parish taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one year

Eliz Turner aged 13 Yrs. upon Oath Saith she is the Daugher of Edwd Turner by Mary his Wife both decd. & that her sd. late father abt. 5 Yrs. ago rented a house in the parish of Iver in the Town & County of Stafford and pd. Mr. Stanborough the Church warden of the sd Parish his proportion towards the Poor Date of the sd. parish of Iver

Mary Lowndes aged abt. Thirty five Years upon Oath says She Intermarried with Saml. Lowndes in the Parish Church of St. Cathn. Coleman Street London abt. Fourteen Years ago says her said Husband Samuel Lowndes Rented a House in Charles Street in the Parish of St. Paul Covent Garden at the Yearly Rent of Forty Pounds lived therein abt. Eight Years & quitted the same abt. Nine Years since when he left this Examinant & She hath not seen him since but hath heard that he dyed in Holland abt. four Years ago & further says that from the time of his quitting the said House in Charles Street he never Rented ten Pounds a Year or pd. Parish Taxes as She verily believes & that She hath not since the hearing of the Death of her said Husband Rented ten Pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for one Year

John Peco Aged about fifty five Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Elizabeth his Wife at the Fleet London about Twenty Three Years Ago Says he served five Years Apprenticeship with one John Ducet a Perukemaker in German Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented Ten pounds a Year Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Pridell Ann Eames Ages about Sixteen Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she was bound an Apprentice by the Church Wardens and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Christ Church in the County of Surry to one Mr. Pridell a Cook in Castle Street in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster and Served her said Master for the space of Three Months or thereabouts when her said Master absconded and this Examinant obliged to go to service Since which fine she hath not gained any subsequent Settlement either by Renting House Paying Taxes or living a lived Yearly Servt. for one Year

Elizth. Williams aged about 37 Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented house or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr- Bush at the Sign of the Boot in Piccadilly in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr - for 3 Years and an half at the Yearly Wages of £5 hath quitted her said Service upwards of four Years ago since which time she hath never gained any other subseqt- Settlement either by Renting house Paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Jane Earnest aged about Thirty Six years on her Oath says she is the Wife of John Earnest gone to Sea with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St. Andrew Holbourn about five years ago and by whom she hath no Children now living says her said Husband has two Children by a former Wife namely Sarah aged about Fourteen years & Ann Maria aged about 13 years, Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Leapers Court Baldwins Gardens in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn above the Bars for five Years or thereabouts at the yearly Rent of 20 and Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Thirteen years ago since which time her said Husband never Rented House or Tenement of £10 a year or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement.

Margery Bulmer Aged about 34 years on her Oath says she Intermarried with her Husband John Bulmer (who was lately Pressed & gone to Sea ) at the Parish of St. Catherines by the Tower in the year 1764 and by whom she hath one Son living Namely Walter aged about twelve Years Says her said Husband was bound an Apprentice for Seven years to one Mr. Wildshire a Tanner in Long Lane in the Parish of St. Mary Magdalen Bermondsey in the County of Surry and served his said Master Six years the first Part of his Apprenticeship and was Afterwards Pressed & went to Sea and his said Master Received Wages, for the last year of his said Apprenticeship and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or did any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement neither hath this Examinant or her said Son

Hannah Nightingale aged about 23 years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House Paid Taxes was an Apprentice or ever lived a hired yearly Servant for one year says her father Samuel Nightingale before his Intermr. with this Examinants Mother & Whilst he was a Single man he lived as a hired Yearly servant with one Mr. Weston a Tobacoo Merchant in Coleman Street in the Parish of St. Stephen Coleman Street London for several years at the yearly Wages of Seven Pounds and after quitted the said last Mentioned Service he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Rending house or Tenement of Ten Pounds a year or otherwise howsoever

Joseph Berry aged about Sixty one Years on his Oath says he Intermarried with Mary his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Giles in the Fields in the Year 1749 and by whom he hath No Children says he was bound an Apprentice to and served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Willim- Seed a Lace Weaver in the Strand in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr . and after he was on of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented house paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Sarah Obrien aged about 54 Years on her Oath says she is the widow of Edward Obrion who died about Four Years ago and with whom she Intermarried with her said late husband at the Parish Church of St Andrew Undersharft London about Six Years ago and by whom she hath no Children now living says her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in red Bull Yard in the Parish of St James Clarkenwell in the County of Middx for severel Years at the Yearly rent of Sixteen Pounds hath quitted the said House about Ten Years ago and after quitting the said House he never Rented House paid Taxes or did any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlemt.

Jane Sharp aged about 43 Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Thos. Sharp (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at St. Bartholomew Cloth Fair about 14 Years ago and by whom she hath no Children now living Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House the Corner of Kent Street in the Parish of Saint George Southwark in the County of Surry for several Years at the Yearly Rent of £12 and paid all Parochial Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Seven Years ago since which time her said Husband never Rented House paid Taxes or did any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement.

Rachael Stainsby Aged about Fifty Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of William Stainsby who died about two Years ago says she Intermarried with her said late Husband at the Parish Church of St. Mary Lambeth in the Year 1769 and by whom she hath no Child or Children living Says her said late Husband has often Informed her that he was born at Richmond in the County of Surry where her said Father was settled as she has been Credibly Informed and Verily believes and that her said late Husband never Rented House paid Taxes served any Apprenticeship or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant before Marriage for one Year as her said Husband has also Informed her and which Information she Verily believes to be true

Eleanor Molyneux aged about 33 Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of John Molyneux (who is Pressed and gone to Sea ) with whom she Intermarried at North Church in the County of Hertford upwards of Ten Years ago and by whom she hath four Children now living Namely Mary aged about Ten Years Isabella aged about Eight Years Matthew aged about five Years and Paul Aged upwards of Three Years Say's her said Husband is a Native of and born in Ireland and never gained a Settlement in England as her said Husband has often Informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true other by Renting House paying Taxes serving any Apprenticeship or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year before Marriage, or otherwise Howsoever And this Examinant further Says that before her Intermarriage to her said Husband she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Charles Chappell a Farmer at Harsfoot End near Brickle Green in the Parish of Great Berkhamstead in the County of Hertford upwards of four Years at the Yearly Wages of Fifty Shillings hath quitted her said Service upwards of Thirteen Years and after quitting mentioned Service she never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House Paying Taxes or living a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Hannah Skelton Aged about 70 Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Charles Skelton who has been Dead about 40 Years and by whom she hath no Child or Children now living Says her said Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant & whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired Yearly servant with one Mr. Jonathan Gurnell a Merchant Opposite St. Lawrence Church in the Parish of St. Lawrence Jury Church in the City of London for four Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds as she beleaves and after quitting the said last Mentioned service she never Rented House paid Taxes or gained any other Subsequent Settlement neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death

Catherine Jones aged about 39 Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Samuel Jones who Entred as a Mercai and gone from her and with whom she Intermarried d the Parish Church of Saint Margaretts Westminster about Nine Years ago and by whom she hath three Children now living Namely John aged about Eight Years Elizabeth Ann aged about Five Years and Samuel aged about two Years says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Turnham Green in the Parish of Chiswick in the County of Middlesex for several Years at the Yearly Rent of Eight Pounds a Year and Paid all Parochial Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about twelve Months ago since which time Her said Husband never Rented House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a Year Paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Sarah Haydon Aged about 25 Years on her Oath says she Never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Wilson a Ship Chandler at Shadwell Dock in the Parish of Saint Paul Shadwell in the County of Middlesex for Eleven Months or Upwards but received Twelve Months Wages that this Examinant was Passed from Saint Mary Lambeth to Saint Paul Shadwell ; Saint Paul Shadwell Appealed and on hearing the Appeal the same was dismissed and she settled in the Parish of Saint Paul Shadwell and this Examinant further Says that she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Margaret Koonart aged about 38 Years on her Oath says she Intermarried with her late Husband Joseph Koonart at the Parish Church of Saint Brides London about Twelve Years ago and who has been Dead upwards of one Year and a half and by whom she hath one Child now living Named Elizabeth Susannah Aged about Four Years says her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in New Bedford Court Catherine Street in the Strand in the Parish of St Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of three Years and a half at the Yearly Rent of Fifteen Guineas and paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House upwards of Thirteen Months ago since which time this Examinant hath gained no other Subsequent Settlemt. either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Elizth. Southgate aged Twenty Six Years On her Oath says she Intermarried to her Husband Robt. Southgate (gone from her) at the Parish Church of Saint Mary Le Strand about Ten Years ago and by whom she hath Two Children living now provided for says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House Opposite the Turnpike near Shoreditch Church in the Parish of Saint Leonard Shoreditch in the County of Middlesex for three Years at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Five Pounds and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Twelve Months ago since which time her said Husband neaver gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or Otherwise Howsoever to her knowledge or Belief

Sarah Wilkinson aged about Twenty five Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Lowe a Fishing Tackle shop in little Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Strand in the Liberty of Westminster for one year and a half at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds hath quitted her said service about Six Months ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Ann Yeldon Aged about Fifty Four Years on behalf of Ann Bromley an Infant aged upwards of Nine Years on her Oath says she is the Daughter of Ann Spatcher lately deceased and who as she has been Informed & believes was never Married but that she had the abovementioned Ann Bromley by one Thomas Bromley who was an Irishman and never gained a Settlement in London as she believes says her Mother Ann Spatcher lived a hired Yearly Servant to one Mr. Ralfe at the Sign of the Blackmors Head Macklesfield Street in the Parish of Saint Ann Soho in the Liberty of Westmr . for one Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about five Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlemt. And further says that the said Ann Bromley was born in Grafton Street in the assd. Parish of Saint Ann Soho

Mary Neale aged about Twenty five Years on her Oaths says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Nichols a Green Grocer in Newgate Markett in the Parish of Saint Faith London for One Year and an half at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Six Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes on living a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Elizabeth Weston aged about Twenty Six Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs Moore a Silver Smith in Grace Church Street in the Parish of Saint Bennett Grace Church London in the City of London for one Year and an half at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said service upwards of Two Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly servant for one Year

Eleanor Hirkton aged about Fifty four Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one George Crawford an Attorney at Law in Cross Lane St. Mary at Hill in the City of London for Two Years and an half at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Nineteen Years ago since which time She hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Judith Graves aged about Thirty Two Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes or ever served any Apprenticeship says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Thomas Gould at The Sign of the Jack of Newberry the Corner of Grubb Street in the Parish of Saint Luke Old Street in the County of Middlesex for Two Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds Ten Shillings hath quitted her said Service upwards of five Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

William Cross aged about Fifty Six Years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Mary his Wife at the Parish Church of Rumford in Essex in the Year 1752 and by whom he hath Six Children four of whom are now provided and Two unprovided for Namely Samuel William aged about Thirteen Years and Edward aged about Eleven Years say's before his Intermarriage with his said Wife and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Hardell a Jeweller in Villers Street York Buildings in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields for Two Years and nine Months at the Yearly Wages of Ten Pounds besides Bed Board & Washing hath quitted his said Service about Twenty Six Years ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a Year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

James Roe aged about Nineteen Years On his Oath says he never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year says he was born an Apprentice to one John Ward a Hairdresser in Bishop Street in the Parish of Saint Botolph without Bishopgate London and served his said Master for the space of four Years or thereabouts And was afterwards discharged by Alderman Woldrige for Non Inrollment of his Indentures and after being so discharged he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Kelly aged about Thirty Eight Years on her Oath any She is the Wife of Nicholas Kelly (gone from her) with whom She Intermarried at Saint Michael in the City of Dublin about Twenty Two Years ago and by whom she hath one Child living Namely Margery Aged about Nine Years Says her said husband Rented and lived in a House in Whites Alley Chancery Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex for three Quarters of a Year at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds but paid no Taxes due for the same as She knows of hath quitted the said House about three Years ago and after quitting the same he never Rented House paid Taxes or did any other Act whereby to gaine Subsequent Settlement

Sarah Rowlatt Aged about Twenty One Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House or Paid Ta Says She was bound an Apprentice or Covenanted Se to One Mary Blanchard a Silk Sorter in Throgmorton Street in the Parish of Saint Bennett Fink London And Served her said Mistress under such Indentures or Covenant for the space of five Years And after quitting her said Misstresses Service which is about 5 Years ago She never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly servant for One Year.

Richard Phillips Aged about Fifty three Years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Elizabeth his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes about three Years ago and by whom he has no Child or Children living says he was bound and Appren to One Joseph Slamaker a Blacksmith in Bermondsey Street in the Parish of Saint John Horseleydown in the County of Surry about Forty Years ago and served his said Master for the space of One Year or thereabouts under such Indenture And afterward his Mother Bought his time out since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Elizabeth Vaughan Aged about Forty five Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says She lived a hired Yearly Servant with Holeman Esqr. in Park Place St. James's Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster for two Years at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Eighteen Years ago since which time She hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Ann Thomas Aged about Thirty Years On her Oath says She never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year says her Father Richard Thomas Served Seven Years Apprenticeship to One Bannister a Stationer in the Strand in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster And after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for One Year neither hath this Examinant otherwise than as aforesaid

Martha Simcock Aged about Sixty Years On her Oath says She is the Widow of Matthew Simcock who died about Eleven Years ago & with whom She Intermarried at the Fleet London about forty Years ago And by whom She hath no Child or Children living says her said late Husbands Father Rented and lived in a House in Leg Alley Long Acre in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields for several Years at the Yearly Rent of Fourteen Pounds as She believes and paid Parish Taxes due for the same And further says that her said late Husband served his Apprenticeship to his said Father And after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or did any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement.

Sarah Sharratt Aged about Forty Two Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House Paid Taxes or ever served any Apprenticeship says She lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Vincent a Hott Presser in Bow Lane in the Parish of Saint Mary Aldermary in the City of London for two Years at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds hath quitted her said Service Upwards of Eight Years ago since which time She hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one year

Elizabeth Lashbrook Aged about Twenty Two Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House paid Taxes or lived was an Apprentice Says She lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Durhans a Taylor in Vinegar Yard in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex for Thirteen Months at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service About Three Years ago since which time She hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one year.

Elizabeth Mary Polly Aged about fifty Seven Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Thornhill a Breechesmaker in Shire Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex for fourteen Months at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Eighteen Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement

Ann Thomas Aged about Thirty one Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House paid Taxes or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year says her Father Richard Thomas served Seven Years Apprenticeship to One Bannister a Stationer in the Strand in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired yearly Servant for one year neither hath this Examinant otherwise then as aforesaid

Ann Butter Aged about Sixty Eight Years on her Oath says She is the Widow of George Heron Butter who died about Thirty Six years ago and by whom She hath no Children now living says She Rented and lived in a House in Back Street in the Parish of Saint John Horsley down in the County of Surry at the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds to the best of her Remembrance and paid Land Tax due for the same and hath not since She quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Ann Robins Aged about Twenty One years On her Oath says She never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes or ever served any Apprenticeship says She lived a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Bengees whose wife kept a Boarding School at Kensington in the County of Middlesex for the space of Ten Months or thereabouts when her Master and Mistress removed into Soho Square where this Examinant also Removed and lived with her Master and Mistress there for the Space of Three Months Amounting in the whole to Thirteen Months and Upwards and where this Examinant was Discharged and further says that after quitting her said last mentioned Service She never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Ann Gabell Aged about Twenty Three Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House paid Taxes or was an Apprentice Says She lived a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Ballentine a Taylor in Southampton Street in the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden in the County of Middx for 2 years and Upwards at the yearly Wages of Six Guineas hath quitted her said Service about Nine Months ago since which time She hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Ann Donovon Aged about Thirty years on behalf of Josiah Collins aged about Eleven years On her Oath says that the said Josiah Collins is a Bastard born on the Belly of Mary Collins lately deceased & further says that the said Mary Collins never was Married Rented House paid Taxes or ever lived a hired yearly Servant to her knowledge or Belief nor does She know were the said Mary Collins Settlement was says that the said Josiah Collins was born in the House of Mr. Tregedion a Watch Maker in Furnivals Inn Court Holbourn in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn in the County of Middlesex about Eleven Years ago and whose Father was Josiah Hale a Sugar Baker in Pye Corner Smithfield as she this deponent hath heard him acknowledge and who Died soon after the Birth of the said Josiah Collins

Martha Mullins Aged about Twenty nine years on behalf of Rebecca James her Daughter by a Former Husband On her Oath says she was Bound an Apprentice by the Churchwardens and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes to John Hall a Carpenter in Dean Street Holbourn in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex by Indenture Dated the 24th. day of September 1779 and Served her said Master under such Indenture for the Space of Two years and Upwards untill her said Master was arrested and to Goal & after parting with her said Master she never gained any other settlement

Amelia Dean otherwise Caffaty Aged about Twenty Eight years an her Oath says she Intermarried to One Phillip Caffaty an Fishman (who was by trade a shoemaker and who never gained a settlement in England either by Renting House or otherwise) at the House of Mrs. Butcher in Rope Makers Alley Moor Fields by a Romish Priest which Marriage is of no Effect by the Laws of this Country as this Examinant has been Informed and believes and further says that she has Two Children by the aforesaid Phillip Caffaty Namely Mary aged about four years born in Petty Coat Lane in the Parish of Aldgate London and Phillip Aged about Eight Months born in Rope makers alley aforesaid in the Parish of Saint Luke in the County of Middlesex And further says that Her said two Children have gained no other settlement then by Births as this Examinant has been Informed and verily believes And this Examinant further says that before such her Intermarriage with the sd Philip Caffaty and whilst she was a Singlewoman she lived a Hired yearly servant with her Uncle Cornelius Dean a Draft Board maker in Little Distaff Lane in the Parish of Saint Augustin Alias Saint Austin in the City of London upwards of Two years at the yearly Wages of Four Pounds Ten Shillings hath quitted her said Service upwards of Fifteen years ago since which time she hath gained no other settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a Hired yearly Servant for One year

Mary Marshall Aged about Sixty years On her Oath says She is the Widow of Joseph Marshall with whom She Intermarr at the Parish Church of Saint George Hanover Square in the year 1745 And who has been dead about Ten years And by whom She hath three Children now Living all of whom are now provided for Says her said Late Husband Rented and Lived in a House in Little George Street in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of Three years at the yearly Rent of Thirty Six Pounds And paid Parish Taxes due for the Same hath quitted the said House about Thirty Three years ago since which time Her said Husband never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either or Tenement of Ten Pounds a year or otherwise howsoever neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death

Henry Woodward Aged about Twenty Six Years on his Oath Says he was bound an Apprentice for Seven Years to one Thomas Lewis a Peruke maker in Star Alley Fenchurch Street in the Parish of All hallows Staining in the City of London and served his sd Master under such Indenture for the Space of Three Years when his said Master failing in Business he gave up this Examinant his Indentures and was never Assigned over to any other person since which time this he hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of Ten pounds a Year or living hired Yearly or Covenanted Servant for one Year

Mary Rochester Aged about Sixty Eight Years on her Oath says she Intermarried with her Husband John Rochester at the Fleet London upwards of forty Years ago and by whom she hath Two Children now living Namely Ann Aged about forty Year and Mary Aged near forty both of whom were provided for before she went to lived as a Servant Says her said Children being so provided for she went to live as a hired Yearly Servant one James Smith a Shagareen Case maker in Little New Street in the Parish of Saint Brides otherwise Bridget in the City of London for five Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Seventeen Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlemt.

Ann Dew Aged about Seventy Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried to her late Husband Samuel Dew deceased at the Fleet London upwards of forty Years ago and by whom she hath One Son living named Samuel (now provided for) Says her said late Husband was bound an Apprentice to one Mr. Wakelin a Leather Dresser in Windmill Court in the Parish of St. Bartholomew the Less London and served his said Master under such Indenture to the time of his Master Death which was about Six Years and further says that her said Husband never was Assigned ever to any other Master nor ever gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paying Taxes or ever Living a hired Yearly Servant for One year before Marriage neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands death

Elizabeth Farquhar aged about Thirty eight Years on her oath says, she is the Wife of Robert Farquhar with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Sepulchre London in the year one thousand seven Hundred and sixty two, and by whom she hath six Children now living namely Robert Aged about Seventeen Years now Provided for, Elizabeth aged upwards of Fourteen Years, Mary aged about Seven Years George aged upwards of Five Years. James aged about four Years and Charles aged upwards of Two Years the last five of white are unprovided for, And further says that her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Newport Market , in the Parish of Saint Ann in the Liberty of Westminster for Eighteen Months at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Eighteen Pounds, hath quitted the said House about Three Months ago, and hath not since he Quitted the same ever Rented House Tenement or Lodgings of Ten pound a Year, paid Taxes or gained any other Settlement.

Elizth. Clarke Aged about 47 Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10. a Year or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servt . with One Mr. Bellas a Jeweller the Corner of Market Lane Pall Mall in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Six pounds hath quitted the same about Seven Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement

James Knight aged about 62 Years on behalf of Ann Singlewoman Aged about 80 Years who now Ill on his Oath Says that the said Ann Stacey Lived as hired Yearly Servant with the Revd. Mr. Delaport at the Privy Seal Office Opposite the Horse Guards in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . & County of Middlesex for Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Six Guineas hath quitted her sd. Service about Seventeen Years ago since wch. time she hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10. a Ye paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever.

Ann Courtney Aged about Thirty Two Years now living at No. 46 in Shire Lane on behalf of Ann her Daughter an Infant Aged upwards of Ten Years by John Morey the Younger her Father on her Oath Says that the said Courtney this Examinants Daughter was born a Bastard in Dyott Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex And Says that this Examint is poor & unable to maintain the said Child and that her said Child has done no Act whereby to gain a Settlemt otherwise than by Birth

Mary Tokely Aged about 52 Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Richd. Parker a Statiary in the Strand in the Parish St. Mary Le Strand for 12 Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Pounds hath quitted her said service upwards of five Years ago Since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlemt. by living as a hired Yearly Servant for one Year or otherwise howsoever.

Ann Condron Aged about 40 Years on her Oath says she Intermarried to her late Husband deceased at the Parish Church of St. George Hanover Square about fourteen Years ago and by whom she hath no Child or Children living Says her sd. late Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship to John Howard the Younger of the Parish of St. Anns Linnh in the County of Middlesex Carpenter and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any or. Settlemt. either by Renting House Tenemt. or Lodging of Ten Pounds P Annl. paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death

Elizth Benbough Aged about 34 Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she Served Six Years the first Part of her Appren ticeship to one John Taylor a Tickett Porter in George Alley Fleet Markett in the Parish of St. Brides otherwise Bridgett London soon after which her Master Dying her late Mistress gave her up her Indentures And further says that she hath gained no other Settlement other than by living a hired yearly Servant to her late Mistress Daughter in the aforesd. Parish of St. Brides upwards of One year at the Yearly of Wages of Three Pounds Eighteen Shillings payable Weekly and after quitting her sd. Service she never gained any other Subsequent Settlement by living as a hired yearly Servant for One Year or otherwise howsoever.

Elizth. Bennett aged about Fifty two years on her Oath says she Intermarried to her Husband John Bennett (gone from her) at the Parish Church of Hallstone in the Parish of Hellstone in the County of Cornwall in the year 1763 and by whom she hath four Children all of whom are now Provided for for anything as she believes Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in the aforesaid Parish of Hallstone of £20. & upwards paid Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House upwards of two years ago since which time her said Husband never gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Wm. Williams aged about Thirty two years on his Oath says he never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says he lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mrs. Burton in the Capacity of a Footman near St. Georges Hospital Knightsbridge in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westmr . upwds. of one year & an half at the yearly Wages of Twelve Pounds hath quitted his said Service about Six years ago since which time he hath never lived a hired yearly Servant for one year or otherwise gained any or Subsequent Settlemt.

James Stone Aged about 48 years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Ann his Wife at the Parish Church of St. Mary Lambeth about 28 years ago and by whom he hath one Child living now Provided for as he believes Says before his Intermarriage with his said Wife and whilst he was a Singleman he lived a hired yearly Servant to Sr. John Shaw at Eltham in the County of Kent in the Capacity of a Postillion upwards of Eighteen Months at the yearly Wages of Six Pounds besides Diet Cloaths & Lodgings hath quitted his said Service about 30 years ago since which time he hath gained no other Settlemt. either by Renting House Tenemt. or Lodgings of £10. a year or otherwise howsoever

Mary Cooper Aged about 37 years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House served any Apprenticeship or ever lived a hired yearly Servant for one year Says her Father Wm. Cooper served seven years Apprenticeship to one John Dorril l a Taylor in Feathers Court Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Mary Le Strand in the Liberty of Westmr . and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any or. Subsequent Settlemt. as her Mother Ann Cooper has lately Informed her and which Information she verily he believes to be true And this Examinant further says that she never gained any other Settlemt. than as aforementioned

Henry Shone Aged about Sixty nine years on his Oath says he served Seven years Apprenticeship to one Mr. Harris a Butcher in Red Lion Street in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex and after he was out of his Apprenticeship he went and lived in divers places as a Weekly Servant only untill about Twenty seven years ago as he believes when he went to live as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Hudson whose Wife Kept a Butcher Shop in Bath Street Cold Bath fields in the Parish of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex upwards of Six years at the yearly Wages of Ten Pounds a year besides Diet and Lodging hath quitted his said service upwds. of Twenty years ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlemt. by living a hired yearly Servant for one year or otherwise howsoever

Margt. Welch Aged about Thirty years on her Oath says she Intermarried to her Husband Peter Welch (gone from her) at the Parish of St. George Bloomsbury in the year 1781 and by whom she hath no Child or Children living Says her said Husband before his Intermarriage to this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived a hired yearly Servant with one Timothy Simms who kept a Public House in St. Michaels Lane Crooked Lane in the Parish of St. Michael Crooked Lane London for sevl. years at the yearly Wages of Six Pounds besides Diet & Lodging hath quitted his said Service upwards of five years ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10. a yearly paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Martha Sherkin Aged about Fifty fiv Years on her Oath says she never was married or ever lived a hired yearly Servant for one Year says her Father Rented & lived in a House at Little Chelsea in the Parish of St. Luke Chelsea in the County of Middx upwds. of Twenty years at the yearly Rent of £10. and lived therein to the time of his Death & this Examinant further says she Rented and lived in the same House upwards of a year since which time she hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House or Tenement or Lodging of £10. a year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Catherine Menley Aged about Thirty two years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10. a year or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Radcliffe one of the Porters to his Majesty in Half Moon Street Piccadilly in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex for one year & Ten Months at the yearly Wages of £6 hath quitted her said Service about 12 years ago since which time she hath never lived as a hired yearly Servt: for one year or or.wise gained any or. Settlement

Robt Waters Aged about 60 years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Elizth . his Wife at the Parish Church of Shoreditch about Nine years ago and by whom he hath one Child now living (vizt) Robert aged upwards of Seven years Says he was bound an Apprentice for Seven years to one John Edmunds a Button maker the Corner of Eagle & Child Alley in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn London & served five Years part of his Apprenticeship and untill his said Masters Death & further says he never was assigned over to any or. Master nor ever gained any or. Settlemt. Renting House of £9. a year but paid no Poor Rates or Land Tax as he remembers

Thomas Spencer Aged about Sixty four years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Mary his Wife at the Parish Church of St. James Clerkenwell about Twenty two years ago and by whom he hath one Child living vizt. John aged about Nineteen years Provided for Says he Rented & lived in a House in Aylesbury Street in the Parish of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middx upwds. of Six years at the yearly Rent of £14. & Paid Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about Six years ago since which time he never Rented House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10. a year or or.wise howsoever

Sarah Watts aged about Twenty Six Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Lady Blackwood in Somerset Street Portman Square in the Parish of St. Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex for 18 Months at the Yearly Wages of £8. hath quitted her said Service about Two Months ago since which time she hath gained no other Settlement says she hath One Child named Hugh born a Bastard aged about five Months in Oxford Road in the said Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone which hath gained no other Settlement than by Birth.

Israel Ripley upon Oath saith he was born in the Parish of Leads in the County of york where his father rented a house & paid Scot & Lot and that he never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant nor ever rented ten pounds a year or paid parish taxes

Thomas Morgan upon Oath saith he lived a yearly Servant with Mr Rd Jenkins in the Parish of Llangibbey in the County of Monmouth for one year at the yearly wages of Six pounds and has not since he Quitted his said Service Rented ten pounds a year paid parish taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one year

Ann Fisher upon Oath saith she is the wife of John Fisher with whom she intermarried in the parish Church of St. George Hanover Square near four years ago & by whom She hath two Children Eliz aged abt. 17 Months & Jane aged about one Month and that her sd. husband rented a house at the upper End of Drury Lane in the parish of St Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex of the yearly Rent of Ten pounds & ten Shillings & lived therein two Years quitted the same about 18 months & has not since rented Ten pounds a Year or paid parish Taxes

Mary Foreman aged upwds. of 20 Years upon Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a Yearly Servant with Mr Norman a Ropemaker at Yalden in Kent for one year at the yearly Wages of £3 and quitted her sd. Service about 3 weeks ago

Ann Stevens aged about 15 Years upon Oath Saith she never was married nor ever was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant for one Year rented ten pounds a Year or paid parish taxes that she was born (as she hath been informed & verily believes) in the parish of St. Mary le Strand in the Liberty of Westmr . and can give no Account of the Settlement of her father & mother

Jane Batson upon Oath Saith she never was married and that she lived a Yearly Servt. with Mr. Thomas at the Globe Tavern in the Strand in the parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr . at the Yearly Wages of for one year & upwds quitted her sd. Service about five years ago & has not since rented ten pounds a year paid parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one Year

Susanna Ballard upon Oath Saith She was married to Joseph Ballard (at prest. a Soldier in Scotland ) at the Fleet London upwds. of two Years ago. that she can give no Accot. of the Settlemt. of her sd. husband that she this Examint. never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant for one year nor ever rented ten pounds a Year or paid parish taxes and that her late father Richd. Stedman lived in and rented house in Cullum Street in the parish of St. Dionis Backchurch Londn. known by the Sign of the Ipswich Arms & never after he quitted the sd house rented ten pounds a Year or pd. parish taxes

Sarah Olfay aged about 15 Yrs. upon Oath Saith she never was married nor ever rented Ten pounds a year paid parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for one year And that she Served three years of her Apprentiship wth. Mrs. Banworth in Rose Lane Limehouse in the parish of St. Ann at Limehouse in the County of Middx at the End of which time her Mistress ran away from her & she never was assigned over to any person

Lucy Green aged upwds. of 17 Years upon Oath saith she never was married and never rented ten pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant and that her late father Rd. Green (as she hath been informed & believes) Served his Apprentiship with a Stone Cutter in the Parish of Burntwood in the County of Essex and never Rented ten pounds a Year paid parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one Year

Sarah Stiff aged upwds. of 21 Years upon Oath Saith she never was married and never rented ten pounds a Year paid parish taxes or was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant for one Year and that her father Thomas Stiff about 8 years ago rented a house of £16 by the year in Drury Lane near the Cole Yard in the parish of St Giles in the Fields and lived therein about 1 year & has not since rented ten pounds a Year or pd. parish taxes

Mary London aged abt. 40 Years upon Oath saith she never was married nor ever was an Apprentice or yearly Servant for one year Rented Ten pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes and that her father lived in a house of his own in the parish of Dunstable in the County of Bedford Sevl Years which he afterwards Sold for more than £80

Sarah Hill upon Oath Saith She is the Widow of John Hill who dyed about 9 Years Since and that her sd late husband informed her, he lived as a Yearly Servant (whilst a Singleman) with Mr. Fuller a Cowkeeper in Grays Inn Lane in the Parish of Pancras in the County of Middlx at the yearly Wages of Six pounds, for two Years and never after he quitted his sd Service nor has this Examint. Since his Decease Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one year
Thos. Bird upon Oath Saith he was born at Desford in the County of Leicester & never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant and that he can give no Account of the Settlement of his father and Mother

Eleanr. Innys upon Oath Saith she was born at Leverpoole in the County of Lancaster and never rented ten pounds a Year paid parish taxes was an Apprentice or yearly Servant and that She can give no Account of the Settlemt. of her father & mother

Wm. Daws upon Oath Saith he lived a Yearly Servant for the Space of four Years with Mrs. Evers at the Noah's Ark in King Street in the parish of Charles at Plimouth in the County of Devon at the yearly wages of £7 and was during all the time of his sd. Servitude a Singleman that he quitted his sd. Service upwds. of two Years ago & has not since Rented ten pounds a Year paid parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one Year

Martha Lake upon Oath saith she never was married and that she is the Daughter of John Lake by Eliz . his wife both deceased that she was born in King Street in the Parish of St. Margt. in the City of Westmr. where her sd. late father rented and lived in a house for sevl. Years & there dyed & that she this Examinant never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant nor ever rented ten Pounds a Year or pd. Parish taxes

Ann Whittingham aged abt. 43 Yrs. upon Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a Yearly Servant with Henry Bendish Esqr . of Bedford Row Holborn for two Years & upwards at the yearly wages of Seven pounds and that during her sd. Service she went with Mr Bendish and the family to Thamesford in Bedfordshire and Continued there about Six months, that she had warning given her during their Stay at Thamesford and was discharged from Mr. Bendish's Service & pd. the money then due to her (being one Years wages) at Thamesford aforesaid that at the time of her being pd. of & Discharged her Service as afsd. her Master's Sister desired her to Continue with them, till they went to Yarmouth (which they intended in a few Days) and promised to Satisfie this Examint. for her time after which she Stayed with them about two Months & had for her trouble a Guinea from Miss Bendish and half a Guinea from her Master

Lucy Key upon Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a yearly Servant with Mr Davis in Shire Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex for four Years & upwds. at the yearly wages of £7 and has left her sd. Service abt. 7 Yrs. since which she has not rented ten pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Sevt. for one Year

Eleanr Hall aged about 20 years upon Oath saith she never was married and that her late father lived in and rented a house in Highgate in the Parish of Pancras in the County of Middx . for several years and there dyed & that she was born at Highgate afsd. and never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant nor ever Rented ten Pounds a Year or pd. Parish taxes

Mary Wall aged 30 Years upon Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a yearly Servant with Mr Wagstaff in Bandy leg Walk in the parish of St. Savrs . Southwark in the County of Surry for three Years at the Yearly wages of £5. quitted her sd Service about 9 Yrs. ago and has not since rented ten pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Johnson upon Oath saith she is the wife of Peter Johnson (at present in Westmr. Infirmary) to whom she was married at the Fleet London upwds. of 8 Years ago & by whom she has a Child now with her (viz) Frances aged upwds. of 7 years and that she has been Informed & verily believes her sd. Husband Served his Apprentiship with Mr Veredit a Gold & Silver Lace Wenore in Belton Street Long Acres in the Parish of St Giles in the Field in the County of Middx and never rented ten pounds a Year paid Parish taxes or lived a yearly Servant

John Barnacle upon Oath saith he never was married and that he lived a yearly Servant with Jno Hines in the Parish of Covington in the County of Warwick for one Year at the yearly Wages of £5 quitted his sd. Service at Michs. last & has not since rented ten pounds a Year or pd. Parish taxes

Mary Marsh aged 23 years upon Oath saith she never was married & never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant rented ten pounds a year or pd. parish taxes that she hath been informed are believes her father Heny. Marsh decd. Served his Apprentiship with a Cooper in the Parish of St. Botolph witht. Aldersgate London and never lived a yearly Servant for one yr. Rented ten pounds a year or pd. Parish taxes and that she (this Examint.) together with her father & mother were removed from the Parish of St. George Southwark to the afsd. Parish of St. Botolph witht. Aldersgate abt. 18 years ago and her father dyed in the Workhouse of the last mentioned Parish

Margt. Pike upon Oath saith she is the Widow of William Pike with whom she intermarried in the Parish Church of St Bennet Paulswharf about 16 Yrs. ago & by whom she hath one Child Thos . aged abt. 14 Yrs. who never was an Apprentice or yearly Servt. and that her sd. husband (whilst a Singleman) lived a Yearly Servant with Mr. Ravenhill in Red Lyon Street in the Parish of St. Andrew in Holborn above the Barrs in the County of Middx for thirteen months & upwds. at the Yearly Wages of £ and never after he quitted that Service rented ten pounds a Year paid Parish taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one year that her sd. late husband dyed in June last and she has not since his Decease rented ten Pounds a Year or pd. parish taxes

Bridget Ward upon Oath saith she never was married & never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant that she is the Daughter of Hugh Ward decd. by Grace his Wife and was born in the Parish of Rahamley in the County of Slaghey in Ireland where her sd. late father who was an Irishman rented a house and lived therein a considerable time and that her sd Mother Grace Ward never gained a Settlement in England to this Examinants Knowledge

John Cox upon Oath saith he was married to his Wife Sarah Cox at Long Collingham in Nottinghamshire Sometime in Febry last and has by her Twin Children Joseph and Mary aged about two Months and that he Served Seven Years Apprentiship with Thomas Laming a Miller in the Parish of Middle Raising South Town in the County of Lincoln and never rented ten Pounds a Year paid parish Taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one Year

Ann Fowler upon Oath saith she intermarried with her husband George Fowler at Alverstoke in the County of Hants upwds. of 30 Years ago and that her sd. husband at Christmas last took a house of the Yearly Rent of Ten pounds in Fleet Lane in the Parish of St. Sepulchers Londn & has Continued to live in & Rent the sd house ever since

Wm. Dymock aged near 16 Years upon Oath saith he was bound Apprentice by the Parish Offices of St. Giles witht. Cripplegate London to John Chambers Childs Pump maker till he should attain the Age of Twenty four Years and lived with the sd. Chambers upwards of two Years as his Apprentice during the last Year of which term he lodged in his Masters house in Harrow Alley whitechapel in the Parish of St Botolph witht. Aldgate London and that he never was assigned over to any person nor ever lived a Servt. for forty days in any place with his Masters Knowledge & Consent

Cathn Taylor upon Oath saith she is the widow of Joseph Taylor an Irishman who never gained a Settlement in England to her Knowledge and that she Served five Years of her Apprentiship with Mrs. Cable a Bomb boat Woman and Lodged all that time at Gosport in the County of Southampton , that at the End of five Years or thereabts. she intermarried with her sd husband Taylor & never Rented ten pounds a Year paid parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for one Year

Cathn Brown upon Oath Saith she is the Wife of John Brown (gone from her) by whom she has one Child (viz) Catherine aged about Six Years, that her sd. husband & herself are both Native of Ireland & never gained a Settlement in England and that her sd husband informed her he was born in the Parish of St Mary in Dublin in the Kingdom of Ireland and never gained a Subsequent Settlement elsewhere

Danl- Davis upon Oath Saith he is the Son of Solomon Davis Decd. who was a Dutchman & never gained a Settlement in England & that this Examinant was born in Broad Court in the parish of St. James in Dukes place London & never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant nor ever rented Ten Pounds a Year or pd. Parish taxes

Jas. Riley upon Oath Saith he was born in the Parish of Killmore in the County of Cavan in the Kingdom of Ireland and never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant nor ever rented Ten Pounds a year or paid Parish Taxes

Margt. Carney aged 18 Years upon Oath Saith she never was married and that she lived a Yearly Servant with Mr Hume Manwell in the West bow in the Old Church Parish at Edinburgh in Scotland for one Year at the Yearly Wages of Q at the yearly wages of Four pounds and has Quitted her sd. Service near Twelve Months

Eliz Collins aged 18 Years upon Oath Saith She never was Married and that she was bound Apprentice to Mr Rd Robins of Philpot Lane in the Parish of St. Alphage London & lived with her sd Master in Philpot Lane afsd. three Years and upwds. & then ran away from him & never was assigned over nor lived 40 Days Servant with any person by her sd Masters Consent or knowledge

Joseph Thomas aged abt. 18 Years upon Oath saith he has been Informed & verily believes that his father Joseph Thomas Deceased Served that first three years & upwards of his Apprentiship with this Examints. Grandfather a Taylor in the Parish of St John the Baptist at Cardiff in the County of Glamorgan & never was assigned over to any other person and that he this Examint. never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servt. for one year

Michael Wall upon Oath saith he was born in the parish of Locken bridge in the County of Carlow in Ireland & never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servt . nor ever rented ten Pounds a year or paid Parish taxes

Eliz: Peers upon Oath saith she is the Wife of Thos. Peers by whom she has one Child Chas . aged abt. Ten Months and that she has been Informed & verily believes her sd husband Served his Apprentisp with Mr Mattocks a Taylor in the Parish of St. Peters at Westchester in the County of Chester & never rented ten Pounds a year paid parish taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one year

Jane Nutkins upon Oath Saith she is the wife of Geo. Nutkins (who at present absconds from her & by whom she has a Daughter (viz) Jane aged 16. Yrs. who never was Apprentice or yearly Servt. And that she has been informed her sd husband (when a Singleman) lived a Yearly Servant with one Mr Goodall a Farmer at Kenton Green in the Parish of Harrow in the County of Middx for three Years which Information this Examinant believes to be true and that abt. 5 Yrs. ago she was removed by Order of two Justices from the Parish of St Geo. Hanr Square to the afsd. Parish of Harrow which Order was not appealed agt.

Jas. Ballinden upon Oath saith he Served Seven Years Apprentiship with Mr. Webb a Salesman in the Parish of Dartford in the County of Kent and never Rented a house of Ten pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one Year

Susa Kelsey aged 15 Years upon Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a Yearly Servant for three Years with Wido Lane at Saltsford in the High Parish at Warwick at the Yearly Wages of thirty Shillings & quitted her sd. Service about one Year ago

Esther Woolridge aged upwds. of 60 Years upon Oath Saith she never was married and that above thirty Years ago she lived a Yearly Servant with Mr Withers an apothecary in St Mary Axe in the Parish of St. Andrew & Undershaft London for two Years at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds and has not since she Quitted her sd Service rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one year

Paul Dowdell upon Oath saith that upwds. of 20 Yrs. ago he lived a yearly Servant with Mr Wm. Todd at the George & Punch bowl at Tottenham Court in the Parish of Pancras in the County of Middlesex and for one Year & upwds. at the Yearly Wages of £4 and was all the time of his sd Service a Singleman And that he has not since he left Mr Todd Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one Year

Dorothy Rothwell on Behalf of Jas. Hamey aged upwds. of 7 Years & Thos. Hamey aged upwds. of 5 Yrs. upon Oath Saith that the sd. Jas. & Thos. Are the Children of Wm. Hamey by Mary his Wife both deceased as she verily believes And that she has been informed & believes the sd. Wm Hamey rented a Farm in the Parish of Kisley in Bedfordshire of the Yearly Value of Ten Pounds & upwards & lived therein Several Years

Alice Higham upon Oath Saith she never was married and that about Seven Years ago she lived a Yearly Servant with Mr Chapman in the parish of St. Mary at St. Edmundsbury in the County of Suffolk at the yearly Wages of Four Pounds for Seven Years and has not Since she quitted her sd Service rented ten Pounds a year paid parish taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one year

Cathn. Thompson upon Oath saith she is the Wido. of Joseph Thompson decd. and that she has been informed & verily believes her sd. late husband never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servt. nor ever rented ten Pounds a year or pd. Parish taxes and that his father Solomon Thompson decd. rented & lived in a house & pd Scot & Lot in the parish of Grt. Osborn in the West Riding of york for Sevl. Years & that her sd. late husbd. & herself had a Certificate Dated 27th. May 1725 from the sd. parish of Gt. Osbourn to All Saints Peasholm in the sd. County of york acknowledging them legally Settled in Great Osborn afsd.

Jane Lewis aged 23 years upon Oath Saith she never was married and that she lived a Yearly Servt. with Thos. Richards in the Parish of Tolgolthie in the County of Merioneth in Wales for two Years at the yearly Wages of 29s for the first year & 30s for the Second year quitted her sd. Service abt. 3 Yrs. ago & has not since rented Ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one year and this Examinant further upon her Voluntary Oath Saith she was delivered of a male bastard Child on the 26th. Day of March last at Mr Stanboroughs in Milford Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex which was baptized John and has been left chargeable upon the sd. Parish and that Joseph Connor a Writer did beget the sd Male bastard Child on her body the said Joseph Connor having had carnal knowledge of this Examinant sevl. times in the Month of June last several times, at the house of Mr Swallow a Writer in Chancery Lane where this Examint. then lived a Servant. at one of which times he got her with Child of the sd. Male Bastard Child of which she was delivered as aforesd. and that the sd. Joseph Connor and no other person is the true and real father thereof

Sarah Page upon Oath Saith she is the wife of John Page by whom she has 2 Childn. Mary aged upwds. of 8 Yrs. & Thomas aged upwds. of 6 years & that she has been informed & verily believes her sd. husband (whilst a Singleman) lived a yearly Servant with Mr Halsted a Farmer near the pound in Kentish Town in the Parish of Pancras in the County of Middx for one Year at the Yearly Wages of Ten Pounds and was during that Year a Singleman, & has not since, he Quitted his sd. Service rented Ten pounds a year or lived a yearly Servt. for one year

Mary Taylor Wife of Wm. Taylor (gone from her) upon Oath Saith she intermarried with the sd. Wm. Taylor at Dainham Church in Cheshire abt. 7 Yrs. ago and has by him two Childn. Mary aged abt. 6 Yrs. and Ann aged about four Years, that she can give no certain Account of the Settlemt. of her sd. husband & that her father Rt. Bostocks lived in a house of his own for several Years at Warmingham in the sd. County of Chester and this Examinant never rented ten Pounds a year Paid Parish taxes was an Apprentice or yearly Servt.

Rose Page upon Oath Saith she is the Wife of Job Page by whom she has one Child (viz) Mary aged abt. 14 Weeks & that she has been informed & verily believes her sd. husband rented and lived in a house & pd. Scot & Lot for several years in Foregate Street in the New Church Parish at Worcester & has not Since he quitted the sd. house Rented ten Pounds a year paid parish Taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one year

Margt. Connor upon Oath saith she is the Wife of Rt Connor an Irishman who never gained a Settlemt. in England and that she can give no further Accot. of his Settlement. that she has 3 Childn. by her sd. husbd. (viz) Rd. aged 4 yrs. Rt . aged 18 Months & Jno. aged one Month and that before her Intermarriage with the sd. Robt. Connor she lived a yearly Servt. for three years with Mr Russell in white fryers Street in the Parish of St. Peter in Dublin at the yearly Wages of 40 Shills

Mary Waller upon Oath saith she is the Daughter of Wm. Waller decd. by Ann his wife that neither herself nor her sd. late father ever rented ten Pounds a Year Paid Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for one Year and that her late Grand father Christr. Waller rented a house & pd Scot & Lot in Catrick Parish near Richmond in Yorkshire & there dyed.

Susa. Crawley aged abt. 25 Years upon Oath saith she never was married And that she lived a yearly Servant with Mary Reader in Fore Street in the Parish of Alhallows in the Town & County of Stretford for four Years at the Yearly Wages of Two Pounds for the first Year, Two Pounds five Shillings for the Second Year & Two Pounds ten Shills. for the two last Years of her Service that she quitted her sd. Service abt. two Years ago & has not since rented ten Pounds a Year Pd. Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one Year
Wm. Blake aged 14 years upon Oath Saith he was born in Creeklade Street at Cirencester in the County of Gloucester & never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant for one Year

Jenkin Davies upon Oath saith he Served three Years Apprentiship with Jas. Parry a Taylor in the Parish of Cranog in the County of Cardigan & never rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish taxes or lived a yearly. Servt. for one Year

Henry Elliot upon Oath Saith he rented a house of £17 by the Year at Kingston upon Hull in the County of York & lived therein about two Years quitted the sd. house upwds. of 30 Years ago & has not Since rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servant

Mary Holder upon Oath Saith she never was Married and that about 5 Years ago she was delivered of a female bastard Child at the Workhouse (belonging to the Parish of St. Andrew in Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex ) in Greys Inn Lane in the sd. Parish & County, which was baptized Alice & is still living

Chas- Smith upon Oath Saith he intermarried with his Wife Elizabeth Smith at the Fleet London upwards of 20 Years ago by lokom he has one Child (now at home with him) viz. Ann aged 13 Years who never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant and that he this Examint. Served Seven Years Apprentiship with Mr Weaver a Baker near the Opera house in the Haymarket in the Parish of St James Westmr. & never rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for one Year.

Eliz. Clatworthy upon Oath Saith she is the Wido. of Valentine Clatworthy decd. by whom she has one Child Valentine aged 18 Months and that she has been informed & verily believes her sd late husband was bound in the Parish of St. James at Taunton in the County of Somerset & never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servt. rented ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes

Cathn. Gibbons upon Oath Saith she is the Wife of Garret Gibbons who at present absconds from her & by whom she has one Child Eleanr . aged near 6 Years & that herself & her sd. husband are both Natives of Ireland & never gained a Settlement in England & her sd. husband Served his Apprentiship wth. Danl. Carty at Charlefield in the County of Cork in Ireland

Ann Heritage upon Oath saith she is the wife of Joseph Heritage ; and that at the time of her marriage to Heritage she was the Widow of Wm. Taylor who dyed upwds three Years since and by whom she has a Child now living (viz) Eliz , aged about three Years and that the sd. Wm. Taylor rented a house of the yearly Rent of £9 in Joy Lane in the Parish of St. Paul at Canterbury lived therein near two Years & Pd. to the Poor rate of the sd. Parish & there dyed & this Examinant continued to live in and rent the sd. house near a Year in her Widowhood

Fras. Bowiss on behalf of Rd. Clark a Lunatic upon Oath saith the sd. Lunatic Rd. Clark lived a Yearly Servant with the late Sd Carpenter in Grosvenor Square in the Parish of St Geo Hanr. Square in the Liberty of Westmr. for two Years & upwds. & has not Since he left the sd. Service rented ten Pounds Year paid Parish taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one Year

Eliz Cogdell upon Oath saith she is the wife of Wm. Cogdell an Irishman who never gained a Settlement in England and that at the time of her Intermarriage with the sd. Cogdell she was the wido . of Rd. Collins decd who (as she has been informed & believes) Served the last Year of his Apprentiship with Mr Cleaver a Ship Carpenter in the Parish of Kingston at Portsmouth and never rented ten Pounds a Year pd. Parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servant

Eliz Bailey upon Oath Saith she never was married and that never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant for one Year that her father John Bailey deceased rented two houses (in one of which he lived) in Stable yard in the Parish of St. Margaret in the City of Westmr . and that the Rent of one of the sd houses was £5 and of the other £5.10 by the Year and that her sd. late father never after he quitted the sd houses rented ten Pounds a Year or Paid Parish taxes

Jane Fairbrother upon Oath saith she is the Wife of Jas. Fairbrother who is now in the Workhouse belonging to the parish of St. Andw. Holbn. above Barrs in the County of Middlx and that she has been informed & believes her sd husband Served his Apprentiship with a Cabinet maker an Hare Street Hill in the sd. parish of St. Andw Holborn above Barrs & never rented ten Pounds a Year Paid Parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for one Year

Hannh. Adams upon Oath saith she never was married and never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant rented ten Pounds a year or pd. Parish Taxes And that she has been informed & believes her father Tho. Adams decd. Served his Apprentiship with a Sawyer in Bridewall Precinct London and never rented ten Pounds a Year paid parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Brown aged abt. 30 Years upon Oath Saith she never was married and that she was bound Apprentice to one Mrs. Kidder and lived with her for the Space of one Year at Garlickhith in the Parish of St James at Garlickhithe London, that she afterwards absconded from her sd Mistress & never was assigned over nor rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for one Year

Mary Geaton upon Oath Saith she is the Wife of John Geaton who never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant rented ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish taxes to her knowledge and that she has been informed and believes her sd. late husbands father lived in a house of his own in High Street Portsmouth

Ann Harris upon Oath Saith she is the Wido . of Wm. Harris to whom she was married at the Fleet London on the 30th. of Janry upwds. of 13 Yrs. ago & by whom she has one Child Wm. aged abt. 12 Yrs. and that she has been further informed & believes her sd. late husband was born in Ram Alley in the parish of St. Dunstan in the West Londn. and, of his Settlemt. she can give us further Accot. And this Examint. further upon her Voluntary Oath Saith the sd. Wm. Harris went beyond Sea about two months after the Birth of her first Child & dyed never returned to England again but dyed abroad, without ever having Seen this Examint. from the time he first Set Sail and that about Eight Years ago she was delivered of a male bastard Child in the house of Mr Wint a Watch maker in Shoe Lane near Holborn in the Parish of St. Andw. Holbn . London which was baptized John & is still living and that Mr. Douglas who was Waggon master General of the Army did beget the sd. male bastard Child on her Body and the sd. Douglas & no Man else is the true & real father thereof

Eleanr. Egan upon Oath Saith she is the wife of Edwd. Egan & by whom she has twin Childn. (Viz) Eleanr . & Mary aged near two Years and that her sd. husband & herself are both Natives of Ireland & never gained a Settlemt. in England and that her sd. husband was bora at Omey in the County of Tyrone in Ireland & never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servt. rented Ten Pounds a Year or pd. Parish taxes
Peter Jempsey upon Oath saith he was born at Linster in Kings County in Ireland & never was an apprentice or yearly Servt. nor ever rented ten pounds a year or paid parish Taxes

Jno. Joell aged abt. 56 Years upon Oath Saith he intermarried with is Wife Frances (aged abt. 42) at the Fleet London four Months ago & that about 25 years ago he rented a house of the Yearly Rent Off Eleven Pounds in Long Lane in the Parish of St. Bartholemew the Great London & lived therein two years & that he has not since he quitted the sd. house Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizath. Roberts aged Thirty Six Years upon her Voluntary Oath Saith she never was married and that in the Month of December last she was delivered of a male bastard Child and Mr. Austine in Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Clemt. Danes which was baptized Jno . & is & likely to become Chargeable to the sd. Parish of St. Clemt. Danes she being Poor & unable to maintain the same and that she is now Pregnant with Child or Children which is likely to be born a bastard or bastards & to become Chargeable to the afsd. Parish of St Clemt. Danes and that John Ragg a Dresser at Drury Lane Play house did beget the aforesaid Male bastd. Child named John on her body & likewise the sd bastard Child or Childn. with which She is now Pregnant the sd. Jno. Ragg & this Examint. having for Sevl. Years past cohabited together as man & Wife during which he the sd. Regg has had carnal Knowledge of her body Sevl. times at one of which times he got her with Child of the afsd. male bastd. Child named John & of the Bastd. Child or Childn with which she is now Preganant & that the said John Ragg & no other person is the true & real father thereof and this Examinant further upon

Eliz Robinson aged upwds. of 14 Yrs. upon Oath Saith she never was married & that she was bound Apprentice by the Church Wards. & Oversr. of the Poor of the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields to Mrs. Higgens a Quilter & lived with the sd. Mrs. Higgens as her Apprentice at the Ship in Bow Street in the parish of St Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westmr. upwds. of her Years & then ran away from her sd. Parish & never was assigned over to any other person

Thomas Gibbons aged 18 years upon Oath Saith he was bound out Apprentice by the Church wds. & Oversrs of the Poor of the Parish of St Giles in the fields to Mr. Roach a Coffin plate Engraver & lived with him in Bartholemew Close in the Parish of St. Bartholemew the Great London about two Years then ran away from his sd master & never was assigned over to any other Person

John Lockey aged abt. 35 years upon Oath Saith he intermarried with his Wife Hannah Maria at the Fleet London on the 11th. Day of March which was in the year 1751 and that when he was about Twelve Years of age he lived with Mr Hurlock a Surgeon in Coleman Strt. in the Parish of St. Stephen Coleman Strt. Lodn. for Two Years & upwds. at the Yearly Wages of Two Pounds Diet & Lodging and has not since he quitted his sd. Services rented ten Pounds a year paid parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one Year

Eliz Ward aged 14 yrs. upon Oath Saith She was born in Johnsons Court Charing Cross in the Parish of St Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. & never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant for one Year

Lucy Lovett aged 14 Yrs. upon Oath Saith she has been informed & believes she was been ever Mandlin Bridge in the Parish of St. Peter in the East in Oxford & never was an Apprentice on yearly Servt. for one year.
David Lloyd aged 16 years upon Oath Saith he was born at Llangaetho in Cardeganshire & never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servt . for one Year

Ann Waight upon Oath saith she is the Wife of Geo Waight by whom she has one Child now with by Mary aged abt. 6 months & that her sd. husband rented a house in Stoney Step Court in the Parish of St. Ann in Blackfryers London of the Years Rent of £14 lived there in abt. 7 months quitted the same upwds. of 11 yrs. ago & has not since rented Ten Pounds a Year or pd. Parish Taxes

Ann Dodd aged 21 yrs. upon Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a yearly Servant with Mrs. Ogilby in Warwick Street in the Parish of St James in the Liberty of Westmr. at the yearly wages Four pounds for two Years or thereabouts quitted her sd. Service about two years ago & has not since rented a ten Pounds a year paid parish taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one year
