Mary B y eard upon Oath Saith she is the Wido. of Henry B y eard who has been dead near 4 years and that her sd. late husband (as she has been informed & verily believes Served his Apprentiship with John Storey a Blacksmith at Walham Green in the Parish of Fulham in the County of Middlesex and never rented ten pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one year no has this Examinant since his Decease rented ten Pounds a year paid parish Taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one year
John Hart upon his Oath saith he was born in the Parish of Donnaghmore in the County of Tyrone in Ireland & never gained a Subsequent Settlemt. to his knowledge

Abraham Buckley upon Oath saith he was married to his Wife Ann Buckley near 9 years ago at the Fleet London and that he never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant not ever rented ten pounds a yr. or pd. parish Taxes and that his father John Buckley about two years before this Examinants sd Intermarriage took a house of the yearly Rent of £18 and upwards in Oxford Road in the Parish of St. Maryle bone in the County of Middx & lived therein 5 or 6 yrs. & from there removed to a house when he now rents in the same Road & Parish

Ann Pearce aged abt. 47 yrs. upon Oath Saith she is the Wido: of Danl. Pearce who dyed abt. 10 years ago & that she has been informed & verily believes her sd. husband was born at Westchester in the County of Chester & she can give no further Account of his Settlement & that since the Decease of her sd. husband she has not rented Ten Pounds by the year paid Parish taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one year

Sarah Wright upon her Oath Saith she never was married and that she was bound Apprentice for five years to Mrs. Prit a Mantua maker in Bride Lane London & Served her sd. Mistress upwards of three years of the sd. term & then absconded from her Service & never was assigned over to any other person or lived with any person as a Servant with her sd. Mistress Consent and that during her sd. Service with Mrs. Prit she continually Lodged with her Mother at Mr Johnsons the Corner of Ormond Street in the Parish of St. Geo: Queen Square in the County of Middlesex Says she never rented ten pounds a year pd. parish taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one Year

Mary Gamidge upon Oath saith she is the wife of Saml. Gamidge with whom she intermarried on the 30th. of Augt. 1747 at the Fleet London and that her Sd husband lived a yearly Servant for two Years or thereabts. before his sd. intermarriage with Mr Shuckburgh a Book seller in Fleet Street in the parish of St. Dunstan in the West London & quitted his sd. Service abt. two Years ago; since which he has not rented ten pounds a year or paid parish taxes

Wm. Cross aged about 68 years upon Oath saith he intermarried with Alice his wife aged abt. 55 yrs. in the Parish Church of St. Philip at Bristol and that about 9 years ago he rented a house of Nineteen Pounds by the Year in Earles Court Cranborn Street in the Parish of St. Ann in the Liberty of Westmr. lived therein upwds. of 3 Years and has not since he quitted the sd. house rented ten Pounds by the year or pd. parish taxes

Mary Lewis aged abt. 26 Yrs. upon Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a yearly Servt. with Mr. Phillips in the parish of Yarpoole in the County of Hereford upwards of one Year and has not Since rented ten pounds a year paid parish taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one Year.

Benj. Sabire upon Oath saith he has a wife named Mary and by her a Child Benjn. Peter aged 18 months that he never was an apprentice or yearly Servt. for one Year nor did he ever rent ten pounds a year or pay parish taxes that his father was a Norman & his mother a Native of Britany in France and that he this Examinant was born in the parish of St. Ann in the Liberty of Westmr.

Jane Ann Murphy upon Oath saith she was born opposite the meeting house in Swallow Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. & never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant nor ever rented ten pounds a Year or pd. parish taxes and that her father & mother were both Natives of Ireland and never gained a Settlemt. in England to her knowledge

Mary White upon Oath Saith she never was married and that she lived a yearly Servant with Mr King a Mason opposite the printing house in the parish of St. Maudlin in Oxford for 5 Years at the Yearly Wages of £2 quitted her sd. Service abt. 3 Yrs. ago and has not since rented ten pounds a Yr. pd. parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for one Year

Jno. Newton aged 14 Yrs. upon Oath saith he has was born at Gosport in Hampshire and never was an Apprentice or yearly Servt. and that his father as he informed this Ext. was a Native of Ireland & never gained a Settlemt. in England to his knowledge or belief.

Sarah Taylor aged 31 yrs. upon Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a yearly Servt. with Mr. Edwards in the parish of all Saints in the City of Hereford near two Years at the yearly Wages of Two pounds and left her sd. Service near twelve months ago since which she has not rented ten pounds a year or pd. parish taxes

Eliz Riley upon Oath saith she is the Wido. of Tho. Riley & has not since her sd. late husband decease rented ten pounds a Year paid parish taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one Year and that she has been informed & verily believes her sd. late husband Served his Apprentiship with Mr Waley a Gunlock maker in the parish of Bilson in the County of Stafford & never gained a Subsequent Settlemt. to her knowledge or belief

Saml Long on behalf of Ann Long his Daughter aged abt. 12 Yrs. maketh Oath that he intermarried with his late Wife Ann Long the mother of the sd. Ann Long abt. fourteen years ago at Crofton Church in Yorkshire and that before his sd. marriage and whilst a Singleman he lived a yearly Servant with Sr Rowland Hynn at Noveall hall in the Parish of Rugby in the County of York upwds. of two years at the yearly Wages of Seven pounds that he was married to the said Ann Long while in Sr. Rowlands Service & has not since rented ten Pounds a year or paid parish taxes

Rachael Tomkins upon Oath saith saith she is the Wife of Michael Tomkins (a Sailor abroad in his Majesties Service) and that her sd. husband informed her & she verily belives he Served Seven years apprentiship wth. Master of a Collier at Shields in the County of Durham and never was a yearly Servant nor over rented ten pounds a year or pd. parish taxes

John Pritchard aged upwds. of 60 years upon Oath Saith he Served Seven years Apprentiship with his father Jno. Pritchard a Shoemaker in the parish of Kensington in the County of Middx and never was a yearly Servt. nor ever rented ten pounds a year paid parish taxes

Ann Wish aged 23 years upon Oath saith she never was married & never was an Apprentice or yearly Servt. for one Year and that her father Austin Wish now rented a house of the yearly Rent of £10 Pounds opposite the horse & Groom in Eagle Street in the parish of St. Geo in Queen Square in the County of Middlesex and has lived in & Rented the said house for 4 or 5 yrs. last past

Mary Cooley aged abt. 30 years upon Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a yearly Servant with Mrs. Richardson in James Street in the parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster for one Year & 9 months at the yearly Wages of three pounds & ten Shillings for the first Year & Four Pounds afterwards quitted her sd. Service abt. 10 Yrs. ago & has not since rented ten pounds a year paid parish taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one year

Sarah Allen aged 19 years upon Oath saith she never was married. that she was born at Tilbey in the County of Hants where her father lived in and rented a house and Paid Scot & Lot. and that she never was an apprentice or yearly Servant for one Year

Rt Bold upon Oath saith he Served Seven years Apprentiship wth. Lawrance Martin a broad Cloth Weaver at Goodhampton in Wilts & never rented ten Pounds a year paid parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servt. for one year
James Bourne upon Oath saith he was born at Drogheda in Ireland and never was an apprentice or yearly Servant nor ever rented ten pounds by the Year or paid parish taxes

James Bourne upon Oath saith he has been informed he was born in the parish of Dromisahen in the County of Lought in Ireland & that he lived a yearly Servant for one year and upwds. with Patrick Costaghan in the sd. parish and has not since rented ten pounds by the year or paid parish taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Eliz Wilson upon Oath saith she is the wido. of Major Wilson who dyed about two Years ago and by whom she has two Children (viz) Esther aged upwds. of 7 Yrs. and John aged upwds. of four Years and that she was informed by her sd. late husband he was bound Apprentice for Seven Years to John Stone Junr. a Baker and after having lived with him about a year was assigned over to John Stone Sevl. with whom he Served the remaining five Years of his sd. apprentiship at Edmonton in the County of Middx which Information this Examinant verily believes and that neither her sd. late husband in his life as he further informed her nor has this Examint. Since his Decease rented ten pounds a Year paid parish taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one year

Mary Wall upon Oath saith she is the wido . of Silvester Wm. Wall and that her sd. late husbd. informed this Examint. he Served his Apprentiship with Mr Williams a Carpenter in Chiswell Street in the parish of St Luke Middx. and never Rented ten Pounds by the Year paid parish taxes nor lived a Yearly Servt. for one Year which information she believes to be true and this Examint. further maketh Oath that she has not since the Decease of her sd. late husband rented ten pounds by the Year Paid Parish taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one Year

John Marlton upon Oath saith he Served his Apprentiship with Jno. Poole a Hatter in the Maze in the Parish of St. Olas Southwark in the County of Surry and never rented ten pounds by the Year paid parish taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one Year

Sarah Robinson aged about 23 Years upon Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a Yearly Servant with Mrs. Fewsdale at Doncaster in Yorkshire was two Years at the Yearly wages of Thirty Shillings for the first Year and Two Pounds afterwards and has not since she quitted her sd. Service (which is abt. 7 Yrs. ago) rented ten pounds by the Year paid parish Taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one Year.

Ann Bellasyse upon Oath saith she is the wido. of Wm. Henry Bellasyse who dyed about 4 weeks since to whom she was married in the parish Church of St. Martin at Birmingham on the 9th. of May 1746 & by whom she has four Children (viz.) Margt . aged upwds. of Seven Years Richard aged upwds. of five years Ann aged upwds. of three Years & Wm. Henry aged nearly Six Months And this Examinant further maketh Oath her sd. late husband informed her he was bound Apprentice by Indrs dated 7th. Janry 1740 for Seven Years to Jas. Hardey a Silver Turner & lived wth. the sd. Jas. Hardey as his apprentice in Maiden Lane near Haberdashershale in the parish of St. John Zachary London near three years at the End of which time he was discharge from his sd. Master & that he never was assigned over to any other person nor ever rented ten Pounds by the Year or Paid Parish taxes. All which Information this Examt. believes to be true

Susa. Smith aged about 13 Years upon Oath saith she is the Daughter of John Smith deceased by Susanna his wife (who has left this Examinant) and that she has been often told her sd. late father was born at Skillgate in the County of Devon and Served his Apprentiship with a Carpenter there which information She believes to be true and that she this Examinant never was an apprentice or yearly Servant for one year

Ann Cuthbert aged upwds. of 40 Years upon Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a yearly Servant with Mrs. Scattergood in Princes Street in the parish of St George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westmr . at the yearly Wages of Four pounds for one Year and upwards and quitted her sd. Service abt. Eight years ago Since which she has not rented ten Pounds a year paid Parish taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Threckingham aged 26 years upon Oath Saith she never was married and that she lived a yearly Servant with Mrs. Ellit upwds. of 2 Yrs. at Mr Conlstons a books in Fleur do his Court in the parish of St. Dunstan in the west London at the Yearly Wages of Twenty Shillings dyet Washing & lodging quitted her sd. Service 5 or 6 Years ago and has not since rented ten Pounds a year paid Parish taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one yr.

Ann Brown upon Oath saith she is the wido . of Barnaby Brown by whom she has a Child Rowland aged abt. 11 Years, who never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servt. and that her sd. late husband frequently informed this Examinant he was born at Glenduse in the Shire of Galloway in Scotland and never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant Rented ten Pounds a Year or pd. parish taxes which information she believes to be true

Roger Russell upon Oath saith he Served 7 Yrs. Apprentiship with Fras. Windows a Taylor in Helliers Land in the parish of St John Baptist in Bristol & never rented ten pounds by the year paid parish Taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one Year

Teresa Johnson wife of John Johnson and Martha Gowtery severally make Oath and first this Examt. Teresa Johnson upon Oath saith about or 12 Yrs. ago she intermarried with her sd. husband Jno Johnson at the Fleet London by whom she hath two Childn. (viz) Eliza . Martha aged abt. 5 Yrs. & Frances Abigail aged abt. 2 Yrs. Says her sd. husband has been gone from her abt. 6 months and that she does not know where he is nor can she give any Accot. of his Settlemt. other than that she has heard him Say he was born at Coventry & this Examint. being poor was maintained in her lying in at the charge of the Inhabitantly of St Clemet Danes Middx. And this Examint. Martha Gowtery upon Oath saith she is well acquainted with the above named John Johnson and that the sd. John Johnson Served Six Years or thereabouts of his Apprentiship wth. Thos. Munsloe at Warsall below the still in the Parish of Warsall in the County of Stafford (this Examt. living at Warsall at the same time) and after that the sd. Johnson run away from his sd. Master & came to London as she has been informed & believes

John Jarvis upon Oath saith he intermarried with his Wife Ann Jarvis in the Parish Church of St Martin at Worcester in the Year 1712 that in the year 1710 he was hired to Mr. Morton a Druggist at the yearly Wages of £6 and lived with the sd. Mr Morton under that hiring & agreemt. opposite Creechurch in the Parish of St Cathn. Creechurch London upwds. of one Year (during which he continued a Singleman & that he has not since he left his sd. Service rented ten Pounds by the year paid Parish taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one Year

Hannah Dalton upon Oath saith she is the Wido. of Saml. Dalton by whom she has one Child Cathn. aged near 8 Yrs. that her sd. late husband was an Irishman and never gained a Settlemt. in England and that she this Examinant was born in West Street in in the City of Westchester where her father lived in & rented a house as she has been informed and that she never was an Apprentice or yearly Servt. nor ever rented ten pounds by the year or pd. Parish Taxes

Ann Everet aged abt. 70 Yrs. upon Oath saith she is the Wido. of Jas Everet who dyed abt. 30 Yrs. since & that between 5 & 6 Yrs. ago this Examt. rented a house of Fifteen Pounds by the Year in Aldersgate Street in the Parish of St. Botolph witht. Aldersgate London lived therein upwds. of one Year & has not since she quitted the Same rented ten pounds by the Year paid parish taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one Year

Mary Quin aged upwds. of 40 Years upon Oath Saith she never was married & that she lived a yearly Servt. with Mrs. Atkins at the Corner of New Street near Carnaby Market in the Parish of St James in the Liberty of Westmr. for two Years & upwds. at the Yearly Wages of Ten Pounds, quitted her sd Service abt. 9 Yrs. ago & has not since rented ten pounds a year paid parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servt. for one Year

Danl. Jones upon Oath saith he Served three Years & upwds. of his Apprentiship witht Mr Benjamin Hopkins a Butcher in Tower Street in the Parish of St. Alhallows Barking London and then his Master Left of Trade & gave this Examint. lease to provide for himself in what manner he thought proper and that he never was assigned over nor ever rented ten pounds by the year or pd. parish taxes

James Jones aged abt. Thirty Years Upon Oath Saith that her was Bound an Apprentice to and Served Seven Years Apprentiship with his father Jno. Jones a Whipmaker in the City of Winchester in the County of Hants Says he Served the last Year of his sd. Apprentiship in the Parish of St. Lawrance in the City of Winchester aforesd. that he never Rented Ten pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes Served a Parochiall Office or hired a Yearly Servt. for one Year

Henry King upon Oath saith he was married to his Wife Mary King at Mayfair Chapel on the 3d. of Septr. 1750 and that about 3 Yrs. ago he rented a house of the yearly Rent of Ten pounds in Mercey Street in the Parish of St Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr . and lived therein upwds. of two months and has not since he quitted the sd house rented ten pounds by the Year or paid Parochial Taxes

Rebecca Gear Aged abt. Forty Nine Years Upon Oath Saith She is the Wido. of Jno. Gear that the sd. Jno. Gear lived in & Rented a House in Pichadilly in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. for Seven Years or thereabts. at the Yearly Rent of Thirty three pounds that the sd. Jno. Gear after he quitted sd. House never Rented Ten pounds a Year or pd. Parish Taxes neither hath this Examinant Since his death rented Ten pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for One Year

Ann Cawthorne on behalf of Eliz Johnson an Infant aged Eleven Years the Daughter of Thomas Johnson by Elizth . his Wife both deceased upon Oath saith the sd. Thos. Johnson Informed this Examinant he Served his time with Mr Barnes a Cutler at Shefield in the County of York and never rented ten pounds by the Year paid Parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year

John Sirett upon Oath saith he is abt. 27 years of age that he never was an apprentice or yearly Servant nor ever Rented ten Pounds by the year or paid parochial taxes that his father John Sirett deceased rented a house in the Old Change in the Parish of St. Gregory by St. Paul London of the yearly Rent of £20 and upwds. lived therein Sevl. Years & there dyed and his late mother Susa. Sirett after his father decease rented a house of Five pounds by the year in Pissing Alley Night Ryder Strt. in the same Parish & these dyed

12th June 1784 Danl Williams aged abt. 15 Yrs. upon Oath Saith he never was an apprentice & that he has been informed & verily believes his father David Williams rented a house of the yearly Rent of Ten pounds in South Side Street in the New Church Parish at Plymouth in the County of Devon lived therein abt. three months & quitted the same abt. 7 Yrs. ago Since which he has not rented ten pounds by the year or pd. Parish taxes

Geo: Wilson upon Oath saith he intermarried with his Wife Margt . upwds. 21 Years ago at the Fleet London and that by Indenture dated the 9th. May 1733 he bound himself apprentice for four Years and five months to Gilbert Hunt a Feltmaker and lived with the sd. Hunt upwards of three years as his apprentice and then they parted by Consent and that he lodged the last two months of the sd. three Years wth. at his brother in Law in little Peter Street in the Parish of St. John the Evangelist in Westmr and that he never rented ten pounds by the year Paid Parish taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one Year

Margt. Simpson upon Oath Saith she is the Wife of John Simpson (gone from her) to whom she was married at the Fleet London on the 11th. Decr. 1750 and by whom she has one Child Ann aged near 20 months and that she has been informed & verily believes her sd husband (whilst a Singleman) lived a yearly Servant wth. Coll Mading for the Space of three Years at the Yearly Wages of Four pounds for the first Year & six pounds by the Year afterwards and lodged the last two months of his sd Service at his Masters Stables in Ham Yard in the Parish of St. Geo Hanr Square in the Liberty of Westmr. that he left Coll Madings Service abt. 6 Yrs. ago & has not since rented ten Pounds a year paid Parish taxes or lived a yearly Servt (in any part of Great Britain) for one Year and this Examinant further maketh Oath that she was at the time of her marriage wth. the abovementioned John Simpson the Wido. of Thomas Harrison to whom she was married in Dublin about 20 Years ago, that the sd. Harrison rented a house in Hady Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. afsd of the Yearly Rent of £17 lived therein two or three Years & quitted the sd house upwds. of 10 Yrs. ago; that the sd. Tho Harrison never afterwards rented ten pounds by the year or pd. Parish taxes And that She has one Child by him now living (viz) Mark aged abt. 9 Yrs

Sarah Hames aged 16 Years upon Oath Saith she never was married and that she lived a yearly Servant with Mr Reece a Sugar Baker in Lewins Mead in the Parish of St. James in Bristol at the Yearly wages of Three Pounds lived therein upwds. of 1 Yr. & has quitted her sd Service abt. 9 months; Since which she has not rented ten Pounds by the year or paid Parish taxes

Fras Band upon Oath saith he was married to his Wife Elizabeth at the Fleet London near 18 Yrs. ago and that he was bound Apprentice for Seven Years to John Booker a Sawyer & lived wth. him abt. 5 Yrs. of the sd. term & then his sd. master broke that the last two Years of the sd. term of five Years this Examint. lodged in his sd Masters house in the East Side of Fleet Ditch in the Parish of St. Ann in Blackfryers London and that he never was assigned ever to any other person nor ever rented ten pounds by the year pd. Parish taxes nor lived Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Gamidge upon Oath Saith she is the wife of Samuel Gamidge with whom she intermarried on the 30th. Augt. 1747 at the Fleet London and that her said husband Lived a yearly Servant for One Year upwards before his said intermarriage & a considerable time afterwds with Mr Shuckburgh a Bookseller in Fleet Street in the Parish of St. Dunstan in the west London and quitted his Said Service about two Years ago since which she has not rented ten Pounds by the Year nor paid Parish taxes

Cathn. Crump upon Oath Saith she is the wife of John Crump to whom she was married at the Fleet London upwds. of 4 Yrs. ago and that her sd. husband he Informed her he lived a yearly Servant with Ld. Thanet for the Space of one Year and upwards (whilst a singleman) and lay the last three months of his said Service over the Stables adjoining to my Lordshouse in North Audley Street in the Parish of St George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westmr. (which Information this Examinant believes to be true) and that her sd husband has not since he quitted Ld Thanet Service rented ten Pounds by the year paid Parish taxes to this Examinants knowledge or belief

Rachel Broadbridge aged 18 Years upon Oath Saith she is the Daughter of John Broadbridge by Mary his Wife deceased that her sd. father informed her he Served his time with Jno. Jane a Thread Throwster in the parish of St. Martin at Reading in the County of Berks and that she this Examinant rever was married nor ever was an apprentice or yearly Servt. for One Year

Mary Egan upon Oath Saith she is the wido . of John Egan who dyed abt. 10 Weeks ago and that she has been informed & verily believes her sd. late husband was born in the Parish of Balnaskreen in the County of Derry in Ireland & she can give no further accot. of his Settlemt. & that she this Examint. is likewise a Native of Ireland & never gained a Settlemt. in England

Sarah Newman upon Oath Saith she is the Wife of Edwd. Newman (gone from her) to whom she was married at the Fleet abt. two Years since & by whom she has one Child Sarah aged nine months Says she has been informed & verily believes her sd. husband was born in Hide Street in the Parish of St. Barthw . in the City of Winchester & never was an apprentice or yearly Servant nor ever rented ten pounds by the Year or pd. parish taxes

Rt Hayward aged 77 Years upon Oath Saith he was married to his Wife Ann Hayward at Grantham in Lincolnshire abt . 33 Yrs. ago. That upwards of 50 Years (being than a Singleman ) he Covenanted (by Indenture in Writing) to live with Mr John Shaw a Gunsmith for four Years certain at the Wages of two Shillings by the week for the first Year three Shillings by the week the second & third Years & four Shillings by the week during the last Year. besides Lodging & Dyet during the whole term and that he lodged during the sd. four Years in Mr Shaws House at the Horse Guards in the parish of St Margaret in the Liberty of Westmr. That he has not since he quitted the sd. Service rented about of Ten Pounds by the Yr. paid parochial Taxes nor lived a yearly Servt for one Year

Martha Burvell upon Oath Saith she is the wido . of Jas. Burvell decd. and that she has been often told by her sd. late husband he was born in the Parish of St James at Dover in the County of Kent which Information she verily believes to be true and that she can give no further Accot. of his Settlemt.

Jas. Culverwell upon Oath Saith he never was an apprentice or yearly Servant and that he is the Son of John Culverwell by Mary his Wife and that he has been informed & verily believes his sd. father rented and lived in a house in the Parish of St. James in the City of Bath of the yearly Rent of £19 & received relief some time Since from the said Parish for himself his Wife & this Examint. they being at that time ill wth. a fever

Richd: Geo: Gridley upon Oath Saith he has been informed & verily believes his late father Michal. Gridley decd. lived a yearly Servant whilst a Singleman wth. Mr Mathew Woodward a Corn chandler at the Corner of Wormwood Street in Bishopgate Street in the Parish of St. Ethelburga London for one Year and & upwards at the yearly Wages of £10 and quitted the sd Mr Woodwards Service abt. 40 Years ago and never afterwards rented ten pounds by the Year paid parochial Taxes nor lived a yearly Servt. for one Year And this Examinant further maketh Oath that he was married to his Wife Eliz. Gridley at Birmingham new Church about Eighteen months ago by whom he has one Child (viz) Richd. aged upwds. of three Months and that he this Examinant never was an apprentice or yearly Servant nor ever Rented ten Pounds by the Year nor paid parochial Taxes

Mathew Warwick upon Oath Saith he was married to his late wife Mary Warwick deced at St. Giles Church in Northampton upwds. of 26 Years ago by whom he has two Children Hannah aged 7 Years & William aged 14 Months and that he served Seven Years apprentiship with Christr. Painter a Butcher in Stony Stratford in the parish of St. Mary Maudlin in the County of Bucks and never rented Ten Pounds by the Year paid Parish taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Heritage upon Oath saith she was married to Joseph Heritage at Camberwell Church upwards of two Years ago by whom she has one Child Ann aged upwds. of one Year (that her sd. husband at present absconds from her) and she has been informed & verily believes he Served his Apprentiship with his father Mr Heritage a Carpenter in the Parish of Bansworth in the County of Worcester and never rented ten Pounds by the Year paid Parish Taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one Year

Jane Gladman aged about 50 Years upon Oath Saith she never was married and that she lived a yearly Servant wth. Mrs. Mary Godfrey in Southampton Street in the Parish of St Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westmr. for Seven Years & upwards at the yearly Wages of £6 quitted her sd Service abt. one Year ago and has not since rented ten Pounds by the year on pd. Parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year

Mary Woodward aged abt. 22 Years upon Oath saith she never was married nor ever rented ten pounds by the Year paid parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year that her father Isaac Woodward now lives in a house of his own in the parish of Woodford in the County of Essex and has paid Parochial Taxes for the same

Mary Woodward aged abt. 22 Years upon Oath saith she never was married and that she was hired to live a servant with Mr. Ashby a Collar maker for one Year certain at the Yearly Wages of thirty Shillings & lived with the sd. Mr. Ashby under the sd. hiring and Agreemt. in the parish of Chigwell in the County of Essex for one Year that she left her sd. Service near 6 Yrs. ago & has not since rented ten pounds a year paid Parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Todd upon Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a yearly Servant with Adam Gordon at the Blackhorse opposite Catherine Street in the parish of St Mary le Strand for thirteen months & upwards (Successively) at the yearly Wages of £ four pounds ten Shillgs. that she quitted her sd. Service about five or Six Years and has not since rented ten pounds by the year paid parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year

Eliz. Deacon aged abt. 40 Years upon Oath Saith she never was married and that she lived a yearly Servant wth St Joseph Aylesse Bart in Carey Street in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middx for three years and upwards at the yearly Wages of Five pounds for the first year and Six pounds by the year afterwards that she quitted her sd. Service upwards of 15 years ago and has not since rented ten pounds by the year paid Parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servt. for one year

Wm. Adams of Theobalds Court near Red Lyon Square (on behalf of Mark King aged abt. 10 years Cathn King aged 3 Yrs. and William King aged abt. 10 Months the Children of Thos. King by Rose his wife both decd.) upon Oath saith the said late Thos King father of the abovenamed Children Served his Apprentiship with Richard Hagget a Taylor in the Parish of Wells in the County of Norfolk and afterwards lived in a house of his own there and paid to the poor of the sd. parish and that afterwards the Parish Officers of the parish of Wells granted a Certificate to the said Thomas King acknowledging him to be an Inhabitant legally settled in the sd. Parish and that the sd Thomas King never after he left Wells rented ten pounds by the year paid parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one Year to this Examints knowledge or beleif

William Dan upon Oath Saith he never was married & that he lived a yearly Servant with Mrs. Evers at the Noahs Ark in King Strt. in Charles Parish at Plymouth in the County of Devon at the yearly Wages of Seven pounds for three years quitted his sd Service about 4 yrs. ago and has not since rented ten pounds a Yr. paid Parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year

Ann Morse aged near 24 years upon Oath saith she never was married and that she is the Daughter of Peter Morse by Hannh . his Wife both deceased that her sd. late father dyed abt. 14 Yrs. ago and her sd. late mother after his decease and while she remained a Widow rented a house known by the sign of the Footman in Waiting in Feathers Court in Fox Court near Greys Inn Lane in the parish of St. Andw. in Holborn above Barrs Middx of the yearly Rent of Ten pounds & upwards and lived therein about three months and then was married to a second husband and this Ext. further saith she never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant for one year nor ever rented ten pounds by the year nor pd. parish taxes

Lucy Hasledine on behalf of Thomas Hasledine a Lunatic upon Oath saith she has often been informed by the sd. Thomas Hasledine Whilst in his perfect Seases that he was born at French Lane in the County of Salop

Sarah French on behalf of Prudence Dixon aged abt. 8 Years Daughter of Fras. Dixon by Prudence his wife deceased upon her Oath saith she has been Informed & verily believes the said Fras Dixon about three Years ago took a house opposite the Red bull in little St Martins Lane in the parish of St. Ann in the Liberty of Westmr. at the yearly Rent of £16 one that he lived therein near two Years and has not since he quitted the same rented ten pounds by the year nor pd parish taxes

Ann Davis aged 21 Years upon Oath Saith she never was married and that she was bound Apprentice by the Trustees of St Clemts. Charity School to Goodwin Wido. for the term of Seven Years & lived with the sd. Mrs. Goodwin abt. Nine months in St. Martins Court in the parish of St Martin in the fields Westmr at the End of which she dyed and this Examint. never was a yearly Servant for one Year nor ever rented ten pounds by the Year nor pd. Parish Taxes

Edmd. Groves upon Oath saith he was married to Eliz : his Wife at the parish Church of St Margaret Westmr. abt. 19 Years ago and that he Rented a house of the Yearly Rent of Ten pounds between Parsons Green and Fulham in the parish of Fulham in the County of Middx lived therein about 16 Yrs. & hath left the same about 18 months; since which, he has not rented ten pounds by the Year nor pd. parish Taxes

Catherine Martin of Plough Court Carey Street in the parish of St Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex on behalf of Ann Martin aged abt. Ten years upon Oath Saith the sd. Ann Martin is the Natneal Daughter of this Examinants brother Gabriel Martin deceased and that the said Ann Martin was born in the parish of St Botolph witht. Bishop- gate London as she has been informed & verily believes

Wm Napper upon Oath saith he was married to his Wife Hannah at the Fleet London abt. 2 Years ago and that he Served Seven Years Apprentiship with Mr Parry a ship Carpenter & lodged the first 3 years (or thereabouts) of that term in his sd masters house in Poplar in the parish of St. Dunstan at Stepney in the County of Middlesex and the remaining four Years in a house to which his sd master removed in Blackwall Yard in the same parish that he never rented ten pounds by the year pd. Parish Taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one Year

Alice Wilkinson (on behalf of John Silk , Sarah Silk & Jonas Silk the Children of Jonas Silk by Jane his wife) maketh Oath that the sd Jonas Silk , the father of the above Children rented a house in Exeter Street in the parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westmr. in the year 1749 and paid to the poor Rate of the sd. parish and that since he quitted the sd house the sd. Jonas Silk has not rented ten pounds a year nor paid Parish Taxes as this Examinant has been informed & believes

Mary Dougan aged abt. 21 Years upon Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a yearly Servant with Mr Hughes at the yearly Wages of Fifty Shillings for one Year & upwards that the last three months of her said Service she constantly lay in her sd masters house in Great Wild Street in the Parish of St Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex that she Quitted her sd Service abt. 6 months ago and has not since rented ten pounds by the year nor pd. parish Taxes

Elizth. Mallard aged abt. Twenty five Years Upon Oath says she was never Married & never was an apprentice or yearly Servt. for One Year says her father Richd. Mallard Served Seven Years Apprentiship with Mr. Jas. Bend a printer in the precinct of White Fryers London says her sd. father never rented Ten pounds a year pd. parish Taxes or Served any parochiall Office

Ann Kilmister aged about 68 Years upon Oath saith she is the wife of Chas. Kilmister who now lives in a Leasehold house of his own in Salisbury Street in the Parish of St Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr . Which house this Examinant verily believes would Lett for twenty pounds a year or thereabouts

Ann Harmony Wido. of John Harmony who dyed abt. 5 Years ago upon Oath saith she was married to her said late husband about 25 years ago at the Fleet London and has by him a Daughter (Viz) Jane aged near 15 years who never was an apprentice or yearly Servant for one year and that her sd. late husband rented a house in Smarts Buildings near the Cole yard in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex and lived therein about 18 months and that her sd. late husband never after he quitted the sd house nor has this Examint. since his decease rented ten pounds by the year nor pd. Parish taxes

Geo. Fisher upon Oath saith he rented a house in Castle Street Oxford Road in the Parish of St Mary le bone in the County of Middlx of the yearly Rent of Ten pounds and upwds. lived therein about 3 years and hath left the sd house about five years, since which he has not rented ten pounds a year paid Parish Taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year

Elizth. Hand Aged abt. Twenty four Years wife of Richd. Hand upon Oath Says she intermarryed with the sd. Richd. Hand at the Fleet London on the first day of Janry 1750 Says her sd. Husband absconds from her & that she doth not know where he is, Says he informed her he served Seven Years Apprentiship at pontacks in Abchurch Lane in the Parish of St. Mary Abchurch London & hath been out of his sd. Apprentiship abt. five Years Says he never Rented Ten pounds a year or was a Yearly Servt for one Year that she hath one Child by him named Ann aged abt three Years & is poor & not able to maintain herself and Child

Rd Bennett aged near 60 Years upon Oath saith he rented the Queens head Alehouse in Long Acre in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr at the yearly Rent of Twenty one pounds lived therein five years and quitted the same about Sixteen years ago since which he has not rented ten pounds by the year paid parish Taxes nor lived a yearly Servt. for one year

Mary Macdonald upon Oath saith she was married to Daniel Macdonald at the Fleet London on the 1st Jany. 1754 & that the sd. Macdonald is a native of Ireland and that at the time of her sd. intermarriage she was the wido. of Fras. Farrell an Irishman who never gained a Settlemt. in England to her knowledge or belief and by whom she has a Child named Thos. aged 8 yrs born in Parkers Lane in the Parish of St Giles in the fields in the County of Middx and this Examint. further Saith that she is a Native of Ireland & never gained a settlemt. in England

Thomas Bridges upon Oath saith he was married to Mary Ann his wife upwds. of three years ago by whom he has one Child Frances aged upwards of three years and that he this Examinant rented a house of the yearly Rent of Five pounds in the Parish of Ampthill in the County of Bedford lived therein about three Years & paid his proportion to the Poor Rate of the said Parish that he quitted the sd. house last Midsummer and has not since rented ten pounds by the Year nor paid parish taxes

James Hawtin upon Oath saith he was married to Frances his wife at the Fleet London about 12 Years ago by whom he has 2 Children Hannah aged 5 Years and Eleanr aged 3 Years and that he served his apprentiship with John Ditcher a Cordwainer in the Salisbury Court in the Parish of St Brides London and never rented ten pounds a year paid parochial Taxes nor lived a yearly Servt. for one year

Thos. Holford upon Oath saith he has Child viz Mary aged near 9 Yrs. which Child was born of the body of Mary Turner Widow decd. at the White Lyon in Clare market in the Parish of St Clemt. Danes and this Examinant further upon his Oath saith he Served upwards of three Years of his Apprentiship with Rd. Eaton a Weaver in Brick Lane in the Parish of Christchurch in the County of Middx and then this Examinants sd master broke and he never was assigned over nor ever Rented ten pounds by the Year paid parochial Taxes nor lived a Yearly Servt. for one year except wth. one Mr Stull a Sadler near Naked boy Court in the Strand wth. whom he lived abt. 2 Yrs. but was then a widower and had a Son named Rt . who was then abt. 14 Yrs of age and had never been an apprentice or yearly Servants
Prudence Grater upon Oath saith she is the Wido. of Henry Greater who informed her he Served his apprentiship with a Weaver at Bradnage in Devon and never gained a Subseqt. Settlement

Rd Beverstock on behalf of Mary the wife of John Gibbins decd. upon his Oath saith he was well acquainted with the sd. Jno. Gibbins & has often heard him say that he was an apprentice to one Mr Gurr a Taylor in the parish of Grant Buckham in the County of Surry which Information he believes to be true and the aforementioned Mary Gibbins upon her Oath saith she married the sd. Jno. Gibbins in the Parish Church of St Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. and has by him two Children Ann aged upwds. of 5 Years and Susanna aged abt. 15 months and that her sd. late husband informed her he never rented ten pounds by the Year paid parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servt. for one Year

Mary Trow wido . of Rt. Trow who dyed abt. 16 years ago upon Oath saith she was married to the said Rt. Trow at the Fleet London abt. 16 Yrs. since and that her said late husband informed her that before his intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst a Singleman he lived a yearly Servant with Mr Maud at the Black Swan Lyon Inn in Holbourn in the Parish of St Andrew in Holbourn London for Eighteen months at the yearly Wages of £7. and never after he Left his sd Service rented ten pounds by the year paid parish Taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one Year nor has this Examinant since his Decease Rented ten pounds by the Year pd parish taxes or lived a yearly Servant

Edwd. Polhill aged 62 years upon Oath saith he was married to his prest. wife Mary Pollhill at the Fleet London on the 13th. July 1747 that near 40 Years ago (being then a Singleman) he was hired to live wth. Mr. Copes take a Taylor for two years certain at the wages of two Shilling Pr Week, that he lived under this hiring and agreemt. with Mr Copestake during the said term of two Years and lodged all that time upon Saffron hill in the Liberty of Saffronhill hatton Garden and Ely Rents in the parish of St. Andw. in Holbourn in the County of Middx and has not Since he left his sd Service rented ten pounds by the year paid Parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year

Danl. Jones aged abt. Twenty Nine Years Upon Oath says he was Bound an Apprentice for Seven Years to Mr. Benjn. Hopkins a Butcher in Tower Street in the Parish of Alhall Barkin London that he this Examinant served Six Years & upwards of his sd. Apprentishipp & then his sd. Master left Business & this Examinant went to Sea, Says he never was Assigned over to any person, Rented Ten pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for one Year

Eliz Woodman aged abt. 23 years upon Oath saith She never was married and that about Seven years ago she lived a yearly Servant with Mr Blunt near the half moon at Putney in the Parish of Putney in the County of Surry at the yearly wages of £3. for one year and upwards & has not Since she quitted her sd Service rented ten pounds by the year paid parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year.

Eliz Clough on behalf of her Son Joseph Clough upon Oath Saith she has been informed & verily believes he was married to his wife Isabella Clough at the Fleet London on the 2d. Feby. 1737/8. O.S. by whom he has 3 Children (viz) Catherine aged 9 Yrs. Eliz aged near 4 Yrs. & Joseph Chas . aged 14 months and that he was bound Apprentice by Indenture dated the 4th. July 1729 to Thomas damarce a Waterman & lived with him as his apprentice in the Broad way in the parish of St. Mary at Lambeth in the County of Surry for her Years or thereabouts of the sd. Term after which he went to Sea and never was assigned over nor ever Rented ten pounds by the years paid parish Taxes nor lived a yearly Servt. for one year

Mary Mc. Donald aged abt. 30 years upon Oath Saith she never was married to Daniel Mc. Donald at the Fleet London on the 1st. Janry 1754 by whom She has one Child John aged abt. 5 months who was born in Rain den Court in the Strand in the parish of St Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. that Her sd husband is a Scotchman & she can give no Account of his Settlement and that she this Examinant is a Native of Ireland and never gained a settlemt. a England.

Margt Spencer upon Oath saith she is the widow of Ja Spencer who dyed abt. 14 Years ago and that her sd. ha husband Informed her he never was an apprentice or yearly Servant for one year and that his father John Spencer rented a house of the yearly rent of in Carnaby market in the parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. lived therein many years and paid Scot & Lot there which Information they Examinant believes to be true

Marmaduke Brown upon Oath saith he rented a house of the Yearly Rent of £20 in Bedford Bury in the parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the County of Middx lived therein abt. 5 years and has quitted it abt. 13 years Since which he has not rented ten Pounds by the year paid parish taxes nor hired a yearly Servt. for one year

Mathw. Warwick upon Oath Saith he Served Seven years apprenticeship with Christ Painter a Butcher at Stony Stratford in the County of Bucks and never rented ten Pounds by the year pd. Parochial Taxes nor lived a yearly Served for one year

John Davis upon Oath Saith he Served Seven years apprentiship with Geo. Nutton in Petticoat Lane in the parish of St. Botolph witht. Aldgate London Dyer and lived with the sd. Nutton after the Expiration of his Apprentiship Sevl. Years as a yearly Servant in Petticoat Lane afsd. and has not Since he left his sd master rented ten pounds by the year pd. parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servt. for one year

Hannah Dolton aged near 40 years upon Oath saith she never was married and that She lived a yearly Servant with Mrs. Wright a Pastry Cook in Old North Street in the parish of St. Geo: the Martyr in the County of Middx for three years at the yearly wages of Four Pounds that She quitted her sd. Service 8 or 9 Years ago and has not Since rented ten Pounds by the year pd. parish Taxes nor lived a yearly Servt for one year

Eleanr. Meredith upon Oath saith she is the wido. of Richard Meredith who dyed upwds. of three yrs. since and that her sd. late husband informed her, he Served his apprentiship with Mr. Derwine a Timplate worker in White Cross Street near the Seven Dials in the Parish of St Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex and never rented ten pounds by the year paid parochial Taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year which Information this Examint. believes to be true And that she has not Since the decease of her said late husband Rented ten pounds by the year Paid Parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year

James Townsend aged near 19 years upon Oath saith he was bound apprentice by the Churchwds. Oversrs. of the poor of the Parish of St. Andrew in Holbourn in the County of Middx to Mr Brooks & Pencil & Brush maker and lived With him as his Apprentice about Six Months in Long Acre in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr . after which his master & mistress dyed and this Examinant was assigned over and never rented ten pounds a year paid Parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year

Mary Bermondsey Sarah Ross upon Oath Saith She was married to Thomas Ross at the Fleet London upwds. of 5 Years ago by whom She has one Child Mary aged 5 weeks that her sd husband is now on board his Majesties Ship Gibralter at Portsmouth and that he informed this Examinant he Served Seven years apprentiship with David Carter in the West Lane in the Parish of St. Mary Rotherhithe in the County of Surry that his sd. apprentiship Expired abt. 6 yrs. ago and he hath never rented ten pounds by the year paid parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year which Information this Examint. believes to be true

Mary Hows aged abt. 32 years upon Oath saith she is the wife of John Hows (gone from her) to whom she was married in Woodford Church in Essex the 23d. April 1758 & by whom she has 1 Child (viz) Wm. aged abt. 15 months and that her sd. husband informed her he Served his apprentiship with his father Thomas Hows at Walthamstow in Essex and that his sd. father was a Certificate person from the parish of St. Olave Southwark to the parish of Walthamstow afsd. and further that her sd. husband never rented ten pounds by the year paid parochial Taxes nor lived a yearly Servt for one year to this Examints. knowledge or belief

Eliz. Hall upon Oath saith she is the widow of Thomas Hall who (as she hath been informed & verily believes) Served his Apprentiship with Peter Ostler a Blacksmith at Long Melford in the County of Suffolk and never rented Ten Pounds by the year paid parish Taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year

Mary Clark upon Oath saith she is the Wido: of Richard Clark to whom She was married at the Fleet London on the 4th. Decr. 1734 and that her sd. late husband Informed her he was hired as a yearly Servant to Mr Rt Stewart a & hynust & lived with him as a yearly Servant opposite Northumberland Alley in Fenchurch Street in the Parish of St Cathn. Coleman London upwds. of 5 Years whilst a Singleman and about 2 Years after his marriage with his Examinant and that he never rented Ten Pounds by the Year nor paid parish taxes which Information this Examinant believes to be true and she further maketh Oath that she has not since the Decease of her said Late husband rented ten pounds by the year pd. parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year

Mary Scott upon Oath saith She never was married and that She lived a yearly Servt. with Mr Kilsha at Somerset house Coffee house in the Strand in the parish of St. Mary le Strand in the Liberty of Westmr . at the yearly wages of £7 for one year within a few Days and that she received the full Sum of £7 for her sd Service which she quitted four or five years ago and has not Since rented ten pounds by the year paid parochial Taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year

Mary Brooks aged abt. 22 Years upon Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a yearly Servant with Mr Tho Hambleton at the Kingshead in Mary bone Street in the parish of St James in the Liberty of westmr. for one year & upwards at the yearly wages of £4 quitted her sd. Service abt. 8 months ago and has not since rented ten pounds by the year paid parochial Taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year

Ann Brown aged upwds. of 40 years upon Oath saith She never was married and that She lived a yearly Servt. with Mr Champ in High Street in the Parish of Allhallows in Oxford at the yearly wages of £2 for two Years or thereabts. quitted her sd. Service abt. 11 Yrs. ago & has not since rented ten Pounds by the year paid parochial Taxes nor lived a yearly Servt. for one year

Sarah Ashby aged upwds. of 10 Yrs. upon Oath Saith She never was married and that she was hired a Servant for two years certain to Mr Smith a Shoemaker and lived wth. him in the Irongate in the parish of Allhallows in the Town & County of Derby for the sd. term of two Years and had for Such her Service Dyet Washing Lodging & Cloaths and that She has not since she left Mr Smith (which is abt. 5 Yrs. ago) Rented ten pounds by the year paid parochial Taxes nor lived a yearly Servt. for one year

Ann Thorinton aged abt. forty six years Upon Oath Saith She is the Wido. of Edmd. Thorinton and that her sd. Husband has been Dead abt. Sixteen Years to her now best Remembrance Says her sd. Husband Edmd. Thorinton before his death rented a House by Popeshead Court near Bell Yard in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middx for one Year & upwards at the Yearly Rent of Fourteen pounds or thereabts. Says She hath not since the Death of the sd. Edmond Thorinton rented Ten Pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for one Year

Eliz Ayres aged upwds. of 28 Yrs. upon Oath saith She never was married and that upwards of 2 Yrs. ago she was hired as a yearly Servant to Mr Jno. Divinee a Leather Clogmaker at the yearly wages of £4 and lived wth. him under that hiring about two Years; the last Six months of which time she lodged in the house of the sd. Divinee on little Saffron hill in the Liberty of Saffron hill Hatton Garden & Ely Rents in the parish of St. Andw. in Holbn. in the County of Middx and quitted her sd. Service about her months since

Jane Williams upon Oath Saith she was married to Thomas Williams at the Fleet London upwds. of 6 years ago by whom she has 2 Childn. Eliz aged abt. five years and William aged abt. 18 months that her sd. husband rented a house of the yearly Rent of £10 in Red Lyon Court in Whitehart Yard in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. lived therein near one year & quitted the sd. house at Lady day last & has not since rented ten pounds by the year nor pd. parish taxes

John Faulconbridge upon Oath saith he never was an apprentice or yearly Servt. never rented ten pounds by the year nor pd. parochial Taxes & that he has been informed & verily believes his late Father Rd. Faulconbridge Served his apprentiship wth. Rd Gravenor a Joiner in King Strt. Holbourn in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex & never Rented ten pounds by the year nor Paid Parish Taxes nor lived wth. any person as a yearly Servt. for one year

Sarah Amos aged abt. 29 Years upon Oath saith she never was married & that she lived a yearly Servt. wth. Mr. Aldin at the Yorkshire Gray in Bloomsbury market in the parish of St. Geo. Bloomsbury Middx for two years & upwards at the yearly wages of £3.10.0 for the first Year & four pounds for the remr. of the said Term quitted her sd. Service abt. Six Years ago and has not Since Rented Ten pounds by the year paid parish Taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year

Sarah Ross upon Oath saith she was married to Thomas Ross at the Fleet London upwds. of 5 Yrs. ago by whom she has one Child Mary aged upwds. of 3 months that her sd husband is now at Sea in his Majesties Service and that he informed this Examinant he Served Seven years apprentiship wth. David Carter in West Lane in the parish of St. Mary Magdalen Bermondsey in the County of Surry that his sd. apprentiship Expired upwds. of Six Years ago & he hath never Rented ten pounds by the Year paid parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one year which Information this Examinant believes to be true

Martha Bossom on behalf of her husband Robt Bossom a Lunatic upon Oath saith she has been Informed & verily believes her sd. husband never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant nor ever Rented ten pounds by the year nor pd. parish taxes and that Rt Bossom Senr . her sd. husbands father lived in a house of his own near Highbridge in the parish of St Peter in the Bailey in Oxford paid Scot and Lot sevl. Years in the said parish and there dyed

Cathn. Webb on behalf of Tho Watkins aged upwds. of Ten years the Son of Thos. Watkins & Dorothy his wife both decd. upon Oath Saith she has been informed & verily believes the abovenamed Tho Watkins (the Elder) Served his time with Mr. Knowles a Leather dresser in Morses Walk in Castle Lane in the parish of St Saviour in Southwk . in the County of Surry and never Rented ten pounds by the year paid parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servt for one year

Honor Gorman aged abt. 54 years upon Oath saith she is the wido . of Jas. Gorman deced and that since the decease of her sd. late husband She this Examinant (not having any Child or Children at that time) lived a yearly Servant with Mr. John Cuthbert a Staymaker in little Russell Street in the parish of St Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of westmr. for 3 Years & upwds. at the yearly wages of £3. quitted her sd Service abt. 5 Yrs. ago & has not Since rented ten pounds by the year pd. parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servt. for one year

Ann Archer upon Oath saith she is the Wife of Jacob Archer to whom she was married at the Church of St. Peter and Paul in Bath about Ten years ago & by whom she has 2 Children Wm. aged about 9 Years & Mary aged near 6 years & that her sd husband informed her he Served 3 years of his apprentiship with Wm. Batty a Taylor in Parsonage Lane in the afsd. parish of St Peter & Paul in Bath and at the End of the sd. 3 yrs. absconded from his Said Master & never was assigned over nor ever Rented ten pounds by the year paid parish Taxes nor lived a yearly Servt for one year which Information this Examinant believes to be true

Ann Brown upon Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a yearly Servant with Mr Champ in High Street in the Parish of Alhallows in Oxford at the yearly Wages of £2. for two years or thereabouts. Quitted her said Service about 11 years ago and has not since Rented Ten pounds by the year Paid Parochial Taxes nor lived a yearly Servt. for one year

Mary Fletcher Wife of Thomas Fletcher living in Bishops Court in the little Old Bailey London on behalf of Elizabeth Cavanaugh an Infant Aged about five Months upon Oath says She is the Daughter of Andrew Cavanaugh by Elizabeth his Wife Deceased That the said Andrew Cavenaugh was by Indenture dated the 3d. Day of Decr. 1744 bound an Apprentice for Seven Years to James Fower in Turnagain Lane in the Parish of St. Sepulchres London this Examinants first Husband and Served him as an Apprentice for two Years or thereabouts & then run away That the said Andrew Cavanaugh never was assigned over to any Person for the remainder of his said Apprenticeship nor ever rented Ten Pounds a year was a yearly Servant or paid Parish Taxes to her knowledge or beliefe

Sarah Breach Aged upwards of Forty two years upon Oath says that She is the widow of John Breach who dyed about four years since, That her said late Husband Rented a House at the yearly Rent of £14. in little Drury Lane in the Parah of St. Mary Le Strand in the County of Middlesex and lived in the same upwards of two years And that She has not since his Death Rented Ten pounds by the year, paid Parish Taxes, nor lived a yearly Servant

Catherine Frisell upon Oath says She is the Widow of Charles Frisell who hath been dead upwards of Seven Years Says her said late Husband rented a House in Goswell Street in the Parish of St. Luke in the County of Middlesex of the yearly Rent of Ten pounds and lived in the same about fourteen Years and paid all Parochiall Taxes Says She hath not since the Death, of her said late Husband Charles Frizell rented Ten pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or been a yearly Servant

John Connell upon Oath says that he is a Native of Ireland and never gained a Settlement in England That whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired yearly Servant with James Poe Esqr . in the Parish of Ballingary in the County of Tipperary in the Kingdom of Ireland above 4 Years at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds

Elizabeth Harley aged about 22 years upon Oath says that She Intermarryed with Alexander Harley (who is now a Marine in his Majesty's Service) the 22d. Octr. 1748 Says that her said Husband was born at Sea, That his Father was a Scotchman & his Mother an Irishwoman and never gained any Settlement in England to this Examinant's knowledge or belief and that her said Husband never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant nor Rented £10 by the Year to this Examinant's knowledge or belief Says that She hath one Child by him namely Alexander Harley aged 10 Weeks That She never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant whilst a Singlewoman Says that her Father John Mann Rented a House in Charles Court in the Strand in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of £16. and lived therein about a year & half and Quitted the same about 21 years as her sd. Father has informed her & as She verily believes

Anthony Carlton on the behalf of John Cramp a Lunatick upon his Oath saith that he has been informed & believes that the said John Cramp about 33 years ago was bound an Apprentice for four years to one Mr. Long at the two Brewers in Water Lane in the Parish of St. Ann in Blackfryers London Victualler & Waterman That he served him as an Apprentice for the said Term of four Years & hath not since his said Apprenticeship rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes nor lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year as this Examinant has been informed & verily believes

Thomas Macdonald upon Oath says he was born in the Parish of St. Stephen in Waterford or in the Parish of Lisnikill in Ireland That he served his Apprenticeship with Thomas Mullins in the Parish of Lisnikill in the same County Taylor and never gained any Settlement in England Says that he Intermarried with Sarah his Wife at the Fleet London about 11 Years since and hath, 4 Childn. by her namely Catherine aged about 10 Years born in Dyott Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields , Michael aged about 7 Years born in the same House, John aged abot. 4 Years born in Great Wild Street in the same Parish & Robert aged abt. 14 Months born in Stanhope Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes and the abovenanamed Sarah upon Oath says that before her Marriage with the sd. Thos. Macdonald She lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Joseph Cross at the Turks head in Dyot Street St. Giles in the Fields 3 years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of £4. and says She did not live in any other Service afterwards.

John Luff Aged abt. Forty two Years upon Oath Says that whilst he was a Singleman he liverd a hired Yearly Servt. with Mr. Jno. Douglass Linnen Draper the Corner of St. Clemts. Lane in Cannon Street in the Parish of St. Clemt. near Eastcheap in the City of London for four Years at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds & there Married since wch time he hath not Rented Ten Pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes or Served any Parochiall Office

Alice Mackquay Upon Oath Saith She is the wife of Nenle Mackquay that the sd. Nenle Mackquay was born in the Parish of Clenvekill in the Kingdom of Ireland and Served three Years Apprentishipp with one Mr. Macure in the same Parish as She hath been informed & beleives

Eleanor Hall aged about 28 Years upon Oath says She never was married That her Father Joshua Hall Rented a House of above Ten Pounds a Year near Kentish Town in the Parish of St. Pancrass in the County of Middlesex and lived therein about fourteen Years as She has been informed & believes Says She has a Child named Richard born a Bastard in the Work- -house of the said Parish of St. Pancrass about two Years since And that She never Rented ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Woollerton Lodging at Mr. Bests a Perukemaker in Witch Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes upon Oath saith that Edward Simpson an Infant Aged about Six Months was born in Belt Lane near Spittal Fields in the Parish of Christ Church in the County of Middlesex

Ann Weston Wife of John Weston upon Oath saith She intermarryed with the said John Weston at the Fleet London sometime in the Month of Octr. 1753 by whom She has a Child named Elizabeth aged about Ten Months Says her said Husband informed her he was bound an Apprentice for seven Years to his Father Edward Weston in the Parish of Chipping norton in the County of Oxford Carpenter and served him about five Years the first part of his said Apprenticeship in the said Parish of Chipping norton and then came to London & never was assigned over to any other Person

Peter Carroll aged about 19 Years upon Oath says that he was born in the Parish of St. Francis in the City of Dublin in the Kingdom of Ireland & never was an Apprentice rented Ten Pounds a Year or lived a hired Yearly Servant

Thos. Turpin Aged abt. Forty Six Years Upon Oath Says he was bound an Apprentice for Seven Years to his father Jno. Turpin in the Parish of Haddenham in the County of Bucks & served him as an Apprentice in the sd. Parish of Haddenham upwards of four Years & then his sd. father Dyed Says he never rented Ten Pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servt.

Francis Barns aged abt. Forty Years Upon Oath Says he intermarried with his wife Esther abt two Years ago in the Savoy Chapel Says he was bound an Apprentice for Seven years to Jno. Bucker and Served abt. three Quarters of a Year the last part of his sd. Apprentishipp with his sd. Master in the Parish of St. Ann in Black Friers in the City of London Says he never rented Ten Pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servt.

Mary Sherman Aged abt. Fifty Nine Years Upon Oath Says She intermarryed with her late Husband Wm. Sherman in the Parish Church of St. Clemt. Danes upwards of Forty Years since Says he sd. late Husband has been Dead abt. Seven Years and that before his intermarryage with this Examinant & whilst a Singleman he lived a Yearly hired Servt. with Mrs. Hudson in Church Lane in the Hamlett of Hammer Smith in the County of Middx four Years & Upwards at the Yearly Wages of Twenty Pounds & never rented Ten Pounds a Year or pd. Parish Taxes Says She hath not since her sd. Husband death rented Ten Pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly hired Servt.

Mary Price aged about 23 Years Upon her Oath Says she never was Married and that she never Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Parish Taxes or Lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year Say's she is the Daughter of Stephen Price by Hannah his Wife both Deceased Says she hath Often heard her said late Father Stephen Price say he Served An Apprenticeship of Seven Years with One Charles Sayer in the Parish of Kingston in the County of Hereford .

Elizabeth Barsby aged about Twenty One Years upon Oath Says She never was Married, Says she has been Informed and verily believes that about Thirty two Years ago her Father Willm. Barsby Rented a House, then the Sign of the Rose and Crown the Corner of Dartmouth Street in the Parish of St. Margaret in the Liberty of Westmr. in the County of Middx at the Yearly Rent of Eighteen Pounds and Lived therein upwards of Twelve Years, Says She has never Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Parish Taxes or Lived a hired Yearly Servt. for One Year

Ann Swetman Aged about Fifty five Years upon Oath Says she is the Widow of Robt. Swetman who Died about 12 Years ago, Says her said late Husband Served Four Years and upwards the last Part of his Apprenticeship with One Jas. Crutchfield a Carman in the Backside of Horseley Downs in the Parish of St. John Southwark in the County of Surry and never Rented Ten Pounds a year Paid Parish Taxes or Lived a Yearly Servt. for One Year, Says She hath not since her sd. husbands Death Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Parish Taxes or Lived a hired Yearly Servant

Sarah Pounder Upon Oath Saith that about Ten Years ago She Intermarried with Thos. Pounder at the Fleet London and has two Childer by him (to wit) Susannah Aged about Seven Years and Richard Aged about Four Years Says her said Husband Informed her and which Information she believes to be true that he Served Seven years apprenticeship with Francis Ginn a Sawer in Snow Fields in the Parish of St. Mary Magdalen Bermondsey in the County of Surry Says he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Parish Taxes or Lived a hired Yearly Servt. whilst a Singleman

Frances Macclesfield Aged about Thirty Six Years Upon Oath Says She was never Married that She Served Five Years apprentishipp with Mrs. Nanfann a Mantua maker in Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex and Says She never Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Parish Taxes or Lived a hired yearly Servant.

Mary Batfield Aged about Twenty four Years upon Oath Says She never was married That She Lived a hired Yearly Servant with One Mr. Geo: Shaw at the King's Arms in Chapel Street Red Lyon Square in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn above Bars in the County of Middx for Three years and upwards At the Yearly Wages of £3. and hath quitted her said Service upwards of Four years and hath not since Lived with any Person as a hired Yearly Servt. for One Year And farther upon her Voluntary Oath Says She is now Pregnant with Child or Children which is likely to be Born a Bastard or Bastards and to become Chargeable to the Parish of St. Clemt. Danes where she now Lodges, She being Poor and unable to Maintain the Same when Born, And that One John Rafes a Taylor Lodging at Mr. Geo: Marcers in New Court Cary Street in the sd. Parish of St. Clemt. Danes Did begett the sd. Bastard Child or Children on her Body The sd. John Rafes having had Carnal knowledge of this Examinant in the Month of March or April last and at several other times since in his the sd. John Rafes Appartmt. in New Court aforesd. At One of wch. times he get her wth. Child of the Child or Children which she is now Pregnant And that the sd. John Rafes and no other Person is the true and Real Father thereof.

Catherine Scoales Wife of John Scoales now in the Marshalsea Prison for Debt upon Oath saith She Intermarryed with the said John Scoales in the Parish Church of St. Andrew Holborn on the 20th. of April upwards of Ten Years since by whom She has two Children (to wit) Peter Henry aged about Seven Years & Ann aged upwards of Ten Months Says her said Husband Rented a House of £40. a Year the corner of Brewers Yard in the Strand in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for five Years or thereabouts and hath quitted the same upwards of Five Years and afterwards Rented a seperate Appartment of 15 or £20. a Year in the same Parish and lived in the same near one Year and quitted it about four Years and has not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year nor paid Parish Taxes elsewhere

Ann Hewett upon Oath saith She is the Wife of John Hewett That She Intermarryed with the said John Hewett at the Fleet London on the 7th. Day of January 1753 Says her said Husband rented a House upon Snow Hill in the Parish of St. Sepulchres London of the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds & lived in the same severall Years Says her said Husband hath not since he quitted the said House on Snow Hill rented Ten pounds a year or paid Parish Taxes

Sarah Space aged about Twenty one years Wife of William Space (who is gone from her) Says her said Husband Served his Apprenticeship of Seven Years with Mr. John Ivy a Chairmaker in the Parish of St. Lawrence in Reading in the County of Berks Says he has been out of his time about five Years and hath not since rented Ten pounds by the year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year as She hath been informed by her said Husband & verily believes

Ann Stockton aged about 20 years Upon Oath says She never was married That her Father William Stockton Rented a House in the Parish of Droitwick in the County of Worcester and lived in the same several Years & paid to the Poor there as She has been informed and believes, and further saith She never Rented a House or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Pearce Wife of Joseph Pearce Aged about 49 Years upon Oath says her said Husband served his Apprenticeship of Seven Years with; his Father in the Parish of Osesstry in Shropshire Says her said Husband never Rented Ten pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one year

Charles Smith upon Oath says he intermarried with his Wife Elizabeth Smith upwards of Twenty two Years ago by whom he has one Child Vizt. Ann aged about fifteen years who never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant And that he this Examinant Served seven years Apprenticeship with, Mr. Weaver a Baker near the Opera House in the Haymarket in the Parish of St. James Westminster & never Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year

John Bowman aged about 62 years upon Oath says he Intermarried with his present Wife Mary at Burford in Oxfordshire about the Year 1746 by whom he has five Children (to wit) Mary aged about Eight Years Elizabeth aged about six Years Milicent aged about four Years Charles aged about two Years and an Infant as yet unbaptized. Says that John Bowman his Father deceased Rented a House upwards of Twenty Pounds a Year in Bridges Street in the Parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster & lived therein several Years and quitted the same about thirty eight Years since as he has been informed and verily believes And this Examinant says that he never rented a House of Ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a yearly Servant

Elizabeth Kiddington aged about 53 Years upon Oath says She is a Widow without Child or Children and that She lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Upjon a Watchmaker by the Pond at Highgate in the Parish of St. Pancras in the County of Middlesex One Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of three Pounds & left her said Service about nine Months since

George Hallett aged about 70 Years upon Oath says he served his Apprenticeship of Seven years with one Thomas Painter a Waterman in the Upper Ground in the Parish of Christ Church in the County of Surry Says that he never Rented Ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year

Susanna Duke aged about 49 Years upon Oath says She never was married Says She lived a hired yearly Servant upwards of year with one Mr. Horn a Perukemaker in King Street in the Parish of St. George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex at the yearly wages of Three Pounds Meat Drink & Lodging and quitted her said Service about Eight years ago and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a year Paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Jane Smith aged about 25 Years upon Oath says She Intermarried with Thomas Smith (who is now at Sea in his Majesty's Service) at the Fleet London the 20th. Day of March 1754 Says She has a Female Child by her said Husband as yet unbaptized and that her said Husband Served the last part of his Apprenticeship to wit about two years with one John, Pouch a Working Brazier in little St. Andrew Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex and that he never afterwards rented Ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one year as this Examinant has been informed by him & verily believes

Isabella Smith aged about 22 Years upon Oath says She Intermarried with Thomas Smith (who is gone from her) at the Fleet London about 5 Years ago and that She has a Child by her said Husband named Thomas aged about 2 Years & six Months Says her said Husband lived a hired Yearly Servant upwards of a Year, with one Mrs. Holmes Widow at the Black Bull Inn in Holborn in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn London and had yearly Wages Meat drink & Lodging And that he hath not since he quitted his said Service Rented Ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year as She hath been informed by her said Husband & verily believes

Ralph Wareham Aged abt. 50 Years Upon Oath Saith he Rented a House in Turnmill Street in the Parish of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middx of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and lived therein abt. Eleven Years & hath quitted sd. House abt. Seven Years & hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly hired Servt . for one Year

Christian Audley Aged abt. Thirty Eight Years Upon Oath Says she is the Widw . of Robt. Audely deced Says her sd. late Husband informed her & with informaton she beleives to true that her Served Seven Years Apprentiship with his father at Grantham in the County of Lincoln Says he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes or was a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year Say she hath not Since his Death rented Ten Pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes or lived a hired yearly Sevt. for one Year

Richard Jones aged about 68 - years upon Oath says he was married at the Fleet London upwards of 42 years ago to his Wife Jane by whom he has a Daughter named Sarah aged about 21 years who never was married nor ever was an Apprentice or yearly Servant for one year nor ever Rented ten pounds a year or paid Parish Taxes to this Examinants knowledge or belief Says he was bound Apprentice to his Father Richd. Jones Senr . & lived with him as his Apprentice in Tothill Street in the Parish of St. Margaret in the Liberty of Westminster for two years or thereabouts and then his Father absconded and this Examinant says he never was Assigned ever nor ever Rented Ten Pounds a year paid parish Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year

Ann Watts aged about 54 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of John Watts deceased And that her said late husband Rented a Farm in the Parish of Tottenham High cross in the County of Middlesex of the Yearly Rent of Fifty Pounds & upwards & lived in the same several Years and there dyed Says her said late Husband hath been dead about 20 years and that She hath not since his decease Rented Ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Sarah Petey aged about 25 Years upon Oath says She Intermarried with William Petey her Husband at the Fleet London the 28th. of June in the year 1750 Says her said Husband is now at Sea on Board his Majesty's Ship the Prince Says that he was bound Apprentice by Indenture bearing Date the 5th. day of February in the Year 1742. to Cornelius Dawkins a Shoemaker whom he served as an Apprentice about two years in white Lyon Yard Charterhouse Lane in the Parish of St. Sepulchre in the County of Middx and then absconded from his Master and went to Sea Says her said Husband was not afterwards assigned over to any other Person nor ever Rented Ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year as She has been informed by him & believes

Hannah Griffin Aged abt. nineteen Years upon Oath saith She was never Married, that She lived a hired Yearly Servt. with Mr. Eady at ye. Wheat Sheaf the Corner of Hosier Lane in ye. Parish of St. Sepulchre's London for two Years & upwards at ye. Yearly Wages of four Pounds quitted said Service abt. three Years; hath not since She quitted said Service rented Ten Pounds a Year, Paid Parish Taxes, or lived a Yearly Servant for one Year Says She was delivered of a Male Bastard Child on the twenty Eighth Day of May 1755. in the House of Catharine Melampey in Gold Smiths Alley in Lukenors Lane in ye. Parish of St. Giles in ye. Fields. which hath since been Baptized Francis.

Richard Eaten on behalf of Sarah West aged about 12 Years upon oath says that her Father John West who dyed about five Months since was a Parishioner legally settled in the Parish of Timsbury in the County of Somerset as this Examinant has been informed by the said John West & believes And further says that the said Sarah West was never an Apprentice or yearly Servant

Sarah Adams aged about 20 Years upon Oath says that Joseph Adams her late Father deceased was born in the Parish of Aldenham in the County of Hertford and lived a hired yearly Servant there upwards of a year and never afterwards lived a hired yearly Servant elsewhere or Rented a House or paid Parish Taxes as She has been informed By him & believes Says She never lived a hired yearly Servant for one year

Ann Norris aged about 21 years Says that John Norris her Father deceased Served his Apprenticeship of Seven Years to a Hath Dyer in the Parish of St. Olave Southwark in the County of Surry & never Rented a House or lived a hired yearly Servant as She has been informed by her said late Father & believes and further says She never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant for one year
