Mary Bowtle upon Oath says She Intermarried with Thomas Bowtle (who is gone from her) in the Parish Church of all Saints in the City of Worcester the 8th. day of April 1750 Old Style by whom She has two Children namely Martha aged about 5 years & Mary aged upwards of two years Says her said Husband Served seven years Apprenticeship with Thos. Assett in the Parish of Braintree in the County of Essex Woolcomber and never rented Ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year as She has been informed by her said Husband & verily believes

Hannah Johnson aged about Twenty Years upon Oath says That She was never Marri -ed that She never was an Apprentice or a Yearly Servt. for one Year Says her Father Henry Johnson was a Foot Soldiers in Ye. First Regiment of Foot Quards, & has been Dead about Sixteen Years, Says She hath been informed & Verily belives, that her sd. Father was born in Ye. Parish of Bradford in Ye. County of Wilts, & never Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Parish Taxes, was an Apprentice , or a Yearly Servt. for one Year.

Richard Eaton on behalf of Sarah West aged about Twelve years upon Oath says that the said Sarah West was born in the Parish of Timsbury in the County of Somerset as John West the Father of the said Sarah West informed this Deponent and as he verily believes Says the said John West hath been dead about five Months

Winifred Maginnees aged about Sixteen Years on behalf of her Brother Jno. Maginnees an Infant aged about Seven Years upon Oath Says her Father & Mother are both Dead, that they were Natives of Ireland & never gain'd a Settlement in England, that her said Brother John Maginnees was born in Cross Lane in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields , in the County of Middx.

Mary Slater Wife of Peter Slater upon Oath Says She Intermarried with the sd. Peter Slater at the Fleet London on the 25th. Day of February abt. Sixteen Years ago, Says her husband was bound an Apprentice for five Years to Robert Fair brother in Indian Court in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn above Barrs in the County of Middx. and serv'd him there one Year & a half the first part of his sd. Apprentiship & then his said Master and this Ex- aminants Husband parted by Con- -sent and never was assigned over to any other Person as her said Husband hath inform'd her and as She verily believes. Says her said husband never Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Parish Taxes or was a Yearly Servant for one Year Says She hath Two Children, John aged about Eleven Years and Eleanor aged abt. Eight Years, & her said Husband being very ill and Poor is not able to maintain himself and them.

Ann Deane aged abt. 26 years Upon Oath Says She is the Wife of Jno. Deane who is on Board his Majestys Ship Drendnought that she intermarried with the sd. Jno. Deane at the Fleet London upwards of four Years since Says her sd. Husband was bound an Apprentice for Seven Years to One Capt. Bell Says her sd. Husband Lodged the last half Year of his sd. Apprentiship in Charles Court in petty France in the Parish of St. Margt. in the City & Liberty of Westmr. Says he never Rented Ten pounds a Year pd. parish Taxes or was a hired Yearly servt. for one Year

Ann Skinner aged abt. Eighteen Years Upon Oath Says She was never Married and cannot give any Accot. of the Settlemt. of her father or Mother Says her Grand father Jno. Skinner Rented a House in the Parish of Rigate in the County of Surry & Served the Office of Overseers of the poor there as She hath been informed & verily believes Says She was brt. up in the Workhouse belonging to the sd. parish & never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servt.

Martha Jesop aged about thirty one Years upon Oath says, She Intermarried with Moses Jesop her late Husband Deceased at the Fleet London abt. Fourteen Years ago, And that he serv'd his Apprenticeship of Seven Years with Jno. Purdey a Plaisterer & Slaterer at the White Lyon Alehouse the upper End of Hog Lane in the Parish of St. Ann in the Liberty of Westmr. Says her said late Husband never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant as She has been informed by him & verify believes. and that She this Examinant since his Death hath not Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parochial Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Slater Widow of Peter Slater Deceased aged upwards of Forty Years upon Oath says She Intermarried with her said Late Husband at ye. Fleet London about Sixteen Years ago Says her said late Husband was bound an Apprentice for Seven Years to Mr. Cerson a Cabinetmaker on Clerkenwell Green in the parish of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middx. & served him three Years & a half the First part of his Apprenticeship & then his said Master Dyed & never was assigned over to any other Person as her said Husband hath informed her & as She verily believes Says her sd. late Husband never Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Parish Taxes was a Yearly Servant for one Year or Served any Parochial Office Says She hath two Children by her said Husband (Videlicet) John aged abt. Eleven Years and Eleanor aged abt. Eight Years Says her sd. late Husband died the third Day of this Instant June & She being poor is not able to maintain herself & Children

Amaryllis Davis aged about 34 years upon Oath says She Intermarried with Henry Davis her husband in the Parish, Church of St. Gregory by St. Pane London on the first day of Janry. in the year 1739 old stile by whom She hath two Children Vizt. Margaret aged about sixteen years & John aged about Seven years and further says her said Husband Rented a House in Coleman Street in the Parish of St. Stephen Coleman Street in the City of London at the Yearly Rent of Seventy Pounds and lived therein upwards of six Months and quitted the same about Twelve years & hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a year or paid Parochial Taxes.

Sarah Hoy Widow aged Sixty Years upon Oath Says She lived a hired Yearly Servt. with Mr. Jennings a Doctor in Physick upwards of a Year in Castle Street in the Parish of St. Ann in the Liberty of Westmr. at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds ten Shillings Whilst She was a Widow & without Child or Children & quitted her sd. Service abt. Sixteen Years ago & hath not since Intermarried with any other Person Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year.

Mary Martin Widow on the behalf of Mary Browne Singlewoman a Lunatic aged about 28 years upon Oath says the said Mary Browne never was married as She hath been informed and believes and that She lived a hired yearly Servant upwards of a year with one Mrs. King in St. Martins Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster & County of Middlesex and quitted the same upwards of two years since And further says the said Mary Browne hath not since her quitting the Service of the said Mrs. King Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes on lived a hired yearly Servant for one year as this Examinant hath been informed and as she Verily believes

Sarah Tyler aged abt. Thirty two Years upon Oath says She is a Singlewoman & that She lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Mary Higgens at the Lukes head Alehouse in Mercer Street Long Acre in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr . for Three Years & upwards at the Yearly Wages of three Pounds & hath quitted her said Service about fourteen Years to her now best Remembrance Says She hath not since She left Mrs. Higgins's Service Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Mary Trow aged abt. Sixty five Years upon Oath says She Intermarried with Robt. Trow her late Husband Deced at the Fleet London abt. Eighteen Years ago Says the said Robt. Trow before his Intermarriage with this Examinant & Whilst a Singleman lived a Yearly hired Servant with Mr. Maud at the Black Swan Inn Holborn in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn London upwards of a Year at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds as She hath been informed by her said late Husband & as She verily believes & that he never after Rented ten Pounds a Year Paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year & further says She hath not since the Death of her said late Husband Intermarried with any other Person Rented ten Pounds a Year Paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Mary Avery Wife of Richard Avery aged abt. Thirty two Years upon Oath Says She Intermarried with her said Husband on the Sixth Day of February about Fourteen Years Since in the Parish Church of St. Sepulchre 's London Says he Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with Mr. Robert Smith a Shoemarker in Whites Alley in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middx. & never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says he is now as She hath been informed on Board a Privateer & She being Poor is unable at present for Want of Cloaths to maintain herself

Ann Bowers aged abt. Twenty six Years Wife of William Bowers who is gone from her upon Oath says She Intermarried with the said William Bowers at the Fleet London on the 20th. of August 1747. Old Style Says he was bound Apprentice by Indre dated 26th. Oct. 1737. for Seven Years to Joseph Springwell Citizen & Turner of London & served twelve Months the last part of his Apprenticeship with Mr. Saml. Dobbins in the precinct of the Savoy in the County of Middx. Says She hath one Child by him Mary Aged abt. Sixteen Months & is poor & not able to maintain herself & Child Says her said Husband never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year as She has been informed & believes

Sarah Rushfield aged about Thirty five Years upon Oath says She is the Widow of James Rushfield Deced. Says he Served Seven Years Appren. with Mr. Davis a Shoemaker opposite St. Stephens Church in Walbrook in the Parish of St. Mary Wool Church London as this Examinants said late Husbd. informed her & as She verily believes Says her said late Husband in his life time nor She since his Death never Rented Ten Pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year

Ellis Walwork aged about Seventy Years upon Oath says he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes was an Apprentice or Yearly hired Servant for one Year Says his Father Ellis Walwork Served his Apprentiship with Reuben Hainworth in the Township of Todington in the County of Lancaster & never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Elizth. Turner aged abt. Forty five Years upon Oath says She lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year with Mrs. Hoblin on Richmond Hill in the Parish of Richmond in the County of Surry at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds Seven Shillings & hath quitted her said Service abt. Three Years since wch. time She hath not Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Lawrence aged abt. Twenty Years upon Oath says She was never Married Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes was an Apprentice or Yearly hired Servant for one Year Says She has been informed & verily believes her late Father Roger Lawrence Deced Served his Apprentiship with one Mr. Peal a Fellmonger in the Parish of Uxbridge in the County of Middx & never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Mitchell aged abt. Fifty four Years upon Oath Says She never was Married & that She lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Edwd. Salmon a Painter for Twenty four Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds Says She lived the three last Months of her sd. Service with the said Mr. Salmon in Little Carter Lane in the Parish of St. Gregory by St. Paul & there her said Master Dyed Says after the Burial of her sd. Master, Mrs. Salmon her Mistress, being Ill told this Examinant that She was left very Poor & could not Afford to pay this Examinant any Wages but hoped this Examinant would not leave her Saying She believed She should not live very long & this Examinant Consented to Continue & did live with her said Mistress untill the time of her Death which happened upwards of one Year after the Death of the said Mr. Salmon & lived with the said Mrs. Salmon in New Street Square in the Parish of St. Bridget Vulgarly St. Brides Londn. near one Year where her said Mrs. Dyed Says She hath not since Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Hubbard aged abt. Sixty one Years upon Oath says abt. Seven Years ago She lived a yearly hired Servant with Mr. Shalhaws a Staymaker in King Street in the Parish of St. Ann in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of two Years at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds She being at that time a Widow & without Child or Children Says She hath not since She left Mr. Shalhaws Service Rented Ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Frisby aged about 37 years upon Oath says She never was married bound an Apprentice lived a hired yearly Servant for one year or Rented a House Says her Father Thomas Frisby deced Rented a House of Ten Pounds a year & upwards in New Rents in the Parish of St. Saviour Southwark in the County of Surry and paid all Parish Taxes there lived therein several Years and quitted the same about 27 Years as She hath been informed and verily believes

Elizabeth Phillis aged about 34 Years upon Oath says She intermarried at the with James Phillis her late Husband Deceased about 10 Years since at the Fleet London by whom, She hath one Child named Lucy aged about five Months Says her said late Husband Served about five Years of his Apprenticeship in the Parish of Shepton Mallet in the County of Somerset and was never assigned over lived a hired yearly Servant for one year paid Parish Taxes or Rented Ten Pounds a year as She hath been informed by him and verify believes

Mary Goram aged abt. fifteen Years upon Oath says She was never Married was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servt. Says her Father & Mother are both dead & that She this Examinant was Born in the Parish of St. Mary at Stanford in the County of Lincoln as her later Mother has informed her & wch. Information She verily believes to be true

Mary Scruton on behalf of Mary Dodd an Infant aged abt. 12 Years upon Oath says She has of ten heard David the Father of the sd. Mary Dodd say, he served his Apprenticeship in the Parish of St. Olave Southwark in the County of Surry & that be never Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes to this Examinants Knowledge or Belief

Elizth. Baldwin aged abt. 23 Years upon Oath says She is the Widow of Wm. Baldwin who hath been dead abt. Three Months, Says her sd. late Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant & whilst a Singleman lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Osborne at Serle's Coffee House in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middx upwds. of one Year at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds & that he quitted his said Service abt. four Years before his Death Says her sd. late Husband in his life time nor She this Examinant since his death never Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes Says She hath one Child by her sd. late Husband (to wit) Elizth. aged abt. 8 Months & being Poor is not able to Maintain her sd. Child

Sarah Pace aged abt. 41 Yrs. upon Oath says She Intermarried with Benjn. Pace at the Fleet London abt. 26 Yrs. since says the sd. Benjn. Pace hath absconded from her for abt these Twenty - Years neither hath she seen him or heard from him since says her sd. Husbd. hath often informed her & which information she believes to be true that he served his Apprentiship of Seven Years with Mr. Vastin a Grocer in Bishopsgate Street in the Parish of St. Botolph without Bishopsgate in the City of Londn . & that he never Rented Ten Pounds a Yr. or pd. Parish Taxes

Ann Wall aged abt. Twenty Years Upon Oath Says She never was Married was an Apprentice or a hired Yearly Servt- Says her father Wm- Wall Rents a Ground Chamber, at No- Nine in Fn valls Inn in the Parish of St- Andrew Holborn London of the Yearly Rent of Ten pounds as She hath been informed & veily believes

Mary Simmonds aged abt. 21 Yrs. upon Oath says she was bound an Apprentice by the Church Wardens & Overseers of the Parish of Lambeth in the County of Surry to Sarah Burmaster in Ely Rents in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn & lived with her abt. three Years & then with the Consent of her said Mistress lived with one Mr. Collyer a Jeweller in Bull & Mouth Street in the Parish of Christ Church in the City of London for one Year & a half

Dorothy Gallington aged abt. 53 Yrs. upon Oath says She is the Widow of Benjn. Gallington who hath been dead abt. two Years Says her said late Husband Rented a House in Fleet Street in the Parish of St. Brides in the City of London of the Yearly Rent of Fifty two Pounds lived therein abt. one Year & quitted same abt. Sixteen Years ago Says she hath not since her said Husbands Death Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant

Mary Clark aged abt. 30 Yrs. upon Oath says She is the Wife of John Clark a Soldier at Gibralter & that she Cannot give any Account of his Settlement save that he was born in Argyle Shire Says She before her Intermarriage lived a Yearly hired Servt. with Capt: Cohone in the Town of Greenough in Scotland for two Years at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds Scotch that she has two Childn. Susan aged abt. two Years & Daniel aged abt. one Month

Cath: Chandler aged upwds. of Sixty Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Jas. Chandler that she hath been informed & verily believes the said James Chandler served his Apprenticeship with a Shag Weaver in the Parish of St. Saviour Southwark in the County of Surry

Rose Brown aged abt. 42 Yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife of Benjn. Brown (now a broad) says the said Benjn. Brown served his Apprenticeship with Mr. Wm. Towzey a Tallow Chandler & Grocer in the market place in the Parish of Wantage in the County of Berks
John Griffin aged upwds. of Fifty Years upon Oath says he was born in the Parish of Kilcummin in the County of Galway in the Kingdom of Ireland

Cath: Moseley aged abt. 50 Yrs. upon Oath says she is the Widow of Richd. Moseley who hath been dead abt. 8 Years says she cannot give any Account of his Settlement; that before her Intermarriage with the said Richd. Moseley & whilst she was a Single Woman she lived a hired Yearly Servt. with Mr. Picket a Wine Merchant on Great Tower Hill in the Parish Hamlet Tower Royal in the City of London for one Year & a half at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds & never Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes

Ann Ellson aged abt. twenty six years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Thos. Ellson (now at sea) says her said Husband Rented a House in Chick Lane in the Liberty Saffron hill Hatton Garden & Ely Rents in the County of Middx. of the yearly Rent of Thirteen Pounds lived therein upwards of a year & quitted same abt. three Months; says She hath four Children by him (to wit) Ann aged abt. seven years Mary aged upwds. of five years Lucy aged abt. two years & Thos. aged abt. one year & being poor is not able to maintain herself & them

John Button aged abt. 63 years upon Oath says her served his Apprenticeship of 7 years with his father John Button a Stockingmaker in Worcester Street in the Parish of St. Saviour Southwark in the County of Surry & hath not since obtained any other Settlement to his knowledge or belief

Eliz: Blakey aged abt. 60 yrs. upon Oath Says she is the Wife of Andrew Blakey with whom she intermarried at the fleet London abt. twenty three years ago says her said Husband informed her & which information she believes to be true that he served his Apprenticeship of seven years with Mr. Wood a Baker near Clay Hill in the Parish of Epsom in the County of Surry
Alexr. Nail aged abt. 60 years upon Oath says, he was born in the Parish of Kello in the County of Longford in the Kingdom of Ireland & never gained any other Settlement to his knowledge or belief

Ann Hilliard aged abt. 17 years upon Oath says she never gained any Settlement by any Act of her own; but that her father John Hilliard Rented a house upwards of twenty Pounds a yr. by Tottenham High Cross in the Parish of Tottenham High Cross in the County of Middlesex for Ten yrs. & upwards & never after he quitted said House Rented ten Pounds a year or paid Parish Taxes

Eliz: Applegarth aged 39 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife of Edwd. Applegarth (gone from her) with whom she intermarried at the fleet London abt. sixteen years ago, says she hath three Childn. by her said Husband (to wit) Mary aged abt. thirteen years, William aged upwards of Nine years & John aged upwards of four years says her sd. Husband served his Apprenticeship with the Widow Archer a Papermaker in the Parish of Sittingbone in the County of Kent as her sd. Husbd. informed her & as she verily believes & that he never Rented Ten Pounds a yr. or paid Parish Taxes

Wm. Pitkin aged abt. 73 yrs. upon Oath says he Rented a House in the Parish of Sunbury in the County of Middx . of the yearly Rent of Ten Pounds lived therein abt. two years & quitted same abt. twenty years ago & hath not since Rented Ten Pound a year or paid Parish Taxes

Eliz: Weaver aged abt. 46 yrs. upon Oath says she intermarried with Saml. Weaver at the Fleet London says her sd. Husband is a Native of Ireland & never gained a Settlement in England & is now abroad & beyond the Seas as she hath been informed & believes says before her intermarriage with the sd. Saml. & whilst she was a single woman she lived a hired yearly Servt. with Mr. Chivins a Baker the Corner of the Back Lane in the Parish of Lambeth in the County of Surry for four years at the yearly Wages of four Pounds ten Shillings says she hath one Child by her sd. Husbd. (to wit) Henry aged abt. seven years

Eliz: Horncastle aged abt. 42 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Widow of John Horncastle who hath been dead abt. ten years says her said Husbd. was as he inform'd her a Native of Ireland & never gained a Settlement in England says before her intermarriage with the sd John Horncastle & whilst she was a Single Woman she lived a hired yearly Servant with Lady Miller on Mays hill in the Parish of Greenwich in the County of Kent for one year & upwards at the yearly Wages of four Pounds says she has one Child be her sd. Husbd. aged abt. Eleven Years

Margt. Lucas aged abt. 41 yrs. upon Oath says she Wife of George Lucas (gone from her) by whom she hath one Child (Videlicet) Mary aged abt. seven yrs. says her said Husband Served his Apprenticeship with a Stay maker in the Parish of Blanesbridge in the County of Monahone in the kingdom of Ireland & never Rented ten Pounds a yr. pd. Parish Taxes or was a yrly. Servt.

Mary Jenkyns aged abt. 40 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife of Joseph Jenkyns (now at Sea) says her sd. Husband served his Apprenticeship of seven years to John Strand a Fisherman in the Parish of Wandsworth in the County of Surry & never Rented Ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or was a yearly Servt.

Sarah Lloyd aged abt. 59 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife Widow of John Lloyd who hath been Dead abt. seven yrs. & that she cannot give any Acct. of his Settlement says before her intermarriage wth. the said John Lloyd & whilst she was a Single Woman she lived a yearly hired Servant with Mr. John Welch at the Rose & Crown the Bottom of Stoney Lane in the Parish of St. Olave Southwark in the County of Surry for five years at the yrly. Wages of five Pounds.

Hannah Collins aged abt. 42 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Widow of Luke Collins who hath been dead abt. four years by whom she hath one Child (to wit) Sarah aged abt. six years says her sd. late Husbd. his Apprenticeship was born in the Parish of Naes in the County of Kildare in the Kingdom of Ireland & never Rented Ten Pounds a yr. paid Parish Taxes was an Apprentice or yearly Servant

Eleanor Anderson aged abt. 41 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife of John Anderson (now at Sea) says her said Husband served his Apprenticeship of seven years with Mr. Geo: Tinkler a Fellmonger in Twotland Street in the Parish of St. James in the City of Dublin in the Kingdom of Ireland & never Rented Ten Pounds a yr. paid Parish Taxes or was a yearly Servt.

Mary Smithers aged abt. 50 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Widow of John Smithers who hath been dead abt. eight says her sd. husbd. Rented a house of fourteen Pounds a year in the Parish of Stornton in the County of Sussex for four years or thereabouts & never after he quitted sd. house Rented ten Pounds a year or paid Parish Taxes says she hath not since his Death Rented Ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a yearly Servant

John Robt Bowman aged abt. 63 yrs. upon Oath says he Intermarried with his prest. Wife Mary at Burford in Oxfordshire abt. the year 1746. by whom he has five Children (to wit) Mary aged abt. nine years Elizabeth aged seven years Millicent aged abt. five years Charles aged abt. three years & John aged abt. one year Says that John Bowman his father deceased Rented a house upwards of twenty Pounds a year in Bridges Street in the Parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westmr. & lived therein sevl. years & quitted the same abt. thirty nine yrs. since as he has been inform'd & Verily Believes and this Examinant says that he never Rented a house of Ten Pounds a yr. pd. Parish Taxes was an Apprentice or yearly Servt

Eliz: Tyler aged abt. 32 yrs. upon Oath says she intermarried with her husband Robt. Tyler who is now at Sea in the Parish Church of St. George Bloomsbary on the 30th. day of Januray 1755. says her said Husbd. whilst he was a singleman lived a hired yearly Servant with Jonathan Watson . Esqr . in Hart Street in the Parish of St. George Bloomsbury in the County of Middx for four year & upwds. at the yearly Wages of Eight Pounds & never Rented ten Pounds a year or paid Parish Taxes says she hath three Childn. by her sd. husband namely Eliz : & Mary aged abt. sixteen Months & Robt . aged abt. Nine Months

Thos. Yarrow aged upwds. of 70 yrs. upon Oath says that whilst he was a Single Man he lived a hired yearly Servt. with Mr. Henry Honour a farmer in the Parish of Stanbridge in the County of Bedford for two years at the yrly. Wages of £5. & never after he quitted his sd. service Rented ten Pounds a yr. pd. Parish Taxes or lived a yrly. Servt. for one yr.

Mary Bayne aged abt. 24 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife of Wm. Bayne (now at Sea) says her sd. husbd. before his intermarriage with this Examinant & whilst he was a singleman he lived a hired yrly Servt . with Mr. Boswell a Cow keeper in the Parish of Plymouth in the County of Devon for one year & upwds. & after he quitted his said Service never Rented ten Pounds a yr. paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servt.

Ann Hannah Treadaway aged abt. Twenty three years Upon Oath Says she Intermarried with her husband Wm. Treadaway in the Parish Church of Chippen Burnett in the County of Hertford on the Twenty Ninth day of Febry 1756 Says her sd. Husband Served Seven years apprentishipp with Mr. Jno. Grayn Breethes maker at Eaton in the County of Bucks as her sd. Husband informed her & as She verily beleives Says he never rented Ten Pounds a year pd. Parish Taxes or was a hired yearly Servt. has one Child by him Wm . aged abt. four Months

Eliz: Holland aged abt. 21 yrs. upon Oath says she intermarried with her husbd. Thos. Holland at the fleet London abt. five years ago says her sd. husbd. served his Apprenticeship to his father Thos. Holland a Plaisterer in Crutched fryans in the Parish of St. Olave Hart Street in the City of London as she hath been informed & believes says her sd. husband never Rented Ten Pounds a yr. paid Parish Taxes or was a hired yearly Servt

Cath: Price aged abt. 23 yrs. upon Oath says she never was married says she lived a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Lyon a Baker in Black Man Street in the Parish of St. George Southwark in the County of Surry for one year & upwards at the yearly Wages of five Pounds & hath quitted said Service abt. two years & hath not since Rented ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a yearly Servt.

Mary Powell aged abt. 64 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Widow of Wm. Powell who hath been dead abt. three years says the sd. Wm. Powell Rent -ed a house near the College in the Parish of Sidbury in the City of Worcester of the yearly Rent of fourteen Pounds lived therein abt. fourteen years & quitted same abt. five years before his death & never after Rented ten Pounds a year or paid Parish Taxes says she hath not since his death Rented ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes lived a yearly Servant or Intermarried with any Person

Eliz: Bolt aged abt. 55 Yrs upon Oath says she never was married was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant says her father Jas. Bath served one Year the last part of his Apprenticeship with Mr. Chas. Doe a Comb maker at Chain Gate in the Parish of St. Saviour Southwark in the County of Surry

Hannah Brown aged abt. 23 Yrs. upon Oath says she never was married says she lived a hired Yearly Servt. with Mr. Glanville in Thames Street in the Parish of Clever in the County of Berks for five Yrs. or thereabouts & hath quitted her sd. Service abt. two Yrs.

Ann Goodman on the behalf of Gertrude Bannister aged abt. 50 Yrs. upon Oath says the said Gertrude Bannister is the Widow of Jospeh Bannister says the sd. Joseph Bannister abt. seventeen Yrs. ago Rented a house in Baldwins Gardens in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn above Bas in the County of Middx. of the Yearly Rent of ten Pounds & lived in the same three Months & upwards & never after Rented ten Pounds a Yr. or pd. Parish Taxes to her knowledge or belief

Mary Spencer aged abt. 45 Yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife of Wm. Spencer says her said husband served his Appren- ticeship of seven years to Mr. Hutchins a Pipemaker in the Coal yard in the Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middx
Jane Young aged abt. 26 Yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife of Patrick Young (now at sea) say her sd. husband was born in the Parish of Dundee in the Shire of Fife in Scotland

Mary Millward aged abt. 28 Yrs. upon Oath says she never was married Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes was an Apprentice or Yearly Servt. Says her father Peter Millward Rented a house in Mouldmakers Row in the Parish of Chorist Church St. Leonard Foster Lane in the City of London at the Yrly. Rent of Twenty Pounds. & upwards; lived therein abt. Twenty four Years & there dyed
Sarah York aged abt. 33 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Widow of Wm. York says her said husband served his Apprenticeship of seven years to a Shoemaker in the Parish of St. David in the City of Exeter

Eliz: Ross aged abt. 44 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife of John Ross (gone from her) by whom she hath one Child James aged abt. six years says her sd. husband served his Apprenticeship of seven years to Mr. Brown a Taylor in the Parish of St. Peter in the City Town of Nottingham

Eliz: Muirhead aged abt. 37 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife of Thos. Muirhead (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the fleet London abt. six years says she cannon give any Account of his Settlement & that before her Intermarriage she lived a hired yrly. Servt . with Mr. Bird a Shipwright at the Wet Dock in the Parish of Rotherhithe in the County of Surry for one yr. & Upwds. at the yearly Wages of Six Pounds

Eliz: Spier aged upwds. of 70 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Widow of John Spier who hath been dead abt. twelve years says her sd. late husbd. before his intermarriage with this Examinant & which he was a single Man lived a hired yearly Servt. with Sr. Thos. Wheat at in the Parish of Glimp near Woodstock in the County of Oxford for 3 yrs. & upwards & never after Rented ten Pounds a year or pd. Parish Taxes says she hath not since his death Rented ten Pounds a yr. pd. Parish Taxes or lived a yrly. Servt

Eliz: Lediard aged abt. 26 yrs. upon Oath says she never was married says she lived hired yearly Servt. with Mr. Ford a Fanmaker one year & upwards at the yearly Wages of five Pounds & hath quitted her sd. Service abt. one years says the last three Months or there abts. of her said Service the sd. Mr. Ford lived in Leaden hall Street over against the India Coffee house in the Parish of St. Catherine Creechurch andrew. widow half London

Sarah Horseman upon Oath says she is the Wife of Wm. Horseman to whom she was married at the fleet London abt. fourteen Yrs. ago & that this Examinant has been informed & verily believes her sd. husband served five yrs. of his Apprenticeship with Mr. Hodges a Picture framemaker & then his said Master dyed & this Examinants husband never was assigned over to any Person nor ever Rented ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one year & that the three last yrs. of the sd. Term of five yrs. her sd. husbd. continually lodged in the said Mr. Hodges house in the great Old Bailey in the Parish of St. Sepulchre in the City of London

Ann Bowers aged abt. 27 yrs. Lodging in Kings head Court in the Parish of St. Clemt. Danes upon Oath says she is the Wife of Wm. Bowers with whom she Intermarried at the fleet London on the 20th. of august 1747. Old style says he was bound Apprentice by Indenture dated the 26th. of Octr. 1737. To Joseph Springwell Citizen & Turner of London & served twelve Months the last part of his Apprenticeship with Mr. Saml. Dobbins in the Precinct of the Savoy in the County of Middx. says she has one Child by him Mary aged upwards of two years & is poor & not able to Maintain herself & Child says her said husbd. never Rented Ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servt. for one year as she has been informed & verily believes

Ann Jenkins Wife of Lewis Jenkins gone from her upon Oath says she intermarried with the said Lewis Jenkins at the Fleet Londn. the 21st. June 1745. says her said husband Rented a house in Ax & Bottle Yard in the Parish of St. Saviour Southwark of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds & lived in the same upwards of one Year quitted said house upwards of three Years & hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes & hath two Children by her said husbd. John aged abt. five Years & Lucy aged abt. Eleven Months

Hannah Everitt aged upwards of 60 Years upon Oath says she never was married & that she lived a hired Yearly Servt. with Mrs. Joanna Roach in the Cleveland Court Noble Yard in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. for 2 Years & upwards at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds & hath quitted said Service abt. thirty Years & hath not since Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Margt. Winstanley of Chandor's Street Covent Garden upon Oath says that she was well acquainted with the father & Mother of Thos. Buerdsell an Infant aged abt. Eight Years says he was born in the house of Mrs. Jennings in the Old Bailey in the Parish of St. Sepulchre's London & that Thomas Buerdsell the father of the said Infant Rented a house in Golden lane in the Parish of St. Luke in the County of Middx of the Yearly Rent of ten Pounds & upwards as she has been informed & verily believes

Eliz: Weston aged abt. 32 Years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Wm. Weston (now at Sea) with whom she intermarried on the Parish Church of St. George in the East in the County of Middx. abt. Seventeen Years ago says her said husband before his intermarriage with this Examinant & whilst he was a Single Man lived a hired Year -ly Servant with one Mr. Warren a Butcher in St. James's Market in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. for three Years or there abouts & lay during all the said term of three Years at the house of the said Mr. Warren in Jermyn Street in the said Parish of St. James & here after he quitted said Service Rented ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes. says she has two Childn. by her said husband (to wit) John aged abt. three Years & Elizth . aged abt. fourteen Months & she being poor is not able to maintain them

Eliz: Sadler aged abt. 62 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Henry Sadler says she being a Widow & without Child or Childn. lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year with Mrs. Mary Potter in Hoxton town in the Parish of St. Leonard Shoreditch in the County of Middx. at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds & hath quitted said Service abt. ten Years & hath not since Rented ten Pounds a Year or paid the Poors Rate

Eliz: Canter aged abt. 48 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Robt. Canter who hath been dead abt. four Years says her said late husband Rented a house in Plumtree Court in the Parish of St. George Bloomsbury in the County of Middx. of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds & lived in the same abt. half a Year according to her now best Remembrance & never after Rented ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish taxes says she has not since her said husbands death Rented ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish taxes

Eliz: Canter aged abt. 48 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Robt. Canter who hath been dead abt. four Years says her said late husband Rented a house in Plumtree Court in the Parish of St. George Bloomsbury in the County of Middx. of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds & lived in the same abt. half a Year according to her now best Remembrance & never after Rented ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish taxes says she has not since her said husbands death Rented ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish taxes

Robt. Wimberley of the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx, Turner on the behalf of Sarah Yates aged upwards of fifteen Years upon Oath says that Wm. Yates the father of the said Sarah Yates Rented a house in South Audley Street in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westmr. of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds & upwards and lived therein several Years & never after Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes to this Examinants knowledge or belief And the sd. Sarah Yates upon her Oath says she never was an Apprentice or a Yearly Servant for one Year.

Mary Houlder aged abt. 30 Years upon Oath says she lived a hired Yearly Servt . with Geo: Rossiter at the Cheshire Cheese at Mount Pleasant in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middx. for 7 Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of £4. and hath quitted said Service about 7 Years: since which Time she hath not Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for One Year and further upon her Oath says she Never was Married

Sarah Parrott aged abt. 28 Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Jane Parrott aged abt. 28 Years deceased and that being a Wido. & without Child or Children She lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Tomlinson a Woodmonger opposite Old Gravel Lane in the Parish of St. John Wapping in the County of Middx. for One Year & upwards at the Yearly wages of £5 and hath quitted said Service abt. 15 Months and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year And further upon her Voluntary Oath says she is pregnant with Child or Childn. which is likely to be born a Bastard or Bastards and to become chargeable to the Parish of St. Clemt. Danes where she now lodges she being Poor & Unable to Maintain the same when born; says that Edwd. Delany Servant to Mr. Bromley a Fishmonger at Temple bar had carnal knowledge of her body in the Month of July last and at sevl. other times since at one of which times he got her with Child of the Child or Children with which she is now pregnant and that no other Persons did beget the same

Elizth: Dove aged abt. 40 Years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Joseph Dove (gone from her) to whom she was Married at the fleet London abt. Ten Years ago and hath two Children by him Mary aged abt. Nine Years and James aged abt. Eight Years. says her said husband served 7 years Apprenticeship with Mr. Vell a Taylor at the Golden Ball in Pall Mall in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. and never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for One Year.

William Henry Peaain aged abt. 70 yrs. upon Oath says he served five years the last part of his Apprenticeship with Thos. Pink a Shoemaker in Damask Street in the Parish of St. Andrew in the City of Dublin in Ireland

Ann Johnson aged abt. 33 years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Ralph Johnson (now at Sea ) says her said Husband was born in the Parish of St. Andrew in the Shire of Inverness in Scotland & never Rented ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes was an Apprentice or yearly Servant as her said Husband informed her & as she verily believes

Rachel Baldwin aged abt. 41 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife of Nathaniel Baldwin says her said husband now rents & lives in a farm of five Pounds a year in the Parish of Badby in the County of Northampton says her said husband hath kept the same abt. two years & hath paid to the Poor all that time

Sarah Owens aged abt. Thirty six years upon Oath says she is the Wife of James Owens with whom she intermarried at the fleet London upwards of Eight Years ago says her said husband is a Native of Ireland & never gained a Settlement in England & is now at Sea on board one of his Majestys Ships of War as she hath been informed & verily believes says before her intermarriage with the said James Owens & whilst she was a Single Woman she lived a hired yearly Servant for one year with Mr. Saml. Johnson in the Parish of Malkiston in the County of Darby at the yearly Wages of Two Pounds ten Shillings says she has two Children James aged abt. seven years & Mary aged abt. five Months

Patrick Reed aged abt. 59 years upon Oath says that he is a Native of Ireland & never gained a Settlement in England says that abt. forty years ago he lived a hired yearly Servant with Terence Grant a Farmer in the Parish of Clunfeigle on Ireland for one year & upwards at the yearly Wages of Twenty Shillings or thereabouts & hath not since Rented ten Pounds a year or paid Parish Taxes

Amey Frazier (lodging at a common lodging house in Drum Alley in the Parish of St. Clemt. Danes in the Liberty of Westmr. within the County of Middx.) Upon Oath says she is the wife of Thos. Frazier gone from her and that her said husband informed her & which information she verily believes to be true that he served Seven Years Apprenticeship with Mr. George Lowther in George Yard Lambard Street in the Parish of St. Edmund the King in the City of London Perukemaker & never Rented Ten Pounds a Year nor was a hired Yearly Servt. for One Year to her knowledge or belief

Frances Sumner aged abt. 30 Years upon Oath she is the Wife of John Sumner ( gone from her ) by whom she has One Child named Frances aged abt. 4 Months says her said husband informed her & which information she verily believes to be true that the served three Years and upwards the first part of his Apprentice ship with Mr Brittenbeigh a Taylor in Oxenden Street in the Haymarket in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. & then parted by consent & never was assigned Over to any Person nor Rented Ten Pounds a Year or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year to this Examinant knowledge or belief

Henry Habbas Aged abt. Fifty Years Lodging in May Pole Alley in the Parish of St. Clemt. Danes in the County of Middx Upon Oath Saith that he Intermarryed with his Wife Mary who is now abt. the Age of Fifty in the Parish Church of Kings near in Hamshire about Seventeen Years ago Says before his Intermarryage with the sd. Mary & whilst he was a Singleman he lived a hired Yearly Servt. with Fras. Cottinton Esqr . in Arguile Buildings for four Years or thereabts. at the Yearly Wages of Ten Pounds & hath left his sd. Service abt. Nineteen Years Says the Coach House and Stables were in the Ragshead Inn Yard in Swallow Street in the Parish of St. George Hannover Square in the Liberty of Westmr . and this Examinant laid at the Ragshead Inn during the last two Months of his sd. Service

Ann Wheat aged about 22 Years liveing in Stanhope Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex upon Oath says that on the Tenth day of November 1759 she was Delivered of a Male Bastard Child in the House of Mr. Drawater a Stone Mason in Great Castle Street in the Parish of St. Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex which hath since been Baptized by the Name of Philip Cooke , Says she is poor and not able to Maintain the Same.

Ann Wheat aged about 22 Years liveing in Stanhope Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex upon Oath saith she never was Married That she lived in and rented an House in Hanover Yard in the Parish of St. Mary Le Bon in the County of Middx for the Space of Three Months and upwards at the Yearly Rent of Fourteen pounds Quitted the Same upwards of Six Months.

William Sumner aged about 51 Years Destitute of Lodging upon Oath saith that he was bound an Apprentice by an Indenture for Seven Years to Mr. John Whitehead a Taylor near Hand Alley in Holbourn in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex and with his said Master there served all his time out which Expired about 30 Years since and hath not since rented Ten pound a Year paid Parish Taxes or been a hired Yearly Servant

Ann Thomas Wife of Edward Thomas Lodging at the house of Mr. Gibson dealer in Coals in Salisbury Street in the Strand upon Oath saith she very well knows Richard Thomas an Infant aged about three Months whom she verily believes to be the lawful Issue of Benjamin Thomas (who is not to be found ) by Judith his Wife Says the said Benjamin Thomas lived in and rented a House in that Part of Exeter Street which is in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for the Space of about Two Months at the Yearly Rent of Twenty five pounds or thereabouts quitted the Same about Eighteen Months and hath not since rented any House or paid Parish Taxes to this Examinant's Knowledge and also says the said Richard Thomas was Born at a House opposite Green Street in Castle Street in the said Parish of St. Martin in the Fields and that the Same is now with Mr. Thomas in Milford Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes

Elizabeth Hills aged about Sixty Years Lodging in that part of Bear Yard which is in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx upon Oath saith she is the Widow of Joseph Hills who has been Dead about thirteen years to whom she was Married at the Fleet about 27 Years since That her said Husband was a Cordwainer by Trade and lived in and rented a House in Prescot Street Goodman's Fields in the Parish of St. Mary White Chapel in the County of Middlesex for the Space of One Year at the Yearly Rent of Ten pounds besides Taxes Quitted the Same several Years before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and never after rented any House or paid Parish Taxes as he hath informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true That she hath not kept House rented ten pounds a year paid Parochial Taxes or been a hired Yearly Servant Since the Death of her said Husband

Samuel Birch aged about 72 Years Lodging at the Spoted Dog in Blackmoore Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx upon Oath saith That he lived in and rented an House the Corner of Hog Lane in Oxford Road in the Parish of St. Anne in the Liberty of Westminster for the Space of Two Years & upwards at the Yearly Rents of Seventeen pounds Quitted the Same about Twelve Years ago and hath not since rented Ten Pounds a year or paid Parish Taxes That he was Married to his present Wife Mary at Prestbury Church in Cheshire in the Year 1715

Anthony Armstrong aged 65 Years Lodging in St. Clement's Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx upon Oath saith That he lived in and rented a House in Falconbridge Court Soho Square in the Parish of St. Anne in the Liberty of Westminster for the Space of Two Years and upwards at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds besides Taxes Quitted the Same about Twenty Years ago and hath not since rented any House paid the Land Tax or Poor Rate That he was Married to his present Wife Elizabeth at St. Clement' s Church upwards of Twenty Years ago

Sarah Brooks aged 70 Years and upwards Lodging in Clement's Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx upon Oath saith she was Married to Thomas Brooks at the Fleet about the Year 1714 whom she believes to be Dead as she has not heard of him for several Years says her said Husband hath informed her That he was bound an Apprentice by an Indenture for Seven Years to Mr. Stoneystreet a Farrier in Nightingale Lane in Red Cross Street in the Parish of St. Botolph without Aldgate in the County of Middlesex London and with his said Master there served about Two Years, then intermarried with this Examinant and Inlisted for a Soldier That he never rented a House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes also says the said Mr. Stoneystreet hath informed her that her said Husband served him as an Apprentice two Years.

Martha Ingham aged about 60 Years Lodging at Mr. Trotters in Houghton Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx upon Oath saith she is the Widow of John Ingham who has been Dead about Eighteen Years That since his Death she this Examinant lived in and rented a House in Round Court in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for the Space of Four Years at the yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds Quitted the Same about Six Years That she hath not since kept House paid the Land Tax or Poor Rate

Mary Morgan aged about 24 Years Lodging at Mr. Batridge's in Stanhope Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx upon Oath saith she never was Married That she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Senhouse, Appraiser and Broker in Lambeth Marsh in the Parish of St. Mary at Lambeth in the County of Surry for One Year and Nine Months at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds diet and Lodging Quitted the same about Five Months That she never rented a House or paid Parochial Taxes.

Elizabeth Chapman aged about 24 Years upon Oath saith she is the Wife of William Chapman a Soldier in one of the Marching Regiments under the Command of the Duke of Richmond to whom she was Married at Woolwich Church in the Month of January 1754 That he served seven Years Apprenticeship with a Taylor in the Parish of Southwell in the County of Bedford That he never kept House paid Parliamentary or Parochial Taxes nor hath been a hired Yearly Servant since his Apprenticeship which Expired about Six Months before his intermarriage with this Examinant That she hath one Child by her said Husband to wit Mary aged upwards of Four Years and also Says her said Husband was Born in the said Parish of Southwell

Elizabeth Riley Wife of Charles Riley living next the White Horse in Moors Yard in St. Martin's Lane upon Oath saith that her Sister Ann Vandercomb (who is a Lunatic and resides at Mr. Acton's in Wych Street ) never rented any House was an Apprentice or hired Yearly Servant for One year That her Father Claudius Vandercomb was a Chairman and never did any Act whereby to gain a Settlement to this Examts. Knowledge That his Father John Vandercomb was a Victualler and lived in and rented a House in Marlbrough Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster for upwards of One year at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds And upwards and there dyed about 30 Years since as she hath been informed and verily believes and also says the said Ann Vandercomb her Sister never was Married to any Person to this Examinants Knowledge

Sarah Price aged about 30 Years upon Oath saith she is the Wife of Hugh Price a Lunatic who Resides at Mr. Brammah's in Stanhope Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes Says she intermarried with the said Hugh Price at May Fair Chapel about Nine Years ago by whom she hath one Child living to wit Nathaniel aged about Eighteen Months That her said Husband is an Attorney and lived in and Rented a House is Old Fish Street in the Parish of St. Nicholas Olave London for about Three Years at the yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and paid all Parochial Taxes Quitted the same between three & four Years ago And hath not since Rented any House or paid the Land Tax or Poor Rate.

Mary Dove aged about 60 Years Lodging in Wych Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes upon Oath saith she is the Widow of James Dove who has been Dead upwards of Four years to whom she was Married at the Tabernacle belonging to the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields about 36 Years ago That her said Husband lived in and Rented a House in King Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster for three Years at the Yearly Rent of Twenty pounds or thereabouts Quitted the Same about Twenty Years and never after Rented any House or paid the Land Tax or Poor Rate Says she hath not since her Husbands Death Rented any House save one at Hammersmith of Four Pounds a Year for which she paid neither Land Tax or Poor Rate

Ann Vaughan aged about 25 Years Lodging at Mr. Edwards in Peter Street near Clare Market in the Parish of St. Clement Danes upon Oath saith she never was Married That she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Edwards in Grays Inn Lane in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middx for One Year and upwards at the yearly Wages of Five Pounds Quitted the Same about Two Years ago and hath not since rented any House paid Parliamentary or Parochial Taxes nor been a hired Yearly Servant for One whole year

Elizabeth Allnutt aged about 35 Years Lodging in Clements Lane in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middx upon Oath saith she never was Married bound an Apprentice kept House or been a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father William Allnutt served Seven Years Apprenticeship with Mr. Giles Louder a Shoemaker in the Parish of Alverstock in the Town of Gosport in the County of Hants as she has been informed and which information she verily beleives to be true also Says he never Rented any House or paid the Land Tax or Poor Rate to this Examinants Knowledge

Anna Clarke aged about 50 Years Lodging in Hemlock Court in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middx upon Oath saith she is a Widow and that since the Death of her Husband she this Examinant and her Mother Mary Raddon (being then in Copartnership) lived in and rented a House near the Armitage Bridge in the Parish of St. John Wapping in the County of Middlesex for about Five years at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds Quitted the Same at Christmas 1755 since which time neither this Examinant or the said Mary Raddon her Mother have Rented any House or paid the Land Tax or Poor Rate.

Margaret Burgin aged about 32 Years upon Oath saith she never was Married kept House was an Apprentice or hired Yearly Servant for One year That her Father William Burgin who has been Dead about 22 Years lived in and rented a House in Hart Street in the Parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster for about the Space of One Year at the Yearly Rent of Eighteen Pounds or thereabouts Quitted the Same about Six Months before his Death and never after rented any House or paid Parliamentary or Parochial Taxes.

Elizabeth Chew aged about 35 Years Removed from the Parish of St. Mary White Chapel in the County of Middx by Order bearing date the 31st. day of October 1761 upon Oath saith she was never Married That she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Barron a Taylor in Arrundel Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx for upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Four pounds Quitted the Same about Nine Years ago and hath not since kept House paid Land Tax or Poor Rate or been a Yearly hired Servant for Twelve Months together And further saith she was on or about the 21st. day of May 1756 Delivered of a Female Bastard Child at the house of Mr. Roddart Shoemaker in Shepherd's Yard in the Parish of Trinity Minories in the Liberty of his Majesty's Tower of London which hath since been Baptized by the Name of Elizabeth and that she was on or about the 25th. day of October 1757 delivered of a Male Bastard Child in Sermon Lane Doctors Commons in the Parish of St. Mary Magdalen in Old Fish Street London which hath since been Baptized by the Name of Samuel Mullins And that she was on or about the 29th. day of May 1759 delivered of one other Female Bastard Child in Three Gun Court in the Parish of St. Botolph without Aldgate London which has since been Baptized by the Name of Isabella which said Three Children are likely to become Chargeable to the said Parish of St. Clement Danes she this Examinant being Poor and incapable of Maintaining the Same

Ann Wilson aged about 33 Years Lodging in Clement's Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middx upon Oath saith she never was Married bound an Apprentice kept House paid Parliamentary or Parochial Taxes or been a hired Servant for One year Says her Father Richard Wilson (who has been Dead about 22 Years) served his Apprenticeship with a Waterman in the Parish of St. Mary at Lambeth in the County of Surry and also Rented a House in Lambeth Marsh as she has been informed and which Information she verily beleives to be true

Susanna Flood aged about 27 years Lodging in Little Shire Lane in the Parish of St Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middx upon Oath saith she is the Widow of Noah Flood who has been Dead near One Month to whom she was Married in the Parish Church of Hornsey in the County of Middx year Six Years ago That he served Five years the last part of his Apprenticeship with Mr. John Farmer Mathematical Instrument maker near St. Sepulchres Church in the Parish of St. Sepulchre London which Expired in the year 1755 That she hath Three Children living by her said Husband to wit Noah aged 5 years Sarah near 3 years and Mary aged about 5 Months Says her said Husband never rented a House or paid any Tax whatever

Ann Sisson Aged about Fifteen Years Upon Oath Says that by Indenture dated the Nineteenth day of July 1759 she was bound an Apprentice by the Church Wardens & Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of St. Clemt. Danes in the County of Middx to Saml Pitchford of the Parish of St. Mary Le Strand in the same County Green Grocer and lived with him in the sd. Parish upwards of two Years Says She hath not been Assigned over to any person that her sd. Master hath Insisted himself for a Soldier as She hath been informed and her Mistress hath discharged her

Margt. Hill Aged abt. Thirty Years Upon Oath Says She Intermarried with Saml. Hill on the Eighteenth day of Augt. 1760 in the Parish Church of St. Ann in in the Liberty of Westmr. Says her sd. Husband Saml. Hill Served Seven Years Apprentiship with Mr. Wm. Worsley Perukemaker in King Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. aforesd. as She hath been informed & verily beleives Says her sd. Husband hath Absconded from her that he never Rented Ten pounds a Year pd. the Land Tax or Poors Rate that She hath one Child by him named Mary aged abt. two Months

Mary Botomly aged about thirty four Years upon Oath Says she is the Widow: of John Botomly who has been Dead near Eleven Years says her said late husband served Seven Years Apprentice with Mr Young Taylor in Gloucester Street near Queen Square in the Parish of St George the Martyr in the County of Middx never rented a house paid Land Tax or poor rate as She has been informed & verily believes

Joseph Churchill aged about fifty five Years upon Oath Says he Lodges at the fountain in Shire Lane in the Parish of St Clement Danes in the County of Middx that he lived in and Rented a House in St Martins Court in the Parish of St Martins in the Fields in the liberty of Westmr: of the Yearly Rent of twenty pounds for seven Years & hath quitted the Same upwards of twenty Years hath not since rented ten pounds a Year paid Land Tax or poor Rate

Noah Flood aged abt. 54 years upon Oath says he is the Father in Law of Susanh: Flood who intermarried with this Examinant Son Noah Flood in the Parish Church of Hornsey in the County of Middx abt six years Since According to his best remembrance and belief and that this Sd Son Noah Flood has been dead near three Months that his Said Son Noah Served two years or thereabts: the la part of his Apprenticeship with Mr Jno Farmer a rule maker in the Sd. Parish of Hornsey that her never rented a house or paid Taxes that his said Daur in Law Susannah Flood now lyes Dangers Ill as he has been informed & believes that She hath three Children by his Sd Son now liveing to wit Noah Aged abt 5 Years Sarah abt 3 Years and Mary Abt Seven Months

Eleanor Brooks Aged abt. Sixty years upon Oath Says she lived a hired Yearly Servt. with Mr Goodwin a Chymist near Suffolk Street in the Parish of St Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr . for One Year & Upwards at the Yearly Wages of four pounds & hath quitted Said Service upwards of Twenty Years says She was at that time a Wido: & without Child or Childn: hath not Since rented Ten pounds a Year pd. Land Tax or poor Rate or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year

Susana: Flood aged about 27 Years upon Oath saith she is the Widow of Noah Flood who has been Dead upwards of three Months to whom She was married in the parish Church of Hornsey in the County of Middx near Six Years ago that he served two Years or thereabouts the last part of his Apprentiship with Mr John Farmer Rule maker in the Said Parish of Hornsey that he never rented a House or paid Taxes

Ann Taylor aged about 25 Years upon Oath Says she is the Wife of John Taylor who has absconded from her & she does not where he is says she Intermarried with the sd. John Taylor in the Town of Charlewill in the County of Cork in the Kingdom of Ireland upwds. of Six Years Since & that her said Husband was Born in the Town of Rathkeil in the Kingdom of Ireland & never gained a Settlemt in England to her knowledge or Belief Says she hath two Children by him (to wit) Mary aged abt. five Years & Henry Aged upwards of One Year & that she has been Obliged to ask Charity in the Sd. Parish of St Clemt Danes in Order to Support herself & Children

Mary Clarke aged abt 45 Years lodging at the Castle in Portugal Street in the Parish of St Clemt Danes in the County of Middx, upon Oath Says she is the Widow of Richd Clarke who has been dead upwards of Nine Years to whom she was Married at the Fleet London near twenty Eight Years Since Says her Said Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant & whilst he was a Singleman lived a hired Yearly Servt . with Mr Robt Stewart Chymist in Fenchurch Street five Years in the Parish of St Katherine Coleman London and that she since his death hath hot rented any House or paid taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Elizth: Hitchcock Singleman Living in Kings head Court in Drury Lane in the parish of St Clement Danes in the County of Middx Upon Oath says That George May an Infant Child aged about three Weeks was born in the Lyingin. Hospital in Duke Street by Grosvenor Square in the Parish of St George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westmr . as this Examinant hath been inform'd & which information She Verily believes to be true

Henry Fifes aged about 29 Years upon Oath Says he intermarried with his Wife Elizabeth in the Parish Church of Much Clerkton in the County of Essex upwards of Eight Years Since by whom he hath One Child named Mary aged about Seven Years Says he Served his Apprentiship with one Mr Franks a Shoemaker in the Parish of Rumbles in Colchester in the County of Essex and that he never rented Ten pounds a Year or paid any Taxes

Charles Eccles aged upwards of Sixty Years Lodging in the parish of St Clemt Danes in the County of Middx, Upon Oath says that he Intermarried with his wife Sarah who is aged abt. fifty Years upwards of Twenty Six Years Since Says he was bound an Apprentice to one Edwd: Roberts who kept the Sign of the Bull faceing Stepney Church in the Parish of St Dunstan at Stepney in the County of Middx & lived there as an Apprentice upwards of Six Years & then went to Sea Says about thirty Years ago he had a Certificate from the sd Parish of Stepney to the Parish of Rumford in the County of Essex Acknowledging him to be legally Settled in the Paid Parish of Stepney

Henry Abbott aged upwards of 50 Years Lodging in the Parish of St Clement Danes , Upon Oath Says he lived a hired Yearly Servt. with Fras: Cottinten Esqr . in Argyle Buildings in the Parish of St James in the Liberty of Westmr. for three Years & upwards Yearly wages Ten pounds Says his Master Horses stood at the Naggs Head Livery Stables in Swallow Street in the Parish of St George Hanover Square where this Examinant Lodged he being at that time a Singleman without Child or Children and hath Quitted Said Service upwards of Sixteen Years and hath not since Rented Ten pounds a Year or paid Any Taxes

Mary Browne aged about 35 Years upon Oath Saith She is the Widow of Daniel Brown who hath been dead about Eight Years and that her said Husband Rented a House in Aldersgate Street in the Parish of St. Botolph without Aldersgate of the Yearly Rent of Forty Pounds and lived in the same about three Years And that She hath not since the Death of her sd. Husband Intermarried with any other Person Rented a House paid any Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant And further upon her Voluntary Oath Says She is pregnant with Child or Children which is likely to be born a Bastard or Bastards and to become Chargeable to the Parish of St. Clement Danes where She now lodges She being poor and unable to Maintain the same when born Says that the Revd. William Cockayne did beget the sd. Bastard Child or Children on her Body he the said William Cockayne having had Carnal knowledge of this Examinants Body in the Month of November last and at sevl. other Times since at one of which times he got her with Child of the sd. Child or Children of which She is now pregnant

Ann Ingram Wife of Giles Ingram a Lunatic upon Oath saith She Intermarried with her said Husband at the Fleet London on the Thirtieth day of March One Thousand Seven hundred and forty eight Says that her said Husband whilst a Singleman lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Durand a Pewterer in St. Martins Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster two Years or thereabouts as She hath been informed by her said Husband which information She verily believes to be true and Says that he hath not since Rented a House or paid any Taxes or been a hired Yearly Servant in one Place for a Year as She verily believes Says She hath one Child by her said Husband named Giles aged upwards of Seven Years

Elizabeth Perne aged about 33 Years Wife of Edward Perne who is gone from her says She intermarried with her sd. Husband about four Years since and that he Served above five Years of his Apprenticeship with Mr. Lewis a Peruke maker in St. Martins Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields when his said Master died as She has been informed by her said Husband and believes Says that he never Rented a House or paid any Taxes as She verily believes Says She hath two Children by her said Husband namely William aged about four Years and Edward aged about Ten Months

Elizabeth Perne aged about Thirty three Years upon Oath Says She is the Wife of Edward Perne (who is gone from her ) with whom She Intermarried about five Years since Says her said Husband Served five Years and upwards the first part of his Apprenticeship with Mr. Lewis a Peruke maker in St. Martins Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster and then his said Master died Says her said Husband never was Assigned over to any Person rented House or paid any Taxes as her said Husband hath informed her and which Information She verily believes to be true Says She hath two Children by him William aged about four Years and Edward aged about ten Eighteen Months

Joan Hartstone aged about 71 Years upon Oath Says She is the Widow of Benjamin Hartstone who has been Dead about Twenty one Years Says her said Husband Served his Apprenticeship with one Harvey Aspree a Shoemaker in the Parish of Uttoxeter in the County of Stafford Says her said Husband never Served any Parish Office or paid Taxes of any kind whatsoever neither hath She since his Death rented any House or paid any Taxes

Ann Nash aged about Eighteen Years upon Oath Says She never was Married or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father William Nash served his Apprenticeship of Seven Years with one Mr. Coleman a Backmaker in Glasshouse Yard in the Parish of St. Botolph without Aldersgate in the County of Middlesex as She hath been informed by him and verily believes Says She is pregnant with Child or Children which is likely to be born a Bastard or Bastards and to become Chargeable to the Parish of St. Clement Danes where She now lodges She being Poor and unable to Maintain the same when born Says that Richard Corbett of the Inner Temple London Gentleman , did beget the said Bastard Child or Children on her Body he the said Richard Corbett having had Carnal knowledge of this Examinant's Body in the Month of February last and at several other Times since at one of which times he got her with Child of the said Child or Children of which She is now pregnant

Ann Castledine aged about 31 Years upon Oath Says She is the Wife of Michael Castledine ( Gone from her ) with whom She Intermarried in the Parish Church of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex in the Month of July about six Years since by whom She hath two Children Ann aged about four Years and George aged upwards of a Year Says her said Husband whilst a Singleman lived a hired Yearly Servant with his Uncle Jonathan Castledine in the Parish of St. Bartholomew by the Exchange in the City of London for two Years at the Yearly Wages of Twenty Pounds Meat Drink and Lodging and never after lived a Yearly Servant Rented a House or paid any Taxes as She hath been informed by her said Husband which Information She verily believes to be true

Elizabeth Lawrence aged about 35 Years upon Oath says She never was Married and that She lived a hired Yearly Servant about Seven Years with Mr. John Woodbridge Merchant on St. Dunstans Hill in the Parish of St. Dunstan in the East London and quitted the same about three Years Says She hath never lived in any other Service since Rented a House or paid any Taxes

Ann Johnson wife of Danl. Johnson gon from her Upon Oath Says She is abt. Thirty five Years of Age that she Intermarried with the sd. Danl. Johnson at May Fair Chapel upwards of Twelve Years Since Says her sd. Husband never rented a House was an Apprentice or hired Yearly Servt. Says her sd. Husbands father Bishop Johnson Rented a House in Downing Street by Hyde Park Corner in the parish of St. George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westmr. of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds & upwards and lived therein Sevll. Years

Mary Williams wife of Roger Williams on Behalf of Susanna Wotton her Neice an Infant aged About Six Years upon Oath Says the sd. Susanna Wotton is the Daughter of Wm Wotton by Elizth: his Wife both Deceased Says the said Wm Wotton served his Apprenticeship with one Willm Lewis A Boat Builder in Trinity Street in the Parish of St Augustin otherwise St Austin in the City of Bristall and never rented any House or Pd: any Taxes as this Examinant hath been informed and believes.

John Godwin Aged About 46 Years Upon Oath says that when he was a Single Man he lived A Hired Yearly Servt. with John Barber Esqr . in Queen Square in the Parish of St George Queen Square in the County of Middx Four Years and Upwards at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds and hath Quitted his said Service upwards of Twenty Years and hath not since rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt for one Year.

Euphemia Johnston of the Parish of St. Clement Danes Widow on behalf of Ann Hay a Lunatick aged upwards of 40 Years upon Oath says that the said Ann Hay was never Married and that She Rented a House in Panton Square in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds lived therein upwards of two Years and quitted same about four Years and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant as this Examinant has been informed and verily believes to be true

John Godwin Aged About 46 Years Upon Oath says that when he was a Single Man he lived A Hired Yearly Servt. with John Barber Esqr . in Queen Square in the Parish of St Georges Queen Square in the County of Middx Four Years and Upwards at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds and hath Quitted his said Service upwards of Twenty Years and hath not since rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year.

Susanna Tilley Aged about 38 Years upon Oath says She Intermarried with James Tilley her late Husband deceased at May Fair Chappel by whom She has two Children George aged about Twelve Years and Ann aged about Four Years Says her said late Husband lived a hired Yearly Servant with a Widow Gentlewoman in Red Lyon Square in the Parish of Saint George the Martyr in the County of Middlesex upwards of three Years and quitted his said Service upwards of Sixteen Years as She has been informed by her said late Husband which Information She verily believes to be true Says that her said late Husband never Rented a House or paid any Taxes

Eleanor Jones Singlewoman aged about 30 Years upon Oath says She was never Married and that She lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Simpson Printseller deceased in Russell Court in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of three Years and quitted same near six Years and hath not since lived a hired Yearly Servant Rented a House or paid any Taxes

Mary Arnell aged about 22 Years upon Oath says She was never Married That She lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Biggs in Bridge Street in the Parish of St. Margaret Westminster upwards of one Year at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds and hath quitted her said Service about Three Years and hath not since rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year That She has One Child named Charles aged about Eleven Months

Sarah Fordham aged about 26 Years Says She is the Wife of Edward Fordham (who is gone from her ) with whom She intermarried at the Fleet London above seven years since Says her said Husband never was bound an Apprentice lived a hired Yearly Servant or Rented a House as She hath been informed by him and verily believes Says her Husband's Father Fordham Served his Apprenticeship of Seven Years with Mr. Grooby at the Kings Arms Tavern on Ludgate Hill in the Parish of St. Bridget otherwise St. Brides London as She has been informed which Information She verily believes to be true

Ann Whable aged about 40 Years upon Oath says She was never Married rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father James Whable Rented a House upon Cuckolds point in the Parish of Rotherhith in the County of Kent of the Yearly Rent of Ten pounds and paid parish Taxes as She hath been informed and which information She verily believes to be true

Amey Frasier Upon Oath Says that She hath by Enquiry been informed & wch. information this Examinant believes to be true that Jno: Fungstone the father of Wm. Fungstone Aged abt. two Years & Jno: Fungstone Aged abt. two Months lived in & Rented a House near the Haymarkett in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds & Upwards & lived in the same upwards of one Year

Wm. Pullen Upon Oath Says he is a Native of Ireland & never gained a Settlemt. in England that he Rented a Farm in the Parish of Clendalken in ye sd. Kingdom of Ireland of the Yearly Rent of Ninety Pounds lived in the same abt. two Years & hath Quitted said farm upwards of One Year or hath a Wife named Elizth . & one Child named Wm. Aged abt. Seventeen Months

Catherine Ellis Aged abt. Fifty Eight Years Upon Oath Says She is the Wido. of Ealy Ellis who hath been Dead abt. Six Months Says her sd. late Husband Served Seven Years Apprentishipp with Mr. George Green a Cork Cutter in Holborn in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn above Barrs in the County of Middx & never Rented House or pd. Taxes

William Pullen aged about Forty three Years upon Oath says that he Rented a Farm in the Parish of Rippon in the County of York at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds and lived thereon four Years and hath quitted the same upwards of two Years Says he hath a Wife named Elizabeth aged about thirty three Years and one Child by her named William aged about Seventeen Months

Ann Price aged about 50 Years upon Oath says She is the Widow of Charles Price with whom She Intermarried in the Parish Church of St. Mary at Newington in the County of Surry upwards of Thirty Years Says her sd. late Husband Served his Apprenticeship of Seven Years with his Father Nathaniel Price a Currier in the Parish of St. Mary Magdalen Bermondsey in the sd. County of Surry as She hath been informed by him an which Information She verily believes to be true and that her said late Husband never Rented a House of Ten Pounds a year or paid Taxes out of the sd. Parish as she verily believes

Eleanor Fox Upon Oath she is the Widow of Richd. Fox who was a Native of Ireland that she this Examinant is a Native of Ireland says she has two Children by the said Richd. Fox Richd Aged upwards of Twelve Years and Eleanor Aged upwards of Ten Years both born in little Russell Street in the Parish of St Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster & County of Middx

Amaryllis Davis Wife of Henry Davis upon Oath Says she Intermarried with the said Henry in the Parish Church of St Gregory by St Pauls in the Year 1739 Says her said Husband Rented a House known by the Sign of the Crown by Smithfield Barrs in the Parish of St Sepulchers in the County of Middx at the Yearly Rent of twenty five Pounds lived in the same about half one Year and hath quitted the same upwards of one Year and hath not since Rented House or paid Taxes

Johanna Wase Aged upwards of Sixty Years Lodging at the Barley Mow in Milford Lane in the Parish of St Clemt Danes in the County of Middx Upon Oath Says She rented A House known by the Name of the Sign of the Plow near three Coney Walk in the Parish of Lambeth in the County of Surry of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and lived therein upwards of One Year and quitted said House about Eight or Ten Years and hath not Since rented any House or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for One Year

Elizth Carr Aged upwards of Sixty Years Upon Oath Says she is the Widow of Robt Carr who was a Native of Ireland and never gained a Settlement in England Says before her Intermarriage with the said Robt. Carr and whilst she was a Singlewoman she lived a hired Yearly Servt. with Mr Gamlin in Bedford Court in the Parish of St Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster two Years at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds and never Rented House or Paid Taxes

Mary Shallcross wife of Wm. Shallcross a Lunatic Upon Oath Says She Intermarried with the said Wm.
