Shallcross at May Fair Chapell upwards of Eleven Years Since Says her said Husband Rented a House in the Old Bailey in the Parish of St Sepulchers London of the Yearly Ground Rent of Five Pounds lived therein Upwards of four Years and was Rated and Paid the Kings Tax quitted said House about Five Months and hath not Since rented House or Paid Taxes Says She hath three Children Elizth Aged upwards of 10 Years Wm Upwards of Nine Years and Mary Upwards of two Years

Ann Watkins Aged about 25 Years on behalf of her Sister Rebecca Wackett Aged about 24 Years Upon Oath says that her said Sister Rebecca Wachett is a Singlewoman and was Never Married and that she Lived a hired Yearly Sert. with Mrs Atkinson at the Sign of the Plow in Kingsgate Street in the Parish of St Giles in the Fields in the County of Middx for One Year at the Yearly Wages of three Pounds & hath quitted her said Service upwards of Six Years and hath not since Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Sert. for One Year

Margt Herring on the behalf of Phebe Johnson Upon Oath Says that the said Phebe Johnson is her Daughter by Wm. Johnson her First Husband that the said Phebe Johnson was born in the Match Walk in Ratcliff Highway in the Parish of St Paul Shadwell in the County of Middx were this Examint. said Husband Wm. Johnson Rented A House of Eight Pounds a Year and Paid the Land Tax

Biddy Jackson Aged about Twelve Years Upon Oath Says she was bound an Apprentice by and with the Consent of the Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of St Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. to Mrs Tinsley in Paradise Row in the Parish of St Mary at Lambeth in the County of Surry and lived with her in the said Parish of St Mary at Lambeth upwards of Four Months

Elizth. Lewis Aged abt. Twenty four Years Upon Oath Saith She was never Married that She lived a hired Yearly Servt. with Mr. Griffith Roberts at the Kings Head Tavern in Chancery Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middx for three Years at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds & hath quitted her sd. Service abt. Twelve Months Says on the NIneteenth of April 1761 She was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in the House of the sd. Mr. Roberts in Chancery Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls aforesd. wch hath since been Baptized by the Name of John Says the sd. Griffith Roberts did beget the sd. Male Bastard Child on her Body that the sd. Griffith Roberts is Since Dead & She being poor is unable to maintain the sd. Child

Elizth: Ryley Aged about 35 Years upon Oath Says she was never Married and that she Lived a hired Yearly Sert. with Mr Johnson a Shoemaker in Grays Inn Lane in the Parish of St Andrew Holborn above ye Barrs in the County of Middx for two Years or there abouts at the Yearly Wages Four Pounds and hath quitted her said Service about Nine Years and hath not Since Rented house Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Sert. for One Year Save and Except her being hired as a Nurse at the Foundling Hospital

Mary Allwright Aged abt. 44 Years Upon Oath Says that on the Seventeenth day of Febry 1744 Old Style She Intermaryed with Wm. Allwright at the Fleet London but whether her sd. Husband is liveing or Dead She this Examinant cannot tell Says her sd. Husband Served Seven Years Apprentiship with Mr. Newman a Bricklayer in the Parish of Epsom in the County of Surry & never Rented House or lived a hired Yearly to her Knowledge or beleif

Jane Harmoney Aged about 21 Years Upon Oath Says she is a Singlewoman Says she lived a hired Yearly Sert. with Mr Ingall a Watchmaker who Lodged at Mr Woodcocks in Fleet Street in the Parish of St. Bridgets Vulgerly St. Brides for One Year at the Yearly Wages of three Pounds Ten Shillings and hath quitted her said Service upwards of Four Years and hath not Since Rented house Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Sert. for One Year

Margt Cowen Wife of Wm Cowen gone from her Aged abt 44 Years Upon Oath Says that she Intermarried with her said husband in the Parish Church of Warborough in the Kingdom of Ireland Says her husband is also a Native of Ireland and never gained a Settlement in England that he Rented a house in the Parish of St Mary in the City of Dublin and lived therein upwards of Six Years and Paid all Taxes and hath not since Rented house or paid Taxes to the best of her knowledge and belief

Ann Redding Aged abt 68 Years Upon Oath Says She was never Marryed and that she lived a hired Yearly Sert. with Mr Windom Bughes in Weston Green in the Parish of Thames Dillon in the County of Surry upward of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds and hath quitted her said Service upwards of 22 Years and hath not Since Rented house Paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Sert. for One Year

Joannah Sharp Widow of John Sharp Aged about Forty Years Upon Oath Says she Intermarryed with her said Husband in the Parish Church of St: Katherine Coleman in the City of London about Seven Years ago Says her said Husband Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with a Plumber in Water Lane in the Parish of Allhallows Barkin in the City of London hath been out of his said Apprenticeship about Twenty Seven Years and Never Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Sert. for One Year Says she hath not Since his Death Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Sert. for One Year.

Wm- Powell of Wych Street in the Parish of St. Clemt. Danes in the County of Middx on behalf of Cath: Manethorp his Grand Daughter an Infant Aged about three Years Upon Oath Says that his Daughter Cath: Manethorp Deceased Mother of the above Named Infant Intermarried with Thos. Manethorp at the Fleet London about Ten Years Says he has Serched the Land Tax Books in the Parish of St. Bridgets Vulgarly St. Brides London & finds by the said Books that his Son in Law the abovenamed Thos. Manethorp Rented a House in Greens Rents in the said Parish of St. Brides & was Rated and paid ye Land Tax there and never after Rented house or paid Taxes William Powell

Hannah Barnesley Aged about 29 Years Upon Oath Says she was Never Married that she lived a hired Yearly Sert. with Mr Steward who kept a Chandlers Shop the Corner of Salsbury Court Street in the Strand in the Parish of St Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. for One Year and Upwards at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Eight Weeks and Never Rented House or Paid Taxes

Richard Evans Aged about 43 Years upon Oath Says he Intermarried with Elizabeth his Wife in the Parish Church of St Bridgets Vulgarly St. Brides in the City of London about Fourteen Years Ago Says he Never Rented House Paid Taxes was an Apprentice or a hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says his Father Richard Evans Rented a House and Farm in the Parish of Kennerley in the County of Salop upward of Twenty Eight Years at the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and Upwards and Paid all Taxes

Ann Gwillim Aged about 30 Years Upon Oath She is the Widow of Thos Gwillim with whom she Intermarried in the Parish Church of Rumford in the County of Essex about Nine Years ago Says her said Husband Rented a House in Honey Lane Market in the Parish of St. Lawrance Jewry in the City of London upwards of Three Years At the Yearly Rent of Twenty Five Pounds or thereabouts hath quitted said House about Six Years and hath not Since Rented House or Paid Taxes, Says she has One Child by her said Husband Named Sarah Aged about Six Years.

Ann Roffee Aged about 45 Years Upon Oath Says about One Year and half ago she Intermarried with Her Husband Henry Roffee Aged about Sixty Years in the Parish Church of St. James in ye Liberty of Westminster Says her said Husband Rented a House in Cathern Wheel Yard in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster aforesaid about Six Years at the Yearly Rent of Sixteen Pounds or there abouts and hath quitted said House about Eighteen Years and hath not Since Rented House or Paid Taxes.

Elizth. Overley Aged about 18 Years Upon Oath Says she never was Married was an Apprentice or a Hired Yearly Sert. Says her Father Isaac Overley Served Seven Years Apprentiship with Mr Chester a Watch Key Maker in Cherry Tree Alley in White Cross Street in the Parish of St. Lukes in the County of Middx and never after Rented House or Paid Taxes as this Examinant hath been Informed by her Mother and which Information she Verily believes to be true.

Mary Jenkins Aged about 35 Years Wife of of Henry Jenkins gone from her with whom she Intermarried in Kentish Town Chappel about Twelve Years ago Says her said Husband Rented a House in Tooley Street in the Parish of St Olaves Southwark in the County of Surry Seven Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Eleven Guineas and Paid all Taxes and hath quitted said House about Ten Years and hath not Since Rented House or Paid Taxes.

Mary Meadows Aged about 47 Years Upon Oath Says she lived a hired Yearly Sert . with Mr Thomas Evans at the Thistle & Crown in South Lambath in the Parish of St. Margat Lambeth upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of three Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of two Years. she being at that time a Widow & without Child or Children and hath not since she left her said Service Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Sert. for One Year

Mary Casady Widow Aged upwards of Seventy Years Lodging in Change Court in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex Upon Oath Says that her Late Husband Patrick Casady was a Native of Ireland and never Gained a Settlement in England as she has been Informed and which Information she Verily Believes to be true Says she Cannot give any Account of the Settlement of her Father other then he was Born in Wales but in what Part she Knoweth not Says she was Born in Brewers Yard in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster Says she Never Rented House Paid Taxes was an Apprentice or a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year

John Sperrin Aged about Seventy Years upon Oath Says that whilst he was a Singleman and without Child or Children he Lived a Hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Hyde a Publican at the Coach & Horses in Burlington Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. upwards of two Years at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds hath quitted said Service about Forty Years and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Sert for One Year

Thos. Wright Aged about Fifty Years upon Oath Says he Intermarried with his Wife Sarah at the Fleet London about Seventeen Years ago Says he is a Native of Ireland and never Gained a Settlement in England Says he Rented a House in the parish of Kingsale in the County of Cork upwards of Ten Years at the Yearly Rent of Five pounds Ten Shills. and paid to the poor hath quitted said House about Twenty four Years & hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says he has One Child by his said Wife Thomas Aged Ten Years & this Examinant being poor was Oblidged to ask Charity in the parish of St. Clemt. Danes

Richard Phillips upon Oath Says he was Bound Apprentice to Joseph Slaymaker Blacksmith in Barnaby Street in the parish of St. John Southwark in the County of Surry Says that he this Examinant with Hannah his Wife were by Order under the Hands and Seals of Barthw. Hammond and Francis Bedwell Esqrs. two of his Majestys Justices of the Peace for the County of Middx (One of the Quorum) Bearing Date the Eigth Day of May One Thousand Seven Hundred and Fifty four Removed from the parish of St Clement Danes in the said County of Middx to the said parish of St. John Southwark

Valentine Rumley on Behalf of Elizth. Rumley A Lunitick Aged about Fifty three Years Upon Oath Says she is the Wife of Valintine Rumley Gone from her Says her said Husband whilst a Singleman and without Child or Children Lived a hired Yearly Servant with Counceller White in Tooks Court Chancery Lane in the parish of St. Andrew Holborn above Barrs in the County of Middx upwards of four Years but what Wages he had this Examinant Cannot tell hath quitted said Service about Twenty Years and hath not Since Rented House paid Taxes as this Examinant hath been Informed and which Information he Verily Believes to be true

Elizth. Meredith Aged about Thirty Years Upon Oath Says she was Never Marryed Says she Lived a Hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Barnett the Town Clerk in the Parish of Woolwich in the County of Kent Upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted said Service about three Years & hath not since Rented House Paid Taxes or Lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Ann Roberts Aged about Twenty Eight Years Upon Oath Says she was never Marryed Says she Lived a Hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Fletcher at the Devil Tavern by Temple Bar in the parish of St. Dunstan in the West in the City of London upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds hath quitted said Service about Two Years and hath not Since Rented House Paid Taxes or Lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year And further upon her Voluntary Oath Says she is Pregnant with Child or Children which is likely to be Born a Bastard or Bastards and to Become Chargeable to the Parish of St. Clement Danes she being poor and unable to Maintain the same when Born Says One Wm- Browne a Victualler had Carnal knowledge of this Examinants Body sometimes in the Month of November Last and at several other Times since at One of which times he got her with Child of the said Child or Children with which she is now pregnant

Elizth. Jones Singlewoman Aged about Fifty Years upon Oath Says she was never an Apprentice Rented House paid Taxes or Lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says she Cannot Give any Account of the Settlement of her Father Says she was Born a Little above Great Turnstile in Holborn in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middx

Cath Baker Aged about 28 Years upon Oath Says she is the Wife of Henry Baker with whom she Intermarried in the Parish of Church of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx about Ten Years Since Says the said Henry Baker is Gone from her where he is she knoweth not neither Can she Give any Account whether he is Living or Dead Says her said Husband Informed her & which Information she Verily beleives to be true that he Served the first part of his Apprentiship with a Butcher in Red Street in the Parish of South fleet in the County of Kent

Eleonor Blunt Aged about 22 Years Singlewoman upon Oath Says she Lived a Hired Yearly Sert . with Mr. Palmer in the Parish of Spackley in the County of Worcester One Year at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted said Service at Michmas 1764 & hath not Since Rented House or Paid Taxes

James George Wilson of Howard Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx on Behalf of John Donifont An Infant Aged about Six Years upon Oath Says that Elizth. Donifont the Mother of the said Child is Dead That she Informed this Examinant and which Information he Verily Beleives to be true that the said John Donifont was Born in Little Wild Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middx

Frederick Smith Aged about 25 Years upon Oath Says he Served One Year & a half of his Apprentiship with Mr. Sermon a Brush maker in Castle Street in the parish of St. Philip & Jacob in the City of Bristol & never after was Assigned over to any person Rented House paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Wm. Giles Aged about Seventy Six Years upon Oath Says that whilst he was a Singleman and without Child or Children he Lived a Hired Yearly Servant with his Father Walter Giles in Princes Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middx & One Year & upwards at the Yearly Wages of Ten Pounds & never after Rented House paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Sert for One Year

Elizth. Gibbs Aged about Twenty Eight Years upon Oath Says she was never Marryed was an Apprentice Rented House Paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says her Father Wm. Gibbs Rented a House in White Chaple in the Parish of St. Mary White Chaple in the County of Middx One Year & upwards at the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and upwards & never after Rented a House or paid Taxes And further upon her Voluntary Oath Says she is Pregnant with Child or Children which is likely to be Born a Bastard or Bastards and to become Chargeable to the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx she being Poor & unable to Maintain the same when Born Says One Thomas Evans a Journeyman Shoemaker who Lodges in Butcher Row in the said Parish of St. Clement Danes had Carnal knowledge of this Examinants Body sometime in the Month of April Last and Once afterwards at One of which times he got her with Child of the said Child or Children with which she is now Pregnant & that he the said Thomas Evans & no other Person did beget the same.

Elizth. Pendlebury Aged about Twenty One Years upon Oath Says she is the Wife of Collins Pendlebury with whom she Intermarried in the parish Church of St. John the Evangelist in the Liberty of Westmr. about One Year ago Says her Husband is an Apprentice to Jos: Grindell a Trunk Maker in Long Acre in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. with whom he now lives & has Served upwards of Six Years of his said Apprentiship Says she has One Child by her said Husband Elizth. Aged about Six Weeks.

John Watson Aged about Thirty three Years upon Oath Says he was never Marryed Says he Served seven Years Apprentiship with Mr. Holt a Shoemaker in Leather Lane in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn in the County of Middx & never after Rented House Paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year

James Cobham Aged about fourteen Years upon Oath says he was Bound Apprentice by the Church Wardens & Overseers of St. Clement Danes to Joshua Roper of Turnmill Street in the Parish of St. John Clerkenwell in the County of Middx Cabinet founder with whom he lived about Nine Months and then went away & never after was Assigned over to any Person

Henry Norman Aged about Fifty three Years upon Oath Says he Intermarried with his Wife Elizth. at the Fleet London about thirteen Years ago Says he Lived a Hired Yearly Servant whilst a Singleman and without Child or Children with Mr. Christopher Coleman an Oylman the Corner of Philpott Lane Eastcheap in the Parish of St. Andrew Hubbard London near Billingsgate One Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Eight pounds hath quitted said Service about Twenty three Years & never after Rented House paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year

James George Wilson of Howard Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes on Behalf of Ann Green an Infant Aged about Seven Years the Daughter of Wm. Green by Letitia his Wife both Deceaced upon Oath Says the said Childs Father Wm. Green who has since Died Served Seven Years Apprentiship with a Baker in the Parish of Watlington in the County of Oxford as this Examt hath been Informed & which Information he beleives to be true

Mary Brooks Aged about Thirty five Years upon Oath Says she Intermarried with her Husband Michael Brooks in the Romish Chaple by Lincolns Inn Fields Says her said Husband Rented a House in the Parish of Westham in the County of Essex three Years at the Yearly Rent of Twelve pounds hath quitted said House about Twelve Years & hath not Since Rented Ten pounds by the Year paid Land Tax or poors Rate

Thomas Kearey Aged about forty Years upon Oath Says he Intermarried with his Wife Catherine in the Parish Church of St. Orgin in the City of Dublin about Twenty three Years ago Says he is a Native of Ireland & never Gained a Settlement in England Says he Served Seven Years Apprentiship with One John Hoy a Shoemaker in the said Parish of St. Orgin in the City of Dublin & never after Rented House paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says he has three Children by his said Wife (to witt) Mary Aged Twelve Years Larnes Aged Seven Years & Martha Aged about three Years & a half

Richard Parker Aged about Fifty Six Years upon Oath Says he was never Marryed Says he Rented a House in Old Brandford in the Parish of Great Eling in the County of Middx One Year & upwards at the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds hath quitted said House about Twenty Six Years & hath not Since Rented House paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year.

Ann Clarke aged about 25 Years upon Oath says she was never Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Martha Pugh who kept an Earthen Ware and Chandlers Shop in Brooks Street in the parish of St. George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster for two Years or there- abouts at the Yearly Wages of Three pounds hath quitted said Service about five Years and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Brooks aged about 35 Years upon Oath she is the Wife of Michael Brooks (at Sea) with whom she intermarried in the Romish Chapel by Lincolns Inn fields about Seventeen Years ago and by whom she hath one Child to wit Dorothy aged about twelve Years, says her said Husband Rented a house in the parish of West Ham in the County of Essex for three Years at the Yearly Rent of twelve pounds hath quitted said House about twelve Years and hath not since Rented House of Ten pounds by the Year or paid the Land Tax or poor Rate

Mary Croysdill Aged about Thirty Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. John Scotta Land Waiter in Prescot Street Goodmans Fields in the Parish of Saint Mary White Chapel in the County of Middlesex upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of One Year Ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Ann Shepherd Aged about Sixty Years on her Oath says She never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with One Mrs Potter a Millener near Great Turnstile Holbourn in the Parish of St Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of £4 hath Quitted her said Service upwards of Twelve Years ago and hath not since she Quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Alice Birch aged about Upwards of Sixteen Years on her Oath says that she never was married, Rented House, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year, says she was bound an Apprentice by the Chapell Wardens and Overseers of the Town of Uxbridge in the County of Middlesex to One James Colman as Poulterer in Clare Market in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster by Indenture Dated the 8th day of August 1771 but her Master using this Examinant Ill was obliged to part with him, and an Application to the Churchwardens and Overseers of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes was by them Informed that the Indentures were good for nothing and would never gain a Settlement thereby and further says that since parting with her said Master she has never done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Haberley Aged about Twenty Eight Years, on her Oath says, she intermarried with Edward Haberley (gone from her) at the Parish Church of Shoreditch about Six Years ago, & by who she hath Three Children now living, namely Mary Aged about five Years, Richard aged about Three Years, & Edward aged about Two Years; Says that her said Husband has one other Child by a former Wife named Robert aged upwards of Eight Years, And further says that her said Husbands before his intermarriage with his said first Wife, and whilst he was a Singleman lived as a hired Yearly servant with Thomas Sewell Esqr now Sr Thos Sewell Knt in Lincolns Inn Square in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex , for Seven Years and upwards, at the Yearly Wages of Ten Pounds, or thereabouts, hath quitted his said Service about Twelve Years ago, and hath not since he Quitted the same ever rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year, or done any other Act where to gain a Subsequent Settlement.

Catherine Piggott Aged about Twenty five Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Charles Piggott gone from her and with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Year 1769 Says her said Husband Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Wallsworth a Lapidary in King Street Seven Dials in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or did any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

John Richardson upon Oath Saith he has a wife named Ann & two Childn. Abigail aged abt. 4 Yrs. and William about 4 months and that whilst a Singleman he lived a yearly Servant with Mr. Corlaces in the Parish of Garstang in the County of Lancaster at the yearly wages of two pounds for one Year and has not Since rented ten pounds a year paid parish taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one year
Wm. Varton aged 17 Yrs. upon Oath Saith he was born at Tamworth in the County of Warwick and never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant for one Year

Eliz Jackson upon Oath saith she is the Wife of Richard Jackson (gone from her) who informed her he served his Apprentiship with a Butcher at Scarborough in Yorkshire and that her sd. husband never rented Ten Pounds a Year paid parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one Year to her knowledge or belief

Mary Wood upon her Oath saith she is the wido . of Richard Wood who informed her he was born in Tooleys Gate in the Parish of St. Olave Southwark where his father lived in and Rented a house and that neither her sd. late husband nor this Examinant since his decease have rented ten pounds a Year pd. Parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for one Year

Isabella Clark aged upwds. of 70 Years upon Oath saith she is the wido . of John Clark who dyed abt. 17 Yrs. ago. and that her sd. late husband lived sevty. Years in a house of his own in Cobbs Court in the Parish of St. Ann Blackfryers London Paid Scot & Lot in she sd. parish & Served the Office of Constable there and that neither her sd. late husband after he quitted the aforementioned house nor has this Examinant since her decease rented ten Pounds a year paid parish taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one Year

Michl. Curtis upon Oath saith he served Seven years Apprenticeship with Mr Thos. Cole a Smith at Cirencester in the County of Gloucester & never rented ten Pounds a Year pd. parish taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one year.

Agnes Jones aged 32 years upon Oath saith she is the wido . of Abraham Jones of whose Settlement she can give no Account and that she this Examinant was bound Apprentice for five Years to Mrs. Large a Schorl mistress & lived with her upwds. of 3 Years in Hatton Garden in the Liberty of Saffron hill Hatton Garden & Ely Rents in the parish of St. Andw. in Holborn in the County of middlesex and then her sd. Mistress & this Examinant Disagreeing the parted by Consent and she never was assigned over to any other person nor ever rented ten pounds a year or paid parish Taxes

Rd. Hodges upon Oath saith he was born in the Parish of St Thomas at Pensford in the County of Somerset and never Rented ten pounds a Year paid parish taxes or was an apprentice or yearly Servant for one Year

Sarah Caswell upon Oath saith she is the wife of Fras. Caswell (who absconds from her) & to whom she was Married at the Fleet London near 8 Yrs. ago & that she has late informed & verily believes her sd. husband (whilst a Singleman) lived a Yearly Servant with Mr Holk an Apothecary in Aldermanbury Postern in the Parish of St Giles without Cripplegate Londn. at the Yearly Wages of Six pounds for the Space of Six Years or thereabt. & continued a year wth. the sd. Mr Holton after his intermarriage with this Examt. & has not since he quitted his sd Service rented ten pounds a Year or pd. parish Taxes

Eliz. Smith aged abt. 50 Years upon Oath saith she never was married & that about 6 Years age she was hired to live with Mr Belchier a Banker & lived with the sd. Mr Belchier as a Yearly Servant in Lombard Street in the parish of St. Edmd. the King in Londons for three Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds and has not since she quitted her sd. Service rented ten pounds a Year pd. parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Beecham upon Oath saith she is the wife of Joseph Beech of whose Settlement she can give no Account and that she was bound apprentice for 5 Years to Mrs King a Quitted & after having lived with her sd. Mistress about two Years ran away & went to live worth Mr Carr at the Crown Inn at Harlow in Essex with whom she continued about three Years and about a fortnight after she left Mr Carr intermarried wirth the sd Joseph Beech and that a short time after her coming to Mr Carr her sd Mistress King came to her & convented to her staying his service

Alice Harthway upon Oath Saith she is the wife of John Harthway who served his time wth. his father at Beckingham in the County of Kent & never Rented ten Pounds a year paid parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one Year as this Examint. has been informed & believes

Mary Sadler upon Oath saith she never was married & never Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one Year that her late father rented a house of the Yearly rent of £30. in the High Street in the parish of St. Mary in Oxford lived therein several years & there dyed

Edwd. Wilson upon Oath saith he never was married and that he lived a Yearly Servant with Mr. Ralph Barnes the Filazer of London & Middx. at the yearly Wages of £30 for one Year & upwds. during which time he lodged in a house at the Corner of Featherstone Buildings in the parish of St. Andrew in Holborn above Barrs in the County of Middlesex & has not since he quitted his said service rented ten Pounds a Year Paid parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one year

Ann Eamondson upon Oath saith she is the wido . of Rt. Eamondson by whom she has two Children Robt. aged 8 Yrs. & Henriette aged 7 Yrs. & that she has been informed & verily believes her sd. husband was born at Leeds in the County of York & she knows nothing further of his Settlemt.

Rt. Thornes upon Oath saith he lived a yearly Servt. (whilst a singleman with Wm. Chitterbuck Esqr . in the Parish of Pountenham in the County of Dorset for 8 yrs. at the yearly Wages of £2 and has not since he left his sd. Service rented ten Pounds a yr. Paid Parish Taxes or lived a yearly servt. for one year

Elizh, Chittenden aged 35 years upon her Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a Yearly Servnt. with Mr Gregory a Sword Cutler in Chancery Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex at the yearly Wages of Four pounds for two years and upwards, quitted her sd. Service upwds. of three years ago and has not since rented ten Pounds by the Yr. pd. parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one Yr.

Sarah Horsman upon Oath saith she is the wife of Wm Horsman to whom she was married at the Fleet London about ten years ago and that this Examinant has been informed and verily believes her sd. husband Served five years of his Apprentiship with Mr Hedges a Picture frame maker and then his sd Master dyed and this Examinants husband never was assigned over to any other person nor ever rented ten Pounds a year paid parish taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one year and that the three last Years of the sd. term of five Years her sd. husband continually lodged in the sd Mr. Hodges house in the yr to Bailey in the Parish of St Sepulchers London

Middx Jas. Hawtin upon Oath saith he Served his Apprentiship wth. John Ditcher a Cordwainer in Salisbury Court in the Parish of St Brides London and never rented ten Pounds by the year paid Parochial Taxes nor lived a yearly Servt. for one year and that He has 2 Childn. by his late wife Frances (viz.) Hannah aged upwds. of 5yrs. & Eleanr . aged upwds. of 3 Yrs.

John Marshall of the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex Taylor on behalf of Charles Huddy who appears to be a Lunatic upon Oath saith the said Charles Huddy Rented a House of Ten Pounds a Year & upwards in little Moorfields in the Parish of St. Giles Cripplegate London and lived in the same upwards of Two Years & hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a year or paid Parish Taxes as this Examinant has been informed and verily believes

Mary Green aged about 16 years Upon Oath says her Father Thomas Green a Blacksmith Rented & lived in a House in Chatham in the County of Kent and Paid all Parish Taxes for the same several Years as She has been informed by him, and believes Says She never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant

John Waters aged about 43 Years upon Oath says he lived in a House of his own in Red Lyon Street in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex and paid all Parish Taxes for the same several years Says he quitted his said House about Eighteen years ago and hath not since Rented Ten pounds a Years paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year

Jane Brenham aged about 42 Years upon Oath says She Intermarried with George Brenham her late Husband deceased in the Parish Church of Bishop Hill the Elder in the City of York about Nineteen Years since. Says her said late Husband Rented a House in Cavendish Square Street in the Parish of St. Mary le Bone in the County of Middx. & paid the Poor Rate for the same several Years And further says her said late Husband never after Rented Ten Pounds a year or paid Parish Taxes

Jane Burkett upon Oath says She was born in the Parish of Hotwissell in the County of Northumberland where her Father served his Apprenticeship of Seven Years, as She hath been informed & verily believes

Ann Conway aged abt. 31 Years upon Oath says She Intermarried with John Conway at the Fleet London the 29th. Octr. one thousand Seven hundred & forty Nine says her said Husband is a Parishioner legally Settled in the Parish of Ruthyn in the County of Denbigh in North Wales as She hath been informed by him & Verily believes & that He non Rents & lives in a Houses there, in which he Carries on the Business of an Apothecary

John Rutter one of the Beadles of the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex or behalf of Silvester and Sarah Eakin the Children of John Eakin by Mary his Wife both deceased upon Oath Says that by Order under the hands and Seals of Ambrose Godfrey & Thomas Deveil Esqrs. two of his Majesty's Justices of the Peace for the said County of Middlesex bearing Date the 4th. Day of Decr. 1741 Mary Eakin Wife of John Eakin (who was therein said to be gone from her) with their three Children therein named were removed from the Parish of St. Clement Danes to the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields as the Place of their last legall Settlement as appears by the said Order of Removal Says he has been informed and which information he verily believes to be true that the above named Silvester Eakin and Sarah Eakin are the Children of the said John Eakin & Mary his Wife.

Sarah Stay aged abt. 65 Years upon Oath Says She is the Widow of Thos. Stay Deced. Says her said late Husband Served the first part of his Apprentiship with his Father Thomas Stay in Carnaby Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. & there Inlisted himself into his Majesty's Service as her sd. late Husband has informed her & as She verily believes Says her said late Husband never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says She hath not since his Death Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Dinah Davis aged abt. Thirty Years upon Oath Says She never was Married & that She lived a hired Yearly Servant upwards of one Year & a half with Dr. Lloyd in Deans Yard in the Parish of St. Margaret in the Liberty of Westminster at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds & hath quitted her sd. Service about Six Years, since which time She hath not Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Sarah Sharrar aged abt. Nineteen Years upon Oath says She never was Married; Says She has been informed & which Information she verily believes to be true that her Father John Sharrar was born in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex & That be never was an Apprentice or Rented Ten Pounds a Year & that her Grandfather Thomas Sharrar Rented a House upwards of Ten Pounds a Year in Parkers Lane in the aforesaid Parish of St. Giles in the Fields

Elizth. Wooley aged abt. Sixteen Years upon Oath says She never was Married says She lived a hired Yearly Servt. with Mr. Geo: Smith in Long Row in the Markett Place in the Parish of St. Peter in the City of Nottingham for One Year & upwards at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds & hath quitted her sd. Service abt. four Months

Joseph Fellows aged abt. Fifty Four Years upon Oath says he Served the last four Years of his Apprentiship with Mr. Jacob Wallis Gold Chain maker near Kensington Square in the Parish of Kensington in the County of Middx: & has been out of his said Apprentiship abt. Twenty Nine Years, Says he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Davis aged abt. Twenty Eight Years upon Widow of Evan Davis upon Oath says She Intermarried with the said Evan Davis at the Fleet Londn. abt. Five Years since, Says her said late Husband has been Dead abt. three Months as She hath been informed and verily believes Says She Cannot give any Account of his Settlement other than that he was a Shropshire Man Says abt. Ten or Elevan Months ago She was removed by an Order or Pass Warrant under the Hands Seals of St. Saml. Gower Knt. & Richd. Ricards Esqr. two of his Majesty's Justices of the Peace for the County of Middx (one of ye. Quorum) from the Parish of St. Mary White Chapel in the sd. County of Middx. to the Parish of Kennington in the same County the Place of her last legal Settlement which Order was not Appealed against

Winifred Maginnees aged abt. Sixteen Years on be half of her Brother John Maginnees an Infant aged abt. Seven Years upon Oath Says her Father & Mother are both Dead that they were Natives of Ireland & never gained a Settlement in England that her sd. Brother John Maginnees was Born in Cross Lane in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middx.

Ann Mc.farson aged abt. Twenty Seven Years Wife of Robt. Mc.farson (gone from her) upon Oath says She Intermarried with the sd. Robt. Mc.farson at the Fleet London in the Month of January 1749. Says the sd. Robt. Mc.farson before his Intermarriage with this Examinant & While a Single Man lived a hired Yearly Servant with Robt. Dunbar Esqr. at Bethnal Green in in the Parish of St. Matthew Bethnal Green in the County of Middx. for one Year & upwards at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds as She hath been informed & Verily believes

Ann Griffith aged abt. Thirty Years Wife of Joshua-Griffith upon Oath Says that abt. five Years ago. She Intermarried with her said Husband at the Fleet London Says her sd. Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant & Whilst he was a Single Man as She hath been informed and believes, lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Spice a Hosier near Aldgate in the Parish of St. Catharine Creechurch Londn. for three Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds, Says on or abt. the 18th. Sepr. 1753. She this Examinant was removed with her Said Husband from the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middx to the sd. Parish of St. Catharine Creechurch London

Cathne. Baker on Behalf of Ann Saunders aged abt. Seventy one Years upon Oath says that the sd. Ann Saunders is the Widow of Richd. Saunders deced Says the said Richd. Saunders lived in & Rented a House in Off Alley in York Buildings in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. for Twenty Years at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds & upwards & here dyed Says the sd. Ann Saunders has not since the Death of her said Husband Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant
John Storey aged abt. fifty four Years upon Oath says he was born in the Parish of Willesey in the Isle of Ely in the County of Cambridge

Sarah Ray aged abt. 40 Years upon Oath says She is the Wife of Joshua Ray to whom She was married at ye. Fleet London abt. Twenty four Years since, Says her sd. Husband now Rents & lived in a house of Ten Pounds a Year & upwards in Devonshire Street in the Parish of St. George the Martyr in the County of Middx. in which he carries on the Business of a Staymaker

Ann Taylor Aged abt. Fifty four Years Upon Oath Says she is the Wido- of Wm- Taylor Says her sd- late Husband was born at Warsall in the County of Stafford where he Served his apprentishipp with his father Says her sd- late husband never rented Ten Pounds a Year pd- Parish Taxes or was a hired Yearly Servt.

Henry Mc. crevy aged abt. Fifty two Years upon Oath says he Intermarried with Isabella his Wife at the Fleet London abt. Twenty seven Years since Says he served his Apprentiship of seven Years with Mr. Chas. Pelagrin a Perukemaker in St. Martins Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. & that he hath been out of his said Apprentiship abt. Thirty Years since which time he hath not Rented Ten Pounds a Year or pd. Parish Taxe's says his said Wife is now very ill & he being poor & out of all manner of work is not able to maintain her

Cathne. Easton aged abt. 25 Yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife of John Easton (now at Sea) by whom she hath one Child John aged abt. 8 Months says her said Husband was born in Caple Street in the Parish of St. Mary in the City of Dublin in the Kingdom of Ireland .

Thos. Thackthwaite aged abt. 57 Yrs. upon Oath says he Rented a house in the Parish of Eaton in the County of Bucks of the Yearly Rent of Seven Pounds Seventeen Shillings & Six pence for Nineteen Years & paid to the Poor there

Sarah Abberly aged abt. 22 Years upon Oath says she never was an Apprentice Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year that her father Chas. Abberly served his Apprentiship with a Bricklayer in Charter house Lane in the Parish of St. Sepulchre's in the County of Middx & never Rented Ten Pounds a Yr. or paid Parish Taxes

John Westerfar aged abt. 31 Yrs. upon Oath says abt. fifteen Years ago he lived a hired Yearly Servant for the space of two Years with one Moses Jennings at the three Tuns in St. James's Back in the Parish of St. Stephen in the City of Bristol he being at that time a Single Man , says he hath a Wife named Ann & two Children John aged four Years & Joseph aged Eight Months & never Rented Ten Pounds a Yr. or paid Parish Taxes

Ann Brown upon Oath says She intermarried with John Holmes her first Husband at the Fleet London abt. Eleven Years since, says She hath one Child by the said John Holmes named Mary aged abt. nine Years, says her said late Husband was born & as he informed her served his Apprenticeship with his father over against the Great Church in the Parish & St. Peter in the City of Exeter , Says the said John Holmes hath been Dead abt. Four Years & that she hath since Intermarried with one John Brown who is a Native of New England & that she hath one Child by him Sarah aged abt. two Years

Thos. Mc. donnell aged abt. 67 Yrs. upon Oath says that abt. Four Years ago he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. John Mc. mahone on Saffron hill in the Liberty of Saffron hill Hatton Garden & Ely Rents in the County of Middlesex for one Year at the Yearly Wages of Nine Pounds diet washing & Lodging he being at the that time a Single Man & hath not since he quitted his said Service Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant

Mary Jones aged abt. 38 Years upon Oath says She is the Widow of Danl. Jones who hath been dead abt. two Years says her said Husband served three Years & upwards of his Apprenticeship with Mr. Hopkins a Butcher in Tower Street in the Parish of alhallows Barking London & then his said Master left off Business & gave this Examinants Husband leave to provide for himself in what manner he thought proper & that he never was assigned ever to any Person Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes Says She hath not since his Death Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant

Alice Rice aged abt. 30 Yrs. upon Oath says she w the Wife of Neale Rice (now at sea) with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Clunfeigle in Ireland abt. two Years since; says her said Husband was born in the said Parish of Clunfeigle as she has been informed & believes & never gained any Settlement in England to this Examinants knowledge or belief says she has one Child by him (to wit) Mary aged abt. 18 Months

Mary Wisdom aged abt. 40 Yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife of James Wisdom (gone from her) with whom She Intermarried at the Fleet London about fifteen Years since Says her said Husband Rented a House in Pepper Alley in the Parish of St. Saviour Southwark in the County of Surry of the Yearly Rent of Twenty four Pounds lived therein abt. two Yrs. & quitted same abt. six Years, since which time he hath not Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes to this Examinants knowledge or belief

Thos. Gees aged abt. 67 Yrs. upon Oath says he was born in North Street in the Parish of St. Mary in the City of Norwich & never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes was an Apprentice of Yearly Servant

Eliz: Hart upon Oath says she is the of John Hart (now at Sea) says her said Husband informed her & which Information she verily believes to be true that he is a Native of Ireland & never gained any Settlement in England & that he was born in Red Cow Lane in the City of Dublin in the Kingdom of Ireland; says she has one Child by him; Esther aged abt. Eleven Months

Ann Stone aged abt. 38 Yrs. upon Oath says she is the Widow of Cornelius Stone who hath been dead abt. Four Years says she cannot give any Account of the Settlement of the said Cornelius Stone , says before her Intermarriage with the sd. Cornelius Stone she Intermarried with one John Edwards who informed her & which information she believes to be true that he served his Apprenticeship with his Father in Kirby Street near Hatton Garden in the Liberty of Saffron hill Hatton Garden & Ely Rents in the County of Middlesex

Mary Wilson aged abt. 62 Years upon Oath says she never was married was an Apprentice Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or was a Yearly Servant , says her father Edward Wilson Rented a House of Sixteen Pounds a Year in Plumbtree Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middx. for upwards of twenty Years & there dyed

Martha Stevenson aged abt. 43 yrs. upon Oath says she never was married says She lived a hired yearly Servant with Anthony Hoyle Esqr . in Queen Square in the Parish of St. George the Martyr in the County of Middx. for upwds. of three years at the yearly Wages of Six Pounds & hath quitted her said Service abt. ten years since which time she hath Rented Ten Pounds a yr. paid Parish Taxes or lived a yearly Servant

Patience Rowland aged abt. 26. years upon Oath says she is the Wife of John Rowland with whom she intermarried at the Parish Church of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middx. abt. upwds. of one year ago; says her said Husband hath often told her that he never gained any Settlement by any Act of his own; but that his father served his Apprenticeship to a Smith in the Parish of Wasson in the County of Nottingham

Mary Bayne aged 24 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife of Wm. Bayne (now at Sea) says her sd. husbd. was Born in the Parish of in Scotland & never Rented ten Pounds a yr. pd. Parish Taxes was an apprentice or yrly. Servt. to this Examinants knowledge or belief

Sarah Brooks aged abt. 54 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife of Thos. Brooks (gone from her) say her said husband Rented a house of nine Pounds a year in St. James's Back in the Parish of St. James in the City of Bristol for two years & upwds. & paid to the Poor there & hath quitted sd. house abt. two years ago & hath not since Rented ten Pounds a year or paid Parish Taxes to this Examinants knowledge or belief

Thos. Holland aged abt. 46 yrs. upon Oath says he never Rented ten Pounds a year pd. Parish Taxes was an Apprentice or yearly Servt. says his father Thos. Holland served seven years Apprenticeship with Mr. Crouch a Plaisterer in Crutched fryars in the Parish of St. Olave Hart Street in the City of London says his sd. father never Rented ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or was a hired yearly Servt.

Mary Rain aged abt. 18yrs. upon Oath says she never was married Rented ten Pounds a yr. paid Parish Taxes was an Apprentice or yearly Servt. says her father Thos. Rain served seven yrs. apprenticeship to Mr. Wodler a Ropemaker in Bridewell Alley in the Parish of St. George Southwark in the County of Surry says her sd. father never Rented ten Pounds a yr. pd. Parish Taxes or lived a yearly Servt. as her sd. father informed her & as she verily believes

Mary Woodford aged abt. 14 yrs. upon Oath says she was born in the Parish of St. Clement in the City of Oxford as she hath been informed & believes & further says she never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant

Mary Morris aged abt. 22 yrs. upon Oath says she never was married says she was born in the Parish of Montrosse in the Shire of Angus in Scotland & never Rented Ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes was an apprentice or yearly Servt. for one year

Eliz: Wright aged abt. 46 years upon Oath says she is the Wife of John Wright (gone from her) says her said husband Rented a house of Ten Pounds a year in Aldersgate Street in the Parish of St. Botolph Aldersgate in the City of London for six yrs. or thereabout & hath quitted same abt. twenty years & hath not since Rented ten Pounds a yr. or paid Parish Taxes to this Examinants knowledge or belief

Ruth Jones aged abt. 47 Yrs. upon Oath says she never was married or Rented Ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes was an apprentice or yearly Servt. says her father John Jones Rented a house (known by the name of norths Coffee house ) in King Street near Guildhall in the Parish of St. Martin Ironmonger Lane in the City of London of the yearly Rent of £50 & upwards for upwards of twenty years & there dyed

Ann Dunning on behalf of John Holmes an Infant aged upwds. of Nine years upon Oath says he was born in the house of Mr. Moulder a Smith in Chancery Lane in the Parish of St. Dunstan in the West in the City of London

Eleanor Allen aged upwards of fifty Yrs. upon Oath says she is the wife of Edwd. Allen now abroad & beyond the Seas says her sd. husband served his Apprenticeship to Mr. Forle a Wire Drawer in the Parish of St. Catharine in the City of Dublin in Ireland as she has been informed & verily believes
Eliz: Johnson aged abt. 28 Yrs. upon Oath says she was born in the City of Dublin in the Kingdom of Ireland & never gained any Settlement in England to her knowledge belief
Duncan Campbell aged abt. 60 Yrs. upon Oath says he was born in the Parish of Kelling in the Shire of Perth in Scotland & never gained any Settlement in England to his knowledge or belief

Eliz: Gregory aged abt. 50 Yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife of Wm. Gregory says her said husbd. when he was a Single man lived one Yr. & upwds. a hired Yearly Servt. with one Mr. Cook at Bromton in the Parish of Kensington in the County of Middx as she has been informed & verily believes

Eliz: Constable aged abt. 40 years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Saml. Constable (now at Sea) with whom she intermarried at the Fleet London abt. Eight Years ago says her sd. husband was born in the Parish of Osperth in the County of Oxford

Mary Mewstead aged abt. 59 yrs. upon Oath says she never was married Rented ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes was an Apprentice or yearly Servt. says her father Thos. Mewstead Rented a house of ten Pounds a yr. & upwards in allens Court in the Parish of St. Ann in the Liberty of Westmr. for sevl. years

Mary Judith Wooldridge aged abt. 29 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Widow of arthur Wooldridge an who hath been dead abt. three Weeks by whom she hath one Child Mary aged three yrs. says her sd. husbd. served three years & upwards the first part of his apprenticeship to his Brother Josias Wooldridge an aneil maker in the Parish of Old Swinford in the County of Worcester & then his Brother & this Examinants Husbd. parted by Consent & never was assigned over to any Person Rented ten Pounds a yr. pd. Parish Taxes or was a yrly Servt.

Eliz: Muirhead aged abt. 37 yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife of Thos. Muirhead (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the fleet London abt. six years says she cannot give any Account of his Settlement & that before her Intermarriage she lived a hired yrly. Servt . with Mr. Bord a Shipwright at the Wet Dock in the Parish of Rotherhithe in the County of Surry for one yr. & upwds. at the yearly Wages of Six Pounds

Ann Brown upon Oath says she never was married & that she lived a hired yearly Servt. with Mr. Champ in High Street in the Parish of Alhallows in the City of Oxford at the yearly Wages of two Pounds for two yrs. or thereabouts. Quitted her said Service abt. thirteen yrs. & has not since Rented ten Pounds a yr. pd. Parish Taxes on lived a yearly Servant for one yr.

Simon Charles aged abt. 38 Yrs. lodging in Witch Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx. upon Oath says he was married to Elizabeth his Wife at the fleet London about fourteen Years ago says he served his Apprenticeship of Seven Yrs. to Robt. Howard a Taylor the Corner of Dutchy Lane in the Strand in the Precinct of the Savoy in the said County of Middx & never rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servant

Margt. Winstanley of Chandois Street Covent Garden upon Oath says that she was well acquainted with the father & Mother of Thos. Bussell an Infant aged abt. 8 Yrs. says he was born in the house of Mrs. Jennings in the Old Bailey in the Parish of St. Sepulchre London & that Thos. Bussell the father of the said Infant Rented a house in Golden Lane in the Parish of St. Giles without Cripplegate London of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds & upwards as she hath been informed & verily believes

Patience Elliston aged abt. 59 Years upon Oath says She is the Widow of Edwd. Elliston & that her said late husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship with Mr. Watkins a Bricklayer in Great Wild Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middx. & never Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

John Kirkpatrick aged abt. 57 Years upon Oath says he served his Apprenticeship of Seven Years to Mr. Willm. Bridges a Carpenter opposite Salisbury Street in the Strand in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . & never Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or was a Yearly Servant for one year

Mary Anderson aged abt. 70 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of James Anderson who hath been Dead abt. thirty Years says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. John Over in Spring Garden in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . for four Years & upwards at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds She being at that time a Widow & without Child or Children & hath quitted said Service abt. Eight Years & hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizabeth Fuge aged abt. thirty three Years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Edwd. Fuge (gone from her) with whom she intermarried at the Parish Church of St. James Westmr. on the 29th. day of Decr. 1746 by whom she hath one Child (namely) Mary aged abt. Eight Years says her said husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant & whilst he was a Single Man lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Thos. Reynardson a Cheesemonger at the Corner of Lawrence Lane in the Parish of St. Luke at Chelsea in the County of Middx. for one Year & upwds. at the Yearly Wages of Twelve Pounds or thereabts. & hath quitted said Service abt. Ten Years says her said husband never after Rented ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes as her said husband has informed her & as she verily believes

Mary Mc. Daniel aged abt. 29 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Stephen Mc. daniel who dyed on the 1st. day of February last says her said late husband was a Native of Ireland & never gained a Settlemt. in England to her knowledge or belief says her late father James Bollington deceased Rented a house in Dyot Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex in the County of Middx. of the Yearly Rent of Eighteen Pounds for two Years & upwds. & never after (he quitted that house) Rented ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes says she never Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant & that she hath one Child by her said late husband (to wit) Ann aged abt. three Years

Wm. Gardner aged abt. 60 Years upon Oath says he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Edwards an Auctioneer in Threadneedle Street in the Parish of St. Bartholomew by the Exchange in the City of London for 2 Years at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds he being at that time a Single Man & hath quitted that Service abt. Twenty Years says he hath not since Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year

Mary Grantham aged abt. 47 Years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Thos. Grantham (now at Sea) with whom she Intermarried at the fleet London abt. 27 Years ago says her said husband served his Apprenticeship of Seven Years to one Mr. Pearce a Shoemaker in St. Martin's Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr. & never Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year

Joseph Carter aged abt. 58 Years upon Oath says he was born in Bannisters Alley opposite St. Giles's Church in the Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middx. & never Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Margt. Hultham Wife of Thos. Hultham gone on board a Privateer upon Oath says she intermarried with the said Thomas Hultham at the fleet London abt. fourteen Years since says she has two Children by him; Mary aged abt. Eight Years & George aged abt. seven Months says her said husband has informed her & which information she verily believes to be true that he served his Apprenticeship of seven Years to his father Joseph Hultham a brass founder in Swan Yard by Hockley in the hole in the Parish of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middx. & never Rented ten Pounds a Yr. pd. Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for one Year

Ann Mooreland aged abt. 28 Years upon Oath says she is the Wife of James Mooreland who is gone from her and is abroad & beyond the Seas as she has been informed & which Information she verily believes to be true, says she intermarried with the said James Mooreland in the Parish Church of St. James in the City of Bath about thirteen Years since, says that she this Examinant & her said husband are both Natives of Ireland & never gained any Settlement in England says she has two Children by her said husband (to wit) Daniel aged abt. Six Years born in the Lying in hospital in Brownlow Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middx. and James aged abt. two Years born in the lying in hospital in Duke Street Grosvenor Square in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westmr.

Mary Jenkins aged abt. 30 Years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Henry Jenkins (at Sea) with whom she intermarried in Kentish Town Chapel abt. seven Years ago & by whom she hath three Children (to wit) John aged abt. five Years; Henry aged abt. three Years & Thomas aged abt. Eight Months says her said husband Rented a house in Tooley Street in the Parish of St. Olave Southwark in the County of Surry of the Yearly Rent of Eleven Guineas; lived therein abt. Seven Months & hath quitted same abt. five Years and hath not since Rented ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes

Elizth. Meredith aged upwards of 60 Years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Howell Meredith with whom she intermarried at Wilsdon Church abt. 27 Years since says her said husband Rented a house at Kilbourn in the Parish of Hampstead in the County of Middx . of the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds lived therein abt. three Years and Quitted same abt. fifteen Years since which time he not Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes.

Mary Hunt on the behalf of her Sister Sarah Hunt an Infant aged abt. ten Years upon Oath says that her father John Hunt served his Apprenticeship of Seven Years with his father Thos. Hunt a Stocking maker in Goal Yard in White cross Street in the Parish of St. Luke in the County of Middx. as her said father & never Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or otherwise gained a Settlement in any other Parish or place as this Deponent hath been informed and which information she verily believes to be true.

Cathne. Katkitt aged abt. 57 Yrs. upon Oath says she is the Widow of David Katkitt who hath been dead abt. twenty Years says her said husbd. served his Apprenticeship of Seven Years with one Jeremiah Ward at the Kings Arms Tavern near Chancery Lane in Fleet Street in the Parish of St. Dunstan in the West in the City of London and never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year to this Examinants knowledge or Belief says she hath not since his Death Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Thos. Giblett aged abt. 72 Years upon Oath says he served four Years and upwards the last part of his Apprenticeship with Mr. Thos. Raban Perukemaker in Warwick Lane Newgate Street in the Parish of Christ Church in the City of London and Never Rented A house of Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Susannah Elizabeth Pennington aged abt. 35 Years upon Oath says she is the wife of John Pennington who is aged abt. Forty Two Years with whom she intermarried in May fair Chapel on the 24th. of June 1749. says her said husband Rented a house in the Strand near the New Church in the Parish of St. Clemt. Danes in the County of Middx. of the Yearly Rent of £32. lived therein abt. one Year & a half & hath quitted same upwards of Eight Years says her said husbd. after he quitted the said house in the Strand Rented & lived in Chambers up one pair of Stairs at No. 5 in Holborn Court Grays Inn in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn above ye. Bars in the said County of Middx. of the Yearly Rent of fifteen pounds for four four Years and upwards and hath not since he quitted the said Chambers Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or otherwise gained a Settlement in any other Parish or place to this Examinants knowledge or belief

Peter Stevenson aged abt. 66 Yrs. upon Oath says he intermarried with Elizabeth his Wife in the Parish Church of St. Martin in the fields abt. Twenty Years since; says that abt. Nineteen Years ago he Rented & lived in a house in Great Shire Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middx. of the Yearly Rent of £24 for three Quarters of a Year and hath not since Rented ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes

Elizth. Brooks aged abt. 25 Yrs. upon Oath says she intermarried with her husband John Brooks at the fleet London on the 1st. day of Sepr. 1752. says her said husband has absconded from her and where he is this Examinant doth not know says her said husband served seven Years apprenticeship with Mr. Saml. Fountain in the Parish of Alhallows in the City of York Comb maker and never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year says she has three Children by her said husband Namely Elizth . aged abt. five Years Edward aged abt. Two Years and George aged abt. five Months

Jane Wilson aged abt. 23 Years upon Oath says she is the wife of John Wilson ( ) with whom she intermarried at the fleet London on the fifth day of March 1753. says she has one Child by him Vizt. James aged abt. three Months says her said husband lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Fortune a Taylor in St. Catharines Lane in the Parish of St. Botolph with- -out Aldgate in the County of Middx. for two Years at the Yearly wages of Six Guineas for the first Year and eight Guineas for the Second Year he being all that time Unmarried and never Rented ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes says her said husband is now a Soldier in North America

Elizth: Waller aged abt. 28 Years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Henry Waller (who is a Soldier and abroad in his Majesty's Service) with whom she Intermarried in the Savoy Chapel on the 12th. day of May 1756. by whom she has One Child Named Henry aged abt. Eighteen Months says her said husband was Born in the Parish of Ardenley in the County of Sussex and never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a Yearly hired Servt. for one Year as her said husband has Often informed this Examinant and which Information she Verily believes to be true

John Lewis aged abt. 26 Years upon Oath says he Intermarried with Lucy his Wife (Who is Now a Lunatic) in the Parish Church of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middx. upwds. of Four Years ago. Says he Rented & lived in a house in Little Earle Street Seven Dials in the said Parish of Saint Giles in the fields of the Yearly Rent of Twenty two Pounds for Nine Months and hath quitted same upwards of one Year since which time he hath not Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or otherwise done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement says he has one Child by his sd. Wife named David aged abt. 1 Year

Ursula Jarrett aged abt. 61 Yrs. upon Oath says she is the Widow of John Jarrett who has been dead abt. Seven Years says her said husband Rented a house in Dyot Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middx . of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds for 30 Years and there dyed says she Continued in the said house for One Year after her sd. husbands decease and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year

Ann Brooks aged abt. 50 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Peter Brooks who has been dead abt. Nine Years; says her said husband Rented and lived in a house in Saint Martin's Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and upwds. for four Years as her said husband informed this Deponent and which Information she verily believes to be True says she hath not since his death Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year or otherwise gained a Settlemt. in any other Parish or Place to her knowledge and belief

Mary Coward aged abt. 65 Years upon Oath says she is the widow of Robt. Coward who has been dead abt. Nine Months says her said husband Rented a house in Church Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . of the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds lived therein abt. seven One Year and quitted it abt. eight Twenty Years before his death and never after Rented Ten Pounds a Year or Paid Parish Taxes says she has not since his death Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or Otherwise done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Sarah Gimber aged abt. 31 Years upon Oath says she is the widow of Francis Gimber who died on Friday the 10th. day of this Instant Novr. by whom she has one Child named Ann aged abt. one Year and nine Months says her said husbd. was by Indenture dated the 23d. of Sepr. 1749 bound Apprentice for seven Years to Thos. Stead of St Pauls Church Yard in the Parish of St. Gregory by St. Pauls in the City of London Stationer and served six Years of his said Apprenticeship and then the said Mr. Stead died says her said husband was never assigned ever to any person or Ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year according to the best of her knowledge of belief

Mary Fairbrother aged abt. 60 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of James Fairbrother who has been dead abt. Eleven Years; says her sd. husband Rented a house in Chancery Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middx. of the Yearly Rent of Twenty Six Pounds and lived in the same abt. Two Years and never after Rented a house of Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes; Says she has not since his death Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year or otherwise done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlemt. to her knowledge and belief

Thos. Morris upon Oath says he Intermarried with Elizabeth his wife lately deceased in the Parish Church of St Brides in the City of Chester abt. 12 Years since by whom he has two Children Chas . aged abt. 5 Yrs. born in the lying in hospl. in Aldersgate Street and Mary aged abt. 4 Years born in the lying in hospl. in Brownlow Street says he was bound Apprentice for Seven Years to Robt. Jones a Carpenter at Greenfield in the Parish of Hollywell in the County of Flint and served him 3 quarters of a Year the first part of his said Apprenticeship and then this Examinant and his Master parted by Consent and never was assigned over to any Person: says he lived in a house of his own of the Yearly Value of three Pounds for One Quarter of a Year in the Parish of Dermerchion in the sd County of Flint and never after Rented ten Pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yrly. Servant for one Year

Joseph Fry aged abt. 37 Yrs. upon Oath says he intermarried with Elizth : his wife at the fleet London Upwards of Ten Years since. says before his Intermarriage with his said wife and whilst he was a Single Man He lived a hired Yearly Servt. with Mrs. Castle at the Cross Keys the Corner of Theobalds Row in Red Lyon Street in the Parish of St. George the Martyr by Queen Square in the County of Middx. for one Year and upwds. at the Yearly wages of £7. and hath Quitted said Service abt. fifteen years: since which Time he hath not Rented Ten Pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year

Joseph Fry aged abt. 37 Yrs. upon Oath says he intermarried with Elizth : his wife at the fleet London Upwards of Ten Years since. says before his Intermarriage with his said wife and whilst he was a Single Man He lived a hired Yearly Servt. with Mrs. Castle at the Cross Keys the Corner of Theobalds Row in Red Lyon Street in the Parish of St. George the Martyr by Queen Square in the County of Middx. for one Year and upwds. at the Yearly wages of £7. and hath Quitted said Service abt. fifteen years: since which Time he hath not Rented Ten Pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year

Hannah Sharlock aged abt. 50 Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Joseph Sharlock who has been dead abt. Eighteen Years. says that being a Widow and without Child or Childn. she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Salmon in the house of Mr Williams in New North Street in the Parish of St. George the Martyr by Queen Square in the County of Middx. for one Year and upwards at the Yearly wages of £4 and hath quitted said Service abt. One Year and a half: since which time she hath not Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year

Jonathan Floyd aged abt. 69 Years upon Oath says he Intermarried with Elizabeth his Wife at May fair Chapel abt. 20 Years ago says he served seven Years Apprenticeship with Mr. Hendley a Plaisterer next door but one to the Bear and Ragged Staff in West Smithfield in the Parish of St. Sepulchre London and never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Eliz: Willson aged abt. 44 Years upon Oath says; she is the Widow of Major Willson who has been dead about 7 Years; says her said husband informed her and which information She Verily believes to be true that he was bound apprentice for Seven Years to John Stone Junr. a Baker and after having Lived with him abt. two Years was assigned Over to John Stone Senr . with whom he served the Remaining five Years of his said Apprenticeship at Edmonton in the County of Middlesex and that Neither her said late husband in his life time as he further Informed her nor has she this Examinant since his decease rented ten pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for One Year

Ann Lyon aged abt. 41 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of John Lyon who has been dead abt. One Year by whom she has two Children Sarah aged abt. four Years and Lucy aged abt. Sixteen Months says her said husband was bound Apprentice for Seven Years to his Uncle Charles White a Shoemaker and served him two Years & Upwards the first part of his said Apprenticeship in Broad St. Giles's in the Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middx. and then absconded from his said Master and was never assigned Over to any Person or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year or Ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes as her said husband inform'd her and as she verily Believes: says she hath not since her said husbands deceased Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes or otherwise done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlemt to her knowledge or Belief

Rebecca Herring aged abt. 22 Years upon Oath says she Never was Married says she lived a hired Yearly Servt. with Mr. Alexr. Robinson at the Lemon tree in Bedford Bury in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr. for fourteen Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds and hath quitted sd. Service abt. Six Months and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes

Thos. Gibbons On the Behalf of his Sister Susannah Jones aged upwards of thirty Years upon Oath says his sd. Sister Never was Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Morris in Newport Alley in the Parish of St. Ann in the Liberty of Westmr. for fifteen Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds and hath quitted said Service abt. Six Years; and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year as his said Sister has informed him and as he Verily believes

Chas. Higgins aged abt. 54 Yrs. upon Oath says he Intermarried with Jane his Wife in the Parish Church of St Nicholas at Newcastle upon Tyne abt. Ten or Eleven Years since by whom he has four Childn. Wm . aged abt. six Years David aged abt. four Years Sarah aged upwds. of two Years and Margt . abt. Six Months; says before his Intermarriage with the sd. Jane and whilst he was a Single Man he lived a hired Yearly Servt. with Mr. Jackson in Boswell Court by Queen Square in the Parish of St. George the Martyr by Queen Square in the County of Middx. for One Year and upwards at the Yearly wages of £10 and never Rented Ten Pounds a year or paid Parish Taxes

Eleanor Scriven aged abt. 35 Years upon Oath says she is the wife of Wm. Scriven with whom she Intermarried in the Month of Decr. 1752. and that she hath two Children by him (to wit) Eleanor aged upwards of five Years and Mary aged upwards of two Years says her said husband Rented and lived in a house in Marsham Street in the Parish of Saint John the Evangelist in the Liberty of Westminster for Six Months and upwards at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds and hath quitted same upwds. of One Year says her said husband now absconds from her and hath not since he quitted the aforesaid house in Marsham Street Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes to the best of this Deponents knowledge or belief

Jane Jackson aged abt. 34 Years Upon her Voluntary Oath says she never was Married; says on the 2d; day of April 1755 she was delivered of a female Bastard Child in the house of Mr. Hutton by the New Church in the Strand in the Parish of St. Mary Le Strand in the County of Middx. which hath since been baptized Ann and that on the 31st. day of March 1754 she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in the sd. house of the sd. Mr. Hutton which hath since been baptized Jas . which said two Childn. are now both living and are both become Chargeable to the Parish of St. Clemt. Danes in the County of Middx. where she now lodges she being poor and unable to Maintain them; says that Jas. Pritchard who now lives in Angel Court in the Old Bailey did beget the sd. two Childn. on her body of which she was delivered as aforesaid and that no other person is the true & real father thereof

Katherine Baker on the behalf of Ann Saunders aged abt. 72 Years upon Oath says that the said Ann Saunders is the Widow of Richd. Saunders deceased says the said Richd. Saunders lived in and Rented a house in Off Alley York Buildings in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr. for Twenty Years at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds and upwards and there dyed. Says the said Ann Saunders has not since the death of her husband Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for One Year as the said Ann Saunders hath informed this Deponent and which Information this Deponent verily believes to be true

Mary Williams aged upwds. of 40 Years upon Oath says she lived a hired Yearly Servt. with Mr. Francis Main in Bury Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. for four Years at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds and hath quitted said Service upwards of Twenty Years; since which time She hath not rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for One Year & further says she never was Married

Sarah Green aged abt. 22 Years upon Oath says she never was married; says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Fisher at the Red Lion Alehouse in Butcherhall Lane in the Parish of Christ Church in the City of London for One Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds and hath Quitted said Service abt. One Year; and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Jane Owen aged abt. 59 years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Isaac Owen who has been dead abt. Twenty Years; says her said husband Rented and lived in a house of Eighteen Pounds a year in King Street Bloomsbury in the Parish of St. Geo: Bloomsbury in the County of Middx. for five years or thereabouts and after he quitted said house never Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes; says she has not since her sd. husbands death Rented Ten Pounds a Year or otherwise done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Eliz: Beezley aged abt. 88 Yrs. upon Oath says she is the Widow of Thos. Beezley who has been dead abt. Sixteen Years and that she can give no account of her said husbands Settlement says before her intermarriage with her said husbd. she was bound Apprentice for 7 Years to John Ellis her father in law in Maypole Alley opposite the Marshalsea prism in the Borough of Southwark in the Parish of St. George Southwark in the County of Surry and served five Years of her sd.
