Apprenticeship and then her said Master dyed; says she never was assigned over to any Person or otherwise gained a Settlemt. in any other parish or place to her knowledge & belief

Susannah Hemblen aged abt. 27 Yrs. on the behalf of her Mother Margt. Hemblen a Lunatic upon Oath says she is the Widow of Saml. Hemblen who has been dead about Eleven Years; says her said Mothers being a Widow lived a hired Yearly Servt. for three Years (at the Yearly Wages of £6 or thereabouts) with Genl. Greys in George Street Hanrs. Square in the Parish of St Geo: Hanr. Square in the Liberty of Westmr. and hath quitted said Service abt. four Years and has not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Yr.

Ann Lowman lodging at Mr. Smith's the Corner of Old Boswell Court in the Parish of St. Clemt. Danes in the Liberty of Westmr. on the behalf of John Griffiths an Infant aged abt. five Years who was lately brought and left in the said Parish of St. Clemt. Danes upon Oath says that Benjm. Griffiths the father of the said infant Rented a house in the Parish of East Greenwich in the County of Kent in the Year 1755 and paid the Parochial Taxes there as appears by a Receipt dated the £14 day of July 1755. signed John Green Collector says that the sd. Benjn. Griffiths has Enlisted for a Soldier in the Light House and that the Mother has Absconded; and that they were married abt. twelve Years ago in the Parish Church of East Greenwich aforesaid as she has been Credibly informed & believes

Ruth Ratcliffe aged abt. 17 Years upon Oath says she never was Married nor was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant for one Year; says her father Richd. Ratcliffe informed her that he served his Apprenticeship of Seven Years to John Martin a Waterman in Water Lane in the Parish of St. Ann Blackfryars in the City of London ; says her father also informed her that he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year

Thomas Sharrard aged upwards of 60 Years upon Oath says that being a Single man he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Langer masterley a Taylor in Peterborough Court in Fleet Street in the parish of St. Brides London for two Years and a half at the yearly Wages of four pounds for the first Year Six pounds for the second year and three pounds ten Shillings for the last half Year and hath quitted said Service about forty Years to his now best Remembrance says he has not since Rented Ten pounds a Year paid parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One year

Sarah Lambert aged abt. 30. Years upon Oath says she intermarried with Wm. Lambert at May fair Chapel abt. Twelve Years since and has by him One Child named Charlotta aged abt. Nine years and that she has been informed and believes the said William Lambert was articled a Clerk for five years to Mr. William Robinson of the Inner Temple London Gent: and served him as his Clerk about three years of the said Term and lodged upwards of Two Months the Latter part of the said three Years at Mr. Ross's a Taylor in Red lion Street Holborn in the parish of St. Andrew in Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middx. And that her said husband never Rented Ten pounds by the Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year to this Examinants knowledge or belief; that her said husband now absconds from her and where to find him she cannot tell

Elishe Oakley on the Behalf of William Tortorshell an Infant aged abt. three Years upon Oath says that her Son William Tortorshell the father of the said Infant has absconded for Debt and where he is this Examinant cannot tell; Says the said Wm. Tortorshell the father served seven Years Apprenticeship with Mr. Baverick a Watch maker in Clements Lane in Lombard Street in the Parish of St. Edmund the King in the City of London and hath been out of his said Apprenticeship about Ten Years and never Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one year.

Susannah Varding aged abt. 40 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Robt. Varding who has been dead abt. a fortnight by whom she has 4 Children (to wit) Sarah aged abt. 6 years Robt. aged abt. 4 Yrs. Jane aged abt. two Years and Mary aged abt. Seven Months. says her said husband lived in and Rented a house in Bell Lane in the Parish of St. Mary le Bone in the County of Middx and paid to the poor there and hath quitted said house abt. five Yrs. and never after Rented Ten pounds a Year or paid parish Taxes.

Mattw. Chamberlain aged on the behalf of Martha Humphrys a Lunatic Widow of John Humphrys deceased Upon Oath says that she said Martha Humphrys Being a Widow and without Child or Childn. lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Unwin in Drapers hall in Broad Street in the Parish of St. Peter Poors London for One Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of four pounds or thereabouts and hath quitted said Service abt. three Years since which time she has not Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year as the said Martha Humphry 's often times informed this Examinant when she was in her Senses; and which Information this Examinant verily believes to be true

Mercy Wood aged abt. 67 Years upon Oath says She is the Widow of Wm. Wood who has been dead about Ten Years to whom she was Married about Twenty Years ago at the fleet London says her said husband Informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true that he served four Years and upwards the last part of his Apprenticeship with Mr. Boulton a Pipemaker in Baldwins Gardens in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn above the bars in the County of Middx: Says her said husband in his life time nor she this Examinant since his death never Rented Ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Markham Widow lodging at Mrs. Handersons in Little Shire Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx. on the behalf of Mary Ives an Infant aged abt. Eight Years the daughter of James Ives (who now abscends) by Margaret his Wife deceased upon Oath says she said Mary Ives was born in the house of Mr. Marshall a Watchmaker in Row Street Shoe Lane in the parish of St. Bridget ats St. Brides London And that She cannot give any Account of the Settlement of the said James Ives .

Ann Sayer aged abt. 60 Years upon Oath says she never was Married and that she lived as a hired Yearly Servant with Gregory Esqr . near the pond in the Parish of Camberwell in the County of Surry for two (Years at the Yearly Wages of five pounds and hath quitted same abt. 20 Years; says she has not since she quitted said Service Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year.

Geo: Cross aged abt. 21 Years upon Oath says he was bound Apprentice for Seven Years to one Mr. Horne of Silver Street Bloomsbury Perukemaker and served him about four Years & a half the first part of his Apprenticeship and then was Assigned over to One Mr. Dixon of Bow Lane in the Parish of St. Thomas the Apostle in the City of London Perukemaker whom he served abt. one Year & a half says he then went from Mr. Dixon to Work with one Mr. Crutwell a Perukemaker at Hampstead in the Parish of Hampstead in the County of Middx. with whom he worked One Year or thereabouts says after he had lived with said Mr. Crutwell abt. three Months (his first Master) Mr. Horne came and demanded his Wages, and that he this Examinant paid him One Pound and Sixteen Shillings of lawful Money of Great Britain. says he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes

Joseph Jarvis aged abt. 54 Years upon Oath says he Rented and lived in a house the Corner of Crooked Lane in the parish of St. Margaret New fish Street London for three Years at the Yearly Rent of Thirty pounds or thereabouts and hath quitted said house about fourteen Years and has not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid parish Taxes or otherwise done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlemt.

Sarah Rogers aged abt. 29 Years upon Oath says; she is the wife of Saml. Rogers who is now at Sea by whom she has one Child Saml . aged abt. four Years; says her said husband is an Irishman and never gained a Settlement in England says her said Son Saml. was born in Princes's Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middx.

Rose Hall aged abt. 24 Years upon Oath says she never was Married, says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr John Ford a Grocer in Jermyn Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr . for One Year at the Yearly Wages of three Pounds and hath quitted same abt. Eleven Months; since which time she hath not Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes

Sarah Rivets aged abt. 24 years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Benjn. Rivets with whom she intermarried at St. Giles's Church on the 16th. day of April 1759. says her said husband informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true that he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes was an Apprentice or Yearly hired Servant for one Year And that he learnt the trade of a Glazier with his father Edwd. Rivets who Rented a house in Church Street in the Parish of St. Ann in the Liberty of Westmr. of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds for sevl. Years.

Mary Stuart aged abt. 31 Years upon Oath says she never was Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Bromfield at the Thistle and Crown near Charing Cross in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Libty of Westmr. for Seventeen Months at the Yearly Wages of £4 and hath quitted said Service abt. Two Years and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Sawyer aged abt. 30 Years Upon Oath says she never was Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Sr. Francis Head Bart : in Rathbone Place in the Parish of St. Mary le Bon in the County of Middx. for three Years and upwds. at the Yearly Wages of £5 and hath quitted said Service abt. five Years And hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year.

Mary Jenkins aged upwards of 30 Yrs. upon Oath says she is the Wife of Henry Jenkins (at Sea) with whom she Intermarried in Kentish Town Chapel abt. Nine Years ago by whom she has Two Childn. Henry aged abt. five Years and Thos. aged abt. Two Years. Says her said husband Rented a house in Tooley Street in the Parish of St. Olave Southwark in the County of Surry of the Yearly Rent of Eleven Guineas lived therein abt. Seven Months and hath quitted same abt. Seven Years and has not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid parish Taxes to this Examinant's knowledge or belief.

Mary Moran aged about 40 Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Fras. Moran who has been dead abt. One Year says her said husband Rented the Foundling hospital Coffee house in Red lion Street Holbn. in the Parish of St. George the Martyr in the County of Middx. for abt. Six Months at the Yearly Rent of Twenty six Pounds and Quitted it abt. 14 Years says her said husband in his life time after he Quitted that house nor she since his death Never Rented Ten pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes in any part of Great Britain

Bridget Cowley Wife of Christr. Cowley lodging at Mr. Coulstons a Carpenter in Barley Court in the Coal Yard Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middx upon Oath says abt. Ten years ago that being before her said Intermarriage with Christ Cowley she being then a Single Woman was delivered of a female Bastard Child in the house of Robt. Johnson in Parkers Lane in the said Parish of St. Giles in the fields which hath since been baptized Elizabeth says that One Matthew Downey did beget the said Child on her body of which she was delivered as Aforesaid; And that the said Matthew Downey is now dead.

Mary Cottingham aged abt. 35 Years Upon Oath says she never was Married says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Mills a Bailiff in Katharine Street in the parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westmr. for three years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of three Pounds and hath Quitted said Service abt. 3 Yrs. and hath not since Rented Ten pounds a Year paid parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Andrew Fowles Aged abt. 60 Years upon Oath says he Intermarried with Elizabeth his Wife in the Parish Church of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middx on the 6th. day of Novr. upwds. of 30 years ago says before his said Marriage and whilst he was a Single Man he lived a hired yearly Servant with Mrs. Sarah Bittany a Corn chandler in Warwick Lane in the Parish of Christ Church in the City of London for One Year at the Yearly Wages of £6 says he has not since he quitted that Service Rented Ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Alice Wilkinson aged abt. 65 years Upon Oath says she is the Wife of Matthew Wilkinson (if living) says her said husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Single Man lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year with Robt. Osborn in the Parish of Rushton in Northamptonshire as her said husband informed her and which Information she Verily believes to be true.

Wm. Salter aged upwards of 60 Years upon Oath says he Rented a house in Bell Yard in the Parish of St. Margaret in the City of Westminster for 3 Years at the Yearly Rent of Nine Pounds and paid the Poors Rate for said house and hath Quitted same about Ten years and further saith that sometime in the Month of March 1758 he was Removed by an Order under the hands and seals of two of his Majesty's Justices of the Peace for the City and Liberty of Westmr . from the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the said Liberty of Westmr . to the said Parish of St. Margaret as the Place of his last legal Settlement which Order was not Appealed against.

Jannett Bell aged abt. 32 Years upon Oath says she never was Married and that she was Bound Apprentice for seven Years to one Mrs. Joell a Child Coat maker at the Sign of the Sun in Fleet Street Opposite Shoe Lane in the Parish of St. Bridget alias St. Bride in the City of London And served her abt. One year and a Qur. and then Absconded from her said Mistress and never was assigned Over to any person nor Rented Ten Pounds a Year or Paid Parish Taxes And further upon her Oath says that on the 14th. of August 1756. She was delivered of a female Bastard Child in the house of One Mr. Cholick in Lambeth Marsh in the Parish of St. Mary Lambeth in the County of Surry which hath since been Baptized Ann and that One James Collett who was the Reputed father of the said Child died about Two Months ago.

Martha Griffiths aged abt. 34 Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of William Griffiths who has been dead abt. Nine Months by whom she has Two Children Elizabeth aged three Years and Wm : aged abt. three Months, says she has been informed & which Information she verily believes to be true that her said husband served four Years & a half the first part of his Apprenticeship with his father Wm: Griffiths a Plaisterer in Rose Street by Covent Garden in the parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr. and then his father died says her said husband Never Rented Ten Pounds a year or paid Parish Taxes to her knowledge or belief

Mary Carrinton aged Upwards of 29 Years Upon Oath says she is the Wife of Edward Carrinton a Soldier in Colonel Crawford's Regmts. of Light Infantry with whom she Intermarried at Clelsea Church abt. four Years ago says her said husband informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true that he lived a hired Yearly Servant with One Mr. Holden a Tallow Chandler in the Parish of Kensington in the County of Middx. for three years he being all that time a Single Man And hath not Since he quitted his said Service Rented Ten pounds a Year or paid parish Taxes to this Examinant's knowledge and Belief.

Abraham Parfet aged abt. 60 Years Upon Oath says he Never was Married and that he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Sir Wyndham Natchbull for three years at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds. says Sir Wyndham used to dwell in Kent during the Summer half Year, and the Winter half Year in Golden Square in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. says he was discharged his said Service in Golden Square where he lived abt. three Months before such discharge which is abt. Twenty Years ago And hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a year paid parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year.

Amelia Hollyer aged abt. 27 years Upon Oath says she never was Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with One Mrs. Bruce in Swallow Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. for One Year at the Yearly Wages of £5 and hath quitted said Service abt. Two Years and has not since Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year.

Mary Head aged abt. Sixty Years lodging at Mr. Greenough's in Arrundel Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx. Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Geo: Head who has been dead abt. fifteen Years Says that the said Geo: Head Rented a Tenement consisting of a Shop and two rooms in Black horse Yard in Monmouth Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the said County of Middx of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and lived therein Sevl. Years and after he Quitted said Tenemt never Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes Says she has not Since his Death Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Mary Marsh aged abt. 28 yrs. Upon Oath says she never was Married and never was An Apprentice or Yearly Servant nor Rented Ten pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes Says she hath been informed And which Information she verily believes to be True that Henry Marsh her Father decd. Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with a Cooper in the Parish of St. Botolph without Aldersgate London and never Rented Ten pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes to this Examinants knowledge or belief

Henry Faithfull aged abt. 45 Years a Soldier in the third Regiment of Foot Guards lodging at Mr. Oatessin Old Boswell Court in the Parish of St. Clemt. Danes in the Liberty of Westmr. within the County of Middx. Upon Oath says he was born in the Parish of Chawton in the County of Southampton And never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servt. for One Year nor Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes And that he cannot give any Account of the Settlement of his Father or Mother Says he has two Children by Alice his deceased Wife (Vizt.) Alice aged almost Seven Years and Elizth : aged almost four Years both born at Mr. Hardy's a Cheesemonger in Clements Inn Passage in the aforesaid Parish of St. Clemt. Danes

Willm. Skinner aged abt. 30 Years a Soldier in the first Regt. of Foot Guards lodging at Mr Barrow's in St. Clements Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr. within the County of Middx Upon Oath says he has two Children by Sarah his deceased Wife (Vizt.) Hannah aged abt. Six Years and George aged abt. four Years; Says he Rented and lived in a house in Green dragon Court in the Parish of St. Saviour Southwark in the County of Surry for two Years at the Yearly Rent of Fourteen Pounds and hath Quitted same abt. Nine Years and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes.

Barney Onail aged abt. 50 years of upon Oath says that whilst he was a single man he lived a hired yearly Servt. upwards of one year with Mr. Timberlick a farmer at Castle Bear in the Parish of Ealing in the County of Middx. at the yearly Wages of Seven Pounds & hath quitted sd. Service abt. Eleven years

Ann Gamboll aged abt. 56 years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Chas. Gamboll who hath been dead abt. four seven years says her said husbd. served his Apprenticeship of seven years to his father Chas. Gamboll a Shoemaker in the Parish of St. Peter in the Town of Nottingham as she hath been informed & verily believes

Eleanor Elizabeth Edwards on the behalf of Wm. Edwards her husband upon Oath says that the sd. Wm. Edwards is now a Lunatic that she intermarried with the said Willm. Edwards upwards of twelve years since & hath three Children by him (to wit) Mary aged abt. twelve yrs. Margt. aged abt. seven years & Alice aged upwards of two Yrs. says her said husband hath often times when he was in his Senses informed her & which information she verily believes to be true that he was born in the Parish of Pwllheli in the County of Carnarvon & served his Apprenticeship to one Mr. Morgan a Shoemaker in the same Parish

Eliz: Somerhill aged abt. 19 yrs. upon Oath says she was never married & that she was bound Apprentice by the Churchwardens & Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Syson in the County of Gloucester to Joseph Barnes a Sadlers in the Parish of St. Philip & Jacob near Bristol in the County aforesaid until she should attain the age of Twenty one years or Marriage as she hath been informed & verily believes & lived with the said Joseph Barnes several years & never was assigned over to any other Person
Richd. Stevens aged abt. 48 yrs. upon Oath says he was born in the Town of Buckingham in the County of Bucks & never Rented Ten Pounds a yr. was an Apprentice or yearly Servant

Ann Oaton aged abt. 36 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Wm. Oaton by whom she hath two Childn. (to wit) Mary aged abt. fourteen years & Wm. aged about three years says her said late husband served his apprenticeship of seven years to James Watson a Stocking Weaver at Castle End in the Parish of Hinkley in the County of Leicester as her said husbd. informed her & as she verily believes

Ann Cook aged about 27 years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Jonas Cook ( gone from her ) by whom she hath one Child Thos. aged upwards of three years says her said husband served his Apprenticeship of Seven years to Mr. John Murphet a Taylor at Heckmanwike in the Parish of Bursell in the County of York & never Rented ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year as her said husband informed her & as she verily believes

Mary Mills aged abt. 65 years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Richd. Mills of whose Settlement she can give no further Account than that he was born at Chipping Norton in the County of Oxford & that she has not since her said husbands death Rented ten Pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for One year

John Rutter of the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx on the behalf of Rachel Herbert a Lunatic Widow of Joseph Herbert upon Oath says that the sd. Joseph Herbert before his Intermarriage with the said Rachel & whilst he was a single Man lived a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Stone a Brewer in Egham Hive in the Parish of Egham in the County of Surry for several years as the said Mr. Stone informed this Deponent & as this Deponent verily believes

Sarah Bevan aged abt. 23 years upon Oath says she is the Widow of James Bevan who hath been dead abt. three years & to whom she was married at the fleet London abt. five years ago says her said late husband was born at Noke in the Parish of Pembridge in the County of Hereford

Lettitia Green aged upwards of 25 years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Wm. Green with whom she intermarried at the fleet London abt. Six years ago & by whom she hath three Childn. (to wit) Willm. aged upwards of five years Mary aged upwds. of three years & Frances aged upwards of one year says her said husband was born in the Parish of Watlington near Nettlebed in the County of Oxford

Bridget Marsden aged abt. 23 Years on the behalf of Mary Godfrey an Infant aged abt. Eleven Years upon Oath says that the said Mary Godfrey was born on Sir John's Key in the Parish of St. Andrew in the City of Dublin in the Kingdom of Ireland and never Gained any Settlemt. in England as this Examinant has been informed and believes.

Mary Garrety upon Oath says she is the Wife of John Garrety who is now abroad and beyond the Seas and that she intermarried with him in the Parish Church of St. Mary in the City of Dublin in the Kingdom of Ireland on the 14th. Septr. 1757 by whom she has One Child Edwd. aged abt. Nine Months says her said husband is a Native of Ireland and never gained a Settlement in England and that before his Intermarriage with her and whilst he was a single Man he lived a hired Yearly Servt. with the Primate of Ireland in the Parish of St. Mary aforesaid for Four Years at the Yearly wages of Seven Pounds or thereabouts And this Deponent being poor was obliged to ask Charity in the said Parish of St. Clemt. Danes

Ann Goodin aged abt. 45 Years Upon Oath says she never was Married and that she now lodges at Mr. Nurseys in Wych Street in the parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr. within the County of Middx. says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Obadiah Weeks a Linnen Draper at the Sign of the three Nunns and Hare in Cheapside in the Parish of St. Peter's Cheap in the City of London for One Year & a half or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of £6; and hath Quitted same about Twenty two Years and hath not since Rented ten Pounds a Year or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for One Year.

Benjamin Rivet aged abt. 21 Years lodging at the house of Mr. Redhead-in Kings head Court Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr. Upon Oath says and hath he intermarried with Sarah his wife at St. Giles Church abt. One Year and a half ago and that he learnt his Trade of a Glazier with his Father Edwd. Rivet and never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes nor was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant for One Year says his said Father Edwd. Rivet Rented a house in Church Street in the Parish of St. Ann in the Liberty of Westmr. of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds for Sevl. Years.

Geo: Darbyshire aged abt. 45 Years (lodging at Mr. Gibbert's in Clements Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr. within the County of Middx.) Upon Oath says he Rented a house in Cursitor's Street Chancery Lane in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn in the City of London known by the Sign of the Turks head of the Yearly Rent of £36 for six Months or thereabouts and hath Quitted same Upwards of One Year and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes.

Francis Collins aged about 60 Years Upon Oath says he intermarried with Susana. his Wife at the Parish Church of St. Gregory by St. Paul London about 35 Years ago; says he Rented a house Opposite Whitechapel Mount in the Parish of St. Mary Whitechapel in the County of Middx. of the Yearly Rent of £16 for two Years or thereabouts & hath Quitted said house abts. Five Years and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes.

Sarah Miles aged abt. 24 Years upon Oath says she is the wife of Robert Miles to whom she was Married at St. Sepulchre's Church in London abt. One Year & a half ago says her said husband informed her and which information she verily believes to be true that before his intermarriage with her & whilst he was a Single Man he lived a hired Yearly Servt. with Mr Bowen a Butcher in Kingsgate Street in the Parish of St. George the Martyr in the County of Middx. for Seven Years at the Yearly Wages of £2..12 diet washing & lodging and after he quitted that Service never Rented Ten Pounds a Year nor paid parish Taxes

Sarah Williams aged abt. 56 Years lodging at Mr Powells in Hollis Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr. within the County of Middx, Upon Oath says she is the Wife of John Williams to whom she was Married at May fair Chapel abt. Ten Years ago, says her said husband Rented a house known by the Name of the Ship Alehouse by King Davids Lane Ratcliffe highway in the Parish of St. Paul Shadwell in the County of Middlesex of the Yearly Rent of £20 for several Years; Quitted said house abt. Seven Years and has not since Rented Ten Pounds by the Year nor paid Parochial Taxes to this Examinants knowledge or belief.

Ann Boucher aged upwards of 70 Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of James Boucher who has been dead about Eighteen Years says her said husband was a Native of Ireland and never gained a Settlement in England And that she this Examinant served Seven Years Apprenticeship with Mr Bullock a Button and loop maker in King Street Westminster in the Parish of St. Margaret in the City of Westminster and never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Hannah Cozens aged abt. 33 Years upon lodging at Mr. Armstrong's in Flemlock Court in the Parish of St. Clement Danes Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Chas. Cozens who has been dead abt. four Years, says her said husband informed her and which information she verily believes to be true that he served Seven Years Apprenticeship with Mr. Flintum a Staymaker in Ely Court Holborn in the Liberty of Saffron hill Hatton Garden & Ely Rents in the County of Middx. and never Rented Ten Pounds by the Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year to this Examinants Knowledge or belief

Robt. Fitzhenry aged abt. 65 Years lodging at Mr. Tippers in Blackmoor Street in the parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr. within the County of Middx. Upon Oath says he Rented a house in Wardour Street in the parish of St. Ann in the Liberty of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of Twenty five pounds for two Years of thereabt. and hath quitted same abt. five Years and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year nor paid Parish Taxes. Says he has a Wife named Ann aged about fifty four Years

Catherine Smith Aged abt. Thirty Years lodging at Mr. Bathridges in Kingshead Court in Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Clemt. Danes in the County of Middx Upon Oath Says that by Indenture dated the Seventh day of Octr. 1754 she was Bound are Apprentice to & Served three Years Apprentiship with James Adams of Coppice Row in the Parish of St. James Clerkenwell in the sd. County of Middx Says She was never Married Rented Ten pounds paid parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for One Year

Eiz Gear aged about Twenty four years Lodging at Mr Botons in Hollis Street in the Parish of St Clement Danes in the liberty of Westminster & County of Middlesex Upon Oath says she was never married that her Father & mother are Both Dead that her Father when living rented a house next door to the Bear & Raged Staff in Piccadilly in the Parish of St James in the liberty of Westminster of the yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds or thereabout as this Examinant Mother informed her & as she verryly Believes Says she never Rented Ten pounds a year paid Parish Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year

William Dalziel aged abt. 60 Years lodging at Mr. Montgomery's at Temple Bar in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx Upon Oath says he Rented a house in Hungerford Marblin the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr. of the Yearly Rent of Ten pounds and upwards for Several Years; in which he carried on the Business of a Tobacconist

Mary Wisdom aged abt. 45 Years upon Oath says she was Married to James Wisdom her husband at the fleet London about Ten Years ago says her said husband is now abroad & beyond the Seas and that he Rented a house in Pepper Alley in the Parish of St. Saviour Southwark in the County of Surry known by the sign of the Watermans Arms of the Yearly Rent of £20 lived therein abt. four Years and hath Quitted same abt. Seven Years And has not since Rented Ten Pounds a year or paid Parish Taxes to this Examinants knowledge or belief

Robert Heather aged about 64 years Lodging in Stanhope Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middx upon Oath saith he is a Painter by Trade and lived in and rented a House in Earls Court Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for upwards of Two years at the yearly Rent of Twenty pounds Quitted the same in the year 1735 and hath not since rented any House or paid Parliamentary or Parochial Taxes

Mary Peak aged about 26 Years upon Oath saith she is the Widow of Richard Peak who has been Dead upwards of Three Years to whom she was Married at the Fleet London about Ten Years & an half ago That he lived in and rented a House known by the Sign of the Horse & Groom in Middle Row in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middx for about One Year at the Yearly Rent of £27 and there dyed and that she this Examt. Continued in the Same for about Six Months after his decease and hath not since rented any House or paid Land Tax or Poor Rate That she hath one Child named Richard aged Six years & upwards

Mary Gregory aged about 60 years Lodging in St. Clements Lane in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middx upon Oath saith that about Eight Years since she was hired as a Yearly Servant by the Matron of the Small Pox Hospital in Cold Bath Fields in the Parish of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middx and lived therein in the Capacity of a Nurse for about Four years and had Eight pounds a year Wages which was paid her by the Secretary of the same Hospital and hath not since she quitted the same rented any House paid Land Tax or poor Rate or lived a hired Servant for One Year also says that she now is and was at the time of her said hiring a Widow and without Child or Children

Susanna Cammock aged about 18 Years upon Oath saith she never was Married bound an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant in any one Place for Twelve Months together says her Father John Cammock who has been Dead about 15 Years was a School Master and lived in and rented a House in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster (as her Mother hath informed her) but cannot tell what rent he paid or how long he kept the same also Says the officers of the said Parish of St. James granted her said Father a Certificate to Ashford in Middx thereby Acknowledging him to be an Inhabitant legally Settled in their said Parish

Ann Lloyd aged 60 Years & upwards Lodging in Bennet's Court Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middx upon Oath says she never was Married That she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Lord Hindford in the Parish of Swanscomb in the County of Kent for Four Years at the Yearly Wages of £7 Quitted the Same about 17 Years ago and hath not since rented any House paid the Land Tax or Poor Rate or been a Yearly hired Servant in any one Place for Twelve Months together Also says that the said Lord Hindford had a Town House in Thrift Street Soho and that she lived during the last two years of her said Service wholly at his Lordship's House at Swanscomb without coming to Town

Mary Jacques aged upwards of 60 Years Lodging at Mr. Temple's near Temple Bar in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middx upon Oath saith she is the Wife of Joseph Jacques ( gone from her ) to whom she was Married at Lincolns Inn Chapel about 16 years ago Says her said Husband rented a House of Twenty Pounds a Year in Broad Court in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster and lived therein about Five Years says he hath not rented any House or paid Parliamentary or Parochial Taxes since he Quitted the Same which is about Ten Years since

Elizabeth Stace aged about 40 Years Lodging at Mr. Vaughan's in Wych Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middx upon Oath says she is the Wife of Nymphas Stace who is very ill Says her said Husband was bound an Apprentice for Seven years to his Father Edward Stace in the Parish of St. Michael in the Town of Stamford in the County of Lincoln and with him there served all his time out which Expired about 17 Years ago Says he hath not since rented Ten pounds a year or paid Land Tax or Poor Rate That she hath Two Children by her said Husband to wit Edward aged about 13 years and Mary aged about 11 Years that neither of the said Children was ever bound an Apprentice or lived a hired Servant for one year Also says about 13 or 14 years since the officers of the said Parish of St. Michael granted her said Husband a Certificate to St. Sepulchre's Parish in Northampton thereby Acknowledging him and this Examinant to be Inhabitants legally Settled in their said Parish of St. Michael

Sarah Barker aged about 76 Years Lodging the Back of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx upon Oath saith she is the Widow of Henry Barker who has been Dead about 20 years with whom she intermarried at Kingstone Church Portsmouth about 34 Years ago That he served Seven Years Apprentice ship with his Father Henry Barker a Corker in Shipwright Street in the Parish of St. Mary Rotherhith in the County of Surry That he never rented Ten Pounds a year paid Land Tax or Poor Rate or was a hired Yearly Servant since his Apprenticeship which Expired about 50 Years as she has been informed and verily believes

Sarah Scott aged about 17 Years upon Oath saith she never was Married bound an Apprentice or lived a hired Servant in any one place for Twelve Months together Says her Father Digby Scott was a Victualler and rented a House known by the Sign of the Blue Anchor in the Precinct of White Friars in the City of London for Nine Years and upwards at the Yearly Rent of £24 and that he died in the Same about 5 Years ago

Mary Brown aged about 37 years Lodging in Clement's Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middx upon Oath Says she never was Married That she lived a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Henry Joynes ( Clerk of the work ) in Kensington Palace in the Parish of St. Margaret in the Liberty of Westminster for about Two Years & Nine Months at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds says she Quitted said Service about Seven years ago and hath not since rented any House paid the Land Tax or Poor Rate or been a hired yearly Servant in any one Place for one year.

Joseph Cawthorne aged about 51 years upon Oath says he was bound Apprentice by Indenture for Seven years to John Underwood Poulterer in Carnaby Market in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster and with his said Master there served upwards of One year and then parted by Consent which is about 33 Years since Says he rented a House of the yearly Rent of Nine pounds ten shillings in Blackman Street in the Parish of St. George Southwark in the County of Surry for about Four Months and that he paid one year Land Tax for same House but that the same was due before he entered that he quitted the same about 13 years ago and hath not since rented any House paid the Land Tax or Poor Rate That he intermarried with his present Wife Ann at the Fleet London in the Year 1742.

Eleanor Fox on behalf of her Father Thomas Wilson who now lies Ill in Vear Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr. Upon Oath Says that her said Father Rented a House in Little Russell Street in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the said Liberty of Westmr. for One Year at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds and Paid to the Poor there hath quitted the said House about Ten Years and hath not Since Rented House or Paid Taxes Says he Intermarried with this Examinants Mother Mary in Belfast Church in Ye County of Antram in ye Kingdom of Ireland hath one Child (to wit) Elizth Aged about Sixteen Years.

Thos. Wilson Aged about 59 Years upon Oath Says he Intermarried with his Wife Mary in the Parish Church of Belfast in the Kingdom of Ireland about Thirty three Years ago Says he has One Child by his said Wife (to wit) Elizth. Aged about Sixteen Years Says he Rented a House in Little Russell Street Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. One Year at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds hath quitted said House about Ten Years and hath not Since Rented House or Paid Taxes

Christian Rice Aged about 23 Years upon Oath Says she was never Marryed, Says she was Bound an Apprentice to Miss Smith a Mantua Maker in Warder Street in the Parish of St. Anns in the Liberty of Westminster and hath been out of her said Apprentiship about 2 Years and hath not Since Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Elizth. Waller Aged about Thirty four Years upon Oath Says she is the Wife of Henry Waller a Soldier with whom she Intermar'd in the Savoy Chapel on the twenty Sixth of May 1756 by whom she has two Children (Viz) Henry Aged about Six Years and Elizth. Aged about Two Years Says her said Husband whilst a Singleman Lived a hired Yearly Servant with Alexr. Hillman a farmer for One Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of three Pounds or thereabouts says he served the said Mr. Hilman the last Nine Months of his said Service in the parish of Horsted Keynes in the County of Sussex and after he quitted his said Service Never Rented Ten pounds by the Year pd. Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Sert. for One Year. as this Examinant hath been Informed by her said husband and which Information she Verily believes to be true

Jane Fitzwood Aged about 22 Years upon Oath Says she was never Marryed Says she Lived a hired Yearly Servant with James Delamore at the Coach and Horses the Corner of Bond Street in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westmr . One Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted said Service about fifteen Months and hath not Since Rented House Paid Parish Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Mary Mills Aged about Forty four Years Upon Oath Says she Intermarried with her Husband Wm. Mills at the Fleet London upwards of Nineteen Years ago Says her said Husband Served five Years Clerkship with Mr. Edmond Pead Attorney at Law Says her said Husband Served the Last Year of his said Clerkship in Baldwins Court in Cloak Lane in the Parish of St Mary Aldermary in the City of London hath Left said Apprentiship about Twenty Years and never Rented Ten Pounds a Year This Examinantions False Paid Land Tax or Poor Rate as this Examinant hath been Informed & which Information she Verily Believes to be true Says she has One Child by her said Husband (Viz) Mary Aged about Ten years This Examinations False

Mary Dean Aged about Twenty Eight Years Lodging in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr Upon Oath Says she was never Marryed Says she Lived a Hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Parcer in Coopers Court near Burchin Lane in the Parish of St Michael Cornhill in the City of London two Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Two Years and she hath not Since Rented House Paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year And further upon her Voluntary Oath Says she is pregnant with Child or Children which is likely to be Born a Bastard or Bastards and to become Chargeable to the said Parish she being Poor and unable to Maintain the same when Born Says One Ratcliff Moffett Lodging by Red Lyon Square had Carnal knowledge of her Body in the Month of August Last and Once afterwards at One of which times he got her with Child of the Child or Children with which she is now Pregnant

Mary Mills Aged about Forty four Years Upon Oath Says she Intermarried with her Husband Wm. Mills at the Fleet London upwards of Nineteen Years ago Says her said Husband Served five Years Clerkship with Mr Pead Attorney at Law Says her said Husband Served the Last Year of his said Clerkship in Baldwins Court in Cloak Lane in the Parish of St. Thomas the Apostle London hath left said Apprentiship about Twenty Years and never Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Land Tax or Poors Rate as this Examt hath been Informed by her said Husband and which Information she Verily believes to be true Says she has One Child by her said Husband (Viz) Mary Aged about Ten Years

Elizth. Kitcherside Singlewoman Aged about Twenty Five Years upon Oath Says that on the Eleventh Day of February One thousand Seven hundred and Sixty four she was Delivered of a Male Bastard Child at a House in Tyburn Road in the County of Middlesex which hath since been baptized by the Name of George Says she Lived a Hired Yearly Servant with One Mr Robinson at the Sign of the Hour Glass in Tuttle Street in the Parish of St. John ye Evangelist in the Liberty of Westminster One Year at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted her said Service about four Years and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year.

Mary Browne Aged about Thirty Eight Years Upon Oath Says she was never Married Says she Lived a Hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Peirson in Burton Street in the Parish of St John the Evangelist in the Liberty of Westmr. Upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted said Service about Ten Months and hath not Since Rented House or paid Taxes

Elizth. Baker Aged about 32 Years upon Oath Says she was Never Married Says she Rented a House in Bedford Court Red Lyon Street in the Parish of St Andrew in Holborn above Barrs in the County of Middx upwards of One Year at the Yearly Rent of Sixteen Pounds hath quitted said House about Six Years and she hath not since Rented House Paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says she hath One Child Named Margaret Aged about Five Years

Mary Hill Aged about Thirty three Years upon Oath Says she was never Marryed Says that on the third Day of September 1758 she was Delivered of a Male Bastard Child at Dr. Harveys in Berwick Street in the Parish of St. Ann in the County of Middx which hath Since been Baptized by the Name of Richard Says she Lived a hired Yearly Servant with John Chase Esqr . in the Parish of Richmond in the County of Surry upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted said Service about Fifteen Years & hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year.

Ann Evans Aged about Twenty One Years Upon Oath Says she was never Marryed Rented House was an Apprentice or lived a Hired Yearly Sert for One Year Says she Cannot give any Account of the Settlement of her Father other then he was Born in Wales but in what part Cannot Say That she has been Informed by her Father & Mother & which Information she Verily beleives to be true that she was Born in Langley Street Long Acre in the Parish of St. Martin in the field in ye Liberty of Westmr.

Christr. Phillipson Aged about Fifty Eight Years upon Oath Says he Intermarried with his Wife Jane in the Parish Church of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx about four Years ago hath One Child by his said Wife Named Jane Aged about Eleven Months Says he Rented a House in little Mays Buildings in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of Eighteen Pounds & Lived therein about Two Years & Never after Rented House or Paid Taxes

Elizth. Goldsmith Aged about 30 Years upon Oath Says she Intermarried with her Husband John Goldsmith in the parish Church of Mickham in the County of Surry about Six Years ago Says her said Husband Rented a House in Wild Court in the parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middx Two Years & a half at the Yearly Rent of Eighteen Pounds hath quitted said House about three Quarters of a Year & he hath not Since Rented House or paid Taxes

Sarah Seddam Aged about Nineteen Years upon Oath Says she was never Marryed was an Apprentice Rented House paid Taxes or Lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says her Father Rented a House in Gardeners Lane Petty France in the Parish of St. Margaret in the Liberty of Westmr . two Years at the Yearly Rent of twelve Pounds & never after Rented House or paid Taxes.

Thomas Williams Aged about Forty Nine Years Upon Oath Says he Intermarried with his Wife Sarah in the Parish Church of St Peter in the City of Worcester hath three Children (to witt) Martha Aged about Twenty two Years Sarah Aged about Nineteen Years & Susannah Aged about thirteen Years Says he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes was an Apprentice or a hired Yearly Servant Says his Father Geo: Williams was Bound an Apprentice to a Tobacconist in St. Martins Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster with whom he Lived near twelve Months & then went into the Army as this Examinant hath been Informed & which Information he Verily Beleives to be true

Elizth: Burnett wife of Owen Burnett on behalf of Michael Thomas Horner aged about Eight Years Son of George Horner deceased by Ann his Wife Upon Oath says the said Michael Thomas Horner was born in Gardiner's Lane, King Street Westminster in the parish of Saint Margaret in the City of Westmr. within the County of Middlesex , And that the said George Horner was a German and never Rented house paid Taxes or otherwise gained a Settlement in England to this Examinants knowledge or belief.

Thomas Thompson aged about 29 Years upon Oath says he intermarried with Sarah his Wife in the parish Church of St. Margaret Westminster about Nine Years ago by whom he hath one Child named Thomas aged upwards of four Years, says he Rented and lived in a House (known by the Sign of the Marquiss of Granby) in Villiers Street . York Buildings in the parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for five Months and upwards at the Yearly Rent of Twenty two pounds hath Quitted same about four Years and hath not since Rented House or paid Taxes

James Cobham aged about 14 Years Upon Oath says he was bound an Apprentice by the Churchwardens and Overseers of the poor of the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx to Joshua Roper of Turnmill Street in the parish of St. John Clerkenwell in the same County Cabinet founder with whom he lived as an Apprentice upwards of One Year and then went away from his said Master and never was Assigned over to any person whatsoever.

Ann Guilliott aged about 30 Years Upon Oath says she is the Wife of Nicholas Guilliott gone from her with him she intermarried in Worksop Church in Nottinghamshire about four Years ago by whom she hath one Child named Joseph aged upwards of two Years says her said husband Rented a house in Orange Court in the parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster for One Year and Upwards at the Yearly Rent of Twenty four pounds hath Quitted same about five Months and hath not since Rented House or paid Taxes

Sophia Bates aged about Twenty Years upon Oath says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Owen a Fishwoman in Church Lane in the parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. for two Years and Upwards at the Yearly Wages of Three pounds and Twelve Shillings hath quitted same about four Years and hath not since Rented house paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year And further upon her Voluntary Oath says she never was Married and that on the 17th. Novr. 1763 she was delivered of a female Bastard Child in the house of Mr. Spriggs in Thomas's Street in the parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex which was baptized Margaret and is now living and that one William Davis a Bricklayer did beget the said female Bastard Child on her Body of which she was delivered as aforesaid

Henry Edwards aged upwards of 40 Years lodging at Mrs. Andrews's in Change Court in the parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex Upon Oath says he Rented a house in little Cranburn Alley in the parish of St. Ann in the Liberty of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of Thirty pounds lived therein about One Year and hath quitted same One Year or thereabouts since which time he hath not Rented House or paid Taxes, says he hath two Children by Ann his Deceased Wife (to wit) Robert aged about thirteen Years and Thomas aged about Nine Years

Mary Anderson aged abt. 39 Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of William Anderson who has been dead about Sixteen Years with whom she intermarried in the Parish Church of Ware in the County of Hertford about Twenty two Years ago says that being a Widow she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Kennett McKenzie Esqr. for Ten Years and upwards says she lived the last two Years of her said Service with the said Kennett Mc.Kenzie Esqr. in Holles Street Cavendish Square in the Parish of St. Mary le Bone in the County of Middx at the Yearly Wages of Ten pounds, says at the time she lived with her said Master in Holles Street she had a Son named William aged about seventeen Years and who was then an Apprentice to one Mr. John Child a Carpenter at Buntingford in Hertfordshire says she has not since she quitted her said Service (which is upwards of three Years since) Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Ann Marlow aged about 27 Years lodging at Mr. Hawkins's in Clements Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr. within the County of Middlesex upon Oath says she was never Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with William Matthew Burt Esqr. in the Liberty of Maiden Early in the parish of Sunning in the County of Berks for One Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted said Service about three Years and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year And further upon her Voluntary Oath says that on the 15th. day of July 1764 she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in the House of the above named Mr. Hawkins in the said Parish of St. Clement Danes which hath since been baptized by the Name of William and that James Flowers a Labourer who was the reputed Father of the said Child died on the 22d. day of May 1765.

Sarah Norton aged about 20 Years upon Oath says she never was Married was an Apprentice or a Yearly hired Servant for one Year Rented Ten Pounds by the Year or paid Taxes says her Father James Norton Rented a house in King Square Court Soho in the parish of St. Ann in the Liberty of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of Sixteen pounds or thereabouts lived therein about Ten Years & there dyed,

George Wood aged upwards of 30 Years upon Oath says he intermarried with Elizabeth his Wife in the Parish Church of Enfield in the County of Middlesex about Ten Years ago, by whom he hath four Children (to wit) Charlotte aged about Nine Years, Emanuel aged about Seven Years George Alrington aged about four Years and Alrington aged about two Years, says he was bound an Apprentice for Eight Years to William Stubbs of the Parish of Hexam in the County of Northumberland Shoemaker and served about five Years the first part of his said Apprenticeship and then his said Master died and this Examinant was Assigned over to William Robson of the said Parish of Hexam Shoemaker and served him two Years and upwards and never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year.

Joseph Lewis aged abt. 36 Years upon Oath says he intermarried with Sarah his Wife at the Fleet London about fifteen Years ago by whom he has three Children Joseph aged about thirteen Years George aged about four Years and penelope aged upwards of one Year say's he served one Year and upwards the last part of his Apprenticeship with Mr. Joseph Hickman Air Pumpmaker in Stonecutter Street in the Parish of St. Brides London & hath been out of his said Apprentice ship about fifteen Years and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Eleanor Mortimer aged abt. Thirty Five Years Upon Oath Says She is the Wife of Paul Mortimer with whom she Intermarried abt. Eighteen Years ago in May Fair Chapel hath one Child by him named Isabella Aged one Month Says her sd. Husband Rented a House in New Round Court in the Strand in the parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. Yearly Rent Twenty four pounds lived in the same upwards. of One Year quitted sd. House about Eight Years & hath not since Rented House or pd. Taxes Says her sd. Husband is now ill & going into an Hospitall for Cure

Catherine Chambers aged about Twenty nine Years upon Oath says She is the Wife of Charles Chambers with whom She intermarried in the Parish Church of Isslington in the County of Middlesex about 9 Years ago, by whom She hath two Children namely Jane aged about seven Years and Elizabeth aged about six Years, Says that her said Husband served his Apprenticeship of seven Years with one Mr. Honeyman a Bookbinder in Saint Martins Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster as She hath been informed by him and verily believes and that her said Husband hath never since Rented Ten pounds a year, paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Cheesbrough Aged about Forty two Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Joseph Cheesbrough who has been dead about Five Years, says her said late Husband of ten times informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true that before his Intermarriage with this Examinant he rented a house in Shug Lane in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster for one Year and Upwards, at the Yearly Rent of Sixteen Pounds, and after he quitted same never Rented ten Pounds a Year or paid Taxes

Mary Eddes Aged about Twenty four Years Upon Oath says she never was Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Chevalier in the House of Mr. Thompson Perukemaker in Mount Street in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster for Three Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds, quitted said Service about Four Years, and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Francis Bishop of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr Beadle on behalf of James Tee on Infant aged about fifteen years upon Oath Says that the said James Tee was bound Apprentice by the Churchwardens and Overseers of the Poor of the said Parish of Saint Clement Danes By Indenture Dated the 14th. day of January 1768 to Edward Lyth of the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westmr. Perukemaker untill the said James Tee shod Attain his full Age of Twenty One Years according to the Statute in that Case made & Provided As by the said Indenture of Apprenticeship relation being thereunto had may more fully and at large And further Says that the said James Tee never was Assigned over or ever gained any or Subsequent Settlemt to the Knowledge or belief of this Examinant

Sarah Hudson aged about forty five Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of William Hudson gone from her with whom she Intermarried at the Fleet London upwards of Twenty Two Years ago by whom she hath Two Sons now living Vizt. Wm . Aged about Twenty one Years and Joseph Aged about Nineteen Years Says her said Husband Served five Years the first part of his Apprenticeship with one Mr. Cox a Carver in Broad Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr . and afterwards went to Sea where he died as this Examinant has been Informed and further says that since her said Husbands absconding she never rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

William Willoughby Aged upwards of Sixty on the Behalf of his Grandson William Willoughby Aged about Seventeen Years on his Oath says that his said Grandson never was married nor ever rented House paid taxes was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says his Son John Willoughby and deceased Father of the abovenamed William Willoughby served seven Years Apprenticeship with Isaac Smith of the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. Wire Worker and after his said Son John Willoughby was out of his said said Apprenticeship he never rented House paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Frances Lacoudae aged about Twenty One Years on her Oath says she never was married nor ever Rented House paid Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father Lacoudae was a Native of France and never gained a Settlement in England to her knowledge or belief Says she was born in Saint Martins Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr . as her said Father has often Informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true

Frances Jennings Aged about Twenty Three Years on her Oath Says she never was Married And that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Ann Williams in Great Marlborough Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster for Two Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted her said Service about five Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Thomas Brees Aged about Sixteen Years on his Oath says he never was married nor ever Rented House or paid Taxes Says he was bound Apprentice to and served Seven Years Apprenticeship with Thomas Tattenham a Chimney Sweeper in One Tun Alley in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Passd. to St Dunstan in the West Celia Sewey Aged Forty One years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith That she Lived with Mr James Tow of Cliffords Inn Passage in the Parish of Saint Duston in the West in the City of London for upward of Three Years at the Annual Wages of £6 That She quitted her said service about 20 years ago-And That since she Quitted it she has not done any Act Matter or thing Whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have a Settlement elswhere

Elizabeth Holmes aged 45 years or thereabout upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes that she lived with one John Stevens Linen Drapers the Corner of St Brides Passage in the Parish of Saint Brides alias Bridget in the City of London as a yearly hired Servant for 19 Months or there abouts at the yearly Wages of £7. hath Quitter said servi about 11 years ago since which time she has not lived as a hired yearly Servant or done any act matter of Thing whereby she may have gained a Subsequent Settlement

Sarah Lodge Aged about Sixty five Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Philip Lodge with who has been dead about Nine Years and with whom she Intermarried at the Parish of Saint Brides London above Forty Years ago and by whom she hath no Children now living Except Two who are provided for Says her said late Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Joseph Brewer at the Black Rasen in fetter Lane in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn London for Two Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds as she belives hath quitted his said Service upwards of Forty Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain Subsequent Settlement neither as this Examinant since her said Husband Death.

Richard Bry aged about Thirty five Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Ann his Wife at the Parish Church of St. Clement Danes upwards of One year & an half ago and by whom he that no Child new living Says he was bound an Apprentice to one Joseph Morris a Staymaker in Vine Street in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr and service his said Master under those Indres upwards of five Months when his said Master Broke and run away since which time he never Rented House paid taxes lived a hired Yearly or Covenanted Servant for one Year

Elizth. Henley aged about Twenty four Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father Rented and lived in a House in Justices Walk in the Parish of St. Lukes Chelsea in the County of Middlesex in which Parish this Examinant was born and this Examinant further saith that she was Passed from Saint Andrew Holbourn upon the said Parish of Saint Lukes Chelsea aforesaid where her said Settlement was found to be since which time she has never gained any subsequent Settlement

Mary Marr Wife of James Marr on behalf of Eleanor Price an Instant aged about Ten Years whose Father William Price has deserted her on her Oath Says that the said William the Father of the Said Eleanor Price Rented and lived in a House in Bow Street in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex for half a Year or upwards at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Two pounds a Year as she has been Informed and verily believes hath quitted the same upwards of one Year & out of since which time he never gained any subsequent Settlement to her knowledge or beleif neither hath the said Eleanor Price the Infant gained any Settment by living a hired Yearly Servant or otherwise to her knowledge or belief

Mary Frohock Aged about forty Seven Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Silvester Frohock with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Allhallow Barking about fourteen Years ago and who has been dead about six Years says her said late Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Edward Jackson at the sign of the Ancher and Baptist Head in Chancery Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he Continued to live as a hired Yearly Servant with the said Mr. Jackson for Two Years or thereabouts and after quitting the said Service he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Dodd Aged upwards of 19 Years on her Oath says she never was married rented house paid taxes or ever served any Apprenticeship says she lived a hirely Yearly Servant with one Mr. Calvert a Cheesemonger in Fleet Market in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn London upwards of 14 Months at the Yearly Wages of St hath quitted her said Service above 9 Months ago since which time she never rented house paid taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a subsequent Settlement

Phebe Nicholson aged about forty two Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of John Nicholson (who is a Militia Man now at Hounslow ) with whom she Intermarrd. at the parish Church of St- Andrew Holborn about ten Years ago and by whom she hath two Childn- now living namely Wm - aged about six Years and Elizth- Ann aged upwards of three Years Says her said husband before his Intermarrd- with this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr- Briscon a Fishmonger in Bloomsbury Markett in the parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the Co- of Middx upwards of six Years at the Yearly Wages of £18 besides Board & Lodging and from whence this Examinant Married-and after quitting his said Service he never Rented house paid Taxes or did any other Act whereby to gain a subseqt- Settlemt-

Jane Hayland aged upwds. of 20 Years upon Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a Yearly Servant with Mrs. Delareve in Gerard Street in the parish of St. Ann in the Liberty of Westmr. and for one year at the yearly wages of four pounds and quitted her sd. Service about 6 months ago

Mary Duck aged abt. 21 Yrs. upon Oath saith she never was married and never was an Apprentice or yearly Servt. for one Year nor ever Rented Ten pounds a Year or pd. parish taxes that her father Jno. Duck deced rented the Bell Inn at Parkgate in the parish of Carrington in the County of Surry and lived therein Sevl. Years and never after he quitted the sd. Inn Rented ten pounds a Year or pd. parish taxes

Mary Odel aged abt. 19 Years upon Oath saith she never was married & that she was born in the Parish of Cranfield in the County of Bedford where her father lived in & rented a house & that she never rented ten pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes was an Apprentice or yearly Servt for one year

Joyce Lee aged near 25 years upon Oath saith she never was married nor ever rented ten pounds a Year paid parish taxes was an Apprentice or yearly Servt & that her father Jno. Lee rented a house of £16 by the Year in Sion Row in the parish of Twickenham in the County of Middx lived therein Sevl Years & never after he quitted the sd house rented ten pounds a year a paid parish taxes

John Forster upon his Oath saith that about twenty Years ago he lived a Yearly Servt. with Mr Holmes a Farmer in the parish of Skefflin in the County of York for one year at the yearly wages of £4.10.0 and was all the time of his sd. Service a Singleman & that he hath not since he left the sd Mr Holmes Rented ten pounds a Year paid parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Kane upon Oath Saith she is the wido. of John Kane who dyed near 4 Yrs. since and by whom she hath one Child Rose aged near 7 years and that she hath been Informed & believes her said late husband lived a Yearly Servant (whilst a Singleman) Wth. Mr Danl. Doghead a Farmer in the parish of Clift in the County of Kent and for 3 Yrs. & upwds and never after he quitted his sd. Service nor has this Examint. Since his Decease Rented ten Pounds a Year paid parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for one Yr.

Mary Withers upon Oath Saith she is the wife of John Withers (gone from her) by whom she hath one Child Mary aged four Months and that she hath been informed and verily believes her said husband rented a house of £10 by the year near Laweys Gate in the parish of St. Philip and Mary in Bristol lived therein abt. 3 Yrs. & quitted the Same about 8 Years ago Since which he has not rented ten pounds a Year or pd. parish taxes

Mary Corkin upon Oath saith she never was married and that she lived a yearly Servant with Mr Russell at Mrs. Cremers in the Strand in the Precinct of the Savoy in the County of Middx for five Years at the yearly Wages of four pounds quitted her sd. Service upwds. of 12 Years ago and has not Since She quitted her sd. Service Rented ten pounds a Year paid parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one year

Priscilla Tanner upon Oath Saith She is the Wido. of John Tanner who dyed upwds. of 2 Yrs. ago and with whom She intermarried at the Fleet London abt. 15 Years ago and that her sd. late husband informed her he Served his Apprentiship with Mr Joshua Murphey a Chimney Sweeper in Newtoners Lane in the Parish of St. Giles in ye Fields in the County of Middlesex & after the Expiration of his Apprentiship lived a Servt. with the sd Mr. Murphey for one year in Newtoners Lane afsd. and never after he quitted the Said Mr. Murpheys Service nor has this Examinant Since his Decease Rented ten pounds a year paid parish taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one year

Winifred Alie upon Oath saith she is the Wife of Mathw. Alie that her sd. husband & herself are both Natives of Ireland & never gained a Settlemt. in England and that the sd. Mathw. Alie (as she hath been informed & believes) Served his Apprentiship with a Taylor in Turlis in the County of Tipper in Ireland afsd. & never rented ten pounds a Year pd. parish taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one Year

Eliz Poole upon Oath saith she intermarried with her husband Jno. Poole at Winchester Cathedral in the County of Southampton abt. 24 yrs. ago (that at prest. he absconds from her) & that before his intermarriage with this Examint. & Whilst & Singleman her sd husbd. lived a yearly Servt. with Edwd. Hooker Esqr. in the parish of St. Mary Calender in Winchester afsd. in the County for 9 yrs. & upwds. & quitted that Service a Short time after their Marriage & has not since rented ten pounds a year nor pd. parish taxes except in the parish of St. Thomas in Winchester where he rented a house of £6..10..0 by the year & had a Certificate from St Mary Calender afsd.

Martha Waters upon Oath saith she was married to Thomas Waters at the Parish Church of St. Mary le Strand about Eight Years ago by whom she has two Children Eliz aged four Years and Charles abt. 18 months and that her sd. husband Served his Apprentiship with his father John Waters a Waterman in Feathers Court in the parish of St Mary le Strand aforesd. and never rented ten pounds a Year paid Parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Smith upon Oath Saith she never was married and that she Served three Years Apprentiship with Mrs. Brown a Hoop Petticoat maker in Mary le bone in the Parish of St Mary le bone in the County of Middlesex and never rented ten pounds a Year paid parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for one Year

Jno. Simpson upon Oath Saith he lived a Yearly Servant with Coll Mading for the Space of three Years at the Yearly Wages of Four pounds for the first Year and Six pounds by the year afterwards and that he lodged the last two Months of his sd Service at his Masters Stables in Ham Yard in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westmr ., that he left the sd. Coll Mading about Six Years ago and has not since rented ten pounds a Year paid parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. (in any part of Great Britain) for one Year

Mary Fitzwalters aged 37 Yrs. upon Oath Saith, she never was married & that upwards of two Years ago she was hired to live a Yearly Servant with Mr. Morgan at the Yearly Wages of Five pounds and lived with the sd. Morgan under that hiring and Agreement in New Broad Court in the Parish of St Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr . for one Year & upwards And that, since she quitted her sd. Service She has not Rented ten pounds a Yr. pd. Parish Taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for one Year

Philip Newman upon Oath Saith he Served Seven years Apprentiship with Mathew Attmore Carpenter opposite the Duke of Devonshires in Pickadilly in the Parish of St Geo. Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westmr. and never rented ten pounds by the Year paid Parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for one year

Mary Moreland aged abt. 27 Yrs. upon Oath Saith she never was married And that in the Month of Octr. 1751 she was delivered of a female bastard Child at Mr Sharps in Paradise Row near Bond Street in the Parish of St. George Hanr Square in the Liberty of Westmr. which was baptized Hannah Frances

Judith Nailer upon Oath saith she is the Wife of Wm Nailer who was born at Nettlebed in Oxfordshire and never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant rented ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish taxes as she has been informed & believes & that her sd. husbands father lived in & rented the White hart Inn at Nettlebed afsd. for one Year & upwds.

Wm. Baismore upon Oath Saith he intermarried wth his Wife Sarah Baismore at the Fleet London abt. 20 Yrs. ago & has by her one Child Jas . aged near 7 Yrs. that he Served 6 Yrs. & upwards of his apprentiship with Jno. Mince a Shoemaker at the corner of Carnaby Street Golden Square in the Parish of St. Jas. Westmr . and then his master dying this Examint. continued to Serve out the remr. of his Apprentiship wth. Mr Mince's Wido. in the same house & that he never rented ten Pounds a yr. pd. Parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for one Year

Ann Bretton aged near 70 Yrs. upon Oath saith she is the wido. of Saml. Bretton with whom she intermarried at Mayfair Chapel the 3d. Day of August 1747 that her sd. late husband rented the Crooked Billet Alehouse next Door to Henleys Oratory near Lincolns Inn fields in the parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of middlesex at the yearly Rent of £20 for servant Year & there dyed upwds. of 5 Years age & this Examinant has not since his decease rented ten Pounds a Year Pd. Parish taxes or lived Yearly Servant for one year

Ann Humphrys upon Oath saith she never was married and that she is the Daughter of Thos Humphry by Mary his Wife that she never was an apprentice or yearly Servant rented ten Pounds a year or paid Parish taxes and that her sd. father Thos. Humphrys rented a house of £40 by the year known by the Sign of the Black horse in little Wild Street in the said Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middx. & lived therein upwds. of one Year and has not since he quitted the sd. house rented ten Pounds by the Year or pd. Parish taxes to her knowledge or belief

Richard Platt upon Oath saith he intermarried wth. his wife Jane Platt in the parish Church of St. Ann Soho on the 27th. May 1733 by whom He has a Child named Rd . aged abt. 6 years & that he served seven years apprentiship with James Platt a Shoemaker in Exeter Street in the Parish of St Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. and never rented Ten pounds a Year paid parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servant for one year

Mary Humphrys upon Oath saith she never was married & that she is the Daughter of Thos Humphrys by Mary his Wife that she never was an apprentice or yearly Servant nor ever Rented ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes and that her said father Thos. Humphrys rented a house of £40 by the Year known by the Sign of the black Horse in little Wild Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middx & lived therein upwds. of one year & never after he quitted the sd. house Rented Ten Pounds a Year or Paid Parish Taxes to this Examinants knowledge or belief

Lisse Ann James aged abt. 40 Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Thos. James who has been dead abt. Six Years says her said husband served seven Years Apprenticeship with Mr. Davis a Watch maker in Nags head Court on Snow Hill in the Parish of St. Sepulchre in the City of London and never in his life time nor she since his Death Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Frans. Gravener Aged about Twenty Six Years Lodging in Milford Lane in the Parish of St. Clemt Danes in the County of Middx Upon Oath Saith he was Bound an Apprentice for Seven Years to Mr. Cheese a Butcher in the Precinct of the Savoy in the County of Middx with whom he Lived as Apprentice near Two Years & then this Examinant and his Master Parted by Consent & this Examinant Immediately Inlisted for a Soldier & hath been Discharged from his Regiment about Nine Months & never Rented House Paid Taxes or Lived a hired Yearly Servant

Thomas Norgrave Aged about Fifty One Years Upon Oath Says he Intermarried with his Wife Mary in May Fair Chapel about Twenty Years ago who has been Dead about Five Years Says that whilst he was Singleman and Before his Intermarriage with his said Wife he Lived a Hired Yearly Servant with Mr Whiteacre in Lime Street in the Parish of Saint Dionis Backchurch in the City of London upwards of Two Year at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds. hath Quitted his said Service about Twenty One Years and he hath not Since Rented House or Paid Taxes.

Eleanor Lebass on the Behalf of James King a Child Aged about twelve Years Upon Oath Says that the said Child was Born in the Parish of St. Ann Blackfryers in the City of London about twelve Years ago as this Examinant hath Been Informed by the Mother by the Mother of the said Child and which Information she Verily Believes to be true
