Mary Cox Aged about Fifty Six Years Lodging in Bennetts Court Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster Upon Oath Says she is the Widow of Arthur Cox who has been Dead about Seven Years with whom she Intermarried at the Fleet London about Nineteen Years ago Says her said Husband is a Native of Ireland and never Gained a Settlement in England as this Examinant hath been Informed by her said Husband and which Information she Verily believes to be true Says that whilst she was a Singlewoman she Lived a Hired Yearly Servant with Richard Cecil an Apothecary the Corner of Bloomsbury Square in the Parish of St. George Bloomsbury in the County of Middx upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted said Service about Twenty Years and hath not Since Rented House or Paid Taxes.

Sarah Cook Aged about Twenty Nine Years Upon Oath Says That on the Fourteenth of February 1758 she was Delivered of a Female Bastard Child in Swallow Street in the parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster which hath since been Baptized by the Name of Eleanora is now Living and this Examinant being poor is unable to maintain the said Child

Elizth. Lewis Aged about Thirty four Years upon Oath Says she was never Marryed Says she Lived a Hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Turner a Chineas Man in Piccadilly in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds & hath quitted said Service about Six Weeks

Catherine Dickenson Aged about Twenty Seven Years upon Oath Says she was never Married was an Apprentice Rented House or paid Taxes Says her Father Richard Dickenson Rented a House in Exeter Street in the Strand in the Parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westmr. upwards of two Years at the Yearly Rent of Sixteen Pounds or thereabouts and never after Rented House or Paid Taxes Says that on the fourth of August last she was Delivered of a Female Bastard Child at the Lying Inn Hospital in Tyburry Road in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the County of Middx which hath since been Baptized by the Name of Lucy and is now Living

Charles Cotton Aged about Fifty Years upon Oath Says he Lived a Hired Yearly Servant with the Duke of Leeds in St. James Square in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of Eight Years at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds hath quitted said Service about Nine Years & hath not since Rented House Paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Sarah Owen Wife of Hugh Owen Gone from her with whom she Intermarried in the Parish Church of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. about upwards of Seven Years ago by whom she has two Children (to wit) Robert Aged about Seven Years & Mary Aged about five Years Says her said Husband Rented the Thistle & Crowne Alehouse in Denmark Court in the said Parish of St. Martin in the Fields at the Yearly Rent of Twenty four Pounds Lived in same about five Years hath quitted same upwards of two Years & hath not since Rented House or paid Taxes

Cath: Sanger on Behalf of Thomas and Catherine Peirson two Infants the Children of Thos. Peirson by Mary his Wife both Deceased Says the Father of the said Children Rented a House in St. Martins Court in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. about two Years at the Yearly Rent of Fourteen Pounds or thereabouts hath quitted said House about four Years and hath not Since Rented House or paid Taxes as this Examinant hath Been Informed and which Information she Verily Beleives to be true

Sarah Eaglesfield Aged about Seventy One Years upon Oath Says she was never Marryed was an Apprentice Rented House paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year other then being a Nurse at the London Hospitall in Goodsmans Fields in the Parish of St. Mary Whitechaple in the County of Middx One Year and three Quarters at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted said Service about Sixteen Years and hath not Since Rented House Paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Wm- Hawkins Aged about Sixty two Years upon Oath Says he Rented a House in Great Bennett Court in the Strand in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr . about Ten Years at the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds hath quitted said House about Twenty four Years & hath not Since Rented House or Paid Taxes.

John Harry Aged about Forty Years upon Oath Says he Served One Year and a half of his Apprentiship with Richard Stars a Taylor in Southampton Buildings Chancery Lane in the Parish of St. Andrew in Holborn above Barrs in the County of Middx & then Went Abroad & never after was Assigned over to any Person Rented House paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Sert. for One Year

Henry Prosser Aged about Thirty Six Years upon Oath Says he Lived a Hired Yearly Servant with Dr. Neasbet in Kings Street Cheapside in the Parish of St. Mildred in the Poultrey London three Years at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds he being at that time a Singleman & without Child or Children hath quitted said Service about Ten Years & hath not Since Rented House paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Ann Hancell Aged about 28 Years upon Oath Says she was never Marryed Says she Lived as hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Archer who Lodged with Mr. Payne on Camberwell Green in the parish of Camberwell in the County of Surry Seven Years at the Yearly Wages of three pounds hath quitted said Service about Eight Months and hath not since Rented House or paid Taxes

Mary Lilley Aged about 40 Years upon Oath Says she was never Marryed Says she Lived a Hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Morin as Taylor Perukemaker in Charles Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. two Years at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds hath quitted said Service about Sixteen Years and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Alice Demson Aged about Sixty Years upon Oath Says she was never Marryed Says she Lived a hired Yearly Servant with General Mosson in St. James Palace in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster One Year & upwards at the Yearly Wages of Ten pounds hath quitted said Service about five Years and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or Lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Elizabeth Hart aged about 36 Years upon Oath says she was never married Rented Ten Pounds by the Year paid Taxes nor ever was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year, says her father John Hart who was by Trade a painter Rented and lived in a house in Great Hart Street Covent Garden in the Parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of Twenty pounds or thereabouts for a great many Years and there died,

Margaret Shaw aged about 33 Years upon Oath says she was never Married and that she was bound an Apprentice by the Church wardens and Overseers of the poor of the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster to James Fry of Swallow Street in the parish of St. James in the said Liberty of Westminster Lamp lighter and served about Seven Years of her said Apprenticeship and then her Master gave her the remainder of the time she had to serve which was about four Years; says she never was Assigned over to any person, Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for One Year.

Elizabeth Maculla aged about 45 Years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Thomas Daniel Maculla with whom she intermarried in the Parish Church of St. Martin in the Fields upwards of five Years since, says her said husband has for sometime past been disordered in his Senses and is incapable of giving a rational Account of himself says her said husband (before he was afflicted with the said Disorder and when in his proper Senses) has often times informed her and which information she verily believes to be true that he is the Son of Andrew Maculla Esqr . deceased late a Captain in the Coldstream Regiment of foot Guards , that her said husband was born in Bell Yard in the Parish of St. Margaret in the City of Westminster in which place his father Rented & lived in a house for several Years says her said husband never Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year as he has likewise informed her and which information she also believes to be true

Mary Blake aged about 35 Years Upon Oath says she is the Wife of Peter Blake with whom she intermarried in the Parish Church of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex about three Years ago by whom she hath one Child named James aged about Six Months, says her said husband is a Native of Ireland and never gained a Settlement in England to her knowledge or belief that her said husband is gone from her and is now in the Kingdom of Ireland as she this Examinant has been informed and which information she believes to be true; says before her intermarriage with the said Peter Blake and whilst she was a Single Woman she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Dickey a Taylor in Villiers Street York Buildings in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for One Year and Upwards at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds and after she quitted said Mr. Dickey's Service never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a Yearly hired servant for one Year And further upon her Voluntary Oath says that sometime in the Month of August 1758, she (being then a Single Woman and had never been Married) was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in the house of Mr. Bennett a Perukemaker in Charles Court in the Strand in the Parish of St. Martin aforesaid in the Liberty of Westminster which hath since been Baptised Edward and is now living says that one James Logan a Taylor was the reputed Father of the said Child, and that the said James Logan died on the 26th. of April 1760.

Wm: Owen aged about 35 Years upon Oath says he intermarried with Elizabeth his Wife in the Parish Church of St. Mary at Islington in the County of Middx about Ten Years ago by whom he has two Children, William aged about Eight Years and Elizabeth aged about five Years says before his Intermarriage with his said Wife and whilst he was a single Man he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Edward Northey Esqr. in Hanover Square in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster for One Year and a half at the Yearly Wages of Eleven Guineas and after he quitted said Service Never Rented house paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year.

Thos. Gorn aged about 53 Years upon Oath says he was married to Eleanor his Wife in the Parish Church of St. Giles in the Fields about four Years ago, says he can give no Account of the Settlement of his Father and that he this Examinant was born in Feathers Alley St. Martins Lane in the parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster and never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt.

Joshua Ray aged about 50 Years upon Oath says he Rented a house in Castle Court Chanders Street in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. of the Yearly Rent of Thirty Pounds lived therein about One Year and hath quitted same about Seven 5 Years And hath not since Rented house of Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Sarah Mayland aged about 38 Years upon Oath says she intermarried with Abraham Mayland in the Parish Church of St. Ann Westmr . at the Fleet London says she Rented a house the Bottom of Chancery Lane in the Parish of St. Dunstan in the West in the City of London of the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds, lived therein about two Years and quitted same about five Years ago And hath not since Rented house or paid Taxes

Richard Archdale Rooke of Hollywell Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster Mercer on the behalf of Mary Keen a Lunatic Upon Oath says the said Mary Keen lived a hired Yearly Servant with this Examinants Mother Esther Rooke in Church Court in the parish of Kensington in the County of Middlesex for three Years or thereabouts and hath quitted her said Service about Seven Months.

Peter Duncan aged abt. 55 Years lodging in Plough Court in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster upon Oath says he was Married to Margaret his wife in the Parish Church of Christ Church Spittal fields upwards of Ten Years since, says he Rented a house in Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the said Liberty of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of Twenty One Pounds lived in the same upwards of Ten Years and hath quitted same about 3 Quarters of a Year and hath not since Rented house or paid Taxes

Esther Pringle aged abt. 25 Years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Walter Pringle (who is now in the Marshalsea Prison ) with whom she intermarried in the Parish Church of St. Saviours Southwark upwards of a Year ago by whom she hath one Child John aged about 4 Months, says her said husband informed her and which information she verily believes to be true that he Rented a house in White hart Court Castle Street in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. of the Yearly Rent of Eleven pounds lived therein about one Year and quitted same in the Year 1750 and hath not since Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year as he has also informed this Examinant and which information she believes to be true says before her said intermarriage with the said Walter Pringle she was the Widow of Thomas Davenport who informed this Examinant he was born in the Parish of St. Botolph Bishopsgate in the City of London And never Rented House paid Taxes was an Apprentice or a Yearly hired Servant for one Year, says she has one Child by the said Thomas Davenport (to wit) Thomas aged upwards of four Years

Mary Jenkins aged about 40 Years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Henry Jenkins gone from her with whom she intermarried in the Chapel at Kentish Town in the Parish of St. Pancras in Middlesex about fifteen Years ago; says her said husband Rented a house in Tooley Street in the Parish of St. Olave Southwark in the County of Surry of the Yearly Rent of Eleven Pounds & eleven Shillings lived therein about one Year & hath quitted same twelve Years or thereabouts and hath not since Rented House or paid Taxes

Alice Edwards aged about 60 Years upon Oath says that being a Widow she Rented and lived in a house in Pettiford Yard in the Parish of St. Mary le Strand in the Liberty of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of five Pounds and Ten Shillings for Eight Years and was assessed and paid the Land Tax for the same and hath quitted said house about three Weeks.

Elizabeth Scuttle aged about 39 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Thomas Scuttle who has been dead about Ten Years says her said husband hath often times informed her and which information she verily believes to be true that he was bound Apprentice by the Churchwardens and Overseers of the poor of the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn London to Thomas Smith a Chimney sweeper and served his said Apprenticeship with the said Thomas Smith in the Coal Yard in Holborn in the Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middx and lived as a Yearly Servant with his said Master in the Coal Yard aforesaid for three Years after his said Apprenticeship expired, and then intermarried with this Examinant, says her said husband in his life time nor she since his Death never Rented house or paid Taxes.

Elizabeth Drury aged about 49 Years upon Oath says she was never married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Turner a Carpenter in Cateaton Street next the Church in the Parish of St. Lawrence Jewry in the City of London for One Year and Upwards at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds, hath quitted said Service about Eight Years and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Sarah Fennell aged about 34 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Richard Fennell who has been dead upwards of two Years says her said late Husband informed her and which information she verily believes to be true that he served four Years, the last part of his Apprenticeship with Mr. Pickle's a Brazier the corner of Maggots Court in Piccadilly in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster and never rented house or paid Taxes says she hath not since her said husbands death Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Elizabeth Dugdale aged about 26 Years upon Oath says she was never Married and that she was bound an Apprentice by the Churchwardens and Overseers of the poor of the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster to John Hill of Ratcliffe highway in the Parish of St. George in the East in the County of Middlesex Silk winder and served about half a Year of her said Apprenticeship with the said John Hill in Ratcliffe high way aforesaid and then her said Master absconded and has not since been heard of, and this Examinant further upon her Oath says she was informed by her Mother that she was discharged from her Apprenticeship with the said John Hill by one of his Majesty's Justices of the Peace who dwelt near West Smithfield , says after she was informed of her being discharged from her said Apprentice- ship she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Martin a Pawnbroker in Reeves's Mews in the aforesaid Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster for One Year and Upwards at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted said Service about Eight Years and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Davis aged about 22 Years upon Oath says she was born in the Parish of St. James in the City of Bristol in the County of Somerset and never rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year, says she can give no Account of the Settlement of her Father other than he was born somewhere in Wales but in what Parish of place this Examinant cannot tell, says she has two Children, John aged upwds. of two Years and James aged upwards of one Year

Mary Dewberry aged abt. 27 Years upon Oath says she was never Married and that she was bound an Apprentice to and served seven Years Apprenticeship with Henry Gardener a Weaver in the Parish of Ewell in the County of Surry and never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Elizabeth Line aged about 48 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of James Line who has been dead upwards of Nine Years says that being a Widow she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Houseman a Cabinetmaker on Clerkenwell Green in the Parish of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex for two Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of three Pound's hath quitted said Service about five Years and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

William Hollis aged about 33 Years Upon Oath says, he was bound Apprentice at the Age of Thirteen Years by the Churchwardens and Overseers of the poor of the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westmr. to Mr. Walter Burton a Sword Cutler in Little Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Mary le Strand in the Liberty of Westmr. aforesaid and served about Nine Years of his said Apprenticeship and then his said Master died and never was Assigned Over to any Person and further on his Oath saith that he never Rented house paid Taxes or lived a Yearly hired Servant for one Year.

Sarah Major aged abt. 27 Years upon Oath says she was never married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Cooper in Bartlett's Court in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn in the City of London for one Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted said Service about five Years and hath not since Rented house paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year, says she has two Children Mary Ann aged about three Years born in Wych Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster and William aged about five Months born in the Precinct of Whitefriars London

Caroline Gardner wife of John Gardner maketh Oath and saith that about Nine Years ago she was married at the fleet London to Thomas Taylor a Carpenter who has been dead upwards of two Years by whom she hath one Child now living (to wit) Anne aged upwards of Seven Years, says she has been informed the said Thomas Taylor served his Apprenticeship to a Carpenter in the City of Bath in the County of Somerset , but what his Master's Name was, or in what Parish or Place this Examinant cannot tell and further upon her Oath says her said Child Anne was born in the house of Mr. Ryley in Great Wild Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex

Daniel Obrien aged about 57 Years upon Oath says he Rented a house next the Play house Passage in Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of Twenty five Pounds lived therein upwards of three Years & hath quitted same about Ten Years and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Grace Westley aged about 50 Years upon Oath says she intermarried with William Westley (gone from her) at the Fleet London upwards of Twenty Years ago; says her said Husband informed her and which information she verily believes to be true that his Father William Westley Rented a house the corner of Fetter Lane in Holborn in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn in the City of London of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and Upwards and lived in the same several Years in which he carried on the Business of an Oilman says her said husband William Westley never Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes, was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year to this Examinants knowledge or belief

Ann Clark aged about 24 Years upon Oath says she was never Married, Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes was an Apprentice or a hired Yearly Servant for one Year, says her Father John Clark Rented a House in Whitcomb Street in the Parish of St: Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for several Years at the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and upwards and there died, and further upon her Oath says that on the 4th. day of January 1764, she was delivered of a female Bastard Child in the house of Mr. Robinson (a Chandler's Shop) in Water Lane Fleet Street in the Parish of St. Bridget alias St. Brides London which hath since been baptized Alkemia Ann

Mary Mc.owen aged about 40 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Roger Mc.owen who has been dead upwards of Two Months, says her said husband was an Irishman and never gained a Settlement in England to this Examinants knowledge or belief; says she served Seven Years Apprenticeship with Mrs. Hosier a Glover in Wardour Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster and never Rented house, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Clementinah Russell aged about 37 Years, upon Oath says she was never Married nor ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes, was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year; says her Father Richard Russell who has been dead about Seven Years Rented a house in Smith's Square in the Parish of St. John the Evangelist in the City of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of Twenty four Pounds lived therein about five Years and quitted same about Twelve Years before his Death and never after Rented House or paid Taxes.

Martha Simcock aged about 49 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Mattw. Simcock who has been dead about two Years; says her said husband serv'd Seven Years Apprenticeship with his Father Matthew Simcock a Perukemaker in Langley Street Long Acre in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster as he Often times inform'd her, and which information she verily believes to be true; and never Rented house, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year to her knowledge or belief; says she hath not since his Death Rented house paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Sarah Gibbons aged about 33 Years upon Oath says she was never married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Hamman's a Boxmaker in the Butcher row in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster for two Years at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds, hath quitted said Service about Seven Years and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year, And further upon Oath says that on the 25th, day of March 1765, she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in the house of Mr. Ryley an Undertaker in Dirty Lane Long Acre in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. which hath since been called baptized by the Name of Ralph

Sarah Morgan aged about 50 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Thomas Morgan who has been dead abt. fifteen Years to whom she was Married at the Fleet London about twenty Years ago, says her said husband was a Welsh Man and that she can give no Account of his Settlement says she never was an Apprentice, Rented house, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year and that about fourteen Years ago she was delivered of a female Bastard Child in the house of Mr. Scamell in Stanhope Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr. which hath since been baptized Sarah ; and that about twelve Years ago she was delivered of another female Bastard Child in the house of the said Mr. Scamell in Stanhope Street afore said which hath since been baptized Jane ; and that about Ten Years ago she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in the House of Mr. Hand the Corner of Vinegar Yard Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster aforesaid which hath since been baptized John ; says that John Patrick who was Father of the said Children is dead, and that she being poor is not able to Maintain them And further upon her Oath says her Father Saml. Birch Rented and lived in a house in Oxford Road in the parish of St. Anne in the said Liberty of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of Seventeen Pounds for one Year or thereabouts, quitted sd. house about Ten Years and hath not since Rented House or paid Taxes to this Examinants knowledge or belief

Elizabeth Bevan aged about 33 Years Upon Oath says she was never Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Parker a Linnen Draper in the Strand in the Parish of St. Mary le Strand in the Liberty of Westmr. for three Years & upwards at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds; hath quitted said Service about five Years, and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Thos. Percy aged about 70 Years upon Oath says he was rated to and paid the Land Tax in Lumber Court near the 7 dials in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middx and hath not since Rented house or paid Taxes

Ann Taylor aged about 55 Years upon Oath says she never was Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Paylor on the Terrass in St. James's Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster for one Year & upwards at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds, quitted said Service about Twelve Years and hath not since Rented the Yearly Value of Ten Pounds paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Mina Baker aged about 21 Years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Giles Baker with whom she intermarried in the Parish Church of Outwell in the County of Cambridge on or about the 17th. day of March 1765, by whom she hath one Child (to wit) Thomas aged about Six Weeks; says her said husband informed her and which information she verily believes to be true that before his intermarriage with her this Examinant, being at that time a Single Man and without Child or Children he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Young a Surgeon in Great Russell Street Bloomsbury in the Parish of St. George Bloomsbury in the County of Middx, for one Year and a half at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds and hath quitted said Service near two Years And never Rented house or paid Taxes; Says her said husband is gone from her and she being poor is not able to Maintain herself & Child

Isaac Crackinthorpe aged about 53 Years upon Oath says he Rented and lived in a house known by the Sign of the Crown opposite Villiers Street in the Strand in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster for three Years at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Six Pounds, quitted the same about Christmas 1760 and hath not since Rented house or paid Taxes

Jane Hall aged about 32 Years upon Oath says, she was never Married, nor Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year; says her Father Saml. Hall deceased Rented a house in Newtoners Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex of the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds for several Years and there dyed

Jane Slingsby aged about 31 Years Upon Oath says she never was married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Andrew Moffatt Esqr . in the Parish of Hampstead in the County of Middlesex for four Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds; hath quitt said Service about three Years and hath not since Rented house paid Taxes or lived a Yearly hired Servant for one Year And further upon her Voluntary Oath says that on the 22d, day of September 1765, she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in the house of Mr. Darby in Grange Court in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster which hath since been baptized Thomas and that being poor she is not able to Maintain herself & Child

Elizabeth Moon aged about 31 Years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Robert Moon (gone from her) with whom she intermarried in the Parish Church of Allhallows Barking London about Eighteen Months ago; says she has been informed and which information she verily believes to be true that about fifteen Years ago her said Husband Rented a house in little Peter Street in the Parish of St. John the Evangelist in the City of Westminister of the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds and hath not since he quitted said house Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Taxes to this Examinants knowledge or belief

Mary Hart wife of John Hart , Labourer (lodging in Mr. Cole's Rents in Drum Alley in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster on the behalf of Jane Burnett aged about four Years and Elizabeth Burnett aged about two Years, the Children of Joshua Burnett by Ann his Wife who have both run away and left their said Children whereby they are likely to become chargeable to the said parish of Saint Clement Danes) Upon Oath says she has been informed and which information she verily believes to be true that the said Joshua Burnett served his Apprenticeship to a Breeches maker in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster aforesaid and that the said Joshua Burnett with his family were in the Workhouse of the said Parish of St. George and were discharged there from about Six Weeks

David Forrester aged upwards of 60 Years upon Oath says he intermarried with Elizabeth his Wife at the Fleet London about 26 Years ago by whom he hath one Child named John David aged about Fourteen Years who never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant says that he this Examinant Rented a house in Oxford Road in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. for 2 Years and upwards at the Yearly Rent of £13, hath quitted same about Twenty Years & hath not since Rented house or paid Taxes.

John Williams aged upwards of 60 Years upon Oath says he served five Years and upwards the first part of his Apprenticeship with Mr. Thomas Sandery a Waterman and Lighterman in Milk Alley Wapping in the Parish of St. John at Wapping in the County of Middlesex and then Entered on Board one of his Majesty's Ships of War, and never Rented house paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Francis Moore aged about 45 Years upon Oath says he Rented a house in Chapel Street in the Parish of St. Anne in the Liberty of Westminster for Two Years and upwards at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds and upwards, hath quitted said house about five Years and hath not since Rented the Yearly Value of Ten Pounds paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Richd. Becket upon Oath says he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Smith at the Turks head Coffee house in the Strand in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . for one Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds he being at that time a Single Man and had never been Married hath quitted said Service about Ten Years and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Martha Pridham aged about 82 Years Upon Oath says that being a Widow she Rented a House in King Street Golden Square in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds ten Shillings lived therein upwards of Eighteen Months and quitted same about Sixteen Years ago, and hath not since Rented the Yearly Value of Ten Pounds, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Deborah Burton aged about 46 Years upon Oath says that in the Month of March 1757, She was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in the House of Mr. Burnett in Lombard Street in the Precinct of Whitefriers in the City of London which hath been baptized William Ross

John Buckett of the Parish of St. James Garlickhithe London Druggist on the behalf of Ann Reeves an Infant aged about four Weeks upon Oath says she is the Daughter of William Reeves by Mary his Wife and that the said William and Mary were Married in the Parish Church of Christ Church Spittal fields in the County of Middlesex about three Years ago as this Examinant hath been often times informed and which information he knows to be true because he hath inspected the Register of Marriages kept by the Minister of the said Parish; Says the Said William Reeves before his said intermarried and whilst he was a Single Man hired himself to this Examinant as a Yearly Servant at the Yearly Wages of Twenty Pounds diet and Lodging and lived with this Examinant in Old Fish Street in the Parish of St. Nicholas Coleabbey in the City of London for Nine Months and then intermarried as is abovementioned, and continued to live under the same hiring with this Examinant about Six Months after the said Marriage making in the whole about fifteen Months Says the said William Reeves never rented a house of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds or paid Taxes to this Examinants knowledge and belief

Mary Smith aged about 36 Years upon Oath, says she never was Married, says her father John Smith Rented and lived in a house in St. Martins Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of Thirty Pounds in which he carried on the business of a Glazier for several Years, and there dyed and further upon her Oath says that she this Examinant never Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes, was an Apprentice, or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year,

Ann Hill wife of George Hill on the behalf of Ann Betson an Infant aged about Seven Years Upon Oath says the said Ann Betson is the Daughter of this Examinant by Robert Betson her late Husband deceased; says the said Robert Betson Rented and lived in a house in John Street Golden Square in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of of Fifteen Pounds for five Years or thereabouts and after he quitted said house never Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Taxes

William Robinson aged about 33 Years Upon Oath says he served three Years & upwards the last part of his Apprenticeship with Mr. Vincent a baker in New Street Square , Shoe Lane in the Parish of St. Bridget alias St. Bride 's London and never rented House paid Taxes or lived a Yearly hired Servant for one Year.

Elizabeth Lowen aged about 66 Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of William Lowen who has been dead about twenty four Years; says she has been informed and which information she verily believes to be true, the said William Lowen Rented a house of Ten Pounds by the Year in Bennets Court in the Strand in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . and lived in the same upwards of one Year and that her said late husband after he quitted that house nor she since his Death never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or otherwise gained a Settlement in any other Place to this Examinants knowledge and belief.

Lettitia Fisher aged about 18 Years Upon Oath says she never was Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Reynolds a Broker the corner of Dean Street in the Parish of St. Anne in the Liberty of Westmr ; for one Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted said Service about Ten Months & hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes

Benjamin Pack aged about fifty Years upon Oath says he intermarried with Mary his Wife in the Parish Church of St. Martin in the fields about Seven Years ago, says that by Indenture bearing date the 17th, day of March 1731-2 he was bound Apprentice for Seven Years to James Smith an Engraver in the Parish of St. George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex , served about two Years of his said Apprenticeship and then his Master removed to St. Clements Dane & afterwards was Arrested and sent to the Fleet Prison, after his said Master came out of the said prison he resided in Middle row in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the said County of Middlesex where he continued till the Expiration of the abovementioned Indenture of Apprenticeship and this Examinant further upon his Oath says that he continued to work for his said Master during the said Term of Seven Years and with the consent of his said Master laid the last twelve Months of his said Apprenticeship at the house of this Examinants Father in Fleet Street in the Parish of St. Dunstan in the West London ;

Anthony Armstrong aged upwards of 70 Years upon Oath say he rented a house in Falconbridge Court in the Parish of St. Anne in the Liberty of Westminster for Three Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of fourteen Pounds quitted same about Twenty Years ago, and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Dorothy Denevett aged about 28 Years upon Oath says she never was Married nor Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes, was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year; says she has been informed and which information she verily believes to be true that her Father John Denevett lived in and Rented a House in Fleet Market (known by the Sign of the Harrow) in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn London of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and upwards and the died.

Mary Slater aged upwards of Fifty Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Peter Slater who has been dead upwards of Ten Years, says Her said husband informed her & which information she verily believes to be true that he was bound an Apprentice for Seven Years to Mr. Cerson a Cabinet maker on Clerkenwell Green in the Parish of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex and served him three Years & a half the first part of his said Apprenticeship & then his said Master died & never was assigned over to any other person nor Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year, Says she has not since her said husbands death done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement, and that she hath a Daughter by her said late husband (to wit) Eleanor aged about Eighteen Years who never was Married or was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant.

Margaret Davis aged about Seventeen Years upon Oath says, she never was Married, and that she was bound Apprentice by the Churchwardens and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of St. Anne in the Liberty of Westminster by Indenture dated the 3rd, day of November 1762, to James Robinson the corner of Denmark Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex Baker untill she should Attain the Age of Twenty one Years or day of Marriage says she served her said Master from the day of the date of the said Indenture of Apprenticeship untill the Month of January 1766, and that on the 30th day of the said Month of January 1766, she was discharged from her said Apprenticeship by Saunders Welch and Edmund Byron Esqrs. two of his Majesty's Justices of the Peace for the County of Middlesex on the Complaint of the said James Robinson for reasons in the said discharge assigned; and this Examinant further says she hath not been bound Apprentice to any Person Since her discharge from her said Master.

Mary Wheeler aged about 28 Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Thomas Wheeler who has been dead about Nine Months; says her said late Husband was bound an Apprentice by the Churchwardens and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Hornsey in the County of Middlesex by Indenture dated the 15th, day of March 1753, for the term of Seven Years to Nathaniel Pitkin of Highgate in the aforesaid Parish of Hornsey Cordwainer and served his said Apprenticeship with his said Master at Highgate aforesaid & never Rented House or paid Taxes to this Examinants Knowledge or belief, Says she hath not since her said husbands Death Rented house or paid Taxes.

Mary Garman aged about 22 Years Upon Oath says she never was Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Seymour a Maltster in the Parish of Ewell in the County of Surry for one Year & upwards at the Yearly Wages of three Pounds, quitted said Service about three Years & hath not since Rented house paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Bourseau aged upwards of Forty Years, Upon Oath says, she never was Married; and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Captain Stamper near Blackheath in the Parish of East Greenwich in the County of Kent for one Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds, quitted said Service about thirteen Years ago, and hath not since Rented the Yearly Value of Ten Pounds, paid Taxes, or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

George Dishouser Aged abt. Sixty Years Upon Oath Says he Intermarried with Ann his Wife in the Parish Church of St. Katherine by the Tower abt. Thirty Years since Says he Rented a House over against White Chapel Church in the Parish of St. Mary White Chapel in the County of Middx of the Yearly Rent of Eighteen Pounds lived in the same abt. Thirteen Years & hath quitted sd. House abt. Twelve Years and hath not since Rented House or pd. Taxes

Mary Billingsley Aged abt. Fifty Two Years Upon Oath Says She is the Wido . of John Billingsley with whom She Intermarried in May fair Chapel abt. Sixteen Years ago Says her sd. late Husband has been Dead upwards of Four Years and Long before his Death Rented a House in Theobalds Row in the Parish of St. George in Queen Square in the County of Middx & lived in same abt. abt. five Years & never after Rented Ten Pounds a Year or pd. Taxes Says She hath not since the Death of her sd. Husband Rented House or pd. Taxes

George Croft Aged abt. 28 Years upon Oath Says he was bound an Apperntice for Seven Years to Thos. Horn of the Parish of St. George Bloomsbury in the County of Middx Says by & with the Consent of his sd. Master he Served Eight Months & upwards the last part of his sd. Apprentishipp with Mr. Thos. Crutwell periwig maker in the parish of Hamstead in the sd. County of Middx & never Rented House pd. Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servt. for one Year

Mary Toole aged about 38 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Patrick Toole who has been dead about Seventeen Months, says her said husband was a Native of Ireland and never gained a Settlement in England to her knowledge or belief, says before her said Intermarriage she was bound an Apprentice for five Years to Mrs. Ann Padget , Millener in King Street Westminster in the Parish of St. Margaret in the City of Westminster and served four Years and upwards of her said Apprenticeship with the said Mrs. Padget and then intermarried with her said late husband. says she hath not since her said husbands Death rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Taxes, and that on the 1st. day of June 1765 she this Examinant was removed from the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn above the bars in the County of Middx to the aforesaid Parish of St. Margaret against which Order there was no Appeal

Andrew Wills of Fleet Street in the Parish of St. Dunstan in the West London Perukemaker on the behalf of Elizabeth the wife of George Wills Upon Oath says that the said George Wills is this Deponents Brother and is now abroad in the East India Company's Service; Says the Said George Wills Rented a house in Charles Street in the Parish of St. Margaret in the City of Westmr . of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and upwards, lived therein about Two Years and quitted same in January 1756 and hath not since Rented house or paid Taxes to this Examinants knowledge or belief.

Margt. Glass aged upwards of 80 Yrs. Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Charles Glass deceased with whom she intermarried at the Fleet in London on the 23d, day of March 1720; says her said husband was bound an Apprentice to and served seven Years Apprentice -ship with Mr. John Lamb a Shoemaker in Salisbury Street in the Strand in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr. as he hath often times informed her & which information She verily believes to be true; says her said late husband never Rented the Yearly Value of Ten Pounds paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year, to her knowledge and belief, neither hath she this Examinant since the decease of her said husband Rented house paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Cross aged about 32 Years upon Oath Says she is the Wife of George Cross with whom She intermarried in the Parish Church of St. Botolph Aldersgate London about Six Years ago by whom she hath one Child named Amelia aged about 17 Months, says she hath been informed and which information she verily believes to be true that her said husband served Eight Months the last part of his Apprenticeship with Mr. Crutwell a Perukemaker in the Parish of Hampstead in the County of Middlesex and never rented House, paid Taxes, or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Sarah Surbutt aged about 23 Years Upon Oath says, She never was Married, nor ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes, was an Apprentice, or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year says, she has been informed and which information she verily believes to be true that her Father Joseph Surbutt deceased Rented a house in Coffin Court, St. Dunstan's Hill in Tower Street in the Parish of St. Dunstan in the East in the City of London for one Year and upwards of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and Ten Shillings.

William Wapshot aged about 56 Years Upon Oath says, he Rented a house at Turnham Green in the Parish of Chiswick in the County of Middlesex of the Yearly Rent of five Pounds and paid the Poor Rate for the same; lived therein upwards of two Years and quitted same about twenty Years ago and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Jane Walker aged about 70 Years Upon Oath says She is the Widow of William Walker who has been dead about Twenty Years and that she intermarried with her said late Husband in the Parish Church at Kendall in the County of Westmoreland , Says her said husband Rented a house in Long Lane in the Parish of St. Bartholomew the Great in the City of London , of the Yearly Rent of Sixteen Pounds, lived in the same about one Year & paid All Parish Taxes and never after in his life time, nor she this Examinant since his Death Rented House or paid Taxes.

Thomas Rayner one of the Beadles in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster on behalf of Mary Wolf Widow of John Wolf who has been dead near twenty Years as this Deponent hath been informed, Upon Oath says he has made diligent Enquiry concerning the Settlement of the said Mary Wolf and has been-informed and which information he verily believes to be true that the said Mary Wolf lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Ferdinandes a Merchant for one Year and upwards and lived the last Six Months of her said Service with the said Mr. Ferdinandes in Savage Gardens in the Parish of St. Olave in Hart Street Crutched friars in the City of London she being at that time a Widow And hath not since done any Act whereby to gain a Settlement to this Deponents knowledge or belief

Margt. Hammer aged about 62 Years Upon Oath says that being a Widow and without Child or Children she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Stilliard at Brompton in the Parish of Kensington in the County of Middlesex for one Year & upwards at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds, hath quitted said Service about Eleven Years and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Thomas Charlton aged about Twenty Years upon Oath says he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Morris at the Gun Alehouse in St. John Street in the Parish of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex for One whole Year at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds, hath quitted said Service about three Years and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizabeth Brown aged upwards of 50, Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Charles Brown who has been dead about fourteen Years and with whom she intermarried at the Fleet London on the 12th, day of June 1730; says her said husband before his intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a single Man lived a hired Yearly Servant with this Grace the Duke of Somerset at Charing Cross in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr. for two Years or thereabouts but at what Wages she this Examinant cannot tell and never Rented House or paid Taxes; says she hath not since her husbands Death Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Mary Mushat aged about 30 Years Upon Oath says she never was Married, and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Brown a Butcher in Chandos Street in the Parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westmr . for one Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds, quitted said Service about Seven Years ago, and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt, for one Year

Ann Carey aged upwards of 30 Years upon Oath says she never was Married nor ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes, was an Apprentice, or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year; says she has been informed and which information she verily believes to be true, that she was born in Snows fields in the Parish of St. Mary Magdalene at Bermondsey in the County of Surry, and cannot give any Account whatsoever of the Settlement of her Father or Mother

Mary Lowndes aged about 44 Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Samuel Lowndes who has been dead about One Month, says her said Husband Rented a house in Charles Street in the Parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of Forty Pounds, for Eight Years or thereabouts quitted said House about Eighteen Years ago & never after Rented house or paid Taxes.

Sarah Tyler aged abt. 42 Years Upon Oath says, she never was Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Mary Higgins at the St. Lukes head Alehouse in Mercer Street Long A in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster for three Years & upwards at the Yearly Wages of three Pounds quitted said Service about Twenty four Years ago and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Berry aged about 37 Years upon Oath says she never was Married and that on the 18th, day of September 1760, she was delivered of a female bastard Child in the House of Mrs. Best in Wych Street in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster which hath been baptized by the name of Catherine and that on the 17th. day of May 1763, she was delivered of a Male bastard Child in the House of Mr. Chamberlain in St. Clements Lane in the aforementioned Parish of St. Clement Danes which hath been baptized by the Name of John Thomas and that Maynard Grendon who was the reputed Father of both the said bastard Children died about a Month ago-And further upon her Oath says that she this Examinant lived a hired Yearly Servant with Webster Esqr. in Great Marlborough Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster for two Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds, says she served the last nine Months of her said Service with her said Master in Great Marlborough Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr . & hath quitted said Service about Ten Years, and hath not since Rented house, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Mary Nicholls aged about 27 Years Upon Oath says she never was Married, and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with her Uncle Joseph Nicholls at the Black Bull Inn in Grays Inn Lane in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for two Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds, quitted said Service about seven Years and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year.

John Warne of White's Grounds Southwark Currier on behalf of his Brother Joseph Warne aged about Twenty seven Years Upon Oath says the said Joseph Warne was never married and that he lived a Covenant Servant by the Year for one Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds or thereabouts (with dyet and lodging) with Mr. John Homan a Currier in Trotter Alley, Barnaby Street in the Parish of St. Mary Magdalen Bermondsey in the County of Surry, quitted said Service about seven Years and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Mary Garrett aged about 57 Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of John Garrett who has been dead about twenty Years, says her said late husband hath often times informed her and which information she verily believes that he served seven Years Apprenticeship with Mr. Gregory a Bridlecutter and Whip maker in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster and never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year to this Examinants knowledge and belief, says she hath not since the Death of her said late Husband Rented Ten Pounds a year, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Sarah King aged about 30 Years Upon Oath says she was never married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Lord Coote in Church Court Chapel Street in the Parish of St. Margaret in the City of Westminster for One Year & upwards at the Yearly Wages of Four pounds quitted said Service about five Years ago, and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Margaret Wormington aged about 17 Years Upon Oath says she never was Married nor ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year, says her Father Charles Wormington a Breeches maker deceased Rented a house in Bakers Row in the Parish of St. James Clarkenwell in the County of Middlesex , for three Years and upwards at the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds, and after he quitted said house, he removed to another House in the said Parish of the Yearly Rent of Eight Pounds, paid poors Rate for same and there dyed.

Joseph Stevens aged about 74 Years & upwards Upon Oath says he never was married and that he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Rowland Linen draper in Bucklersbury in the Parish of St. Bennet Sherehog in the City of London for One Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds, quitted said Service about six Years ago and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Rebecca Grudgeworthy aged about 36 Years upon Oath says, she is the Widow of Humphry Grudgeworthy who has been dead about twelve Years, says her said Husband Rented a House (known by the Name of the Fountain Tavern ) in Catharine Street of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and upwards and also Rented a private house adjoining the said Tavern in the Parish of St. Mary le Strand in the Liberty of Westmr. of the Yearly Rent of Forty five Pounds or thereabouts for Seven Years , says she hath not since the Death of her said Husband Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Alice Hooper aged about 36 Years upon Oath says she is the Wife of John Hooper (gone from her) with whom she intermarried at the Fleet London about fourteen Years ago, says her said husband is was an Irishman and never gained a Settlement in England to her knowledge or belief; says before her Intermarriage with the said John Hooper and whilst she was a SingleWoman she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Grayham in Tooley Street in the Parish of St. Olave Southwark in the County of Surry for One Year and Upwards at the Yearly Wages of three Pounds,

Alice Hooper aged about 36 Years Upon Oath says she is the wife of John Hooper (gone from her) with whom she intermarried at the Fleet London about fourteen Years ago; says her said husband is an Irishman and never gained a Settlement in England to her knowledge or belief; says before her intermarriage with the said John Hooper and whilst she was a Single woman she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Grayham in Tooley Street in the Parish of St. John Southwark in the County of Surry for One Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of three Pounds

Catherine Willett aged about 22 Years Upon Oath says she never was married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Welborn in Rathbone Place in the Parish of St. Mary le Bone in the County of Middlesex for two Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds Quitted said Service about five Years ago and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

John Robins aged about 47 Years Upon Oath says, he intermarried with Elizabeth his Wife at the fleet London about twenty Years ago; says he was bound an Apprentice for Seven Years to Mr. Wm: Altham a Nail founder in Winchester Court Cripplegate with whom he served three Years or thereabouts the first part of his said Apprenticeship and then was Assigned over to one Mr. Bignall a Nail founder in Parker's Lane in the Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex and continued to serve the said Mr. Bignall in Parker's Lane aforesaid until the Expiration of the said Indenture of Apprenticeship-says he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Mary Bottomly aged about 40 Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of John Bottomly who has been dead upwards of fifteen Years, says her said husband served seven Years Apprenticeship with Mr. Young a Taylor in Gloucester Street near Queen Square in the Parish of St. George the Martyr in the County of Middlesex and never Rented House or paid Taxes, as she has been informed by her said late husband, and verily believes; says she hath not since her said late Husband's decease Rented House, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Alice Thompson lodging at the Ship Alehouse at Fleet Ditch London on behalf of John Thompson an Infant aged about Six Weeks Son of Willm. Thompson by Martha his Wife who died on Friday the 27th, day of February 1767, Upon Oath says the said William Thompson is the Son of this Deponent and that he was bound an Apprentice for Seven Years to Mr. Sutton a Stationer in Barbican in the Parish of St. Giles Cripplegate London and served four Years or thereabouts the first part of his said Apprenticeship & then went to Sea and never was Assigned over to any Person nor ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year to this Deponents knowledge or belief.

Mary Fleming aged about 66 Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Francis Fleming who has been dead about 30 Years, says her said Husband rented a house in St. John's Lane in the Parish of St. Sepulchre in the County of Middx , for one Year and Upwards at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds or thereabouts and there died says she hath not since the Death of her said Late husband Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes, or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Elizth. Wadesell aged about 49 Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Jno. Wadesell who has been dead about Twelve Years, says her said husband Rented a house in Heathcock Court in the Strand in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds, lived therein about six Months and there died; says she hath not since the Death of her said late husband Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Catherine Purcell aged upwards of Twenty Years upon Oath says she never was Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Royer a Perukemaker in Bull and Mouth Street in the Parish of St. Anne and Agnes Aldersgate London for 3 Years at the Yearly Wages of £3 for the first Year £3..10..0 for the Second Year and £4 for the third Year, quitted said Service about One Year and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year.

Sarah Kent aged about 53 Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Henry Kent who has been dead about Twenty Years; Says that being a Widow and without Child or Children, she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Parker in Church Entry near Shoemaker Row in the Parish of Saint Anne Blackfryars London for two Years, or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds quitted said Service about seven Years ago, and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year.

James Bond one of the Beadles of the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middlesex on the behalf of Hannah Sawyer an Infant aged about Ten Years and Elizabeth Sawyer an Infant aged about Eight Years the Children of William Sawyer by Hannah his Wife deceased, Upon Oath says, he this Deponent as been informed and which information he verily believes to be true that the said William Sawyer Rented and occupied two Houses in Chick Lane in the Liberty of Saffron hill Hatton Garden and Ely Rents in the County of Middx the one of the Yearly Rent of Twenty five Pounds the other of the Yearly Rent of Sixteen Pounds, for the space of Ten Months or thereabouts and quitted the said houses about the Month of April 1766 and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Taxes to this Deponents knowledge and as he verily believes.

Eleanor London aged about 46 years upon Oath says she is the Wife of John London with whom she intermarried in May fair Chapel about Twenty Years ago by whom she has One Child named Eleanor aged about Sixteen Years. says her said Husband Rented a house in Charles Court in the Strand in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster for one Year and upwards at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds quitted said House about sixteen Years ago, and hath not since Rented House or paid Taxes

Mary Rainsford aged about 65 Years Upon Oath says, she is the Wife of Robert Rainsford with whom she intermarried at the Fleet London about thirty six years ago; says her said Husband served seven years apprenticeship with Mr. Henry Allen a Waterman at Dartford in the County of Kent and never Rented Ten pounds a year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

John Cross aged about 23 Years Upon Oath says he was bound an Apprentice for Seven Years to Mr. Yardley a Carver & Gilder in Fitches Court Foster Lane in the Parish of St. Olave Silver Street London and served two Years of his said Apprentice- ship and then his said Master died, says he was Assigned over to Mr. Cooper of Fitches Court aforesaid Carver and Gilder and continued with him till the expiration of the said Indenture of Apprenticeship And never Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Elizth: Harvey aged about 27 Years Upon Oath says she never was Married nor ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one year, says she has been informed by her Mother (who is now dead) that she this Examinant was born in Great Swan Alley in St. John Street in the Parish of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex where this Examinants Father Rented & lived in a house but what Rent he paid for same this Examinant never heard.

Elizabeth Leethet Wife of Walter Leethet lodging at Mr. Dorrains in Burleigh Street in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes on behalf of Sarah Mullins an Infant aged about five Years Daughter of Henry Mullins by Sarah his Wife deceased Upon Oath says that she has been informed and which information she verily believes to be true that said Henry Mullins Rented a house in New North Street in the Parish of St. George the Martyr by Queen Square in the County of Middlesex for six Months & upwards at the Yearly Rent of Twenty four Pounds or thereabouts, and hath quitted the same upwards of three Years, since which time the said Henry Mullins hath not Rented Ten Pounds a year or paid Taxes to this deponents knowledge and belief and further upon her Oath says, the said Henry Mullins hath deserted the said Infant whereby she is likely to become chargeable to the said Parish of St. Clement Danes .

Mary Hobbins aged about 30 Years upon Oath says she never was Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Rainsford a Cutter-near Durham Yard in the Strand in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Six Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds quitted said Service about Six Years ago and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Celia Sourey aged about 27 Years upon Oath says she never was Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Bridget Maggot -in Cliffords Inn Passage in the Parish of Saint Dunstan in the West in the City of London for One Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds, quitted said Service about the Month of September or October 1763, and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year And further upon her Oath says that on the 21st, day of August 1764, she was delivered of a female Bastard Child in the house of Mrs. Wright in Ogden Court in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr. which hath since been baptized Anne and that Thomas Mears the reputed Father of the said Child died on the first day of this Instant May.

Sarah Kent aged about 53 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Henry Kent who has been dead about 20 Yrs, says that being a Widow and without Child or Children she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Parker in Church Entry in the Parish of St. Brides London for two Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds quitted said Service about seven Years ago and hath not since Rented house paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for One Year.

Sarah Kent aged about 53 Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Henry Kent who has been dead about twenty Years, says that being a Widow and without Child or Children she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Parker for two Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds says she lived three Months or thereabouts the last part of said Service with the said Mrs. Parker in Naked boy Court Ludgate Hill in the Parish of St. Brides London, quitted said Service about Seven Years ago, and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Sarah Charlton aged about 29 Years upon Oath says she never was Married And that she was bound an Apprentice (untill she should Attain the Age of Twenty one Years or Marriage) to Thomas Terry of the Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex Shoemaker as appears by Indenture dated the 22nd, day of August 1752, says she served three Months and upwards the first part of her said Apprenticeship with the said Thomas Terry in a Cellar under the St. Lukes head in Monmouth Street in the aforesaid Parish of Saint Giles in the fields , and then she this Examinant having frequent disputes with the Wife of the said Thomas Terry was turned out of Doors by her; and after that time never was assigned over to any Person; says she hath not since she attained the age of Twenty one Years, Rented Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes, or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Hooper aged 66 Years upon Oath says she is the widow of William Hooper who has been dead about Twenty six Years; says that being a Widow and without Child or Children she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Perkins in Red lion Square in the Parish of St. George the Martyr by Queen Square in the County of Middlesex for One Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Ten Pounds, Quitted said Service about twelve Years ago and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one year.

Priscilla Gilburn aged about 57 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Jno. Gilburn who has been dead about Twenty five Years; says that being a Widow and without Child or Children, she lived a hired yearly Servant with Dr. Newton in Woods Close in the Parish of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex , for two Years and Upwards at the yearly Wages of five Pounds; quitted said Service about twenty years ago and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year.

Ann Branson aged about 31 Years, Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Joseph Branson with whom she intermarried in the Parish Church of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr. upwards of Twelve Years since and that her said Husband hath been dead about three Months; says she hath one Child by her said late husband (to wit) George aged about Eight Weeks; Says her said Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Single Man lived a hired yearly Servant with the Right Honourable the Earl of Hertford in Lower Grosvenor Street in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the said Liberty of Westminster for four Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of £20 or thereabouts and lodged during that time over his Master's Stables in Brooks's Mews behind the divalling house, and after having served about four Years as aforesaid, intermarried with this Examinant, but continued in the said Earl of Hertford's Service under the same hiring about three Years longer and was discharged in Lower Grosvener Street aforesaid And after he quitted said Service never Rented Ten Pounds a year or paid Taxes

Mary Robinson aged about 28 Years Upon Oath says she is the Wife of John Robinson with whom she intermarried in the Parish Church of St. Andrew Holborn on the 7th, day of June 1760, by whom she hath One Child, William aged about Seven Years; says her said Husband has absconded her, and that he hath of ten times informed her, which information she verily believes to be true that he served Seven Years Apprenticeship with Mr. Granger a Staymaker in Wardour Street in the Parish of St. Jame in the Liberty of Westminster , and never Rented Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year;

Elizabeth Hopkins on behalf of her Son John Hopkins a Lunatick aged about upwards of Twenty Years upon Oath says the said John Hopkins was bound Apprentice by Indenture dated the 12th, day of Novr. 1760, to Henry Taylor of Tottenham Court Road in the County of Middlesex Watch case maker , and that on the 29th, day of June 1764, the said Apprentice was turned over to Henry Billinghurst of Aldersgate Street in the Parish of St. Botolph Aldersgate in the City of London Watch case maker as appears by an Indorsement on the back of the said Indenture of Apprenticeship; and served the said Mr. Billinghurst till about three Months ago, and never was assigned over to any Person afterwards,

Edmund Morgan aged about 66 Years Upon Oath says he intermarried with Sarah his Wife at Shoreditch Church about four Years ago by whom he hath One Male Child aged about one Month as yet unbaptized, says he Rented a House in Dirty Lane Long acre in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Nine Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Thirteen Pounds, Quitted said house about Seventeen Years ago, and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a year or paid parish Taxes.

Danl. Frazier aged about 54 Years upon Oath says he intermarried with Sarah his Wife in the Parish Church of Holy Trinity in Coventry about 34 years ago; says that on the 14th, day of September 1738, the Church Wardens & Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster granted a Certificate under their Hands and Seals acknowledging him this Examinant and his said Wife to be Parishioners legally Settled in the said Parish of St. Martin which said Certificate was directed to the said Parish of Holy Trinity in Coventry; says he hath not since the granting sd. Certificate taken a Lease of a Tenement of Ten Pounds a year or served an Annual Parochial Office.

Thomas Etherington aged about 54 Years Upon Oath says he never was Married and that about seven or eight Years ago, he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Robert Salkield Esqr . in Bell Yard in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex for One Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds and hath not since he quitted said Service Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for One Year

Ann Wait aged abt. 24 Years upon Oath says she never was married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with the Hungarian Ambassador in St. James's Square in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr , for five Years at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds for the three first Years and and Eight Pounds for the Two last Years; quitted said Service about four Years ago and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes, or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One year.

Joseph Dunlop aged about 35 Years Upon Oath says he intermarried with Margaret his present wife in the Parish Church of St. Margaret in the City of Westminster about four Years ago; says that being a Single Man he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Henry Fox Lane Esqr . (now Lord Bingley) in Cavendish Square in the Parish of Saint Mary le bone in the County of Middx, for two years at the Yearly Wages of Thirty five Pounds and continued in said Service about one year after his marriage with his first Wife, and after he quitted said Service never Rented Ten Pounds a year or paid Taxes, says his first Wife has been dead about Six Years, and that from the time of her Death to the time of his Second marriage (being about two Years) he never lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Joseph Dunlop aged about Thirty five years Upon Oath says, that about thirteen Years ago he lived a hired Yearly Servant with George Fox Lane Esqr , (now Lord Bingley) in Cavendish Square in the Parish of St. Mary le bone in the County of Middlesex for near the space of two years at the Yearly Wages of Thirty five Pounds and then intermarried with Ann his first Wife and continued in said Service under the same hiring for one Year or thereabouts after his said Marriage and was discharged his Service in Cavendish Square aforesaid where he resided in the house of the said George Fox Lane Esqr . during the last Six Months of this Examinants Service; says his first Wife Ann hath been dead about Six Years, and that he intermarried with Margaret his present Wife in the Parish Church of St. Margaret Westminster abt. four Years ago; says from the time of his first Wife's Death to the time of his second Marriage he never lived a hired Yearly Servant for One year, and further upon his Oath says he never Rented Ten Pounds a year or paid Taxes

Mary Wright aged about 72 Years Widow of Thomas Wright deceased with whom she intermarried in the Parish of St. Margaret Westminster near fifty years since, says that her said late Husband hath been dead about Twenty six Years and that she can give no account whatever of his Settlement other than he was born some here in Lancashire , says She lived a hired yearly Servant before her intermarriage with Mr. Arnold a Brewer near the Broadway Chapel in the Parish of Saint Margaret Westminster for One Year and upwards at the yearly Wages of Five pounds and hath not since lived in other Service for one year Rented House or paid Taxes.

Susanna Sampson aged about 40 Years upon Oath says she never was married, That She lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. White in that part of Cecil Street in the Strand which is in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of a Year, at the Yearly Wages of Five pounds, and quitted same about Eight Years ago and hath not since lived in any other Service for one Year nor Rented Ten pounds a year or paid Taxes

Mary Jenkins aged about 42 Years upon Oath says She is the Wife of Henry Jenkins gone from her with whom She intermarried in the Chappel at Kentish Town in the Parish of St. Pancras in Middlesex about Seventeen Years ago; Says her said Husband Rented a House in Tooley Street in the Parish of St. Olave Southwark in the County of Surry of the Yearly Rent of Eleven Pounds and Eleven Shillings lived therein about one Year and hath quitted same fourteen Years or thereabouts and hath not since rented House or paid Taxes

Margery Mahon aged about 32 Years Upon Oath says she is the Wife of Patrick Mahon (who hath absconded and left about four Months) with whom she intermarried at the Sardinian Ambassador's Chapel in Duke Street Lincolns Inn Fields about fourteen Years ago, by whom she hath one Child named Winifred aged about Nineteen Months, says her said husband is a Native of Ireland and never gained a Settlemt. in England to this Examinants knowledge & belief says before her intermarriage with the said Patrick Mahon and whilst she was a Single Woman she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Hoy at the Elephant & Castle in Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Martin the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for one Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of five pounds and quitted said Service about five Months before her said Marriage with the said Patrick Mahon
