Mary Broderick aged about 36 Years Upon Oath says, she is the Wife of John Broderick (who hath absconded and left her about five Months) with whom she intermarried in the Parish Church of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster about Eleven Years ago by whom she hath four Children Mary aged upwards of Nine Years Charles aged upwards of Seven Years Eleanor aged upwards of five Years and William aged upwards of two Years; says her said husband is a Native of Ireland and never gained a Settlement in England to this Examinants knowledge and belief Says that before her intermarriage with the said John Broderick and whilst she was a Single Woman she lived a hired yearly Servant with her Uncle Thomas Fielding a Staymaker in Denmark Court in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields aforesaid for one Year and upwards at the yearly Wages of Two pounds Ten Shillings and then intermarried with the said John Broderick .

David Hopkins aged about 58 Years Upon Oath says he Rented a house in Leather Lane in the Liberty of Saffron Hill Hatton Garden and Ely Rents in the County of Middlesex of the Yearly Rent of Eleven Pounds lived therein about three Months and quitted same about Ten Years ago and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or done any Act whereby to gain a subsequent Settlement.

Roger Adams aged upwards of 40 Years Upon Oath says he never was Married and that he lived a hired Yearly Servant at St. Luke's hospital for Lunatics in Moorfields in the Parish of Saint Luke Old Street in the County of Middlesex for two Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Ten Pounds, quitted said Service in the Month of March last and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes.

Ann Ward aged about 50 Years Upon Oath says she is the Wife of Henry Ward with whom she intermarried at the Fleet London about Eighteen Years ago, says her said husband hath ofter times informed her and which information she verily believes to be true that he served two Years and upwards the last part of his Apprentice Ship with Mr. John Winard a Taylor in Saint John's Lane in the Parish of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middx & never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year, And further says that her said Husband is now in the Workhouse of the said Parish of St. James Clerkenwell

Clementina Russell aged about 39 Years upon Oath says she was never Married nor ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year, Paid Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year; says her Father Richard Russell who has been dead about nine Years Rented a House in Smith's Square in the Parish of St. John the Evangelist in the City of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of Twenty four Pounds lived therein about five Years and quitted the same about Twelve Years before his Death and never after Rented a House or paid Taxes

Mary Pond aged about 54 Years upon Oath says she is the Wife of James Pond with whom she intermarried in the Parish Church of Fulham in the County of Middlesex about Eighteen Months ago, says her said Husband hath informed her and which information she verily believes to be true that he served Seven Years Apprenticeship with Mr. John Soper a Lighterman in the Hamlet of Hammersmith in the Parish of Fulham in the County of Middlesex aforesaid where he Rented a Tenement of Four Pounds a Year and hath paid Land Tax for the same; and as she verily believes now Rents a Tenement of Five Pounds a Year in the said Hamlet of Hammersmith and pays the Land Tax for same

Margaret Burgess aged about Thirty two Years Widow of Anthony Burgess who died in the small Pox Hospital about Seven Months ago, by whom she hath one Child now with her (to wit) Anthony aged about Twenty Months, says her said Husband was a Native of Ireland and never gained a Settlement in England to her knowledge or belief says before Her Intermarriage with the said Anthony Burgess and whilst she was a Single Woman she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Stone at the Lyon and Hey, in Thames Street in the Parish of Alhallows Barking London for three Years and Upwards at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds and then intermarried with the said Anthony Burgess

Elizabeth Trinner Aged about Twenty nine Years on behalf of Andrew Breman an Infant aged about Seven Years Son of Andrew Breman by Ann his Wife both deceased, Upon Oath says the said Andrew Breman the Father of the Said Infant was a Dutch man and never gained a Settlement in England to this Examinants knowledge or belief, says the said Andrew Breman the Younger was born in the house of Mr. Goad a Carpenter in Princes Street Plymouth Dock in the Town of Plymouth in the County of Devon

Richard Carrier Aged about Fifty Years upon Oath says he intermarried with Mary his Wife at St. Bride's Church London about Five Years ago, says about Thirty Three Years ago being a Single Man and had never been married, he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. John Stanley Grocer and Confectioner in Ludgate Street in the Parish of St. Martin Ludgate in the City of London for Two Years and Upwards, at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds, and hath not since he quitted said Service Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes or otherwise done any Act whereby to gain a subsequent Settlement

Mary Crossfield aged abt. 19 Years Upon Oath says she never was married and that she was bound an Apprentice by the Churchwardens and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of St. Michael Crooked Lane London to her Uncle Thomas Crossfield a Turner in Rent Street in the Parish of St. George Southwark in the County of Surry and Served about three Years of her said Apprenticeship and then run away from her said Master, and never was Assigned over to any person, or Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Robert Davis Aged about Thirty five Years Upon Oath says he never was married and that he lived a hired Yearly Servant with William Lloyd Esqr . in Bedford Row in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn above the Barrs in the County of Middlesex for Five Years at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds, quitted said Service about Eight years ago, and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a year, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Sarah Scatliff Aged about Twenty nine Years Upon Oath says she is the Wife of James Scatliff gone from her with whom she intermarried at Wapping Old Chapel near Ten Years ago, says her said Husband served about three Years of his Apprenticeship with his Father Samuel Scatliff Optician , the corner of St. Michael's Alley in Cornhill in the Parish of St. Michael Cornhill in the City of London , and then parted by his said Father Consent, says her said Husband never was Assigned over to any Person nor ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes, or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one whole Year to this Examinants knowledge or belief, says she hath two Children by her said Husband (to wit) MariaSelima Aged about Four Years and Martha Aged about One Year and Ten Months, and being poor is not able to maintain herself and Children.

Bathsheba Clark Aged about Forty four Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Thomas Clark , with whom she intermarried at St. Peter's Church at Wisbech in the Isle of Ely in the County of Cambridge upwards of Eleven Years ago, and that her said Husband hath been dead about Eight Years, says her said Husband has often times informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true that he was born at Green Bank in the Parish of St. John Wapping in the County of Middlesex and never Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes, was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year, neither hath she since her said Husbands Death Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Ann Pool Aged about Fifty Years, Upon Oath says she is the Widow of William Pool who has been dead about Twenty Years, and that he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes, was an Apprentice, or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year, says her said husband hath informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true that he was born in King Street in the Parish of St. Margarett in the City of Westminster

Rebecca Dowthwait aged about 42 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of William Dowthwait who has been dead about twelve Years says her said husband served about four Years of his Apprenticeship with John Thomas a Waterman in the Parish of East Greenwich in the County of Kent and Then Went to Sea, says her said Husband returned from Sea after the Seven Years of His Apprenticeship was Expired and Rented a House of Three Pounds a Year in the said Parish of East Greenwich for three Years or thereabouts and paid the Land Tax for the same, says her said late Husband after he quitted said House, never Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Taxes, neither hath she this Examinant since his Death, Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

William Forrester Aged about Fourteen Years Upon Oath says that on or about the Twenty Seventh day of March 1766, he was bound Appren- -tice by the Chapel Wardens of Bridewell Precinct London , to Stephen Frankland of Skinner Street in the Parish of Saint Botolph Bishops -gate London Weaver and served about Twelve Months of his said Apprenticeship , and then his Said Master failed and went away; says he never was Assigned over to any Person nor ever lived a Yearly hired Servant for one Year

Mary Farquhar Aged about Thirty nine Years, Upon Oath says she intermarried with Alexander Farquhar (who is now gone from her) in the Parish Church of Stoke in the County of Southampton about Nine Years ago, says her said Husband was a Native of Ireland and never gained a Settlement in England to her knowledge or belief, says before her intermarriage with the said Alexander Farquhar , (and whilst she was a Singlewoman ) she lived a hired Yearly Servant with John Popham Esquire in Kensington Square Square in the parish of Kensington in the County of Middlesex for Fifteen Months or thereabouts, at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds; Quitted said Service about Eight or Nine Years before her Marriage, and never after Rented Ten pounds a Year, paid Taxes, or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Elizabeth Russell Aged about Twenty Years, Upon Oath says she never was Married, and that she served Three Years or thereabouts the latter Part of her Apprenticeship with Mrs. Bond a Mantua Maker the corner of Allens Court in Leadenhall Street in the Parish of Saint Mary Axe London , and then she and her Mistress parted by Consent this Examinant having then about Six Months of her said Apprenticeship to serve, says she never was Assigned over to any Person, nor ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year, Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Eleanor Norris Aged upwards of Thirty four Years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of John Norris deceased, by whom she hath One Child now with her (to wit) Jane aged near Two Years, says her said Husband in his life time hath of ten times informed her and which information she verily believes to be true, that, before his Marriage and whilst he was a Single Man he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Henry Hyde a Hackney Coach Master in Bond Street in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster for One Year and Upwards but what Yearly Wages this Examinant cannot tell, says she hath not since her said Husbands Death Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Catharine Pallet Aged about Sixty Years, Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Robert Pallet deceased; says that since her said Husbands Death she Rented a House in Crown Court in the Precinct of While Fryars London , at the Yearly Rent of Seven Pounds and paid Parochial Taxes for the same, and after she quitted same, never Rented, House or Paid Taxes

William Walford Aged about Forty five Years, Upon Oath says he intermarried with Dorothy his Wife at the Fleet London about Twenty Years ago, by whom he hath two Children now living (to wit,) Jane Aged about Thirteen Years and William Aged about Nine Years; says he Rented a House in the Great Minories in the Parish of St. Botolph Aldgate London for Seven Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds, quitted same about One Year, and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year or Paid Taxes

James Stone Aged upwards of Forty Years, Upon Oath says he intermarried with Elizabeth his Wife at the Parish Church of Shoreditch in the County of Middlesex about Thirteen Years ago, by whom he hath one Child now living (to wit) James aged about Twelve Years, says that before his intermarriage with his said Wife and whilst he was a single Man he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Thomas Corbett Esqr. who lived in Mildman Street in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn above the Barrs in the County of Middlesex for One Year and Upwards at the Yearly Wages of Thirteen Pounds thirteen Shillings and quitted said service about Fourteen Years ago, says that for Six Months or there abouts the first part of his said Service he this Examinant lodged at the Horse and Groom the bottom of Great James Street Bedford Row in the said Parish of St. Andrew Holborn above the Barrs , and then he travelled with his said Master into the Country, and never afterwards during his said Service continued to lodge in anyone Parish or place for the space of Forty days together, says he was discharged his said Service in Mildman Street aforesaid about a Month after he returned from the Country with his Master And further says that he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes

Margarett Carr Aged about Twenty seven Years, Upon Oath says she never was Married, and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Ferrol Master of the Royal Bagnio in Long Acre in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for one Year and Upwards at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds, quitted said Service about Three Years ago, and hath not since Rented House, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly for one Year

Thomas Peach Aged about Forty two Years, Upon Oath says he served Seven Years Apprenticeship with Mr. Jacob Vale in Major Forbes Passage in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster Brushmaker , and never Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year, says he hath a Child by Sarah his late Wife deceased (to wit) Alice Aged about Ten Years

Sarah Alsop Aged about Twenty Years Upon Oath says she never was Married, nor ever Rented House, paid Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year, Says her Father Thomas Alsop lived in and Rented a House in the Parish of Ashford in the County of Middlesex for several Years but what Yearly Rent he paid for the same this Examinant cannot tell, says that she was Born in the said Parish

Sarah Lambeth Aged about Thirty one Years, Upon Oath says she is the Widow of William Lambeth who has been dead about Four Years; Says her said Husband was bound an Apprentice to Mr. Wm: Robinson of the Inner Temple , Attorney , for Five Years; and after he served Four Years or thereabouts of his said Appren- -ticeship he intermarried with this Examinant, says her said Husband during the time he served said Apprenticeship Boarded and lay in the House of Mr. Peter Ross opposite the Dolphin in Red Lyon Street in the Parish of St. George the Martyr by Queen Square in the County of Middlesex ; Says her said Husband never Rented House or paid Taxes neither hath she since her said Husband's Death Rented House or paid Taxes

Uriah Sims Aged about Thirty one Years, Upon Oath says he intermarried with Mary his Wife (deceased) in the Parish Church of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster about Eight Years ago, by whom he hath three Children now living (to wit) Elizabeth aged about Six Years, James aged about Two Years and Rachel aged about Two Months; Says he served Seven Years Apprentice -ship with Mr. Simon Wass a Painter in Basing Lane in the Parish of St. Mildred in Bread Street in the City of London , and never Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Thomas Aged about Forty three years Upon Oath says she is the Widow of Richard Thomas with whom she intermarried in the Parish Church of Shoreditch about Twenty Years ago, says her said Husband has been dead about Eight Years, and that she hath one Child by her said late Husband now with her, (to wit) Ann aged upwards of Eighteen Years who never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant; Says her said Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship to Mr. Bannister a Stationer in the Strand in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields within the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex and never Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year; neither hath she since her said Husbands Death Rented House, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Schellinger Aged about Twenty seven Years, upon Oath says she intermarried with Edward Schellinger in the Parish Church of Enfield in the County of Middlesex about Nine Years ago; Says her said Husband Rented a House in Grace Church Street in the Parish of St. Peter in Cornhill London, of the Yearly Rent of Forty Pounds, lived therein about a year and half, & Quitted same about Five Years and half ago; Says her said Husband Absconded from her about Five Years and half ago and after he quitted said House in Grace Church aforesaid, never Rented Ten Pounds by the Year or paid Taxes to her knowledge or belief, says since the time her Husband Absconded from her she hath not seen or heard of him, and that about Two years and half ago, she this Examinant Rented and lived in a house of Twenty five Pounds a Year for the space of Two Years the back of St. Clements in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster but without the knowledge, privity consent or any act or Deed whatsoever of the said Edward Schellinger her Husband; She during all the time she Rented said House the back of St. Clements never having seen or heard of her said Husband as aforesaid

Margaret Franks Aged about Thirty two Years, upon Oath says she is the Widow of John Franks who died on the 27th. day of January 1768, with whom she intermarried at the Fleet London on the Sixth of December 1751, and by whom she has three Children now with her (to wit) William Aged Nine Years, Mary aged Five Years, and Margaret aged about One Year and ten Months, Says her said late Husband hath of ten times informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true that before his intermarriage with this Examinant, and whilst he was a single Man he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Chessell Esquire for Two Years or thereabouts but what Wages this Examinant cannot tell and that during her said Husbands Service he lodged with his said Master at the House of Mr. Long a Packer in Kings Arms Yard in the Parish of Saint Stephen Coleman Street in the City of London , Says her said Husband never Rented Ten Pounds Pounds a Year or paid Parish Taxes to this Examinants knowledge or belief

John Whittington Aged about Forty Years, Upon Oath says he intermarried to Isabella his Wife in the Parish Church of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex about a Year and half ago, by whom he hath one Child now living (to wit) John Aged about Six Months; Says he served Seven Years Apprenticeship to Mr. Symmonds in little Russell Street in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster Peruke Maker , and never Rented House or paid Parish Taxes

Mary Osgathorp Aged about Twenty nine Years, upon Oath says she is the Wife of John Osgathorp (gone from her) with whom she intermarried in the Parish Church of Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex upwards of Five Years ago, by whom he hath two Children now living (to wit) Thomas aged Four Years and Eleanor aged about Fourteen Months; Says her said Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship to Mr. John Fillingham a Staymaker in St. Johns Lane in the Parish of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex , and never Rented House or paid Taxes

Mary Clarke Aged about Thirty nine Years, upon Oath says she is the Widow of Vincent Clarke who died on the Ninth of December 1767, by whom she hath Five Children (to wit) John aged Eleven Years, Sarah aged Ten Years, Ann aged Five Years, Vincent aged about Three Years and Francis aged about Fifteen Months; Says her said Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Single Man he lived a hired Yearly Servant with John Pindar Esqr. for the space of about Seven Years and then he intermarried with this Examinant he being still in the same Service and under the same hiring as when he was a Single Man and Continued to live with the said John Pindar Esqr. under the said former hiring and Agreement for the space of Five years and then quitted his said Service which happened about Eight Years ago, says her said Husband during the whole time of his Service always laid in his Master's house, and he lodged and lay the the last Two Months of his said Service in the House of His said Master in Queen Square in the Parish of St. George the Martyr by Queen Square in the County of Middlesex , and then quitted his said Service as aforesaid, says her said late Husband never Rented Ten Pounds a Year, or paid Taxes

Rachel Williams Aged about Fifty seven Years, upon Oath says she is the Widow of William Williams who has been dead about Twenty three Years ago, says that being a Widow and without Child or Children she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Coombe's a Taylor in Wych Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster for One Year and Upwards at the yearly Wages of Six Pounds quitted same about Seventeen Years ago, and never after Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Bridget Rock Aged about Twenty three Years upon Oath says she never was Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Conner in Jackson's Court in the Parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster for One Year and an half at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds, quitted said Service about Five Years ago, and never after Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Jenkins Widow , on the behalf of Francis Jenkins Aged Eleven Years, and Mary Aged Ten Years upon Oath says they are the Children of Francis Jenkins by Susannah his Wife deceased and that the said Francis and Susannah were Married in the Parish Church of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex about Twelve Years ago, as this Examinant hath been informed and which Information she verily believes to be true Says the said Francis Jenkins the Elder (who is gone into the Country) Rented a House in Great Saint Andrews Street in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex of the Yearly Rent of Twenty four Pounds or thereabouts, quitted same about Seven Years ago and never after Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one year

Charles Cooks Aged about Fifty six Years; upon Oath says he intermarried with Phillis his Wife at the Fleet London, about Nineteen Years ago; Says he rented House in Kennington Lane in the Parish of Saint Mary at Lambeth in the County of Surry , of the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds, Quitted said House about Twenty eight Years ago, and hath not since Rented House or paid Taxes

William Johnson Aged About Thirty Years upon Oath Says that about Six Years ago he lived as a Covenant Servant with John Bradshaw a Glazier and Painter at Hide Park Corner in the Parish of St George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Thirty Pounds and upwards and never Since Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Since that time

Francis Bishop of the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the liberty of Westmr on behalf of Elizth Spencer an Infant Aged about fourteen Years upon Oath Says that the said Elizth: Spencer was bound Apprentice by the Church Wardens and Overseers of the Poor of the said Parish of St Clement Danes by Indenture Dated the 24th Day of July One thousand Seven hundred and Sixty Eight to Wm Cleaver of the Parish of St John Wapping in the County of Middx Carpenter untill the sd Elizabeth Spencer Shod Attain her full Age of 21 yrs or Marriage According to the Statue in that Case made and provided as by the said Indentures of Apprenticeship relation being thereunto had may more fully and at large Appear And further Says that the said Elizth. Cleaver never was Assigned Over nor ever gained any other Subsequent Settlement to the Knowledge and belief of this Examinant

Hannah Davis Aged about Sixty Six Years on her Oath Says she never was Married and that she was bound out apprentice to one Mrs. Le Tour a Mantra maker in Saint Martins Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster and Served upwards of Nine Months of her said Apprenticeship and then her said Misstress died Says she never was Assigned over to any other Person nor ever after Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year nor any other ways gained a Settlement in any other Place to her knowledge or belief

Thos. Rogers Aged about 40 Years on his Oath saith he rented a House in Hedge Lane in the Parish of St. Martins in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of Sixteen Pounds and Paid all parish Taxes Due for the Same and lived therein Two Years or thereabout & quitted the Same at Michs. last and hath not since Done Any Act where by to gain a Subsequent Settlement.

Mary Clarke Aged about Thirty Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of John Clarke who has been dead upwards of One Year and an half by whom she has one Child named Mary aged upwards of One Year Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Eagle Court the Corner of Bedford Court in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster of the yearly Rent of fifteen Pounds lived therein about Three years where he died Says she hath not since her said Husbands Death Rented House paid taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

James Haymers Aged about forty Years on his Oath Says he never was married and that he rented and lived in a House in Alehouse Yard in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster for One Year and upwards at the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted same about four Years ago and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Dove Ash aged about Seventy Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Catherine his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Anns so he in the Liberty of Westmr . in the Year One Thousand Seven hundred and Twenty Two but what is become of his said Wife this Examinant Cannot set forth he having parted with her about 30 Years ago Says he served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Reakstrow a Cabinet maker to wit five Years in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields and Two Years the latter Part of his Apprenticeship in Maiden Lane in the Parish of Saint Pauls Covent Garden where his said master removed to And never after Rented House of Ten pounds a year paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year.

Mary Street aged about 21 years on her Oath says she never was married nor ever Rented House or Paid Taxes says she Lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr Stephens a Cheesemonger in East Street in the Parish of Christ Church Spittle Fields in the County of Middlesex for 2 Years at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds hath Quitted her said Service about 6 Months ago Etc hath not since she quitted same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or Lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Crawley Aged about Sixty five Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Patrick Crawley who has been dead about fourteen years says that being a Widow and without Child or Children she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Lewis who kept a Poor Shop in Shug Lane in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr . upwards of Two years at the yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Seven Years and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly servant for one year

Elizth. Maiden Aged about Thirty Three years on her Oath says she never was married nor ever rented House or Paid Taxes Says that she lived a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Rainey a Cabinet maker in Saint Martins Lane in the Parish of Saint Martins in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr. upwards of one year & a half at the yearly wages of seven Pounds hath Quitted her said Service upwards of Four years and a half ago and hath not Since she quitted same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year and further says that on the first day of February 1765 she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in the House of one Mrs. Gillett in Swan Yard Butcher Row in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr. which hath since been baptized by the Name of William and further sayth that one William Richardson a Gentlemans servant (and who now lives an hostler some were in Northamptonshire but at what Place this Examinant cannot set forth) is the father thereof he having had Carnal knowledge of her Body some time in the Month of May 1764 and at Sevl. Different times afterwards at one of which times he got her with Child of the Male Bastard Child of which she was Delivered as aforesaid And that the said William Richardson of no other Person is the True and real Father thereof.

James Barrett Aged about 24 Years on his Oath Says he never was married Says he lived as a hired Yearly Servant in the Capacity of an Under- Butler with the Countess of Suffolk in Savil Row in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster for one Year and an half at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted his said Service upwards of Two years and half ago and after he quitted the same never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Ford of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster Widow on behalf of Mary Grant an Infant Female Bastard Child Aged about Eight Months on her Oath Says that the said Child is deserted by its Mother Mary Johnson as she the said Mary Johnson Informed this Deponent and which Information she verily believes to be true And further says that the said Mary Johnson also Informed her that the said Child was a Bastard and Born in the Hospital in Totenham Court Road in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex And has also often heard the said Mary Johnson say that one John Grant who lately worked at a Timber Yard in Salisbury Court London is the Father of the said Female Bastard Child And this Dept. further says that she knows nothing where either the said John Grant or the said Mary Johnson the reputed Father and Mother now lives or resides

Mary Mould Aged about fifty One Years on her Oath Says she never was married nor ever Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Medhurst formerly a Slop Seller in East Smithfield for Ten Years or upwards and her said Master quitting Business he went to live in Great George Street in the Parish of Saint Margarets Westmr . where this Examinant lived with him upwards of Eleven Months at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds Ten Shillings hath quitted her said Service about Two Years ago and after quitting the same she never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Bottomley Aged about forty Two Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of John Bottomley who has been Dead about Nineteen Years Says her said late Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship with Mr. Young a Taylor in Gloucester Street near Queen Square in the Parish of Saint George the Martyr in the County of Middlesex and never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year neither hath this Examinant since her said Husband Death done Any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Nowel George Van Reder Aged about Eight Six Years on his Oath Says he has been a Widower for many Years And that he Rented and lived in a House in Mark Lane in the Parish of Alhallows Staining in the City of London for one Year and a Quarter at the Yearly Rent of forty Pounds and Paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Thirty five Years Ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Catherine Bamford Aged about Twenty Eight Years on her Oath Says she never was married nor ever Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Harding a Painter in Charles Street the Parish of St. Pauls Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westmr. for Two Years at the Yearly Wages of forty Shillings hath quitted her said Service about Ten Years ago and hath not since quitting the same ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Daniel Hering Aged about 23 Years on his Oath Says he Intermarred with Elizth . his Wife at the Parish Church of St Clements Danes in the County of Middlesex in June last Says that before his sd Intermarriage with his sd wife he served 7 Yrs. Apprenticeship wth. Jonathan Wood a Blacksmith in Newtoners Lane in the Parish of St Giles in the fields in the said County of Middlesex and after he was out of his sd. Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Sarah Simpson Aged about 30 Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of George Simpson gone from her with whom she Intermarried at the Parish of Saint Clement Danes about Seven Years ago by whom she hath Three Children now living Vizt. George aged about Three Years James Aged about Seventeen Months and Sarah Aged about Three Weeks Says her said Husband Served seven Years Apprenticeship with Charles Batchellor a Shagereen Casemaker in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Catherine Bamford Aged about Twenty Eight Years on her Oath Says she never was married nor ever Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Harding a Painter who lived in a House in Charles Street wch. by Act of Parliament belongs to the Parish of St. Mary le Strand in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middlesex for Two Years at the Yearly Wages of forty Shillings hath quitted her sd Service about Ten Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

William Tippett Aged about fifty Six Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Susannah his now Wife at the Parish Church of Saint George in the Borrough of Southwark in the County of Surry about four Years ago Says that before his Intermarriage with his said Wife and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with Eleanor Goodson a Milkwoman for Six Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds Vizt. the first 3 Years in the Parish of St Mary Overs & the last Three Years in the Parish of St. Olave in the said Borough of Southwark in the County of Surry hath quitted his said Service about four Years Ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House or paid Taxes

Ann Hathwell Widow Aged about Seventy Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of John Hathwell who has been dead about Eight Months and with whom she Intermarried at the Fleet London about Thirty Years ago Says that her said late Husband Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one William Taylor a Taylor in Bow Street in the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster as appears by her said Husbands Indentures and as he has often Informed her and which Information she verily bels. to be true and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rent Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Clara Evans Aged about fifty five Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly with one John Felton Esqr . at Knights bridge in the Parish of Kinsington in the County of Middlesex for Two Years and an half at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Thirty Eight Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever rented Ten pounds P Annum paid taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Margaret Maule Aged about Seventy Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Robert Maule who has been dead about Twelve Months and with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St. Botolph Aldersgate about Twenty Eight Years ago Says her said Husband was a Native of Scotland and never gained a Settlement in England to her Knowledge or belief either by renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says that before her said Intermarriage with her said late Husband and whilst she was a Singlewoman she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Ord a Staymaker in Round Court in the Parish of St. Leonard Foster in the Liberty of St. Martin le Grand upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of 28 Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same or since her said Husbands Death ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Elizth Tubb Aged about Thirty five Years on her Oath says she is the Wido. of Jno. Tubb who has been dead about 6 Years with whom she Intermarried at Newington in the Year 1751 says that her said Husband Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Wm. Ryal a Carpenter & Joyner in Chequer Parish above Hill in the City of Lincoln and never gained any other Subsequent Settlement afterwards niether hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death

Elizabeth Malpas Aged about Twenty One Years On her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Ewing a Cabinet maker lately deceased the corner of Durham Yard in the Strand in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Sixteen Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Twelve Months ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Renn Aged about Twenty four Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Saml. Prichard Dealer in Horses at Harrow Wheel Common in the Parish of Harrow on the Hill in the County of Middlesex for fifteen Months at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about five Months ago & hath not since she quitted the same done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

John Mico Chappell on behalf of Wm. Mico Chappell his Son who lays ill upon his Oath saith that his said Son was on the 13th. day of July 1776 bound Apprentice to Thos. Crosby a Chimney Sweeper in Marigold Court in the parish of St. Martin in the fields for Nine years that his said Son served 3 years of his said Apprenticeship or thereabout that then h went away to Sea whereby he has done no Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Cole Aged upwards of Seventy one Years on her Oath Says She is the Widow of William Cole who has been dead about Twenty three Years and by Whom she hath no Children now Living says that after her said husbands death she rented and lived in a house in Portugal Street in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes lb/>in the liberty of Westminster upwards of Three Years at the Yearly rent of forty Pounds and Paid all Taxes due for the same till the time that she was burnt thereout which is upwards of thirteen Years ago since which time she hath never rented house paid Taxes lived a hired Yearly Servant or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement.

Susannah Cox Aged about Twenty Six years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired yearly Servant with Richard Down Esqr a Banker in Thread needle Street who soon afterwards removed and lived on Fish Street Hill , afterwards in Lombard Street and last in Bartholomew Lane in the Parish of Saint Bartholomew near the Royal Exchange where this Examinant lived the last Six Months in all about three years hath quitted her said service about Seven Months ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year And further on her Voluntary Oath says that on the 19th day of August last she was delivered of a female Bastard Child in the House of Mr Warmington in Little Shire Lane in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster which has since been Baptized Ann and that one Thomas Wakeman a Servant to her said late Master is the father thereof he having had Carnal Knowledge of her Body in her said Master house about the Middle of November last but the Particular Day she does not now remember and one other time afterwards at one of which times he got her with Child of the female Bastard Child of which she was so delivered as aforesaid and that the said Thomas Wakeman and no other Person did beget the same and that he is the real and true father thereof

Rebecca Whalley Aged about Thirty One years on her Oath Says she never was Married Rented or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Rowland Jones an Attorney in Hamil Street Hyde Park Corner in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex for fifteen Months or thereabouts at the yearly Wages of Twenty Pounds being in the Capacity of a Wett Nurse hath quitted her said Service upwards of Two years and an half ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year or otherwise gained any or Subsequent Settlement

Mary Powell aged abt. Nineteen Years upon hath Says She never was Married, Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Parish Taxes, was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father Jonathan Powell Rented a House of Twenty Six Pounds a Year in New Round Court in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster and paid all Parish Taxes lived therein upwards of Eighteen Years & hath quitted the same about Six Months Since which time he hath not Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or Served any Parochial Office to this Examinants knowledge or belief.

James Pilsley aged about 42 years upon his Oath saith that about Three years ago he took the lower part of a house in the Str and adjoining Somerset house of one Robert Black for Three Months that he was to pay the said Robert Black the sum of Sixty Pounds for the said Three Months and that he lodged at the same Time at Mr. Whitemans the London Punch house on Ludgate Hill in the Parish of saint Brides alias Bridget in the City of London for which Lodging he paid the yearly Rent of Twenty pounds that he hath quitted said apartments upwards of Two years since which time he has not rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or done any Act to the best of this Examinants Knowledge Information or belief to gain a Subsequent Settlement

James Allen of Vere Street Clare Market Glazier on behalf of Carolina Mountague an Infant Maketh Oath and saith that he has been informed which Information he verily believes to be true that she was born a Bastard in the Parish of Saint mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex for and that she never was bound an Apprentice lived as a hired yearly servant for one year or done any Act to gain a Subsequent settlement to the best of this Examinants knowledge Information or belief

Alexander Daniel aged 58 years or thereabouts upon his hath Saith That he this Examinant Rented and lived in apartments in Eagle street in the saint of saint andrew Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for upwards of 12 Months at the yearly rent of £10:10 - that he quitted the same upwards of 20 years ago since which time he this Examinant hath nor to the best of his knowledge information or belief gained any subsequent Settlement

Ann Wright Wife of John Wright of Haughton Street Clare Market maketh Oath and saith that she hath a Daughter named Sarah (by her said Husband) who is aged near 20 years and is now every weak and infirm And saith that her said Daughter Sarah Wright hath never been married and about five years ago she lived an hired yearly Servant with Mr Edward Jones at No. 4 in Pitt Street Tottenham Court Road in the Parish of Saint Pancras in the County of Middlesex for upwards of two years together at Fifty Shillings a year Wages And since she quitted that Service she hath never lived an hired Yearly Servant for one whole year together having for the greatest part of the time at Intervals been very infirm and disabled and mostly supported by this Examinants said Husband and hath done not Act which could acquire a Settlement subsequent to her Service with the said Mr. Jones in Pitt Street aforesaid to her this Examinants Knowledge or Belief.

Sarah Ward aged 27 years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that she was Married to Arthur Ward her now Husband who is now in Newgate under Sentence of Transportation at the Parish Church of Saint Giles Cripplegate above four years ago by Limm that her said Husband has informed this Examinant that his Parish in Saint Giles Cripplegate aforesaid and that he is legally setled then by Virtue of his father having served an Apprenticeship to Malson or Cabinet maker at Barbican in the said Parish and this Examinant believes her said Husband has never gained any other Settlement Saith that she has one Child now living by her said Husband namely Ann Ward aged 15 Months and that she is poor and unable to maintain herself and said Child

Frederick Edward Rickets aged about 25 years upon his Oath saith that about 5 years Ago he Intermarried with Sarah Rebecca his present wife at the Parish Church of Saint Giles in the fields that he hath Two Children living by his said Wife vizt. William aged about Four years and Sarah aged about Three Months That this Examinants father Rented and lived in a House in Kenrietta Street Portman Square in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex for Fourteen years on thereabouts at the yearly Rent of Thirty Six Pounds that he lived with his said Father in the said House till his Intermarriage and that he never did any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement either by Renting House Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year paying Taxes or Serving any Apprenticeship

Nathaniel Searl aged about 34 years upon his Oath saith that about Nine years ago he Intermarried with Jane his present Wife at Bow Church in Cheapside that he has Three Children living vizt. Sarah aged about Five years unprovided for Hannah aged about Three years and George aged about Two years both provided for That he this Examinant Rented and lived in a House on the New Wharf in the Precinct of White Fryars in the City of London for about Twelve Months at the yearly Rent of Thirty Pounds that he hath quitted said House about Twelve Months since Which time he has not Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Barnes Aged about 24 Years on her Oath Says she never was Married Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr Thos Greenwood a Drugist On Ludgate Hill in the Parish of St Martin Ludgate London upward of one Year and a half at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath Quitted her said Service about Two Years Ago & hath not Since she Quitted the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year or otherwise Gained any Subsequent Settlement

Prudence Ross Aged about Sixty five Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of John Ross who has been Dead upwards of Twenty five Years ago and by whom she had no Children then living Says that being a Widow and without Childr or Children she lived a Hired Yearly Servant with one Mr Thos Lewis an Apothecary on Ludgate Hill in the Parish of St Bridget otherwise St Bride London upwards of Two Years & an half at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Twenty Years ago and hath not since she Quitted the same ever rented house paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Mary Aycock Aged about 64 Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of Wm Aycock who has been dead about 4 Years says her late Husband Rented and lived in a House in Ashen Tree Court in the Precinct of White Fryers for 4 Years or thereabout at the Yearly Rent of 5 Pounds & was Rated to and Paid all Parish Taxes due for the same has quitted the same about four Years

Moses Wagstaffe Aged about fifty three Years on his Oath says he intermarried to Elizabeth his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Sepulchre London about Twenty One Years Ago and by whom he hath One Child now living Namely Thomas Aged nine Years and he further saith that he served seven Years Apprenticeship to one Mr Alexander Pay an Glover in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the City and Liberty of Westminster and County of Middlesex and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he has never rented House paid Taxes or done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

John Rofe Aged about forty two Years on his Oath Says he was bound an Apprentice to & Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with One Wm Jabes a Sawyer in Alphabet Court Stanhope Street in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the liberty of Westminster and soon after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he Intermarried with Elizabeth his now wife at St John Chappel in the Precinct of the Savoy in the Year 1755 and by whom he hath three Children now Living Namely John Aged about Eighteen Years (now Provided for) Pellajah aged about Seven Years & Wm George Aged about Nine Ten Months says about Seven Years ago he went and resided in the Parish of St Mary Le Bone otherwise Mary bone and rented a Part of a Sawyers Yard thereof One Isaac Newton a Carpenter at the Yearly Rent of fourteen Pounds for five Months or thereabouts Payable Quarterly And also Rented Appartments in the house of Mr Gwadkins in Castle Street in the said Parish of St Mary Le Bone for Three Months at the Yearly Rent of Eight Pounds And Quitted the same about Seven Years ago since which time he never Rented House paid Taxes or otherwise Gained any Subsequent Settlement

Martha Thornton Aged about 30 Years on her Oath Says she never was Married, Rented House, or paid Taxes, says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Barnes at the sign of the Kings Arms the Corner of Sidneys Alley near Princes Street Leicester fields in the Parish of St Anns Soho in the Liberty of Westminster for fourteen Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of five pounds hath Quitted her said Service upwards of four Years ago & hath not since she Quitted the same ever rented house paid Taxes or done any other act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement, And further on her Voluntary Oath says that on the 10th day of June 1774 she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in Wych Alley Wych Street which has since been baptized by the Name of James . And further says that one James Lacey a Shoemaker who lately lived with this Examinant in Wych Alley aforesaid had Carnal Knowledge of her Body on the 21st day of August 1773 and has ever since Cohabited with him, and that the said James Lacey and no other Person did beget the same & that he is the real and true father thereof.

Sarah Starling Aged about Twenty Eight Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of William Starling (gone from her) with whom she intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the field in the Liberty of Westminster about Ten Years ago, and by whom she hath Three Children now living viz: Isabella aged about nine Years, Archibald aged about four Years and James Aged about Eighteen Months, says her said Husband was bound an Apprentice to one Christian Lahn a Taylor in the Parish of Clapham in the County of Surry and served the said Christian Lahn for five Years and and Upwards who Assigned him over to one Mr. Henry Desterberg a Taylor in Cecil Court in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster and served the said Mr. Henry Desterberg two Years the latter part of his said Apprenticeship , and after her said husband was out of his said Apprenticeship he has never Rented house paid Taxes lived a hired Yearly Servant or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement.

Ann Jones , Aged upwards of Sixty Six Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Daniel Jones who has been dead about Seven Years and by whom she has one Daughter named Phoebe who is provided for, Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Bishopgate Street within in the Parish of Saint Ethelburga in the City of London at the Yearly Rent of Thirty Pounds a Year and paid all parish Taxes due for the same for upwards of Three Years, and further says that her said Husband died in the Workhouse of the said Parish of Saint Ethelburga , & that since her said Husbands Death she had never rented house paid Taxes lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year or done any other Act whereby to gain any Subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Wood Aged about Thirty Six Years on behalf of Ann Meadows her Female Bastard Chid on her Oath Says that Michael Charles who was the Father of the said Child is gone to Ireland but whether living or dead she does not know Says that the said Ann Meadows the Infant is upwards of Seven Years of Age and was born in the House of One Andrew Thomas a Shoemaker within Two Doors of White Hart Yard Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster & County of Middlesex and that the said Ann Meadows her Child hath gained no Settlement other than by Birth.

Ann Pearce Aged about Thirty Five Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Leach a Butcher in Saint James's Markett in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of four pounds Ten Shillings hath quitted her said Service upwards of Nine Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Marriage Renting House paying taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Hughes Aged upwards of fifty Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of William Hughes who died about Eighteen Years ago and by whom she hath no Children now living Says that being a Widow and without Child or Children living she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Breanton a Widow Lady in the Capacity of a Cook in Charlott Street Rath bone Place in the Parish of St. Pancras in the County of Middlesex for One Year at the Yearly Wages of Ten Guineas hath quitted her said Service about Two Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Mary Eyres Aged about Forty three Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of Christr. Eyres who died about five Weeks ago and with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Stephen Coleman Street about Eighteen Years ago and by whom she hath four Children now living Namely Samuel aged about Eleven Years, William aged about Ten, Years, Mary aged about Six Years, and Christr . aged about five Years, Says her said late Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Harrington a Fishmonger in Salisbury Court Fleet Street in the Parish of Saint Brides als Bridgett in the City of London and after he was out of his said apprenticeship he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Mary Emerson Aged about Forty Two Years on her Oath says she Intermarried to her late Husband John Emerson at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes upwards of Twenty Year ago and by whom she hath Two Children namely Sarah Aged about Twenty Years now provided for and John Aged about Eleven years now in St. Clement Charity School Says her said late Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship to one John Pitts a Staymaker in Newgate Street in the Parish of Christ Church London and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained anyother Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of Ten pounds P Annum or otherwise howsoever with hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death

Martha Miles Aged about 45 Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Hartley at the Bedford Head in Southampton Street Covent Garden in the Parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the County of Middlesex for Sixteen Months at the Yearly Wages of £7. hath Quitted her said Service upwards of 11 years ago and after Quitting her said Service she never afterwards gained anyother Settlemt. or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for one year.

Sarah Richards Aged about Thirty Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Richard Richards who is now in the Workhouse belonging to the Parish of St. Margarett Westmr together with her Three Children Says she married to her said Husband at the Parish Church of Shoreditch about Thirteen Years ago Says her said Husband Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Lawson a Shoemaker in Tothill Street in the Parish of St. Margaret Westminster and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any other Settlement either by Renting House Tenemt. or Lodging of Ten Pounds a Year or otherwise howsoever

Elizth. Oram Aged about Thirty three years on her Oath says she Intermarried to her late Husband deceased at the Parish Church of Hendon in the County of Middx about Eight years ago and who died about Six Months ago by she hath two Children living namely John by a former Husband and Amelia by her late husband Says her said Husband served seven years Apprenticeship to one Mr. Evans an Apothecary at Knights bridge in the Parish of St. Margts- Westmr. and after he was out of his sd. Apprenticeship he never gained any or Subsequent Settlemt. And further says that her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House at Milbank in the afsd. Parish of St. Margarets Westmr. for sevl. years at the yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds and Rented same to the time of his Death further says that this Examinant never gained any or. Subsequent Settlement since her said Husbands Death orwise than as aforesaid

William Sargarson Aged about Twenty five Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried to Mary his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holborn about four Years ago and by whom he hath Two Children living Namely Mary Aged about Three Years and George Aged about Nine Weeks Says his Father William Sargarson has Rented Two Several Houses in Kensington in the Parish of St. Mary Abbotts Kensington in the sd County of Middlesex for sevl. Years last past at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds or upwards And further Says he never in his Own Right gained any other Settlement than as aforesd. he having never Rented House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a Year or otherwise howsoever.

Elizabeth Winbolt Aged about Twenty Five Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says her Father John Winbolt Rented and lived in a House next Door to the Golden Key in Tenter Alley little Moor Fields in the Parish of St. Giles Cripplegate without but within the Freedom of the City of London for several Years and where this Examinant was born as her Uncle Thos. Fountain has often Informed her and which this Examinant verily believes & can give no further or other Account of her Settlement than as afsd.

Ann Street Aged about Twenty Nine Year on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Nichols a Dancing Master in the Old Change Cheap side in the parish of St. Faiths London upwards of Three Years at the Yearly Wages of Six Guineas hath quitted her said Service about Six Weeks ago since which time she hath gained no other Settlement and further says that on the 11th. day of August last she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in the House of Wm. Clarke in Milford Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes and is likely to become Chargable to the sd. last mentioned Parish and further says that one George Charles Seymour an Apprentice to her sd. late Master is the Father there of he having had Carnal knowledge of her Body in her said Master sometime in the Month of November last but the particular day she does not now remember and at sevl. different times afterwards at one of which times he got her with Child of the Male Bastard Child of which she was so delivered as aforesaid and that the said George Charles Seymour and no other person did beget the some and he is the real & true Father thereof

Sarah Williams Aged about fifty One Years on her Oath says she Intermarried to her late Husband at the Parish of St. Peter Le Poor Bread St . London in the year 1761 and by whom she hath Two Children now provided for, says before she Intermarried to her said late Husband and whilst he was a Single man he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with Messrs. Coleman and Lucas Merchants in Mining Lane in the Parish of St. Dunstans in the East London for three Years at the yearly Wages of Seven pounds hath quited the said Service about 24 years ago and after quiting the same he or ever Rented Rates Tenth:on Lodging of Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or ever gained any other Settlement.

Sarah Fennell upon Oath says she intermarried with her husband Richd. Fennell in the Parish Church of St. James Westmr. in the Month of September 1749. says her said husbd. is a Soldier in the 2d. Regiment of Foot Guards and is drafted off to the Isle of Wight says he bound himself by Indenture for 4 Years to Thos. Pickle the corner of Maggots Court in Piccadilly in the Parish of St. James Westmr. Brazier and lived with him during all that time and had meat drink washing and Lodging & hath not since Rented ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year says she has two Childn. by him Elizth : aged Seven Years and Richd . aged abt. Eight Months

Henry Read aged abt. 60 Years upon Oath says he Rented a house in Johnson's Court Charing Cross in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr. of the Yearly Rent of Sixteen Pounds or thereabts. lived in said house about One Year & hath quitted it abt. fifteen Years: Since which time he hath not Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Parish Taxes or otherwise done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Minors aged about 40 Years upon Oath says she is the Wife of Edward Minors (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the Fleet London about fifteen Years ago by whom she hath four Children now with her (to wit) Thomas aged about Ten Years James aged about five Years Ann aged about Two Years and Edward aged about Six Weeks, says her said Husband informed her and which information she verily believes to be true that he never Rented Ten pounds by the Year nor paid Taxes nor was an Apprentice or a Yearly hired Servant for one Year says her said husband has also informed her that he was born near the Market House in the Parish of Campden near Broadway in the County of Gloucester where his Father Rented a house and carried on the Business of a Perukemaker for upwards of Thirty Years

Ann Day Aged about Thirty Six Years on her Oath says she never was Married nor ever Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with with on Richard Sankey Esqr . at the Parish of Camberwell in the County of Surry for four Years at the Yearly Wages of Three pounds for the first Year and so on till five Pounds a Year hath quitted her said Service about fourteen Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House or paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year And further upon her Oath Says that on the 25th. day of Novr. 1765 she was delivered of a Female Bastard Child in the Great Almoney in the Parish of St. Margarets Westmr . which hath since been baptized Mary Whitling and that Thos. Whitling who has been Dead this Three Years was the Father of the sd. Female Bastard Child of which she was delivered as aforesaid

Janet Cartwright Singlewoman upon her Oath saith that she never was married, that she never lived as an hired Yearly Servant for one Year or ever to the best of her Knowledge acquired a legal Settlement in her own Right and that Thomas Durham of Cockspur Street Bookseller is as this Deponent believes her father she this Examinant being an Illegitimate Child of the said Thomas Durham as he has informed her and she believes and further this Examinant saith She has been informed by the said Thomas Durham that she was born in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes And this Examinant also further on her Voluntary Oath Saith that she is now pregnant with a Child or Children which is or are likely to be born a Bastard or Bastards and to be chargeable to the said Parish Saint Clement Danes and that George Phillips who is a Surradier in the third Battalion of the first Regiment of foot is the Real and true father of such Child or Children where with she is so pregnant he the said George Phillips having had Carnal Knowledge of this Deponents Body and begotten the same thereon.

Mary Harvey Wife of David Harvey a Soldier now in His Majestys Service but she knows not where maketh Oath and saith that upwards of Eight years ago she was lawfully married to her said Husband David Harvey at the Parish Church of St Martin in the Fields in the County of Middlesex And saith that it appears to her this Examinant by an Indenture of Apprenticeship Dated the tenth Day of October 1754 which is now in her Custody that her said Husband was bound Apprentice to Richard Sheffield of the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields aforesaid in the said County of Middlesex Cordwainer for the Term of Seven Years And saith that she hath been informed by her said Husband and which she verily believes to be true that he did actually live with and duly serve his said Master for the full Term of seven years and he lived all that time with his said Master in New Street in the said Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the said County of Middlesex And since the Expiration of his said Apprenticeship he hath never rented a Tenement or Lodging of so much Rent as Ten Pounds a Year paid any Parish or other Taxes or done any Act Matter or thing whatsoever which could acquire him a Settlement in any Parish or Place

James Talboys one of the Beadles of the above Parish of on behalf Jonathan Woods who is Ill maketh Oath and saith that he has been informed by the said Jonathan Woods which information he believes to be true that the sd. Jonathan Woods is about 16 Years of age and that about 2 Years ago he was bound an Apprentice by Indentures duly executed to one John Nott of Haydon Court in the Parish of Saint James Westminster in the County of Middlesex Hairdresser that when he had served 2 Months with his said Master his sd. Master he quitted his House in Haydon Court aforesaid and that he the said Jonathan Woods hath not since had any Information where his said Master is and that since he hath quitted his sd. Master he has done no Act matter of or Thing whereby he may have gained a Subsequent Settlement

Elizth. Pound Aged about Twenty One Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried with her Husband Edward Pound at the Parish Church of St Martins in the fields in the County of Middlesex the 18th Octr 1773 and who is now in the East Indies says her said Husband lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr Bilson at No 85 in Cannon Street in the Parish of St Swithin London upwards of One Year & an half at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds as she believes hath Quitted his said Service upwards of half a Year Ago & hath not Since he Quitted the same done any other Act Whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlemt

Christian Rankin Aged upwards of fourteen Years on her Oath Says she was bound an Apprentice by the Churchwardens and Overseers of the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex by Indenture bearing Date the Seventh day of October 1772 to one Thomas Blencowe a Glazier the Cornor of Bloomsbury Court in the Parish of Saint Georges Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex untill this Examinant shod accomplish her full Age of Twenty one Years or day of Marriage as she has been Informed and believes and as by the said Indentures of Apprenticeship relation being thereunto had may more fully Appear And further says that she this Examinant never was Assigned over to any other Master or ever gained any or Subsequent Settlement

Hannah Malin Wife of John Malin (gone from her) On her Oath Says she Intermarried with her said Husband at the Parish Church of St. Clement Danes about four Years ago and by whom she hath Two Children now living namely Mary Aged about Two Years and Maria Aged about three Months Says her said Husband Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Purvis a Perukemaker & Hair Dresser in George Yard Lombard Street in the Parish of St. Edmund the King London and after he was out of his said Apprenceship he never Rented House paid Taxes on did any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlemt.

Elizabeth Kendall Aged upwards of 60 Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Robinson a Quilter who lodged with on Mr. Smith a Builder in Durham Yard in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for fifteen Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Twenty Years ago since which time she never Rented House paid Taxes of otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlmt.

Griffith Pritchard aged about 37 Years on his Oath says he never was married rented house or paid Taxes Says he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Thomas Blamier a Chymist on Dowgate Hill in the Parish of St. John the Baptist in the City of London for 2 Years at they yearly Wages of £14..14..0 hath quitted his said Service about 6 Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same over rented house paid taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

T passd. to St. Giles in the fields Sarah Wilkins aged between fifteen and Sixteen Years on her Oath Saith That the never was married that she was bound Apprentice be Indentures duly executed to Mr. Thomas of Queen Street Lincolns Inn Fields in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex about ten Months ago, That she served as such Apprentice to the said Mrs. Thomas in Queen Street aforesaid for about five or Six Months, that she quitted her said Mistress about four Months ago, and since that time has been with her Sister Rachael Williams in Haughton Street Clare Market in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex

passd. to St. Geo: Hanr. Sqr . A Elizabeth Danford Aged about 62 Years on her Oath Saith that she Intermarried to Thomas Danford her late husband deceased at the Parish Church of St. George Hanover Square about thirty three Years ago & by whom she hath for 4 Children Living now provided for Says her said late Husband Bought the Lease of a House in Brook Street in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square aforesaid & which She thinks to be worth Twelve pounds a Year if they had rented it & paid Taxes for the said House for 11 Years or thereabouts hath Quitted her said House about 24 Years ago since which time she never rented House, Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a Year or done any other Act Matter or thing whereby to the Best of this Examinants knowledge Information or Belief she may have gained a Settlement Elsewhere

Jane Evans Aged about Thirty Two Years Wife of John Evans gone from her on behalf of Peter and Fanny Rotchett her Children Vizt. Peter Aged about 11 Years and Fanny Aged about Seven Years by a former Husband upon Oath Says that her said late Husband John Rotchett Father of the said Peter & Fanny Rotchett Rented and lived in a House in Hemmings's Court in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster of the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds and upwards and where the said Peter & Fanny Rotchett were both born and further says that after her said late Husband quitted the said House which is upwards of Ten Years ago he never afterwards Rented House paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Hannah Hart Aged about 64 years on her Oath says she is the Widow of George Hart who has been dead about 11 Years says her said Husband was born in the Parish of St. Pauls Shadwell in the County of Middlesex as her said Husband h often Informed her Etc which Information she verily believes to be true And further says that her said Husband never rented house Paid Taxes was an apprentice or Lived a Hired yearly servant for one year to her knowledge or belief

Hannah Richardson Aged about Thirty four Years on her Oath Saith she never was Married nor ever Rented House or Paid Taxes Says that she lived a Hired Yearly Servant with one Mr: Goodwin a Plumer in Bride's Lane in the Parish of Saint Bride's otherwise Bridget in the City of London for Fourteen Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Six Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year And further Says that on the thirteenth day of June 1766 she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in the House of one Mrs: Winter in Clements Lane in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster which hath since been Baptized by the Name of Frederick William And further Says that one William Massey a Watch Spring Maker (and who now lives as this Examinant believes in or about London but at what Place this Examinant cannot Set forth) is the Father thereof he having had Carnal knowledge of her Body sometime in the Month of September 1765 and at several different times afterwards at one of which times he got her with Child of the Male Bastard Child of which she was delivered as aforesaid And that the said William Massey and no other person is the true and real Father thereof

Mary Bakewell Aged about Thirty Six Years on her Oath Says she never was married nor ever Rented House or paid Taxes, Says she lived a Hired Yearly Servant with Doctor Twells the Corner of Queens Court Great Queen Street Lincolns Inn Fields in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex for Ten Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Five pounds hath quitted her said Service about Two Years & hath not since she quitted her said last Service ever Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

John Harvey Aged about fifty Seven Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Mary his late Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Austin London about Seventeen Years ago and who has been dead about fifteen Years Says he last Rented and lived in a House in the Parish of Saint Mary at Lambeth in the County of Surry for Two Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about five Years ago and after quitting the same he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement.

Martha Smith Aged about Sixty Two Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of John Smith who has been dead about Seven Years Says that being a Widow she rented and lived in a House at Knights Bridge in the Parish of Saint Margarets in the Liberty of Westminster for Two Years and upwards at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds hath quitted same about Three Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented Ten pounds a Year Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Elizabeth Gates Aged about forty Seven Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Wm. Gates who has been Dead about fifteen Years ago Says that being a Widow and without Child or Children she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Thos. Brake Esqr . in Mansel Street Street in the Parish of Saint Mary Whitechapel in the County of Middlesex for five Years at the Yearly Wages of Ten pounds hath quitted her said Service about Ten Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Sarah Godfrey aged 21 Years upon her Oath saith That she Never was Married That she was bound Apprentice to Mr Murphy a Milk Man in Crown Court Russell Street in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the County of Middlesex for the Term of seven Years that she served 3 Years of her time and was then discharged from her said Master by Order of the Magistrates about 5 Years ago since which time she hath done No Act Matter or thing to the best of her knowledge to gain Any other settlement

Isabella Heyman aged about 27 Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of David Starlece Heyman who has deserted her and with whom she Intermarrd. at the parish Church of Saint Andrew Holborn in the Year 1773 and by whom she hath no Children living Says her said husband Rented and lived in a house in Gunpowder Alley in the parish of Saint Bridget otherwise Saint Brides London of the Yearly Rent of Eleven pounds lived therein about six Months and paid Rent due for the same but whole any Taxes this Examinant cannot setforth hath quitted the said house about four Years ago since which time her said husband never rented house or Tenemt- of Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or orwise howsoever wise gained any other subseqt Settlement

Elizth. Barrett Aged about fifty Eight Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Richard Barrett gon from her, with whom she Intermarried in the House of Mrs. in Berry Street St James's by a Romish Priest Says her sd Husband was an Irishman & never ganed a Settlement in England ether by renting house paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year having always worked Chair work till the time he left her says that before her sd Intermaridg with her sd. Husband she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Crockford a Haberdasher in Pall Mall in the Parish of St James's in the Liberty of Westmr . for Six Years at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds hath quitted her sd Service about Twenty five Years ago & hath not since she quitted the same ever done Any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement
