Mary Davey Aged about Thirty One Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of John Davey with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St. Dunstans in the West about Three Years ago and by whom she hath Two Children now living Namely Mary Aged about Two Years and Elizabeth Aged about five Months Says that her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Chichesters Rents Chancery Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex for Nine Months at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds hath quitted the same about Ten Months Ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House or Paid Taxes

Thomas Pritchard aged seventy two Years a thereabouts upon his Oath saith, that he never rented any House or Tenement of the Yearly Value of ten Pounds, paid Taxes, lived for one Year as an hired Servant, served as an Apprentice, or did any Act, Matter or thing whereby to gain any Settlement in his own Right That his father Robert Pritchard in his Lifetime rented and lived in a House and Long Lane in the Parish of Saint Bartholomew the Great in the City of London and lived there for about five Years, that his Father bought the Lease of the said House, and it up himself, that after quitting the same House his said Father in his life time never did any Act whereby to this Examinants Knowledge Information or belief she gained any subsequent settlement that this Examinant lived with his father as part of his family in Long Lane , aforesaid has received a Weekly allowance from the said Parish of Saint Bartholomew the Great in the City of London aforesaid for sometime then he was out of Work and that he is now poor and cannot get Employment to maintain himself and is under the Necessity of becoming Chargeable to the Parish

Mary Peat Widow aged 41 years on thereabouts upon her Oath Saith that since her Husbands death and being Single and unmarried She has lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr. Thomas Gearl a Sugar Baker in Saint Bennetts Hill in the Parish of Saint Bennett in the City of London for fifteen Months that she quitted her Place about four Years ago and since quitting same has not gained any other or Subsequent Settlement

Lydia Allen aged thirty one Years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that she was married to Francis Allen her present Husband at the Parish of Wilmington in the County of Kent about thirteen Years ago by Licence and that since there Intermarriage her said Husband until and lived in a House Queens Row Portwell in the Parish of Saint Mary at Lambeth in the County of Surry at the yearly Rent of Fourteen Guineas for about ten Weeks, that they quitt Amls House about Six Months age and since then have not to the best of this Examinants Knowledge done any Act whereby to gain Subsequent Settlement, And further this Examinant Saith that her said Husband is now dangerously ill at this Lodging in Lych Street in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes , and that she this Examinant upon and unable to maintain her said Husband-And this Examinant further that she has three Children by her said Husband Vizt. Thomas aged Eleven Eleven years or thereabouts, John aged Six years or thereabouts and Lydia , aged two three years thereabouts and this Examinant Saith that her said for House hath never acquired any Settlement in his own right

Wm- Nurse Overseer of the Poor of the Parish of St- Clement Danes and Elizth. Cornwall Wife of Jno. Cornwall jointly and severally make Oath and say that first this Examinant on her Oath says that she is about 40 Years of Age and that she is the Wife of John Cornwall (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St- Faith London about 12 Years ago and by whom she hath one Child living Named John aged about four Years as she believes And this Examinant William Nurse on his Oath says that Jno. Cornwall husband of the other Examinant now Rents and lives in a House in the Parish of St- Peters in Colchester in the County of Essex of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds or upwards and has lived therein about two Months as he has been credibly informed and verily believes

Sarah Wood Aged about Eighteen Years on behalf of her Father John Wood who now lies ill in the Workhouse belonging to the Parish of Saint Clement Danes on her Oath Says that her said Father Rented and lived in a House in Sharratt Street Golden Square in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of four Years at the Yearly Rent of Seventeen Pounds and Paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House as she believes about Nine Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

John Herbert aged about Thirty Nine years on his Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says her lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Lilley a Silver Smith in Saint John Street in the Parish of Saint Sepulcre without in the County of Middlesex upwards of one year and a half at the Yearly Wages of 4 Pounds hath quitted the said Service near Eighteen years ago Since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired yearly Servant for one year

Charlotte Read Aged about Thirty Seven years on her Oath says she is the Wife of John Read gone to Sea with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St. James Westminster about Twelve years ago and by whom she hath one Child now living Named Ann Aged about Ten years Says her said Husband Rented & lived in a House in Langley Street Long Acre in the Parish of St. Martin in the Field in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of one year at the yearly Rent of £16 paid Parish Taxes due for the same since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement other by Renting House or Tenement of £10 a year or Otherwise Howsoever

Jane Slingsby aged about 31 Years upon her Voluntary Oath says she never was Married that on the 22d, day of September 1765 she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in the house of Mr. Darby in Grange Court in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr. which hath since been baptized Thomas ; says that Thomas Essex Coachman to the Earl of Macclesfield in Harley Street Cavendish Square had carnal knowledge of her body the beginning of January 1765, & at sevl. other times afterwards at one of which times he got her with Child of the Male Bastard Child of which she was delivered as aforesaid and that the said Thomas Essex and no other person is the true and real Father thereof

Mary Perry Aged about Thirty Years, Upon Oath says she never was Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Largent at the Three Tunns Eating House in Fleet Street in the Parish of St. Dunstan in the West London for One Year and Upwards at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds, quitted same about Eight or Nine Years ago, and never after Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year And further upon her Oath says that on the Sixth day of October 1764, she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in Cow Cross in the Parish of St. Sepulchre in the County of Middlesex , which hath been baptized by the Name of John , and that on the Tenth day of April, 1768, she was delivered of a Female Bastard Child in Sawyers Yard in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr. within the County of Middlesex , which hath been baptized by the Name of Anne , Says that Robert Bryan who is the Reputed Father of the said Children is gone to the East Indies in the service of the East India Company, And she being Poor is not able to maintain herself and Children

Martha Drover aged about 37 Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of John Drover who has been dead about Eight Months & by whom she hath five Children now living namely Mary Aged 13 Years Wm. Aged 9 Years Elizth Aged 8 Years & Geo Aged 5 Yrs. and Sarah Aged about 3 Years Says that her said late Husband Rented & lived in a House known by the Name or Sign of the Fountain in Clave Street in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster for 2 Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of £34. hath quitted the same about 2 Years ago & after quitting the same he never Rented £18. P Year or Paid Taxes Says that since her said Husbands Death & having a Family of Children had some thoughts of taking a House to teach School and to let the same out in Lodgings in Order the better to suport herself & Family Accordingly this Examinant hearing of one at Chelsea Applyed to one Mr. Hales the Landlord thereof but this Examinant being a Widow & a Family of Children the said Mr. as she Acts did not & have to let the same to her unless some Person wod Pass his Word for the Accordingly this Examinant Applyed to an Acquaintance one Mr. Vigures who took the said House for her at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Eight Pounds and belives his name is rated in the Parish Books belonging to the Parish of St. Geo. Hanover Square not withstanding which this Examinant letts the sd House out in Lodgings and receives Rent for the same and does now as she always did pay Rent for the sd House and looks upon herself lyable & bound to pay for the same Not withstanding the Landlord gives recipts in the sd. Mr. Vigures Name

Mary Jupp Aged about fifty Three Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried with her late Husband John Jupp at the Fleet London in the Year 1774 and by whom she hath no Children now living Says her said late Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Thomas Perry a Cooper the Corner of Poland Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr . and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House or Tenement or orwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death

Ann Price Aged about 23 years on her Oath says she never was married nor ever rented House or Paid Taxes says she lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mary Turton who keeps the Red Lyon and French Horn in Red Lyon Street in the Par of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex upwards of one year Etc half at the yearly Wages of £4. hath Quitted her sd. Service about 4 years and hath not since she quitted Same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired year for one year

William Woodley Widower Aged abt. 55 Yrs. Upon Oath saith that he Married his late Wife Ann Formerly Ann Calter Spinster at the parish Church of Saint James Westminster about 23 years ago (be Quence) that he hath a Son & Daughter his only Children by his said Wife now living the Youngest of which is thirteen Years Old or thereabouts & with Mr. Wheeler Glover, in Church Court Strand who maintains her: that the Son is provided for having Served his Apprenticeship in Kent Street Southwark : That this Deponent said Wife Died about two years & an half ago that previous to his paid Marriage & while he was single and unmarried & not having any Child or Children he lived as an hired Yearly Servant with Willm. Matty a Coach master at the Kings Arms in Fulham in the parish of Fulham in the County of Middlesex for two years upwards at the Annual Wages of £5. that he quitted his said Master's Service about 30 Years ago & about Six Months afterwards returned to his said Master & continued with him us a Weekly Servant till his Decease being about two years And this Deponent saith that since leaving the said Mr Maltby as aforesaid he hath never obtained any other legal Settlement by any means whatever

Isabella Welbank aged 48 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes that she lived with Antony James in Bell Yard as a Yearly hired Servant for 2 years or thereabouts at the yearly Wages of 6 Guineas She has quitted said service about 7 years ago since which time she has not lived as a Yearly hired Servant for one year or done any Act Matter or thing whereby she may have gained a Subsequent Settlement

Joseph Monk Aged about Nineteen Years on his Oath says he never was married nor ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Taxes Says he was bound an Apprentice by the Churchwardens and Overseers of Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr to John Jones of Grosvenors Mews a Hackney Coachman in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex and served four Years and an half the first part of his Apprenticeship and then his said Master died since which time he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Joseph Baker aged 37 Years and upwards upon his Oath Saith that he was intermarried with Margt. Baker his present Wife at the Parish Church of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster by Bans that him and his said Wife since their intermarriage (that is to say) abt. 2 years ago they Rented and Lived took and Rented a house in No. 1 in Lees Mews North Audley Street in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex and lived there upwards of One Year at the Yearly Rent of £15 that since they left the said House they have been in Weekley Lodgings and have never since Rented any Tenemt. or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or lived a the that he never lived as a hired Yearly Servant for One Year nor has done any other Act matter or thing whereby he might have gained any other subsequent settlement to the best of this Examinants knowledge information or belief that he & is said Wife is poor and the

Sarah Caton Singlewoman aged 27 Years or thereabouts Upon her Oath Saith that she never was Married That she lived as an hired hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Simmonds No. 25 Poppins Court Fleet Street in the parish of Saint Brides otherwise Bridget in the City of London for 2 years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of 6 Guineas That she quitted said Service abt. 7 Years ago and hath not obtained any Subsequent Settlement to the best of this Examinants knowledge information a belaf belief and this Deponent further upon her Oath Saith that on the 29th. day of July last she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child at the Navy Coffee House in New Castle Street in the sd parish of Saint Clement Danes which Male Bastard Child is now in the Workhouse of the said parish and further Saith that One John Perry a Coach Painter who Worked for Mr. Ken Campbell a Coachmaker in Long Acre as a Journeyman, is the Father of the said Child he having had Carnal Knowledge of this Examinants Body some time in or about the Month of October last and at several times since at One of which times he did beget the said Child and that the said John Perry and no One else is the Real and true Father thereof,

William Shepherd Aged about Thirty Nine years on his Oath Says he never was married Rented House paid Taxes or ever served any Apprenticeship Says he lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Robinson a Confectioner in New Bond Street (in a Capacity of a Coachman ) in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westmr . in the County of Middlesex for Two years and a Quarter at the yearly Wages of Ten pounds hath quitted his said Service about Eleven years ago since which time he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year or orwise gained any other subsequent Settlement.

Mary Page aged about Twenty Seven Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried with Francis Page her Husband (gone from her) at the Parish Church of St. Temple in Bristol about Seven Years ago and by whom she hath one Child now living Namely Ann Aged about Six Years, Says her said Husband Served five Years the first part of his Apprenticeship with one Francis Pistila a Painter in Warden Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster who afterwards ran away soon after which his Master dying his Masters Widow delivered her said Husbands Indentures up and further says that her said Husband was never assigned over or ever gained any other Subsequent Settlemt. to her knowledge or belief.

Mary Ward aged Sixty two Years or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith that she is a Widow and that since she has to been a Widow and whilst show as a Single Woman not having any Child or Children she lived as an hired Yearly Servant with Richard Woodham at Cliffords Inn Coffee House in the Parish of Saint Dunstan in the west in the City of London for upwards of one Year at the Wages of Seven Pounds a Year and when Mr. Woodhouse quitted the said Coffee House she continued at the same Wages with his face for Mr. Eales for about a Year and an half that she quitted the said Mr. Gale is Service about two Years ago and hath not since done any hit whereby to gain any other Settlement or the best knows and believes

John Jenkins aged about Thirty Years on his Oath says he Intermarried with Ann his Wife in the Parish Church of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster about Three Years ago Says that before his said Intermarriage and whilst he was a Single Man he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Berry who keeps the Queens head Tavern in Holbourn in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn in the County of Middlesex upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted his said Service about five years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizabeth Campbell aged thirty four Years or thereabouts, upon her Oath saith That she lived as an hired Yearly Servant with William Rous , a Grocer at the Corner of Wimpole, and Wigmore Street in the Parish of Saint Mary le bone in the County of Middlesex for upwards of twelve Months that she quitted his Service about Eight Years ago, that since quitting such Service she has not lived in any other Service for twelve Months nor done any Act whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have acquired any other Settlement

Elizabeth Hide aged 17 Years or thereabout upon her Oath saith That she never was Married Rented a House or Lodging or ever paid Taxes of lived as an Fined yearly servant saith that she bound Apprentice to one Bedward of Brick Lane in the Parish of St Christ Church Spitalfields in the 6 of night by the Church Wardens and Overseers of the Poor of St. Sepulchres in the City of London untill she shod. attain her age of 21 Years or day of Marriage according to Act of Parliament Days that she lived under such Indenture for the space of One year or thereabouts and left her said Masters Service which was about Christmas last days she never gained any Subsequent Settlemt. to the brt of her Knowledge or Belief

Mary Vincent Wife of John Vincent of New Inn Passage in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex Taylor on behalf of Hugh Ward a Child aged Eighteen Months or thereabout on her Oath saith that Sarah Watts this Examinants Sister who is the Mother of the said Hugh Ward informed this Examinant that the said Hugh Ward was born in Oxford Road in the Parish of Saint

Marshall of Brownlow Street Holborn in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn in the County of Middlesex Carver and Gilder on the behalf of Sarah Marshall Singlewoman his Sister now in Lodgingsin Bennetts Court Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the said County of Middlesex and so ill that she cannot Attend to be examined upon his Oath saith that ceted for rly ig Settlement in her own Right Saith that John Marshall their Father is dead that in his Life time he rented and lived in a House in Knightsbridge in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex at the yearly rent of £10 and upwards and paid Taxes for the same for upwards of years and after he quitted such House till the time of his Death did not nor did Sarah Marshall this Examinants Mother who Survived the said John Marshall her Husband but is since dead nor either of them Rent any other Tenement of Ten Pounds Value Per Annum or pay any Taxes

Mary Vincent Wife of John Vincent of New Tom Passage in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex Taylor on behalf of Hugh Ward a Child aged Eighteen Months or thereabout on her Oath saith that Sarah Watts this Examinants Sister who is the Mother of the said Hugh Ward informed this Examinant that the said Hugh Ward was born in Oxford Road in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex

Alexr. Marshall of Brownlow Street Holborn in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn in the County of Middlesex Carver and Gilder on the behalf of Sarah Marshall Singlewoman his Sister now in Lodging in Bennetts Court Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the said County of Middlesex and so ill that she cannott Attend to be examined upon his Oath saith that the said Sarah Marshall never was Married Rented House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes for any such was bound an Apprentice lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or did any other Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of this Deponents Knowledge Information or belief she may have Acquired any Settlement in her own Right Saith that John Marshall their Father is dead that in his life time he Rented and lived in a House in Knightsbridge in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex at the yearly rent of £10 and upwards and paid Taxes for the same for upwards of years and after he quitted such House till the time of his Death did not nor did Sarah Marshall this Examinants Mother who Survived the said John Marshall her Husband but is since dead nor either of them Rent any other Tenement of Ten Pounds Value Per Annum or pay any Taxes Taxes or do any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of this Deponents Knowledge Information or belief they or either of them may have gained any other Settlement than in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square as above Stated

A Passd. to St. Pancras William Buckingham aged 43 Years or thereabouts upon his Oath saith That he was Married to Ann his late wife at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex upwards of Seventeen years ago. That he hath five Children living by said wife Namely Ann aged 36 years or thereabouts William aged 15 Years or thereabouts who are now both Provided for and Sarah aged 12 years or thereabouts Elizabeth aged 11 years or thereabouts and Benjamin aged 9 years or thereabouts. who are now in the Workhouse belonging to the Parish of Saint Pancras That his said Wife departed this Life about 3 Years and a half ago. That since their Intermarriage They rented and lived in a House in George Street Battle Bridge in the Parish of Saint Pancras in the County of Middlesex for about 3 Years at the Yearly rent of Eleven Pounds four Shillings that They quitted then said House about above 10 Years ago since which time he this Examinant hath not any done any Act Matter or Thing whereby the best of her his knowledge Information or belief he may have gained a Subsequent Settlemt.

Margarett Ashburn aged 15 years or thereabout upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House Lodging paid Taxes or ever lived as a hired yearly Servant Saith that she was bound Apprentice to one Alexr. Biggs of Newington Green in the Parish of Saint Mary at Newington in the County of Middx Baker and Chandler by the Churchwardens and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of St. Clement Danes untill she should Attain her Age of 21 years or day of Marriage according to Act of Parliament Says that she lived under such Indre for the space of Six Months or thereabouts and left her said Masters Service on Sunday last Says she never gained any Subsequent Settlement to the best of her knowledge or belief

Margarett Ashburn aged 15 years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House Lodging paid Taxes or ever lived as a hired yearly Servant Saith that she was bound Apprentice to one Alexr. Elizabeth Hide Aged 17 years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that She never was Married Rented a House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year or unr paid Taxes or Lived as an Hired Yearly Servant Saith That She was Bound Apprentice to One Bedward of Brick Lane in the Parish of Saint Matthew Bethnal Green in the County of Middlesex by the Churchwarden and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Saint Sepulchre in the City of London until She should Attain her Aged Twenty One Years or Day of Marriage according to the Act of Parliament Saith that She Lived under such Indenture for the Space of one year or thereabout and left her said Masters Service about Christmas last saith that She never gained any Settlement elswhere to the best of her knowledge Information or belief

William Bayly aged twenty six Years or thereabouts upon his Oath saith That that he intermarried with Mary Bayly his new Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Leonard Shoreditch about Six Years and an half ago, that he has only one Child now living by his Said Wife Vizt. William aged four Years or thereabouts, And this Examinant further Saith That he was bound an Apprentice to one William Mifflin of Shoe Lane in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn in the City of London Sawyer , by Indentures duly executed that he served about two Years and three Quarters of the said Apprenticeship and then the said Indentures were given up that for some time Previous to his Quitting his said Master he was allowd Board Wages and the he worked with his said Master in the Day time Lodgd elsewhere and that the last Place in which he lodgd for the space of forty Days together before he quitted his said Masters Service upon the Indentures being given up as afore- said was in Church Street Coverleads Fields in the Hamlet of Mile End New Town in the Parish of Saint Dunstan at Stepul otherwise Stebbun Heath , And this Exami- nant further also saith that since her with his said Master Service he has not done Any Act Matter or Thing whereby to the best of his Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained any other Settlement

Elizth. Faithfull aged about 36 years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Wm. Sowster of Roe Hampton Surry in the Parish of Putney for 15 Months & upwards at the yearly Wages of Eight Pounds hath quitted said Service about 8 years since which time She has gained no other Settlement than as aforesaid Says that she has one Child living named Robert aged upwards of Seven years born a Bastard in the House of one Mr. Browning a Publican in Hart Street Covent Garden in the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden in the County of Middlesex And further says that her said Child never gained any other Settlement than by Birth

John Cooper aged about 42 years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Mary his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Leonard Shoreditch -about 18 Months ago and by whom he has no Children living that he has two one Children living by his late Wife Ann vizt. Cooper Served Seven Years Apprenticeship to one John Dorrill a Taylor in Feathers Court Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Margt Le Strand in the Liberty of Westmr and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never done any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of this Deponents Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained a Settlement elsewhere nor hath this Examinant than as aforesaid

John Cooper aged about 42 years on his Oath Saith that he never Rented any House or Tenement of the yearly Value of Ten Pounds paid Taxes lived as an hired yearly Servant for the Space of One year Served as an Apprentice for the space of 40 Days or did any other Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of his Knowledge Information or belief he may have ever gained a Settlement in his own Right And this Examinant further saith That his Father Wm Cooper is dead that his said Father in his Life time served an Apprenticeship of Seven Years under Indentures of Apprenticeship duly Executed to John Dorrill a Taylor in Feathers Court Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Strand in the County of Middlesex and after serving his said Apprentice till the time of his Death never did any other Act Matter or thing whereby to gain any Subsequent Settlement And this Examinant further saith That he was married to Ann his late Wife now deceased at the Parish Church of Saint Geo: the Martyx Queen Square in the County of Middlesex about twelve years ago that he has one Child living vizt Samuel by his said late Wife vizt. Samuel aged Eight years or thereabouts who has never been absent from this Examinant or gained any Settlement in his own right Saith That he was married to Mary his now Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Leonard Shoreditch about Eighteen Months ago and that he is poor and Sick and unable to maintain himself Wife & Child

Vide or side John Myers aged about 74 years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Sarah his late Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the fields in the County of Middlesex upwards of 27 years ago That he hath no Child or Children living That his said Wife departed this Life about 20 years ago That before his Intermarriage he lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Dodd a Dry Salter and Oilman on Dowgate Hill in the Parish of Saint Anthonys outgarly called Saint Antholins in the City of London for upwards of Six years at the yearly Wages of Ten Pounds hath quitted said Service upwards of 30 years ago since which time he has done no Act Matter or Thing whereby to the best of his Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

John Myers aged about 74 years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Sarah his late Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the fields in the County of Middlesex upwards of 27 years ago That he hath no Child or Children living That his said Wife departed this Life about 20 years ago That before his Intermarriage he lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Dodd a Dry Salter and Oilman on Dowgate Hill in the Parish of Saint John the Baptist in the City of London for upwards of Six years at the yearly wages of Ten Pounds hath quitted said Service upwards of 30 years since which time he has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of his Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Mary Rooke aged about 43 years on her Oath says she Intermarried to John Rook at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes about 20 years ago that her Husband lived with Mr Turning of Devereux Court as a Porter and rented a House in Essex Street at £30 Pounds a year and kept same for five years That after her Husband died she kept it 12 Months That she went to Islington and lodged there about a year then went to Needle Work then went to live with Mr. Meriton the Coal Merchant at Islington in the Parish of Saint Mary at Islington in the Co. of Middx as Ladys Maid They agreed to make it as good as Eight Pounds a year to her she stayed there about 15 Months and she received to the Amount of Eight Pounds a year that since she quitted said Service she has not rented Ten Pounds a year lived Twelve Months in Service done any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained Settlement elsewhere

Cath: Doyle behalf of Jeremiah Bryan aged about 9 years on her Oath says that Wm. Catherine Pritchard aged Thirty years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith That she never was married Saith that on or about the 29th. day of May 1784 she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child (since which Christened by the name of John Currer ) at the House of a Mr. Banks a Broker in Rose Lane Spital Fields in the Parish of Christ Church Spital Fields in the County of Middlesex and that John Currer of High Street White Chapple Sadler is the Father of such Child and this Examinant further saith that the Child now Produced by her at the time of her swearing to this Examination is the Child of which she was so delivered as aforesaid

Passd. to St. George Hanover Square Lydia Woodrow aged about Thirty Seven years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Edward Richardson of Chelsea in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex for 12 Months and upwards at the yearly Wages of Six Guineas hath quitted said Service about five years ago since which time she has done no Act Matter or thing to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Hester Pulley aged about 19 years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House paid Taxes ever lived as an hired yearly Servant or ever served an Apprenticeship says that Esther Pulley her late Mother Whilst she was a Widow Rented and lived in a House in Russell Street Covent Garden in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster for five years at the yearly Rent to Twenty Pound hath quitted said House about two years ago and never in her Life time to this Examinants Knowledged gained any settlement and this Examinant hath and since her said Mother Death since which time the Examinant hath gained any other Settlement than as aforesaid

Passd. to St. Pancras James Talboy some of tho Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex, and William Buckingham aged between Fourteen and Fifteen Years or thereabouts upon their Oaths severall say and first this Examinant James Talboy s for himself Saith That he has been informed by William Buckingham the Father of William Buckingham the other Examinant in this Examination mentioned that the said William Buckingham the father some time ago rented and lived in a House in George Street Battle Bridge in the Parish of Saint Pancras in the County of Middlesex for about three Years at the Yearly Rent of Eleven Pounds four Shillings, that he quitted the said House about ten Years ago, and since that time her not rented any other House or Tenement of the Yearly Value of ten Pounds or done any other Act, Matter or Thing whereby to the best of the said William Buckingham (the Father) Knowledge Information or Belief he may have gained or acquired any other subsequent settlement Rent this Examinant William Buckingham (thereon) for himself saith that he Recollects his father living at Battle Bridge as aforesaid, that he this Examinant has never lived as an hired Yearly servant for one Year, served any Apprenticeship or done any Act Matter or Thing Whereby to the best of his Knowledge Information or belief he may have ever gained or acquired any Settlement in his own right.

Elizabeth Grigson aged about 17 years upon her Oath saith that she Intermarried with Benjamin Grigson her Present husband at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holborn in the Month of January last That in the Month of April last she was delivered of a Male Child which has not as yet been baptized at the House of Mr. Healy at No.18 Duke Street Lincolns Inn Fields in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex where her Husband and she rented a Lodging at Nine Shillings Per week for two Months and upwards that her Husband during such Time was Clerk to Wm. Manley Esqr . a Banister at Law in the Inner Temple being an Exparochial Place at a yearly Salary and Perquisites of near or about £100 a year That her Husband has deserted her and her Child That she is unable to maintain herself and Child that she does not know of any other Settlement over Obtained by her said Husband

Passd. to St. Anns Blackfryars Elizabeth Chambers Singlewoman aged Forty four Years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that she never was married saith that she rented and lived in a Tenement Situate in Printing House Yard in the Parish of Saint Chris Blackfryars at the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds for upwards of Forty Days, that she has quitted the same about Six years ago and since quitting the same hath not lived as an hired Yearly servant for one Year served as an Apprentice, rented any other Tenement of the Yearly Value of ten Pounds or done any other Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Informa tion or belief she may have gained any other settlement than the said Parish of Saint Ann Black fryars , by renting and living Such Tenement in Painting House Yard as is above Stated

Mary Brewin aged upwards of Fifteen Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes lived as an hired yearly Servant or ever served any Apprenticeship Says that she was born at the Crown in in the Parish of St Mary Huntingdon in the County of Huntingdon and that she has not done any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her knowledge Information or belief she may have gained a Settlement elswhere

Aaron Lilly aged forty Nine Years or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith That he rented and lived in a House Situate in Peters Lane Cow Crop in the Parish of Saint Sepulchre in their the City of London at a Yearly Rent of upwards of ten Pounds for about half a Year that he quitted the same about Nine Years ago and since that time has not rented any Tenement of the Yearly Value of ten Pounds paid Taxes or done any Act Matter or Thing whereby to the best of his knowledge, Information or belief he may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Susan aged Eleven Years on thereabouts, Indeneas aged Eight Years or thereabouts and William aged seven Years or thereabouts that her said Husband has deserted her and her said Children and that she is Poor and unable to maintain herself and her said Children name of whom have ever gained a Settlement in their own Right

passd. to: Bloomsbury Sarah Babb aged upwds 80 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Crowder of Duke Street Bloomsbury in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex for four years and upwards at the yearly Wages of Five Pounds hath quitted said Service upwards of 30 years since which time she hath done no Act Matter or thing to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief whereby she may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Sarah Wellings aged 72 Years or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith That she was married to John Wellings her now Husband in Rachington in the County of Somerset , that her said Husband is by trade a Shoemaker and served his time as an apprentice to a Shoemaker in the Parish of Saint John the Evangelist in the City of Bristol that the doc it thereof his having ever gained any subsequent settlement and that being poor and in great Distress she has lain about in the open Air in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes for three or four Nights

Richard Blake aged about 51 years on his Oath says he never was married Rented House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year lived as a hired yearly Servant or Served any Apprenticeship Saith that his Mother Rented and Lived in a House in Bangor Court Shoe Lane in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn below the Barrs in the City of London at the yearly which was Rent of Eight Pounds and duly late for and paid Parish Taxes due for the same that his Mother hath quitted said House about 20 years since which time he hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby he may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Sarah Towcester Aged 27 years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith That she never was Married Rented a House or Tenement of £10 a year or ever paid any Taxes Saith That she was Bound an Apprentice to One Silvester Field of Feathers Court Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Mary le Strand in the Co. of Middx Staymaker by the Governors of the Foundling Hospital for the Term of 7 years or Day of Marriage that She Served the said Term of 7 years According to the said Indres of Apprenticeship That since, she hath not done any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or Belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement to the best of her Knowledge and belief and that she is Poor and unable to maintain herself

Susannah Sarjeant aged about 39 years upon her Oath saith that she was married to her late Husband Wm. Ann Matthews aged 47 years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that she intermarried with Henry Matthews her present Husband at the Parish Church of Egham in the County of Surry upwards of 14 years ago by whom she has three Children living vizt. John Livingston aged about 65 years upon his Oath saith that he Intermarried with Martha Livingston his present Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Brides in the City of London upwd. of 7 years ago and by whom he has on Child or Children living Says that he Rented and lived in a House in Poppins Court , Street in the Parish of Saint Brides in the City of London for 4 years and upwards at the yearly Rent of £14 and paid Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about Six years ago since which time he hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the Best of this Deponent Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Elizabeth Thompson aged 20 years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House or Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year says that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Phielling in Charles Street in the Parish of St. Marygate Bone for Six Months and went along with that her said Master to Goodge Street in the Parish of Saint Pancrew and there where this Deponent lived with him for the space of 9 months at the yearly Wages of 5 Pounds hath quitted said How Service about 5 years ago since which time he hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Ann Barrott aged 22 Years or thereabouts was upon her Oath saith That she was Married to Thomas Barrett her now Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the fields that she has two Children living by her said Husband Vizt. Ann Barrett aged 22 Years or thereabouts was upon her Oath saith That she was Married to Thomas Barrett her now Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the fields that she has two Children living by her said Husband Vizt. passd. to St. Martins Mary Cookson aged 23 Years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith That she never was Married Rented a House or paid Taxes or over lived as an hired Yearly Servant Saith That she was bound Apprentice by Indentures duly Executed by of saint to one Alexander Dow of Great May's Buildings Saint Martin's Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the County of Middlesex for the Term of seven Years that she served the whole of her Apprenticeship since which time she this Examinant hath not done any Act whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

passd. with her 2 Childn. to Woolwich Sarah Bayer aged 27 Years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith That she was Married to Andrew Bayer her lathe Husband at the Parish Church of Woolwich in the County of Middlesex Kent upwards of five Years ago that she has 2 Children living by her said Husband Vizt. Mary aged 2 Years or thereabouts and Joseph aged 12 Weeks or thereabouts That her said Husband was a Stand or of Ireland and never gained any Settlement in England to the best of this Examinant Knowledge or belief that her said Husband departed this Life in the Month of May last and this Examinant further saith that before her Intermarriage with the said Andrew Bayer she lived as an hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Alexander Forrestor at Woolwich for upwds. of 2 years at the yearly Wages of £8 that she quitted her said service at the time of her Marriage and this Examinant saith she hath not done any act to the best of her Knowledge to gain a best subsequent Settlemt.

And further this Examinant when her Oath saith That her father William Phillips and Mary her Mother Mary Phillips were at this Examinant is informed believes Married at the Parish Church of Saint Bride Fleet Street in the City of London about 40 Years ago that she this Examinant was born in Exeter strand in the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden and her said Father was bound by Indenture of Apprenticeship to Thos. Jeffery's of Kirby Street Hatton Garden in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn below the Bars in the City of London for seven Years that he served the whole of his said Tenn with his said Master since which time her said Father hath not done any Act to the best of this Examinants Knowledge or belief to gain any Subsequent Settlemt.

James Talboys one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex When his Oath saith That she has been informed which Information he this Examinant believes to be true that Esther Pulley aged 20 years or thereabouts is the Daughter of George and Esther Pulley who were as this Deponent is informed Married at the Parish Church of Great Ealing in the County of Middlesex upwards of 20 years ago That her Father died abroad & after his Death her Mother Rented & lived in a House in Little Russell Street in the Parish of Saint Clement Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster upwds. of 3 Years at the yearly Rent of £20 & upwards & that her said Mother was passed from the Parish of Saint Clemt. Danes to Saint Martin in the fields afored. abt. a Year & a half ago & died in the Workhouse belonging to the said Parish of Saint Martin in the fields And this Examinant fmr. says that the said Esther hath not accordg to the best of his Death Knowledge or belief gained and Subsequent Settlemt

David Read aged upwds. of 21 years upon his Oath saith that he was bound an apprentice to one James Smith of Peter James Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. that he served his said Master upwds. of 2 years and an half that then his said Master broke & after his quitted said Master he has not been in any Regular employ whereby he may have gained a Settlmt to the best of his Knowledge & belief

Elizabeth Box aged about 21 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Baxter in Arrundell Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes for 18 months at the yearly Wages of Five Pounds hath quitted said Service about two years ago since which time she has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained a Settlement elsewhere Says that she has one Child living named Charlotte Horton aged 17 Months or thereabouts born a Bastard in the House of a Mr. Blencow No. 8 Ratcliff Mount in the Parish of Saint Luke Old Street in the County of Middx , And further says that her said Child never gained any other Settlement than by Birth And this Examinant further saith That she has hired herself as a yearly Servant to a Baker opposite Barnhill Row in Chiswell Street with whom she is to go to live tomorrow night that her said Child has been Christned by the Name of Charlotte Hoghton , is weaned and that she this Examinant wishes to leave same to the Care of the Parish that she may go to her place to which she is hired as aforesaid

James Tall aged thirty five Years or thereabouts upon his Oath saith That he was married to Deborah his now Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Mary Matsellor otherwise Whitechapel in the County of Middlesex in the Month of July about fifteen Years ago, that he has five Children now living (by his said Wife) Vizt. James aged fourteen or thereabouts, who has never gained any Settlement in his own Right and is now with this Examinant Deborah aged thirteen or thereabouts who has never acquired any Settlement in her own Right but is now in Place With a Person in Newcastle Court Butcher Row John aged Nine Years or thereabouts, who has not gained any Settlement in his own Right and now lives with this Examinant, Margaret aged Six Years or thereabouts, and Sarah aged four Years or thereabouts. And this Examinant further Saith that he rented and lived in a House in Petticoat Lane in the Parish of Saint Mary Matsellor otherwise Whitechapel at the Yearly Rent of ten Pounds for between three and four Years, that he quitted the said House about Eight Years ago, and since quitting the same hath not rented any Tenement of the Yearly Value of ten Pounds, paid any Rates or Taxes, served any Parochial Office, or done any Act Matter or King whereby to the last of his Knowledge information or Belief he may have acquired any other Settlement, than in the Parish of Saint Mary Matsellor otherwise Whitechapel as aforesaid that his Wife is came and unable to Work, and he this Examinant is Poor and not able to maintain his said Wife and Children

Elizabeth Dollman aged Twenty six Years or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith that she never was married that she lived as an hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Copley a Taylor in Bolt Court Fleet Street in the Parish of Saint Dunston in the West in the City of London at the Yearly Wages of £6. for the first year & 7 Guas afterwards for the peace of one year and seven Months or thereabouts that she quitted her said Masters Service about three Months ago and has not since then done any act whereby she believes she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

John Close aged about 33 years on his Oath saith that about Nine years ago he Intermarried with Mary Clarke his late wife at the Parish Church of Saint Anns Soho and who has been dead about Six Months by whom he has two Children living Vizt Mary aged about Six years and John aged about Seventeen Months that in the 11th. day of June 1766 he was bound Apprentice for Seven years by Indenture to Richard Carpenter of Coventry Street in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields Cordwainer that he served his said Master under such Indenture Five years or thereabouts and then Run away since which time he has done no Act matter or thing whereby to the best of his Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Hannah Hoare Widow of No. 3 Phenix Alley Long here Maketh Oath and Saith That she has been informed and which Information she this Examinant has reason to belief is true that Ann Walton who is lately deceased was married to Matthew Walton her Husband who now lives at one Sir Thomas Edward 's in Upper Seyment Street at the Parish Church of Saint Ann Soho that she had after he said Marriage two Children Vizt. Matthew now aged fourteen or thereabouts and Grenada aged eight Years or thereabouts that the said Ann Walton lived with her said two Children in Vere Street in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex for about three Months was taken all there and died, that she left her said Children there who are both ill and unable to maintain them and this Examinant further saith that she has been informed and believes that the last legal Settlement of the Said Matthew Walton is in the said Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex

Elizabeth Goddard on behalf of Mary Hague who lays Ill at Mr. Smiths the Wheatcheaf in Clements Lane upon her Oath saith that the said Mary Hague has informed her that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Jones of East Street Red Lyon Square Coal merchant in the Parish of Saint George the Martyr in the County of Middlesex for 18 Months and upwards at the yearly Wages of 6 Guineas hath quitted said Service upwards of four Months ago since which time she has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge this Depts Information or belief she may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Ann Ward aged 35 Years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith That she intermarried with Wm. Ward at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holborn upwards of 12 Years ago That after their Intermarriage they Rented and lived in a House in Chancellor Court Cock Lane in the Parish of Saint Lennard Shoreditch in the County of Middlesex at the Yearly Rent of 9 Guineas & paid Poors Rates & other Taxes for the same that they lived in the said House upwards of 12 Months that her said Husband deserted her about 8 Years ago, & that she never heard of him after and knows not whether he be living or dead And smt. saith that her said Husband he or herself have either of them gained any subsequent Settlement to the best of her Knowledge or belief

William Willows upon his Oath saith that he has been informed which information he believes to be true that Thomas Buck was married to Sarah his first Wife at the Parish Church of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middx about twelve years ago that his said first Wife has been dead about Seven years That he has one Child living by his said first Wife Vizt. Thomas aged Eight years or thereabouts who has never gained any Settlement in his own Right That his said first Wife Sarah died about Seven years ago and this Examinant was further informed by the said Thomas Buck that he was married to Sarah an his Second and present Wife at the said Parish Church of Saint George Hanover Square about Seven years ago by whom he has no Child or Children living that his said Wife is now gone away from him and this Examinant does not know where she now lives and further this Examinant has been informed that whilst the said Thomas Bush was a Singleman unmarried and not having Child or Children living he was hired to Sir Gerrard Vanneck who then lived in Stretton Street Piccadilly in the Parish of St. Geo: Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex at the yearly wages of 18 Pounds for about Three Years that since he quitted the said Sir Gerrard Vannecks Service he has done no Act whereby he may have gained any other Settlement

Mary Johnson Aged 40 years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith That she was married to Richard Johnson her present Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the Fields in the County of Middlesex about Four years ago, That before and after their Intermarriage her said Husband Rented and Lived in a Shop Parlour and Kitchen Part of a House Situate in Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Field in the county of Middlesex aforesaid at the yearly Rent of thirteen pounds for upwards of one Quarter of a year, that they quitted the same about two years ago, and since that time her said Husband has not to her Knowledge done any Act whereby to gain any subsequent Settlement

John Ashton aged 32 years or thereabouts upon his Oath saith That he never was married That he was bound an Apprentice by Indentures duly rented to Mr. John Grace of Russell Court Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the County of Middlesex that he served seven years and upwards, being than his whole time under this Indres that since quitting his said Masters Service he has never done any Act Matter or this whereby to the best of his Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained any other Settlement

Elizabeth Tremlett aged 29 years or thereabouts whom her Oath saith That Henry Simpson and Infant aged 5 Weeks or thereabouts a Bastard was born in the Osle Street in the Parish of Saint Mary le Bone in the County of Middlesex & of whom she is the Mother & that one Henry Simpson who did live with Mr. Pearson of Cooks Court is the father of such Child and that she is Poor and unable to maintain the said Child

Charles Nutting aged 43 years or thereabouts upon his Oath saith That he was bound apprentice to Henry Williams of Islington in the Parish of Saint James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex Baker by Indentures duly Executed for Seven years or and served the under the said Indentures upwards of 4 years, and that his Master then gave him up the remainder of his time, That he has been in the Workhouse in belonging to the said Parish of Saint James in Clerkenwell who and was discharged there from abt. 5 years ago That since serving such apprenticeship he hath not done any Act whereby her may have gained a subsequent Settlemt

Andrew Rooke aged 50 years or thereabouts upon his Oath saith that he never was married to his Present Wife according to the Rites and Ceremonies of the Church of England that he Rented and lived in a House in Strand Lane in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes for 18 Months at the yearly Rent of £16 hath quitted said House about a Twelve month since which time he has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of this Deponents Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained any other Settlement And further this Examinant saith that he has 4 . Illegitimate Children living vizt. Andrew Pearce Rooke aged 10 years or thereabouts who was born in Cross Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster Elizth. Rooke aged 3 years and upwards who was born in St. John Street in the Parish of Saint James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex Mary Rooke aged 2 years and upwards who was born in St. John Street in the said Parish of Saint James Clerkenwell in the County of Middx and Margt. Rooke aged 1 year or thereabout who was born in Strand Lane in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes And further this Deponent saith that he was married to Bridgett Flanagan the Mother of the said Children at the Chapel in Duke Street by a Roman Catholic Priest according to the Rites and Ceremonies of the Romish Church

Daniel Douglass aged about 49 years upon his Oath saith that he Intermarried with Elizth . his present Wife at the Parish Church of St. Luke Old Street upwards of Ten years ago and by whom he hath one Child living vizt. Sholto George aged Seven Months or thereabouts Saith he Rented and lived in a House in Silver Street White Fryars in the Precinct of White Fryars in the City of London at the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds hath quitted said House about 18 years ago since which time he hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of his knowledge Information or belief he may have gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Macdonald aged about 22 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married according by the Rites and Ceremonies of the Church of England, that she never Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or ever served any Apprenticeship Saith that her Father Patrick Macdonald Rented and lived in a House in new Bedford Cowet in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr. at the yearly Rent of £10 and upwds. and paid Taxes due for the same that her Father lived in the sd. House upwds. of Sixteen years that this Ext. has done no Act whereby she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement And further this Ext. saith that she has one Illegitimate Child living vizt. Mary Macdonald aged about 10 Months born in the Workhouse belonging to the said Parish of Saint Martin in the fields And further this Ext. saith that she was married to James Nevill deceased the Father of the said Child at the Chapel in Duke Street by a Roman Catholic Priest according to the Kites and Ceremonies of the Romesh Church

Edward Oldis aged about 51 years upon his Oath saith that he Intermarried with Ann his late Wife at the Parish Church of St. Michael Royal about 18 years ago and who has been dead about a week that he has 4 Children living by his said Wife vizt. Edwd . aged 17 years or thereabouts Provided and Joseph aged 13 years or thereabouts both Provided for Edoth aged about 2 years and a Quarter and Sarah aged abouts a fortnight both unprovided for that he Rented and lived in a House at Kingston in the Parish of Kingston in the County of Surry for 3 years at the yearly Rent of £18 hath quitted same about 13 years ago since which time he hath done no Act Matter or thing to the best of his knowledge Information or belief whereby he may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Elizth. Moore aged 17 years or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith that she never was married Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or served any Apprenticeship Says her Father Thos. Moore Served Seven years Apprenticeship to one Mr. Dodd of Long Acre in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster that after her sd. Father was out of his Apprenticeship he never did any other Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of this Deponents knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any other Settlement

Christian Sheriff aged about 46 years upon her Oath saith that she Intermarried with Thomas Sheriff her now Husband who has deserted her at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holborn about 13 years ago and by whom she hath no Child or Children living That her said Husband served Seven years Apprenticeship to one Ann Gladman who lived at the Corner of the Pea Markett in Leadenhall Street in the Parish of Saint Peters Cornhill in the City of London that after her said Husband was out of his said Apprenticeship he has never done any other Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of this Depts. knowledge Information or belief he may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Thomas Buck aged 38 years or there abouts on his Oath saith that he was married to Ann his late Wife at the Parish Church of Saint George Hanover Square about 10 years ago and hath One Child by her now living vizt. Thomas aged 8 years or thereabouts and that he was married to Sarah his present Wife at the said Parish Church of Saint George Hanover Square about 4 years and an half ago and by whom he hath no Child or Children living and that the last time he heard of her she was in a Salivation in the Workhouse belonging to the said Parish of Saint George Hanover Square and that when he was a Singleman he lived as a hired yearly Servant with Colonel Fitzroy in Stretton Street in the sd. Parish of Saint George Hanover Square for 4 years and upwards and was all the time in the same Street and there discharged and have not since Quitting that Service when Single done any other Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of this Exts. knowledge Information or belief he may have gained any Settlement

Elizabeth Bellows aged 26 Years or thereabout when her Oath Saith That she never was Married Rented a House or paid Taxes over lived as an hired Yearly Servant or ever served as Apprenticeship Saith that her father John Bellows and her Mother Blewitt Bellows were Married at Saint Supulchre in the City of London that her father before his Intermarriage lived with one Mr. Carr of Charter House Square 4 as a lived Yearly Servant in the Parish of Saint Sepulchre in the City of London as a hired Yearly servant for upwards of three Years and Received Wages for the gaine that her said father has been dead Some Years & died in the Workhouse belongg. to the said Parish that she knows not of any Subsequent her father ever gained nor has she this Examinant ever to the best of her knowledge gained any Settlemt in her own Right and that she was pass'd from the Parish of Sr. Siles in the fields in to the said Parish of Saint Sepulchres abr. 4 Years ago

John Jackson aged about 63 years upon his Oath saith that he Rented and lived in a House at Hampstead in the Parish of Saint Johns Hampstead in the County of Middlesex for 14 years at the yearly Rent of Fourteen Pounds hath quitted said House about 20 years ago since which he hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of this Deponents Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Eleanor Parr singlewoman aged thirty Years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that she never was married, rented House or Tenement of the Yearly Value of ten pounds paid Taxes for any such or ever was bound an Apprentice - That she lived as an hired yearly Servant with one Mr Cornish a Printer who lived at the seven Houses Battersea in the Parish of Battersea in the County of Surry - for upwards of one Year at the Yearly Wages of eight Pounds that she quitted the said Mr Cornish's Service about five Years ago, and since that time has not done any thing whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

William Powell aged twenty five Years or thereabouts upon his Oath saith that he never was married that he was hired by one John Thurrock Purser of the Camel of 20 Guns a Ship in the English Service at Little Yorks in Quarries to serve him as his Servant at 30-% a Year Cloaths and Board that he continued Servant to the said Mr. Thurrock under that Agreement for about three Years sometimes on these Board at others on shore in the different Ports the Ship was stationed at that he came to England in the said Mr Thurrocks Services and lived him for about 8 Mrs. at the Black Bear in Piccadilly when he quitted him, and since quitting him which was above Nine Months ago, has not lived as an hired yearly Servant for 12 Months with any other Person or done any Act whereby to the best of his Knowledge he may have gained any subsequent Settlement

Sarah Sedgley aged 40 Years or there abouts upon her Oath saith That she Never was Married, Saith That she lived as an Hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Robt. Hanstead a Butcher in Wardour Street in the Parish of Saint Ann's Soho for upwards of 8 Years at the Yearly Wages of 6 Gunieas hath quitted her paid Service about 12 Months ago since which time she this Examinant hath not done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement to the best of her knowledge Information or belief

Ann Sandalls aged 22 Years or thereabouts upon her Oath, saith That she Never was Married Rented a House or Paid Taxes or over lived as an Hired Yearly Servant for Twelve Months Saith That she was bound out Apprentice by a Society called the Ladies Society supported by Voluntary Subscription held in Gillspur Street in the Parish of St. Sepulchre in the City of London to Mr. John Houseman in Crown Court Russell Street in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the County of Middlesex for the Term of 5 Years and served the whole of her Apprenticeship and or the said Indenture that since the Expiration of her said Apprentices but the has not done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement to the best of her knowledge or belief

Catharine Peet aged Eighteen Years or thereabouts singlewoman on behalf of Jane Peet her Sister aged 14 Years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that Their father and Mother are both Dead that she has been informed and believes that her fathers Settlement at the time of his Death was in the Parish Saint Paul Deptford in the County of Kent, that the said Jane Peet was bound Apprentice from the Parish of Saint Paul Deptford afd to one Catharine Peet this Examinant Aunt who then lived in the Parish of Saint Paul Shadwell by Indres duly executed that the served with her there for about two Years, that then her Aunt placed her with a Mrs- Selby and paid her for her Board - that Mrs. Selby aged with her Aunt to get her into place that by Mrs- Sebbys Prouration she was to live with Mr- Pain a Watch Care maker in Islington Row facing Salers Wells in the Pas: of Saint Mary Islington at st. which Mrs- Selby was to receive lay out for her lived thereabts. 18 Weeks quitted abt. a fortnight since

Catharine Peet singlewoman aged eighteen Years or thereabouts on behalf of Jane Peet her Sister an Infant of the Age of fourteen Years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that the said Jane Peet , was placed out Apprentice by the Officers of the Parish of Saint Paul Deptford to one Catharine Peet this Examinants Aunt, who at the time lived in the Parish of Saint Paul Shadwell that she served as an Apprentice to her said Aunt for about two Years, and then her said Aunt placed her with one Mrs. Selby to whom she paid for her board and it was agreed between her said Aunt and said Mrs. Selby that the said Mrs. Selby should procure a Service for the said Apprentice Jane Peet ,-and this Examinant further saith that the said Mrs. Selby did accordingly procure a Place for the said Jane Peet to live with one Mr-Pair a Watch care maker in Islington Road facing Sadlers Wells in the Parish of Saint Mary Islington James Gler manuall in the County of Middlesex at the wages of one shilling a Week besides Board - that Mrs the said Jane Peet lived with the said Mr- Pair under such Agreement for about eighteen Weeks - and quitted her said place about a fortnight three years ago - That said Mrs Selby reced the said Wages the greater part of which she has laid out for Cloaths for the said Jane Peet

Dinah Bromhall aged 47 Years or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith that she Intermarried with Joseph Rowley her late Husband at the Christ Church in the County of Surry about 25 years ago, that her said Husband Joseph Rowley Rented & Lived in a House in Off Alley in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the County of Middleses for 3 quarters of a year at the Yearly Rent of £20, That her said Husband Joseph Rowley quitted the said House about 24 years ago, that her said Husband departed this Life about 10 years since - that she hath Living by her said Husband Joseph Rowley One Child Named Ann Rowley of the age of 23 years or thereabouts That her said Husband Joseph Rowley since he so quitted the said House in his Life time nor she since his Decease nor the said Ann Rowley have not nor hath either of them done anyother Act Matter or thing whereby her said Daughter might have gained any Settlement elsewhere then in the said Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the said County of Middlesex and this Examinant father saith that her said Daughter Ann Rowley hath never Served any apprenticeship Lived as an Hired Yearly Servant or done any Act Matter or thing whereby she might have gained any Settlement in her own Right and that her said Daughter is poor and unable to maintain herself

Mary Pinnell aged forty two Years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that she was married to James Pinnell her now Husband who now is in the Kings Bench at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holborn about twenty one Years ago, according to the Rites of the Church of England by Law Established that she has four Children by her said Husband now living Vizt. James aged Nineteen Years or thereabouts who was put Apprentice one Mr John Brookes of Fleet Market Pawnbroker William Pinnell aged fifteen or thirty fourth also is now in the Workhouse of the Parish of Saint James Clerkenwell John aged from ten Years or thereabouts, is Clerk to Mr Welslim of No. 1 in furnivale Inn holborn and Daniel aged seven Years thereabouts who hath never born absent since this Examinant or his father house gained any settlement in his own right - And further this Examinant saith that he said Husband and she this Examinant rented and lived in a House in Battle Burdge in the Parish or Saint James - Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex at the Yearly Rent of £12 for upwards of a Year and half that this quitted same about a Year ago and since that time her said Husband hath not done any act Matter or King Whereby to the hart of this Examinant Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained any subsequent Settlement and that she is poor and unable to maintained her said Child, her Husband being in the Things Bench us above stated

Eleanor Lackey aged about 69 years upon her Oath saith that about 40 years ago she Intermarried with Hugh Lackey at the Parish Church of Abbin in Ireland Saith that her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Parkers Lane in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex for 15 years at the yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and paid Taxes hath quitted said House about 20 years ago since which time she hath done no Act matter or thing whereby to the best of this Examinants knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any other Settlemt.

Elizth. Watson aged 23 years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that she never was Married Rented House paid Taxes over lived or hired yearly Servant for one year or ever served any Apprenticeship that her Father Rented and lived in a House in Church Lane in the Parish of Greenwich in the County of Kent at 14 pounds year that she lived with him as part of his Family that her Father has been dead about 3 years that since his Decease she hath done no Act matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any other Settlement than as aforesaid

Richard Dunton aged 27 years or thereabouts upon his Oath saith that he was bound an Apprentice to Mr. Lambert of St. Clements's Church Yard about 14 years ago That he served about 5 years of his Time to him and Mr. Lambert and he not Agreeing Mr Lambert Consented that he should go and work as a Journey man upon allowing him the said Mr. Lambert 5s. Per week out of his Earnings - That he accordingly did go out to work and worked at several Places for 2 & 3 weeks and then at Stratford in the Parish of West Ham where he worked with a Mr. Alsop a Peruke maker and Hair Dresser at the Wages of 10s. Per week and board that he paid Mr Lambert several times 5s. after he left his Service that he stayed with Mr. Alsop near 3 years that his Indentures were never given up That he Intermarried with Christian Dunton his now wife at the Parish Church of St. Brides London about 8 years ago That he has 3 Children by her Vizt. Jas. aged 7 years Richd. aged 5 years and Ann aged 3 years That he has not done any act whereby he may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

John Belchier aged about 49 years upon his Oath saith that he Rented and lived in a House at Lambeth in the Parish of Saint Mary Lambeth in the County of Surry for twelve Months at the yearly Rent of 20 Guineas hath quitted said House about 5 years ago since which time he has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of this Depts. knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

George Edwards aged 50 years or thereabouts upon his Oath saith That he Intermarried with Mary his now Wife at the Parish Church of Cripplegate about 15 years ago That he hath 1 Child ren living by his said Wife Named Joseph aged 9 years or thereabouts and the Examinant further saith That he was bound Apprentice to George Draper of Baldwins Gardens in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for Shoemaker for 7 years by Indenture duly executed that he served the whole of his said apprenticeship with the said George Draper since which time he this Examinant hath not done any not to gain a Subsequent Settlemt. to the best of his knowledge or belief

John Conaway aged 15 years or thereabouts upon his Oath saith that on the 30th. day of August 1784 he was bound an Apprentice by the Churchwn and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes to one Morris Jones of the parish of Barking in the County of Essex Fisherman and served his said Master under such Indenture till within this Eight Months that since he left his said Master he has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of his Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained any other Settlement

Elizth. Pettey aged about 56 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Saith that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mrs. Napper a Mantua Maker in Church Street Soho in the parish of Saint Anns Soho in the County of Middx for 15 Months or thereabouts at the yearly wages of four pounds hath quitted said Service about twelve Months ago since which time she hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of this Depts. knowledge Information on belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Lucy Wilson aged about 63 years upon her Oath saith that she Intermarried to David Wilson her late Husband at the parish Church of Saint Andrew Holbourn London about Nine years ago who has been Dead upwards of 5 years Saith her said Husband hath 2 Children now Living by a former Wife Namely Mary Aged about 14 years and David Aged about 10 years And further saith that her said Husband Rented and Lived in a House know by the Sign of Wheat Sheaf in Red- Lyon Street in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn above the Barrs in the County of Middx for one year at the Yearly Rent of £20 as she believes & paid Taxes due for the Same hath quitted the said House about 10 years ago in since which time he hath not to the best of this DExaminants Knowledge Information or belief gained any other Settlement And further faith that She this Examinants hath & done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gaine any Settler

Lucy Wilson Aged 63 years or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith that She Intermarried with David Wilson her late Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holborn London about Nine years ago, that her said Husband hath been Dead upwards of 5 years - that her said late Husband Rented and Lived in a House Known by the Sign of the Wheat Sheaf in Red Lyon Street in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn above the Barrs in the County of Middx for 1 year at the yearly Rent of £30 as she believes & paid Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about 11 year ago since which time he hath not gained any other Settlement to the best of this Deponents Information Knowledge or belief And this Examinant further upon her Oath saith that She hath not since the Death of her said late Husband done any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her knowledge she may have gained any Settlement in her own Right and that she is poor and unable to Maintain herself

Mary Smith aged 23 years or thereabts upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Hinnard of Brompton Row Kensington in the parish of Kensington in the County of Middx for 14 Months at the yearly wages of Eight Guineas hath quitted said service about twelve Months ago since which time she hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Rebecca Spencer aged about 31 years upon her Oath saith that she was married to George Spencer at the Parish Church of Bow upwards of Seven years ago who has been dead about 4 years and by whom she hath no Child or Children being Saith that her Husband was bound an apprentice to one Thos. Rusco a pipe maker at Bell wharf Shadwell in the parish of Saint Paul Shadwell in the County of Middlesex that her Husband served his said Master under

Rebecca Spencer aged about 31 years upon her Oath saith that about Seven years she Intermarried with George Spencer her late Husband at the parish Church of Bow in the County of Middx that her said Husband hath been dead about 4 years that her said late Husband was bound an Apprentice to Thomas Rusco of Bell Wharf Shadwell in the parish of Saint Paul Shadwell in the County of Middx Pipe maker for 5 years by Indres duly Executed that he served the whole of his said Apprenticeship with the said Thos. Rusco since which time her said late Husband has not done any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of this Etc. knowledge Information or belief he may have gained any subsequent Settlement And this Examinant further upon her Oath saith that she hath not since the Death of her said late Husband done any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her knowledge she may have gained any Settlement in her own right and that she is poor and unable to maintain herself
