Mary Lee aged 52 years and upwds upon her Oath Saith that about 23 years ago She Intermarried with John Lee her late Husband at the Tower Chaple and who has been dead about 5 Months that her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Mansell Street in the parish of Saint Mary Most fellow alias White Chaple in the County of Middlesex at the yearly Rent of £38 for 10 years hath quitted said House about 13 years ago since which time her said late Husband hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of this Exts. knowledge Information or belief She may have gained any subsequent Settlement

Susannah Harford aged about 34 years upon her Oath saith that she Intermarried with Thos. Harford her late Husband at the parish Church of Fulham about 11 years ago that he has been dead about 6 years that she hath two Children living by her said late Husband Vizt. Ann Harford aged 9 years who is in provided for and John aged about 8 years who is in the Workhouse at Hammersmith that her said late Husband Served Seven years Apprenticeship to one Mr. Bartlow or Fisherman at Hammersmith in the parish of Hammersmith in the County of Middx by Indres duly executed that after he quitted his said Apprenticeship he never done any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Sarah Wilson Aged 30 years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith That she is the Daughter of John & Ann Wilson who were Married as she has been informed by her said Father and mother That she has been informed by her said Father that she was Born in Tothill Street Westminster That she Remember her old Father keeping a House in Maidenhead Court in the Parish of Saint Margaret Westmint. about 16 years ago that he Rented the same of a Mr. Alexander of Paker Street & paid her £10 a year for the same That she Resided there with them, That he Lived in the same near 10 years, That her Sister Elizabeth Wilson aged about 16 years was Born at the said House in Maidenhead Court , That her Father never gained any Settlement after he left the same, And this Examinant further on her Oath Saith That neither She this Examinant nor her said faid Sister Elizabeth , have not nor hath either of them done any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of this Examinants Knowledge or belief they or either of the may have gained any Settlement in their or either of their own rights and that she this Examinant and her said Sister Elizabeth are poor and unable to Maintain themselve

David Hatchman of Chander's Street Covent Garden in the County of Middlesx Coachmaker on the behalf of Ann Hatchman a Poor Woman now in sane at the House of Mr. Taylor in Arundel Street in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex upon his Oath Saith That be verily believes the said Ann Hatchman never was married, or ever did any Act whereby to gain a Settlement in her own right That John Hatchman her father rented and lived in a House in Janes Street in the Parish of Saint Mary be Bone in the County of Middlesex of the Yearly Value of upwards of ten pounds for more than forty Day - thats her father and Mother are both dead the father having survived the Mother and that both of them died in Marybone Workhouse or Infirmary without having as this Examinant verily believes gained any other Settlement than in the Parish of Saint Mary labour as above stated

Jane Bardin Aged about 50 years on the behalf of her Daughter Ann Bardin aged about 27 years upon her Oath Saith That she Intermarried with Thomas Bardin her present Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Dunstan in the West in the City of London about Thirty years ago That she hath Eight Children Living by her said Husband (four of whom are now provided for) And the others now Residing with her Vizt. the said Ann Bardin Aged about 27 years Richard Aged about 19 years John Aged upwards of 15 years and Charlotte Aged about 10 years Saith That she hath been Informed by her said Husband and which Information she verily believes to be true That her said Husbands Father served the first Four years of his time under Indentures of Apprenticeship duly Executed with a a Glass Grinder near Puddle Dock in the Parish of Saint Andrew by the Wardrobe in the City of London That her said Father Husband Father never was assigned over to any person whatsoever for the remainder of time now ever Rented any House or Lodging of £10 a year paid any Taxes Lived as an Hired yearly Servant or ever did any other Act Matter or thing whereby he have gained any other Settlement as her said Husband Father was Informed by his said Father And this Examinant further on her Oath saith that her said Husband has Informed her That he never did any Act Matter or thing whereby he might have gained any Settlement in his own Right And further saith That her said Daughter Ann Bartin hath Lived with her Father ever since her Birth and never gained any Settlement in her own Right and this Examinant further saith That the and her said Husband together with their Eight Children have been Relieved by the said Parish of Saint Andrew by the Wardrobe And that her said Daughter Ann Bardin being more Insane her said Husband is unable to Support her

Elizth. Findlass aged about 16 years upon her Oath saith that she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes that she never laied as a hired yearly Servant or ever was bound an Apprentice that her Father Sebastian Findlass Rented and lived in a House in Angel Court Westmr. in the parsih of Saint Margaretts on the Liberty Westminster for Ten years at the yearly rent of upwards hath quitted said House about 5 Months ago since which time She hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Margaret Mc.Farlane aged 16 or in thereabouts upon her Oath Saith That She was born in Perthshire , That she came from there with her Father & Mother, that her Father Name is Daniel Mc.Farlane her Mother was Ann , that they were Married as informd. her in Saith and, That her Father about Four Years ago kept the Three Suns upon Snow Hill , in the Parish of St. Sepulchre that he moved from thence to Bear Alley in the same Parish where he took a House of £12 pr. Ann, that She left him about 4 Yrs ago that since that Time She has not been 12 Months in Service or done any Act Matter or Saing whereby She may have gained a Settlement. to the best of her knowledge or belief

Mary Brett aged about 34 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Perkins a Coach Carver in Little Queen Street in the parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middx upwards of One year at the yearly Wages of 3 pounds hath quitted said Service about 17 years ago since which time she hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of this Deponents knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Ann Hughes aged 39 or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith That she never was Married, That an about Eighteen years ago she lived with Mr. the white Lyon Wych Street as a hired yearly Servant at £7:0:0 a year & continued in his Service 7 years - That since she quitted his Service she has not to the best of her knowledge gained any other Settlement Aud. Further Saith That when she left the Service of the Said Mr. Weitz she went to live and Cohabit with one Thomas Williams a Shoemaker that he died in the Month of Decr last and further Saith That she had 9 Children by him, Four of whom are now living. Thomas aged 9 Nine Years or thereabouts who was born at there in Harding Rents Snows Fields in the Parish of Saint Mary Magdalen Bermondsey John aged about Six Years who was born in the Same place. Ralph aged 3 Years or thereabouts born at a Chandlers Shop in Golden, Lane in the Parish of St. Lukes Old Street . Ricd aged 1 Year & an half born in the same place - and Saith that They were all lay the said Thomas William , that she was never Married to him and he died about Xmas last a

Margaret Dowlin aged 27 years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith That she never was Married - That she lived as an hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Foster of Richmond Buildings in the Parish of Saint Ann John in the Liberty of Westminster for chwards of Twelve Months at the yearly Wages of 6 Guineas that she quitted her said Service abt. 18 Months ago since which time she has not Done any Act Matter or Thing to gain a Subsequent Settlement to the best of her knowledge or belief

Elizabeth Harper aged 49. or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith That she intermarried with Daniel Harper her late Husband at the Parish Church of Kingston upon Thames about Thirty four Years ago, That before their Intermarriage and whilst her said Husband was a single man and unmarried not having Child or Children, her said Husband lived as an hired Yearly Servant with one Mr Tash of Suffolk Lane in the Parish of Allhallows the Less - in the City of London Wine Merchant at the Yearly Wages of for upwards of one Years that he did not quit his said place till after their Intermarriage - that he died about twenty two Years ago, and that her said Husband after quitting his said place until the time of his Death did not do, nor hath this Examinant since his Death done, any Act, Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information and belief she may have gained any other Settlement then in the Parish of Allhallows thereof above stated and this Examinant further saith that she is poor and Lame and unable to maintain herself and being in much Want hath applied to the Overseers of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes for Relief.

Mary Douglass aged about 73 years upon her Oath saith That she Intermarried with George Douglass at the Parish Church of Saint Margaretts Westmr . about 20 years ago That he hath been dead about 15 years and by whom She hath no Child or Children living That her Said Husband Rented and lived in a first floor of a Mr. Rothery in Twik Street Chelsea in the Parish of Saint Luke Chelsea in the County of Middlesex for One year at the yearly Rent of Ten pounds that he quitted said Lodging about 2 years before his Death that he did no other Act whereby he may have gained any subsequent Settlement nor hath this Ext. done any Act Matter or thing whereby she may have gained any Settlement

Elizth Mackenzie aged about 66 years upon her Oath saith that about 31 years ago she Intermarried with Murdock Mackenzie at the Savoy Chapel that she hath no Child or Children living that her said Husband was a Scotchman and never gained any Settlement in England that she was born in Peter Street Bishopgate in the Parish of Saint that her Father and Mother Rented and lived in a House in Peter Street Bishopgate in the Parish of Saint Botolph without Bishopgate in the County of Middx where this Examinant was born that She hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any other Settlement otherwise than by Birth

Cath: Sexton aged about 27 years upon her Oath saith that she never was Married Accordg. to the Rites and Ceremonies of the Church of England that she lived as a hired yearly Servt . with one Mr. Collis of Vere Street in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes for 14 Months at the yearly Wages of Eight pounds hath quitted said Service about Seven years ago since which time she hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement And further this Ext. upon her Oath saith that she hath two Illegitimate Children living (Vizt.) Thos. Sexton aged about 2 years and a Quarter born in Kinsgate Street in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex and Philips Sexton aged about 13 Months born in Church Street Saint Giles's in the parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex And further saith that John Sexton to Whom this Ext. was married at the Chapel in Duke Street by a Roman Catholic Priest according to the Rites and Ceremonies of the Romesh Church and who has been dead about four Months is the father of the said Children and that she this Examinant wishes to leave the same to the Care of the Parish

Alice Metcalfe aged about 44 years upon her oath saith that about 23 years ago she, Intermarried with Richard Metcalfe her late Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Mary Magdalen and who has been dead about Six years that she hath four Children living by her said Husband Vizt. Thomas aged about 19 Years Killy aged 18 Years or thereabouts both Provided for Wm. aged 15 years or thereabouts and Alice aged about 12 years both unprovided for that her said late Husband before his Death rented and lived in a House in Duke Street Bloomsbury in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex for 15 Months or thereabouts at the yearly rent of 26 Guineas hath quitted said House about 13 years ago since which time her said late Husband did no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her knowledge Information or belief may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Bromfield aged about 36 years upon her Oath saith that she Intermarried with John Bromfield at the Parish Church of Saint Mary White Chaple about 3 years ago that her said Husband lived but 5 Weeks after his Inter marriage to this that she had no Child on Children by her said Husband that since her said late Husbands Decease and having no Child or Children living she went to live as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Reed in High Holborn in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn above the Barrs in the County of Middlesex that she Continued to live in her said Service for 18 Months or thereabouts hath quitted her said Service about Six Months ago since which time she hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Sarah Taylor aged about 40 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with a Mr. Scott at Hammersmith in the Paris Hamlett of Hammersmith in the Parish of Fulham in the County of Middlesex for 18 Months and upwards at the yearly Wages of Seven Guineas hath quitted said Service about Six years ago since which time she hath done no Act Matter or thing where by to the best of her knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Frederick Wise aged thirty two Years or thereabouts upon his Oath saith That he intermarried with Honor Wise his now Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Giles in the field in the County of Middlesex about Six Years ago that since their Inter marriage he rented and lived in a shop and Parlor in New Compton Street in the Parish of Saint Giles in the field in the County of Middlesex at a Yearly Rent of upwards of ten pounds for about three Quarters of a year that he quitted the same about three Years ago and since that time has not done any other Act Matter or thing Whereby to the lach of his Knowledges Information or belief he may have gained any subsequent Settlement-and that he is poor and unable to maintain himself and his said Wife she being sick and ill

Benjamin Newman on behalf of Ann Patterson who lies ill upon his Oath Saith that he has been informed by the said Ann Patterson that she is aged about 26 years that she never was married Rented House Paid Taxes or ever lived as a hired yearly Servant that she was bound Apprentice to a Mr. Carthra a Mantua Maker in Boars Head Court Fleet Street in the Parish of Saint Dunstan in the West in the City of London by a written Agreement executed by her Mistress her Father and the said Ann Patterson for 12 Months that she only served six Months of her said Time and that her said Mistress then having no Work she left her that she was Born in Batavia that she has done no Act Whereby to gain any Subsequent Settlement that her Father kept House in Mary Le Bone Street at the Yearly Rent of £30 that he kept said House for about Six Months ago that he hath left said House about 16 years ago

Eleanor Lackey aged about 70 years upon her Oath saith that about 40 years ago she Intermarried with Hugh Lackey at the Parish Church of Abbin in Ireland that her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Parkers Lane in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex for 15 years at the yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and Paid Taxes hath quitted said House about 20 Years ago since which time she hath done no Act Matter or thing Whereby she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Mary Howlett aged 26 upon her Oath Saith That she lived as a Hired Yearly servt . with Mr Watson of Upper Seymour Street for 13 Months at £7: a Year.-That it is in the Parish of St. Mary lebone That she quitted such Service about 14 Months ago. That since she quitted same she has done as Act Matter or Thing Whereby she may have gained a Settlement

Catherine Poole Aged 21 or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith That John Perry an Illegitimate Child Aged about two Months was Born in the Workhouse belonging to the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the County of Middlesex and of whom she this Examinant is the Mother and that she is Poor and unable to Maintain the said Child

Ann Mitchell aged 30 Years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that she was married to Walter Mitchell at the Parish Church of Saint Margaret Westmr in the County of Middlesex about two Years and an half ago that before her the does not know any Settlement the said Walter Mitchell ever gained nor where he was born that he has deserted her there two Years and she does not know where he is gone that whilst she was a singlewoman she lived as an hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Berry at the Queen Head Tavern the Corner of Grays Iron in Holborn at the Yearly Wages of seven pounds for about two Years this since in thing the same she has not to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief Done any Act Matter or thing Whereby she may have gained any the Settlement-and that the this Examinant is poor and in gave as Distress and unable to maintain herself having a Young Child to Fachalr and maintain, and that she has applied to the Overseers of the Poor of Saint Andrew Holborn being the Parish where she lived as a Yearly Servant with Mr Berry as aforesaid and they before refered to relieve her unless she should come to them regularly pased by Justices Order of Removal

Jane Bradford of the said Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex Widow upon her Oath saith That she in her married with John Bradford her late Husband at the Christ Church Surry in the Man that August of the Year 1774-that her said Husband before their late mar- riage served his time as an Apprentice under Indentures to Messrs. Windle and Madem Glass Cutters at the Kings Army in the Strand in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex -that after their Intermarriage she does not know of any Act Matter or Thing be ever did whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement that her said Husband died about Seven Years ago at □ Giber alter , and that she this Examinant hath not since his Death lived as an hired Yearly Servant for one Year or done any Act whereby to the best of her Knowledge she may have acquired any Settlement in her own right-and further this Examinant on her Voluntary Oath saith That she is now Pregnant with Child or Children Which is or are likely to be born a Bastard or Bastards and to be Chargeable to the said Parish of Saint Clement Danes and that John Pears one of the Rummers of the Public office in Bow Street is the Zealand true father of such Child or Children he having sometime in the Month of latter End of the Year 1785 had Camal Knowledge of this Examinant Body and that he the said John Pears and no one else did he got such Child or Children on this Examinants Body of Which she is Pregnant as aforesaid and that the said John Sears and no one else in the real and true father of such Child or Children

Elizabeth Card Wife of John Card of Westminster in the County of Middlesex Laborer -Maketh Oath and saith that the said John Card her Husband hath deserted her and refuses to maintain her and that she is now maintained by and at the Expence of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex and lives in the Workhouse of the said Parish

Charles Leary aged about 33 years upon his Oath saith that he served Seven years Apprenticeship by Indres duly executed to one Joseph Vanderiom a Chimney Sweeper in Faleon bridge Court Hoghan in the Parish of Saint Annes in the Liberty of Westmr. that since he quitted his said Apprenticeship he has never done any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of this Depts. knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Jane Bradford aged about 24 years upon her Oath saith That she intermarried with John Bradford her late Husband at the Christ Church Surry in the Month of August in the year 1774 that her said Husband has been dead about Seven years that she has one illegitimate Child living Vizt. Jane Bradford aged about 6 years born a Bastard in Silver Street Spittlefields in the Parish of Said Matthew Bethnell Green

Peter Dagworthy aged about 42 years upon his Oath saith that he Intermarried with Rose Dagworthy his Present wife at the Parish of St. Mary Newington That he lived with Mr. Everett at the London Apprentice Hoxton in the Parish of Saint Leonard Shoreditch for 3 years at the yearly Wages of Ten Pounds

Cath: Sexton aged about 27 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married according to the Rites and Ceremonies of the Church of England that she has two illegitimate Children Vizt Thos. Sexton aged about 2 years and a half Provided for and Philip Sexton and aged about 15 Months born in the Haymar Kett in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr. and further said that John Sexton to whom this Examinant was married at the Chapel in Duke Street by a Roman Catholic Priest according to the rites and Ceremonies of the Romish Church of England and who has been deced about Six Months is the father of the said Children and that she this Examint. wishes to leave same to the Care of the Parish

Hannah Weaver aged about 37 years upon her Oath saith that about 21 years ago she Intermarried with Wm. Weaver at the her Present Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Leonard Shoreditch and by whom she hath 4 Children living Vizt. Wm. aged about 17 years Rebecca aged about 12 years Sophia aged about 10 years & Richard aged about 7 years-that her said Husband Rents a Lodging of Mr. Morgan a Hatter in the Strand in the Precinct Parish of St. of the Savoy at the yearly Rent of Ten Pounds that her said Husband has lived there since Midsummer day last that her said Husband Refuses to maintain this Ext. & his Son Wm

Sarah Murry aged about 42 years upon her Oath saith that about 25 years ago she Intermarried with James Murry at the Island of Guernsey and that this Ext. has not heard of him for this 5 years that her said Husband served Seven years Apprenticeship with a Mr. Gine the Banker in Lombard Street in the Parish of Alhallows Lombard Street in the City of London that her sd after her said Husband was out of his Apprenticeship he never did any Act Matter or thing Whereby to the best of this Depts knowledge Information or belief he may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Christian Lucas aged 33 or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith That she intermarried with Richd. Lucas her Present Husband at the Parish Church of Saints Martin in the Fields abouts Ten Years ago. That he has deserted her That about 7 years ago her Husband Rentd. the Boot in Cross Lane in the Parish of Mr Giles in the Fields that he had in it Six Months & was to pay £40. a Year That since that Terice he has not to the best of her knowledge done any Act whereby he may have gained a Settlement

Any Suckmore Singlewoman Aged 26 years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with a Mrs. Gunthorpe in Fleet Street in the Parish of Saint Brides alias Bridgett in the City of London for 18 Months or thereabouts at the yearly Wages of £6..10..0 hath quitted said Service about 2 years ago since which time she hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement And further upon her Oath saith that about 5 weeks ago she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child at the House of a Mr. Lally a Shoemakers in Vere Street Clare Markett

Elizabeth Fletcher on behalf of Mary Cloudsly Singlewoman her Niece who is ill Maketh Oath and Saith that she has been informed which information she believes to be true that the said Mary Cloudsly lived as a hired yearly Servant with Major Reed in lower Seymour Street Portman Square in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone for about 3 years that the last 40 Days of the Elizth. Cloudsly Service was in lower Seymour Street in the said Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone that the said Elizth Cloudsly has quitted said Service upwards of a twelve Month ago since which time the said Elizth. Cloudly has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of this Exts. knowledge Information or belief the said Mary Cloudsly may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Sarah Dibble aged 56 years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that about 27 years ago she intermarried with Thos. Dibble her late Husband who has been dead about 16 Months at the Parish Church of St. Mary Overys that her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Lads Court Mai Lane in the sd. Parish of St. Mary Overys for upwards of 12 years at the yearly Rent of £5..10..0 and Paid the Kings and Watch Rate due for the same hath- quitted said House about 14 years ago since which time she hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

James Talboys one of the Beadles of the Parish of St. Clement Danes on behalf of Elizth. Berman who is rather disordered in her mind, Maketh Oath and Saith that he has been informed which information he believes to be true that the said Elizth Berman lived as a hired yearly Servant with Lady Egremont at Egremont House Piccadilly in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square for upwards of Twelve Months.-That He has great reason to believe such information to be true From the Affidavit of Dennis Kinslow who lived and Cohabited with the Said Elizabeth Benman taken the 10th. Instant.

Sarah Campbell aged about 24 Years upon her Oath saith that about 5 Years ago she intermarried with Walter Campbell who has been dead about 2 years at the Parish Church of Saint Mary Le Bone that her said Husband served 5 years Appceship with Mr. Richie a Hairdresser No. 58 Oxford Street in the Parish of St. Mary Le Bone in the County of Middx that after he was out of his said Apprenticeship her never did any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any subsequent other Settlement

Elizabeth Hart aged 58 or thereabouts Saith That she was born in Hart Street Covent Garden That her Father Rented a House of Twenty Pounds a Year there lived in it many Years and died there that it is in St Pauls Covent Garden-that she never was Married or did any Act to the best of her Knowledge whereby she may have gained a Settlement

Ann Jones aged about 60 years upon her Oath saith that about 20 years ago she Intermarried with John Jones at the Parish Church of St. Dunstan in the City of London that her said Husband has been dead about 17 years that her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Cradle Court St. Mary Axe in the Parish of St. Andrew Under shaft in the City of London for 3 Years at the yearly Rent of £12 and Paid Taxes due for the same that after her said Husband Death she this Ext. Kept the said House for 3 years that after quitting that House she never did any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Elizth. Devin aged about 25 years Widow upon her Oath saith that about 10 years ago she Intermarried with Thos. Devin her late Husband (who has been dead about 6 years as she has been informed) at the Parish Church of St. Mary at Hill at Billinsgate by License that she hath One Child living by her said Husband Vizt Thos. aged about 8 years-that since her said Husbands Death she Rented and lived in a House at Walworth in the Parish Church of St. Mary at Newington in the County of Surry for 2 Months & upwards at the yearly Rent of 18 Guineas hath quitted said House about 15 Months ago since which time she has not rented any House Tent. or Lodging of £10 a year or ever did any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Informative or belief she may have gaine any Subsequent Settlemt

Lydia Lafortune aged about 60 years upon her Oath saith that in the year 1758 she Intermarried to Anthony Lafortune her late Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the fields that her said Husband has been dead about 11 years that her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Feather bed Lane in the Parish of Saint Dunstan in the West in the City of London for about 11 years at the yearly Rent of £20 hath quitted said House about 12 years since which him she hath done no net Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlemt

Thomas Cock aged about 26 year upon his Oath saith that about two years ago he went to live as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Spencer in Sharps Alley Cow Cross in the Parish of Saint Sepulchres in the County of Middx that he lived in the said Mr. Spencers Service for twelve Months and upwards at the yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted said Service about twelve Months ago since which time he hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of this Dept Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained any other Settlement

James Talboys One of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes Maketh Oath and Saith that he has been informed which Information he believes to be true that Andrew Forrest aged about 13 years was bound Apprentice by the Overseers of the Poor of the said Parish of St Clement Danes by Indres duly executed to one William Footman of No. 26 Aldermanbury Hair Dresser in the Parish of St. Mary Aldermanbury in the City of London on the 13th. day of April last that the said Andrew Forr served his said Master under such Indre till Yesterday that then he Came away from said Master

Elizth. Hockly aged about 32 years upon her Oath saith that she never was Marrd Rented any House Tent. or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year that about 2 years & ago she went to live as a hired yearly Servt . with one Richd. Ward a Perfumer in Oxford Street in the Parish of St. Mary Le Bone that she lived in his said Service about 21 Months at the yearly Wages of £7 hath quitted said Service about 7 Months ago since which time she has done no Act to gain any other Settlement

Benjn. Newman One of the Beadles the Parish of St Clement Danes on behalf of Eliz Harper who lays ill Maketh Oath and Saith that he has been informed which information believes to be true that the said Elizth. Harper belongs to the Parish of Allhallows the Less the City of London by her Husband Daniel Harp living for upwards of One year as a hired year Servant with One Mr. Tash of Suffolk ha in the said Parish of Allhallows the Less th after he quitted his said Service he never any other Act to gain any other Settlement

Susannah Baker aged about 61 years upon her Oath saith that about 37 years ago she Intermarried with Roger Baker (who has been dead about 6 years) at the Fleet London that said Husband in his Life time informed which information she believes to be true tha her said Husband Rented and lived in a Ho in York Street Covent Garden in the Parish o St. Paul Covent Garden in the County of Midd for 40 Days & upwards that after her Husband quitted said House he never any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Ann Millot aged about 26 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Smith in Gloucester Street in the Parish of Saint George th Martyr in the County of Middx for 13 Months at the yearly Wages of £7 hath quitted said Service about 2 years ago since which time she has not done any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Setts

Hannah Williams aged about 22 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented any House Tent. or Lodging of £10 a year that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with Mr Groves of Ludgate Street in the Parish of Saint Brides alias Bridgett in the City London for 15 Months at the yearly Wages of £7 hath quitted said Service about Twelve Months ago since which time she has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Mary Cunning ham aged about 27 Years upon her Oath saith that she never was married that she lived as a hired yearly servant with one Harry Paine of Wottell in the County of Suffolk in the Parish of Wottell in the said County of Suffolk for 2 Years at the Yearly Wages of 50 Shillings hath quitted said Service about 4 years ago since which time she has done no Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement And further this Examt. saith that she has two illegitimate Children living Vizt. Mary aged about 2 years born in the House of a Mr Baddeley in Featherstone Street in the Parish of Saint Luke Old Street in the County of Middlesex and Martha aged about 3 weeks born in the Close in the Borough

Edward Burbidge One of the Beadle the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes on behalf of Thos. Spencer an Infant Maketh Oath and Saith that he has been informed which Information he believes to be true that Wm. Spe the Father of the said Thomas Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Thos. Brignall a Butcher in Aldersgate Street in the Parish of St. Botolph without Aldersgate in the City of London and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any other Settlement

Elizabeth Simpson aged about 42 Years upon her Oath saith that about 3 Years ago she Intermarried with Robt. Brown Simpson her Present Husband (who is gone from her) at the Parish Church of St. Stephen Walbrook in the City of London that she hath Two Children living by her said Husband Vizt. Robert aged about Two Years and Richard aged about 8 Weeks that her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in the Walker Cot. St. James's in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr. for Seven Weeks at the Yearly Rent of £30 hath quitted said House about 2 Years ago since which time she has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her knowledge Information or belief he may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Sarah Mansel aged about 39 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married that she as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Pigmore Parliament Street in the Parish of Saint Margaret in the Liberty of Westminster for 2 years at the Yearly Wages of £5 hath quitted said Service about 11 Years ago since which time she hath done no Act to gain any Subsequent Settlement

James Talboys One of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes Maketh Oath and Saith that he has been informed which Information he believes to be true that Mary an Infant aged about 2 Years born a Bastard on the Body of Mary Cunningham (who has deserted it) was born in the House of a Mr. Baddeley in Featherstone Street in the Parish of Saint Luke Old Street in the County of Middx

James Talboys One of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes on behalf of Martha Shelton who lays ill Maketh Oath and Saith he has been informed which Information he believes to be true that the said Martha Shelton Rented a House and Garden in Little Chelsea in the Parish of Saint Lukes Chelsea in the County of Middlesex for 2 Years at the Yearly Rent of £10 hath quitted said House about 18 Years ago since which time she has done no Act Matter or thing to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Christopher Hodgson of Newport Market in the Parish of St. Anns John Maketh Oath and Saith That Robert Hodgson the Illegitimate Child of Robert and Sarah Hodgson was born the corner of Middletons, Buildings Queen Ann Street East in the Parish of St. Mary e bone that he has been in St. Mary le bone Workhouse and since he left same has not gained a Settlement to the best of his Knowledge or belief

James Tasker aged 39 or thereabouts upon his Oath Saith That he intermarried with May present Wife at the Parish Church of Saint dr in the Field about Seventeen Years age That he has Four Children by her now being Vizt Jaca aged 13 or thereabouts, David aged 9 or thereabouts Jacob aged 5 or thereabouts, and Mary aged 3 or there abouts And Further Saith That about 18 years ago he Rented a House in Portsmouth Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields that the paid £10. a year Rent for the Same and quitted is about 4 years ago That his Wife and a great part of his Family were about 4 years ago in the Workhouse of Saint Giles in are Fields .

Benjn. Wingrove Master of the Workhouse belonging to the Parish of Saint Clement Danes Maketh Oath & Saith that he has been informed which Information he believes to be true that one Sarah Holmes is aged abo 20 years that She was bound an apprentice by the Parish Officers of Saint Sepulchres to a Mr. King who kept a Cloaths Shop on Saffron Hill in that part of the Parish of Saint and Holborn which in the Liberty of Saffron that after She had served about 4 years of her Sai Apprenticeship her Master broke and that the said Sara Holmes has done no Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement to the best of this Extr. Knowledge Information or belief Hill Hatton. Garden and Ely Rents.

Mary Mullender aged about 46 years upon her Oath saith that she is about 40 years of Age never was Married that she kept House in Petticoat Lane in the parish of Saint Mary Whitechaple in the County of Middlesex for 3 Months at the yearly Rent of £10 & upwards hath quitted said House about 10 years ago since which time she has done no Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Jane Davis aged about 34 years upon her Oath saith that she Intermarried with Wm. Davis her present Husband at the parish Church of Saint Andrew Holborn abo 3 Months ago that her said Husband Served Seven years Apprenticeship to one Mr. Pouch a: Jeweller in Aldersgate Street in the parish of Saint Botolph without Aldersgate in the City of London that after he was out of his said application he has done no Act to gaint a Subsequent Settlement to the best of this Exts. Knowledge Information or belief

Thos. Preston aged about 39 years upon her Oath saith that he lived as a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Mortlock a Publican in New Street Square in the Parish of Saint Bride alias Bridgett in the City of London for 18 Months at the yearly Wages of Six Guineas hath quitted same about 9 years ago since which time he has done no Act Matter or thing to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Benjamin Wingrove , maketh oath & Saith that he hath been informed and which information the believes to be true, That Mary Webb aged One Year or there abouts now in the workhouse of Saint Clement Danes is an illegetimate Child and was born at Mr Holmes's No. 21. Charles. Court in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields

Sarah Perry Single woman Aged 40. or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith, That she never was married That she has Six illegitimate Children living Vizt. Thomas aged 19 years or thereabout born upon Saffron Hill in the Liberty of Saffron Hill George aged 15 years or thereabouts born in Cockpit Court Shoe Lane in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn below the Bars , William aged Nine years born at the House of a Mr. Lumby in Apollo Court in the Parish of Saint Dunstan in the West in the City of London , David aged Seven years born at the House of a Mr. Paine in Bell yard in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middx Mary aged four years, born at the House of a Mr. Anderson in Great Shire Lane in the parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middx and Henry aged Five Months born at the House of a Mr. Bilby in Sawyers Yard in the said parish, Saith that they are the Children of Henry Perry . who has born dead Absconded and gone into Wales. And further saith that she is Poor and unable to maintain herself and Children

Christopher Hodgson of Newport Markett in the Parish of Saint Anns in the Liberty of Westminster Shoemaker upon his Oath saith that Sarah Hodgson on Instant Aged 5 years or thereabout is the Illegitimate Child of Sarah Haynes by Robert Hodgson this Exts. Brother and was born at House which the said Robt. Hodgson Rented situate the Corner of Neils Passage Queen Street Seven Dials in the parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middx that the said Robert Hodgson and Sarah Haynes were never married and that the are both dead

John Berryman aged about 34 years upon his Oath saith that he never Rented any House Tenement Lodging of £10 a yearly that about 14 years ago he went to live as a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Gray who kept the White Horse Inn in Friday Street in the parish of Saint Margt. Moses in the City of London that he lived there for the Space of Two years at the yearly Wages of £5 hath quitted said Service about 12 years ago since which time he has not lived as a hired yearly Servant for One year or done any Act to the best of this Exts. knowledge Information or belief whereby he may have gained a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Ditcher aged about 19 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Meacher in Lambs Conduit Street in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn above the Barrs in the County of Middlesex for Two years or thereabouts at the yearly Wages of Three Pounds hath quitted said Service about 4 years ago since which time she hath done no Act Matter or thing to gain a Subsequent Settlement

N Margaret Ballantine aged about 30 years upon her Oath saith that about 13 years ago she Intermarried with Robt. Ballantine her late Husband (who has been dead about 6 years) at the Parochial Chaple of Saint Nicholas at Liverpool and by whom she hath two Children living by her said late Husband Vizt. Elizth . aged about 11 years and James aged about 8 years both provided for that her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in Virginia Street in the Parish of St. George in the East in the County of Middx for 9 years at the yearly Kent of £15 hath quitted said House above 4 years since which time she has done no act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Elizth. Earth aged about 48 years upon her Oath saith that about 8 years ago she went to live as a hired year by Servant with lady Franks in Newman Street Oxford Road in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone in the County of Middx for 18 Mos. or thereabouts at the yearly Wages of £5 hath quitted said Service about 6 years ago since which time she has done no act Matter or thing to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Sutherland aged about 47 years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that about 26 years ago she Intermarried with John Sutherland her late Husband (who has been dead about 5 weeks) at May Fair Chaple that she hath 5 Children living by her said Husband 4 of which are provided for the one unprovided for is named James aged about 7 years that her said late Husband Rented a House in Essex Court White Fryars in the Precinct of White Fryars in the City of London for 3 years or thereabouts at the yearly Rent of £12 that he hath quitted said House about 12 years since which time her said late Husband has done no Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Thomas Hubbard aged about 36 years upon his Oath saith that about 4 years ago he Intermarried with Mary his now Wife at the Parish Church of St. Martin in the fields that he has no Child or Children living that before his Intermarriage with his said Wife he lived as a hired yearly Servant with Geo: Weatherstone in Kirby Street in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn below the Barrs in the City of London for 12 Months and upwards at the yearly Wages of £5 hath quitted said Service about 16 years ago since which time he has not done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Brown aged about 33 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Wilmot a Butcher in Fletcher Street Clerkenwell in the Parish Saint James Clerkenwell in the County of Middx for 13 Months at the yearly Wages of £3 hath quitted said Service about 13 years ago since which time she has not lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement And further this Ext. saith that she has one illegitimate Child living vizt. Elizth. Margt. Steers aged about 5 years & upwards born at the House of a Mr. Daniel the bott of Clerkenwell Green in the said Parish of Saint James in the Clerkenwell

Daniel Coleman aged about 73 years upon his Oath saith that he Rented and lived in a House in Grays Inn Lanes in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn above the Barrs in the County of Middx for 6 years or thereabouts at the yearly Rent of £15 hath quitted said House upwards of 30 years ago since which time he has not Rented any Place of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Benjamin Newman one of the Beadle of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex Maketh Oath and Saith that he has been informed which Information he verily believes to be true that Maria aged about 4 years born a Bastard on the Body of Jane Johnston was in the House of a Mr. Metcalfe in Castle Street Oxford Road in Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone in the said County of Middlesex and Elizth . aged about 5 weeks born a Bastard on the Body of the said Jane Johnston was in the House of a Mr. Collins in Brod Street Saint Giles's in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the said County of Middlesex

Cassandra Parry aged about 53 years upon her Oath saith that about 22 years ago she Intermarried with John Parry her late Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Antholin in the City of London that he has been dead about 12 years that she hath two Children livg. by her said late Husband vizt. Cassandra aged about 19 years who is insane and unprovided for and W aged about 17 years Provided for that her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in Queens Street Cheapside in the Parish of St. Antholin in the City of London for 3 years or thereabouts at the yearly Rent of £32 that he ha quitted said House about 21 years before his said Death since which time he never did any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement And furth this Ext. upon her Oath Saith that her Sd. Daur Cassandra who is insane never was bound an apprentice lived as a hired yearly Servt. or don any Act to gain a Settlement in her own right

Benjamin Wingrove Master of the workhouse of St. Clement Danes Maketh Oath and Saith that Jane robe was bound apprentice to Ann Bowerbank of Buxter Place Sambeth Tambour Worker by the Churchwardens & Queens of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes with the Consent of Two of his Majesty Justices of the Peace on or about the 23d. Day of April last . That she went with the said Ann Bowerbank to the Parish of St. Mary Newington to live as he has been informed and believe and that she resided with the said Ann Bowerbank there for upwards of Forty Days 4 & that she ran away from the Sd. Ann Bowerbank about the 28th. day of February last .

Wm. Freeman of Nags head Court in the Parish of St. Clement Danes on behalf of Magdalen Galley who lays ill Maketh Oath and Saith that he has been informed which information he believes to be true that the said Magdalen Galley lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Geo: Swindley of Mags Buildings in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the County of Middx for 2 years or thereabouts at the yearly wages of £7 that she hath quitted said Service about 8 years since which time she the said Magdalen hath done no Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Christian Veitch aged about 49 years upon her Oath saith that she Intermarried with Alexr Veitch her late Husband deceased at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes about 28 years ago that he has been dead about 2 years that she hath four Children livg. by him Charlotte 21 George aged 17 years Christian aged 15 years and Robt . aged 8 years or thereabouts all of whom are provided for that her said late Husband Rented and lived 2 Shops in Saville Row Passage in St. James Parish in the Liberty of Westmr. for about 18 years Months at the yearly Rent of £10 during which time he lived in Swallow Street in the said Parish that he hath quitted said House about 14 years ago since which time he never did any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Lucy Springhall aged 50 years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that about 16 years ago she being a Widow and having no Incumbrance she lived a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Morgan the Co of Brownlow Street Holborn in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn above the Barrs in the County of Middx for 7 years & upwards at the yearly wages of £5 that she hath quitted said Service about 9 years ago since which time she has not done any Act to gain any Subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Alphey aged about 60 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Mullar in Villers Street York Buildings in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr. for 18 years Months & upwards at the yearly wages of £7 hath quitted said Service upwards of 2 years ago since which time she has not lived as an hired yearly Servant for one year or done any Act Matter or Thing to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Elizth. Staples aged 39 years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that She never was married that she lived as an hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Richardson a Disenting Minister in Little Moor fields in the Parish of St. Giles Cripplegate in the City of London for upwards of 12 Months at the yearly wages of £5 that the hath quitted his said Service about 14 or 15 years ago and since then have never lived as an hired yearly Servant for one year with any other Person Rented any House or Tenement of the yearly Rentor Value of £10 paid Taxes or done any or Act Matter or Thing whereby to the best of her knowledge Information or belief She may have gained or acquired any Subsequent Settlement and that she is poor & Sick & unable to maintain herself

Sarah Marshlin aged about 19 years upon her Oath saith that she never was Married that she was Round an Apprentice to Mr. Phillips of Stanhope Street Clare Market that she served her about 5 years of her time that she then left her Mistress for some time and was out of place that she went into the Service of Mr. Kentelo Musician of Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Martin the Fields that she remained in his Service about 5 Months that at that time her indenture was not expired & that her Mistress knew where she was while she was in such Service with Mr. Kentelo that since that time she has not done any Matter or thing whereby she may have gained a Subsequent Settlement

Elizth. Roe aged about 30 years upon her Oath saith that upwards of Six years ago she Intermarried with Thos. Roe her late Husband at Christ Church Dublin that her said Husband has been dead upwards of Three Months that she has 4 Children living by him vizt. Robt. aged 5 years Mary Ann aged up of 3 yrs. unprovided for John aged 2 years provided for and Loving a aged about 9 Months unprovided for that her said late Husbd. Rented and lived in a House in Great Wild Street in Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middx for 15 Months or thereabouts at the yearly Rent £25 that then he died that she this Ext. Rented & lived in the same House for full 3 Months after her said late Husbands Death that she this Ext. has not Rented any House Tent. or Lodging of the yearly Rent of £10 for 40 days or done any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement and that she this Ext. is poor & unable to maintain herself & Children & therefore is obliged to apply to the Parish of St. Clement Danes for relief

Benjamin Newman of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes Maketh Oath and Saith that he did take Robert Roe mentioned in the Examination on the opposite Side aged 5 years Mary Ann aged 3 years and Louis a Roe . aged about 9 months and John aged about Two years to the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields , by Virtue of an Order of Removal, that last night Three Children were left at the Door of the Workhouse of the Parish of St. Clement Danes which Three Children this Examinant verily be lives are the said May Ann Roe , John Roe and Louisa Roe whom this Deponent took to Saint Giles's as aforesaid

Eleanor Sisum aged about 64 years upon her Oath saith that about 38 years ago she Intermarried with Walter Sisum her late Husband (who has been dead upwards of 20 years ) at the parish Church of Saint Clement Danes that her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in Brokers Alley Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr. for 3 years & upwards at the yearly Rent of £14 that he had quitted said House about 5 years before his Death during which time he never did any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement nor hath this Ext. since her said late Husbands death done any act whereby she might have gained any Subsequent Settlement

James Talboys one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes on behalf of Thos. Spencer an Infant Maketh Oath and Saith that he has been credibly informed which Information he verily believe to be true that William Spencer the Father of the said Thos. Spencer served Seven years Apprenticeship with one Thos. Brignall a Butcher in Aldersgate Sto in the Parish of Saint Botolph without Aldersgate in the City of London and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never did any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Job Nichols aged about 40 years upon his Oath saith that on the 16th. day of December 1770 he Intermarried with Mary his present Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holborn by whom he hath 4 Children living vizt. Job aged upwards of 16 years Elizth. aged upwards of 8 years Thos. aged upwards of Three years and William aged about 12 Months that he this Examint. Rented and lived in a House in Robinhood Court Shoe Lane in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn below the Barrs in the City of London for 2 years or thereabouts at the yearly Rent of Ten Guineas hath quitted said House about 7 years ago since which time he never Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Hannah Fisher aged about 33 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married that she lived Two years as a hired yearly Servant with one Jonah. Hopkinson a China Merchant of Knowles's Court Little Carter Lane in the City of London at the yearly Wages of £8..8..0 that the last 40 Days was of her Service was at her Masters Country House which was in Thomas Street Deptford in the Parish of Saint Nich at Deptford in the County of Kent that she hath quitted her sd: Service about 6 Months since which time she has not Rented any House Tens. or Lodging £10 a year or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Benjn. Newman one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes on behalf of Elizth. Price aged about 44 years who is ill upon his oath saith that he has been informed which by the said. Elizth. Price Information he verily believes to be true that she never was married Rented House Tent. or Lodging of £10 a year or paid Taxes on that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with a Mr. Walther a Baker opposite Shoreditch Church in the Pish of St. Leonard Shoreditch in the County of Middlesex for 14 Months at the yearly Wages of £7..0..0 that she has quitted same about 10 years since which time she has not lived as a hired yearly Servd. for one year or done any act to gain a Subsequent Settlement.

Mary Cust aged about 71 years upon her Oath saith about 20 years ago she being a Singlewoman & having no Child or Children living she went to live a hired yearly Servant with Dr. Watts in Charles Street Long Acre in the Parish of Saint Martin on the fields in the Liberty of Westmr. for 4 years & upwards at the yearly Wages of 6 Guas that He hath quitted her said Service about 16 years since which time she hath not done any Act Matter or Thing to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Oliver aged about 60 years upon her Oath saith that on the 11th. day of Augt. 1762 she Intermarried with Thos. Oliver her late Husband (who has been dead about 3 years ) at the Parish Church of St. Mary at Kensington that before her Intermarriage with her said late Husband he lived as a hired yearly Servd. with Henry Letouch Esqr . who lived at Kensington in the said Parish of St. Mary for 14 Months at the yearly Wages of £20 that he has done no Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year or Paying Taxes

Ann Curtis aged about 57 years upon her Oath saith that she Intermarried with James Curtis her late Husband (who has been dead about 12 years) at the Parish Church of Saint Bennett Grace Church in the City of London by whom she hath one Child living vizt. Makepeace aged about 13 years that her said late Husband in his Life time Rented and lived in a House in Blue Anchor Alley in the Parish of Saint Luke Old Street in the County of Middlesex for about Two years at the yearly Rent of £10 & paid all Taxes due for the same that he quitted said House about 9 Months before his decease during which time he never Rented any House Tent. or Lodging of the yearly Rent or Value of £10 paid Tax or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement nor hath this Ext. since her said late Husbands decease rented any House Tent. or Lodging of the yearly Rent or Value of £10 paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Wm. Acros of No. 17 in the Cloisters near St. Bartholomews Hospital on behalf of Fras. Acros this Ext. Mother who is insane Upon his Oath saith that he is the Son of the sd. Fras. Acros that upwards of 40 years ago his sd. Mother Fras Acros Intermarried with Jos: Acros his present Father at May Fair Chaple that his sd Father about 17 years ago bought a Lease of a House situate at Broad Wallnea the Nitre in the Parish of Christ Church Surry that he gave 28 pounds for the same subject to a Ground rent of £3..10..0 that he kept same for abt. 17 years & paid The Land Tax due for the same That his sd. Father has quitted same about 10 years since which time he has not read any place of the yearly Rent or Value of £10 paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Lee Read of No. 11 New Square Lincolns on behalf of Wm. Read an Infant of the age of 10 years or thereabouts (this Exts. Nephew) upon his Oath saith that Jas. Read this Exts. Brother & Father to the said Wm. Read Rented and lived in a House in Tothill Street Westmr. in the Pish of St. Margarett in the Liberty of Westmr . for 12 Months at the yearly Rent of £10 that he di in the said House whereby he did no Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Edward Mc.Carthy of No. 7 Clements Lane on behalf of Catherine Crowley an Infant of the Age of 5 years or thereabouts which was left at this Exts House on the 25th. day of June last past Maketh Oath & Saith that the said Cath: Crowley is the illegitimate of Child of one Rebecca Croke that the said Rebecca Croke Swore at the Parish of Saint John at Wapping in the Coy. of Middx the said illegitimate Child to one Chas. Crowley that the Officers of the sd. Parish took the said Chas . and bad Security from him that they allowed to the said Chas . 1s. Per week to Nurse & take care of it himself And further this Ext. Upon his Oath saith that the said Rebecca the Mother assd. lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Andrew Cailey a Publican in Sir Wm Warrens Square in the said Parish of Saint John at Wapping in the Coy. of Middx for 18 Months & upwards at the yearly Wages of £5 that she had quitted said Service about 5 years since which time she never lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year Rented any House Tent. or Lodging of £10 paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

William Croxon aged about 22 years upon his Oath saith that he never Rented any House Tent. or Lodging of the yearly Rent or Value of £10 paid Taxes lived as a hired yearly Servant ever bound an apprentice that this Exts. Father & Mother informed him which information he verily believes to be true that he was born in Jewin Street in the Parish of Saint Botolph without Aldersgate in the City of London that he has done no Act whatever to gain any other Settlement

Charles Tool aged about 54 years upon his Oath saith that in the Month of June 1779 he was married to Mary his present wife by a Dernish Priest (in a private Room at Ireland ) according to the Rites & Coremonies of the Roman Catholic Religion that in May 1780 the said Mary was delivered of a Male Bastard Child name John at the House of a Mr. Jones in Red Lyon Street in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middx that he this Ext. in Augt. 1783 was married to the said mary by a License in the Parish Church of St. Paul Covent Garden & that on the 29th. day of Janry. 1786 the said Wife was deced of a Boy which hath since been Christened by the Name of Chas . That this Ext. Rented and lived in a House in Great Shire Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx for 3 Months or thereabouts at the yearly Rent of £20 that he hath quitted said House about 3 Months since which time he has not Rented any House Tenemt. or Lodging of the yearly Rent of £10 for 40 days paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Tool aged upwards of 29 years upon her Oath saith that on the day of May 17 she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child (which hath since been Christened by the Name of John ) at the House of Mr. Jones a Publican in Red Lyon Street Holborn in the Parish of St. Andrew Holb above the Barrs in the County of Middx

Charles Tool aged about 54 years upon his Oath saith that in the Month of Augt. 1783 he Intermarried with Mary his present Wife at the Parish Church of St. Paul Covent Garden by License & by whom he hath Two Children living vizt. John aged about 8 years born a Bastard in the House of a Mr. Jones in Red Lyon Street Holborn in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn in the County of Middx and Chas . aged about 18 Months That he this Ext. Rented & lived in a House in Great Shire Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx for 3 Months at the yearly Rent of £20 that he hath quitted said House about 3 Months since which time he never Rented any House Tent. or Lodging of the yearly Rent of £10 for 40 days paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Edward Burbidge one of the Beadles of the Parish of St. Clement Danes on behalf of 2 illegitimate Children of Ann Pollord who has deserted them vizt. Ann aged about 4 years and Mary aged about 3 years Maketh Oath and Saith That he has been credibly informed which Information he verily believes to be true that the Ann the younger was born a Bastard in the Hou of one Mr. Lambley a Butcher in Fore Street in the Parish of Saint Giles Cripplegate in the City of London and that said Mary was likewise born a Bastard at the sd. Mr. Lambleys House in the Parish and City aforesaid

Elizth. Henderson aged upwards of 50 years upon her Oath saith that she is the Widow of Isaac Henderson who has been dead about 16 years & with whom she Intermarried at the Parish of St. Clement Danes about 30 years ago and by whom she hath no Children now living Says her said late Husband was bound an Apprentice to one Mr. Johnson a Buck maker in Church Court in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields and served his said Master for 5 years or thereabouts and then her said Husband Listed and went for a Soldier and never was Assigned over to any other Person neither did her said late Husband gain any other subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Sarah Bayzand aged about 30 years upon her Oath saith that in the Month of Janry. 1784 she Intermarried with one Jonan. Seddon Bayzand her present Husband (who has deserted her about 2 years at the Parish Church of Portsea in the County of Southampton and by whom she hath one Child living vizt. Harriott Lucy aged about 2 years & a half that her said Husband Rents and lives in a House in Pennington Street in the Parish of Saint George in the East in the County of Middx and he done for these 12 Months past or thereabouts at the yearly Rent of £10 and pays the Poors Tax due for the same
Elizabeth Wilkins aged about 2

Elizth. Self aged about 40 years upon her Oath saith that about 20 years ago she Intermarried with George Self her late Husband (who has been dead abot. 3 years) at the Parish Church of St. Mary at Newington in the Coy. of Surry and by whom she hath 4 Children livg. 3 of which are provided for & 1 unprovided for vizt. Margt . aged about 8 years that her said late Husband Served Seven years Appceship to one Mr. Hollingsworth a Rope maker in Lambeth Marsh in the Parish of St. Mary at Lambeth in the County of Surry that her said late Husband after he was out of his said Apprenticeship never Rented any House Tent. or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Elizth. Burley aged about 36 years upon her Oath saith that in the year 1773 she Intermarried with Chas. Burley her present Husband (who is at present ill in St. Bartholomews Hospital ) at the Parish Church of St. Mary Le Bone and by whom she hath 3 Children living vizt. Wm. aged about 8 years Jas . aged about 9 years and Elizth. aged about 3 years. That her said Husband Rented & lived in a House in Ogle Court in the said Parish of St. Mary Le Bone in the County of Middx for 3 years or Thereabouts at the yearly Rent of £30 & paid all Taxes due for the same that he hath quitted said House about 11 years ago since which time he has not Rented any House Tent. or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Thomas Shidley aged about 45 years upon her Oath saith That he lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Benjn. Smith a Cornfactor in Orange Street Leicester Fields in the parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the County of Middlesex for 15 years at the yearly Wages of £10 that he hath quitted said Service about 15 years ago since which time he has not lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year Rented House Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Elizth. Turpin aged about 27 years upon her Oath saith that she Intermarried with Jos: Turpin her present Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the fields on the 25th. day of July 1783 and whom she hath 2 Children living vizt. Elizth. aged upon of 2 years and Mary aged about 6 Months That she Ext. has been informed by her said Husband which information she believes to be true that he was bound an Apprentice to one Mr. Cook a Taylor in King Street Bloomsbury in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middx for 7 years that he served years of his said Apprenticeship And then run away that he never did any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Theodocia St. George aged about 33 years upon her Oath saith That she never was married Rented House Tent. or Lodging of £10 a year or paid Taxes that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mrs. Dulpiner in Millman Street in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn above she Bars in the County of Middlesex for 12 Months at the yearly Wages of Six Pounds that she hath quitted said Service about 7 years since which time she has not lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or done any Act. to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Lawrence aged about 63 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Carr a Taylor in Little Russell Street in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex for Two years and upwards at the yearly Wages of Six Pounds that she hath quitted said Serv about 14 - years ago since which time she has not lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Martha Lowden aged about 35 years upon her Oath saith that on the 10th. day of March 1773 she Intermarried with John Lowden at the Parish Church of St. George the Martyr that she this Ext. has not heard of or seen her said Husband for these 9 years last past therefore she does not know whether he be a live or dead that she never heard or does she know where her said Husband was born whether he ever was bound an Apprentice lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year Rented House Tent. or Lodging of £10 a year for 40 Days or paid Taxes That she this Ext. Rented a Two Pair of Stairs Floor and a Shop in Gate Street in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields for which she paid the yearly Rent of £17 that she lived in same for 2 Months and upwards that she hath quitted said Apartment about 3 years ago since which time she never Rented any House Tent. or Lodging of £10 a year or paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Jane Egen of No. 19 Little Shire Lane on behalf of Eleanor Crafts aged about 9 years and George aged about 6 years Two Children of Isabella Crafts in lays in at No. 19 in Little Shire Lane Maketh Oath and Saith that she this Ext. hath been informed by the said Isabella Crafts that she Intermarried with John Crafts (the Father of these Two Children) at the Parish Church of St. Leonard Shoreditch that he has been dead about 2 years & an half that he served 7 years Apprenticeship to one John King a Coal Dealer in Golden Lane in the Parish of St. Giles Cripplegate in the City of London that after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never did any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Martha Ranson aged about 32 years upon her Oath saith that in the year 1770 she Intermarried with Robt. Ranson (her late Husband who has been dead about 11 years) at the Parish Church of St. George Southwark that she hath Three Children living by her said late Husband vizt. John Phadre aged about 16 years and Lentillus aged about 11 years both provided for That her said late Husband Rented and Lived in a House the Corner of the Kath: Wheel Inn in the Borough in the Parish of St. George Southwark for Three years & upwards at the yearly Rent of £90 and paid Taxes due for the same that he had quitted said House about 12 Months before his Dece after which he never Rented any House Tent. or Lodging of £10 a year or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement nor hath this Ext. since her said late Husbands Death done any Act whereby she might have gained a Settlement in her own right

James Tallant aged Sixty Years or thereabouts upon his Oath saith that he Rented and lived in a House in Bedford Court in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the County of Middlesex and Liberty of Westminster at the yearly Rent of ten Guineas for about four years that he has quitted the same about Sixteen Years ago and since that he has not done any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of his Knowledge he may have gained any subsequent Settlement and that he is poor and Sick and unable to maintain himself

Catharine Carney Widow aged Sixty Six Years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that since the Deceased Richard Carney her late Husband and having only one Child Vizt. John Carney who at the time of her living herself as herein after is mentioned was bound out Apprentice and had acquired a Settlement in his own right she this Examinant lived as an hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Dillon at the Blakeneys Head in Bow Street Covent Garden at the yearly Wages of Six Pounds for about fifteen Months that she quitted her Service about Six Years ago and since then hath not done any Act Whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have acquired any subsequent Settlement

George Blakeney aged about 17 years upon his Oath saith That in the Month of August 1781 he was bound Apprentice by the Church wardens and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes to one John Brown a Peruke Maker who lived in Holborn in that part of the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn below the Bars in the City of that Lies in the Liberty of Saffron Hill Hatton Garden & Ely Rents London for 7 years that he served his said Master under such Indre upwards of Six Months that them his said Master broke and could not keep this Ext. no Conger that he this Ext. has never been Assigned over to any person or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Hannah Rockley aged about 48 years upon her Oath saith that in the year 1764 she Intermarried with Richd. Rockley her late Husband (who has been dead upwards of 13 years) at the Parish Church of Saint Dunstan in the West in the City of London that her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in Buckeridge Street in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex for 12 Months or thereabouts at the yearly Rent of £12..12..0 that she hath quitted said House about 13 years ago since which time she hath not Rented any House Tent. or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Benjn. Newman one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes on behalf of Edwd. Martin who is at present rather disordered in his mind Maketh Oath and Saith that he has been informed which Information he verily believes to be true that the said Edward Martin in the Month of June 1786 he took of one John Williams in Stone Cutter Court Crutched Fryars in the Parish of Saint Olave Hart Street in the City of London Two Parlours for which he pays the yearly Rent of £10 that he only quitted same last Thursday therefore can have done no Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Edward Burbridge one of the Beadle of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes upon his Oath saith that he hath been informed and which Information he believe to be true that Sarah Hadd a and in the Workhouse of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes aforesaid in the Daughter of Thomas and Sarah Hadd of the Parish of Saint Leonard Shoreditch in the County of Middlesex and never gained any legal Settlement in her own right ever been married.

Benjamin Newman one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex Maketh Oath that Richard Chilest a Panper now in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes Oath information this Examinants and which Information he believes to be true that he the said Richard Chilest rented & lived in a House in Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex at the Yearly rent of twenty Pounds and thereby gained a settlement in the said Parish of Saint Giles and that he hath never done any that whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlemt.

Sarah Sterling aged about 39 years upon her Oath saith that about 22 years ago she Intermarried with Wm. Sterling her present Husband at the Parish Church of St. Martin in the fields and by whom she hath 5 Children living 3 of whom are provided for and Two unprovided for vizt. Sarah aged about 11 years and Cath : aged about 6 years That her said Husband Served the latter part of his Apprenticeship to one Mr. Disterberry a Taylor in Cecil bound St. Martins Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . that he has never Rented any House Tent. or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any act to gain a Subsequent Settlemt.

Benjamin Newman one of the Parish of St. Clement Danes Yeoman maketh Oath & Saith That he has been informed that a Female Child named Mary Butter , the Child of Lucy Emblan a Singlewoman who never was married was born at the House of Mr. John Smith , in Swan Yard in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Strand and further Saith that the said Child is now Chargeable to the Parish of St. Clement Danes and is as this Deponent is informed Illegitimate.

Mary Wood aged about 20 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House paid Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or ever bound an Apprentice that she was born in Charles Street Covent Garden in the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden in the County of Middlesex That her Father was an Irishman and never gained any Settlement in England

Fulton Thomas aged about 52 years upon his Oath saith that about 23 years ago herented & lived in a House in Lambs Conduit Passage in the Parish of Saint George the Martyr in the County of Middlesex for 18 Months or thereabouts at the yearly Rent of £21 and paid Taxes due for the same that since he quitted said House he has not Rented any Place of the yearly Rent of £10 paid Taxes or done any act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Ann Owen aged about 30 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Barker in Old Compton Street she in the Parish of St. Anne in the Liberty of westmr. for 12 Months & upwards at the yearly wages of Six Pounds that she hath quitted said Service about 2 years ago since which time she has not lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Brown of No: 162 in the Strand in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes on behalf of James Thomas an Infant aged about 11 weeks whose Mother is ill in St. George Hospital Maketh Oath and Saint that the said James Thomas was born in the workhouse belonging to the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields

Jane Kent of Little Stanhope Street on behalf of Thos. Prime who is at present il maketh Oath and Saith that said Thomas Prime belongs to the Parish of Saint Mary Staining in the City of London as appears by a Certificate granted signed by the Churchwns. & Overseers of the Poor of the said Parish of Saint Marys on the 17th. day of Augt. 1786

Edward Burbidge on behalf of Thos. Keppell who is ill Maketh Oath and Saith that he has been informed by the said Thos. which Information he believes to be true that the said Thos. is about 50 years of age that he Rented and lived in a House in Horsley Down Back Street in the Parish of Saint John Southwark for 9 Months & upwards at the yearly Rent of £18 - that he hath quitted said House about 16 years ago since which time he has not Rented any Place of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Susannah Fletcher aged about 29 years upon her Oath saith that about 6 years ago she Intermarried with Moses Joseph Fletcher her late Husband (who has been dead about 10 Months) at the Parish Church of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr. and by whom she hath one Child living vizt.
