John Archibald aged about Two years That her said late Husband was an Irishman & never gained any Settlement in England that before her Intermarriage she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mrs. Sillitox who kept Bakers Coffee House Change Alley Lombard Street in the Parish of Saint Mary Woolnorth in the City of London for 2 years & upwards at the yearly wages of Eight Guineas hath quitted said Service upwards of Six years ago since which time she has not lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or done any act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Thomas Williams aged about 57 years upon his Oath saith That he Rented a Shop & Parlows of a Mr. Earle in New Round Court in the Strand in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the County of Middx for 4 Months & upwards at the yearly Rent of Fourteen Guineas that he hath quitted said Tent. about a Month since which time he has done no act to gain a Subsequent. Settlement That he has 2 Children living vizt. Thos. lived about 12 years and Selena aged about 5 years by this Exts. Wife vizt. Mary to whom he Intermarried with about 22 years ago at the Parish Church of Constantine in the County of Cornwall

Ann Smith aged upwards of 40 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married That she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Benman a Goldbeaters in Duke Street in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex for Two years & upwards at the yearly wages of Seven Pounds that she hath quitted said Service about Two years since which time she has not lived as a yearly Servant for 12 Months or Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year or paid Taxes

Sarah Berry aged about 18 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House paid Taxes lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or ever bound an Apprentice That her Mother informed her that her late Father gained a Settlement in the Parish of Westham in the County of Essex where that her said late Father died in the Workhouse belonging to the said Parish of Westham where her Mother now is

Ann Gilson aged about 30 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Cort in Lincolns Inn Field in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex for Two years and upwards at the yearly wages of Eight Guineas hath quitted said Service about 14 years ago since which time she has not lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or done any act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Cole aged about 17 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married that about 2 years ago she was bound apprentice by the Churchwardens and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square for Seven years th to one Robert Nash late of the Strand Japan that she was discharged from her said Master yesterday that the last Forty days of her said apprenticeship to the said Robert Nash was in Catherine Street in the Strand in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Strand

James Talboys and Mary Gamon for themselves severally make Oath and might And first this Deponent Mary Gammon for herself saith that on the 29th. day of February 1784 she Intermarried with Fras. Gammon her present Husband at the Parish Church of Saml. Mary Whitechaple in the County of Middlesex And James Talboys for himself saith that he has been informed by Richd. Gammon the Father of the said Francis which Information he verify believes to be true that the said Francis was an illegitimate Child born at the Sign of the Crown in Ormand Yard in the Parish of Saint George the Martyr in the County of Middlesex that he never was bound apprentice lived as a hired yearly Servant for one years ever Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Jane Sale aged about 46 years upon her Oath saith that about 19 years ago she Intermarried with George Sane her late Husband (who has been dead about 7 years) at the Parish Church of Saint George Bloomsbury that her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in great wild Street in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex for 18 Months and upwards at the yearly Rent of £33 that he quitted said House about 15 Months before his Death during which time he never Rented any House Tent. or Lodging of £10 a year or paid Taxes nor hath this Ext. since her said late Husbands Death Rented any House Tent. or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any act to gain a Settlement in her own right

Benjamin Newman one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex (on the Behalf Jane Middleton aged 22 years or thereabouts who is ill) upon his Oath Saith. that he has been informed by the said Jane Middleton which information he believes to be true that she never was married Rented House Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year That she never lived as a hired Yearly Servant That her Father kept a House in White Hart Yard in the Parish of Saint Martins in the fields at the Yearly Rent of £22 That since she Quitted said House she has done no act matter or Thing whereby she may have gained a subsequent Settlement to the best of this Examt. Knowledge and Belief.

Joshua Prosser aged about 48 years upon his Oath saith that whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired yearly Servant with Fras. Thompson who kept the Nags Head Tavern in Leaden hall Street in the Parish of Saint Peters Cornhill in the City of London for 4 years or thereabouts at the yearly wages of Twelve Guineas that he hath quitted said Service about Eleven years ago since which time he hath not lived as a hired yearly Servant for One year Rented any House Tenement at or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Richd. Coxe aged 32 or thereabouts upon his Oath saith that he intermarried with Rebbecca his Present Wife about 4 years age at allhallows Church Thomas Street , that about 2 months before such Intermarriage she was delivered of a Child who was Richard Coxe in an Hospital yearly gained (as this deponent believes) siter all beyond Oxford Street Turnpike That she the said Rebecca which single had lived as a Hired Yearly Servant at the Dyer Anns in Thames Street in the Parish of Saint allhallows the Great that she lived there about 4 or 5 years as this Deponent believes at the Yearly Wages of 4 or 5s. That time she quitted such serviceshe has not done any act matter or thing to gain a Settlement to the best of this Deponents Knowledge or belief

Ann Farrall aged about 58 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes lived as a hired Yearly Servant for one year or ever bound an Apprentice that she was born in King Street Covent Garden in the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden in the County of Middx that her Father Rented House there for sevl. years that she has done no act to gain any other Settlement than by Ba

James Talboys One of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes maketh Oath and Saith that he has been credibly Informed which Information he believes to be true that Rebecca Cox the Mother of Richd. Cox an Infant aged about 4 years born a Bastard in a Licensed Hospital lived as a hired yearly Servant when Single at the Dyers Arms in Cole Harbour in the Parish of Allhallows the Less in the City of London for 12 Months and upwards at the yearly wages of £4 or £5 that after she quitted said Service she has done no act to gain any other Settlement

Charles Brown aged about 70 years upon her Oath saith that about 23 years ago he rented and lived in a House in St. James's Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr. for 3 years or thereabout at the yearly Rent of £60 hath quitted said House about 20 years ago since which time he has not rented any House Tent. or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

John Jeffreys Sealey aged 23 Years upon his Oath Saith that he rented a House and Shop in Leadenhall Markeh for 6 Months at the Yearly Rent of £40 a Year that since he quitted said House he has done no Act matter or thing whereby he may have gained a Subsequent Settlement

Ann Hard aged about 30 years upon his Oath saith that she Intermarried with Patrick Hart her present Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes about 11 years ago that her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Fleet Lane in the Parish of Saint Sepulchre in the City of London for about 3 Years at the yearly Rent of £14 that he hath quitted said House about 8 years ago since which time she hath done no Act gain a Subsequent Settlement

James Baxter aged about 40 years upon his Oath saith that about he has an illegitimate Child living by his late Wife Jane vizt. Margarett aged about 7 years born a Bastard at No. 8 Crown Court Whites Yard Rosemary Lane in the Parish of Saint Mary White Chapel alias Matfellon in the County of Middlesex

Thomas Ingerston aged about 76 years upon his Oath saith that he Rented & lived in a House in Phoenix Alley Saint Martins Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields for about 4 years at the yearly Rent of £18 that he hath quitted said House about 30 years ago since which time he has not Rented any House Tent. or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Harrison aged about of No:1 Three Herring Court Red Cross Street Spinster Maketh Oath and Saith That Mary Harriet Harrison the illegitimate Child of Mary Gray formerly Harrisons Now of the Age of Six year or thereabouts was born in the House of Appleyard a Baker in Charles Street Westmr. in the Parish of Saint Margaret Westmr. and that the said Mary Harrison the Mother never was that this Deponent knows of or believes Married before she was delivered of the said Child and that Richard Ireland late of Bow Street Covent Garden deceased was as this Deponent hath been informed by the said Mary Harrison the Mother and Verily believes the real and true Father of the said Child.

Elizabeth Harrison of No.1 Three Herring Court Red Cross Street Spinst Maketh Oath and Saith That Jonathan Harrison the illegitimate Child of Mary Gray formerly Harrison now of the Age of Ten years or thereabouts was born in Store Street Tottenham Court Road in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex that he was not born in the Tying in Hospital but in a Private House on the opposite Side of the Way and that the said Mary Harrison the Mother never was that this dept. knows of or believes Married before she was deled of the said Child and that Richard Ireland late of Bow Street Covent Garden deceased was as this Deponent hath been informed by the said Mary Harrison the Mother and Verily believes the real and true Father of the said Child

John Cobden aged about 60 years upon his Oath saith that in the year 1762 he Intermard. with Ann his present Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Mary Magdalen Bermondsey that he Rented and lived in a House in Shire Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex for 18 Months or thereabouts & the yearly Rent of £14 that he hath quitted said House about 6 years ago since which time he has not Rented any House Tenement on Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Jane Morris aged about 61 years upon her Oath saith that about she never was married Rented House of paid Taxes that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with a Mr. Bullock in Frith Street Soho in the Parish of Saint Annes in the Liberty of Westmr. for Two years & upwds. at the yearly wages of £5 that she hath quitted said Service about 12 Years ago since which time she has not lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Elizth. Powell aged about 21 years upon her Oath saith that she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with a Mrs. Varlav in Mount Street Grosvenor Square in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex for Twenty Months and upwards at the yearly Wages of £5 that she hath quitted said Service about 5 years since which time she has not lived as a hired yearly servant for one year Rented House paid Taxes one done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Sarah Hudd aged about 19 years upon her Oath saith that she is the Daughter of Thomas and Sarah Hudd who as this Deponent has been informed belongs to the Parish of Saint Leonard Shoreditch in the County of Middlesex and that this Examinant never did any Act in her own Right to gain a Settlement

Robert Burnett aged about 30 years upon his Oath saith that he was bound an Apprentice by the Trustees belonging to Saint Giles's Charity School to a Mr. Meredith a Shoemaker in Orange Street in the Parish of Saint George the Martyr for Seven years that after he served about 5 years of his said Apprenticeship his said Master moved to Gilbert Street in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex that he went his said Master and served the Remainder of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Hannah Bentley aged about 30 years upon her Oath saith that she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with Mr. John Bannister the Comedian in Great Russell Street Covent Garden in the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden for about Eighteen Months and in Bow Street in the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden for Six Months that after she quitted said Service she nerver lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement That she hath One Child living Vizt. James aged about 5 years born a Bastard at Camberwell in the County of Surry

Benjamin Newman one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex on the behalf of Catharine Lenoir aged 25 or thereabouts Upon this Oath Saith That he has has been informd which information he believes to be true that her father kept House on Snow Hill that after his death her Mother went to live in Walworth in the County of Surry that she lived there and Rented House for upwards of One Year that after since she quitted her said Mother she has done no Act Matter or thing whereby she may have gained a subsequent Settlement to the best of this Examinants knowledge and belief

Benjamin Newman One of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes Maketh Oath and saith That he has been informed which Information he believes to be true John Wilson an Infant aged upwards of Three Months was born a Bastard in Saint Anns Workhouse in the Parish of Saint Anne in the Liberty of Westmr.

Sophia Burney aged 21 years or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith That she lived with Mr. Mills of Blue Cross Street Leicester Fields in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the County of Middlesex as a Hired Yearly Servant at £4:0:0 Year, that she a for upwards of the Year that she quitted that Service about 5 years ago since which Time she has not done any Act Matter or Thing whereby she may have gained the a Settlement And Saith that she never was Married

Mary Taylor aged about 59 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or ever bound an Apprentice that her Father William Taylor Served Seven years apprenticeship with a Mr. Cole a Cooper in Coopers Row in the Parish of Saint Olave Hart Street in the City of London that after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never did any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Benjamin Newman one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes Maketh Oath and Saith that he has been informed which Information he believes to be true that Elizabeth Perrott an Infant was born a Bastard at the House of a Mr. Marsh a Hair Dresser in Fleet Lane in the Parish of Saint Sepulchre in the City of London

Sarah Ward aged about 27 years upon her Oath Saith that about 4 years ago she Intermarried with Arthur Ward her present Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Giles Cripplegate & by whom she hath one Child living Vizt. Ann aged about 15 Months That her said Husband never did any Act in his own Right to gain a Settlement that his Father Thos. Ward Served his time as an Apprentice to a Mr Hall a Sawyer in Barbricam in the Parish of Saint Giles without Cripplegate that after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never did Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Lucy Taylor aged about 25 years upon her Oath saith that about 3 years ago she Intermarried with Thomas her late Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes that her said Husband has been dead about Five Months that her said late Husband served Seven years Apprenticeship to a Mr. Clarkson in Windmill Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster Plater that after he was Out of his said Apprenticeship he never did any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement That this Examinant has Two Children living by her said late Husband Vizt. John aged about Two years and Ann aged about 4 Months

Ann Murray Widow upon her Oath Saith that she is the Widow of William Murray her late Husband who was an Irishman born and never as this Examinant believes acquired a Settlement in this Thingdon and this Examinant further Saith that She lived as an hired Yearly Servant whilst she was Single and unmarried and not having Child or Children with Mr. Hitchcock a Porter Butcher in Saint James's Market in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middlesex for upwards of one Year-that since Earthing her Said Service she hath nor to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief gained any Subsequent Settlement

Edward Burbidge one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex upon his Oath saith that he has been informed and believes that Marry Price a Pauper who now is in the said Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the Wife of William Priest to whom she was Married about thirty two Years ago that her said Husband rented a House in Great Chapel Street Oxford Road in the Parish of Saint Ann within the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middlesex a yearly Rent of upwards of ten pounds & that he has gained a Subsequent Settlement

Susannah Nags aged about 31 years upon her Oath saith that on lthe 10th. day of April now last past she this Ext. Intermarrd. with Thomas her present Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex that her said Husband served his Time at Lisson Green in the County of Durham that on the 28th. day of Augt. 1786 she this Examinant was delivered of a Male Bastard Child at the House of a Mr. Jones in Shorts Gardens in the said Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex which hath since been Christened by the Name of Thomas

Benjamin Newman one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes on behalf of Ann Wicks who will Maketh Oath and Saith that he has been informed by the said Ann which information he believes to be true that she is about 24 years of Age that she intermarried with James her present Husband at the Chapel in Kentish Town about 9 years ago that she has one Child living by her said Husband Vizt. James aged about 8 years that her said Husband served his Time as an Apprentice to one Mr. Withey a Shoemaker in Kentish Town in the Parish of Saint Pancras in the County of Middlesex that after her said Husband was out of his said Apprenticeship he Never did any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

James Hope aged about 50 years upon his Oath saith that he Intermarried with Sarah his present Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Pancras about 19 years ago that he rented and lived in a House in Bedford Street in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn above the Bars for Six Months at the Yearly Rent of £25 that he hath quitted said House about 10 years Since which time he has done no Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Lawrence Foy aged thirty five or thereabouts upon his Oath Saith that he lived as an hired Yearly Servant for upwards of a Year with Mrs. Leigh of Cross Street Islington in the Parish of Saint Mary Islington in the County of Middlesex at the Yearly Wages of ten pounds or thereabouts that he was single and unmarried not having Child or Children during such his Servitude that he has quitted the said Mr Leigh Service about three Years ago, and since quitting the same has not done any Act whereby to the best of his Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained any other or Subsequent Settlement And this Deponent further Saith that he was married to Elizabeth his now Wife at the Parish Church of Kensington in the County of Middlesex by Barns according to the rites of the Church of England about One Year and three Quarters of a Year ago, that he this Deponent is poor and unable to maintain himself and his said Wife

Ann Johnson singlewoman aged 16 Years or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith That She is the Daughter of James and Hannah Johnson that Her Father kept the Taylors Arms Clements Lane 5 or 6 Years, That her Mother a few Months ago. took a House in Mint Street in the Parish of St. George in the Borough of Southwark that she took it of a Mr. Henderson of Mint Street at the Yearly Rent of £12: that She lived with her Mor. there near 4 Months, that her Mothers Sister lived with Them and lent her Mother the Money To pay the Rent-that her Father is in the Fleet and she is Poor and unable to maintain herself.

Margaret Hughes aged about 48 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married that she has one Child living Vizt. James aged upwards of Eight years born a Bastard in the House of a Mr. Hughes in Bell Court Grays Inn Lane in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex and that he never did any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Robert Gibbeson aged about 51 years upon his Oath saith that he lived as hired Yearly Servant with Robert Richard Gammon in Lawrence Poulteney Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin Ongar in the City of London for Twelve Months and upwards at the yearly Wages of Fourteen Pounds that he hath quitted Said Service about Fifteen Years ago that he hath quitted said Service ab since which time he has done No Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Hood aged about 39 years upon her Oath saith that on the 18th. day of Augt 1783 she Intermarried with Samuel her late Husband (who has been dead about Nine Months) at the Parish Church of Camberwell that she hath Two Children living by her said late Husband Vizt. Samuel aged about Five years and John aged about Nineteen Months that her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House the Corner of Angel Alley without Bishopgate in the Parish of Saint Botolph without Bishopgate in the City of London for Eighteen Months or thereabouts at the yearly Rent of £30 that he quitted said House about 4 years since during which time he never Rented any house Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year or did any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Ann Singer aged about 20 years upon her Oath saith that She never was married that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with Mrs. Wild in King Street Golden Square in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster for Three years at the yearly Wages of £5 that she hath quitted said Service in March last since which time She has done no Act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Mary O'Daniel aged about 30 years upon how Oath saith that about four years ago she Intermarried with Owen O'Daniel at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the fields that her said Husband has deserted her about Six Months that he was an Irishman and never gained any Settlement in England That she this Examnt lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Flower in George Yard Lombard Street in the Parish of Saint Edmund the King in the City of London for Two years on thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Seven Guineas that she hath quitted said service about Six years since which time she has not lived as a hired Yearly Servant for one year or done any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement

William Bradbury aged about 34 years upon his Oath saith that about 13 years ago he Intermarried with Ann his present wife at the parish Church of Saint Clement Danes that he has four Children living by his said Wife vizt. William aged about Twelve years George aged about Ten years Joseph aged about Eight years and Ruth aged upwards of Three years that he has been informed by his Mother which information he verily believes to be true that he was born in High Street Saint Giles's in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex and that he has done no Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

George Michael Mills aged about 36 years upon his Oath saith that he never Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes Served any Apprenticeship or ever lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year That he was born at Croydon in the Parish of Croydon in the County of Surry where this Examinants father served his Time

Eleanor Albon aged about 19 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Cohen in Duke Street Saint James's in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster for Fifteen Months at the yearly Wages of Six Pounds that she hath quitted said Service about Eighteen Months since which time she has not lived as a hired yearly Servant for One year or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

William Treves aged about 30 years upon his Oath saith that he served Seven years Apprenticeship all but four Months with one James Duxton in Wells Mews Oxford Road in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex Chimney Sweeper that after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or did any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

John Durr aged about 40 years upon his Oath saith that about 14 years ago he Intermarried with Catherine his present Wife at the State house Amsterdam according to the rites and Ceremonies of the Church of England that he this Examinant Rented and lived in a House in Falcon Bridge Court in the Parish of Saint Annes in the Liberty of Westmr. for about 3 years at the yearly Rent of Sixteen Pounds that he hath quitted said House about 7 Years since which time he has not Rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Benjamin Newman one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes on behalf of Elizabeth Tracey who is insane Maketh Oath and Saith That he has been informed which Information he verily believes to be true that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Williams a Taylor in Marybone Street Shug Lane in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster for Twelve Months and upwards that she quitted said service in April last since which time she has done no Act to gain a Subsequent Settlemt.

Benjamin Newman one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes on behalf of Mary Smith aged about Ten years Thomas Smith aged about Eight years and Richard Lewis Smith aged about four years the Legitimate Children of Thomas Smith who has deserted them Maketh Oath and saith that he has been informed which Information he verily believes to be true that the said Thomas Smith Rented a House and Land in the Parish of the Holy Trinity in the City of Coventry for about Six years at the yearly Rent of Eighty Pounds and upwards that he hath quitted said Premes about Six Months since which time he has not Rented any Place of Ten Pounds a year or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Hesse aged about 16 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or ever bound an Apprentice nor to the best of her knowledge never lived as a hired yearly servant for One year at one time that she was born in East Smithfield in the Parish of Saint John Wapping in the County of Middlesex that her Father kept House in the said Parish for several years

Matthew Jackson aged about 31 years upon his Oath saith that he intermarried Martha his present wife at the Parish Church of Saint Sepulchres about Eight years ago and by whom he hath One Child living vizt. William aged about four years that he this Examinant served five years Apprenticeship to his Brother Edward Clarke in the Parish of Saint Sepulchre in the City of London that after he was out of his said Apprentiship he never Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Mary Gladman aged about 25 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with Mr. King a Butcher in Bridges Street in the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden in the County of Middlesex for Two years at the yearly Wages of Eight Guineas that she hath quitted said Service about four years since which time she has not lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or done any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Jane Norman of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes aforesaid upon her Oath Saith that Mary, Ann Norman a poor Child who in now in the said Parish of Saint Clement Danes is the Child of Jeffry Norman by living his first Wife and that the place of the legal Settlement of the said Jeffry Norman the father is in the Parish of Saint Mary Newington in the County of Surry he having rented a House of the yearly Value of Sixteen Guineas in that Parish and lived therein serve two years Since when he hath with done any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement & this Examinant further Saith that the said Mary Ann Norman is about four years old, that her Father hath deserted her and left her with this Deponent and that She this Examinant is not able to maintain her

Matthew Jackson aged about 31 years upon his Oath saith that he Intermarried with Martha his present Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Sepulchres and by whom he hath One Child living vizt. William aged about four years that he this Examinant served Five years Apprenticeship to his Brother Edward Clarke in the Parish of Saint Sepulchre without in the County of Middlesex that after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

John Finch aged about 22 years upon his Oath saith that he lived as a hired yearly Servant with a Mr. Clarke in Princes Street in the Parish of Saint Margaret in the Liberty of Westminster for about Five years at the yearly Wages of Twelve Guineas that he hath guitted said Service about Eight Weeks since which time he has done no Act to gain subsequent Settlement

John Hirst aged about 51 years upon his Oath saith that he served four Years Apprenticeship to one Mr. Battishill an Organist in Orange Street Bloomsbury in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex that after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Slaton Wife of Richard Slaton Cooper, upon her Oath Saith that she was married to Richard Slaton her Husband at the Parish of Pancras in the County of Middlesex on the Third Day of June 1787 That the said Richard Slaton Served his time as an Apprentice in the Parish of Mary Le bone in the County of Middlesex with his own Father and Since that time has not done any other Act Matter or thing to the best of this Examinant Knowledge Information and belief whereby he may have acquired any Subsequent Settlement

Eleanor Harris aged about 60 years upon her Oath Saith that about 35 years ago She Intermarried with Adam Harris her late Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Chads in Shrewsbury that her said late Husband Rented a House at Islington in the Parish of Saint Mary at Islington for about Ten years at the yearly Rent of Thirteen Pounds that she has one Child living vizt. Susannah aged about 27 years that her said husband Daughter never lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or ever bound an Apprentice

Samuel Foster aged about 30 years upon his Oath saith that on the 15th. day of January 1787 he Intermarried with Ann his present Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Philip at Birmingham and by whom he hath one Child living vizt. Mary Ann aged about Eighteen Months That he this Examinant was bound an Apprentice to a Mr. James Petty a Smith in Bear Yard Clare Markett for Seven years that after he had served Five years of his said Apprenticeship his said Master moved out of Bear Yard to Great Wild Street in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex where this Examinant served the remainder of his Apprenticeship and was discharged that since he has left his said Master he has not rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Mary Brown aged about 48 years upon her Oath saith that She never was married Rented House or paid Taxes that She lived as a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Close a Victualler in Warwick Lane in the Parish of Christ Church in the City of London for about Two years at the yearly wages of Six Pounds that She hath quitted said Service about Twelve Years since which time She hath not lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or done any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Tregal aged about 69 years upon her Oath saith that She Intermarried with George her late Husband at the Fleet about 50 years ago that her said late Husband has been dead about Two years that he served Seven years Apprenticeship to Mr. James in Marsham Street in the Parish of Saint John in the Liberty of Westminster Shoemaker and that after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year or done any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Benjamin Haswell aged about 16 years upon his Oath saith that on the 31st. day of May 1787 s he was bound Apprentice to George Rouse of Monmouth Street in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields for Seven years that after he had served about Twenty Months of his said Apprenticeship his said Master moved into Brills Place Pancras in the Parish of Saint Pancras in the County of Middlesex and that he lived with his said Master in Brills Place aforesaid for about Three Months

Elizabeth Veartey aged about 25 years upon her Oath saith that on the 29th. day of June 1784 She Intermarried with William Veartey who is gone to the East Indies at the Parish Church of Saint Mary Le Bone and by whom she hath one Child living namely Ann aged about fourteen Months that her said Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired yearly Servant with a Mr. Raiksted in Berners Street in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex for Eighteen Months and upwards and that after he quitted said Service he never lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year Rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Richard Tuder aged about 80 years upon his Oath saith that he Rented a House in Southampton Buildings Chancery Lane in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for about Seven Years at the yearly Rent of £20 that he hath quitted said House about Twelve Years since which time he has not rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Jane Fluck aged about 42 years upon her Oath saith That she Intemarried with John Fluck her present husband who is ill at the Parish Church of Eltham in the County of Kent that her said Husband lived as a hired yearly Servant with a Mr. Hogg in Sambrook Court in Basinghall Street in the parish of Saint Michael Bassishaw in the City of London for Twelve Months and upwards at the yearly Wages of Nineteen Guineas that he hath quitted said Service upwards of Twelve years since which time he has not rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Ann Scannan aged about 45 years upon her Oath saith that She Intermarried with Wm. Scannan her late Husband in a Room at Cork by a Roman Catholic Priest about 26 years ago that her said Husband has been dead about 14 Months That her said Husband was an Irishman and never gained any Settlement in England and That she this Examinant is an Irishwoman and never gained any Settlement in England That she has one Child living by her said late husband vizt. Ann aged about Eight years born at the house of a Mr. Dunstan in Exeter Street in the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden in the County of Middlesex

Ann Soames aged about 72 years upon her Oath saith that she Intermarried with Wm. Somes her late husband at the parish Church of Saint andrew Holborn that her said Husband Rented a House Called or known by the name or Sign of the Kings Head Pimlico in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the county of Middlesex for Four years at the yearly Rent of Fifty two Guineas that he hath quitted said House about Twelve years since which time he has not Rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Ann Gow aged about 43 years upon her Oath saith that she lived as a lived yearly Servant with Mrs. Seymour in Oxford Road in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex for Twenty Months at the yearly Wages of Eight Guineas that she hath quitted said service about six Months since which time she has not done any Act to gain a subsequent settlement

Ann Gow aged about 43 years upon her Oath saith that she Rented Two Parlours of a Mr. Fairly in Plumb Tree Street in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex for Twelve Months and upwards at the yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds that she hath quitted said apartments about Twelve seven Months years since which time she has not done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Ann Lloyd aged about 29 years upon her Oath saith that in the Month of Janry. last she Intermarried with Wm. Lloyd her present Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Margat Lambeth that her said Husband was bound an Apprentice to a Mr. Hutton in the Temple Hairdresser that he was then turned over to a Mr. Sherwood in Saint Martins Lane and afterwards to a Mr. Kitchen nearly facing Hatton Garden in the Parish of Saint andrew Holborn below the Bars in the City of London where he served the last part of his apprenticeship and that after he was out of his said apprenticeship he never rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or done any act Matter or Thing to the best of this Examinants knowledge Informed or belief to gain a subsequent settlement

Ann Bilby aged about 66 years upon her Oath saith that she Intermarried with James Bilby her late Husband (who has been dead about Twenty years) at the Fleet London about Forty years ago. That her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in Stable yard Street Greenwich in the Parish of Greenwich in the County of Kent for several years at the yearly Rent of Six Pounds and paid all manner of Taxes due for the same that after her said late Husband quitted said House he never Rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or did any act to gain a subsequent settlement nor hath this Examinant since her said late Husbands Doath done any Act to gain & settlement

George Bromley aged about 19 years upon his Oath saith that he was born in Wild Street in the Parish of saint Clement Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex that he never was bound an apprentice lived as a lived yearly servant for one year or done any Act to gain a Settlement

Esther White of great shire Lane on behalf of John Sidley an Infant aged about Three years Maketh Oath and saith that she has been informed which Information she verily believes to be true that the said John Sidley was born a Bastard on Garlick Hill in the Parish of saint James Garlick at Hith Church in the City of London

Amey Sidney aged about 28 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with Richard Powell who lived in Batemans Row in the Parish of saint Leonard shoreditch in the County of Middlesex for Three years or thereabouts at the yearly Wages of Eight Guineas that the hath quitted said service about Two Years since which time she has not lived as a hired yearly servant for one year or done any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Benjamin Newman one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes on behalf of Mary Barton who is ill Maketh Oath and saith that he has been informed which Information he verily believes to be true that she Intermarried with John Barton her late husband at the Parish Church of Heston Middlesex about Eighteen years ago That the said John Barton served an apprenticeship of seven years under an Indenture with Humphry Barton his Father in Portsmouth street in the Parish of saint Clement D Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex and hath not obtained any subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Field aged about 30 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married that she lived as a hired yearly servant with Miss James in Lime Street in the Parish of Saint Dionis in the City of London for Twelve months and upwards at the yearly wages of £5 that she hath quitted said service about Three years Nine months ago since which time she has done no act to gain a subsequent settlement

John Hodley aged forty nine year or thereabouts upon his Oath saith that he rented and lived in a House No.172 High Holborn in the Parish of saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex or the yearly rent of twenty five pounds and afterwards of fifteen pounds for about two years that he quitted the said Hame about five years ago since where he hath not done any act whereby to the best of his knowledge he may have acquired any subsequent Settlement

Margaret Downing aged about 28 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married that she lived as a hired yearly servant with Mr. Foster a Jeweller in Richmond Buildings in the Parish of Saint Anne in the Liberty of Westminster for Twelve Months and upwards at the yearly wages of six Guineas that she hath quitted said Service about five years-since which time she has done no act to gain a subsequent Settlement

John Stevens aged about 29 years upon his Oath saith that in the year 1782 he Rented and lived in a House in the Savoy in the Precinct of the savoy in the County of Middlesex for Three Months at the yearly Rent of Thirty pounds that he hath quitted said house about seven years since which time he hath not rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes on done any Act to gain a subsequent settlement

Mary Howard aged about 69 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married lived as a hired yearly servant for one year ever bound an apprentice or Rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year or paid Taxes that she was born at Bedford in the Parish of Saint Paul in the county of Bedford where her Father was bred and born and fivethere this Examinant on behalf of sarah Howard her Sister further maketh Oath and saith that her said sister was born in the said Parish of saint Paul in the County of Bedford and that she never gained any settlement either by Marriage Renting house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paying Taxes ever living as a hired yearly servant for one year on ever being bound an apprentice

John Pitts aged about 43 years upon his Oath saint that he lived as a hired yearly servant with one Peneston Topper who kept the sign of the Roya Hospital at Chelsea in the Parish of Saint Luke Chelsea in the County of Middlesex for Fifteen Month and upwards at the yearly wages of seven Guineas that he hath quitted said service about seven years since which time he hath not lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year Rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or done any act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Waine aged about 58 years upon her Oath saith that about 28 years ago she Intermarried with Wm Thos. Waine who has been dead about Eighteen months at the Parish Church of Saint Mary Overys That her said late Husband before his Intermarriage to this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman lived as a hired yearly servant with one Saml. Lloyd a Tobacconist in Threadneedle street in the Parish of saint Bennett Fink in the City of London for Twelve months and upwards at the yearly wages of Forty Guineas that after he quitted said service he never Rented any house Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or did any act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Sarah Wood aged about 22 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Clarke at old Bedland in the Parish of St. Botolph Bishopgate in the City of London for Eighteen Months at the yearly Wages of Four Pounds that she hath quitted said service about Four years since which time she hath not lived as a hired yearly servant for Twelve Months or done any Act to gain a subsequent settlement

James Talboys one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes on behalf of Catherine Parker who is ill Maketh Oath and saith That he has been informed which Information he verily believes to be true that the said Catherine Parker Rented and lived in a house near the Sheep Pens in the Parish of Saint Sepulchre within in the City of London for upwards of Twenty years at the yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and upwards and that after she quitted said house she never did any Act to gain a subsequent settlement to the best of this Examinants knowledge Information or belief

Elizabeth Emery aged about 41 years upon her Oath saith that about 15 years ago she Intermarried with John Emery at the Parish Church of Saint Leonard Shoreditch That her said Husband served Seven years apprenticeship to one his Father George Emery a Shoemaker in Arlbemarle Street in the Parish of Saint James at Clerkenwell in the County of middlesex for and that after he quitted said was out of his said apprenticeship he never Rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Mary Kelly aged about 29 years upon her Oath saith that on the 28th. day of augt 1786 she Intermarried with Lockland Kelly her present Husband who has been dead about deserted her at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes by whom she hath one Child living Vizt. John aged about Two years That her said husband Rented and lived in a house in new Street Saint Giles's in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of middx for Twelve Months and upwards at the yearly Rent of Sixteen Pounds that he hath quitted said house about Three years since which time he hath not never Rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pound a year said Taxes or done any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Ann Melvin aged 64 or thereof upon her Oath saith That & Elizabeth Melvin aged 35 years or thereabouts Severally make Oath and Say, and first this Examinant ann Melvin upon her Oath faith, That she Intermarried with John Melvin her late husband at the Fleet about 38 years ago-That her said Husband was a scotchman & never gained any settlement in England, that after their Intermarriage her said Husband & this Examinant went to live in Carteret street in the Parish of saint Margaret Westminster in the County of middlesex where her son Reginald Melvin was born, That her said son never served an apprenticeship, lived as an field yearly servant, Rented £10 a year, Served any Parish Office or ever did any other Act Matter or thing where to the best of this Examinant knowlodge information or belief whereby here said son Could have gained any settlement otherwise than by birth and this Examinant Elizabeth Melvin upon nor Oath saith That she intermarried with the said Reginald Melvin at the Parish Church of said Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex about 7 years ago That she hath 3 Childrens living by her said Husband namely John aged 4 years or thereabouts, Elizabeth aged 3 years or thereabouts & Reginald aged 14 months or thereabouts, that her said Husband died abt. 3 Weeks ago That her said Husband never did to this Examinants knowledge Information or belief gain any Settlemt. are than as aforesd.

Jesse Richardson aged about 46 years upon his Oath saith that he served seven years Apprenticeship to one Thomas shirley a Lapidary who lived in St. Altmans Church Yard Derby in the Parish of Saint Altman in the County of Derby and that after he was out of his said apprenticeship he never Rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year Paid Taxes ever lived as a hired yearly servant for one year or done any act to gain a subsequent settlement

James Talboys one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes on behalf of Mercy spire who is ill Maketh Oath and saith That he has been informed which Information he verily believes to be true that the said Mery Spire is the Widow of Richard spire with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of saint Brides about Twenty three years ago that the said Richard Spires Rented and lived in a house in Tooley Street in the Parish of Saint Olaves southwark for about Two years at the yearly Rent of Twenty two Pounds and that after he quitted said house he never did any Act to the best of this Examinants knowledge whereby he might have gained a subsequent settlement

Edward Douglass aged about 35 year upon his Oath saith that about Eight years ago h Intermarried with Elizabeth his Present Wife in a Church in the Tower by Banns & by whom hath Three Children living Vizt. Samuel aged about seven years Elizabeth aged about Three years and Edward aged about Fifteen Month That he this Deponent rented and lived in a house in Playhouse yard Whitecross Street in the Parish of Saint Luke Old Street in the County of Middlesex for about nine months at the yearly Rent of Fifteen Pounds that he hath quitted said house about Three years since which time he has not rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or done any act to the best of this Examinants knowledge Information or belief he might have gained a subsequent Settlement

Benjamin Newman Beadle of the Parish Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex Maketh Oath and Faith that Mary Colt Singlewoman now ill at the Crown Public House in Panhope street Clare market in the Parish saint Clement Danes aforesaid to the in pound this deponent and while Information he believes to be true that she that said Mary Cole never was married and that about his years age the was lived as a yearly Servant at the wages of our Pounds by the year to a Mr. Pierce who kept the Sign of the shoulder of Matter Cole in the Parish of saint John Hesley in the County of Middlesex that she lived with him for upon and of a years under and Having and since quitting his Service hath not gained at the best of her knowledge any subsequent settlement

Thomasin Thomas Widow aged fifty nine years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that time she has been a Widow she has lived for twelve Months and upwards as a lived yearly Servants on the Mr steel a stagmaker his Canver Court Infell street Charles Streets day in the Parish of saint months in the Fields at the Yearly wages of his pounds that she quitted his service about twenty years ago and since that her not done any act Matter or things whereby to the best of her knowledge she may Rent acquired any subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Grant aged about 50 years upon her Oath saith that in the Month of May 1785 she Intermarried with George Grant her late husband at the Parish Church of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster That he has been dead about nine Months That her said late Husband Rented and lived in a house in Dukes Court in the Parish of saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Forty years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Forty Pounds that he quitted said house about Three Months before his Decease after which he never did any act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Mary Ann Douglas aged about 26 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Harden in St. Martins Lane in Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the county of middlesex for two year and half at the yearly Wages of five bounds that she Rath quitted said service about two years and a half since which time she hath not lived as a hired yearly servant for twelve months or done any act to gain a subsequent Settlement to the best of this Examinant knowledge information or belief

James Flynn of No.58 Clements Lane on behalf of James Flynn an Infant maketh Oath and Saith That the said James Flynn the Infant was born a Bastard at the house of a Mr. Kichoe in Orange Court Wild Street in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex some time in or about the month of april 1784

Margarett Mc. Guire aged about 40 years upon her Oath saith that about 14 years ago she Intermarried with Michael Mc. Guire (who is gone to sea ) in Dublin according to the Giles and Ceremonies of the Church of Rome by whom she hath one Child living Vizt. Peter aged upwards of Two years born at the house of a Mr. Gibson in white hart yard in the Parish of saint Mary Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster

Sarah Markham aged about 33 years upon her Oath th saith that on the 17th. day of Decr. 1787 she Intermarried with Adam Markham her present husband at the Parish Church of Saint sepulchres who has deserted her that she hath Two Children living by her said Husband Vizt. Adam born a Bastard on Little New Street Hill on the 16th. day of novr. 1784 and who is now in the Hospital and Ann aged about Two years That her said Husband is a Scotchman and never gained any settlement in England to the best of this Examinant knowledge Information or belief And this Examinant upon her Oath further saith that about Sixteen years ago she Intermarried with Samuel Sinter at the Parish Church of saint Leonard shoreditch and that he has been dead about nine Years That her said late Husband informed this Examinant that he was born in Little Essex Street in the Precinct of White Fryars in the City of London and that he never did any Act to the best of this Examinants knowledge Information or belief whereby he might have gained any other Settlement

Sarah Mountain aged about 28 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married lived as a hired yearly servant for one year or ever bound an apprentice that her Father served his time as an apprentice to one Mr. Phillips a Brazier in Maid Lane in the Parish of Saint Saviour Southwark that he also Rented a house in Maid Lane in the said Parish and Paid the Kings Tax for the same and that he never did any act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Charles Newton Aged about 41 years upon his Oath saith That Samuel George Newton a Poor person who is now of the Age of 19 years or thereabouts is ill at a Lodging House in Shore Lane in the parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex is this Examinants son and that he this Examinant did about 4 or 5 years Ago bound his said Son an Apprentice to one Mr. Morrison in the Brough in the parish of Saint Saviour in the Borough of Southwark in the County of Surry Hair Dresser by Indentures duly Stampt and Executed. that his said Son served only 2 Months of his time and during that time lived with his said Master at his House in the parish of Saint Saviour aforesaid then some Disagreement taking place this Examinant by Consent of his said Master Took his said Son away and destroyed the Indentures and this Examin at further saith that to the last of this Examinants Knowledge information and belief he has not lived has a hired yearly Servant for one year Renter any House Tenement or Lodging of Ten pounds a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Clarke aged about 41 years upon her Oath saith that about 24 years ago she Intermarried with John Clarke her present husband at the parish Church of Saint Giles in the fields That her said Husband was bound Apprentice to Wm. Fell a Taylor who lived in Newcastle Cowit for seven years that after he had served Six years of his said Apprenticeship his Master gave him up his Indentures and that the last Six Months of his said Service with his said Master was in Bread Court Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster where he was discharged and that after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented any house Tenement or Lodging of Ten pounds a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a subsequent Settlement

Lucy Bullock Aged 30 years or thereabouts on the behalf of her sister Ann Bigg Aged 42 years or thereabouts Upon her Oath Saith that her said sister Ann Bigg lived as a hired yearly servant with one Mr. Thornton of Southampton Buildings in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middx for 3 years and upwards at the yearly Wages of Six pounds Six shillings that she hath quitted said service about 9 months, Since which time she the said Ann Bigg has been ill and unable to Maintain herself And has never Rented any House Tenement or Lodging or done any Act since living as a hired yearly servant with Mr. Thornton whereby she might have gained a Subsequent Settlement to be the best of this Examinants knowledge information or belief

Elizabeth How Aged about 54, Upon her Oath Saith that she was born at Lambeth , that she came to London when a Child, that she never was Married, has Children but they are all provided for, New That she has been in several places but never lived twelve Months in any of them And this Examinant further Sayth that she is poor and unable to gain her Livelihood by Working.

Margaret Walker aged 76 years and upwards or thereabouts Upon her Oath Saith That about 48 years ago she intermarried with John Kakewit who has been Dead about 33 years That 2 years after the said John Kakewit s Death she intermarried with Thomas Walker who has been Dead about 25 year That the said John Kakewit her first Husband informed this Examinant that he Served his Apprenticeship to one Mr. Mills a Buckle Master in White cross street in the parish of Saint Giles Cripplegate in the County of Middlesex , And this Examinant further upon her Oath Saith That the said Thos. Walker her Second Husband never Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of 10 pounds a year or did any Act whereby he might have gained any sort of Settlement and that the said John Kakewit never gained any other Settlement but by serving his Apprentice with the said Mr. Mills in White cross street in the parish and County aforesaid To the best of this Examinants Knowledge information or belief

Margaret Walker aged 76 years or thereabouts Upon her Oath Saith That about 48 years ago she intermarried with John Kakewit who has been Dead about 33 years That about 2 years after the said John Kakewit s Death she intermarried with Thomas Walker who has been Dead about 25 years That the said John Kakewit her first Husband informed this Examinant that he served his Apprenticeship to one Mr. Mills a Buckle Maker in White cross street in the Parish of Saint Lukes Old street in the County of Middlesex , And this Examinant further upon her Oath Saith That the said Thomas Walker her second Husband never Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of 10 pounds a year or did any Act whereby he might have gained any Sort of Settlement And that the said John Kakewit never gained any other Subsequent Settlement but by serving his Apprenticeship with the said Mr. Mills in white cross street in the parish and County aforesaid To the best of this Examinants Knowledge information or belief

Mary Kelly aged forty three Years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that she was married to Edmund Kelly her Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex about Christmas 1789 that she believes her said Husband is a Fishman and does not know that he ever acquired a Settlement in England And this Deponent further saith that whilst she was single and unmarried she lived as an hired Yearly Servant for one Year with Mr. Johnson Foreign Cordial Warehouse keeper in the Haymarket in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster and since quitting his Service has not done any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have acquired a Subsequent Settlement and that her said Husband has deserted her, and she is poor and sick and unable to Maintain herself.

James Talboys one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex Maketh Oath and saith that William Bishop Evans a poor Boy of the age of 11 years or thereabouts now in the Workhouse of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex is, as be this Deponent has been informed and verily believes the Son of William Bishopp Evans a Hairdresser who is deceased and that he was born in lawful Wedlock - and this Deponent hath also been informed-and which he believes to be true that the said William Bishop Evans the father in his lift time rented and lived in a House in Fleurde his Court in the Parish of Saint Dunstan in the West in the City of London at the yearly West of twelve Guineas for about a year and an half and died there-and that the said William Bishop Evans the for never has acquired any Settlement in his over rise

James Talboys one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex Maketh Oath and saith that Susannah Clare Snelling a Poor Girl of the Age of Eight Years and an half or thereabouts now in the Workhouse of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes aforesaid is (as he this Deponent hath been informed and verily believes) the Illegitimate Child of Isabella Williamson Singlewoman and was born at the House of a Mr John Gordon a Tanner in Grange read in the Parish of Saint Ch Mary Magdalen Bermondsey in the County of Surry and never has gained or acquired any Settlement in her own right

John Watkins Perukemaker Maketh Oath and saith that in the last Week in the Month of January in the year 1776 he agreed with one Joseph Norton the then Tenant and Occupier of a Publick House in Vinegar Yard in the parish of Saint James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex known by the Sign of the Halfmoon and in pursuance to become the Tenant of the said House and in pursuance of the said Agreement he immediately paid Ten pounds to the said Joseph Norton for the Fixtures therein and entered directly upon the said House as Tenant agreeing to pay Ten pounds a year Rent for the same which was the same Rent the said Joseph Norton his predecessor pd And saith that under the said Agreement he did actually inhabit and occupy the said House and there carry on the Business of a Victualler for upwards of seven Weeks but after he became in the Occupation thereof in manner aforesd. the Landford of the said House having refused to accept him this Examinant as Tenant a few Days before the Lady Day then next he quitted the said House and took part of the Fixtures he had purchased of the said Joseph Norton but he paid no Rent nor any Taxes for the said House And since his quitting the said House he hath never rented or agreed to Rent a Tenement or Lodging at so great a Rent as Ten pounds a year paid any kind of Taxes or done any other Act which to knowledge or Belief hath acquired him a subsequent Settlement

Mary Beath Singlewoman aged 30 years and upwards on her Oath saith that about 20 Months ago as she believes it may be she lived an hired yearly Servant with Mr. Atkinson Victualler at the Sign of the Watermans Arms at Wansworth in the County of Surrey for upwards of one whole year together at Four pounds a year Wages and since she quitted that Service she hath not lived an hired yearly Servant for one whole year together been an Householder contracted Matrimony or done any other Act whatsoever to her Knowledge or Belief whereby to gain a legal Settlement in any parish or place

Mary Quintin Widow of John Quintin Taylor deceased maketh Oath and saith that she is in the Fortyninth year of her age and that about 22 Years ago she was lawfully married to her said late Husband at the parish Church of St Olave Tooley Street and that he was a Frenchman and had not then nor did ever since (as he after informed this Examinant and which she verily believes to be true) do any Act since he came Born Normandy where he was born whereby to gain a legal Settlement in England or elsewhere either by Servitude renting a Tenement or Lodging of Ten pounds a year or by payment of any kind of Taxes or otherwise howsoever And this Examinant saith that her Maiden Name was Mary Bennett and at the time she was married to her said late Husband John Quintin she lived an hired yearly Servant with Mr John Gray in St. Thomas Street in the Parish of Saint Thomas Southwark in the County of Surrey where she had then lived for full two continued years together at five pounds a year Wages for the first year and Five pounds and ten Shillings for the second year And saith that since the Decease of her said late Husband which happened about two years ago she hath not lived a Servant for any space of time paid ten pounds a year Rent for an House or Lodging or any Parish or other Taxes or done any thing which to her Knowledge or Belief hath gained her a Settlement in any Parish or place

Sarah Zether singlewoman aged twenty one years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that she never was married, that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Yardley is China Street Bedford Square in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex for upwards four years at the yearly Wages of seven pounds that she quitted her sd. place about eighteen Months ago & since then has not lived for twelve Months in one Service nor rented any House Tenement of ten pounds a year Value nor done any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her knowledge Information & belief she may have acquired any other or Subsequent Settlement

Mary Swinbank aged 25 years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith That she Intermarried with John Swinbank her a present Husband at the Parish Church of St. Martin in the fields about Ten year ago That her Husband was bound an Apprentice to Mr Drysdale a Stagmaker in Eagle Street Red Lyon Square with whom as she has been informed he served his Time, And she Further Saith That Eagle Street is as then believes in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn above the Bars , And that she has not any other Settlement to the best of no her knowledge or belief

Hannah Gibbons Aged forty two years or thereabouts Upon her Oath saith she intermarried with Matthew John Gibbons her late Husband abt. Six years ago in the parish Church of St Martin in the fields in the County of Middlesex by whom she had one female Child who Died abt. five years since after living only abt. Six Weeks that her said Husband Died abt. four years since having no Issue surviving him that since her said Husband Death she lived as an hird yearly Servt .-with-Crofts Esquire No. 39 King Street Covent Garden about One year and Ten Months at the yearly Wages Eleven Guineas-that she quitted said Services in the Month of August 1789 since which time she has not done any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her knowledge Information or belief she might have gained any other Settlement

John Worthington Aged abts. thirty years Upon his Oath saith that he served his Clerkship with Str. Peart & with whom he was Articled but Boarded Lodged with his Father in Holborn in the parish of St Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex That after the Term for which he was Arcticled expired he lived with them him & Messrs Est County, Shilling as an hired yearly Clerk for five years or thereabouts & and that during the lather part of the time he belived with them for three years afterwards he lody in Thorney Street of Bloomsbury and saith that since he so served his Clerkship he has not done any Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby he Might gain any other Settlement to the best of his Knowledge or belief

Peter Sidebotham Clerk to Mr. Jennings of Shire Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx Gentleman on behalf of Two Children of Robt. Jenks who has been dead upwds. of a fortnight upon his Oath saith that the said late Robt. Jenks informed this Dept which Information he this Dept. believes to be true that he was about 50 years of Age that he had been married upwards of 16 years to Sarah his late Wife at the Parish Church of Walsal in Stafford shire that he had 2 Children Livy. by his said late wife Vizt. Ann aged about 15 years & Chas. aged about 8 years that he the said late Robt. Jenks in his Life time served his time as an Apprentice under Indres to one Joseph Griffiths a Buckle Chafe Maker at Walsal in the Stafford shire in the Parish of Walsal in the County of Stafford that after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never had done any Act Matter or thing whereby he might have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Joseph Cook of No. 3 Clements Lane in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex Shoemaker upon his Oath saith that he was Married to Elizth. his now Wife at the Parish Church of Laughton le Morthin in Yorkshire the 6th. day of March 1764 that he has One Son named Joseph by his said Wife besides four other Children that his said Son Joseph is about 25 Years of Age that he has never to the best of this Examinants Knowledge gained or acquires any Settlement in his own right unless as this Examinant himself conceived but is now informed Otherwise he might have acquired such Settlement serving him this Ext. for 7 Years under an Indorsement in writing without Stamp on the back of this Exts. own Indres of Apprenticeship that this Ext. was bound an Appr . by Indre duly executed to Richard Binney of Worksop in the County of Notting ham Shoemaker for the Term of 7 years and Duly served the whole of his sd. Appship to his sd. Master there except. abt. 8 Months the than residue there of which his Father bought out and his Indres were then delivered up that since Quitting his sd. Master's Service he has not rented an house Land or Tenement of the yearly Value of £10. pd. any rates of or Taxes or done any Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of his Knowledge informed or belief he may have gained or acquired any subsequent Settlemt. other than in the sd Parish of Worksop in the County of Notting ham And this Ext. further Saith that his said Son Joseph is in an ill State of Health and unable to Work to Maintain himself and that he this Examinant is poor and unable to Mantain him having his Other Children and Wife to Support

Benjn. Newman one of the Beadles of the Parish of St. Clement Danes Maketh Oath and Saith That he has been Credibly informed which Information he verily believes to be true that George Clegg an Infant of the Age of 14 years or thereabouts was placed out Apprentice on the 22d. May 1786 by the Overseers of St. Clement Danes by Indres duly executed (till he should Attain the Age of 21 years) to on Wm. Aycrigg a Baker in Lilly Street in the Liberty of Saffron Hill Hatton Garden and Ely Rents that he served about 5 Months of his said Apprenticeship to his said Master then his said Master ran away and left him Destitute that the last 40 days of his said Service with his said Master was in Lilly Street in the Liberty aforesaid

Grace Mitchell aged about 34 years upon her Oath saith that about in July 1770 she Intermarried with Lawrence Mitchell her present Husband (who has deserted her) at the Parish Church of St. Mary Lambeth that she hath 2 Children living by her said Husband vizt. John aged about 16 years unprovided for and Mary Elizth. aged about 10 years provided for that her said Husband before his Intermarriage with this Ext. And whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Bullon who kept the Hampshire Hog on Bethnell Green in the Parish of St. Matthew Bethnell Green in the County of Middlesex for 12 Months and upwds. that he hath quitted said Service upwards of 18 years ago since which time he has not lived as a hired yearly Servant for One year Rented any House Tent. or Lodging of the yearly Rent or Value of £10 or done any Act whereby she might have gained any subsequent Settlement

Peter Sidebotham Clerk to Mr. Jennings of Great Shire Lane in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex Gentleman on behalf of Two Infants of Robert Jenks who has been dead upwards of Two Months upon his Oath saith that the said late Robert Jenks informed this Dept which Information he this Dept. verily believes to be true that he was about 50 years of Age that he had been married upwards of 16 years to Sarah his late Wife at the Parish Church of Walsal in the County of Stafford that he has 2 Children living by his said late Wife vizt. Ann aged about 15 years and Charles aged about 8 years that he served his time as an Apprentice under Indres to one Joseph Griffiths a Buckle Chafe maker at Walsal in Staffordshire in the Parish and County afsd. that after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never did any Act to gain any other Settlement

James Case of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes Taylor upon his Oath Saith that Francis Purcell an Infant of the Age of Nine years or thereabouts in the Son of William Purcell by Mary his Wife who are both dead that the sd. William Purcell in his life time rented & lived in a House in Vine Street Swallow Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster at the yearly rent of upwards of ten pounds for about three Quarters of a year that he died in such House and that the said Married Purcell the Infant never was bound out Apprentice or did any Act to gain a Settlement in his own right

Benjamin Newman of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes. Peruke Maker , Maketh Oath Saith that he has been informed that Frances Eaton a Female Child of Mary Eaton Singlewoman was born at Mr. Kents a Chandlers Shop in Great Cater that Westminster in the Parish of Saints John the Evangelist , And further Saith that the said Child is now Chargeable to the Parish of Saint Clement Danes and is as above Stated and this Examinant is informed Illegitimate

Jane Meldrum aged 18 or thereabts. upon her Oath Saith that she was born in Charles Court in the Strand in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields that her Father went to Sea & died abroad that she never gained any Settlement to the best of her knowledge that her Mother is now in Saith Martins Workhouse, That she this Examinant is Ill and unable to provide for herself

Alice Kelly aged about 20 years upon her Oath saith that she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes That she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Leigh at Buttle Bridge in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes Pancras in the County of Middx for Two years or thereabouts at the yearly Wages of Eight Guineas that she hath quitted said Service about 5 years ago since which time she hath not lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

John Grimes aged about 62 years upon his Oath saith that about 28 years ago he Intermarried with Elizth. his present Wife at the Parish Church of Kingston in Hampshire that he hath Three Children living by his said wife Two of which are provided for and one unprovided for vizt. Priscilla aged about 6 years that he served Seven years Apprenticeship to one John Ausley a Waterman at Stangate Wall in the Parish of Saint Mary Lambeth in the County of Surry that since he has been out of his said Apprenticeship he has not Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Ann Cummins aged about 60 years upon her Oath saith that in the year 1755 she Intermarried with Enoch Cummins her late Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holborn that her said late Husband has been dead about 20 years that before his Intermarriage to this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Ewer in Hatton Garden in the Liberty of Saffron Hill Hatton Garden and Ely Rents in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn in the County of Middlesex in the Capacity of a Clerk for Twelve Months and upwards at the yearly Wages of £50 that after he quitted said Service he never Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Edward Burbidge of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes Peruke Maker Maketh Oath and Saith That he has been informed that Ann Leach a Female Child of Mary Leach Singlewoman was born at Mr. Flaxtons a Muffin Baker in Little Saint Andrews Street in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex And further saith that the said Child is Chargeable to the said Parish of Saint Clement Danes and is as above stated and this Examinant is informed is illegitimate

James Talboys of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes Peruke maker on behalf of Eleanor Banes who is ill Maketh Oath and Saith that he has been informed by the said Eleanor which Information he believes to be true that she was born in Crown Court Little Russell Street in the Parish of Saint Paul & Martin in the fields in the County of Middlesex that her Father Rented House in the same Court for 29 years or thereabouts that she never was bound an Apprentice lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year Rented House Tent. or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or ever married

Sophia Hallywell aged about 23 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with a Mr. Froome in Hart Street Bloomsbury in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex for 12 Months & upwards at the yearly Wages of £5 that she hath quitted said Service upwards of 3 years since which time she has not lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement

James Maydman aged about 34 years upon his Oath saith that she never wa he served Seven years Apprenticeship to Mr. Langley in Chancery Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex Stationer that after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented any House Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes or done any Act to gain a Subsequent Settlement
