Susannah Hayward Aged twenty five years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that she never was Married that she lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr. Chawner in Hart Street in the parish of St George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex for one year & three Months at the Annual Wages of Seven Guineas that she quitted that Service about two years ago and since hath not to the best of her knowledge or belief gained any other legal settlement and that she is now Ill Poor and unable to maintain herself

Deborah William Aged 45 years & upwards Upon Oath saith that while she was single & unmarried and a Widow not having any Child or Children she lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr. Vigne in Albion place Surrey side of Blackfryan Bridge in the parish of Christ Church in the County of surrey about 17 Months at the Annual Wages of Ten Guineas quitted that she quitted that Service abt Six or Seven years ago & since hath not done any Act or the thing whereby be the best of her knowledge or belief she may have gained any other legal Settlement and Last by that she was removed from their parish to the said parish of Child Church by Orders of removal in the Month of April last was then maintained in the House for Six Weeks assd. which Order they have not ever appealed to their Deponent knowledge or belief and that She unable to maintain herself with and Assistance Assistance

Ann Seddon Singlewoman Aged forty one years & upwards Upon Oath saith that she never was Married that she Rented and Rended in an House in Kentishtown near the Chapel but on the other side of the Way in the parish of St. Pancras in the County of Middlesex about One year and a half at the Annual Rent of £15 that she quitted that same about Eleven years ago and since hath not obtained any other legal Settlement and this Deponent saith that she hath a Female Bastard Child born on the seventeenth day of November in the year 1790 at the House of Mr. formerly belonging to, or in the Occupation of, Mrs. Burton in Narrow Marsh in the parish of St. Peter in the Town of Nottingham which hath service been Christened by the names of Jane Seddon of that the said Child is not yet Weaned

James Stewart Aged ten Years & upwards, Upon Oath saith that he Married with his present Wife Rebecca at the Fleet about 45 years ago that he hath three Children all provided for now living that he Served as an Apprentice with Mr. David Low under Judices duly exted executed for four Years that he lived with then his said Master fader & gave up his Judies that his said Master then lived in Swallow Street in the psts of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster was a Baker & that this Deponent lodged in his said Master's House the whole time

Elizabeth Campion Wife of James Campion Ag Maketh Oath & saith that she was Married to her said Husband James Campion at the parish Church of St. James Westminster on or about the fourteenth day of September in the year 1783 that she hath two Children now living by her said Husband namely Ann Aged about One year & Eleven Months or thereabouts and John Aged Eight Months & upwards-, that her said Husband hath left her & is gone to seek for Work that he Served of his Apprenticeship with a (under Indres duly executed) for the last year with his Father John Thomas Campion in Coventry Court in the Haymarket in the parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster in the said County and Lodged Boarded in his said father's House and he hath never obtained any Subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Deponents knowledge or belief

Ann Riley Singlewoman Aged 30 years & thereabouts Upon Oath saith that she never was Married; that she lived as an hired yearly Servant with with Mr. Allen at No. 5 in Little Chappell Street in the parish of St. Ann within the Liberty of Westminster in the said County for about fourteen Months at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds, that she quitted that service about Two years ago, and since hath not obtained any Subsequent legal Settlement, And this Deponent with that she hath been Maintained in the Workhouse belonging to the said parish of St. Ann for about three Months at the Expenced of the said Parish by Virtue of an Order of Reml. from the Parish of St. Mary le bow about four years and an half ago-Against which Order there hath been no Appeal preferred, to the Knowledge or belief of this Deponent

Edward Burbidge one of the Beadles of the parish of St. Clement Danes in the County and Liberty aforesaid on behalf of John Troy a Poor Boy aged 13 years and upwards On Oath saith that he that been Deponent hath been Informed and verily believes the said John Troy is the Illegitimate Son of Margaret Connell otherwise Troy , that he was Born in Great St. Andrews Street Seven Dials in the parish of St. Giles in the fields on the Seventh day of July 1778 and hath never obtained any legal Settlement in his own Right

Mary Seer singlewoman Aged 28 Years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that she never was Married, That she lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mrs. Hutton no.12 on the Terrace facing Crossby Row in the Parish of St. Mary Newington in the County of Surry , about two Years, at the Annual Wages of Eight Guineas; that she quitted that Service about Six years ago, and hath never obtained any Subsequent legal Settlement, And this Deponent Saith that she hath a Female Bastard Child now living with her Aged about two years & three Month, and which hath been half Baptized by the Name of Mary Lloyd , which was born of her Body and of lawful Matrimony at No. 5 New Bedford Court Catherine Street in the parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of a Westminster And that She is unable to maintain herself and Child without Assistance

Henrietta Bernard Widow of Joseph Bernard Deced Aged about twenty Nine Years Upon Oath saith that she intermarried with her late Husband Joseph Bernard at the parish Church of St. Luke Chelsea Middlesex on or abt. the 22nd. day of December 1778 that her said Husband hath Informed her which else verily believes that previous to then Marriage and while he was single & unmarried not having any Child or Children lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr. Strannaugh at the Artichoke Peckham in the parish of Peckham in the County of Surry for three years at the Yearly Wages of Nine Guas. that he quitted that service about fourteen years ago and since hath and obtained any no other legal Settlement and to the best of this Deponents knowledge or belief and this Deponents further saith that he Died on the 9th of August last that she hath one one Child now living by her said Husband namely named Joseph aged Six Months & upwards that she this Deponent hath not gained any Settlement since her said Husbands Decease and is now unable to provide for herself without Assistance

Elizabeth Campion Aged about 38 years Wife of Jas. Campion Maketh Oath and Saith that she was Married to her present Husband James Campion at the parish Church of St James Westmr. on or about the 14th day of September 1783 that she hath two Children now living by her said Husband Namely Ann Aged One year & Eleven Months and upwards and John Aged Ten Months and upwards that her said Husband served the last year of his Apprenticeship (under Indentures duly executed) with his father Thomas Campion in Coventry Court in the Haymarket in the parish of St. Martin in in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster in the said County and Lodged and Boarded in his said Father's House and he hath never obtained any Subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Deponent Knowledge or belief

Mary Smith Widow Aged 31 years & upwards Upon Oath saith that she was Married to her late Husband William Smith at the parish Church of St. Martin in the fields abt in the Liberty of Westminster in the said County of Middlesex about fourteen or fifteen years ago that previous there to and while he was Single and unmarried he lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr. Boon a Butcher the Corner of Bedford Bury in Chandor Street in the said parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr. in the County of Middlesex aforesaid for Six years & upwards at the Annual Wages of £5.10:0-that he quitted that service about 18 or 19 years ago and gained no Subsequent legal Settlement during his Life time, that he Died on the 30th. day of November last and since this Deponent hath not been Married nor acquired any other legal settlement That she hath no Child now living by her said Husband Named Thomas Aged Four years Ten Months ten Months & upwards And Saith that She is poor and unable to Maintain herself and Child

Mary Cormick Singlewoman Aged 44 years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith That she never was Married that she lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr. John Hall in the Temple Lane in the Precinct of White Friars in the City of London for three Years at the Yearly Wages of £3 for the first Year £4 for the second and £6 for the third that she quitted that Service about twelve or fourteen Years ago and hath not obtained any Subsequent legal Settlement to the best of her knowledge or belief And that She is now Poor and unable to support herself without Assistance

Jane Prague Aged about forty Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Franklin a Widow Lady who lodged at one Mr. Carlers an appothecary the Corner of Broad Court Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for three Years at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds Ten Shillings payable Weekly or as this Examinant thought proper and the Two last Years at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Seven Months ago & hath not since she quitted the same done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Elizth. Timms Aged about Forty three Years on her Oath Says she is the wife of William Timms (gone from her) upwards of Twelve Years ago and dos not no know now whether he is now living or Dead and with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holborn in the County of Middlesex about Twenty Years ago and by whom she hath one Childr no living named ( Ann ) Aged about Seventeen Years, say before her Intermarriage with her said Husband and whilst he was a Single man he living a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Walker a Cow-keeper near St. Pancras in the County of Middlesex for Four years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds and After she was Married to her said Husband she never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year And Says that her said Dauther has never done any act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlemt.

Mary Jones Aged about Sixty Three Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Henry Jones who has been Dead above Thirty Years Says that she being a Widow and without Child or Children she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Messrs. Coombs and Aldersey Mercers in Chandes Street in the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden upwards of one Year an half at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of 5 Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Dell Aged about Thirty Two Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Williams a Tobacconist in Queen Street in the Parish of Saint Saviours Southwark in the County of Surry upwards of One Year and an half at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of five Years and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Hannah Greenwood Aged about Fifty One years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Cochran in Great Shire Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex for Eight Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pound Seven Shillings hath quitted her said Service upwards of One Year and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Robert Shread Aged about Eighty Four years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Elizabeth his wife at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the Fields about Thirty two Years ago and by whom he has no Children now living Says he Rented and lived in a House in Crown Court Russell Street in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Eight Years at the yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds hath quitted the same upwards of Sixteen Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived as hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Thompson Davis Aged about Fifty Seven Years in his Oath Says that he Intermarried with Martha his late wife in the City of Oxford about Thirty years ago and who has been dead about three Months and by whom he hath Six Children now living Vizt. Charles Aged about Twenty two years Vincent Aged about fifteen years both of whom are now provided for & further says that he has Four other Children and provided for Vizt. Thompson Aged about Twenty Years Elizabeth Ageed about Ten Years Thomas Aged about Seven Years Aged about five Years who never gained any Settlement either by Renting House or serving any Apprenticeship or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year And further says that he Rented and lived in a House in Great Russell Street in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex for one Year and an half at the Yearly Rent of Thirty Four Pounds hath quitted the said House about Two Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Taylor Aged about forty five Years on behalf of her Husband who now lies ill of a Year on her Oath Says she is he Wife of Jeremiah Taylor with whom she Intermarried at Saint Leonard Shoreditch about Sixteen Years ago and by whom she hath one Child now living Vizt. John Aged about Nine Years Says her said Husband Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Mears, an Irony Turner in Red Lyon Street in the Parish Saint Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex and After he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year as her said Husband has Often Informed her and which Information she veri believes to be true

John Wright Aged about Twenty five Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Ann his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Dunstan in the West London about Four Years ago and by whom he hath one Child now living which this Examinant now Provides for Says he Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. George Mynitt a Taylor in St. James Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Purslow Aged about Twenty Four Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House paid Taxes or ever Served any Apprenticeship Says she lived a hired Years Servant with one Mr. Clark at the Falcon in Fal Court Fleet Street in the Parish of Saint Danes in the West London upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Eleven Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizth. Lee Aged about Forty Four Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of Henry Lee who has been Dead about Eleven Years ago and by whom she has no Children now living Says her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in Little Brittain in in the Parish of Saint Botolph without Aldersgate London for several Years at the Yearly Rent of Fourteen Pounds and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same and further Says that since her said late Husbands Death she never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

William Crue Aged about Fifty Seven Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Jane Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes about Seven Years ago and by whom he hath Two Children now living Olivia Aged about Six Years and John Aged about Ten Weeks Says he Rented lived in a House at Ratcliffe Cross in the Hamlett of Ratcliffe in the Parish of Saint Dunstan Stepney otherwise Steben-heath in the County of Middlesex for Three Years or thereabouts and paid Parish Taxes for the same at the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds hath quitted the said House up wards of One Year and an half ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

John Langford Aged about Sixty four Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Mary his Wife at the Parish Church of St. Leonard Shoreditch in the County of Middlesex about Thirty Eight Years ago And by whem he hath three Children now living and all provided for Says he served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one John Fowles a Blacksmith at Froom in the County of Somerset and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he Came to London and worked Journey work for upwards of Eight Years And further Says that he afterwards Rented Two several House in Duke Street in the Parish of Saint Saviour otherwise St. Mary Overees in the Borough of Southwark in the County of Surry the one at the Yearly Rent of Six pounds for about Seven Years & the other at the Yearly Rent of 5th. for about Eight Years & was rated to and Paid Land tax due for the Same hath quitted the same upwards of fourteen Years ago & hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or done any or Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

William Hewson Aged about fifty Six Years on his Oath Says he is a Widower & without Child or Children And Says he served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one James Knight a Cane head Chaser at the Bishops head in the little Old Bailey London and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship which is new upwards of Twenty Six Years ago and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizabeth Burt Aged about Nineteen Years on behalf of James Burt her Brother an Infant Aged about Seven Years on her Oath Says that her Father John Burt Intermarried with her late Mother at Salisbury as she has often heard her said Father and Mother decla Says her late Father hath Seven Children by her late Mother all of whom are provided for Execept the said James Burt as she Verily believes Says her late Father John Burt Rented and lived in a House at Sutton Scotney in the Parish of Sutton Scotney in the County of Southampton known by the Name or Sign of the White Swan for Two Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Thirty Pounds or thereabouts and paid all Parish taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House upwards of Two Years ago and after her said late Father quitted the same he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or ever gained any other Subsequent Settlement neither hath the said James Burt her Brother

Ann Fordham Wife of Richard Fordham (gone from her) Aged about Thirty five Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried with her said Husband at Saint Georges Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex about Seven Years ago and by whom she hath Two Children now living Vizt. Ann Aged about five Years and Mary Aged about Eight Months Says her said Husband Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Mills as Peruke Maker in Saint Johns Court in Saint Johns Square in the Parish of Saint James in Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or Done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Eleanor Everett Aged about Twenty five Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Carney a Linnen Draper in Broad Court in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Six Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizth. Farmer Aged about Thirty Six Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Elizabeth Sherrads in the Parish of Saint George Bloombury in the County of Middlesex upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Fourteen Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived as hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Joan Barnard Aged about Ninety Years on her Says her Husband William Barnard Rented and lived in a House in Leicester Fields in the Parish of Saint Anns So ho in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middlesex for several Years at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds and paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the same about Twelve Months ago and hath not since she quitted same ever Rented House paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary East Aged about Twenty Eight Years on her oath Says she is the Wife of Wm. East (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes about Seven Years ago and by whom she hath two Children now living Vizt. Frances Aged about of Six Years now living with her said Husbands Sister in Maiden Lane Covent Garden and William Aged about five Years Says her said Husband rented and lived in a House in Warwick Lane in the Parish of Faith in the City of London for upwards of Nine Months at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Eight pounds and paid land and other Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the same upwards of One Year and an half ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement to her knowledge or belief

Mary Mogridge Aged about Thirty Nine Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Henry Mogridge (gone from her with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of of St. Botolph Bishop Gate about Twenty Years ago and by whom she hath several Children now living Three of whom she hath now with her Vizt. Amelia Aged about Seven Years Major John Aged about Six Years and George Aged about three Weeks Says her said Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Brazier a Gunsmith in Ratcliffe Broad Street in the Hamlett of Mile End Old Town in the Parish of Saint Dunstan Stepney in the County of Middlesex and after he was not of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain Subsequent Settlement

Frances Burleton aged about Twenty four Years on her Oath Says she Wife of Richard Burleton (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried by Licence at the Parish Church of St. Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex upwards of four Years ago and by whom hath Two Children now living Viza. Richard Aged about Three Years and Herbert aged about Two Years Says her said Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Lady Frawley in Somerset House in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Strand in the County of Middx upwards of One Year and an half at the Yearly Wages Seven Pounds and Seven Shillings Per Week Board hath quitted his said Service upwards of five Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement to her knowledge or beleif.

Elizth. Swift Aged about forty Three Years on behalf of Elizth. Warner an Infant aged about Nine Months whose Mother Mary Warner now lies dead and the Father gone and left them Says that James Warner Father of the said Elizabeth Warner rented and lived in a House in Richmond Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster for Two Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Six Pounds and paid Parish Taxes due for the same and after quitting the same never gained any Subsequent Settlement as Appears by an Examination of the said James Warner taken the 8th. Day of September Last Past Signed by Thos. Kynaston & R: Butler Esqrs.

Mary Duce Aged about Twenty Three Years on on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Samuel Duce (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at Christs Church in the Borough of Southwark in the County of Surry about Two Years ago and by whom she hath no Children now living Says that her said Husband Served Seven Years apprenticeship with one George Small a Spur Maker Colmer in the Parish of Blockwich in the County of Stafford and After he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House Paid Taxes or otherwise gained a Subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Crossley Aged about Sixty One Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Joseph Crossley who has been dead about Fifteen Years and with whom she Intermarried at the Fleet London in the Year 1752 Says her said late Husband served Six Years apprenticeship with one Edward Edwards a Gilder in New Street fetter Lane in the Parish of Saint Brides otherwise Bridget and the said Edward Edwards the Master dying was duly discharged from his apprenticeship and after her said Husband was discharged he never Rented House or paid Taxes or did any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement neither hath this Examinant since her said late Husbands Death

Edward King Aged about Twenty Six Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Mary his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Leonard Shoreditch in the County of Middlesex about five Months ago and who now Lies ill in Saint Bartholomews Hospital and by whom he hath no Children now living Says before his Intermarried with his said Wife and whilst he was a Single man he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Davis at the Swan and hoop Tavern in Swan and hoop Alley Cornhill in the Parish of Saint Mary Woodnoth in the City of London upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted his said Service about Eight Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year.

Sarah Cossham Aged about Twenty Years on behalf of Anna Maria Humphrys an Infant Aged about Eight Weeks (whose Mother is Lately dead and the Father Thomas Humphrys gone and deserted it) on her Oath Says that the said Thomas Humphrys Intermarried with Susanna his late Wife at the Parish of Stonehouse in the County of Gloucester about Thirteen Years ago and by whom he hath Two Children now living Vizt. Thomas Aged about Nine Years now Provided for and the above Anna Maria Humphrys Aged about Eight Weeks Says that the said Thomas Humphrys Rented and lived in a House known by the Sign of the Two Pumps in Old Street in the Parish of Saint Luke in the County of Middlesex upwards of half a Year at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds but whether he ever paid any Rent or Taxes this Examinant Cannot set forth hath quitted the said House upwds. of twelve Months ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Eleanor Elliston otherwise Ellison Aged about Thirty Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of George Elliston otherwise Ellison who has been Dead upwards of Seven Years and with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Branford in the County of Middlesex about Twelve Years ago and by whom she hath no Children now Living Says that being Widow and without Child or Children She lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Smith at the Devil Tavern Temple Bar in the Parish of Saint Dunstan in the West London upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds and afterwards Agreed with her Misstress Mrs. Smith for Eight Pounds P Year that her Mistress soon afterwards look or lodging in the Parish of Fulham where she Continued for four Weeks or thereabouts and this Examinant can the more Particularly speak to the truth thereof as her said Mistress paid this Examinant Thirteen Shillings and four Pence in full for her Wages after the Rate of Eight Pounds P Annum which was in full for a Months Wages or thereabouts due to this Examinant hath quitted her said Service about Seven Months ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

John Grummitt aged about Thirty five Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Elizabeth his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex in the Year 1763 and by whom he hath four Children Namely thomas Aged about Nine Years Elizabeth Aged about Eight Years William Aged about Six Years and Charles Aged about One Year & an half Says he Rented and lived in a House in Angel Court White hart Yard in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex upwards of One Year at the Yearly Rent of fourteen Pounds hath quitted the said House upwards of Two Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Taxes or otherwise gained a Subsequent Settlement.

Susan Jones Aged about Fifty One Years on behalf of Mary Rowland the Wife of Thomas Rowland who now liks Ill of a Fever on her Oath Says that the said Thomas Rowland Rented and lived in a House in Red Lyon Street Clerkenwell in the Parish of Saint James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex upwards of one Year at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds as she believes and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House upwards of Six Years ago & hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Tamer Frances Jones Aged about Twenty Six Years on her Oath Says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a Hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Martin in Duke Street in the Parish of St. Margarets Westminster for Thirteen Months at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Six Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year or otherwise gained a Subsequent Settlement.

John Spriggs Aged about Sixty Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Ann his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Pauls Covent Garden about Six Years Ago and by whom he hath no Children now living Says he lived in a House of his own in Adam & Eve Court in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex upwards of Twelve Years and was Rated at Fourteen Pounds a Year and paid at Parish Taxes due for the same and quitted the said House in the Year 1768 and after quitting the same he never Rented House paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Ann Hughes Aged about Twenty Two Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House Paid Taxes or was an Apprentice Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one David Price a Green Grocer in Gouge Street near Middlesex Hospital in the Parish of Saint Pancras in the County of Middlesex for One Year and three Months at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Three Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

John Eastwood Aged about four Score Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Mary his now Wife at the Parish Church of St. Giles in the Fileds in County of Middlesex about Seven Years Ago Says he Rented and lived in a house in Bett's Street in the Parish of Saint George in the East in County of Middlesex about three Years at the Yearly Rent of four Pounds & was rated to and Paid Land tax due for the same hath quitted the said House about Seven Years ago and hath not Since he quitted the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or other wise gained a Subsequent Settlement.

William Webb of Milford Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes Cooper on behalf of William Harris an Infant Son of William Harris late of Milford Lane in the said Parish of St. Clement Danes on his Oath Says that he hath often heard the said William Harris the Father Say that he served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one John Randall a Lighterman in the Parish of Saint George in the East in the County of Middlesex and as Appears by his Indentures of Apprenticeship now Produced to his Examinant and that after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rent House paid Taxes or Otherwise gained a Subsequent Settlement

Isabella Thompson Aged about fifty Nine Years on her Oath says she never was married Rent House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Robert Titchbull a Merchant at Hackney in the County of Middlesex upwards of two Years at the Yearly Wages of five pounds hath quitted her said service upwards of Twelve Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly servant for one Year

Martha Stephenson Aged about Sixty Eight on behalf of William Stephenson her grandson an Infant Aged about Twelve Years son of George & Elizth. Stephenson both deceased on her Oath says George Stephenson the Father of the sd. William Stephenson the Infant Rented and lived in a House known by the Name or sign of the Two Blue Posts near Porters Block West Smith field in the Parish of St. Sepulchre Middlesex for upwards of four Months at the Yearly Rent of Eighteen Pounds Eighteen Shillings hath quitted the said House upwards of Eight Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a subsequent settlement

John Meredith Aged about Sixty Years on his Oath says he intermarried with Margaret his Wife at the Parish Church of St. George the Martyr Queen Square about Twenty Years ago and by whom he hath four Children now living all of whom is now provided for says he served Seven Years Apprentice with one Mr. Sadler a Baker the Corner of Red Lyon Passage in the said Parish of Saint George the Martyr Queen Square in the County of Middlesex, and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or otherwise gained a Subsequent Settlement.

Penelope Anderson Aged about Seventeen Years on her Oath says she was bound out an Apprentice by the Govrs. & Guardians of the Foundling Hospital to one Mr. Scott a Book binder in Princes's Street Red Lyon Square and Served her Master there for one Year and upwards and afterwards her said Master removed into Villers Street York Buildings where she continued to live with him thereupwards of half a Year where her Master broke and run away into Stoctland since which time she hath never gained any Subsequent Settlement either by being turned over to any other Master or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizth. Turpin Aged about Thirty Nine Years On her Oath Says she is the Widow of Joseph Turpin who has been dead upwards of Six Weeks ago and with whom she intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Dunstans in the West upwards of Thirteen Years ago and by whom she hath five Children now living Vizt. Joseph Aged about thirteen Years, Elizth . Aged about Ten Years, George Aged about five Years William Aged about Three Years, and John Aged about one Year and an half says that her said late Husband was born in the Parish of Studham in the County of Bedford and never gained any other Subsequent Settlemt either by Renting ten pounds a Year or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year says her said late Husband has often informed that he served Seven Years Apprentice with one Luke Brickland a Breaches Maker at St. Albans in the County of Hertford But the said Luke Brick being a Certificated Man her said Husband gained no Settlement thereby.

Theodocia Hopkins Aged about forty seven on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly servant with one Mr. Chandler a Carver and Guilder in New Street near Broad Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster for Twelve Years or thereabouts hath quitted her said service about Six Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a Yearly hired Servant for one Year

Elizabeth Kezar aged about Thirty Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Peter Kezar a German gone from her and who never gained a Settlemt. in England either by Renting house or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year before Marriage Says before her Intermarriage with her said Husband she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Father in Law Thos. Storey a Scourer in Bell Yard in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex for several Years at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Nine Years ago & hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Hammond aged about forty Two Years on her Oath Says she intermarried with her late Husband James Hammond deceased at the Parish Church of Saint George tho Martyr Southwark in the County of Surry upwards of Twelve Years ago and by whom she hath four Children now living Namely Mary aged about Eleven Years John and Elizabeth Two Twins aged upwards of Three Years and an half and Thomas aged about Six Months Says her said late Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. William Haydon a Grocer in Blackman Street South in the said Parish of St. George the Martyr Southwark in upwards of Seven Years County of Surry and after quitting that Service he was Rented House or otherwise gained a Subsequent Settlement

Thomas Clayton aged about forty five Years on his Oath Says he is now a Widower and that no Children living Says that before his Intermarriage with his late Wife and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Cripps a Goldsmith in Saint James Street in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex upwards of One Year and Three Quarters at the Yearly Wages of Nine Pounds for the first Year and Ten Pounds for the last Year hath quitted his said service upwards of Twenty four Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

John Mercer Aged about Thirty Eight Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Frances his Wife at St. Leonards Shoreditch in the County of Middlesex about Sixteen Years ago and by whom he hath four Children Namely John Aged about fourteen Years Mary Aged about five Years & Samuel & Rebecca Twins Aged about fifteen Months Says that since the time of the Churchwardens & Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Saint Mary Le Cheap London acknowledging this Examinant to be a Parishoner legally Settled in the sd Parish of St. Mary Le Cheap he never Rented Rented House or lived a hired Yearly Servant before Marriage neither has he done any other Act since Marriage whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Peter Minton Aged about forty four Years on her Oath Says he Intermarried with Ann his late Wife at the Parish Church of St. Ann Black Fryars about Twenty Years Ago and who has been dead about 18 Years ago and by whom he hath one Child now living Namely Mary Aged about Twelve Years Says he served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Thomas Anderson a Cuttler near Smith field Bars in the Parish of Saint Sepulchres London and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House of Ten Pounds P Annum paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year neither or hath he done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Ann Shaffeitile Aged about Thirty four Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried with Jasper Shaffeitlile her Husband gone from her at the Parish Church of St. Pauls Covent Garden in the Year 1762. and by whom she hath five Children now living namely Mary Ann aged about Nine Years Isabella & Christiana Twins Aged about Seven years George Aged about Three Years and Margaretta Aged about Twelve Months Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Cumberland Street in the Parish of St. Pancras in the County of Middlesex for Three Years & an half at the Yearly Rent of Thirty Pounds hath quitted the said House about Two Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Judith Bury on the behalf of William Slumbers an Infant Aged about Eight Years on her Oath Says that he is the Son of James and Mary Slumbers who on her Oath Says were Intermarried at the Parish Church of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex and who are now both deceased and further says that the said William Slumbers the Infant was born in the sd Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the said County of Middlesex and that she can give us further or other Account of her of the Settlement of the Father of the said Infant nor of the sd. Infant otherwise than that he was born in the sd. Parish of St. Giles in the fields

Judith Bury Aged about Thirty Six Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried with Benson Bury at the Parish Church of St. Clement Danes a Nine Years ago and by om she hath Two Children now living Vizt Mary Aged about Six Years and Benson Aged about Nine Months Says that her said late Husband Served seven Years Apprenticeship with Mr. Demnott a Bookbinder the Corner of Swan Yard in the Parish of St. Mary Le Strand in the said Liberty and after her said late Husband was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year or otherwise gained a Subsequent Settlemt.

Thomas Bardin Aged about forty Six Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Jane his Wife at the Parish Church of St. Dunstan in the West about Nineteen Years ago and by whom he hath Eight Children now living two of whom are now provided for) and William aged about Thirteen Years Ann Aged about Twelve Years Sarah Aged about Nine Years Richd Aged about Seven Years John Aged about four Years and Nathaniel aged about Two Years Says his Father John Barden Served four Years the first Part of his Apprenticeship with a Glass Grinder near Puddle Dock in the Parish of St. Andrew Wardrobe in the City of London & further says that his said Father Never was Assigned Over to any other Person nor ever gained any Subsequent Setlement either by renting House paying taxed or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year as his said Father has often informed him and which Information he verily believes to be true

Ann Austin Aged about Thirty five Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father John Austin Rented and lived in a House in King Street Golden Square in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr . for sevl. Years at the Yearly Rent of fifteen Pounds and upwards and when this Examinant was born And further says that she was bound an Apprentice to one Mr. Bowen a Childs Coc maker in Swallow Street in the sd. Parish of Saint James and lived within upwards of One Year & then parted by Consent since which time she has done no Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Susannah Berry Aged about Twenty three Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House Paid Taxes or ever served any Apprenticeship Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Watts a Butcher in Carnaby Street Carnaby Markett in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr . for Two Years & an half at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Two Years ago & hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Dorothy Vincent Aged about Sixty Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife or Widow of William Vincent gone from her with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Brides in the Year 1740 Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Little St. Martins Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster for sevl. Years at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Eight Pounds and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about fifteen Years ago and hath not since quitting the same done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement to her Knowledge or belief neith hath this Examinant.

John Clayton Aged about Sixty five Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Susannah his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Andrews about Sixteen Years ago and by whom he hath no Children now living Says he Rented and lived in a House in Roy Oak Yard Hatton Garden in the Liberty of Hatton Garden in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn in the County of Middlesex for One Year and a Quarter at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the same upwards of Eighteen Years Ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Ruth Matthews Aged about Thirty Six Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of John Matthews who has been dead upwards of Two Years Says her said late Husband had several Small Houses in Farthing alley Barnaby Street in the Parish of Saint Olave Southwark in the County of Surry for the Term of his Natural Life at the Yearly Income of Twenty five Pounds & where this Examinant lived and Paid all Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said Houses upwards of five Years ago and hath not since quitting the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Meredith Harris Aged about Sixty Two Years on his Oath Says he never was married Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says he served Seven Years Apprenticeship to one Thomas Shaw a Shoemaker in Queen Street the Corner of Gilbert Street in the Parish of Saint George the Martyr Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he has never done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Ann Guthrie Aged about fifty Three Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Alexander Guthrie who has been dead near Twenty Years ago and with whom she Intermarried at the Fleet London about Thirty Years ago and by whom she hath Three Children now living at of whom are now Provided for Says her said late Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship with his Uncle Guthrie a Tobacconist in the Parish of St. Katherine by the Tower and after her said Husband was out of his Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid taxes or otherwise gained any Subsequent Settlement neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death

Catherine Branden Aged about Forty Seven Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Ann Ellis in Old Burlington Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster for Two Years at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Six Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Worrall Aged about forty Six Years on behalf of Daniel Henry and Rebecca Infants by Daniel Henry Wood their Father lately deceased on her Oath says that the Sd. Daniel Henry Wood her Son aged about Thirteen Years and Rebecca Wood her Daughter Aged about Ten Years were both born in George Court Rupert Street in the Parish of Saint James in Liberty of Westminster and Says that her said Two Children Never did any Act whereby to gain any Settlement.

Mary Worral Aged about Forty Six Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rent House in her own right Says that this Examinant lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Davis a Pewterer in the Parish of Saint Mary at Lambeth in the County of Surry upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds since which time hath sd her said Service upwards of Fifteen Years ago & hath not Rented House in her own right Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Elizabeth Bridgen Aged about Twenty three Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Merrington at the House of one Mr. Thomas a Taylor at No. 6 in St. Johns Square in the Parish of Saint James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex upwards of one Year at the hath quitted her said service upwards of five Years ago Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes a lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year And further upon her Oath says halon the 5th day of September last she was delivered of a Female Bastard Child in the House of Mr. Miller a Hairdresser in Wych Street in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes which hath since been baptized by the Name of Ann Says that one Christopher Plumley a Taylor who is now run away is the Father thereof he having had Carnal knowledge of her Body sometime in December 1772 & at severally different times afterwards at one of which times he got her with Child of the Female Child of which she was so delivered as aforesaid and that the said Christ Plumley and no other Person did beget the same and that he is the real and true Father thereof

Saml. Massey Aged About Twenty four Years on his Oath Says he never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says he served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Whitehead a Shoemaker in Little Turn Still Holbourn who afterwards removed into Duke Street Lincolns Inn Fields in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex & says that after he was out of his said Apprenticeship He never Rented House paid Taxes or otherwise Gained any Subsequent Settlement

Martha Tinkler on behalf of Mary Lacey singlewoman Aged upwards of Eighteen Years who now lives ill of a Fever on her Oath Says that the said Mary Lacey never was married Rented House was an Apprentice or lived hired Yearly Servant for one Years Say her late Father John Lacey rented and lived in a House in Bridgewater Gardens near Goswell Street in the Parish of St. Giles Cripplegate London for five Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Eleven Pounds as she has oftentimes been informed and believes the same to be true and further Says that the said John Lacey has been dead about five Years and that the said Mary Lacey since her said Fathers Death or before never gained any or subsequent Settlement

Mary Widdon Delose Aged about Twenty one Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or Paid Taxes says he was bound an Apprentice to and Served five Years the first part of her Apprenticeship to one Mrs. Short a Mantua Maker who lodged with one Mr. Pinder a Chairman in Great Russell Street in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsburry in the County of Middlesex and never was Assigned over to any other Person nor ever gained any subsequent Settlement by renting House paying Taxes or living a Yearly hired Servant for one Year.

Richd. Phillips Aged about Forty Years on his Oath Says he was bound an Apprentice to one Joseph Slaymaker a Blacksmith in Barnaby Street in the Parish of Saint John Southwark in the County of Surry and served the said Joseph Slaymaker his Master upwards of one Year when his said late Mother bought the Remainder part of his said Apprenticeship of his said Master since which time the never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one year.

Elizabeth Bridgen Aged about Twenty Three Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Lester the Matron at the foundling Hospital in Lambs Conduit Fields in the Parish of Saint Pancras in the County of Middlesex upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of three Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Sarah Triscott Aged about fifty Seven Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Anthony Triscott who has been dead upwards of Twenty two Years ago And this Examinant further says that being a Widow and without Child or Children she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Bigg Shrimpton a Tabacco Cooper in Saint Nicholas Lane Lumbard Street in the Parish of Saint Nicholas Acons London upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said service upwards of five Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizabeth Douglas otherwise Purnell Aged about Twenty Three Years on her Oath Says the never was married Rented House was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year And further says that she was born the Corner of one Tan Alley facing Hungerford Street in the Parish of saint Martin in Fields in the Liberty of Westmr and that one Mr. Pumell who kept the Publik Home there is the reputed Father of this Examinant as she has been Informed and Verity believes the same to the true and that after her said reputed Fathers death Death she never gained any subsequent Settlement as above mentioned

Frances Turner Aged about Twenty Six Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Frances Barbara Villers who lodged in bond Street in the Parish in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Twelve Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

John Smithers Aged about Twenty Seven Years on his Oath Says to Intermarried with Sarah his Wife at the Parish Church of St. Leonard Shoreditch about five Years Ago and by whom he hath one Child now living Namely Hannah Aged about Sixteen Months Says he served seven Years Apprenticeship with one Richard Palmer a Watch Casemaker in Red Lyon Street Clerkenwell in the Parish of Saint James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or otherwise gained a Subsequent Settlement

Martha Jones Aged about Seventeen Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes or was served any Apprenticeship or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father John Jones Rented and lived in Two Houses the one on Saffron Hill ely Rents in the Parish of St. Andrews Holbourn in the County of Middlesex the Other in Union Court in the said Liberty the first of which Mentioned House he paid upwards of Ten Pounds a Year and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same but what Rent her said Father paid for the last mentioned House this Examinant Cannot set forth Since which time her said Father or this Examinant ever gained any subsequent Settlemt. to her Knowledge or belief and as she has been Informed her Bother George Jones

Mary Pickering Aged about Twenty five Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says she was bound an Apprentice to and Served one Daniel Adcock a Ribbon Weaver in in Holywell Row in the Parish of St. Leonard Shoreditch in the County of Middlesex for Three Years or upwards the first part of her said Apprenticeship but through the ill Usage of her Master her late Mother took her away says she never was Assigned Over to any other Person or ever gained any Subsequent Settlement and Further says that on the 28th day of Decr. past she was delivered of Female Bastard Child in the House of Mr. Miller in Little Wych Street which has since been baptized by the Name of Ann Says that one George Lee is the Father then of he having had carnal Knowledge of her Body sometime the Month of April 1773 and at servl. different times afterwards at one of Which times he got her with Child of the Female Bastard of which she was so delivered as afsd. and that the said Geo. Lee did beget the same and that he is the real and true Father

Ann Hooper Aged about Twenty five Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Robert Hooper gone from her with whom she intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Brides London in the Year 1770 Says her said Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Allen a Printer in Bolt Court Fleet Street in the Parish of Saint Dunstand in the West London And that after her said Husband was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Parish Taxes or orwise gained any subsequent Settlement

Hannah Pye Aged about Twenty Six Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Henry Knowles who now keeps a Cooks Shops in Whites Alley Chanecry Lane in Liberty of the Rolls upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds Ten Shillings hath quitted her said Service upwards of half a Year ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever gained any other subsequent Settlement

Henry Collins Holdaway Aged about Thirty Nine Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Susannah his Present Wife at Bishop Storford in the County of Essex about Two Years ago and by whom he hath one Child Named Samuel Aged about Eight Months Says he was bound Apprentice to and Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one William Rooke a Pene Cutter on Stepney Green in the Parish of St. Dunstan Stepney in the County of Middlesex and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he Rented and lived in a House in Mutton Lane in the Aforesaid Parish upwards of one Year at the Yearly Rent of Nine Pounds and paid Land Tax due for the same but no poors Rate and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship & Renting the above House he never gained any other subsequent Settlement whatever.

Elizth. Smith aged about about Eighty Three Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Charles Smith who has been dead about Twelve Years Says her said late Husband Served seven Years Apprenticeship to one Mr. Weaver a Baker in the Haymarkett in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr . and lived several Years as a Journey man with the said Mr. Weaver before this Examinant intermarried with her said late Husband and after he quitted the said Mr. Weavers Service he never Rented House paid Taxes or did any of Act Where by to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Abner Osman Aged about fifty Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Rachael Osman now in the Workhouse belonging to the Parish of St. George Southwark in the County of Surry at the Parish Church of St. George aforesaid about Twenty five Years ago and by whom he hath Two Children Namely Elizabeth Aged about Twenty Three Years and Rachael aged about Eighteen Years Says he served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one William Frame a Cork Cutter in the Borough of Southwark in the County of Surry and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Neither hath the said Elizabeth or Rachael his Children done any Act whereby to gain any other Subsequent Settlement

Elizth. Lawson Aged about fifty Nine Years on behalf of William Adamson an Infant aged about Six Years whose Father John Adamson has deserted him on her Oath Says that the said John Adamson Intermarried with Mary his Wife at the Parish Church of St. Olave Southwark in the County of Surry in the Year 1765 as appears to this Examinant from a Copy of the Register of the said Parish and further Says that the said John Adamson the Father served seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Woodfall a Printer in Pater Roster Row in the Parish of Saint Saith London and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House Paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other subsequent Settlement to her knowledge or beleif

Elizabeth Latham Aged about Thirty Seven Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried with her late Husband Charles Latham at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the Fields about Sixteen Years Ago and who has been dead about Three Months Says she has Two Children now living by her said late Husband Namely Henry Aged upwards of Eight Years and Thomas aged upwards of five Years Says that her said late Husband as he has often Informed her lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Benjamin Sedgley at the Ship and Anchor Temple Bar in the Parish of St. Clement Danes upwards of One Year but at what Wages cannot say and after quitting that Service he went to her with one Mr. Marr a Hatter the Corner of Arundel Street in the Strand in the said Parish of St. Clement Danes and lived with him upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds besides Diet and Lodgings as she believes And after quitting the said Mr. Marrs service he hired himself and went to live with one Mr. Morry weather Haberdasher in Hatts in the Parish of Saint Edmunds the King Lombard Street London at the Yearly Wages of fifteen pounds and served his said Master accordingly for that time and received Wages agreeable thereto But says that this Examinant intermarried with her said late Husband about Six Months after he went to live with the said Mr. Merryweather on where Marriage or seven afterwards her said Husband with his Masters Consent took Lodging in Nicholas Lane in the Parish of St. Nicholas Acons where he Continued to lodge till the time he left his said Master which is about Eight Years ago since which time he never Rented House or otherwise gained any subsequent Settlement.

Elizth. Henley Aged about Twenty five Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House was an Apprentice or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father Rented any lived in a House in Justice Walk in the Parish of St. Lukes Chelsea in the County of Middlesex in which Parish this Examinant was born And further says that she was passed from St. Andrew Holbourn upon the said Parish of Saint Lukes Chelsea Afsd. where her said Settlement was found to be upon an Appeal at the Quarter Sessions since which time she has never gained any other Subseqt. Settlmnt.

Isaac Gurney Aged about Thirty Two Years on Oath Says he Intermarried with Elizth . his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Mary le Bone upwards of five Years ago and by whom he hath three Children now living Namely Mary Ann Aged about four years Charlott Aged about Three Years and Carolina Aged about Eighteen Months Says that before his Inter- marriage with his said Wife and whilst he was a singleman he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Thomas Whillingham at a Carpett Warehouse in Bread Street Allhallows in the City of London for one Year and an half at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds besides Diet and Lodging hath quitted his said Service upwards of Six Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Eliz. Tordan Aged about Twenty five Years on her Oath says she Inermarried with her Husband Alexander Tordan at the Parish Church of St. Katherine by the Tower on the Second day of Octr. in the year 1765 and by whom she his two Children now living namely Harriot . Aged about Seven Years and Ann Aged about four Years Says her said Husband is gone from her and is now at Portsman and at Present she is unable to provide for herself and her said Children and this Examinant farther says that her said Husband Rented and liv'd in a House in the Green yard in the Parish of St. Johns Wapping in the County of Middlesex of the Yearly Rent of Six Pounds six shillings and paid land Tax due for the same hath Quitted the said house upwards of Six Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented house paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Elley Aged about Twenty Six Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried with her said Husband John Elley at the Parish Church of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex upwards of Seven Years ago and by whom she hath Two Children now living Namely Mary Aged about Three Years and John Aged about Seven Weeks Says her said Husband (who now lies under Sentence of Transportation) is a Native of France and never gained any Settlement in England either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly or Covenanted Servant for one Year Says that before her Intermarriage and whilst she was a Singlwoman she lived a Hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Precious West. a Cabinet Maker in High Holbourn in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex for fourteen Months at the Yearly of five Pounds hath quitted her said service about 9 Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever gained any or Subsequent Settlement.

Benjn. Morley Aged about Twenty Eight Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Mary his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlex in November last past and by whom he hath no Child Says he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Ealing at an Academy at Kensington Gravel Pitts in the Parish of Kensington in the County of Middlesex upwards of Sixteen Months at the Yearly Wages of Ten pounds hath quitted his said Service upwards of Eight Months ago since which time he hath never gained any subsequent Settlement.

Eleanor Moore Aged about Thirty Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried with Robert Moore her Husband who has been gone for her about four Years and does not know whr. his is living or Dead And by whom she hath Two Children now living namely Jane Aged about Eleven Years and John Aged about Eight Years Says her said Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Daniel Peirs a Silver Smith in Spur Street Leicester Fields in the Parish of Saint Anns Soho in the Liberty of Westminster and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House Paid Taxes or otherwise gained any Subsequent Settlement to her knowledge or belief Says that she this Examinant Rented a House in Princes Street Saint James's but without any knowledge of her said Husband or did he ever know who the Landlord of the Premises was or ever engaged for the paymt. of the Rent or orwise

Ann Roffee Aged about Sixty four Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Henry Roffee who has been Dead about four Years and a half, Says that before his Intermarrd with this Examinant her said Husband Rented and lived in a house in little Saint James Street in the Parish of Saint James in the liberty of Westmr for several Years at the Yearly Rent of Sixteen pounds or upwards and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Twenty four Years ago and after he Quitted the same he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year or ever gained a Subsequent Settlemt.

Sarah Rouse Aged about twenty four Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House paid Taxes served any Apprenticeship or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year says her Father Rented and lived in a House in Theobalds Row Red Lyon Street in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn above the Bars for several Years at the Yearly Rent of Ten pounds or Upwards (as she has often heard her Aunt say, and which she verily beleives to be true,) paid Taxes due for the same and where this Examinant was born, says her said Father has been Dead upwards of Eighteen Years ago as her said Aunt has also informed her since which time she never gained any other subsequent Settlement

Frances Mathews On her Oath saith she is about Sixty Years of Age and yt she Intermarried with Edward Mathew at the Fleet London about Thirty Years ago, says her said Husband was a Native of Ireland and never gained any settlement in England to the best of her knowledge & beleif and says that being a Widow and without Child or Children she lived a hired Yearly Servant with One Mr Jackson a Master Taylor in Paradise Row in the Parish of Saint Luke Chelsea upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Five Guineas a Year has Quitted her said service about Twelve Years ago, and since that time has never rented House paid Taxes or otherwise gained a subsequent Settlement

Sarah Radbourn Aged about Thirty Seven Years On her Oath says she never was Married, Rented House, was Apprentice, or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year; Says her father Thomas Radbourn Rented and lived in a House in Angel Court Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middlesex at the Yearly rent of fifteen Pounds and paid Taxes for the same and further says her said father has been dead about Twenty Two Years and that since that time this Examinant has never gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Christian Storey Aged about Twenty One Years on her Oath says that She intermarried with her husband William Storey (who was Transported about a Month Ago) at the Parish Church of Saint Ann Soho in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middlesex , and by whom she has One Child now Living Named Wm Joseph Aged about 10 Months, And further on her Oath says that her said Husband Served 5 Years the first Part of his Apprenticeship with One Mr Ravenscraw in Street in the Parish of Saint Botolph Bishopsgate London And that Since that time he has never Rented House paid Taxes lived A hired Yearly Servant or has done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Eleanor Trevor Aged about Seventy Eight Years on his Oath says She is the Widow of Thomas Trevor who has been dead about Six Years and by whom she hath no Children now living Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in White Hart Yard in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields upwards of Eighteen Years and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath Quitted the said House upwards of 14 Years ago and after he Quitted the same he never Rented House paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Robert Gilmour Aged about Sixty Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Elizabeth his now Wife at Shrewsbury in the County of Salop about Six Years ago and by whom he hath no Children now living Says before his Intermarriage with his said Wife he lived as a Warrant Servant in the Capacity of a Turnbroach with her Royall Highness the Princess Dowager of Wales in the Parish of Saint James in the liberty of Westminster for several Years at the Yearly Wages of Twenty Pounds hath Quitted his said Service about 5 Years ago and hath not since he Quitted the same ever done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Ann Row Aged about Twenty nine Years on her Oath says that she never was Married, Rented House, Paid Taxes, or ever Served any Apprenticeship, says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with One Mr Sowerby at the Crown in Little Bridges Street Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster about Two Years at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath Quitted her said Service about Three Months and hath not since she Quitted the same ever gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Mary Parkison Widow aged about forty Years on her Oath Says that she Intermarried with William her late Husband at the Parish of Saint Giles Cripplegate about Fifteen Years ago & who has been dead about Six Years ago, and by whom she has no Children now living and further on her Oath says that her said Husband lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Wallington a Soap boiler in Red Cross Street in the Parish of St. Giles Cripplegate London upwards of five Year at the Yearly Wages of forty Pounds and since her said Husbands death she has never done any Act Whereby to Grain any other Subsequent Settlement

Sarah Allen Wife of John Allen on the behalf of Eliz Stanfield an Infant Aged about four Months whose Father and Mother are lately Dead says that before the Death of the father John Stanfield her rented and lived in a house in Snow fields near Bermondsey Street in the Parish of Saint Mary Magdalen Bermondsey in the borough of Southwark in the County of Surry for five Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Nine pounds and paid Land Tax due for the same hath had Quitted the said House upwards of Two Years before his Death and never after Rented House Paid Taxes or otherwise gained any Subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Austry Aged about Nineteen Years in her Oath says She never was Married Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father Thomas Austry Rented and lived in a House in Queen Court near Little Turn Stile Holbourn in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds a Year lived therein for forty Days and Upwards and Paid Thirty Shillings for the six weeks he lived therein hath Quitted the same ever since Midsummer 1763 since which time her said Father, hath never Rented House Paid Taxes or done any act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement as her mother has informed her and which Information She verily believes to be true

John James Aged upwards of Thirty nine Years on his Oath says he is now a Widower and has no Children, now Living says he was bound Apprentices to Moses Viridet an Orris Weavers in Fetherston Street in the Parish of Saint Luke Old street in the County of Middlesex and Served his said Master under those Indentures the full term of Seven Years, and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never rented ten pounds a Year paid Taxes, lived a hired Yearly Servant or any otherwise gained a Subsequent Settlement.

John Harpham Aged about Thirty Eight Years on his Oath says he Intermarried with Alice his Wife at Saint Leonard Shoreditch upwards of Eight Years ago, and by whom he hath Two Children now living namely John Aged about Seven years and Ann Aged about five Years says before his Intermarriage with his said Wife & whilst a Single Man he lived as hired Yearly Servant with the Honourable William Stourton Esqr Commonly Called Lord Stourton at Chipping hill in the Parish of Witham in the County of Essex upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Ten Pounds, hath Quitted his said Service upward of fourteen Years and hath not Since he Quitted the same ever Rented house paid Taxes lived A hired Yearly Servant or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Jacobs aged about Forty Years ( Wife of John Jacobs gone from her) on her Oath says she Married her said Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Botolph Bishopgate in the Year One Thousand Seven Hundred & Sixty four and by whom she hath four Children now living Namely Mary Aged Upwards of Eight Years, William Aged about Six Years, Martha Aged about five, and John Aged about three Years, Says before her intermarriage with her said Husband and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a Hired Yearly Servant with Jacob Wilkinson Esqr . in Abchurch Lane in the Parish of Saint Nicholas Acons for Three Years, at the Yearly Wages of Ten pounds, hath quitted his said Service about Ten Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented house paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Ann Anthony Aged about Twenty two Years on her Oath Says she never was Married Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly servant for one Year Says she was bound an Apprentice by the Churchwardens & Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Saint George Botolph Lane London to one Mrs. Bishop at a Chandlers Shop in Beer Lane Tower Street in the Parish of Alhallows Barking in the said City of London , and Served five Years, part of her said Apprenticeship and then left her said Mistress, Since which time she has never done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement.

Elizabeth Loveland Aged about Twenty Nine Years, on her Oath Says she is the wife of Stephen Loveland (who is gone from her) with whom she intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Paul Covent Garden about Eleven Years ago, and by whom she hath one Child now alive namely Ann Aged about Nine Years, Says that her said husband Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Boyce a Cutler in Maiden Lane in the said Parish of Saint Pauls Covent Garden and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he Rented and lived in a House in a Court adjoining to White hart Yard in the said Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of half a Year at the Yearly rent of Ten Pounds as Years and paid all Parish Taxes for the same, hath Quitted the said house about Three Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or done any other act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement.

Samuel Vaughan Aged upwards of Thirty three Years his Oath Says he never Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year or ever Served any Apprenticeship, Says that he intermarried with his present wife Mary at the Parish Church of Saint Leonard Shoreditch about 11-Years ago and by whom he hath three Children now living namely Ann Aged about Eight Years, Susannah Aged about two Years and Amelia aged about 10 Weeks, Says that his father Samuel Vaughan served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Arnold an Apothocary in Salisbury Court in the Parish of Saint Brides otherwise Bridget in the City of London and never after Rented House paid Taxes or any otherwise Gained any Subsequent Settlement

Joseph Cross Aged about fifty two Years on his Oath Says, that he Intermarried with Mary his Wife (gone from him) at the Parish Church of Saint Andrews Holbourn in the Year 1768 and by whom he hath one Child now living, namely Peter aged upwards of five Years, gone with his Mother, but where they are he does not know: Says he Rented and lived in a House in Yeomans Row Brumpton in the Parish of Kensington in the County of Middlesex for two Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of fifteen Pounds and Paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath Quitted his said House about four Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Mary Hussey aged upwards of Sixty five Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House paid Taxes or ever served any Apprenticeship Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Daniel Hewitt who Kept a boarding School at Bromley near Bow in the County of Middlesex upwards of Three Years at the Yearly Wages of four pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Twenty five Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year or orwise. Gained any Subsequent Settlement
