Margaret Tyrer Aged about Thirty Nine Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Joseph Tyrer who has been dead about Three Years and with who she intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holbourn about Eleven Years ago & by whom she hath no Children now living, says her said Husbands Rented and lived in a House on Saffron Hill Ely Rents for Seven Years at the Yearly Rent of Twelve pounds and paid all parish Taxes due for the same that he Quitted the said House upwards of Three Years ago and never after Rented House paid Taxes on otherwise gained any Subsequent Settlement - Neither has this Examinant since her said Husband Death.

Mary Dawney Singlewoman Aged Sixty Years and upwards upon her Oath Says she never was Married was an Apprentice or Rented a House of Ten pounds a Year or lived a Yearly hired Servant for a Year Says her Father Jas Dawney Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Black - A Shoemaker in the Parish of Saint Giles Cripplegate in the City of London where Name she Says her said Father about Two Years after he was out of his said Apprenticeship went for a Soldier and was in Colonol Honeywoods Company for many Years and died in Chelsea College or Hospital and never after after his said Apprenticeship Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year, as her said father hath often informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true.

Sarah Bylin otherwise Byling Aged upwards of Forty One Years on her Oath says that she is the Wife of John Byling otherwise Bylin (gone from her) with whom she intermarried as the Parish Church of Saint Leonard Shoreditch about Sixteen Years Ago and by whom she hath no Children now alive, Says her said Husband served Seven years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Wyatt a Copper plate printers in Long Acre in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes lived hired Yearly Servant for one Year or any otherwise gained a Subsequent Settlement to the best of this Examinants Knowledge or belief.

Thomas Steele Earle Aged about Thirty years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Ann his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Leonard Shoreditch about Six years ago and by whom he hath three Children now living namely Thomas Aged upwards of five years who was born a Bastard in Grub Street in the Parish of St. Giles Cripplegate before this Examinant married to his said wife. Richard aged about three years and Mary aged about nine Months says he Served Seven years A pprenticeship with one Mr Hart a Mast Maker at Shad Thomas in the Parish of Saint John Horsly Down fair Street in the Borough of Southwarke in the County of Surry and after he was out of his said Apprentice- ship he never Rented House paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other subsequent Settlement

Hannah Lightfoot Aged about Nineteen years on her Oath says she never was Married, Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired yearly Servant with Robert Barrow a Stationer in Saint Brides passage Fleet Street in the Parish of Saint Brides otherwise Bridget in the City of London for Two years or thereabouts at the yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted her said Service about nine months ago since which time she hath gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Corney Aged about forty five years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Samuel Littlefear a Cutler in London Hall Street in the Parish of Saint Andrew Undershaft in the City of London upwards of Two years and an half at the yearly Wages of Three Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Twenty Eight years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or ever lived a hired yearly Servant for one year or otherwise gained any Subsequent Settlement.

Mary Chandler Aged about Sixty five years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Joseph Chandler who has been dead about Eleven years and by whom she hath no Childn. living Says her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in Lewkeners Lane in the Parish of Saint Giles in th Fields in the County of Middlesex upwards of Half a year at the yearly Rent of Eleven Pounds and paid Parish Taxes due for the same and quitted said House near Twenty years ago & never after he quitted same Rented House paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other Subseqt. Settlement neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death.

John Chappell aged about fifty Three years on his Oath Says that He Rented and lived in a House in Grays Inn Lane in the Parish of Saint Andrew above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for several years at the yearly Rent of Sixteen pounds and paid all parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House upwards of Ten years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement.

William Bason Aged about Sixty one years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Rebecca his late at the Savoy Church about Thirty four years ago and by whom he hath no Children living except One now provided for Says he Rented and lived in a House in Pettyford Yard Little Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Strand upwards of four years at the yearly Rent of fourteen Pounds and paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Twenty Nine years ago and after quitting the same he never Rented House paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Susan Inman Aged about Twenty Two years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Middleton a Taylor in Little Portland Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr . & County of Middlesex upwards of Two years at the yearly Wages Vizt. the first year at 4 Pounds and & the remaining other time at four pounds Ten Shillings hath quitted her said Service upwards of four years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year.

Sarah Tunnicliff Aged about Sixty years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Joseph Tunnicliff who has been dead about five years and by whom she hath no Children now living Says that being a Widow and without Child or Children she lived a hired yearly Servant with one William Raven as Beadle to the Stationers Company in Stationers Court Ludgate Hill in the Parish of Saint Martin Ludgate in the City of London for one year all but Two or Three Days which her said Mistress gave her but received but received her whole years Wages hath quitted her said Service upwards of Two years since which time she never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year

Catherine Lowe Aged about Thirty five years on behalf of Jane Low her Female Bastard Child on her Oath says that Richard Cundall who was the Father of her said Child is now Dead and further says that the said Jane Lowe the Infant is upwards of Seven years old and was born in the House of one John Mead in Whites Alley in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex and that she the said Jane Low her Daughter hath done no Act to gain a Settlement in any other Parish or Place

Dorothy Hall aged about forty years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired yearly Servant with Messrs. Belcher and Gray Cabinett makers in Brownlow Street in the Parish of Saint Andrews Holbourn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex upwards of One year and three Quarters at the yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Three Months ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement

Mary Ashford Aged about Twenty Eight years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House served any Apprenticeship or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year Says she has a Female Bastard Child begotten by one Joseph Symonds Named Jane Aged about four years which which was born near the Rose and Crown Ale house at Wandsworth in the County of Surry And this Examinant further saith that her late Father James Ashford served Seven years Apprenticeship to one William Gardiner a Waterman at Wandsworth aforesaid in the said County of Surry and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement neither hath this Examinant since her said Father death

Jane Gallard Aged about Twenty Three Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried to her Husband Henry Gallard (a Soldier belonging to the Third Regiment of Guards & who is now draughted off and gone for America at the Parish Church of Kensington about Three Years ago and by whom she hath Two Children now living namely Rebecca Aged about Two Years and Edward Aged about Two Months Says her said Husband Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with his Father who was by Trade a Carpenter in the Parish of Cook field in the County of Sussex and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly or Covenanted Servant for one Year or otherwise Gained any or Subsequent Settlement to her knowledge or beleif.

Elizabeth Jenkins Aged about Thirty Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says she was bound an Apprentice by the Churchwardens and Overseers of the Parish of Saint Johns Southwark in the County of Surry to one Mr. Whitchurch a Carpenter near Queen hithe in the Parish of Saint Michael Queen hithe in the City of London and after she was out of her said Apprenticeship she hath never done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Grendon Aged about forty Six Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says She lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Webster Esqr. in Great Marlbrough Street in the Parish of St James in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of Three Years at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Eighteen Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Elizth. Wood Aged about Thirty Six Years on her Oath Says she intermarried with George Wood her Husband now gone to America at the Parish Church of Lime house on the 26th. of September 1774 by whom she hath no Children now living Says her said Husband was bound an Apprenticeship to one Mr. Lodge a Scowier in Fenchurch Street London and Served Six Years or thereabouts the first part of his said Apprenticeship and afterwards was Assigned Over to one Mr. Lawrence a Scowier in Somerset Street White Chapel in the Parish of St. Botolph without Aldgate London and served the remainder of his said Apprenticeship which was upwards of Eleven Months as her said Husband has of ten informed her and which she believes to be true and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House or Tenemt. of Ten pounds P Ann. paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant or orwise gained any or Subsequent Settlement to her knowledge or belief.

Hannah Grove Aged about 58 Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of Saml. Grove who has been Dead about nine Years and by whom she hath four Children now living all of whom are now provided for except Hannah aged about nineteen who has never gained any other Settlement than thro' her father and furthr says that her said late husband Rented and lived in a House in Suffolk Street in the Mint in the Parish of Saint George in the Borough of Southwark in the County of Surry for 12 Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of twelve pounds and after he quitted the said house he never afterwards rented house paid Taxes or otherwise gained anyother subsequent Settlement neither hath this Examinant since her said husbands Death.

Penalope Hunt aged about 40 Years on her oath says she never was married rented house paid taxes or ever served any Apprenticeship, says, she lived a hirely yearly servant with one Mr. Osborne a Pilot at the Waterman Arms the Cornor of Bread Street Ratcliffe Cross in the Parish of Saint Dunstans Stepney for three Years at the Yearly Wages of £4.10s. hath quitted her said service upwards of 18 Years ago & hath not since she quitted the same over rented house paid taxes or lived an hirely yearly servant for one Year

Sarah Stone Aged about Twenty Seven Years On her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived as a Covenanted Servant to learn the Business of a Book binder with one William Morless a Book binder in Bear Alley in the little Old Bailey in the Parish of St. Sepulchre London for three Years and after she was out of her time she never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year And further says that on the 23d. day of December last she was delivered of Two Bastard Children in the House of one Mr. Gregory in Change Court Saint Clement Danes which area intended to be called John and Elizabeth And that one John Smelly a Journeyman Book binder and who now lived at Mr. Bells a Bookseller in the Strand is the Father of the said Children And that this Examinant hath gained no other Settlement than as aforesaid

Mary Garthwaite Aged about Thirty Nine Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Charles Garthwaite who has been dead about a Year and an half ago and with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St. James Westmr about Nine Years ago and by whom she hath one Child Named Charles Aged upwards of Seven Years Says her said Late Husband Rented and lived in a House in Johnson Court Charing Cross in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr upwards of One Year at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds and lived therein to the time of his Death since which time this Examinant or her said son have gained no other Settlement.

James Gullesor aged about 57 Years or his oath says he never was married rented house or paid Taxes says lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Lemon at Star Eating house in George Yard Lombard Street in the Parish of St. Edmund the King London for one Year and half at the yearly Wages of eight pounds hath quitted her Service about nine Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever rented house paid taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Whitfield aged about seventy four Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of Jos: Whitfield who died about 6 Months ago in the Workhouse belonging to St. Johnson the Borough of Southwark in the County of Surry Says her said husband Rented and lived in a house in Tooley Street in the said parish of St. John at the yearly Rent of £10 as she bets. hath quitted said house about 8 Years ago and after quitted same to never gained any other subsequent Settlement neither hath this Examinant since her sd. husbands Death.

Sarah Sanders aged about fifty three Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of James Sanders who has been Dead about four Years and with whom she Intermarried in the Fleet about twenty five Years ago and by whom she hath two Children now provided for says her said late husband rented and lived in a house on Clerkenwell Green in the parish of St. James's Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex for several Years at the yearly rent of forty pounds hath quitted the same upwards of twenty Years ago since which time she never rented house paid taxes or otherwise gained any other subsequent Settlement

Mary Moore Aged upwards of Thirteen Years on her Oath Says she was bound an Apprentice by the Churchwardens & Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields to one Anthony Connor a Shoemaker in that Part of Wych Street which lies in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Strand and served her said Master under that Indenture to the time her said Master run Away and Deserted her which was upwards of Nine Months and this Examinant does not know what is become of him And further says that since her said Master has left her she never lived as a hired Yearly Servant for one Year or otherwise gained any other Settlement to the best of her Knowledge or beleif

Sarah Frogley Aged about Nineteen Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House served any Apprenticeship or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father Thos. Frogley served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Ferly a Lighterman in High Street in the Parish of Saint Mary at Lambeth in the County of Surry and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with his said Master upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Nine Guineas & after parting with his said Master he never gained any other Settlement to her knowledge or beleif neither hath this Examinant done any Act whereby to gain any or. Subsequent Settlemt. than as aforesaid

Thos. Mogeridge Aged about fifty Six Years on behalf of Ann Mogeridge his Daur an Infant aged about Twelve Years on his Oath Says that the sd Ann Mogeridge his Daughter was bound out an Apprentice by the Church Wardens and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn above the Bars in the County of Middx to one James Clarke a Sawyer in Goose Alley Fleet Markett in the Parish of St. Sepulchre London and lived with her said Master under that Indenture for the Space of Nine Months when her said Master removed to Goose Ally aforesaid and lived with him there under the same Indenture for upwards of One Year & Three Months till her said Master used his said Daugher ill and was obliged to leave her said Master as this Examinant has been Informed and Verily believes the same to be true

Hester Blacklock Aged about Thirty Nine Years on behalf of Edward Lewis an Infant Aged about Six Years on her Oath Says that the Father Edward Lewis who now lies ill in St. Thomas Hospital Rented and lived in a House in Feathers Court Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Mary le Strand for three Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Twelve pounds hath quitted the said House upwards of Three Years ago and after quitting the same he never Rented House paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Gabriel Long Aged about Thirty Two Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Elizabeth his Wife at the Parish Church of St. Bennetts Paul Wharf London in the Year One Thousand Seven hundred and Seventy Two and by whom he hath Two Children now living Namely John Aged upwards of Two Years and Thomas aged about Three Months And this Examinant further says that he rented and lived in a House in Silver Street Golden Square in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of Eight Months at the Yearly Rent of Thirty Pounds and paid Parish Taxes due for the same that quitted said House about Two Years and an half ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other subsequent Settlement

Margaret Westweather Aged about Twenty Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one James Willick a Shoemaker in Tudor Street in the Precinct of Bridewill London for Eighteen Months at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds hath quitted Same about Nine Months ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement

Jane Stains Aged about Twenty four Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Jones at the Sign of the Queens head in Little Poultney Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Six Months ago since which time she hath never gained any other Subsequent Settlement.

Elizth. Burt aged about Twenty Nine Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Tays says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with the Revd. Mr. White adjoining to Bridewell in the Precinct of Bridewell London upwards of four Years at the Yearly Wages of Ten pounds hath quitted her said Service about Three Months ago since which time she hath gained no other subsequent Settlement.

Elizabeth Burt aged about Twenty Nine Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with the Revd. Mr. White adjoining to Bridewell in the precinct of Bridewell London upwards of four Years at the Yearly Wages of Ten pounds hath quitted her said Service about Three Months ago since which time she hath gained no other subsequent Settlement And further upon her Voluntary Oath Says that on the Seconed day of August last she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in the House of Roger Rock in Bear Yard in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr . which hath since been baptized by the name of Thomas and is become Chargable to the said Parish she being poor and unable to maintain the same And that one Michael Boyd a Footman to her said late Master and who now lives with one Doctr. Warren at Hammersmith in the same Capacity is the Father thereof he having had Carnal Knowledge of her Body in her said Masters House near Bridewell aforesaid on the fifth day of November 1775 and at sevl. different times afterwards at one of which times he got her with Child of the Male Bastard Child of which she was so delivered as aforesaid and that the said Michael Boyd and no other person did beget the same and that he is the real and true Father thereof.

Ann Mc.Cullum Aged about Thirty Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Malcolm Mc.Cullum who is now in America and with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St. Clement Danes about Seventeen Months ago and by whom she hath one Child now living named John aged about fifteen Months says her said Husband was a Native of Scotland and never gained any Settlement in England either by renting House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a Year paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says before her sd. Intermarriage with her said Husband and whilst she was a Single Woman she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr Collick an Attorney in Dyers Buildings Holbourn in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn London upwards of fifteen Months at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds and soon after her sd Marriage left her place since which time her said Husband or this Examinant never gained any other Subseqt. Settlement.

Mary Harris Aged upwards of Twenty one Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Goodwin at the Coach and Horses the Corner of Mill Street in Great Conduct Street in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex upwards of one Year and an half at the Yearly Wages of five five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Two Years ago since which time she never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Yearly.

Sarah Mears Aged about Sixty Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr Asheton Ally in Brooke Street Holborn for fifteen Months at the Yearly Wages of Six pounds hath quitted her said Service about 40 Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same done any Act whereby to gain a subseqt. Settlement

Ann Monday about 21 Years on her Oath says she never was married rented house or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Dickinson who lived at the house of one Mrs. Smith in Frith Street in the Parish of St. Anns Soho in the Liberty of Westmr . upwds. of one Year at the Yearly Wages of £4 hath quitted her said Service upward of four Years ago since which time she hath never lived in one continued Service for one Year or orwise gained any other subseqt. Settlemt.

Ann Richardson Aged about 70 Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of John Richardson by whom she hath no Children now living says her said late husband rented and lived in a House in Warwick Street the Corner of Leicester Street in the Parish of St James's Westmr . in the City and Liberty of Westmr . for one Year and a Quarter at the yearly Rent of £25 and hath quitted the same upwards of 40 Years ago since which time she hath gained no other subsequent Settlemt. either by renting house paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Rowe Aged about 20 Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented house paid Taxes Served any Apprenticeship or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her father Willm. Rowe Rented and lived in a House in Middlesex Court Long Acre in the Parish of St. Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster at the Year Rent of £10 or thereabouts and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the same upwards of eight Years ago since which time neither her said Father nor this Examinant hath or ever gained any other subseqt. Settlemt.

Mary Buzvargus aged about 51 Years on her Oath says she never was married Says she Rented and lived in a House in Aff. Alley York Buildings in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr . upwards of two Years at the Yearly Rent of £28 and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted her said House upwards of seven Years ago since which time she hath gained no other subseqt. Settlemt. either by renting house paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Issac Trueman Aged about 23 Years on his Oath says he never was married Rented house or paid Taxes says he served seven Years Apprentiship with Mr. John Pepper a pockett Bookmaker in George Street Foster Lane in the Parish of St. Leonard Foster Lane London and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never rented house paid Taxes or done any or Act whereby to gain a subsequent Settlement

Ann Maccabe Aged about Twenty four Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of John Maccabe (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holbourn in June 1775 and by whom she hath one Child now living named John Aged aged about Seven months Says her said Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived a hired Yearly Servant at the Smerna Coffee house Pall Mall in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster for Six Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Three pounds or thereabouts and after quitting his said Service he never afterwards gained any other Subsequent Settlement.

Jeremiah Taylor Aged about sixty Years on his Oath says he Intermarried with Mary his Wife at St. Leonard Shoreditch about twenty Years ago and by whom he hath one Child now living vizt. John Aged about thirteen Years Says he served seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Mears an Ivory Turner in Red Lyon Street in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn above the Barrs in the County of Middlesex and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Years or otherwise gained any other subsequent Settlement

George Edwards aged about forty seven Years on his Oath says he never was married Rented house or paid Taxes Says he was bound an Apprentice to Mr. Saml. Willard an Oil man and Colour Man in Maiden Lane Covent Garden in the Parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westmr . and served his said Master upwards of six Years under the same Indres when his Master gave him up the same since which time this Examinant never gained any other subsequent Settlement

Elizth. Cowen Aged about Seventy Two Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Patrick Cowen who has been dead upwards of Twenty Years ago and by whom she hath one Son now provided for Says her said late Husband Rented and lived in a house old Tothill Street in the Parish of St. Margaret in the Liberty of Westmr . upwards of One Year at the Yearly Rent of Eighteen pounds and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House near forty Years ago since which time her said Husband nor this Examinant Never gained any other subsequent Settlemt.

Hannah Skelton Aged about Sixty four Years on behalf of her Daughter Elizabeth Shelton who now lies Ill on her Oath Says that her said Daughter never was married Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year or otherwise gained any other Settlement otherwise than thro' this Examinants late Husband who before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived a hired Yearly Servant to one Jonathan Guirnell a Merchant facing Saint Lawrences Church Yard near Guild Hall in the Parish of St. Lawrence Jewry Church in the City of London for sevl. Years at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds as she believes and after quitting the said last mentioned place he never Rented House paid parish Taxes or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Charles Nicholson Mandell Aged about forty Nine Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Mary his Wife (who is now in Saint Georges Workhouse ) at the Fleet London about Thirty Years Ago and by whom he hath one Child living now provided for Says He Rented and lived in a House near Chelsea Bridge in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster & County of Middlesex for four years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Twenty four Pounds and paid parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Sixteen Years ago since. which time He never Rented House paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement.

Elizabeth Steel Aged about Twenty One Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant one Mr. Giffard a Broker in Holbourn in the parish of St. George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex for Two Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds Ten Shillings hath quitted the same about Six Months ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement.

Elizth. Faron Aged about 37 Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of John Faron who has been Dead upwards of Twelve Months ago And by whom she hath one Child living named Charles aged about thirteen Months Says her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in Theobalds Row in the Psh of St. Andrew Holbourn above the Barrs in the County of Middx for sevl. Years at the Yearly Rent of £10 and paid Parish Taxes due for the same and quitted the same upwards of 18 Yrs. ago since which time he never Rented House or Tenemt. of £10 a Year paid Taxes or orwise. gained any other Subseqt. Settlemt. neither hath this Examinant since her sd. Husbands Death.

Eleanor Larken living at Mr. Jarvis's in Hemlock Court aged about 28 Years on behalf of Alexr. Talland Aged about Seven Years and William Talland aged about four Years Infants and Children of Alexr. Talland by Alice Lords who has been dead about Six Months on her Oath says that the said Alexr. Talland and Alice Lord never was Married as she has been Informed and verily believes Says that the said Alexander Talland the Father who is now pressed and gone to Sea was a Native of Scotland and never gained a Settlemt. in England other than his Renting and living in a House in Leicester Street in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the Co. of Middx at the Yrly Rent of £9 In which House the sd. Alexr. Talland was born & the said Wm. Talland in Croson Court purple Lane in the said Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn but Whr. the said Alexr. Talland the Father ever paid any Taxes due for the same she cannot set forth And that the said Alexr. Talland & Wm . the Children never gained any Settlemt. other than being born in the aforesd. Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn .

John Holt Aged about 52 Years on his Oath Says he Intermarr with Jane his late Wife at the Fleet London about 24 Years ago and who died about Ten Days since and by whom he hath 2 Childn. namely William Aged 15 Year's & Thompson Says he never Rented house paid Taxes served any Apprenticeship or lived a hired Yearly Servt. before Marriage for one Year Says his Father John Holt Rented and lived in a House in Gunpowder Alley New Street Shoe Lane in the parish of St. Brides otherwise Bridget in the City of London for sevl. Years at the yery Rent of £10 as he has been Informed & verily believes hath quitted same upwards of 40 Years ago and after Quitting the same he never Rented House Paid Taxes or otherwise gained any or. subseqt. Settlemt. neither hath this Examinant since his sd. Fathers Death.

Richard Hargrave aged about 48 Years on his Oath says he never Rented House or Paid Taxes Says he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Thomas Carter Horse Dealer who lived at the Red Lyon Hyde Park Corner in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middlesex for two Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Ten Pounds four shillings hath quitted his said Service upwards of Thirty Years ago since which time he hath gained no other subsequent Settlement

Wm- Shadewell Aged about thirty four Years on his Oath says he Intermarried with Mary his Wife at St- Anns Black Fryers about Ten Years ago and by whom he hath no Childn- now living says before his Intermarrd- with his said Wife and whilst he was a Singleman he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one John Harrison who kept the Sign of the Swan in Water Street Black Fryers in the said Parish of St- Anns Black Fryers in the City of London upwards of eight Years at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds hath quitted the same about eight Years ago Since which time he hath gained no other subsequent Settlement.

Elizth- Arnold Widow Aged about thirty two Years on her Oath says she Intermarrd. with her late husband at the Parish Church of St- Georges Hanover Sq - in the Co- of Middlesex about 12 Years ago and by whom she hath no Childn- now living says before her Intermarr. with her said late husband & whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr- Witt who kept the Black Horse in Oxford Road in the sd. Parish of St- Georges Hanover Sq- in the Co- of Middlesex at the Yearly Wages of twenty Pounds as she has been informed & verily believes hath quitted the sd. place upwards of 4 Years ago and after quitting the same he never gained any other subsequent Settlemt- neither hath this Examinant since her sd. husbands Death

Leonard Jones Aged about 46 Years on behalf of his Wife Ann Jones who is now Insane on his Oath says he Intermarrd- with his said Wife at Shoreditch Church about 5 Years ago and by whom he hath no Children now living Says he is a Native of Ireland and never gained a Settlement in England either by renting house paying Taxes or living as a hired Yearly Servant before Marriage for one Years says that before his said Intermarrd- with his said Wife she lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr- Rallans a Cabinet Maker in Goodwins Court St- Martins Lane in the Parish of St- Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr - upwards of one Year at the Yearly Wages of £4 10s hath quitted the said Mr- Rallans Service about 15 Years ago since which time this Examinant or his sd. Wife never gained any other subseqt- Settlemt-

Mary Sutton aged about 38 Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented house paid Taxes or lived a hired Yrly Servant for one Year says she was bound out an Apprentice by the Trustees of the Charity School of St- Clemt- Danes to Mr Carpenter a Glazier and Painter in Ball Yard in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middx and served the said Mr. Carpenter under that Indenture for the Space of 12 Months or thereabouts when her said Master was Arrested for Debt and left this Examinant to provide for herself Says she never was assigned over to any other person or ever gained any other subseqt- Settlemt- than as aforesaid

Elizth. Faron Aged about 37 Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of John Faron who has been dead upwards of Three Years and by whom she hath no Child or Children living Says she hath one Child living by one John Wilkins decead Names Charles Aged about fourteen Months Says her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in Theobalds Row in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for sevl. Years at the Yearly Rent of Eighteen Pounds and paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House upwards of Eighteen Years ago since which time he never Rented House or Tenement of Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or otherwise gained any or Subsequent Settlement neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death.

Catharine Slade aged about sixty six Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented house or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Joseph Salvedore in White Hart Court Bishopgate Street in the Parish of Saint Botolph Bishopgate without London for two Years and six Months at the Yearly Wages of Ten Pounds Ten Shillings hath quitted the same upwards of fifteen Years ago since which time she hath done no other Act whereby to gain a subsequent Settlement

William Nurse one of the Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of St- Clement Danes maketh Oath that on Searching the Register of Marriages in the Parish Church of Saint Faith's London about three Weeks ago found therein that the then Elizth. Cope was married to John Cornwall her husband in the Year 1775 and by whom she hath one Child now living named John aged about four Years as he has been Informed and verily believes That her said Husband Rents and lives in a House in the Parish of St. Romwald als Runwald in the Borough of Colchester in the County of Essex upwards of four Months at the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and upwards and has gained no other subsequent Settlement since as he verily believes.

Sarah Slider aged about 40 Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented house or paid Taxes says she lived A hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Bibby a Staymaker in Hedge Lane in the Psh of St Martin in the Fields for one Year and three Quarters at the Yearly Wages of £4 hath quitted the said Mrs. Bibbys Service upwards of four Years ago since which time she hath gained no other subseqt. Settlemt.

Abigal Robinson Aged about fifty Nine Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one John Haisel otherwise Hassell Esqr . at a Laceman on Ludgate Hill in the Parish of St. Bride otherwise Bridget in the City of London for one Year and Seven Months at the Yearly Wages of Seven pounds hath quitted her said Service ever since the Year 1740 since which time he never gained any other subsequent Sentlement either by Marriage Renting House or Tenement of Ten pounds a Year or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Sullivan aged about 61 Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of Michael Sullivan who has been Dead upwards of two Years and by whom she hath no Children now living except one who is married and provided for and further says that her said husband Rented and lived in a House at Nutkins's Corner in the Parish of St. Mary Magdalen Bermondsey in the County of Surry for several Years at the Yearly Rent of Ten pounds or thereabouts and paid all parish Taxes due for the same and quitted said house upwards of twenty Years before his Death and after quitting the said house he never gained any other subsequent Settlement either by Renting house paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever neither hath this Examinant since her said husbands Death

Mary Boswell aged about Thirty Nine Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly servant with one Mr. Mort in Cold Bath Square in the Parish of Saint James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex upwards of four Years at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Two Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired yearly Servant for one Year

John Lees aged about seventy two Years on her Oath says he Intermarried to Catherine his now wife at Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex about forty five Years ago and by whom he has one Child now provided for Says he Rented and lived in a House in Pump Court White Hart Yard in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the said County of Middx at the Yearly Rent of £9-10s-0d and paid Land Tax due for the same hath quitted the said House about eighteen Years ago since which time he hath never Rented house or Tenement of £10 a Year paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a subsequent Settlement

Ann Lloyd Aged about Nineteen Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says Her father Rees Lloyd Rented and lived in a House in Shire Lane in the Liberty of Rolls in the County of Middlesex for Two Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of fourteen pounds and upwards and paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Seventeen Years ago since which time her said Father never Rented House paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain any other Subsequent Settlement to her knowledge or belief.

Jonathan Mitchell aged about forty Years on his Oath says he never was married rented house or paid Taxes Says he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Humbleby a Dealer in Coals in the Old Bailey in the Parish of St. Sepulcher London for two Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted his said Place upwards of Ten Years ago since which time he hath never Rented house or Tenement of £10 a Year nor done any other Act whereby to gain a subseqt. Settlement

Thos. Clean one of the Overseers of the Psh of St- Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr - in the Co- of Middx on behalf of Henry Gallard an Infant aged about one Year and five Months Son of Henry Gallard (gone to America ) by Jane Gallard his Wife now deced on his Oath says that on searching the Examination Book & Pass Warrts- find that the above named Jane Gallard with her two Children were passed from the sd- Parish of St- Clement Danes to the Parish of luckfield in the Co- of Sussex by Order dated 4th- day of April 1776 under the hands & Seals of R. Butler & Wm- Kitchiner Esqs Two of his Majesty's Justices of the Peace for the said County of Middx & City & Liberty of Westmr - & further says that the said Jane Gallard is since Dead that the above named Edward Gallard the Infant is the Son of the Jane Gallard by the said Henry Gallard & is the same Child that was passed with the sd- Jane the Mother by the above mentioned Order as he has been credibly Informed & verily believes

Elizth- Grimett aged about 26 Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Wm- Grimett (gone to America and with whom she Intermarrd- at the parish Church of St- Andrew Holborn the 1st- of April 1776 and by whom she hath one Child now living named William Francis aged about three Months Says her said husband was bound an Apprentice to Wm- Clowder Sadler & Pocket book Maker in Baldwins Garden Holborn and served the said Mr- Clowder under such Indre for the space of four Years or thrabouts when the said Mr- Clowder gave up his sd- Indres and that her said husband never was assigned over to any other Master nor did he ever gain any other subseqt- Settlemt- either by Renting house paying Taxes or living a hired Yrly Servant before Marriage to her Knowl or Belief

Elizth- Stevens aged about thirty seven years on her Oath says she never was married Rented house or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr- Cornish a Distiller in the Haymarket in the Parish of St- Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr - and County afsd- for one Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of six pounds six shillings a Year hath quitted her said Service about twelve Years ago since which time she hath gained no other subseqt- Settlemt- either by Renting house paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizth- Webb aged about 26 Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented house paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year Says her Father Willm- Webb Rented and lived in a House in Milford Lane in the parish of St- Clemt- Danes in the County of Middx for sevl- Years at the Yearly Rent of £10 and quitted same in the Year 1771 since which time he hath gained no other subseqt- Settlemt- neither hath this Examinant since her said Father quitted the same and further says that she hath three Children now living all of whom were begotten by one Jno- Davis a Bargeman Vizt- John aged upwards of seven Years born a Bastard in the Parish of Saint Lukes Chelsea in sd- County of Middx Willm- aged five Years and four Months Rebecca aged two Years and eleven Months both born Bastards in the parish of Richmond in the County of Surry that none of her said Children hath gained any other Settlement than by Birth

John Greenwood one of the Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middx on behalf of William and Rebecca Davis Infants by John Davis the Father on his Oath says that on searching the Exaimcon & pass Warrant Books find by an Order under the hands and Seals of Jass Clitherow and Jno- Drinkwater Esqr two of his Matys Justices of the Peace for the Co- of Middx bearing date the 9th- Day of November 1776 whereby Elizth- Webb singlewoman was passed with her then four Children vizt- John aged six Years & upwds- born a Bastard in the Parish of Chelsea in the sd. Co- of Middx William aged four Years and eight Months Rebecca aged two Years and a quarters both born Bastards in the Parish of Richmond in the County of Surry and Philip aged about six Months since deced born a Bastard in the parish of Isleworth And this Deponent further says that the said Elizabeth Webb and the Father of the said Bastard Children have both deserted them as this. Deponent has been credibly informed and verily believes

John Bennett aged about 32 Years on his Oath says he Intermarrd- with Frances his now Wife at the Parish Church of Wapping in the County of Middlesex upwards of 7 Years ago and by whom he hath no Children now living Says before his Intermarriage with his said Wife and whilst he was a Singleman he served seven Years Apprenticeship with Mr- Grace a Peruke Maker in Russell Court in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr - & after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any other subseqt- Settlement

Cath: Harsey aged about 51 Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of Thos- Harsey who has been Dead about 8 Years and by whom she hath no Children now living Says her said late husband Rented & lived in a house in Green Street Grosvenor Square in the Psh of St- George's Hanover Square in the County of Middx upwds- of ten Years at the Yearly Rent of £15 and paid all parish Taxes due for the same & lived therein to the time of his Death and after this Examinant quitted the same she never gained any other subseqt- Settlemt- either by Renting house paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Rebecca Aggas aged about 40 Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Noah Aggas who (is now in America ) and with whom she Intermarrd- at Shoreditch Church about 20 Years ago and by whom she hath Two Children now living namely William aged about Nineteen Years now provided for and Rebecca aged about seven Years Says her sd- husband Rented & lived in a house in John Street Totenham Court Road in the Parish of St- Pancras in the County of Middx for three Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of fourteen Guineas but never paid any Rent or Taxes for the same hath quitted same about 20 Years ago since which time her said husband never gained any or. subsequent Settlement.

Ann Langridge aged about forty two Years on her Oath says she Intermarried with Edward Langridge her husband (gone from her) at the Parish Church of St- Dunstan in the West London the 15th- day of May in the Year 1768 and by whom she hath two Children now living Namely Sarah aged about eight Years and Elizabeth aged about two Years Says her said husband Rented and lived in a House known by the Sign of the Ship in Lombard Street in the Precinct of White Fryers London of the Yearly Rent of £23 and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the sd- House about five Years ago since which time he hath gained no other subseqt- Settlement either by Renting house or Tenemt- of £10 a Year or orwise howsoever

Margt- Austin aged about fifty eight Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Thomas Austin with whom she Intermarrd- at the City of Dublin about 34 Years ago and by whom she hath one Child living now provided for says her said husband Rented and lived in a house on Windmill Hill in the parish of Saint Lukes Old Street in the Co- of Middx for upwards of 10 Years at the Yearly Rent of Six pounds and was rated to and paid Land Tax due for the same hath quitted the said house about nine Years ago since which time her said husband never Rented house paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a subseqt- Settlemt-

Dorothy Gould aged about 50 Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of John Gould with whom she Intermarrd- at May Fair Chappell upwds- of 30 Yrs- ago who has been Dead upwds- of 20 Years ago Says her said husband served his Apprent- with one Mr- Taylor a Peruke Maker in Craven Stt - Strand in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr . in the County of Middlesex and after he was out of his Apprent- he never gained any other subseqt- Settlemt- either by Renting house or orwise. howsoever neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death

Mary Pearcy aged about 26 Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented house or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr- Waterhouse who kept a Hard Ware Shop in Middle Row Holborn above the Bars in the Co- of Middx for Eighteen Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of £4 hath quitted her said Service upwds- of 10 Years ago since which time she has gained no or- subseqt- Settlemt- either by Renting house paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Wm- Masters aged about 40 Years on his Oath says he Intermarrd- to his late Wife Sarah Masters at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holborn about fifteen Years ago and by whom he hath Two Children now living namely William aged about fourteen yrs. and Sarah aged about twelve now both of whom now Provided for Says he served his Apprenticeship with one George Halla Button Maker in Three Fox Court Long Lane Smith field in the Parish of St- Sepulchre without in the Co- of Middx and after he was out of his Apprenticesp he never Rented house paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a subseqt- Settlemt-

Harriot Elly aged 40 Yrs. on her Oath says she is the Wife of Wm- Elly (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at St- Martins in the Fields upwards of seven Years ago and by whom she hath Two Children living named Job aged two years & Nine Months and Charlotte aged 5 Months Says her said husband Rented and lived in a House known by the Sign of the Crown in Feathers Court Westons Park in the Parish of Saint Giles's in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr - and County of Middx for Eleven Months or thereabouts at the Year Rent of Eighteen Pounds and paid all Parish. Taxes due for the same hath quitted the same about Two Years ago since which time her said husband never Rented house paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a subseqt- Settlemt-

Cathr- Lloyd aged about 70 Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of William Lloyd who died about three Years ago with whom he Intermarried at the Duke Street Chappell about twenty eight Years ago and by whom she hath no Children now living says her said late husband Rented and lived in a house in Jacksons Alley Russell Street in the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westmr - for thirteen Years at the Yearly Rent of £9 for two Years and at £8 a Year for sevl. Years afterwards and paid Land Tax and other Parochial Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said house about twenty Years ago since which time she hath never gained any other subseqt- Settlement either by Renting house paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Jane Honnor aged about 26 Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Thomas Honnor who hath Deserted her with whom she Intermarried at the Parish of Saint Mary le Bone about Eleven Years ago and by whom she hath two Children now living namely Sarah aged about Ten Years and Jane aged about Six Says her said late husband Rented and lived in a House in Leather Lane the in the Parish of St- Andrew Holborn in the County of Middx for Eighteen Months at the Yearly Rent of fifteen pounds and paid all parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said house upwards of four Year ago since which time her said husband never gained any subseqt- Settlemt- either by Renting house or paying Taxes

John Prigg aged about 63 Years on his Oath says he Intermarried to his now Wife Ann at Saint Paul Covent Garden about Eleven Years ago and by whom he hath no Children now living Says that before his said Intermarriage with he Rented and lived in a House in Adam & Eve Court near Oxfords Markett in the Parish of Saint Mary le Bone in the County of Middlesex for Eighteen Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of fourteen pounds a Year and paid all parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the same upwards of fourteen Years ago since which time he hath gained no other subsequent Settlemt either by Renting house or Payg- Taxes

Richd- Hopkins aged about 22 Years on his Oath says he never was Married Rented house paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says his Father Saml- Hopkins lived as a hired Yearly Servant before Marriage with Lord George Bentick in Green Street in the parish of St. Anns Soho is the Liberty of Westmr . in the Capacity of a Coachman for two Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Twelve pounds and upwards has quitted his said last mentioned Service upwards of twenty three Years ago Since which time his said Father hath never gained any other subsequent Settlemt- either by Renting house or paying Taxes

Elizth- Hillier Aged about 50 Years on her Oath says she never was Married Says she Rented and lived in a House Rented house or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr- Nark a Coachmaker the Corner of Swan Yard in Bishopsgate Street in the Parish of saint Botolph without Bishopgate London for two Years at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds a Year hath quitted her said Service upwards of five Years ago since which time she has gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting house paying Taxes or living a hired yearly Servant for one Year

Richard Knowlands Aged about 40 Years on his Oath says he never was Married Rented house or paid Taxes Says he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr- Robert Webster a Brewer in Mercer Street Long Acre in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr - and County of Middx for eight Years at the Yearly Wages of Nine Pounds nine Shillings hath quitted that Service upwards of Sixteen Years ago since which time he hath gained no other subseqt- Settlement either by Renting house paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Ainell aged about 18 Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented house or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs- Davenall in Church Street in the Parish of Saint Annes Soho in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of fifteen Months at the Yearly Wages of three Pounds ten Shillgs hath quitted that Service upwards of two Years ago since which time she has gained no other subsequent Settlement either by Renting house paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one one Year

Elizth- Anderson aged about twenty one Years on her Oath Says she never was Married Rented house paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says she was bound an Apprentice by the Churchwdns- and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of S aint Saviours Southwark in the County of Surry to one Edward Noulton who kept a Cook Shop in Butcher Row in the parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middx untill this Examinant shod- Attain her said Age of Twenty one Years or Day of March And further saith that her said Master removing out of the parish of Saint Clement Danes this Examinant went and lived with him near Chad Wells in the Parish of Saint Pancras in the County of Middx for two Months or upwards but her said Master using this Examinant ill she left him since which time she hath gained no or- subsequent Settlemt- either by Renting house paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Richard Lowe aged about forty eight Years on his Oath says he Intermarried to his now Wife Hannah at the Parish Church of St- Brides about nine Years (ago and by whom she hath two Children now provided for vizt- Elizabeth aged about nine Years and Sarah aged about two Years Says he served his Apprenticeship with one Francis Mc.Canna Brushmaker the Corner of White Heart Yard in the parish of Saint Giles's in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr -County of a Middx and after he was out of his Apprenticeship he never Rented house paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a subsequent Settlemt-

Elizth- Dighton aged about 56 Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of David Dighton who has been Dead upwds- of eight Years ago and by whom she hath no Children now living Says she Intermarrd- with her said late husband at the parish Church of St- Andrew Holborn about thirty Years ago Says her said husband before his Intermarrd. and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with James Hemmings at the George Inn in Little Drury Lane in the parish of Saint Mary le Strand in the Liberty of Westmrs - for eight Years at the Yearly Wages of five pounds a Years hath quitted his said Service about thirty Years ago since which time he never gained any other subsequent Settlement either by Renting house or paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever neither hath this Examinant since her said husbands Death

Ann Ross aged about sixty years on her Oath says she is the Widow of John Ross who has been Dead upwards of twenty five years ago by whom she hath no Children now living And further says that being witht- Child or Children she lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr- Wilson a Carpenter in Swan Yard in the Parish of Saint Mary le Strand for two Years at the Yearly Wages of four pounds hath quitted that said Service twenty Years ago since which time this Examinant hath never gained any other subseqt Settlemt either by Renting house or orwise. howsoever

Mary Gosling aged about 23 years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented house or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Groom at t he Red Lyon & Still in Drury Lane in the parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the Co. of Middx upwards of three Years at the Yearly Wages of £4 hath quitted her said Service about five Years ago since which time she has gained no or. subsequent Settlemt. either by Renting house paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizth- Payne aged about thirty seven Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Wm- Payne (gone from her) with whom she Intermarrd- at St Ann Black Fryers London about 17 Years ago and by whom she hath three Children now living namely Ann aged about five Years Elizth - aged about three Years and Thomas aged about Eighteen Months Says her said husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a Covenanted Servant with one Mr- Dane a Taylor in Bell Court St- Martins le Grand in the Psh of St- Ann Aldersgate London upwards of three Years and after quitting his said Masters Service he never Rented house pd. Taxes or did any other Act whereby to gain a subsequent Settlement

Margt- Pace aged about twenty three Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented house or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr- Callam a Gold & Silver Lace Maker in Buckingham Street York Buildings in the Psh of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr - for Eighteen Months at the Yearly Wages of £5 hath quitted that her said Service about six Years ago since which time she has gained no other subseqt- Settlemt- either by Renting house paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Job Thomas aged about 56 Years on his Oath says he Intermarried to with Elizth - his now Wife at the Parish Church of St- James Westmr - about 20 Years ago by whom he has three Children now living all of whom is now provided for Says this Examinant Rented and lived in a house known by the Sign of the Two Brewers in Longditch in the Psh of St- Margt- Westmr - for twelve months or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of £40 and paid all parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted that said house about seven Years ago since which time he never Rented house paid Taxes or orwise. gained any other subseqt- Settlemt.

Eleanor Coleman aged about sixty Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of Cornelius Coleman who has died about two Years ago with whome she Intermarried in the County of Corke in the Kingdom of Ireland about forty Years ago and by whom she has two Children now living as she believes both of which are now provided for Says her said husband Rented and lived in a house in Wych Street in the parish of St- Mary le Strand in the Liberty of Westmr . for twelve months or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of £31 hath quitted the said house about four Years ago since which time she never gained any other subseqt- Settlement either by renting house paying Taxes or orwise howsoever neither hath this Examinant since her said husbands Death

Sarah Edwards aged about twenty eight Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented house or paid Taxes Says she was bound out an Apprentice by the Churchwdns- and Overseers of the Psh of St- Sepulchre London to one Mrs- West a Furrier in Half Moon Alley Bakers Court in the parish of Saint Botolph Bishopgate without London and served her said Mistress about four Years and then this Examinant run away since which time this Examinant hath gained no other subseqt- Settlemt- either by Renting house paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizth- Webb aged about 27 Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented house paid Taxes a lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father Willm- Webb Rented and lived in a house in Milford Lane in the Parish of St- Clement Danes in the Co- of Middx for sevl- Years at the Yearly Rent of £10 and quitted same in the Year 1771 since which time he hath gained no other subseqt- Settlemt- neither hath this Examinant since her sd- Father quitted the same And further says that she hath one Child named John begotten by one John Davis a Bargeman born a Bastard in the said Parish of St- Lukes Chelsea in said County of Middx and that her said Child named John hath gained no other Settlement than by Birth

Joseph Kirkman Aged about Twenty Eight Years on his Oath says he intermarried with Elizabeth his now Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Luke in the County of Middlesex about five Years and by whom he hath no Children now living Says he was bound an Apprentice by Indenture to one Mr. John Brown a Watch Glassmaker in Little Deans Court St. Martins le Grand in the Parish of Saint Anns within Aldersgate London and Served his said Master upwards of four Years the last half year of which time he Served his said Westmr. Parish of Saint Ann's and after leaving his said Master he never Rented House of Ten pounds P Ann paid Taxes or did any other Act whereby to gain a subsequent Settlement.

Mary Row aged about 27 Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House paid Taxes or ever lived a hired yearly Servant for one Year Says her father John Row rented and lived in a House in Three Tun ally White Chapell in the parish of Saint Mary White Chapll in the County of Middlesex where father sd. Deponent was born for several Years at the Yearly Rent of Nine Pounds or thereabouts and paid Land tax due for the same as her Grandmother as often informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true and lived therein to the time of his Death which is upwards of Twenty Years ago since which time she hath gained no other subsequent settlement than aforesaid

Margaret Dennis aged about forty Eight Years on behalf of her Husband Ambrose Dennis who now lies ill of the Gout on her Oath Says she Intermarried to the said Ambrose Dennis at the Parish Church of Saint Georges Hanover Square in the Year 1772 and by whom she hath no Child living; Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Cursitors Street Chancery Lane in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn London for several Years at the Yearly Rent of fifteen pounds and paid parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Eight Years ago since which time he hath gained no other subsequent Settlement either by renting House or Tenement of Ten pounds a Year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever.

Frances King Aged about fifty Seven Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of John King who died about Thirteen Years ago and with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St. Andrew Holbourn about Twenty Seven Years ago and by whom she hath no Child now living Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House the Corner of Hatton Wall in the Liberty of Saffron Hill Hatton Garden in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn in the County of Middlesex for sevl. Years at the Yearly Rent of Nine Pounds and paid Land tax due for the same hath quitted said House upwards of Twenty Years ago since which time her said Husband never gained any or. Subsequent Settlement neither hath this Examinant since her said Husband Death

Henry Hubbard Aged about forty Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with his late Wife Sarah at the Parish Church of St. Bartholomew about Ten Years ago and by whom he hath Three Children Two of whom are now in the Workhouse belonging to St. Giles Cripple gate London & the or is now provided for Says this Examinant Rented and lived in a House in Pauls Alley in the Parish of St. Giles Cripplegate London of the Yearly Rent of fifteen pounds lived therein for about half a Year hath quitted same about Ten Years ago since which time he hath gained no other subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying taxes or otherwise howsoever.

Elizabeth Spencer Aged about Twenty Three Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Years Says she was bound and Apprentice by the Churchwd. and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of St. Clement Danes to one John Stacey a Shagereen Case Maker at Epping Forrest in the Parish of Wanstead in the County of Essex untill this Examinant shod. Attain her Age of Twenty One Years or Day of Marriage as by the Indnes relation being there may appear Says that her said Master afterwards went and Rented a House at Statford in the said County of Essex when her said Master soon afterwards run away and what is become of him she Cannot Say; Says that soon after her said Master run away her Mistress Rented and lived in a House in Bethlem Green in the Parish of St. Mathew Bethlem Green for upwards of One Year at the Yearly Rent of Ten pounds and upwards and where this Examinant Continued to live till her Indenture were Expired and this Examinant further saith that she does not Knows what is become of either her Master or Mistress but this Examinant Positively Saith that she lived with her said Mistress upwards of Eight Months before she left her Mistress and that she hath gained no other subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Skinner Aged about Twenty Two Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Kirk a Nursery Woman in the Parish of Kensington in the County of Middlesex upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her sd Service upwards of Three Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement And further on her Oath Says that on the 14th. day of August last past she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in the House of Robt. Cairns in Bear Yard in the Parish of St. Clement Danes which hath since been baptized William and is likely to become Chargable to the said Parish And further says that one Benjamin Carne a Bricklayer did beget such Bastard Child on her Body Says that the said Benjamin Carn served his Apprenticeship in Wales and never gained a Settlement in England to her Knowledge or belief.

Eleanor Leach aged about Twenty four Years on her Oath Says she Intermarred with Thomas Leach her Husband (gone from her) at the Parish Church of Saint Mary Le Strand upwards of Eighteen Months ago and by whom she hath one Child now living namely William aged upwards of Eleven Months Says her said Husband is an Irishman and never gained a Settlement in England either by Renting house Paying Taxes or Otherwise howsoever Says her Father Rents and lives in a house in King Street in the Parish of St. George Bloomsbury in the said County of Middlesex and as so done for Twenty Years and upwards & Paid all Parish Taxes due for the same and where this Examinant was born and this Examinant further says she never gained any Other subsequent Settlement either by Renting House Paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year before Marriage

William Payne Aged about forty Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried to Elizabeth his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Anns Black Fryars about Sixteen Years ago and by whom he hath one Child living namely William aged upwards of fourteen Years who now lives with this Examinant And this Examinant further Says that his said Wife left this Examinant about Eight years ago and went and Cohabited with one Thomas Child a Staymaker and by whom she hath three Children namely Ann Aged upwards of five Years Elizabeth Aged about Three Years and Thomas Aged about Two years as this Examinant is Informed and verily believes to be true And this Examinant further Says that before his Intermarriage with his said Wife he lived as a Covenanted Servant with one Robert Dacore a Taylor for three years or thereabouts the last year of which said Services was in the Parish of St. Anns Aldersgate London And further Says that it was Agreed between this Examinant and his said Master that this Examinant was to have Meat Drink Washing Lodging & Pockett Money and which this Examinant had accordingly and after he left his said Masters Service he never Rented House said Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Nicholls aged about Twenty Eight years on her Oath Says that she has gone by the Name of Mary Ashby for several years past on Account of her Cohabiting with a Man Whose Name was Robert Ashby but that she never was married to him and that he has been dead for upwards of Ten years Says that after his Death she Rented and lived in a House under the Piazza Covent Garden upwards of Six Months at the Yearly Rent of forty five Guineas P Annum that she lived therein upwards of Six Months and paid half a years Rent for the same but never paid any poors Rate or other Taxes to her knowledge or beliefe hath quitted the said Houses about five years ago since which time she hath gained no other subseqt. settlemt. either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired yearly Servant for one year

Elizabeth Davis aged about Twenty Two years on her Oath says she is the Wife of William Davis now a Soldier in the Tenth Regiment of Foot now lying at Chatham Barricks in the County of Kent with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint James in the City of Bath about three years ago and by whom she hath one Child named Jane aged about Ten weeks and this Examinant further says that her said Husband hath other Children living by a Former wife namely William aged about thirteen years and Thomas aged about five Years says that it appears from an Examination taken in Writing the 26th. Day of June Instant that her said Husband Rented and lived in a House at Bathford in the County of Somerset for Nine Months at the Yearly Rent of £16 a year and paid Taxes due for the same and that her said Husband hath gained no other subsequent Settlement since Quiting the same which Examination this Examinant Verily believes to be true.

Mary Plunkett aged about forty Two Years and Oath Says she is the Wife of Arthur John Plunkett with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Stepney in the County of Middlesex about Nineteen years ago and by whom she hath no Children now living Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Fetter Lane in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbour London for Six Months or thereabouts at the yearly Rent of Thirty Pounds and upwards hath quitted the said House about Twelve years ago since which time he never Rented House or Tenement of Ten pounds a year paid taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement.

Elizth. Kelly Aged about Seventeen Years on her Oath Says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says she was bound an Apprentice to and served three Years of her Apprenticeship to one Mrs. Willington a Mantuamaker in Litchfield Street in the Parish of Saint Ann in the Liberty of Westmr . has left her said Mistress about Three Months ago since which time she hath gained no other subsequent Settlement.

Sarah Richards aged about Twenty Six years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Richard Richards (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at Shoreditch Church about Seven years ago and by whom she hath Three Children now living namely Sarah Frances Aged about five years Richard Aged about Two years and Hester Aged about Twelve Weeks Says her said Husband served upwards of five years the first part of his Apprenticeship to one Henry Slawson a Shoe- maker in Tothill Street in the Parish of Saint Margaret Westminster and after her said Husband had served the said Henry Slawson for the space of five years his Mother gave to his said Master Two Guineas for the remainder of his time which his said Master accepted of & delivered up his Indres accordingly as this Examinant has been Informed by his said Mother and which Information she verily believes to be true and after quitting his said Masters Service he never gained any or Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired yearly Servant for one year before Marriage.

Thos. Pierce Aged about Sixty Seven Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried to Mary his Wife at May Fair Chapel in the Year 1750 and by whom he hath one Child living which is now provided for says that before his Intermarriage to his said Wife and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with His Grace the Duke of Montague in the Parish of Greenwich in the County of Kent for one year at the Yearly Wages of Twenty one pounds P Annum hath quitted his said Service in the year 1750 and after quitting the same he never Rented House or Tenement of Ten pounds a year paid Taxes or did any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Plunkett aged about forty Two Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Arthur John Plunkett with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Stepney in the County of Middlesex about Nineteen years ago and by whom she hath no Children now living Says her said Husband has rented Several House since his Intermarr- iage with this Examinant but the last House that her said Husband Rented was at No. 13 in King Street Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex of the Yearly Rent of Eighteen pounds payable Quarterly lived therein for five Months or upwards hath quitted the said House about four Months ago since which time her said Husband Never, Rented House or Tenement of Ten pounds a year paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain Subseqt. Settlement

Elizabeth Kelly Singlewoman Aged about Seventeen years on her Oath Says she never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year Says that this Examinant and her late Brother were in the Workhouse belongg. to the Parish of St. Brides London for several years and to which Parish her Grandfather as also her late Father and Mother belongd as She has often been Informed and which Information she verily believes to be true And this Examinant further saith that about Three years and half ago her Father in Law Mr. Hodgson out of Compassion to this Examinant took her out of the aforesaid Workhouse belonging to the said Parish of Saint Brides and bound this Examinant an Apprentice to one Mrs. Willington a Mantua Maker in Litchfield Street in the Parish of Saint Anns in the Liberty of Westminster for Six Years, The first Three years to work below Stairs and the last Three years above Stairs the first Three years of which said time this Examinant served accordingly That this Examinant soon after the first three years of her Apprenticeship left her said Mistress and afterwards falling a Casualty in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes was passed on the aforesaid Parish of Saint Anns Soho , Saint Anns soon afterwards appealed to the Quarter Sessions And the Court were of Opinion that as the Indenture was for Six years only this Examinant Cod. gained no Settlement thereby And further says she can give no further or other Account of her Settlement than as abovementioned

Ann Holton Aged about Twenty Eight years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived as a hired Yearly or Covenanted Servant with one Mr. Oliver a French Trinning maker in New Bond Street in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex for Two years or thereabouts at the yearly Wages of Twenty Pounds besides Diet & Lodging hath quitted her said Service about four years ago since which time she never gained any or Subsequent either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired yearly Servant for one year

Elizth. Ellames Aged about Twenty five years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Robert Ellames (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St. Brides London about four years ago and by whom she hath one Child named Mary Aged about Sixteen Months Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Little Mays pond in the Parish of Saint Olave Southwark in the County of Surry for three Months at the Yearly Rent of Eighteen Guineas hath quitted the said House upwards of One Year and half ago since which time her said Husband never Rented House or Tenement of Ten pounds a year paid Taxes or gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Mary Worrellow Aged about Twenty Three years on her Oath Says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired yearly Servant with one John Crocketta Taylor in the Parish of Hampstead in the County of Middlesex upwards of One year at the yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said upwards of Nine Months ago and hath not since she quitted the same done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement.
