Elias Williams Aged about forty years on his Oath Says he Intermarried to his Wife Eleanor at the Parish Church of St. George Hanover Square about Eighteen years ago and by whom he hath one Child now living namely Catherine Aged about Hired years Say he is now a patient in Guys Hospital and not able to support himself or his said Child And further says that before his Intermarriage with his said Wife and whilst he was a Single Man he lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Churchill in Dover Street in the sd. Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex for Sixteen Months at the yearly Wages of Twenty Three pounds besides Meat drink Lodging and Cloaths hath quitted his said Service Eighteen years ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement whatever.

Elizth. Goolbey Aged about Thirty Three years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Thos. Goolbey (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the City of Dublin about Sixteen ago and by whom she hath Three Children which her Uncle now keeps Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in White Lyon Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex about Two years at the yearly Rent of Twenty Six pounds and paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House upwards of One year ago since which time her said Husband never Rented House or Tenemt. of Ten pounds a year paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other subsequent Settlement to her knowledge or belief

Elizth. Page aged about Thirty five years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Robt. Page (who is now in the Militia at Cox heath ) and with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St Anns Westminster about five years ago and by whom she hath no Child now living says her said Husband was bound an Apprentice for Seven years and served most part of his Apprenticeship with one Thos. Spencer a Shoe Maker in Hungerford Markett in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster and after quitting his said Masters Service he never Rented house or Tenement of £10 a year paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement.

Hannah Dearham Aged about Twenty Seven Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Thos. Dearham who is pressed and gone to sea with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Allhallow Staining in the City of London about Six years ago and by whom she hath one Child now living Namely Rebecca Aged about Sixteen Months Says that her said Husband Rented and lived in a house in the Butcher Row East Smithfield in the Parish Saint Botolph without Aldgate in the County of Middlesex for Six Months or thereabouts at the yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds besides Taxes hath quitted the said House about five years ago since which time her said Husband never Rented House paid Taxes or did any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement.

Francis Salmon Aged about fifty Three years on his Oath Says he Intermarried to his late Wife Hannah at the Parish Church of St. George Hanover Square about Twenty four years ago and by whom he hath one Boy living now provided for Says before his Intermarrd. to his said late Wife and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired yearly Servant with and Mrs. Raines at Charlton in the Parish of Charlton in the County of Kent for One year and Ten Months at the yearly Wages of Six pounds a year besides Meat Drink Lodging and Cloaths hath quitted his said Services upwards of Twenty four years ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement with by Renting House or Tenement of Ten pounds a year payg. Taxes or otherwise howsoever.

Francis Salmon Aged about fifty three years on his Oath says he Intermarried to his wife Hannah at the Parish of St. George Hanover Square about Seventy four years ago and by whom he hath one Child living now provided for Says before his Intermarrd. to his said wife and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mrs. Ranies at Charlton in the Parish of Charlton in the County of Kent for one year and Ten Months at the yearly Wages of Six Pounds besides Meat Drink Lodging and Cloaths hath quitted his said service upwards of Twenty four years ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement Other than Renting a Tenement of four Pounds a year in the Parish of Woolwich in the County of Kent rented the same about Nine years and paid Land Tax due for the same hath quitted the said House about Eighteen years ago since which Since he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise Howsoever

Oliver Blanchfield Aged about Sixty Seven years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Hester his late wife at the Parish of St. Margarets Westmr . in the year 1740 And by whom he hath four Children all of whom are now provided for Says that this Examinant Rented and lived in a House in Diott Street in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex upwards of four years at the yearly Rent of Eighteen pounds and paid all parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Twenty years ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement Eigher by Renting House or Tenement of Ten pounds a year paid Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Mary Wright age about 66 Years on her Oath says she Intermarried with her late Husband William Wright at the Parish Church of allhallows in Derby about Thirty Two Years ago & who has been Dead about 12 Years and by whom she hath no Children now living says her said Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one John Cross a Shoe Maker in the aforesaid Parish of Allhallows in Derby and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death

Mary James aged about 24 Years or her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Steel at the Hicks's Coffee house in King Street in the Parish of Saint Ann Soho in the Liberty of Westminster for one Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds Seven Shillings hath quitted her said Service upwards of Eight Months ago since which time she hath never gained any other Subsequent either by Renting House paying Taxes or Otherwise Howsoever

Letitia Wilkinson Aged about Eighteen Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Bromley a Coach painter in Parker Street Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex for Two Years or thereabouts at Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Three Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Rentg. House payg. Taxes or living a hired Yearly Sevant for one Year And further on her Oath Says that on the 12th day of September last she was delivered of a Female Bastard Child in the House of Mr. Morgan a Taylor in New Castle Court Butcher Row in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes which has since been baptized by the name of Ann Letitia and is likely to become Chargable to the said Parish And that one Lawrence Fields a Surveyor in Vine Street Greenwich in the County of Kent is the Father thereof he having had Carnal Knowledge of her Body about the Middle of June 1777 at his the said Fields House and at sevl. different times afterwards at one of which times he get her with Child of the Female Bastard Child of which she was delivered as aforesaid And that the said Lawrence Fields & no other person did beget the same and that he is the real and true Father thereof

Margaret Brown aged about 30 Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. White a Ribbon Weaver in Addle Street in the Parish of Saint Mary Aldermanbury in the City of London upwards of one Year at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Three Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year

John Ashmore Aged about Sixty Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Martha his Wife at the Fleet London about Thirty Years ago and by whom he hath no Child or Children now living Says before his Intermarriage with his said Wife and whilst he was a Singleman he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Colonel Whitworth in Clifford Street Burlington Gardens in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster in the Capacity of a Postillion & Second Coachman for Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Eight pounds hath quitted his said Service upwards of forty Years ago and after quitting his said Service he never Rented House or Tenement of Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

John Evans aged about fifty Three Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Mary his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Dunstan in the West London about Twenty Years ago and by whom he hath one Son living now provided for Says that this Examinant Rented and lived in a House known by the Name of Bagnio's Wells in the Parish of Saint Pancras in the County of Middlesex upwards of Two Years & an half at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds a Year & paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House upwards of Sixteen Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other subsequent Settlement

Rachael Stedman Aged about Thirty Three Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Joseph Fowthrop Stedman (who is pressed and gone to sea ) Says she Intermarried to her said Husband at the Parish Church of St. Sepulchre London about Eleven Years ago and by whom she hath four Children now living namely George Aged upwards of Nine Years James Aged about five Years Elizabeth aged about Three Years and Catherine Aged about Eleven Months Says her said Husband Served part of his the first part of his Apprenticeship with one Thomas Bradford a Lapedary in St. Bartholomew Close West Smith field in the Parish of St. Bartholomew the Great for about Two Years & his Sd. Master into the Parish of St. Botolph without Aldersgate London said in the London for the space of Nine Months or thereabouts when her said Husband bought his time out and after quitting his said Masters Service he never gained any other subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly or Covenanted Servant for one Year or otherwise howsoever

Mary Clarke Aged about Thirty Six Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Alexander Clarke (who now lies ill) with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the Fields about Eighteen Years ago and by whom she hath no Children by him now living Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House known by the Sign of the White Lyon in Hemings's Row in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for several Years at the Yearly Rent of thirty five pounds & also rented other houses to the amount in the whole of £60 Pounds and paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about Ten Years ago since which time her said Husband hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House or Tenemt. of £10. a Year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever.

Elizabeth Dodman aged about 38 Years on her Oath says she Intermarried to her Husband Richard Dodman (gone from her) at the Parish Church of St. Mary Islington about 11 Years ago and by whom she hath one Child living Named William aged upwards of 9 Years Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a Shop and Parlour the Lower part of a House of one Mr Richardson situate in Totenham Court Road in the Parish of Saint Pancras in the County of Middlesex for Six Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Sixteen Pounds but paid no Parish Taxes due for the same But that her said Husbands Goods were seized for one Qars. Rent due and in Arrear to the said Mr. Richardson Says her said Husband Quitted the said House in the Year 1769 since which time her said Husband never gained any other subsequent Settlement to her knowledge or belief neither hath this Examinant since her said Husband left her

Susannah Brown Aged about forty One Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Woodnorth the Two blue Posts in Holbourn in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn London for One Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of five pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Twelve Years ago since which time she hath gained no other subsequt. Settlement And further on her Oath Says she hath one Child living named Rachael Mary aged about 13 years a Bastard born in Fetter Lane in the said Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn London and that her said Daughter was never Bound out an Apprentice lived a hired Yearly Servant or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement than as aforesaid

Benjamin Organ Aged about Sixty Three Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with his late Wife Ann at the Parish Church of Brocksworth in Gloucestershire about Eleven Years ago and who has been Dead about five Years Says he has Two Children living by his said late Wife whose Friends now keeps in Gloucestershire And this Examinant further Says that he rented and lived in a House in Dacre Street near Tothill Street Westmr . in the Parish of St. Margaret in the City of Westminster for three Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Guineas and paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House upwards of Twenty Years ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of Ten pounds P Annum paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Richard Murray Aged about fifty Years on his Oath says he never was Married Rented House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a Year or paid Taxes Says he lived as a hired Yearly or Covenanted Servant with one Mr. Davison a Portrait Painter the west side of Leicester Square in the Parish of St Ann in the Liberty of Westminster for five Years and was to receive of his said Master after the Rate of £13 Per. Ann payable as this Examt. thought proper but his Mother was to find him Lodgings for the first three Years and that after the first three Years were Expired he was and did Lodge in his said Masters House till the time of his quitting his said Masters service and after quitting the same he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Mansfield Aged about 19 Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father Nicholas Mansfield was a Native of Ireland and never gained a Settlement in England other then by Renting a House in Duke Street in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex for three Years and upwards at the Yearly Rent of £9 but paid no Parish Taxes due for the same but this Examinant saith that she was born in the aforesaid House and that her Mother Hannah Mansfield now Hannah Nichols before her Intermarriage to this Examinants Mother Father she lived a hired Yearly Servant to one Mr. Toderick at a Tea Shop in Great Russell Street in the afsd. Parish of St. George Bloomsbury in the said County of Middlesex upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds from whence her said Mother married to her said Father as her said Mother has Informed her & which Information she verily believes to be true

Ann Lovin aged about Forty Years (on behalf of William and Grace Morrell Children of Robt. Morrell who is now a Prisoner in Tothill Fields Bridewell ) On her Oath says that her Brother Robt. Morrell before his Intermarriage with Sarah his now Wife he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Willows at Great Chelsea in the Parish of Saint Luke Chelsea in the County of Middlesex in the Capacity of a Coachman upwards of one Year at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds besides Dyet Lodging and Cloaths as she believes and after quitting the said Mrs. Willows's Service he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever as her said Brother has this Day Informed her and which Information she Verily believes to be true

Sarah Tall aged about Thirty Nine Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of John Tall (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Mary Le Bone about Nine Years ago and by whom she hath one Child now living Namely John Aged about Eight Years Says her said Husband before his Intermarriage to this Examinant & whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with Lord Darnley in the Capacity of his Gentleman in Berkley Square in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex for fourteen Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Thirty five Pounds besides Diet & Lodging hath Quitted his said Service about Nine Years ago since which time her said Husband never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Elizth. Smith aged about Twenty Six Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Vaughan Esqr. in Lincolns Inn Fields in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex for one whole Year at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Six Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Jane Coltsfoot Aged about Thirty Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says her Father Summers Coltsfoot Rented and lived in a House in Deptford Road in the Parish of Saint Nicholas Deptford in the County of Kent known by the Name or Sign of the Green Dragon quitted same about Twenty five Years ago and after quitting that House he Rented another House for several years in the aforesaid Parish of Nicholas in Deptford of the Yearly Rent of £7 and paid all parochial Taxes due for the same and where this Examinants Father died which is about fifteen Years ago and further Says that this Examinant hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement since her said Fathers Death.

Elizabeth Henderson Aged about forty Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Isaac Henderson who has been dead about four Years and with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St. Clement Danes about fifteen Years ago and by whom she hath no Children now living Says her said late Husband was bound an Apprentice to one Mr. Johnson a Buckle maker in Church Court in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields and served his said Master for five Years or thereabouts and then her said Husband listed and went for a Soldier and never was Assigned over to any other Master neither did her said late Husband gain any other subsequent Settlement either by Renting house paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Mary Holmes Aged about Twenty Eight Years on her she is the Widow of Thomas Holmes with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Mathew Bethnall Green about Seven Years ago and who has been dead about Six Years and by whom she hath no Child or Children living Says that being a Widow and without Child or Children living she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one James Westbrook at the sign of the Robinhood and Little John Hogsdon in the Parish of Saint Leonard Shoreditch in the County of Middlesex for five Years and upwards off and on but this Examinant Says he lived upwards of One Year and a Quarter the last time she lived with her said Master at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Ten Months ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement either by Renting house paying Taxes or living a lived Yearly Servant for one Year

John Pierce Aged about Twenty Eight Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried to his late Wife at the Parish Church of St. Clement Danes about Nine Years Ago and by whom he hath Two Children Living Namely Anna Maria Aged about four Years and Mary Aged about Two Years Says he rented and lived in a House the Corner of Wooden Street Chancery Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex for Three Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of forty four Pounds hath quitted the said House upwards of Seven Years ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of Ten pounds a Year or otherwise howsoever.

James Twiddy Aged about forty Two Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with his Wife Mary at the Parish Church of Hodsdon about Twelve Years Ago and by whom he hath Two Children now living namely James aged about Eleven Years and William Aged about Seven Years Says he Rented and lived in a House in Tennis Court Middle Row in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for Two Years at the Yearly Rent of Eighteen pounds hath quitted said House about four Years ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House or Tenement or otherwise howsoever.

Hester Sunderland Aged about Twenty Eight Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Hall at the Sign of the Goat in Little Minories in the Parish of Trinity Minories in the County of Middlesex for fifteen Months at the Yearly Wages of four pounds hath quitted her said Service about four Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Henry Croasdale one of the Beadles belonging to the Parish of Saint Clement Danes on behalf of Eleanor Pemberton an Infant aged about Thirteen Years on his Oath says that he hath looked at an Indenture of Apprenticeship whereby it appears that the said Eleanor Pemberton was by Indenture bearing Date the 16th. day of November 1778 bound out an Apprentice by the then Churchwardens and Overseers of the Poor of the said Parish to one Henry Eagleton then of Bagnio Court Newgate Street in the Parish of Christ Church London that her said Master whent to live at Hogsdon in the Parish of Saint Leonard Shoreditch in the County of Middlesex where the said Mr. Eagleton has resided for upwards of Two Months do the said Mr. Eagleton has lately informed this Examinant and which Information he verily believes to be true

James Feltham one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex on behalf of John Jones Elizabeth Ann Jones Samuel Jones and Thomas Jones Infants and Children of Catherine Jones deceased by Samuel Jones their Father ( gone to sea ) maketh Oath that it appears by an Examination of the said Catherine Dated the 14th. day of December last that she the said Catherine Jones with her then three Children were passed from the said Parish of of Saint Clement Danes to the Parish of Chiswick in the County of Middlesex as the place of their last legal Settlement and his Examinant further says that he is Informed and verily believes they have gained no other Subsequent Settlemt.

Edward Noyce Aged about Nineteen Years on his Oath Says he never was Married Rented House or ever served any Apprenticeship says he lived a hired Yearly Servant to one Mr. Adlow at the sign of the British Museum in Great Russell Street in the Parish of St. George Bloomsbury upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Six pounds when his said Master died and afterwards he Continued to live in the said House with one Mr. Wright who look the House on the Death of his said former Master and this Examinant lived with the said Mr. Wright for the Space of Nine Months which together with Twelve Months before mentioned make together One Year an Ten Months and after quitting his said Service he never after lived as a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Susannah Rogers Aged about forty Seven Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of Robert Rogers who died the Thirty first day of May last and with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Martins in the Fields about Three Years ago and by whom she no Child or Children living says her said late Husband has Two Children by a former Wife Namely Susannah Aged upwards of Eight Years William aged upwards of five Years says her said late Husband never Rented House paid Taxes served any Apprenticeship or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year as he has often Informed her and which Information she Verily believes to be true And further says that her said late Husbands Father as he has often Informed her Rented and lived in a House called or known by the Name or Sign of the Queens head at Knightsbridge in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex for some Years at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds and after quitting that House neither her said Husband or his said Father never gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Henry Croasdale one of the Beadles belongg. to the Parish of Saint Clement and Constance Avern Wife of Edward Avern Cockcutter severally make Oath and first this Examinant Constance Avern for herself Saith that she is the Wife of Edward Avern with whom she Intermarried at the Fleet London the first day of March in the year 1740 and by whom she hath no Child or Children living Says her said Husband now Rents and lives in a House in Marquis's Court lately Called Vinegar Yard in the Parish of St Martin in the Fields as she has been Informed and believes and is of the Yearly Rent of Ten pounds or upwards as she also believes and Can give no other Account than as aforesaid And this Examinant Henry Croasdales for himself Says that he has lately made Inquiry who Rented the abovementioned House and was Informed that the abovementioned Edward Avern did and has so done for Six Months or thereabouts and was also Informed by this Occupier the next house that the Rent of the said House is £18 a Year.

Robt. Hunter aged about fifty one Years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Sarah his Wife at the Parish Church of Stepney upwards of fourteen Years ago and by whom he hath one Child living Named Robert aged about Thirteen Years now provided for says he was Bound an Apprentice to one Thos. Eger a Perukemaker in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex and served his said Master for the Space of three Years or thereabouts and afterwards this Examinant was Assigned over do one Richard Catherwood a Peruke Maker in Windmill Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster and served his said Master for the space of three Years and an half or thereabouts and after quitting his said Masters Service he never Rented House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or Otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Forbes aged about Forty Eight Years on her Oath says she Intermarried with her late Husband Francis Forbes at the Parish Church of Saint James Westminster about Seventeen Years ago and who died about Two Years ago and by whom she hath four Children now living Namely Mary Aged about Fifteen Years now Provided for William aged about Thirteen Years who is also Provided for Elizth . aged about Eleven Years and Francis aged about Nine Years says her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in Round Court in the Strand in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for one Year at the Yearly Rent of Twenty four Pounds hath quitted the same about Six Years ago and after quitting the same her said Husband never Rented House or Tenement of Ten Pound a Year Paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death

Phillis Hansteen aged about Thirty Two Years on her Oath says she is the Widow Hans Hansteen who died about Twelve Years ago with whom she Intermarred at the Parish Church of Saint James in the Year 1764 and by whom she hath no Child now living says that being a Widow and without Child or Children she lived a hired Yearly Servant to one Mr. Rainer an Exciseman in Orange Street Leicester Fields in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields for one Year and an half at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about four Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizabeth Dugard aged about Twenty four Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Thomas Dugard (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Mary Lambeth in the County of Surry about three Years ago and by whom she hath four Children now living Namely Hester aged upwards of 4 Years born a Bastard in the sd Parish of St Mary Lambeth Charlott aged upwards of Two Years Elizth . aged about Eighteen Months and Mary aged about three Months says her said Husband before her Intermarriage with her said Husband he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Ashley at the Riding School in the Parish of Saint Mary Lambeth in the County of Surry upwards of Twelve Months at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds as her said Husband has often Informed her and which Information She Verily believes to be true and after quitting his said Masters Service he never Rented House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or otherwise howsoever

John Green aged about fifty Nine Years on behalf of Eleanor Talks an Infant aged upwards of Eleven Years a Bastard born on the Body of Patience Talks Widow since deceased at the House of one John Surry at the Sign of the Shepherd & Flock in High Street in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex and the Examinant further says he never was Married to the said Patience Talks but that he had she aforesaid Eleanor Talks by the aforesaid Patience and can give no further or other Account of the Settlement of the said Patience than as aforesaid and this Examinant further says that he is Poor and unable to Maintain the said Child and that She the said Eleanor Talks hath gained no other Settlement Otherwise than by Birth as this Examinant Verily believes

Elizabeth Hawtray aged about 32 Years on her Oath says she Intermarried to her late Husband Ralph Hawtray in the Year 1763 in the City of Dublin and who died about five Years ago and by whom she hath Two Children now living and residing in the Parish of Saint Mary in the said City of Dublin and further say's that her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in Abbey Street in the aforesaid Parish of Saint Mary Dublin of the Yearly Rent of Forty Six Pounds to the time of his Death and lastly says that since her said Husbands Death she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement

Jane Campbell aged about Twenty Eight Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lives as a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Challenor a Butterman in Clare Markett in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes and has so done upwards of one Year at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds and further on her Oath says that on the 3rd. day of July 1774 she was delivered of a Male Bastard in the House of Henry Leech a Staymaker at No 17 in Crown Street Westminster in the Parish of St. Margt. Westminster which was soon afterwards Baptized by the Name of Scipio and that she this Examinant is unable to maintain the same and further says that her said Child hath gained no other Settlement than by birth

Frances Cleland aged about Twenty Six Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she was bound to a lived as a Covenanted Servant to Messr Paulin & Coat Milliners in Tavistock Street in the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster and lived with them for the Space of Three Years under such Covenant and after leaving the said Messrs. Paulin and Coats's service she never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for One Year.

Margt. Jones aged about Sixty Eight Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of Thomas Jones with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the Fields about Twenty Nine Years ago and who has been dead about Nine Years say her said Husband Rented and lived in a House Called or known by the Name or Sign of the Red Lyon in Nottingham Court Castle Street Long Acre in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex Upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds or Upwards and paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House upwards of Forty Years ago and after quitting the same he never afterwards Rented House paid Taxes or did any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent as her said Husband has often Informed her and which Information she Verily believes to be true and this Examinant lastly says that she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement since her said Husband Death

Hester Shevellier aged about Sixty One Years on her Oath says she Intermarried to Dennis shevellier at the Parish of Saint Mary Radcliff in the City of Bristol about Twenty Eight Years ago and by whom she hath one Child living now provided for says her said late Husband was an Irishman and never gained a Settlement in England either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year before Marriage with this Examinant and this Examinant further says that before Intermarriage with her said late Husband she lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Timothy Davis a Hott Presser in Castle Street Castle Precinct in the City of Bristol upwards of one Year at the Yearly Wages of three Pounds and after quitting her said last Mentioned Service she never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Sarah Vallance Aged about forty Years on her Oath Says she never was Married Rented House was Apprentice or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for one year Says her Father before his Intermarriage with this Examinant Mother and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired Yearly Servant to one Mr. Lines or Lisle in Bread Street near Drapers Gardens in the Parish of Saint Peter Le Poor London for Several Years at the Yearly Wages of Ten Pounds or upwards and after he quitted his said Service he never Rented House paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Sarah Slater Aged about forty Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Charles Slater with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Shoreditch Church about Thirty Years ago and who has been dead about Twenty Years and by whom she hath no Child or Children living Says that being a Widow and without Child or Children she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Tomlin a Tobacconish in Hedge Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. for Two Years and an half at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds Ten Shillings hathquitted her said Service about Six Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Elizth. Shade Aged about Nineteen Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Taite a Watchmaker near the Adam and Eve Tottenham Court Road in the Parish of St. Pancras in the County of Middlesex for Eighteen Months at the Yearly Wages of Five pounds Ten Shillings hath quitted her said Service about Two Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House Paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizth. Walker aged about forty Years on her Oath Says she never was Married Rented House paid Taxes served any Apprenticeship or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year says her Father John Walker before his Intermarriage with her late Mother and whilst he was a singleman he lived a hired Yearly servant to Lord Carpenter and afterwards to Lord Ward who Gotheresided in the Parish of Saint George Hanover square but whr. he lived with Lord Carpenter or Lord Ward last she Cannot possitively say but that he lived upwards of One year with each at the Yearly Wages of Ten pounds and upwards besides Diet Lodgings and Cloaths hath quitted his said service upwards of forty Years ago as her said Father and Mother has often Informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true and after quitting his last servitude he never gained any other Subsequent Settlemt. neither hath this Examinant since her said Father Death

John Shireson Aged about Thirty five on his Oath Says he Intermarried to Martha his lately at the Parish Church of Shoreditch about Twelve Years of and by whom he hath one Child now living namely Sophia Aged about Eleven Years Says his first Wife died about Eight Years ago without any or Child living by her And further Says that he Intermarried to his present Wife Sarah at Shoreditch Parish aforesaid about Six Years and by whom he hath Two Children now living namely John Aged about five Years and Ann Aged about Two Years And this Examinant further says that his Father John Shireson rented and lived in a House in Baldwins Garden Grays in Lane in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for Twenty Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds or thereabouts and paid Parish Taxes due for the same Quitted same about fifteen Years ago and after this Examinant having his said Fathers Service he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by living as a hired Yearly or Covenanted Service whilst a single Man Renting House or orwise how soever

Hannah Moore aged about Sixteen Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Saml. Coppock deceased in that Part of Shire Lane which lies in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex for One Year and an half at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Eleven Months ago since which time She hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement by living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year or otherwise howsoever

George Allwood aged about Fifty Years on his Oath says he never was Married Rented House or Paid Taxes he was bound an Apprentice to One Joseph Hilton a Staymaker who at that time lived in the Castle and Falcon in Aldersgate Street London And his said Master sometime afterwards failing this Examinant was Assigned Over to One James Bradd a Staymaker in Winchester Court Monkwell Street in the Parish of Saint Albans London and Served the said Mr. Bradd under such Assignment for the Space of Ten Months and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship or Assignment he never Gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise Howsoever

Mary Grace Reed aged about Thirty Nine Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Robt. Reed with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St. Mary White Chappel about Twenty Years ago and by whom she hath Two Children now living namely Mary aged about 19 Years & Esther Aged about Nine Years (one of whom is now Provided for) Says her said late Husband was an Irishman and never gained a Settlement in England either by renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father Thomas Chamberlain Rented and lived in a House in Horn Court Bear Lane Tower Street in the Parish of all Hallows Barking Tower Street in the City of London for sevl. Years at the Yearly Yearly Rent of Nine Pounds and Paid Land Tax due for the same lived therein to the time of his Death which is upwards of Nine Years ago since which time this Examinant has gained no other Subsequent Settlemt. either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise house ever

Dorothy Jones Aged about forty Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Pennery an Apothecary in Tooley Street in the Parish of Saint Olave in the Borough of Southwark in the County of Surry for Thirteen Years and Upwards at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds hath quitted her said Service Upwards of seven Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Years Servant for One Year

Mary Edwards aged about Fifty Two Years on Oath says She never was Married Rented House a paid Taxes says She lived a hired Yearly Servant One Mrs. Rutkin in Craven Street in the Parish of Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Eleven Years at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Thirty five Years ago since which time She hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Pugh Aged about Sixty Seven Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of William Pugh who died about Seven Years ago and with whom she Intermarried at the Fleet London upwards of Twenty Years ago and further says that her said late Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship to one John Simpson a running Poulterer in Hog Lane in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middx And after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant before Marriage for One Year neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death

Rachael Dewxell Aged about forty four Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Thomas Dewxell with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holbourn about Twenty Two Years ago and who has been dead about Twelve Years Says her said late Husband Served Seven Years Apprenticeship to one Andrew Janaway a Bedstead maker in Gravel Lane Hounsditch in the Parish of St. Botolph without Aldgate London and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House or Tenement of Ten pounds a Year Paid Taxes or ever gained any other subsequent Settlement otherwise than as before mentioned neither hath this Examinant since her said Husband Death

Mary Turner Aged about Twenty Three Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of William Turner (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried a the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holbourn in Febry 1779 and by whom she hath one Child now livingna Samuel Aged about One Month Says her said Husband Served Three Years the latter Part of his Apprenticeship with One Mr. Jones an Engraver near White Count Alley Shoreditch in the Parish of St. Leonard Shoreditch in the County of Middlesex and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or ever gained any other Subsequent Settlement otherwise than as before mentioned

Sarah Linnell Aged about Twenty Eight Years on her Oath Says she never was Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Lowe at the Crown Alehouse at Peckham in the Parish of Camber in the County of Surry upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of four pounds hath quitted her Service upwards of Nine Years ago since which time she hath gained no other subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

John Kelly Aged about Six five Sixty six Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried to Mary his Wife at Saint Marys in Dublin about Twenty Years ago and by whom he hath one Child living namely Catherine Aged about fifteen Years Says before his Intermarriage to his said Wife and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Charles Wilson at the Sign of the George in Piccadilly in the Parish of Saint George Hanover in the County of Middlesex in the Capacity of a Groom and lived with his said Master upwards of Thirteen Months at the Yearly Wages of Eight pounds besides Diet ant Ledging hath Quitted his said Service about Thirty Years Ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of Ten pounds a Year paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year or otherwise howsoever.

Jane Jones aged about Twenty Nine Years on her Oath says She Intermarried with Edward Jones her late Husband at the Parish Church of Saint mary Le Strand about Eight Years ago and who has been d about Three Years and by whom She hath no Child or Children living says her said late Husband Served Seven Years Appren to one Mr. Edwards a Sawyer the Corner of Nottingham Court Cross Lane in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly servant for one Year.

Jane Jones aged about Twenty Nine Years on behalf of Johannah Marks otherwise Peeling an Infant aged about Eleven Years by Joseph Peeling her Father deceased her Oath says She never was Married to the aforesaid Joseph Peeling but that the said Johannah Peeling born a Bastard on her Body in the House of the Joseph Peeling her Father in Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster And further says that her said Daughter never Gained any other Settlement tha by Birth.

Sarah Telby Aged about Twenty Three Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House paid Taxes Says She lived a hired Yearly Servant with One Mr. Fowler at the Sign of the Crown in Brewer Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster Upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds hath quitted her said Service Upwards of Two Years ago since which time She hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement

Ann Gill Aged about Fifty four Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says She lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Horman a Victualler in Conduit Street in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middlesex for three Years and Upwards at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Nine Years ago since which time She hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Martha Robinson Aged about Fifty Three Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes or was an Apprentice says She lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Pritchard a Surgeon in Hart Street in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex for fourteen Months at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds Eight Shillings hath quitted her said Service about Ten Months ago since which time She hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

John Jenkins Aged about Forty five Years on his Oath says he Intermarried to his late Wife Ann at the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields about Thirteen Years ago and by whom he hath no Child or Children living says before his Intermarriage to his said late Wife and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. John Berry at the Queens head Tavern in Holbourn in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for one Year and Upwards at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted his said Service about Eleven Years ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Mary Buzvargus Aged about Fifty four Years on her Oath says She never was Married says She Rented and lived in a House in Off Alley York Buildings in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster Upwards of Two Years at the yearly Rent of Twenty Eight Pounds and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted her said House Upwards of Eleven Years ago since which time She hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Lydia Glover Aged about Twenty five Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes Says She was bound an Apprentice by the Churchwarden and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Saint Mary at H Thames Street London to one Don Bartholomew Shaw an Orange Merchant at No. 3 Saint Dunstans Alley in the Parish of Saint Dunstan in the East London and servt. her said Master under such Indenture for the space of five Years when her said Master gave up her Indenture And after quitting her said Masters Service She never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Elizabeth Henley Aged about Thirty Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year says her Father Rented and lived in a House in Justice Walk in the Parish of Saint Lukes Chelsea in the County of Middlesex in which Parish this Examinant was born And further says that She was Passed from Saint Andrew Holbourn upon the said Parish of Saint Luke Chelsea aforesaid where her said Settlement was found to be upon an Appeal at the Quarter Sessions since which time She has never gained any other Subsequent Settlement.

Elizth. Irons aged about Thirty two Years on her Oath says She Intermarried with Abraham Irons (who has deserted at the Parish Church of Saint John's Horsley down in the Borough of Southwark in the County of Surry about fourteen Years ago And by whom She hath one Child living Namely Samuel Aged about one Month says her said Husband Rented a House in Lamb Court Abchurch Lane in the Parish of Saint Mary Abchurch London at the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and lived therein upwards of Three Months and run away by Night but kept the Key for one Year and a Quarter her said Husband having made and Agreement with the Landlord for a Year Certain) and a Quarters Marning but whither her said Husband paid either Rent or Taxes this Examinant cannot sett forth Hath quitted sd. House about 10 Years ago since which time He never Rented House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Amey Witton aged about Fifty Years on her Oath says She is the Wife of Thomas Witton who has deserted her and with whom She Intermarried at the Parish Church of Aldgate London about Thirteen Years ago And by whom She hath no Children living says her said Husband has Often Informed her And which Information She verily believes to be true that her said Husbands Father was a Covenanted Servant with one Mr. Poole a Glover in James Street in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex and where her said Husband was born And further says he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement.

Ann Boveall Aged about Fifty five Years on her Oath says She is the Widow of James Boveall who died in December last And with whom She Intermarried at Fleet London about Thirty Three Years ago and by whom She hath one Child living named Ann Boveall Aged about Twenty Three Years now provided for says her said late Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Thomas Hooker a Watchmaker in Golden Lane in the Parish of Saint Lukes Old Street in the County of Middlesex and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or Otherwise howsoever

Alice Cook Aged Forty Nine Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes or served any Apprenticeship says She lived a hired Yearly Servant with one John Hudd a Clock Forger in Duke Street Artillery Lane in the Liberty of the Tower of London at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Twenty five Years ago since which time She hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired yearly Servant for one Year.

James Talboys of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes Perukemaker on the behalf of Elizabeth Otter a Lunatick maketh Oath that he this day went over into the Borough of Southwark to Examine the Books kept at the Rotation Office there and whilst this Examinant was Examining the same Samuel Swabey Esqr . came in there And on Asking the Clerk and the said Samuel Swabey whither such Examination was taken and sworn before him the Clerk and the said Samuel Swabey Acknowledged that there was such Examination And that it was his the said Samuel Swabey s hand writing Relative to the said Elizabeth Otter .

Elizabeth Bryant Aged about Fifty Years on her Oath says She Intermarried to her Husband Thomas Bryant at the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn about Twenty four Years Ago and by whom She hath four Children now living Vizt. Thomas Aged Twenty One Years Susannah Aged about Nineteen Years Mary Aged about Eleven Years and Elizth. aged upwards of Five Years (Two of the first Named Children are now provided for) says her said Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship to one Edward Cuthbert Alias Cudboard a Pattenmaker in Smock Alley in the Parish of Christ Church Spittle Fields in the County of Middlesex And after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of Ten pounds a Year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Elizabeth Wiggs Aged about Thirty Three Years on her Oath says She Intermarried with her late Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holbourn about Six Years ago And by whom She hath no Child or Children living says her said late Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship to one Mr. Lindsey a Bricklayer in Vinegar Yard Bernaby Street in the Parish of Saint Clave Southwark in the County of Surry And after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever.

Elizabeth Eadson Aged about Nineteen Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House as paid Taxes or hired yearly Servant for one Year says her Father Christ. Eadson Rented and lived in a House in Church Street in the Parish of Newington in the County of Middlesex Upwards of One Year at the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds on thereabouts And afterwards kept another House on the other side of the Way at the Yearly Rent of Seven Pounds

Elizabeth Eadson Aged about Nineteen Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes Served any Apprenticeship or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year says her Father Christr. Eadson Rented and lived in a House in Church Street in the Parish of Stoke Newington in the County of Middlesex Upwards of One Year at the Yearly Rent of Eleven Pounds or thereabouts and paid Taxes due for the same and after quitting the said last mentioned House he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a Year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever neither hath this Examinant since her said Fathers Death.

Elizabeth Cooper Aged Upwards of Twenty Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House paid Taxes was an Apprentice says She lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Priggs a Grocer and Cheesemonger the Corner of Queen Charlotte Street Pimlico in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middlesex for Two Years and Upwards at the Yearly Wages of Five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Three Years ago since which time She hath done no other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Ann Hammond Aged about Fifty Years on her Oath says She Intermarried to her late Husband James Hammond at the Parish Church of Saint George the Martyr in the Borough of Southwark in the County of Surry about Twenty Years ago and by whom She hath Two Children unprovided for Namely John and Elizabeth Two Twins aged upwards of Ten Years says her said late Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Haydon a Grocer in Blackmay Street in the Parish of Saint George the Martyr aforesaid in the County of Surry and after quitting his said Masters Service he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement neither hath this Examinant since her said Husband Death

Joseph Hills Aged about Sixty One Years On his Oath Says he Intermarried to his late Wife Hannah at the Fleet London about Thirty five Years ago and by whom he hath no Children living, Says he was bound an Apprentice to one Mr. Cannon a House Smith in May Poll Alley in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr . for the Term of Seven Years & served his said Master under such Indenture for three Years & upwards when his said Master gave up this Examinant his Indentures And this Examinant further Says that he was afterwards bound to or Covenanted with John Whitingham a House Smith near Deadmans Place in the Parish of St. Mary Oversees otherwise St. Saviour Southwark in the County of Surry for the Term of Three Years & an half and after his Apprenticeship or Covenant was out he never gained any other Settlement either by renting House or Tenement of Ten pounds P Ann Paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever.

Mary Hallaway Aged about Twenty one years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says says She lived a hired Yearly Servant with Colonel Roberts in Holles Street Cavendish Square in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex for three years and in half at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds the last half year of which Servitude was at East Acton in the said County of Middlesex Her Master removing there And was discharged from thence about Twelve Months ago since which time She hath gained no other Settlements by Servitude or otherwise howsoever

Ann Hayward Aged about Thirty three Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House was an Apprentice or ever lived a hired yearly Servant for one Year says her Father James Hayward who died many Years ago Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Smith a Hartshorn Rasper in the Old Change in the Parish of Saint Augustine otherwise Saint Austin in the City of London and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any other Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever neither hath this Examinant since her said Fathers Death.

Thomas Rumball Aged about Twenty five years (On behalf of Mary his Wife who is Insane ) on his Oath says he Intermarried to his said Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Lukes Old Street in the County of Middlesex And by whom he hath no Child or Children living says he was bound an Apprentice for Seven years to one James Coghlan a Book binder in Duke Street Grosvenor Square in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middlesex And served his said Master under such Indenture for 6 years when his said Master gave up this Examinant his Indenture and they Consented to part And never was Assigned over to any other Person but has worked Journey Work ever since And further says that after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a Year or otherwise howsoever

Thomas Pierce Aged about Sixty Nine Years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Mary his Wife at May Fair Chapel in the Year 1750 and by whom he hath one Child now living which is now Provided for says that before his Intermarriage to his said Wife And whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with his Grace the Duke of Montague in the Parish of Greenwich in the County of Kent for one Year at the yearly Wages of Twenty one Pounds quitted his said Service in the year 1750 and after quitting the same he never Rented House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes on did any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Catherine Riley Aged about Sixty Eight Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House or Paid Taxes says She lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Riley an Auctioneer in Long Acre in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for one Year and an half at the yearly Wages of Five Pounds hath quitted her said service Upwards of Ten Years ago since which time She hath gained no other Settlement

Mary Chase Aged about forty Eight Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired yearly Servant with on Mr. Millan a Taylor in the Parish of Tottenham High Cross in the County of Middlesex for one Year at the Yearly Wages of five pounds hath quitted her said Service about Twelve years ago since which time she hath gained no other Settlement

Elizabeth Ward Aged about forty years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says She lived a hired yearly Servant with one Captain Cooper in Catherines Court Great Tower Hill in the Parish of All Hallows Barking in the City of London Upwards of Three years at the yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Thirteen Years ago since which time She hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement

Elizabeth Rust Aged about Twenty Six years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House paid Taxes or was an Apprentice says She lived a hired Yearly Servant with Thomas Clay a Victualler who kept the Sign of the Talbot the Corner of Grays Inn Lane in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for one Year at the yearly Wages of Ten Pounds hath quitted her said Service about four years ago since which time She hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one year

Lucy Wilson Aged about Fifty Seven Years on her Oath says She Intermarried to David Wilson her late Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holbourn London about Three Years ago And who has been Dead about One Month Says her said late Husband has Two Children now living by a former Wife Namely Mary Aged about Nine Years And David Aged about Five Years And further says that her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House known by the Sign of the Wheat Sheaf in Red Lyon Street in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn above the Barrs in the County of Middlesex for One Year at the yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds as She believes And Paid Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about five Years ago since which time he hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House Paying Taxes or otherwise Howsoever.

Samuel Scott Aged about Thirty five Years on his Oath says he never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes Says he was bound an Apprentice for Seven Years to one Samuel Houses a Stationer in Chancery Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex and served his said Master under such Indenture for the Space of three years when his said Master & this Examinant Agreed to part And to Cancell his Indenture And this Examinant further says that after quitting his said Masters Service he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise Howsoever

Sarah Yarwood Aged about 25 Years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says She lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Holton in Downing Street in the Parish of Saint Margaretts Westminster for three year at the yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Two years ago since which time She hath gained no other Settlement And further says that on or about the 2nd. day of June-last She was delivered of a Female Bastard Child in the Workhouse belonging to the said Parish of Saint Margaretts Westminster which hath since been Baptized by the name of Margarett She being poor & Humble to maintain herself and Child that the Parish of Saint Margaretts Westminster is the Parish to which She belongs

Elizabeth Howell Aged about Forty Years on her Oath says She is the Wife of Richard Howell gone from her with whom She Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Brides in the City of London about Seven years ago and by whom She hath no Children having says her Husband Richard Howell Rented and lived in a House in Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for four Years at the yearly Rent of Thirty Six Pounds and paid Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Nine Months ago since which time he hath gained no other Settlement

Mary Parker Aged about Sixty one Years on her Oath says She is the Widow of Thomas Parker with whom She Intermarried at the Fleet London in the year 1745 and by whom She hath no Children living says her said Husband was a West Countryman as he has been Informed but from what Parish or Place She does not know nor did her Husband ever Acquaint her thereof neither does She know where her Husband was born or did he ever gain a Settlement by Renting House paying Taxes or Otherwise howsoever says before her Intermarriage with her said late Husband and whilst She was a Singlewoman She lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Lewis Smart in Holbourn in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex for fifteen Months at the yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Thirty five Years ago since which time She hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of £10 a year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Michael Brooksbank Aged about Fifty Six years on his Oath says he Intermarried to his present Wife Avis at the Parish Church of Saint Brides London about Eleven years ago Says he hath one Child by a former Wife Named John Aged about Thirty Six Years now provide for says he Rented and lived in a House in Cursitor Street in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middx for Two Years At the yearly Rent of Ten Pounds hath quitted the said House about fifteen Years ago since which time he hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

John Breeden Aged about Sixty five years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Mary his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes about Twelve years ago and by whom he hath no Children now living says he Rented and lived in a House known by the Name or Sign of Ben Johnsons Head in Bath Street in the Parish of Saint James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex for five years at the yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds and paid Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Eighteen years ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a Year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

William Middleton Aged Sixty years on his Oath says he Intermarried to his present Wife Jane Esther at the Parish Church of Saint Giles in the Fields in or about the year 1763 and by whom he hath one Child now living namely Jane Aged about fourteen years says he Rented and lived in a House in White Harts Yard in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex for Six Months at the yearly Rent of Twenty Two Pounds and paid Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Two years ago since which time he hath gained no other Settlement

Mary Holloway Aged about Thirty Two years on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes Says She lived a hired yearly Servant with John Bennett a Dealer in Coals in New Bound Court in the Strand in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Two years and an half at the yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Three years ago since which time She hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired yearly Servant for One year

Charles Halfpenny Aged about Forty five years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Rebecca his late Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Brides London about Seventeen years ago and by whom he had One Child both of which died about Twelve years ago Says that afterwards being a Singleman & without Child or Children he lived as a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Chapman a Plumber in the Capacity of a Clerk in Saint Martins Lane in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Two years and Upwards at the yearly Wages of Forty Pounds hath quitted his said Service about Seven years ago since which time he hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a year paying Taxes or living a hired yearly Servant for One year

Elizabeth Yallop aged about Thirty Two years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Thomas Yallop (who now lives Servant with Commission Lowndes) and with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Mary Le Strand about fourteen years ago and by whom she hath no Child or Children living says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in the Strand Opposite Hungerford Coffee House in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Two Years and upwards at the yearly Rent of Sixty Pounds and paid Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Eight years ago since which time her said Husband hath gained no other settlement

Thomas King aged about Forty One years On his Oath says he Rented and lived in a House near Battle Bridge in the Parish of Saint Pancras in the County of Middlesex for Three Months or upwards at the yearly Rent of Ten guineas hath quitted the said House about One year and a half ago since since which time he hath gained no other settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Rebecca Dark Aged about Thirty six years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes or ever lived a hired yearly servant for One year. Says she was bound an Apprentice by the Churchwarden and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone in the County of middlesex to her Grand Father John Ivory a Carpenter at Acton in the Parish of Acton in the County of Middlesex untill this Examinant shod. attain her Age of Twenty One years or day of marriage and after she was out of her said Apprenticeship she never gained any other settlement otherwise than as aforesaid

Susannah Prosser Aged about Twenty four years On her Oath says she Intermarried with her Husband John Prosser who hath acserted her in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn in the County of Middlesex in the year 1778 and by whom she hath two Children now living Namely John Aged about Two years and mary Ann Aged about Three Months says her said Husband never Rented House paid Taxes served any Apprenticeship or ever lived a hired yearly servant for One year before marriage And this Examinant Elizabeth Prosser Mother of the said John Prosser whose Father William Prosser was an Fishman and never gained any Settlement in England to her knowledge or Belief otherwise then by being born in Phenix Alley Long Acre in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster about Twenty four years ago and that her said son never gained any other settlement then as aforesaid

Elizabeth Bass Aged about Fifty years (On behalf of her Sister Susannah Bass a Lunatic Aged about Forty seven years on her Oath says that her said sister Susannah Bass never was Married Rented House paid Taxes or ever servant any Apprenticeship says her said sister lived as a hired yearly Servant with One Mr. Butler a Hatter in Tooley Street in the Parish of Saint Olave Southwark in the County of Surry for 2 years or thereabouts at the yearly Wages of Five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Twenty years ago and after quitting her said Service she never gained any other subsequent settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired yearly servant for one year

Ann Brinner aged about Fifty Eight years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired yearly servant with Mr. Pollard a Taylor in D evereux Court in the Strand in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex for Sixteen Months at the yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said service Upwards of Twenty years ago since which time she hath never gained any other settlement And further says that in the year 1765 she became Acquainted with One Hugh Davis a Plane maker on Newington Causeway in the Parish of Saint mary Newington in the County of Surry but knew nothing of the settlement of the said Hugh Davis and further says that in the year 1768 she was bros. to bed of a Female Bastard Child in the House of Mr. Bates on Newington Causeway aforesaid which was soon afterwards baptized by the name of Elizabeth & is now Chargeable to the Parish of Saint Clement Danes this Examinant being passed with said Child for Nurture in the year 1769 And further that her said Child never gained any other settlement then by Birth

Elizabeth Smith Aged about thirty nine years on her Oath says she Intermarried with her Husband John Smith who deserted her at the Parish Church of Saint Margaretts Westminster in the year 1769 and by whom she hath Two Children namely Terizia Elizabeth Ann Aged Eight years and upwards and Hannah Aged Two years and upwards says her said Husband served his apprenticeship or a Covenanted servant with One Mr. Coleman a Breeches maker at Chairing Cross in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster and after his Master removed to the Corner of Round Court in the said Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster and after quitting his said Masters service he never Rented House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other subsequent settlement

James Hell Aged about Fifty years on his Oath says he Intermarried to his present Wife Eleanor at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes about five years ago and by whom he hath no Child or Children says before his Intermarriage to his said Wife and whilst he was Single man he lived a hired yearly servant with One Mr. Ward a Victualler in Saint Martins Lane in the Parish of Saint martins in the Field in the Liberty of Westminster for four years or thereabouts at the yearly Wages of Ten Guineas hath quitted his said Service about Eleven years ago since which time he hath gained no other subsequent settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Elizabeth Turner Aged about Fifty Eight years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House paid Taxes or was an Apprentice says she lived a hired yearly servant with Mr. Jones in George Street near the Adelphi in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Two years and Upwards at the yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Upwards of Three Months ago since which time she hath gained no other settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Margarett Davis Aged about Thirty Eight years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired yearly servant with Mr. John Sharp in Hart Street Bloomsbury in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex for three years at the yearly Wages of Eight Guineas hath quitted her said service about Six years ago since which time She hath gained no other settlement And further says that she hath one Child named James aged Three years and upwards a Bastard born on the Body of this Examinant and which was born at Rumsey in the County of Southampton which Child hath gained no other settlement oherewise than by Birth

Catherine Bury Aged about Thirty Six years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House paid Taxes or was an Apprentice says she lived a hired yearly servant with Mrs. Miller in Queen Street in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex for 12 years at the yearly Wages of Five Pounds hath quitted her said service about Fifteen years ago since which time she hath gained no other settlement

Jane Coleman Aged about Twenty One years On her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired yearly servant with One Mr. Wellings a Coachmaker who Lodged at Mr. Coropass's a Bricklayer in Wormwood Street in the Parish of all Hallows London Wall in the City of London upwards of One year at the yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted her said service about Twelve Months ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent settlement

James Mango Aged about Sixteen years on his Oath says he was bound an Apprentice by the Churchwardens and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr . by Indenture bearing Date the fifth Day of May 1780 to William Hughes of High Street in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex and served his said Master under such Indenture for the space of six Months or thereabouts when his said master removed to Butler Court Moor Lane where he Resided with his said Master for four Weeks or thereabouts from thence his said Master removed to the Upper End of Bunhill Row Moor Fields in the Parish of Saint Luke's Old street in the County of Middlesex where he Continued to Live with his said Master under such Indenture for four Months when his said Master died and after his Master Death this Examinant went to Live with one Mr. Attwood a shoe maker in W ych Street in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex on the 24th of April last and Continued to Live with him to this Day which is five Weeks and two Days

Mary Pasquier Aged about Seventy four years on her Oath says she Intermarried to Francis Joseph Pasquier (who was a Frenchman & never gained a Settlement in England) at the Fleet London in the Year 1727 and by whom she had five Children who all died in their Infancy says her Husband went away from her about Twenty Two years ago into the Spannish Service and who soon afterwards died as she believes says that being a Widow & without Child or Children she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one George Wychart a Taylor in Saint Martin Street in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . for 14 years or thereabouts at the yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about 21 years ago since which time she hath gained no other settlemt either by renting House or Tenement of Ten pounds a year paying Taxes or living a hired yearly servant for one year

Elizth. Wells Aged about Twenty Six years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House paid Taxes served any Apprenticeship or ever lived a hired yearly servant for One year says her Father James Wells served seven years Apprenticeship with One Nicholas Crope The Corner of Thames Street in the Parish of Allhallows the great in the City of London and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship He never gained any other Settlement then as aforesaid neither hath this Examinant since her said Fathers Death
