Ann Weaver Aged about Thirty five years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says she Lived a hired yearly Servant in the Capacity of a Cook with One Mr. Richardson a Cow keeper in Gray's Inn Lane Road in the Parish of Saint Pancras in the County of Middlesex upwards of One year at the yearly Wages of Ten Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of One year ago since which time she hath gained no other settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or Living a hired yearly servant for One year And further says she hath One Child Named Harriott Aged about Two years and an half a Bastard born on the Body of this Examinant by One Thomas Wheat deceased and which said Child was born in Milford Lane in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex and which said Child hath gained no other settlement then by Birth as this Examinant is Informed & Believes

Mary Carr Aged about Fifty Three years on her Oath says she Intermarried to her Husband William Carr (gone from her) at the Parish Church of Saint Ann Soho about Seventeen years ago and by whom she hath Two Children Living Namely Mary Aged about Fifteen years and Elizth . Aged about Eleven years both of whom her Husband Maintains as she Believes says her Husband Rented Two Houses in Vine Street near Chandos Street in the Parish of Saint Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Eight years and Upwards at the yearly Rent of Thirty four Pounds and paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said Houses about seven years ago since which time He hath gained no other settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of Ten Pounds P Annum paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Rachael Middlemost Aged about Twenty two years on her Oath says she is the Wife of James Middlemost (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint James in the beginning of the year 1779 and by whom she hath one Child now Living namely John aged about Nineteen Months says her said Husband served seven years Apprenticeship to One Mr. Crispin a Silver Smith the Corner of Panton Street Haymarket in the Parish of St. Martins in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster and after He was out of his said apprenticeship he never gained any other settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

John Clarke Aged about Forty Eight years on his Oath says He Intermarried to His Wife Hannah at the Parish of Saint Luke Chelsea about Nineteen years ago and by whom He hath no Children living says He Rented and lived in a House in Cloth Fair Smithfield in the Parish of Saint Bartholomew the Great in the City of London for One year and Upwards at the yearly Rent of sixteen Pounds and paid Parish Taxes and for the same Hath quitted the said House about six years ago since which time he hath gained no other subsequent settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Mary Peachy Aged about Twenty five years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or ever served any Apprenticeship says she lived a hired yearly Servant with Mrs. Robinson an Actress near the Bedford Arms Covent Garden in the Parish of Saint Pane Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middlesex for Fifteen Months at the yearly Wages of Seven Guineas hath quitted her said service about Eighteen Months ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Roberts Aged about Forty One years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a Hired yearly Servant with One Mr. Haywood a Taylor in Evangelist Court in the Parish of Saint Anns Black Fryers in the City of London for One year and Nine Months at the yearly Wages of Five Pounds hath quitted her said service about Seven years ago since which time she hath gained no other settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired yearly servant for One year

William Buckingham Aged about Thirty Seven years On his Oath says he Intermarried with Ann his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes about Fourteen years ago and by whom He hath Six Children now Living Namely Ann Aged about Twelve years now provided for William Aged about Eleven years, Sarah Aged about Nine years, Elizabeth Aged about Seven years, Benjamin Aged about four years, and Mary Aged about Ten Months, and this Examinant further says that He Rented and Lived in a House at Battle Bridge in the Parish of Saint Pancras in the County of Middlesex upwards of Two years at the yearly Rent of Ten Pounds but paid no Parish Taxes due for the same as He remembers Hath quitted the said House about five years ago since which time He hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement Either by Renting House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a year paying Taxes or otherwise Howsoever

Mary Lucas of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes Widow and Sophia Thomas Daughter of the said Mary Lucas severally make Oath and say and first this Examinant Sophia Thomas on her Oath says that she is about Twenty five years of age that she never was Married Rented House paid Taxes was an Apprentice or ever lived a Hired yearly Servant for One year and this Examinant Mary Lucas mother of the said Sophia Thomas on her Oath says that about Twenty six years ago she became acquainted with One Thomas Thomas by whom she had her said Daughter Sophia Thomas but that she never was married to the aforesaid Thomas Thomas but that her said Daughter was born a Bastard in the House of Mr. Peters in Grays Inn Lane in the Parish of Saint andrew Holbourn above the Bars in the County of middlesex and that Her said Daughter never gained any other Settlement than by a said

Catherine Shires Aged about Twenty five years on her Oaths say's she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a Hired yearly Servant with One Mr. Jelicoe an Upholder in Fleet Street in the Parish of Saint Bride otherwise Bridget London for Thirteen Months at the yearly Wages of Eight Pounds hath quitted her said Service about four years ago and after Quitting her said Service she never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or Living a Hired yearly servant for One year and further says she hath One Child named Catherine aged about five Months a Bastard born on the Body of this Examinant by one James Tiller and which said Child was born in the Precinct of White Fryers and hath gained no other Settlement then by birth as this Examinant hath been Informed and believes

Henry Croasdell one of the Beadles belonging to the Parish of Saint Clement Danes on behalf of Elizth. Thompson Widow (who this Deponent looks upon not Capable of making an Oath) On his Oath says that on the Strictest Inquiry he can make finds that Her late Husband James Thompson Rented and Lived in a House in Cross Court Gun Dock in the Parish of Saint John Wapping in the County of Middlesex for two years and Upwards at the yearly Rent of nine Pounds Ten Shillings and paid Land Tax and for the same and Quitted she said House in the year 1774 as Appears to this Deponent by the Landlords Receipt and after Quitting the last mentioned House she said James Thompson never Rented House except One in the Parish of Saint Catherine near the Tower of the yearly Rent of Five Pounds five shillings but paid no parish Taxes due for the same as he has been Credibly Informed by the Landlord thereof and which Information He verily believes to be true

Sarah Moore Aged about Sixty Six years on her Oaths says She Intermarried to her late Husband John Moore at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holbourn about Eighteen years ago and by whom She hath no Child or Children living Says Her said Late Husband Rented and Lived in a House in Blue cross Street Leicester Fields in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for upwards of Twenty years at the Yearly Rent of Twenty five Pounds and paid Parish Taxes and for the same and quitted said House about 14 years ago and after quitting the said House He never gained any other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever neither hath this Examinant since her said Husband death.

Rachael Middlemost Aged about Twenty Two years on her Oath says She is the Wife of James Middlemost gone from had with whom She Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster in the beginning of the year 1779 and by whom She hath One Child now Living namely John aged One Year and Upwards Says her said Husband Served Seven Years Apprenticeship to One Mr. Crispin a Silver Smith the Corner of Panton Street Haymarkett in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster & after He was out of his said Apprenticeship He never gained any other Settlement either by Renting House or otherwise howsoever.

James Mead Aged about Forty Six years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Mary his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Mary Lambeth about four years ago And by whom He hath One Child now Living namely James aged about Three years both of whom are now in the Workhouse belonging to the Parish of Saint Pancras and this Examinant further says that before this Intermarriage to his said Wife and whilst He was a Singleman He Lived a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Huggins at the Castle in Kentish Town for several years the first year at Three Pounds the Second at Three Pounds Ten Shillings the Third at four Pounds and the fourth year at five Pounds Hath quitted his said Service about Eighteen years ago since which time He never gained any other Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or Living hired yearly Servant for One year

Mary Hall aged about forty five Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Colonel Monntalieu in Arlbemarl Street in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster for One Year and an half at the Yearly Wages of Twelve Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Nine Years ago since which time she hath gained no other subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

John Charley Aged about fifty Years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Elizabeth his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Mary Magdalen London abo about a Year ago by whom he hath no Child living Says he served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Jeffson a Printer in Pye Corner in the Parish of Saint Sepulchre London and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any other Settlement either by Renting House Paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year before marriage.

Edward Langbridge aged about fifty Nine Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried to Jane his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex about Nine Years ago and by whom he hath no Child or Children living Says he Rented and lived in a House in Little Stanhope Street May Fair in the aforesaid Parish of Saint George for sevl. Years at the Yearly Rent of Thirty Four Pounds & paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about Three Years ago since which time he hath gained no other Settlement either Renting House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a Year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever.

Mary Jones Aged about Twenty Two Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Calvert a Staple keeper in Theobalds Row in the Parish of Saint George the Martyr Queen Square in the County of Middlesex for Two Years and an half at the Yearly Wages of 8 Guineas hath quitted her said Service about Two Months ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlmt. And further says she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in the House of Mrs. Brassatt in Portugal Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes which hath since been baptized by the name of James and is become Chargable to the same and that one Thos. Rawlins late a Cookman to one Mrs. Benham who lodged in Red Lyon Square is the Father thereof what is become of him she does not know otherwise than she has been informe that he went of for Portsmouth

Mary Clear lived about 41 Years on her Oath says she Intermarried to Edward Clear her late Husband linasor at the parish Church of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . about 17 Years ago and by whom she hath Two Children now living Namely by Edward Aged about 10 Years and Mary Aged about Eight Years says her said late Husband served seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Githama Glazier in Middlex Row in the Parish of Brompton in the County of Kent and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House or tenement of 10 P Ann paid Taxes or did any other Act Whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Tomlin Aged forty two Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented house or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Messrs. Fonseager & Fernandes Tobacconists in Bevis Marks in the Parish of all hallows London wall upwards of one Year at the Yearly Wages of 7th- hath quitted her said service about three Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting house paying Taxes or Living a hired Servant for one Year.

Sarah Preston aged about Twenty One Years on her Oath says she never was married rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Blount Shoe- -warehouse in Bridge Street in the Parish of Saint Mary Lambeth in the County of Surrey upwards One Year at the Yearly Wages of £3. hath gained quitted her said Service about twelve Months since which time she hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Servant for One Year

Martha Cornish aged about Fifty Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of John Cornish who has deserted & with whom she intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Mary le Strand in the Year 1766 and by whom she hath no Child or Children living Says her said Husband rented and lived in a House in Bridgewater Square in the parish of St. Giles Cripplegate London for 9 Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Ten Guineas and paid Parish Taxes due for the same Hath quitted said House about sev Years ago since which time her said Husband hath gained no other subsequent Settlement either by renting House paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever.

Francis Lissner Aged about Thirty Eight Years on behalf of Samuel Winspear (who now lies ill of a Fever) on his Oath Says that the said Samuel Winspear this Examinants Journeyman served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. French a Glass Cutter in Shoe Lane in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn London and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any other Settlement either by renting House paying Taxes or living a hired yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Beckett aged about 33 Years on her Oath says she never was married rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Lady Barrymore in Postman Square in the parish of St. Mary le Bone in the County of Middlesex a Year and Nine Month at the Yearly Wages of Twelve pounds, hath quitted said Service about three Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Servant for One Year.

John Graves Aged about 50 Years on his Oath says Intermarried to Catherine Graves his now Wife at the Pari Church of St. Clement Danes about Eight Years ago by Whom he hath no Child or Children living Says befo his Inter marriage with his said Wife and whilst he was a Singleman he lived a hired Yearly With one M Evans a Tallow Chandler in parkers lane in the Parish St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middx for 3 Years at the Yearly Wages of £4. hath quitted his said Service about Twenty Years ago since which time he hath gained no Other Settlement either by Renting House paying Tax or Otherwise howsoever

Elizabeth Browne otherwise Wingfield aged about 55 Years on her Oath Says she intermarried with one John Wingfield an Irishman (who was a Dealer in Fish and Poultry ) in the Sardinian Ambassador's Chappel in Duke Street Lincoln's Inn fields by a nomish Priest which Marriage is of no Effect by the Laws of this Country as Examinant is informed and believes And further Says that before such her Intermarriage with the said John Wingfield and whilst she was a Singlewoman she served four Years Apprenticeship to the Mantua making Business wth. Mrs. Bird in South sea Court in the Mint in the Parish of Saint George in the Borough in the County of Lesney since which time she hath gained no other Settlement either by renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for One Year.

Jane Skillen Aged about Twenty Six Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Charles Piggot Esqr . in South Audley Street in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex for Two Years and an half at the Yearly Wages of Ten Guineas hath quitted her said Service upwards of Ten Months ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House Paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Mary Ann Heath Aged about Eighteen Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Lady Keith in German Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster Upwards of Twelve Months at the Yearly Wages of Six pounds six Shillings hath Quitted her said Service about Eight Months ago since Which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement

Penelope Stokes Aged about 30 Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes was an Apprentice or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says her Father John Stokes Rented and lived in a Heyse in Bush Lane Cannon Street in the Parish of St. Swithens in the City of London for Several Years at the Yearly Rent of Forty pounds and upwards a Year & paid Parish Taxes due for the same and lived thereinto the time of his Death which is about Two and Twenty Years ago since which time this Examinant never gained any other Settlement

Grace Bennett aged about 38 Years on her Oath she Intermarried to her late Husband James Benn at the Parish Church of St. Sepulchre London about Eighteen Years ago & by Whom she hath Two Children living Namely Mary Aged about fourteen & James aged about Seven Says her said late Husband was bound an Apprentice to his Brother Robt. Bennett Citizen & Gunmaker in the Parish of a Saint Botolph Aldgate London and Served his said Brother for the space of One Year or thereabouts and was a P Assigned over to one John Loden Citizen & Gunsmith of Preston Yard in the Minories in the aforesaid Parish of a Botolph Aldgate London & Served the said Loder the remaining part of his Said Apprenticeship and after he was out of his said apprenticeship never gained any other Settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of £10 a Year or Otherwise howsoever

Elizth. Henley Aged about Thirty Two Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House was an Apprentice or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year Say her Father Rented and lived in a House in Justice Walk in the Parish of Saint Luke Chelsea in the County of Middlesex in which Parish this Examinant was born and further says she was passed from St. Andrew Holbourn upon the Parish of St. Luke Chelsea afsd. where her said Settlement was found to be upon an Appeal at the Quarter Sessions since which time she hath gained no other Settlement

Mary Reading Aged about Sixty four Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried with Samuel Reading at the Savoy Chapel about Eleven Years ago and who died in the Year 1773 Says her said Late Husband was an Irishman and never gained any Settlement in England to her knowledge or belief Says she Intermarried to a former Husband John Fuller a Cooper and who served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Shaw a Cooper in Little Trinity Lane in the Parish of Saint Mildred Bread Street in the City of London and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any other Settlement either by Renting House or Tenemt. of Ten pounds a Year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever neither hath this Examinant Since her said Husbands death.

Sarah Scarsbrook Aged about Thirty Seven Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried with Richard Scarsbrook her late Husband deceased at the Parish Church of St. Martin in the Fields about Eleven Years ago and by whom she hath no Child or Children living Says her said late Husband never Rented House paid Taxes was ever bound an Apprentice or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year before Marriage Says her said late Husband has often Informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true that his Father Richard Scarsbrook Rented & lived in a House in Charles Court Hungerford Markett in the sd Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields for several Years at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds hath Quitted said House above Twenty Years ago since which time her sd late Husband never gained any or Subsequent Settlement than as aforesaid neither hath this Examinant since her sd Husbands Death

Presley Lock Aged about forty Seven Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Jane his Wife (gone from him) at the City of Norwich abo about Twenty Two Years ago and by whom He ha no Child or Children living Says he Rented and lived in a House in Cow Cross in the Parish of St. Sepulchre without in the County of Middlesex upwards of Six Months at the Yearly Rent of Ten pounds and paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about Ten Years ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of Ten pounds a Year or otherwise howsoever.

Elizth. Mercy aged about Fifty Two Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Philip Mercy with who she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Martin the Fields about thirteen Years ago and who died about S Years ago and by whom she hath no Child or Children living Say her said late Husband Rented House in the Strand the sd Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields for several Years at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds & paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about Two Years ago and after quitting the same he never Rented Ho or Tenement of Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or other gained any other Subsequent Settlement either hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death

Mary Short aged about Nineteen Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Palmer at the Sign of the Castle in Castle Street in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex for Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Twelve Months ago since which time she hath never lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizth. Hughes Aged about Thirty five Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried to John Hughes (who hath deserted her at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holbourn about Nine Years ago and by whom she hath no Child or Children living Says her said Husband before his Intermarriage to this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr Crofts in James Street Bedford Row in the said Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn in the County of Middlesex and after quitting the said Mr. Crofts's Service he never Rented House paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlemt

Sarah Fletcher Aged about Thirty Eight Years on her Oath Says she never was Married or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says she Rented and lived in a House in Woodstock Street near High Street in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex for Seven Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Twenty four pounds and paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about four Years ago since which time she never gained any other Settlement other by Renting House Tenement or Lodgings of Ten Pounds a Year or otherwise howsoever

Jno. Haynes Aged about 33 Years on his Oath says he never was married Rented House or payed Taxes Says he served Seven Years Apprenticeship with One Henry Lewis a Printer in Salisbury Street Strand in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster & County of Middlesex and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any Other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly servant for One Year.

Jane Burton Aged about Sixty Two Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of Alexander Burt who who died about Six Weeks ago and by whom she hath one Child named Thomas now provided for Says her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in Sugar Loaf Court Salisbury Court in the Parish of Saint Bride otherwise of Bridget in the City of London upwards of Three Years at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds hath quitted said House about Ten Years ago since which time he said Husband never Rented House or Tenement of Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or otherwise how soever neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death

Elizabeth Gray Aged about Fifty Two Years on her Oath says she Intermarried to her late Husband Arthur Gray at the Parish Church of Elderton in the County of Northumberland about Twenty five Years ago and who died about fourteen years ago and by whom she hath no Child or Children livings Says that being a Widow and without Child or Children she went and lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Strang an Ingraver in Castle Street Leicester Square in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster & County of Middlesex for Eighteen Months at the Yearly Wages of Eight Guineas hath quitted her said Service about Ten Years ago and after quitting her said Service she never gained any other subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Sarah Nicholls aged about 41 Years on her Oath says she is the wife of Thos. Nichols gone from her with whom she Inter- -married at Spittle Fields Church about 21 Years ago & by whom she hath 3 Children all of whom are now provided for say's her said Husband Rented & lived in a House Known by the Sign of the Angel in Goswell Street in the Parish of St. Luke Old Street in the County of Middx for Twelve Months at the yearly Rent of £18. and paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about 14 Years ago and after quitting the same he never gained anyother Subsequent Settlement to her Knowledge or Belief

Jane Perry Aged about 50 Years on her Oath say's she is the Widow of John Perry who died in the Year 1762 and by whom she hath no Child or Children living say's that being a Widow & without Child or Children living she lived as a hired yearly servant with Mr. George Scrivener a Butcher in Portsmouth Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middx for 8 Years & upwards at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted her said service upwards of 4 Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly servant for one year

Elizth. Hopwood Aged about 13 years on her Oath says she is the Daughter of James Hopwood who is now at Sea says her said Father Rented & lived in a House in Wells Street Oxford Road in the Parish of St. Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex for Two years or thereabouts at the yearly Rent of £30. hath quitted said House upwards of one year & after quitting same he never gained any other Settlement neither hath this Examinant since her said Father quitted the same either by being bound on true Apprentice or living a hired yearly Servant for one Year

Heny. Wharton aged about 43 years on his Oath says's he Intermarried to Susannah his wife at the Parish Church of Saint James Clerkenwell upwards of 18 Years ago and by whom he hath three Children now living two of whom are now provided for & one unprovided for namely Thomas aged about 12 years says before his Intermarriage with the said wife and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Boston who kept the si of the swan in Shoe Lane in the Parish of St. Andrew Holb London for 4 years at the yearly wages of five Pounds be Board washing & Lodging hath quitted his said service about Thirty years ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement either by Renting House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a year paying Taxes or other howsoever

Hannah Twydell aged about 38 years on behalf of Sarah Singer an Infant aged upwards of 5 years whose Mother is Dead and her Father William Singer is run away Says the said Wm. Singer Rented & lived in a House in White Hart Court in the Broad Way Westmr . in the Parish of Saint Margaret Westmr . for Sevl. Years at the Yearly Rent of £10 and upwards and paid Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about Three Years ago and hath not since he quitted the the same ever Rented House or Tenemt. of £10 a Year paid Taxes or ever gained any other Subsequent Settlement.

Elizth. Bearley Aged about 47 Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried with Robt. Bearley her late Husband deceased at the Parish Church of St. Clement Danes about 14 Years ago and by whom she hath O Child named Letitia aged about Ten Years Says her sd. late Husband Rented & Lived in a House in Little Catherine Street late Called Eagle Court Strand in the Parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . for 9 Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of £10. hath quitted said House about 3 Years ago and after quitting same he never Rented House Tenement or Lodging of £10. a year paid Taxes or ever gained any other Subsequent Settlement.

Susannah Leister Aged about 40 Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Richd. Leister with whom sh Intermarried at the Parish of St. Michael Basinghall alias Bassishaw London about 15 years ago and by whom she hath no Child or Children living Says said late Husband before his Intermarr with this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Thos: Palmer a Broker in Broad Street in the Parish of St. Bene Vulgarly St. Bennett Fink London upwards of one year at the Yearly Wages of Ten Pounds or upwards and after quitting his said service he never Rented House Tenemt. or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year or ever gained any other Subsequent Settlement neeth hath this Examinant since her sd. Husbands Death other than by living as a hired yearly Servant with one Ede Carty a Lodger at Mr. Townsends a Packer in Broad Street in the afsd. Parish of St. Benedict for 13 Months at the Yearly Wages of 12 Guineas hath quitted her said Service about 14 Months ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlemt.

John Barker aged about fifty Eight Years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Violett his wife at the Parish Church of St. Giles in the Fields about 23 years ago and by whom he hath One Child now provided for And this Examinant further Says that he Rented and lived in a House in Exeter Street in the Parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westmr . for One year & an half at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Three Pounds & paid Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about Seven Years ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settemt. either by Renting House Tenement or Lodgings of £10 a year or otherwise Howsoever.

John Cooper aged about 39 Years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Ann his Wife at the Parish Church of St. Geo: the Martyr Queen Square about Nine Years ago and by whom he has Two Children now living Namely John aged about 12 Years born a Bastard in the Parish of Saint Giles and Saml . Aged about Seven Years Says his Father Wm. Cooper Served Seven Years Apprenticeship to One John Dorrill a Taylor in Feather Court Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Mary Le Strand in the Liberty of Westmr . and after he was out of his Apprenticeship he never gained any other Subsequent Settlemt. as his Mother Ann Cooper has lately Inform him and with Information he verily believes to be And this Examinant further Says that he never gained anyother Settlemt. than as aforementioned having never Rented House or Tenemt. or Lodging of £10. a Year service any Apprenticeship or ever lived a hired yearly Servant before Marriage for One Year

Mary Ann Maddox Aged about 29 years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Penny an Apothecary in Lamb Conduit Street in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for One year at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds hath Quitted her said Service about Seven years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever lived a hired yearly Servant for one year or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement And further says that she has One Child Named John William Aged about 11 Months Born a Bastard in the House of Mr. Marshall at the Coach & Horses in Bear Yard in the Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the said County of Middlesex

Henry Croasdell one of the Beadles of the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the said County of Mid on behalf of Lewis Brooks an Infant Aged about 12 years On his Oath says that the sd. Lewis Brooks was bound an Apprentice to One John Leeson of the Parish of Hammer smith in the County of Middlesex Fisherman by Indenture bearing Date the 27th. day of Decr. 1781 by the Church and Overseers of the Poor of the sd. Parish of St. Clement Danes as by a Duplicate of the sd. Indenture appears and that the sd. Lewis Brooks has ever since served his sd. Master in the sd. Parish of Hammersmith to the time of his being Discharged by the Justices as this Examinant has been Informed and verily believes.

Jane Morris Aged about 55 Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a Hired yearly Servt . with one Mr. Bulla in Thrift Street in the Parish of St. Ann Soho in the Liberty of Westmr . for 3 Years at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said service upwards of 12 Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever lived a Hired Yearly Servt. for One Year or other gained any other Settlemt.

Wm. Bradbury aged about 54 years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Jane his Wife at the Fleet London about 37 years ago and by whom he hath 2 Children living now provided for Says before his Intermarriage with his said Wife & whilst he was a Singleman he lived a Hired Yearly Servant with One Mr. Smith a Master Carman & where this Examinant was born in Broad St . Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex for one year at the yearly Wages of Two Pounds hath quitted his said service upwards of 40 years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10. a year paid Taxes or ever gained any other Subsequent Settlemt.

Saml Dew Aged about 33 years on his Oath says he Intermarried to his Wife Martha Dew at the Parish Church of St. Andrew Holbourn about 10 years ago and by whom he hath 4 Childn. now living Namely Ann Aged upwards of 8 year Saml . Aged about 7 years Martha Aged about 2 years and another Child not yet Christened Aged about 16 Days Says before his Intermarrd. to his sd. Wife and whilst he was Singleman he served seven years Apprenticeship with One Saml. Foskett a Leather Dresser the latter Part of who sd. Apprenticeship he served his sd. Master in Bell Sava Yard in the Parish of St. Bride otherwise Bridgett London and after he was out of his sd. Apprenticeship he never gained any other Subsequent Settlemt. either by Renting House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10 a year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever.

Elizth. Duckworth Aged upwards of 19 Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House paid Taxes or ever lived a hired yearly Servant for One year Says she went to live wth. one Mr. Baxton a Musician in the Parish of St. Clement Danes and was to have 6d. P Week & afterwards her said Master Agreed to give her after the Rate of 1s..6d. P Week but never was hired by the year or did she ever live under at her Agreemt. for One year or in any other place whatever Says her Father Richd. Duckworth Rented & lived in a House in fore Street Limehouse Corner in the Parish of Limehouse in the County of Middlesex for sevl. Years at the yearly Rent of £10. upwards and pd. Parish Taxes for the same hath quitted said House about Nine Years ago and after the quitting the same He never Rented House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10. a year paid Taxes or ever gained any other Settlemt. than as aforesaid.

Elizth. Wimbolt Aged about 23 Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House was an Apprentice or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says her late Father & Mother John & Mary Wimbolt died soon after this Examinant was born and that her sd. late Father who was a Notary Public lived in a House the next Door to the Golden Key in Tenter Alley Little, Moor Fields in the Parish of St Giles Cripplegate without London where this Examinant was born as her late Uncle Thos. Fountain has often Informed her and whch. Information she verily believes to be true and give no further other Acct. of either her Father or this Examinant Settlemt. than as above set forth And this Examinant further Says that her sd. late Uncle has often Informed her that the sd. Parish of St. Giles Cripplegate was this Examinants Parish & that her sd. late Uncle frequently Acquainted her that he went Apply to the Parish Officers to get her in to the Poor House belonging to that Parish And this Examinant lastly says that she has a Male Bastard Child born on her Body in Shire Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes and that the father thereof is in Goal for Debt.

Elizth. Whetstone Aged about 27 Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived as a Hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Kipling who Keys a Boarding School in Chaple Street Bedford Row in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn above the Bars in the County of Middx upwards of four Years at the yearly Wages of 4 Pounds hath quitted her said service upwards of 3 Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlemt. either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says she hath a Child by one Fras. Dyer named Elizth . Aged about 18 Months born a Bastard in Grays Inn Lane in the sd. Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn in the sd. County of Middx who hath gained no other Settlemt. than by Birth.

Elizth. King Aged about 35 Years on her Oath says She never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a Hired Yearly Servt . with one Wm. Gladman at a Cooks Shop in Barnaby Street in the Parish of St. Olave Southwark in the County of Surry upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her sd. Service about 7 Years ago and after quitting her sd. Service she never gained any other Subsequent Settlemt.

George Allwood Aged about 53 Years on his Oath says he never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says he served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Jam Brad a Staymaker in Mankwell Street in the Parish of St. Olave Silver Street London and after he was one of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement.

Elizth. Goreing Aged about 25 Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servt. with one Mrs. Cheeseman in Richmond Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr . upwards of one Year at the Yearly Wages of £4. hath quitted her sd. Service upwards of Two Years ago since whch. time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement by living as a hired yearly Servt. for one year or otherwise howsoever.

Sarah Ellmoor Aged about 42 Years on her Oath say she Intermarried to her late Husband Thos. Elmoor at the Parish Church of St. Saviours, Southwark about 20 Years ago and by whom she hath no Child or Children living says her said late Husband was bound an Apprentice to one Thos. Burgess a Waterman in Queens Arms Court near Black Fryers Bridge in the Parish of Christ Church Southwark in the County of Surry and served his said Master four years the first Part of his sd. Apprenticeship when his sd. Master gave him up his Indentures & afterwds. went to Sea And further Says that her sd. late Husband never gained any other Settlemt. either by Renting House Tene or Lodging of £10. a year pd. Taxes or otherwise howsoever neither hath this Examinant since her sd. Husbands death

Thos. Chaddock Aged about Fifty Nine Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried to his late Wife Mary at the Parish Church of St. Leonard Shoreditch about Twenty Years ago & who has been dead about 12 Years Says he was bound an Apprentice for Seven Years to Wm Strahan Esqr . A Printer in New Street in the Parish of Saint Bride otherwise Bridgett London and served the sd. Mr Strahan for five Years the first part of his Apprenticeship & afterwards ran away & went to Sea and further Says he never gained any other Settlemt. than as afsd. either by Renting House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10. a year paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one year.

Mary Chapman Aged about about 40 Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or Tenemt. of Ten Pounds a year or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Hughes a Lamp Lighter in Shire Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex for Seventeen Years at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds hath quitted her sd. Service about Eleven years ago & hath not since she quitted the same ever lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year or otherwise gained any other Settlemt.

Mary Taylor aged about 50 years upon her Oath saith that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with a Mr. Hayes of Mary Bone Street Shug Lane in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr for 15 Months at the yearly Wages of £7..10s..0 hath quitted said Service for about Thirteen years ago since which time she hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement

Catherine Patterson aged about 22 years upon her Oath saith that she never was married Rented House or Paid Taxes that she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mrs.. Cole No. 2 George Street Aldgate in the Parish of Saint Botolph Aldgate in the City of London for 17 Months or thereabouts hath quitted said Service about Six Months since which time she hath done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlemt. And further saith that she hath an Illegitimate Child living vizt. Eleanor Cliffen aged upwards of 3 Months born in Storey Street Hospital

Hannah Wilstone Aged about Twenty five years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or Paid Taxes says she lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Haines a Butcher in Rose Street Newgate Markett in the Parish of Christ Church London upwards of one year at the yearly Wages of Six Guineas hath quitted her said Service about Six Months ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement.

Elizth. Dunn aged Sixty Nine Years on her Oath says she Intermarried to her late Husband deceased at May fair Chaple in the year 1751 and by whom she had sevl. Children who are all since dead Says her sd. late Husband served Seven years Apprenticeship to one Mr. Hancock a Bricklayer in Petty France in the Parish of St. Margaret in the Liberty of Westmr. and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House Tenement or Lodgging of £10. a Year Paid Taxes or otherwise howsoever neither hath this Examinant since her sd. Husbands Death

Ann Davies Aged about Twenty Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried to her Husband James Davis at the Parish Church of Saint Ann Soho about four Years ago (and who is now gone to Wales for the benefit of his Health says she has Two Children by her said Husband Namely William Henry Davis Aged about Two Years and Elizth. Ann Aged about five Months Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Princes Street Leicester Fields in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr . for Two Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of fifty Pounds & paid Taxes due for the same hath quitted house about Eighteen Months ago since which time he hath gained no other Settlement whatever.

Elizabeth Bale Aged about Thirty Seven Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried to her late Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Mary Stratford Bow in the County of Middlesex in the Year 1767 and by whom she hath one Child living namely Elizabeth Aged about Seven Years Says her said Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one William Lucas at the White Horse in Bow in the said County of Middlesex for Sixteen Months at the Yearly Wages of Ten pounds hath quitted his said Service upwards of Sixteen Years ago and after he quitted his said Service he never gained any other subsequent Settlemt. either by renting House Tenement or Lodging of Ten pounds a Year paying Taxes or orwise howsoever

Elizth. Donaldson aged about Thirty five Years on her Oath says she Intermarried to her Husband James Donaldson (gone from her) at the Parish Church of St. Martin in the fields about Nine Years ago and by whom she hath Two Children living Namely Margt . aged about Nine years and Elizth . aged about five Years Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Hungerford Markett in the sd. Parish of St. Martin in the fields upwards of Two years at the yearly Rent of Eleven Pounds hath quitted sd: House upwards of Three Yrs. ago since which time he hath gained no other Settlemt.

Thos. Clarke Aged about 38 Years on his Oath says he never was Married Rented House or pd. Taxes Says he was bounds out an Apprentice and served upwards of five Years the first Part of his Apprenticeship with one Edwd. Bailey a Stocking frame Knitter in Swan Yard in the Parish of St. Mary Le Strand in the Liberty of Westmr . And his Master Using this Examinant very Ill was by Order of Two Justices discharged from his said Masters Service after Which he never gained any other Settlemt. either by Renting House or Tenemt. of £10. a year Paying Taxes or living a hired yearly Servant for one Year.

Wm. Bradbury aged about 54 Years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Jane his Wife at the Fleet London about 37 Years ago and by whom he hath 2 Children living now Provided for Says before his Intermarriage with his said Wife & whilst he was a Singleman he lived a hired Yearly Servant with One Mr. Smith a Master Carman & where this Examinant was Born in Broad Way St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex for One year at the yearly Wages of Two Pounds hath quitted his said Service upwards of 40 Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10. a Year pd. Taxes or ever gained any other Subsequent Settlement.

Martha Clarke Aged about Seventy Seven Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of George Clarke with whom she Intermarried at the Town of Northampton about 50 years ago and who has been dead about 40 Years Says her said Husband Rented & lived in a House called or known by the name of Sign of the Warwick Castle near the Palatine Houses Stoke Newington in the Parish of Hornsey in the County of Middlesex about 3 Years at the Yearly Rent of £12. hath quitted house upwards of 40 years ago and after quitting same he never Rented House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10 a year or ever gained any other Subsequent Settlemt. neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death.

Margarett Bulmer Aged about Sixty years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired yearly Servant with one John Henley Esqr . in King Street Bloomsbury Square in the Parish of St. George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex upwds. of one year at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said Service about 4 Months ago since which time she hath gained no other Settlement.

Rachael Jones aged about Forty Two Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Omell a Musician in King Street Soho in the Parish of St. Anns in the Liberty of Westmr . for Eighteen Months at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Sixteen Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement.

Martha Robinson Aged about Forty five years on her Oath Says she Intermarried to Omer Robinson her late Husband deceased at the Parish Church of St. Anns Limehouse in the County of Middx in the year 1767 and by whom she hath no Child or Children living Says her said late Husband never Rented House Tenemt. or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year Paid Taxes served any Apprenticeship or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Husbands Father Rented a Small House at Mitcham in the County of Surry where this Examinants Husband was Born as her sd. late Husbands has often Informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true & can give no further or other Account thereof than as aforesaid.

Mary Whitaker Aged about Sixty Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Whitehead at a Jelly Shop the Corner of Bridges Street Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westmr . & County afsd. for 3 years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of 5 Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Thirteen years ago since which time she hath gained no other Settlemt. either by Renting House Paying Taxes or living a hired yearly Servt. for One year.

Mary Gosling about Sixty years on her Oath says she Intermarried to Joseph Gosling her late Husband deceased at the Parish Church of St. Andrew Holborn about Thirty four years ago and by whom she hath no Child or Children living Says her said late Husband before his Intermarriage to this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman He lived a hired yearly Servant with one Edward Vernon Doctor in Divinity in Bloomsbury Church Yard in the, Parish of St. George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex upwards of Two Years before this Examinant Intermarrd to her late Husband & Two Years afterwards at the Yearly Wages of Nine Pounds and Quitted his said Service upwards of 26 years ago and after quitting his said Service he never gained any or. Settlement either by Renting House or Tenemt. of Ten Pounds a year paying Taxes or orwise howsoever neither hath this Examinant since her sd. Husbands Death.

John Pritchard Aged about Sixty Eight years on Behalf of Ann Hart his Grand Daughter who is now raven Mad on his Oath says that his said Grand Daughter Intermarried to her Present Husband Patrick Hart about Seven years ago who is now down at the Nore as he believes Says that the said Patrick Hart Rented and lived in a House in Fleet Lane in the Parish of St. Sepulchre London for Three years or thereabouts at the yearly Rent of Twelve Guineas & Paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about four years ago since which time he never gained any other Settlement otherwise than as aforesaid

Elizabeth Pratt Aged about Twenty Three years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Mitchell in Salisbury Street in the Parish of St. Martins in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of 15 Months at the yearly Wages of £5. since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement Says that her said Mistress removed into Carey Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes with whom this Examinant has lived One Month & five days which this Examinant is Informed and verily believes she has gained no Settlement thereby.

Martha Penny Aged about Forty one Years on her Oath says she Intermarried with James Penny (gone from her) at the Parish Church of St. Martins in the fields about 15 Years ago and by whom she hath Six Children now living namely Fras . Aged about 14 Years John Aged about 12 years (out on liking) Hugh Aged about 11 Years Mary about Six years Richard Aged about 4 years and James aged upwards of One year Says her said Husband Rented & lived in a House in Alesbury Street Clerkenwell Green in the Parish of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex upwards of Two Years at the yearly Rent of £20 & paid Taxes due for the Same hath quitted said House about Three Years ago since which time he never Rented House Tenemt. or Lodgings of £10. a year for 40 Days or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement.

Martha Robinson Aged about Forty five years on her Oath says she Intermarried to Owen Robinson her late Husband deceased at the Parish Church of St. Anns Limehouse in the County of Middx in the year 1767 and by whom she hath no Child or Children living Says her said late Husband never Rented House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year Paid Taxes served any Apprenticeship or ever lived a hired yearly Servant for One year Says her Husbands Father Rented a Small House at Mitcham in the County of Surry where this Examinants Husband was Born as her said late Husband has often Informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true & can give no further or other Account thereof than as aforesid And this Examinant further saith that on this Examinants being passed by the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex on the Parish of Mitcham in the County of Surry the Parish of Mitcham Appealed to the then next Genl. Qr. Sessions of the Peace for the County of Middx where it was Proved that Wm. Robinson the Father of this Examinants Husband Owen Robinson was a Certificated Man from the Parish of Fulmer in the County of Sussex to the Parish of Mitcham in the said County of Surry as by a Certificate bearing Date the 14th. day of May 1737 may more fully Appear The Original of which is now in the Hands of the Parish Officers of Mitcham in the said County of Surry.

George Mills aged about forty three years on his Oath Says he Intermarried to Elizth . his Wife at the Parish Church of St. Clement Danes in the year 1773 And by whom he hath no Child or Children living Says he has been married Twice But before he Intermarried to either of his Wives and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired yearly Servant with one James Duff at the Angel & Crown the Corner of New Street St. Martins Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . upwards of Two years at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted his said Service upwards of 28 Yrs. ago and after quitting his said Service he never gained any other Settlement either by Renting House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10 a year or otherwise howsoever

Jane James Aged about 38 Years on her Oath says she Intermarried to her late Husband deceased at the Parish Church of St. Margaretts Westmr . about 12 years ago and by whom she hath one Child living namely Jane aged about 10 years now in the Workhouse belonging to St. Pauls Covent Garden Says her said late Husband before his Intermarriage to this Examinant & whilst he was a Singleman he lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Butley a fruiterer in Covent Garden in the Parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster for two years & upwards at the yearly Wages of £16. a year or thereabouts and after quitting his said Servant he never gained any or. Settlement neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death.

James Talboy one of the Beadles of the Parish of St. Clement Danes on behalf of William Maddan an Infant Aged upwards of 3 years on his Oath Says that he has been credibly Informed and verily believes and Doubts not prove that the said Wm. Maddan was born a Bastard on the Body of Eleanor Maddan Singlewoman in the House of Mr. Mainwaring in Phillip Lane in the Parish of St. Alphage in the City of London And further says that the said Eleanor Maddan was removed by a Vagrant Pass from the aforesaid Parish of St. Alphage And that the said Eleanor Maddan has deserted her said Child and is now Committed to Bridewell as a Vagrant on that Account.

Elizabeth Morewood Aged about forty Six Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or Tenement of Ten pounds a Year or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with on Mr. Hicklin a Silkman in Bread Street in the Parish of Allhallows Bread Street London upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Six Guineas hath quitted her said Service about Ten Years ago since which time she hath never lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year or ever gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Mary Longmore Aged about Sixty Eight years on her Oath says she Intermarried with her late Husband deceased at the fleet London upwards of 50 years ago and by whom she hath no Child or Children living Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Tash Street Grays Inn Lane in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for Six Months at the yearly Rent of £12 and quitted same upwards of 30 years ago and after quitting said House he never Rented House Tenemt. or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year or ever gained any or. Settlemt. than as aforesaid neither hath this Examinant since her sd. Husbands Death.

Richd. Lewis Aged about Twenty two years on his Oath says he never was married Rented House or paid Taxes or ever served any Apprenticeship Says he lived a hired yearly Servt . with one. Mr. Rock an Apothecary in Hatton Street in the Liberty of Saffron Hill Hatton Garden in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn for one year & upwards at the yearly Wages of Eight Guineas besides Diet Lodging & Cloaths hath quitted his said Service upwards of Twelve Months ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement

Lewis James aged about Fifty years on behalf of of Thos. James his Son an Infant aged about fourteen years on his Oath says that his said Son never gained any other Settlemt. than through this Examinants Renting and living in a House in Bedford Court Catherine Street in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . for sevl. years at the yearly Rent of Ten Pounds hath quitted said House about Ten years ago since which time he hath never Rented House Tenemt. or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or done any other Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlemt.

Catherine Williams Aged about 55 years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Saml. Bonnington a Grocer in Little Britain in the Parish of Saint Botolph without Aldersgate London upwards of five years at the Yearly Wages of £5. hath quitted her said Service upwards of Twenty years ago since which time she hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or living a hired yearly Servant for one year.

Thos. Silvester aged about Forty Eight years on his Oath says he never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says he served seven Years Apprenticeship with one Thos. Lincon a Spectacle maker in Little Britain in the Parish of St. Bartholomew the less and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement than as aforesaid.

Henry Croasdell One of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes (on behalf of Mary Harwood Singlewoman a Lunatic Aged about Thirty Years) on his Oath Says that on strict Inquiry into the Settlement of the said Mary Harwood was Informed by Mrs. Richardson her late Misstrss that the said Mary Harwood lived a hired Yearly servant with her upwards of fifteen Months at the Yearly Wages Seven Pounds Vizt. the first Twelve Months in the Parish of Saint Dunstan in the West London and the last Three Months in the Parish of Saint Leonard Shoreditch in the County of Middlesex where she quitted her said Service about Six Months ago and that she hath gained no other Settlement since quitting her said Service all which Information this Examinant verily believes to be true

Catherine Snelling Aged about Thirty Three Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of John Snelling with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Hackney in the County of Middlesex in the Year 1766 and by whom she hath four Children living Namely Ann Aged about fifteen Years now provided for Susannah Aged about Ten Years James Aged about Eight Years and Elizabeth Aged about four Years Says her said late Husband before his Intermarriage to this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one John Winter a Coach Master in the Parish of Ealing in the County of Middlesex for several Years at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds as she believes and after quitting his said Masters Service he never Rented House Tenement or Lodging of Ten pounds a Year or ever gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Edmund Kempster Aged about fifty Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried to Susannah his now Wife at the Parish Church of St. Sepulchre London about Thirty Two Years ago and by whom he hath no Child or Children living Says he Rented and lived in a House late Called Princess Amelia Court near Duke Street Marylebone in the Parish of St. Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Rent of Eleven Pounds hath quitted said House about Nine Years ago since which time he hath never Rented House Tenement or Lodgings of Ten pounds a Year or ever gained any other Subsequent Settlement.

George Shearwin Aged about Thirty Seven Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried to Jane his now Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes about Twelve Years ago and by whom he hath Two Children now living namely Jane Aged about five Years and Rose Ann aged about Seven Weeks says he Rented and lived in a House in Bedford Bury in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Field in the Liberty of Westmr . upwards of One Year at the Yearly Rent of £20 and paid Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about Six Years ago and after quitting said House he rented Different apartments in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields of the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds but after quitting the said Parish he never Rented House Tenement or Lodgings of Ten pounds a Year or otherwise gained any other Settlement than as before set forth.

Mary Lock Aged about 26 Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes ever lived a hired yearly Servant for one year or ever served any Apprenticeship says her Father Rented & lived in a House in King Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. upwards of one year at the yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and paid Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about 20 years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlemt.

Phebe Evans Aged about Twenty two years on her Oath says she Intermarried to her Husband Richd. Evans (gone from her) at the Parish Church of St. Leonard Shoreditch in the year 1779 and by whom she hath one Child living namely Richard Aged about two years says her said Husband served four years & a half part of his Apprenticeship to one Mr. Pain a Shoemaker in Paradise Street Rotherhithe in the Parish of St. Mary Rotherhithe in the County of Surry and was never Assigned over to any or. Person but believes he run away from his said Master nor did he ever gain any or. Settlemt. either by Renting House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10 a year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Mary Hawley Aged about Thirty Eight years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes or ever lived a hired yearly Servant for one year Says her Father Caleb Hawley served seven years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Hollister a Taylor in Serle Street in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster & after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any or. Subsequent Settlement And further says that she hath one Child living named Ann Aged upwards of Eight years born a Bastard in the House of one Mr. Hayton a Chandler in Smarts Buildings Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex and whose Father went a Broad as a Marine and is since dead as she believes And further says that her said Child never gained any or. Settlement than by Birth

Martha Lloyd Aged about Twenty five Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House paid Taxes or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says she was bound out an Apprentice by the Governors & Guardians of the Foundling Hospital to One Richard Brandass a Gold and Silver Trimming maker in Mays Buildings Saint Martins Lane in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster untill this Examinant shod. Attain the Age of 21 Years or Day of Marriage That she served her full Apprenticeship and after serving her said Apprenticeship she never gained any other Settlement than as abovementioned.

Margarett Ounsworth aged about Fifty four years on her Oath Says she is the Daughter of Henry Hounsworth who was by Trade a Shoemaker and that her said Father served One years Apprenticeship to one Richd. Richardson of the Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex as by an Indenture amongst her said Father Papers after the Decease of her Mother Frances Ounsworth may more fully Appear And further says that her said Father after serving his said Apprenticeship never Rented House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or ever gained any other Subsequent Settlement neither did her said late Mother after the Decease of her said Father And lastly this Examinant says she never gained any Settlement either by being Married Served any Apprenticeship Renting House Tenement or Lodging or living a hired yearly Servant for one year

Elizth. Davis Aged about fifty Nine years on her Oath says she Intermarried to her late Husband Richd. Davis at the Parish Church of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex about twelve years ago and who died about two years ago and by whom she hath no Child or Children living says her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House facing the Adelphi in the Strand in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr for four years or thereabouts at the yearly Rent of fifty Pounds & Paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about four years ago and after quitting said House he never gained any other Settlement neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death

Mary Davis aged about Sixty one years on her Oath says she never was married says she Rented and lived in a House in Northumberland Passage in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . & County of Middlesex for two years at the yearly Rent of twenty Pounds & paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House upwards of Eighteen Months ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement

Ann Loyd Aged about Twenty five years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a Hired yearly Servant with Mr. Webb a Comedian in Bedford Street Covent Garden in the Parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westmr . upwards of twenty Months at the yearly Wages of five Guineas hath quitted her said Service in March last since which time she hath gained no other Settlement by living a hired yearly Servant for one year or otherwise housoever

Peter Drew Aged about Twenty One Years on his Oath Says he never was married Rented House paid Taxes served any Apprenticeship or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says his Father Joseph Drew Rented and lived in a House Called or Known by the Name or Sign of the Crown & Mitre Public House in Little Russell Street in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex upwards of Three Months at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds hath quitted said House about five Years ago since which time his said Father hath never gained any other subsequent Settlement either by Renting House Tenement or Lodging of Ten pounds a Year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever.

Susannah Lewis Aged about Sixty one years on her Oath says she Intermarried to Danl. Lewis her late Husband deceased at May fair Chapple about 35 years ago And by whom she hath four Children being all of whom are now Provided for Says her said Husband rented and hired in a House in Hart Street Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westmr . for sevl. years at the yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and upwards hath quitted said House upwards of Thirty years ago and after quitting the same He never gained any other Settlemt. either by Renting House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10. a year Paying Taxes or or.wise howsoever neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death

John Goff aged about Twenty Six years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Hannah his Wife (gone from him) at the Parish Church of St. St. Clement Danes about three years ago and by whom he hath one Child living namely John aged about two years Says he was bound an Apprentice by the Churchwardens & Overseers of the Parish of St. Luke Old Street in the said County of Middlesex to one John Johnstone a Hair Merchant No. 14 St. Johns Lane in the Parish of St. James Clerkenwell in the sd. County of Middlesex & served his said Master under such Indre upwards of three years And untill his said Master Run away And further says he never gained any or. Subsequent Settlemt. either by Renting House Tenemt. or Lodgings of Ten Pounds a year or otherwise howsoever

James Sanders Aged about Twenty one years on his Oath says he never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says he lived a hired yearly Servant with one Andrew Rooke who lately kept the Golden Cross in Cross Lane Long Acre in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . for two years at the yearly Wages of fifty two Shillings besides Diet and Lodging hath quitted said Service upwards of Six years ago since which time he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement by living as a hired yearly Servant for one year

Elizth. Williams aged about Thirty Eight years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired yearly Servant with one John Hawkins a Linnen Draper at Pimlico in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westmr . & County of Middx for three years at the yearly Wages of Eight Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of seven Years ago since which time she hath gained no other Subsequent Settlemt.

Wm. Slater aged about Fifty five years on his Oath says he has an Illegitimate Child living by one Martha Lawrence lately deceased named Catherine Aged upwards of five years born a Bastard in Long Lane in the Parish of Saint Bartholomew the Great London and that she has gained no or. Settlement than by Birth

Gloud Groves aged about Fifty Eight years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Mary his late Wife deceased at the Parish Church of St. Martin in the fields about Twenty years ago & who died about five Months ago and by whom he hath one Child or Children living Says he Rented & lived in a House in Falwoods Rents in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for 18 Months at the yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds hath quitted said House upwards of Sixteen years ago since which time he hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement by Renting House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10. a year paid Taxes or or.wise howsoever

Wm. Griffiths Aged about Sixty two years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Margarett his Wife at the Parish Church of St. Margarett Moses Bread House Street in the year 1766 and by whom he hath no Child or Children living Says he Rented & lived in a House in King Street in the Parish of St. Geo: Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex for Six Months at the yearly Rent of £40. hath quitted said House upwards of 15 years ago since which time he hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10. a year Paying Taxes or or.wise howsoever

Sarah Cooper aged about Twenty eight years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Cambler in Great Russell Street Bloomsbury in the Parish of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex for Six Months Years at the yearly Wages of five pounds hath quitted her said Service about 8 years ago since which time time she hath never lived a hired yearly Servant for one year

George Berkenhead aged about Thirty Seven years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Sarah his Wife at the Parish Church of St. Mary at Cambridge in the year 1774 by whom he hath two Children namely Paul aged Six years & Samuel aged four years Says before his Intermarr. to his said Wife he served seven years Apprenticeship to Wm. Long a Carver & Gilder in Long Acre in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . & after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House Tenement or Lodging of £10. a year Paying Taxes or or.wise howsoever

Elizabeth Hitchcock Aged about Twenty eight years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes or ever lived a hired yearly Servant for one year Says her Father Henry Hitchcock Rented & lived in a House at Rockford in the Parish of Ellingham in the County of Hants for several years at the yearly Rent of Ten Pounds & upwards as she believes & paid Parish Taxes due for the same and lived therein to the Time of his Death which happened about Thirteen years ago since which time this Examinant never gained any or. Settlemt. than as before mentioned

Thomas Phillips Aged about Thirty years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Mary his Wife in the Parish Church of St. Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex about five years ago and by whom he hath no Child or Children living Says he lived a hired yearly Servant with one Edwd. Cotterell a Cowkeeper in the Parish of Hampstea Hampstead in the County of Middlesex for two years at the yearly Wages of £5. hath quitted his said Service upwds. of Seven years ago since which time he hath never Rented House Tenemt. or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or ever lived a hired yearly Servant for one year

Ann Smith Singlewoman aged about forty five years on his Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Barlow a Silk Mercer at the Wheatcheaf in King Street Covent Garden in the Parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westmr . for fourteen months in the Capacity of a Cook at the yearly Wages of twelve Guineas hath quitted her said Service upwards of three years ago since which time she never lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or gained any other Settlement

Richd. Pyner aged about Fifty years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Martha his Wife at the Parish Church of St. Bride London about Sixteen years ago and by whom he hath three Children living one of whom is now Provided for and Two others (vizt.) Samuel aged about Fourteen years & Abraham aged about Seven years Says he Rented & lived in a House in Tooley Street in the Parish of St. Olave Southwark in the County of Surry upwards of one year at the yearly Rent of Ten Pounds hath quitted the said House about Twenty years ago since which time he hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Wm. Spencer aged upwards of Forty four years on his Oath says he Intermarried to his Wife Phoebe (gone from him) at the Parish Church of St. James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex about Twenty years ago and by whom he hath two Children living (Vizt.) James aged about Seventeen years now provided for and Thos . aged about Ten years who never gained any Settlemt. Says he served seven years Apprenticeship with one Thos. Brignall a Butcher in Aldersgate Street in the Parish of St. Botolph without Aldersgate London and after he was out of his sd. Apprentices he never gained any or. Settlement either by Renting House Tenemt. or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year or or.wise howsoever

James Rogers aged about Twenty nine years on his Oath says he never was married Rented House Tenemt. or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year says he lived a hired yearly Servt . with one Mr. Siscotty a Staymaker in Queen Street Golden Square in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr . for 3 years at the yearly of Wages of Ten Pounds hath quitted his sd. Service upwards of three years ago since which time he hath never lived a hired yearly Servant for one year or otherwise gained any other Settlement

Jane Mundin aged about Thirty five years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or Tenemt. of Ten Pounds a year or paid Taxes says she has three Illegitimate Children by one Thos. Smith lately deceased namely George aged upwards of Eight years (now Provided for) Susannah aged about five years and Elizth . aged upwards of three years Says she lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Backhouse a Harpsichord Maker in German Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr . upwards of one year at the yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said Service about 13 years ago since which time she hath never gained any or. Subsequent Settlement

Elizth. Sparks Aged about Twenty years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Little a Taylor in Leadenhall Street in the Parish of St. Catherine Christ Church London for 18 Months at the yearly Wages of £5. hath quitted same about Nine months ago since which time she hath gained no other Settlement.

Eleanor Warden aged about 26 years on her Oath says she is the Widow of John Warden deceased with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . about Nine years ago & who died about 5 years ago as she has been Informed & verily believes and by whom she hath no Child or Children living says that being a Widow & without Child or Children living she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Alcock a Sword Cutter on Ludgate Hill in the Parish of St. Martin Ludgate London upwards of one year at the yearly Wages of 6..10..0 hath quitted her sd. Service upwards of four years ago since which time she hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House paying Taxes or or.wise howsoever.

Lydia Lafortune aged about 56 years on her Oath says she is the Widow of Anthony Lafortune deceased with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . upwards of 24 years ago & who died about 8 years ago & by whom she hath no Child or Children living Says her said late Husband Rented & lived in a House in Fetter Lane in the Parish of St. Dunstan in the West London for two years or thereabouts at the yearly Rent of £30. hath quitted said House about Ten years ago since which time she never gained any or Settlement

Thos.
