Dagnall aged about 50 years on his Oath says he Intermarried with his Wife Margarett at the Parish Church of St. Martin in the fields in the year 1764 and by whom he has two Children living namely Mary Ann Aged about 12 years now Provided for and Sarah Aged about 8 years Says before his Internarriage to his said Wife and whilst he was a Single Man he lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Lea a Corn Chandler in Goswell Street in the Parish of St. Luke Old Street in the County of Middx upwds. of two years at the yearly Wages of £10. besides Diet & Lodging hath quitted his said Service upwds. of 20 years ago since which time he hath gained no other Settlement either by Renting House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10. a year paying Taxes or or.wise howsoever

Edwd. Mc.Kanna Aged about Twenty four years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Susannah his Wife at the Parish Church of St. Clement Danes about three years ago and by whom he hath two Children now living (vizt.) Sarah aged about Eighteen Months and anr. Child which is intended to be Christened by the name of Susannah aged about two Months says he served seven years Apprenticeship to one Henry Davis a Shoemaker in Hanoway Yard Oxford Road in the Parish of St. Mary Le Bone in the County of Middx and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House Tenemt. of or Lodging of £10. a year or or.wise gained any or. Settlement than as aforementioned

Elizth. Smith Aged about Thirty Six years on her Oath says she is the Widow of James Smith with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St. James Clerkenwell about Eighteen years ago and who died about two years since and by whom she hath Three Children living (vizt.) Sarah aged about Sixteen years (at Present Provided for) Ann aged about Seven years and Elizth . Aged about 16 Months Says her said late Husband served Three years the latter part of his Apprenticeship to one Ambrose Stevenson a Tin Plate Worker in Tower Street in the Parish of St. Dunstan in the East London and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any or. Settlemt. either by Renting House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10. a year Paying Taxes or or.wise howsoever neither hath this Examinant since her sd. Husbands Death

Susannah Swalthy Aged about 24 years on her Oath says she Intermarried to her Husband Barthow. Swalthy (gone from her) at Duke Street Chapell about 10 Months ago and by whom she hath no Child living Says she has been Informed and believes that such Marriage is not legal by the Lams of this Kingdom And further says that her said Husband is an Irishman & never gained any Settlemt. in London either by Renting House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10. a year or otherwise howsoever Says before her Intermarriage to her said Husband & whilst she was a Singlewoman she lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Calley a Coal merchant in Piccadilly in the Parish of St. James Westmr . upwards of 14 Months at the yearly Wages of Six Guineas hath quitted her said Service about Twelve Months ago since which time she hath gained no other Settlement.

Elizth. Carter Aged about Sixteen years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she was bound out an Apprentice by the Churchwdns. and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of St. Margaretts Westmr . to one John Delarouch who kept the Sign of the Green Man in Table Street White Chaple in the Parish of St. Mary White Chaple in the County of Middlesex and served her said Master under such Indre upwards of Three years & a & untill such times as her said Master became Insolvent And further says she never gained any or. Settlemt. than as aforesaid

James Witts aged about Twenty Six years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Hannah his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes about Two years ago and by whom he hath one Child living vizt. James aged about Three years born a Bastard in the Parish of St. Pancras Says he served seven years Apprenticeship to one Arthur Lake a Copper Plate Printer in Goodge Street in the Parish of St. Pancras in the County of Middx and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House Tenemt. or Lodging of £10 in year or or.wise howsoever or gained any or. Settlement than as aforementioned

Hester Blacklock Aged about forty Six Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Peter Blackstock with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St. Martin in the Fields about Eighteen Years ago and by whom she hath no Child or Children living Says her said Husband was a North Countryman but from what part parish or place she does not know neither did he ever acquaint her therewith nor did he ever gain a Settlemt. in London either by Renting House Tenement or Lodging of Ten pounds a Year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever Says before her Intermarriage to her said late Husband she was bound an Apprentice to & served Upwards of Six Years an Apprenticeship to One Mrs. Keppen a Mantua Maker in Southampton Street in the Parish of St. Paul Covent Garden and after quitting her sd Apprenticeship she never gained Any other Settlemt.

David George Opiney Aged about Nineteen Years On his Oath Says he never was married Rented House paid Taxes was an Apprentice or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says his Father Joseph Ocum Opiney Rented a House in Little Duke Street Moor Fields in the Parish of St. Leonard Shoeditch in the County of Middx upwards of One Year at the Yearly Rent of Ten pounds and upwards and paid Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about Ten Years ago since which he never gained any other Settlement

Mary Pyle Aged about Fifty Seven Years on her Oath Says she never was Married Served any Apprentice or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says she Rented and lived in a House in St. Martins Church Yard in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the said County of Middlesex upwards of one Year and a half at the Yearly Rent of Twenty four Pounds a Year besides Taxes hath quitted said House about Thirty Years ago since which time she never Gained any other Settlement otherwise by Renting Lodgings of Ten Pounds and upwards and which were all Within the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields aforesaid.

Jane Powys Aged about 38 Years on her Oath says she intermarried to John Powys her late Husband Deceased at the Parish Church of St. Andrews Holbourn above 13 Years ago and by whom she hath One Child Named John Powys living aged about 11 Years Says her said late Husband Rented & lived in a House in Red Lyon Street in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn above the Bars for Several Years at the Yearly Rent of £35 a Year besides Taxes hath Quitted said House about 4 Years ago since which time she never Gained any or Settlement neither hath this Examinant since her said Husbands Death Either by Renting House Tenement or Lodging of £10 a Year paying Taxes or otherwise howsoever

Esther Pulley Aged about fifty Six Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of George Pulley with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Great Ealing in the County of Middlesex upwards of Twenty Years ago and by whom she hath Two Children now living Namely John Aged about 17 Years now provided for and Esther Aged about 19 Years unprovided for or did she ever gain any other Settlement than hereafter mentioned and further Says that after her said Husbands Death she Rented and lived in a House in Little Russell Street in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr upwards of Three Years at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds and upwards that she this Examinant hath quitted said House upwards of four Years Ago and hath gained no other Subsequent Settlement

Ann Patridge Aged about about 68 Years On her Oath says she never was Married Rented House paid Taxes or ever lived a hired Yearly Servt. for one Year says her Father Jno Patridge a Watch Maker Rented and lived in a house in Swan Yard in the Parish of Christchurch Newgate Street London for Several Years at the Yearly Rent of £10 and upwards and after his Death her Mother Kept the same House for some time afterwards and can give no further or other Account of her Settlement than as aforesaid

John Jay Aged about 23 Years on his Oath says he intermarried to Rebecca his Wife at the Parish Church of Old Street in the County of Middx about Fifteen Months Ago & by whom he hath One Child now living named Sarah Aged about three Months Says he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with Robt Burton the Sign of the Star Inn in Carey Street in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middx for fourteen Months at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds besides Diet and Lodgings hath Quitted his said Service about Five Years ago since which time he hath Gained no Other Settlement Neither by Renting House Tenement or Lodging of £10 paying Taxes or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Howard Aged 70 Years On her Oath Says she never was Married nor ever gained any or. Settlement than as hereafter Mentioned Says she Rented & Lived in a House in John Street Golden Square in the Parish of St Jamess in the Liberty of Westr . for 2 Years at the Yearly Rent of £32 a Year and Paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about 30 Years ago since which time she Never Rented House Tenement or Lodging of £10 a Year Paid Taxes or ever lived a hired Yearly Servant for 1 Year

Sarah Hoyle Aged about fifty Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Robert Welch a Surgeon in Panton Square near the Haymarkett in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster for Eighteen Months at the Yearly Wages of Nine Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Two Years ago since which time she never gained any other Subsequent Settlement

Joshua Holt Aged about fifty Three Years on his Oath Says he never was married Rented House Tenemt. or Lodging of Ten pounds a Year or paid Taxes Says he lived a hired Yearly Servant with John Wyndham Boyer Esqr . in Upper Grosvenor Street in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex for four Years at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds besides Diet and Lodging hath quitted his said Service upwards of Twenty Three Years ago since which time he hath gained no other Settlement

Ann Landen Aged about 39 Years on behalf of Robt. Fillery an Infant Aged about 5 Years on her Oath Says that the Father Robt. Fillery never gained any or Settlement than by Birth as she Believes says the Grandmother of the said Robt. Fillery is now Chargeable to the Parish of Lee or Lee Green in the County of Kent says that Thos. Fillery & the above Named Robt. Fillery were both Passed to Lee in Kent from the Parish of St Andrew Wardrobe London about Twelve Months & that the afsd. Robt Fillery has gained no other Settlement than as aforesaid

Mary Carter Aged about Thirty One Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of George Carter with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St. Anne Westminster about Eighteen Months ago and by whom she hath One Child living namely George Aged about Ten Months Says before her Intermarriage with her said Husband and whilst she was a Singlewoman she had an illegitimate Child by one Saml. Rigley Rigley named Sarah aged about four Years born a Bastard in Cross Keys Court Chick Lane in the Parish of St. Sepulchre London and that her said Child Sarah never gained any other Settlement than by Birth.

James Piddock Aged about Thirty Years on his Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Say she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Sr Ralph Milbank about Eighteen Months at the Yearly Wages of Five Ten Guineas besides Cloaths Diet & Lodging Vizt. the first Six Months in Bond Street in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square and the last Twelve Months in Harley Street Cavendish Square in the Parish of St. Mary Le Bone in County of Middlesex where his said Master removed to be was there discharged and after quitting his said Masters Service he never lived as a lived Yearly Servant nor has he gained any other Settlement.

Robert Watson aged about thirty four Years on his Oath Says he never was Married Rented or ever Rented House Tenement or Lodging of Ten pounds a Year or paid Taxes Says he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Payne a Doctor & Apothecary the Corner of Coventy Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Twelve Pounds besides Diet & Lodging hath quitted his said Service about three Years ago since which time he Never lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year or otherwise gained any other Settlement.

Elizth. Roberts aged about Fifty One Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Robert Roberts who died about Twelve Month ago and by whom she hath Two Children living now provided for Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Fetter Lane the Corner of Cliffords Inn in the Parish of Saint Dunston in the West London for Three Months at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Five Pounds hath Quitted said House upwards of Twenty years ago since which time her said late Husband never rented House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a Year or otherwise gained any other Settlemt.

Mary Rippen Aged about Sixty Years on behalf of Harry Morris her Son (who now lyes ill of Consultions on her Oath Says that her said Son Rented and lived in a House in Britania Row near Westmr. Bridge in the Parish of Saint Mary Lambeth in the County of Surry for several Years at the Yearly Rent of Ten Guineas and paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about Eight Years ago since which time he never gained any other Settlement

Henry Townrow Aged 78 Years on his Oath Says he never was Married Says he Rented and lived in a House in Red Lyon Street Red Lyon Square in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn above the Barrs in the County of Middx for One Year & an half at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds year & paid Parish Taxes due for the sam hath quitted the said House about fifty Years ago and after he quitted the same he never Rented House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a Year or ever gained any other Settlement.

Rose Taylor aged about fifty five Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Charles Taylor with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holbourn London about Seventeen Years ago and who has been dead upwards of Ten Years Says that beeing a Widow and without Child or Children she lived as a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Hussey an Apothecary the Corner of King Street St. James's in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr . for Three Years at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted her said Services upwards of Six Years ago since which time she never lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year or otherwise gained any or Settlement.

Elizth. Shaw Aged about 27 Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Knight a Milliner in that part of the Strand which is in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Sixteen Months at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of four Years ago since which time she never lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year or otherwise gained any other Settlement

Eleanor Jones Aged about Twenty Six Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Thomas Jones (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Mary Lambeth in the County of Surry about Nine Years ago and by whom she hath one Child living named Robert Aged about Eight Years Says her said Husbands Rented and lived in a House in Kennington place in the Parish of St. Mary Lambeth in the said County of Surry for Nine Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Guineas but Whether he paid Taxes due for the same she does not know hath quitted said House about Six Years ago since which time her said Husband never Rented House Tenement or Lodgings of Ten pounds a Year or otherwise gained any other Settlemt.

Susannah Hicks aged about 10 Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried to Stephen Hicks her Husband (gone from her) at the Parish Church of St. Clement Danes about four Months ago Says her said Husband was bound an Apprentice to Messrs. Skreen and Chambers in Nicholas Lane Lombard Street in the Parish of St. Nicholas Acons London and Served the first Year of his Apprenticeship and afterwards ran away and went to Sea and further says that her said Husband never gained any other Settlement thas as aforesd

John Mitchell aged about Fifty Six Years on her Oath Says he Intermarried to Ann his Wife at the Parish Church of St. Clement Danes upwards of Two Years ago and by whom he hath no Child living Says he rented & lived in a House in Newport Markett in the Parish of Saint Ann in the Liberty of Westmr . for one Year at the Yearly Rent of £24 & paid parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about Five Months ago since which time he never Rented House Tenement or Lodgings of Ten pounds a Year or otherwise gained any other Settlement

John Devere Aged about Forty Five Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried to Elizabeth his Wife at the Parish Church of St. Botolph without Bishopgate London about 16 Years ago and by whom he has four Children living namely John Aged about Twelve Years Mary Aged about Nine Years Thomas aged about five Years and Elizabeth Aged about Six Weeks, Says before his Intermarriage with his said Wife & whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Demeire a Merchant at Amen Corner Pater Noster Row in the Parish of Christ Church Newgate London upwards of four Years at the Yearly Wages of £12 besides Diet & Lodgings hath quitted his said Service upwards of Thirteen Years ago since which time he never gained any other Settlement

Frank Nicholls aged about Forty one years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House on paid Taxes served any Apprenticeship or ever lived a hired yearly Servant for one year Says her Father Thos. Nicholls served seven years Apprenticeship with a Person at the Golden Head Orange Court in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . & after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained anyoe. Settlement & she can speak with more Certainty that her Father was passed from the City of Winchester in the County of H amp shire to St. Martins in the fields & that her Father died in St. Martins Workhouse

Elizth Pomfrett Aged of Twenty Years or there abouts on her Oath says She never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes nor ever lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father Edwd Pomfrett rented & Lived in a house in Worship Street Moorfields in the Parish of St Leonard Shoreditch in the County of Middx Chandler about Two years at the yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds & paid parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Six years ago since which time he never Rented House Tent. or Lodging of Ten Pounds a Year or or.wise howsoever

pd. to William Voll aged about thirty eight Years upon his Oath Saith, That he was born in PallMall in the Parish of Saint James Westminster , where his Father rented a House at fifty Pounds a Year That he lived there with his Father, and Mother for twenty three Years, That he never served any Apprenticeship, rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes, lived as an hired Yearly Servant or has done any Act Matter or Thing whereby he may have gained a Settlement to the best of his Knowledge or Belief

Ann James aged about Thirty Five Years upon her Oath Saith That she was married to Evans James at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew in the County of Glamorganshire in Walls about 20 Twenty Years ago That about 17 Seventeen Years ago her said Husband went to Jamaica in the West Indies for the recovery of his Health since which time this Examinant Bath beard Nothing of him and therefore Concludes he hath bee long since Dead And this Examinant Further Upon her Oath Saith that she lived as an hired Yearly Servant with Mr Samuel Darby an Iron Merchant in the Parish of Saint Mary Somerset in the City of London for Upwards of Twelve Months Yearly Wages of Nine Pounds that since she quitted her said Service she has not done any Act Matter or Thing whereby to the best of her knowledge Information or Belief she may have a gained a Settlement Elsewhere

pd. to Geo Hanr Sq. Hannah Slaughter Singlewoman , aged twenty four Years or thereabouts, upon her Oath Saith That she lived as an hired Yearly Servant with the Bishop of Peterborough in Conduct Street in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square at the Yearly Wages of Six Guineas, for upwards of twelve Months That she quitted her said place between three and four Years ago, That since she so quitted her said Place, she has not lived any where else as an hired Yearly Servant for the Spare four Year together at any one time that she has not Rented any House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a Year or paid any Taxes for done any other Act Matter or Thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge she may have gained any other Settlement and this Examinant further saith That she never was married

Hannah Bush aged about Twenty Seven years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired yearly Servant with one Wm. Robinson a Trunk Maker in Bond Street in the Parish of Saint James Westminster upwards of Eighteen Months at the yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Three Weeks ago since which time she hath gained no other Settlement

William Brown aged about Seventeen years on his Oath says he was born in Brick Lane in the Parish of Saint Luke Old Street in the County of Middlesex where his Father now resides And that he this Examinant never lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year served as an Apprentice rented any House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a year paid Taxes or hath done any Act Matter or Thing Whereby to the best of her Knowledge he may have gained a Settlement Elsewhere than in the said Parish of Saint Luke Old Street aforesaid

Thomas Smith Aged about 37 Years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Margarett his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex upwards of Nine years ago and by whom he hath no Child living Says he Rented and lived in a House in Great Earl Street Seven Dials in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County aforesaid for two years at the yearly. Rent of Thirty Six Guineas Pounds and paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about Seven years ago since which time he never Rented House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year or otherwise gained any other Settlement

Mary Earle aged 50 Years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith That she intermarried with James Earle her now Husband about Sixteen Years ago, at the Parish Church of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster - That since their Intermarriage her said Husband rented Lodgings Demark Court in the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden in the County of Middlesex of one Startings a Taylor at the Yearly rent of 10s. that they lived in their said Lodging for upwards of forty Days and since they quitted the same her said Husband has not done any Act Matter or Thing whereby to this Deponents Knowledge Information or Belief he may have gained a Settlement elsewhere therein the said Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden aforesaid, That this Examinant is poor and unable to maintain herself

Sarah Painter aged about Twenty Five years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired yearly Servant with Mrs. Bullock Great Russell Street Bloomsbury in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middx for Thirteen Months at the yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Five Months ago since which time she hath gained no other Settlement

Richard Pyuar aged about fifty four Years upon his Oath saith, That he intermarried with Martha his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Brideair London about Sixteen Years ago, and by whom he hath three Children living one of whom is provided for and two others Vizt. Samuel aged about fourteen Years and Abraham aged about seven or Eight Years who have never gained any Settlement of their or Says that he rented a House in Torbay Street in the Parish of Saint Olave Southwark in the County of Surry and lived in the same upwards of one Year at the Yearly Rent of ten pounds that he hath quitted his said House about Twenty Years ago since which time he has gained us other Settlement either by renting House Tenement or Lodging of ten pounds a Year paying Taxes, or any otherwise howsoever

Samuel Wheeler aged about 65 years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Mary his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Leonard Shoreditch about Twenty years ago and by whom he hath no Child or Children living Says he rented and lived in a House in King Street in the Parish of Saint Luke Old Street in the County of Middlesex for Nine Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of fourteen pounds, and that since he quitted the said House he has not rented any House or Tenement of ten pounds a Year, lived as an hired Yearly Servant or done any Act Matter or Thing Whereby to the best of his Knowledge he may have gained a Settlement else where than in the said Parish of Saint Luke old Street and that is poor and ill and unable to Maintain himself

Mary Louiza Dolcho aged about 60 years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or ever lived a hired yearly Servant for one year Says that she and her Family went and lived in a House near the Castle and Falcon Aldersgate Street in the Parish of Saint Botolph without Aldersgate London for Twelve Months at the yearly Rent of Ten Pounds hath quitted the said House about 29 years ago since which time she hath never Rented House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year ever lived a hired yearly Servant for one year or otherwise gained any other Settlement

passd. to White Chapple J. Alexander Hector aged thirty two Years or thereabouts upon his Oath Saith, That he inter- -married with Mary his late Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Giles Cripplegate about the Year one Thousand seven hundred and Seventy three, That he has one Child living by his said Wife, namely George Lord Hector aged ten Years or thereabouts, who is now at Woodbridge in Suffolk under the Care of this Examinants relations, that his said Wife died about three Years ago, And this Examinant further Says that white she was single and unmarried he served as an Apprentice under Indentures duly Executed to a Mr. John Shaw of Leman Street Goodmans Field in the Parish of Saint Mary Matfellon otherwise Whitechapel Silk Thereafter for seven Years, and that the whole of his said Apprenticeship his said Master lived in Leman Street Goodmans Fields aforesaid. - and that since he this Examinant quitted his said Master he has not rented any House Lodging or other Tenement of ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or done anyother Act Matter or Thing whereby to the best of this Examinants Knowledge he may have gained any other Settlement subsequent to his Settlement to gained in the said Parish of Saint Mary Matfellon otherwise Whitechapel by Serving such his Apprenticeship as above is stated

Elizabeth Blackman aged twenty Nine Years or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith That she was married to George Blackman her now Husband at the Parish Church of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex about fourteen Years ago - That her said Husband is by Trade a Plasterer and is now in the County Vizt. at Lambeth in the County of Surry at Work, That she has four Children by her said Husband Videlicet Henry Aged thirteen Years or thereabouts, who has never gained any Settlement of her own George aged twelve Years or thereabouts who is now at work with his Father, Ann aged three Years or thereabouts and Charles aged Seven Months or thereabouts And this Examinant says that her said Husband never Served any Apprenticeship, lived as an hired Yearly Servant, rented any House or Tenement of ten pounds a Year Value or did any other Act whereby to gain any Settlement of his own, - That she has been informed and believes that her said Husband father George Blackman who is dead served his time or an Apprentice with Blackman Plaisterer at the Court of Featherstone Alley in Saint Martin Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the County of Middlesex and never after he was not of his said Apprenticeship gained any Subsequent Settlement

St. Martins J. Ann Bartlett aged twenty nine Years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that she never was married that she lived with Mr. Hayman a Turner in the Hay market in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middlesex as an hired Yearly Servant for upwards of two Years and an half That she quitted her said Place about ten Years ago and since that time has not done any Act Matter or King whereby of the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained a Settlement elsewhere than in the said Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields

Mary Milford aged forty three Years or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith that She never was married Saith that she lived as an hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Morley in Southampton Street Bloomsbury Square in the Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex for upwards of Fourteen Months at the Wages of Seven Guineas by the Year - That she quitted her said Place about five Years ago, and since that time hath not rented any House or Tenement of ten Pounds a Year Value, lived for one Year as an hired Yearly Servant or done any other Act Matter or Thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information and belief She may have gained a Settlement elsewhere than in the said Parish of Saint George Bloomsbury as above is stated

passd. to Eton but Return'd She has been passd. to us 2 years ago & unappead to. Ann Glanvill aged 68 years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith That she was Married to Thomas Glanvil her late Husband at the Parish Church of Eton in the County of Buckingham That after their Intermarriage her said Husband rented and lived in a House at Eton for near Thirty Years and paid Poors Rate for the same during all that time That her said Husband died in the said House and that after his Death this Examinant rented and lived in the said House for about two Years and paid Poors Rate for the same as aforesaid that she quitted her said House about four Years ago and since that time has not rented a House or paid Taxes lived in Lodgings of £10 a year, lived as an Hired yearly Servant or done any other Act Matter or Things whereby to the best of her knowledge Information or Belief she may have gained a Settlemt. elsewhere and that Being poor and in Extreme Distress she this Examinant hath for three nights wander'd about and lodged in the open air in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex

Ann Holmes Aged about Thirty years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House Tenement or Ten pounds a year ever lived a hired yearly Servant for one year or ever was bound an apprentice Says her Father died when she was about four years old That her Mother Rented and lived in a House in Harp Alley in the Parish of Saint Brides otherwise Bridgett in the City of London till the time of her death which is about 12 years ago and paid Taxes due for the same and That this Examinant lived with her said Mother till the time of her death

James Talboys of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes on behalf of William Williams aged about 66 years on his Oath says that said he has been Creditably Informed that he Intermarried to Elizth . his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Paul Covent Garden about 20 years ago and by whom he has Six Children living Vizt. Ann Aged about 15 years Edwd. Wm . aged 13 years Wm . aged 11 years Elizth . aged Six years Peter Aged three and Mary aged Eighteen Months, Says he rented part of a house in Bell Court Grays Inn Lane in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn above the Barrs at the Yearly Rent of Eleven Guineas for hath quitted the said about Eight Years ago since which time he never Rented House or Tenement of Ten Pounds a Year

Edward Steers Aged about 74 years on his Oath says he lived as hired yearly Servant with Sir. William Bunbury in upper Grosvenor Street in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex about for two years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of £16 hath quitted his said Service about 18 years ago since which time he has gained no other Settlement than as aforesaid

John Rofe Aged about Fifty two years on his Oath says he Intermarried with Elizabeth his now Wife at Saint John Chappell in the precinct of the Savoy in the year 1755 and by whom he hath three Children now living Namely John aged 29 years or thereabouts Pellajah Aged about 18 years now provided for and Wm. George aged about 11 years Says about Seven years ago he went and Resided in the parish of Saint Marry Le Bone otherwise Mary Bone and Rented a Part of a Sawyers Yard of One Isaac Newton a Carpenter at the yearly Rent of Fourteen Pounds upon a Lease for Five Months or thereabouts payable Quarterly And also Rented Apartments in the House of Mr. Gwadkins in Castle Street in the said Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone for three Months at the yearly Rent of Eight Pounds and Quitted the same about Seventeen years ago since which time he never Rented House paid Taxes or otherwise gained any Subsequent Settlement

Alexr. Kennedy Aged Sixty Seven years or thereabouts upon his Oath says he was bound an Apprentice to Mr. Nathl. Cross of Aldermanbury in the Parish of Saint Mary Aldermanbury in the City of London Musical Instrument maker under an Indenture of Apprenticeship for Seven years says he served five years and upwards and then had his Indentures given up to him by the Order of the Lord Mayor That he quitted his said Master about Forty Seven years ago since which time he has done no Act Matter or thing Whereby to the best of his knowledge Information or belief he may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Jane Jackson Aged about Fifty Eight years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House Tenement or Lodging of Ten Pounds a year, says she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Thomas in Great Queen Street Lincoln Inn Fields in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields for 13 Months & upwards at the yearly Rent of Wages of Six pounds hath quitted said Service upwards of One year since which time he has done no Act Matter or thing Whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Lucey Hughes aged about 28 years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House Tenement or Lodging of Ten pounds a year says she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Jackson a Chymist in Fleet Markett in the Parish of St. Brides otherwise Bridgett in the City of London for Twelve months at the yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted said service upwards of three years ago since which time she hath gained no other Settlement than as aforesaid.

passd. to St. Martins C George Clark aged 55 years or thereabouts upon his Oath Saith That he intermarried about 35 years ago at the Parish Church of Bewdley in Worcestershire to Sarah his late Wife That she departed this Life about 2 years ago. That he had Issue by her 13 Children Two of whom have not gained Settlements Vizt. James aged 16 (and Samuel aged 14 who is now with this deponent Ill) Saith That he kept a House in little Catherine Street , in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields , that the Rent thereof was £16. a year & he resided in it 3 Quarters of a year That he Quitted the same at 8 years ago That since that Time he has done no Act whatever whereby he may have gained a Settlement And Saith That his Son Samuel (who is now with him Sick) was sent to Sea by the Marine Society and never has gained or Acquired any Settlement as he verily believes

Jane Jackson aged about fifty Eight years on her Oath says she never was married That she lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr Wilson a Dry Cooper in Botolph Lane in the Parish of Saint Botolph Billinsgate in the City of London for two years, at the Wages of Six pounds a Year, That she quitted her said service about two years ago, & that since she quitted same, she has not done any Act Matter or Thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or Belief she may have gained a settlement elsewhere than in the Parish of Saint Botolph Billinsgate aforesaid

C passd. to St. Geo Blooms bury Charles Harriott aged about 55 years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Ruth Harrt . his now Wife at Christ Church Spittle fields about 30 years ago and by whom he hath one Child living (vizt.) Christiana aged about 18 years Says that since his Intermarriage to his said Wife he Rented and lived in a House in Duke Street Bloomsbury in the parish of Saint George Bloomsbury for 17 years at the yearly Rent of 12 Twelve Guineas and paid Taxes for the same hath quitted said House about 6 years since which time he has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of his Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Hannah Watson aged about 33 years on her Oath says she Intermarried never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mrs. Thornhill at the White Lyon Vere street for upwards of Twelve Months hat at the yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about 14 years since which time she has gained no other Settlement than as aforesaid ago Says that she has an Illegitimate Child living by one John Stevens who was born in Old Pye Street in the Parish of Saint John the Evangelist Westminster

Sarah Buck Aged about 22 years on her Oath says she Intermarried to Thomas Buck her present Husband at the Parish Church of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex about four years ago Says that while her Husband was a Singleman he lived as a hired yearly Servant with Colonel Fitzroy in Hanover Square in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square for upwds. of Twelve Months that since he quitted his said Place he has done no act matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained a Settlement elsewhere than as aforesaid

James Piddock Aged about Thirty four Years on his Oath says he never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says he lived a hired yearly Servant with Sir Ralph Milbank about Eighteen Months at the yearly Wages of Five Guineas besides Cloaths Diet and Lodging vizt. the first Six Months in Bond Street in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square and the last Twelve Months in Harley Street in Cavendish Square in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex where his said Master Removed to and was there discharged And after quitting his said Masters Service he never lived as a hired yearly Servant nor has he gained any other Settlement

Susannah Sanford Aged about 59 yrs. on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived as a hired yearly Servant with Mr. Barnard a Poulterer in David Street in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex and City and Liberty of Westminster for two years at the yearly wages of 5 Pounds hath quitted said Service about 40 years ago since which time she has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Elizabeth Wootten aged about 47 years on her Oath says she Intermarried to William Wooden at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holborn above the Bars Says that her said Husband Never gained any Settlement Says that previous to her Intermarriage she lived as a Hired yearly Servant with Lady Ennison in Bedford Row for 13 Months and upwards hath quitted her said Service about 26 years ago since which time she has done no Act matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Joseph Sandell one of the Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes Maketh Oath and Saith that Phoebe Lewis a Pauper and Daughter of Christopher Lewis whose Examination was taken on the 3d. Day of January 1785 hath been since that time Inn the Workhouse of this Parish till Friday last And therefore has not gained any Settlement Subsequent to such Examination being taken

Elizth. Woodcock aged about 66 years on her Oath says she Intermarried to Robert Woodcock he late Husband Deceased at the Parish Church of Aldgate London Saint Botolph without Aldgate about 38 years ago Says that her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in King David Lane Shadwell for Eleven Years at the yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and upwards and paid Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Sixteen years ago since which time she has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Maria Chester aged about 44 years on her Oath says she Intermarried to Robt. Chester at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holbourn about 8 years ago Who has been gone from her about 4 years and can give no Account at all of her said Husbands Settlement Says that about 20 years ago she Intermarried to Jas. Hopper her late Husband deceased at the Parish Church of Saint Michaels Foster Lane and who has been dead about 12 years Says that he Rented House in Free School Street Horsely Down in the Parish of Saint Johns Southwark for 12 Months and upwards at the yearly Rent of five Pounds and paid the Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about Ten years ago since which time she has done no Act matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Mary Hawley aged about Sixty Seven years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mrs Shewart in Great Newport Street in the parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Twelve Months and upwards at the yearly Wages of £5 hath quitted said Service upwards of Twenty years ago since which time she has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

the Childn. were passd. away but dy havg. en passd. to us sometime ach. we were obliged to take turn back again to wit Ann Threader aged 52 years or thereabouts upon her Oath says That she Intermarried with John Threader her Husband about 30 years ago at the fleet That he deserted her about Two Months afterwards That she had no Children by him That since that time she has never been with seen him or known anything further than that she once heard he was married to another Woman That she also heard he has been dead some years That after he so deserted her, vizt. about 3 years after she lived and Cohabited with one Jacob Wesley a Journeyman Shoemaker That she had three Children by him vizt. Hannah a Female Child aged about 14 years who was born at a House in Bird Cage Alley in the parish of Saint George Southwark of whom the said Jacob Wesley was the father and such Child was Christened in the parish Church of Saint George Southwark by the name of Hannah Wesley That shortly after the Birth of the Hannah she and the said Jacob Wesley went to live in Queen Street in the Parish of Saint Mary Overys That they lived there at the House of a Mr. Cuthbert for some years that she was delivered of a Male Child thereof which the said Jacob Wesley was the father who was afterwds. Christened at Saint Mary Overys by the name of Thomas Wesley and is about 12 years of Age That she was after that also delivered of a Female Child at the said Mr. Cuthberts of which the said Thomas Wesley was the Father that such last Child was also Christened in the Parish Church of Saint Mary Overys by the name of Catherine Wesley and is about 9 years of Age That all three Children have been at Nurse or with her from the time of their Birth and have never gained a Settlement except by their Birth as aforesaid

Mary Bayley aged about 25 years on her Oath says she Intermarried to Wm Bayley at the Parish Church of Saint Leonard Shoreditch about Six years ago who is now insane and by whom she hath two Children living vizt. William aged four years and upwards James aged One Month and upwards Says that her said Husbd. Served Seven years Apprenticeship to one Wm. Mifflin a Sawyer in Shoe Lane in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn below the Barrs in the City of London and that after he quitted his said Apprenticeship he has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information on belief he may have gained a Settlement elsewere
William Gowers aged about 53 years on his Oath says he Intermarried to Mary Gowers her late Husband deceased

Wm Gowers aged about 53 years on his Oath says he Rented and lived in a House in Little Russell Street Bloomsbury in the parish of Saint Georges Bloomsbury for upwards of Six years at the yearly Rent of £22 and paid Taxes due for the same hath quitted said House about Ten years ago since which time he has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of his Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Elizth Reynolds aged about 64 years on her Oath says she Intermarried to Joseph Reynolds her late Husband deceased at Cannon Street Church Ratcliff Highway about 30 years ago and by whom she has no Children living Says that her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in Bear Street Lane upper Thames Street in the Parish Allhallows Barking for 30 years or thereabouts at the yearly Rent of £12 and upwards and paid Taxes for the same hath quitted said House about Ten years ago since which time she has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

John Browne aged about 45 years on his Oath says he Intermarried to never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says he lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Mervillan Haberdasher in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Strand in the Liberty of Westmr facing of Somersett House in the Strand for Eighteen Months at the yearly Wages of Eight Pounds hath quitted said Service about Twelve years ago since which time he has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of his Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Swears to St. C. D . Mary Boutflower aged 44 or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith That She never was married, That she lived with Mr. Lackam of Cecil Street in the Strand as a Hired Yearly Servant at the Wages of £7 per Ann. That she lived with him upwards of Two Years That the greatest part of the Time She lived with him on the East Side of the Street That about Two Months before she left his Service he moved to the West Side of the Street in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster , That she went with & Served him there during such Two Months, That since she quitted his Service she has done no Act Matter or Thing whereby she may have gained a Settlement, to the best of her Knowledge or belief

Martha Tilt aged about 23 years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mrs. Collick of Richmond in the Parish of Richmond in the County of Surrey for fifteen Months & upwards at the yearly Wages of four pounds hath quitted said Service about four Months ago since which time She has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Esther Margaret aged 26 or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith That she never was Married, That she lived with Mrs. Brett of Eastmead Street , and afterwards of Eastmead Fields (both in the Parish of Walcot in the City of Bath ) as a hired yearly Servant for upwards of Four Years at the yearly Wages of Eight Guineas, That she quitted such service about 4 Years ago, That since she quitted the same, she has not lived as a hired Yearly Servant for the Space of Twelve Months nor done any other Act Matter or Thing whereby she may have gained a Settlement to the best of her knowledge or belief

Mary Hawley aged about 60 years Sixty seven Years on her Oath saith That she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived as an hired yearly servant with one Mrs. Bank of Little Wild Street in the Parish of Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex for near seven years at the yearly Wages of 6 Guineas hath quitted her said Service upwards of 4 Years ago since which time she has done no Act Matter or Thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained a Settlemt elsewhere

Margaret Swanscoat aged forty Years or thereabouts on her Oath saith That she never was married rented House or Tenement of ten pounds a Year or paid Taxes for any such And further this Examinant on her Oath saith That she was bound Apprentice from the Parish of Saint Olave Hart Street in the City of London to Henry Holdaway of Whitechapel in the Parish of Saint Mary Matfellon otherwise Whitechapel Pen cutter and served he Apprenticeship of Seven Years with her said Master in Whitechapel aforesaid, That since he has quitted her said Master she has not lived as a Hired Yearly servant for twelve Months or done any Act whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or Belief she may have gained any other settlement than by her said service in the said Parish of Saint Mary Matfellon otherwise Whitechapel aforesaid

passd. to St. Mary Le Strand Mary Coe : aged 70 or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith, That she intermarried with Vincent Coe her late Husband at the Parish Church of Christ church Surey about 44 years ago. That her Husband lived with Messrs. Mayd & Co. of the Strand and at the same Time kept a House in Stones Buildings in the Parish of Saint Mary le Strand at the yearly Rent of £14: That they inhabited the same some Years That since that Time her Husband died in the Workhouse of Saint Mary le Strand , That she has not (nor Did her Husband to the last of her knowledge) gained any Settlement since he Rented the said House in Stones Buildgs.

Elizabeth Hurl aged 64 or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith That she intermarried with George Hurl at the Parish Church of Saint George the Martyr Southwork about 34 Years ago That her Husband deserted her about Eighteen Years ago, That her Husband was a Seaman and never did any Act to the best of her knowledge whereby he might have gained a Settlement That she does not Know where he now is not having heard of him for above 15 years That she has been informed by her said Husband and by his Relations at Shepton Mallett and which information she believes to be True that his Father was a Clothier of Reputation and Credit there, and kept a large House which was his own property, and carryed on Considerable business in the Manufacturing Line at Shepton Mallet aforesaid, that her Husband went to Sea, That her Husbands Father Failed at Shepton Mallett, That she never has done any Act Matter or Thing whereby She may have gained a Settlement Since her Husband left her

own Settlemt. St. Clemts. Mary Ann St Brides James St. Botolph Sarah Ann Morltake Eliz St. Clemts. Elizabeth Breedon commonly Called Elizh Limb Aged 36 or Thereabouts Upon her Oath Saith That She never was Married That about 16 Years Ago she lived with Mr Breedon of Arundell Street Living Stable Keeper as Five Pounds a Year That she lived with him some Years That after she left his Service she went to live with John Limb a Lighterman That she had Seven Children by him Four of which are now Living Vizt. Mary Ann aged Nine Years now with Mrs Thompson Wife, & Saml Thompson a Trunk Maker living Opposite to London Street Tottenham Court Road which Mary Ann was Born in Mr Lucass Rents in Hanging Sword Alley white Fryers in the Parish of Saint Brides London and his Father was the said John Limb James aged abt Seven Years born at the House of Mr Moore in Red Cross Street East Smith, held in the Parish of Saint Botolph without Aldgate who was also by the said John Limb Sarah Ann aged Three Years or thereabouts who was born at the House of the said John Limb at Morltake in the County of Surry was by the said John Limb and Elizth . aged 5 Weeks who was Born in St Clement Danes Workhouse That he the said John Limb died about Seven Months ago That since she quitted Mr Breedons she has not gained any Settlement

Elizabeth Timberley aged about 58 years on her Oath says she Intermarried to Richard Timberley at the Fleet London about 30 years ago and who is been dead about 20 years Says that her said Husband Served Seven years Apprenticeship to one Mr Conner a Glazier in Scotland yard in the parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster and that after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief he may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

Edward Preston aged about Eighteen years on his Oath says he never was married Rented House paid Taxes lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year or ever was bound an Apprentice Says that his Father informed him that he Served Seven years Apprenticeship to one Pearce and Smith in Church Street Hackney in the parish of Saint John Hackney in the County of Middlesex this Examinant was born and that he has gained no or. Settlement than as afsd.

Grace Carter : aged 57 or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith That Christopher Lewis the Father of Phoebe Lewis was born at Ratfine Farm in the Parish of Amesbury in Wiltshire , That his Father owned the same That she believes the said Christopher Lewis , or his Father never gained any Settlement since living at Ratfine aforesaid.

Catherine Farmer aged about Sixty years on her Oath says she Intermarried to William Farmer her late Husband at the Fleet about Thirty four years ago Says that she was informed her said Husband was born somewhere in Yorkshire and that her said Husband was a Soldier in the Army that she never heard of her Husband ever gaining a Settlement in his own Right says that before her Intermarriage she lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Frohawkes in Long Lane in the parish of Saint Mary Magdalen Bermondsey for one year at the yearly Wages of four pounds hath quitted her said Service about Thirty four years ago since which time she has never done no Act matter or thing to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained a Settlement elsewhere

John Higgins aged about 17 years upon his Oath saith That he never was bound Apprentice or ever lived as an Hired yearly Servant for one year did any Act Matter or Thing whereby he might have gained a settlemt in his own Right, Saith that he has been informed his Father Charles Higgins and his Mother Elizth. Higgins were Married at Winchester , that after their Intermarriage they Rented a House Called by the Names the Bell and Crown in High Street in the Parish of St. Maurice in the City of Winchester for some years and that this Examinant was born at Resaid House That his Father died when this Examinant was very young, and his Mother died in St Clements Workhouse abt. 2 years ago Months ago

Isabella Crafts aged about Thirty three Years on her oath Saith That she Intermarried with John Crafts her late Husband Deceased at the parish Church of Saint Leonard Shoreditch about 16 Years ago and by whom She has 4 Children living Vizt. John aged about 15 Years provided for Elizabeth aged about 10 Years, Eleanor Aged about 6 Years and George aged about 4 Years, (unprovided for) Saith that She never Rented a House or Tenement of £10 a Year or paid Taxes and that her said Husband served an Apprenticeship of Seven Years the last 2 Years of which he Served with Mr. John King of Golden Lane in the parish of Saint Giles Cripplegate Coal Merchant and since which time to the best of this Examinants Knowledge Information or belief he has done no other Act Matter or thing whereby he may have Gained a Settlement elsewhere

Ann Bibby Aged 69 Years or thereabouts upon her oath Saith that she Intermarried with her late Husband John Bibby at the Parish Church of Saint Margarets at Lyme Regis in the County of Norfolk about 42 Years ago and that she does not know of any Settlement her said Husband ever gained And this Examinant further upon her oath Saith That since her said Husbands Death she lived as a hired Yearly servant with a Mrs. Walker in Bentinck Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr . upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Five pounds & since which time she has done no Act Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge Information or belief she may has gained a Settlement Elswhere

John Conaway aged about Sixteen years on his Oath says he was bound an Apprentice by the Overseers of the Poor of the parish of Saint Clement Danes to one Morris Jones of Barking in the County of Essex for Seven years and that he served his said Master under such Indenture the space of Nine Months after which he run away

Mary Mills aged abt. 60 years upon Oath saith she is the Wido . of Richd Mills of whose Settlement she can give no further Account than that he was born at Chipping Norton in the County of Oxford and that she has not since her Husbands Decease rented ten pounds a year or paid parish Taxes

Eliza. Read on Behalf of Roger Vallely an Infant aged abt. ten Months upon Oath Saith the sd. Roger Vallely is the Son of Terence Vallely and Bridget his Wife who were both Irish People & never gained a Settlement in England to this Examint. Knowledge And that the sd. Infant was born at the Plough Alehouse in Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middx

Eliz Kent aged abt. 21 Yrs. upon Oath saith she never was married and that She lived a yearly Servant with Mr King in Newcastle Street near the Fleet Market in the Parish of St. Sepulchers London for one Year & Six Months at the Yearly Wages of £5. and Quitted her sd Service abt. Seven Weeks since

Thomas Parker aged upwds. of 11 Years upon Oath Saith he has been informed & believes he was born at Sand betch in the County of Chester and that he never was an Apprentice or Yearly Servant for one year

Sarah Johnson upon Oath saith she is the Wife of Rt Johnson (who absconds from her) and that her sd. husband (as she has been informed & believes Served his Apprentiship wth. his father a Carpenter at Barham in Kent & never rented ten Pounds a Year Paid Parish taxes or lived a Yearly Servt. for One Year

Mary Winter upon Oath Saith She is the Wife of Edwd. Winter a Sailor on board the Cumberland now lying at Chatham & has been informed & verily believes her sd husbd. (whilst a Singleman) lived a Yearly Servant wth Mr Bads a Perukemaker near the Cross in Twickenham Middx for one years & upwds. & has not since rented ten Pounds by the year Paid Parish Taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for other year

John Perry upon Oath Saith he was married to his Wife Jane Perry abt. 16 Yrs. ago at the Church of St Catherines by the Tower and that whilst he was a Singleman he lived a Yearly Servant with Mr. Rd. Sherrard at North End in the Parish of Fulham in the County of Middx at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds for the Space of Sixteen Months quitted his said Service upwds. of twenty Years age & has not since rented ten Pounds a Year paid parish taxes or lived a yearly Servt. for one year

Wm Huggins of Salisbury Street in the Strand Maketh Oath that he knew Joseph more is when he rented a house opposite Durham yard in the Strand in the Parish of St Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr . and that he believes the Rent of the sd house was upwd. of twelve Pounds by the year & that the sd. Joseph Morris lived in the upwd. of two months And the sd. Joseph Morris has not since he quitted the sd. house rented ten pounds a year paid parish Taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one year to this Examinants knowledge or belief

Henry Woodcock upon Oath saith he was bound apprentice for Seven Years to Mr. Atkinson Glassman & after having Served his sd. Master abt. 5 Years of the sd. term during which he Lodged at Mr. Atkinson's house in the parish of St. Andrew in Holbourn above Barrs Middx he was discharged from his sd. Apprentiship and has not since rented ten pounds by the year paid parish taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one Year

Rd. Phillips upon Oath saith he intermarried with his Wife Hannah Phillips at the Fleet London upwds. of Seven Years ago that he was bound apprentice by Indenture dated the 5th. Octr. 1738 to Joseph Staymaker a Blacksmith & lived with him as his apprentice in Barnaby Street in the parish of St John Southwark in the County of Surry about two Years & then the sd. Rd. Phillips this Examint & his sd. Master parted by Consent & he never was assigned over to any other person nor ever rented ten pounds a year paid parish Taxes or lived a yearly Servant for one year
Davenport Platt aged 20 Years upon Oath Saith he was born at Chipston in the County of Monmouth & never was an apprentice or yearly Servant nor ever Rented ten pounds by the Year or paid Parish taxes

Henry Greenrod upon Oath saith he was born in New Street in the Parish of St Philip & Jacob in the County of Gloucester Somerset and never was an Apprentice or yearly Servant not ever rented ten Pounds by the year or paid Parish taxes

Stephen Ratten upon Oath Saith he Served Seven Years apprentiship wth. John Scott a Farmer in the Parish of Hewton in the County of Somerset & never rented Ten pounds by the Year paid Parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servt. for one Year

Evian Smith upon Oath saith she is the Wife of Wm. Smith by whom she has 3 Childn. John aged 5 Years Richd. aged 3 Years & David aged 8 Months & that her sd. husband informed her Served his Apprentiship wth. John Latham a Taylor in Elbow Lane in the Parish of Liverpoole in the County of Lancaster & never rented ten pounds by the year paid parish taxes nor lived a yearly Servant for one Year

Jno: Park aged abt. Twenty Nine Years upon Oath Says he intermarryed with his wife in the Parish Church of Hendon in the County of Middx upwards of five Years since Says he Rented a house in Silver Street near Golden Square in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. of the Yearly Rent of Twenty Six Pounds & lived therein upwards of Six Weeks Says he quitted the sd. House in the Month of Augt. 1749 since wth time he hath not rented Ten Pounds a Year pd. Parish Taxes or Served any Parochiall Office

Alex Dawson on behalf of Thomas Hasledine upon Oath saith he has been Informed & verily believes the said Thos Hasledine rented the Crown Alehouse in Hatton Garden in the Liberty of Saffron hill Hatton Garden and Ely Rents in the parish of St. Andrew in Holborn in the County of Middlx at the yearly Rent of Ten pounds lived therein Sevl. Years & quitted the same abt. Ten Years ago since which he has not rented ten pounds by the Year nor pd. parish taxes to this Examints. knowledge or belief

John Golden aged 29 Years upon Oath saith he served Seven Years apprentiship with Mr Thos. Scriven a Painter and Glazier in Knightsbridge in the parrish of St Margaret in the City of Westmr. & that he never rented ten pounds a Year paid parish Taxes nor lived a yearly Servt for one Year

Eliz Russell aged 56 Years upon Oath saith she never was married and never was an Apprentice or yearly Servt. that she was born at Portsmouth in the County of & that her father Tho Russell decd. Served his Apprentiship wth. Mr. Ilkias a Bricklayer upon Saffron hill in the Liberty of Saffronhill in the parish of St. Andw. in Holbn. Middx & never rented ten pounds by the year nor pd. parochial Taxes

Eliz: Wondey aged abt. 66 Years upon Oath says he was Married to Thos. Wondey her present Husbd. at the fleet London abt. forty six Years ago Says he Rented and lived in a house in Villar's Street York buildings in the Parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westmr . for three Years and upwards at the Yearly Rent of £30, and hath quitted said house abt. Ten Years; since which time he hath not Rented Ten pounds by the Year or paid Parish Taxes.

Hannah Sharlock aged about 53 years Lodging in Milford Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middx upon Oath saith she is the Widow of Joseph Sharlock Says that since his Death being a Widow and without Child or Children she lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mrs. Salmon who lodged in the house of Mr. Williams in New North Street in the Parish of St. George the Martyz by Queen Square in the County of Middx for One year and upwards at the yearly Wages of Four pounds Diet and Lodging and hath quitted the Same upwards of Four years Since which she hath not rented any House paid the Land Tax or Poor Rate or lived a hired Servant for One year

Ann Brandling Aged about 29 Years upon Oath Says she was never Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Hemmings at Norton in the Parish of Kingstone upon Thames in the County of Surry upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of Four Pounds hath quitted said Service about Ten Years and hath not Since Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Mary Asford Aged about 19 Years Upon Oath Says she was never Married was an Apprentice or a hired Yearly Servant Says her Father James Asford Served Seven Years Apprentiship with Mr. Gardener a Waterman in the Parish of Wandsworth in the County of Surry and hath been out of his said Apprentiship about Twenty Six Years and never Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Sert for One Year And further upon her Voluntary Oath Says she is pregnant with Child or Children which is likely to be Born a Bastard or Bastards and to become Chargeable to the parish of St. Clement Danes she being poor and unable to Maintain the same when Born Says One Thomas Post a Postillion had Carnal knowledge of this Examinants Body about the Latter End of May Last and at several other times since at One of which times he got her with Child of the said Child or Children with which she is now pregnant

Margt. Burk Aged about 34 Years Wife of George Burk Gone from her upon Oath Says she Intermarried with her said Husband at the Fleet London abt. 12 Years ago Says her said Husband is a Native of Ireland and never Gained a Settlement in England and that Before his Intermarriage with her he Lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr Evans a Miller in the parish of Selbridge in the County of Kildare in the Kingdom of Ireland aforesaid with whom he Lived about Seven Years at the Yearly Wages of three Pounds or thereabouts hath quitted said Service about Fifteen Years and he hath n Since Rented House Paid Taxes or Lived a hired Yearly Sert. for One Year as this Examinant hath been Informed by her said Husband and which Information she Verily Believes to be true Says she has One Child by her said Husband (to wit) Wm. Aged about Seven Years

Wm Hart Aged about Fifty One Years Upon Oath Says he was Bound Apprentice for Seven Years to Mr Sylvester a poulterer in Bishopgate Street in the parish of St Botolph Bishopgate London with whom he Served the first five Years of his Apprentiship Says he Served the last two Years of his said Apprentiship with Mr Vesey a poulterer in New Bond Street in the parish of St. George Hanover Square in the Liberty of Westminster & hath been out of his said Apprentiship upwards of twenty Years Says he never Rented House paid Taxes or Lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year

Sarah Davis Aged about Thirty six Years Upon Oath says she never was Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Edwards at a Bacon Shop in Newgate Street in the Parish of Christ Church London for Six Years at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds, quitted same about Twelve Years ago, and never after Rented Ten Pounds a Year, paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year; And further upon her Oath says that on the Twentieth day of May 1764, she was delivered of a Female Bastard Child in the House of Mr. Gaywood in Whites Alley in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex which hath been Baptized by the Name of Bethia , says that Leonard Keeve now a Pauper in the Rolls Workhouse did beget the said Female Bastard Child on her Body of which she was delivered as aforesaid, he having had carnal knowledge of her Body several times at one of which times he got her with Child of the said Female Bastard Child, and that the said Leonard Keeve and no other Persons is the true and real Father thereof

This Examinant Saith on her Oath that She was born as She hath been Informed by her Parents as Mile End Old Town in the Parish of St Dunstan Stepney in the said County of Middlesex and lived as an Yearly Servant at the Wages of Twenty Shillings for the first Year and was to have Forty Shillings the next year for one Year and an half with one Captain Marsh in the said Parish of St Dunstan Stepney and received Wages for that time Accordingly And this Examinant Saith that She hath not lived as an Yearly hired Servant with any Person Since quitting that Service and that She hath not Rent any House or done any thing to gain any Settlemt. elsewhere And this Examt. Saith that upwards of Eight Years ago She was deld. of a femal Bastard Child which was begotten on her Body by John Alldie late of Naimten Butts in the County of Surry Bricklayer lately deced which was born & baptized by the Name of Murry Alldie in the sd parish of Newington

Mary Weddell Aged about Twenty Nine Years on her Oath Says She is the Wife of Francis Weddell (gone from her) with whom She Intermarried in the Parish Church of Christ Church Spittle Fields in the County of Middlesex on the Eighteenth Day of October One thousand Seven hundred and Sixty three Says her said husband never Rented a house paid Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a Yearly hired Servant for one Year to the Knowledge or belief of this Examinant Says her said Husbands Father Rented and lived in a house in St Martins Lane in the Parish of St Martin in the Fields in the liberty of Westmr. in the County of Middlesex for Sevl: Years at the Yearly Rent Twenty pounds and Upwards and lived therein to the time of his Death which happened about five Years ago and this Examinant further Saith that She hath not done any Act matter or thing whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Isabella Surridge Aged upwards of Eighteen Yrs. on her Oath Says She is the Wife of Bartlett Surridge (gone from her) with whom She Intermarried in the Parish Church of St Botolph without Aldgate Londn on the Twenty first Day of Decr: One thousand Seven hundred and Sixty Seven Says her said Husband never Rented House paid Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year to the knowledge or belief of this Examinant Says her sd Husband Rented and lived in a House in Pellys Court Hanway Street in the Parish of St Mary Le Bone for some Years but how many this Examinant cannot Say at the Yearly Rent of Ten pounds or thereabouts and that her said Husband was born in the said Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone as this Examinant has been Informed by Several persons in the Neighbourhood and which Information She verily believes to be true And further Says that She hath not Since her said Husbands Absconding done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Reed Aged about Twenty three Years upon her Oath Says She never was Married and that She lived a hired Servant with one Mr Mackay: a Fruiterer in Henrietta Street in the parish of St Paul Covent Garden in the liberty of Westmr. for one Year and Two Months as the Yearly Wages of Six pounds Six Shillings hath quitted said Service about four Months and hath not Since Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Simpson Aged about Eighteen Years on her Oath Says She never was Married nor never Rented House Paid Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a hired yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father John Simpson deceased has Often Informed her and which Information She verily believes to be true that he lived many Years as a hired Yearly Servant in the Parish of St: George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex to a Gentleman there whose Name this Examinant cannot now recollect But Says that her said Father falling into decay was taken into St: Georges Work house and lived therein Several Years and there died

Elizabeth Brewen Aged about Twenty four Years upon Oath Says She is the Wife of Thos. Brewen (gone from her) with whom She Intermarried at the Parish Church of St Thomas the Apostle in the City of London about Six Years ago by whom She has one Child Named John Aged about Two Years Says her said Husband Rented Two Seperate Houses the one in Turnmill Street at the Yearly Rent of Sixteen Pounds and the other in Swan Alley at the Yearly Rent of fifteen pounds both Situate in the parish of St: James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex and lived therein Eight Months or thereabouts and paid all Parish Taxes for the same hath quitted said lastmentioned house about Three Years and hath not Since Rented house paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Joseph Totham aged about fourteen Years upon his Oath Says he was bound Apprentice by the Church Wardens and overseers of the Poor of the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the liberty of Westmr. and County of Middlesex by Indenture Dated the Twentieth Day of Sepr. One Thousand Seven hundred and Sixty Six untill he shod. Attain his Age of Twenty four Years to Charles Todd of the Parish of Saint Lawrence Jewry London Perukemaker as by the said Indentures may Appear Says he Served Ten Months part of his said Apprenticeship with the said Charles Todd that his said Master Using this Examinant very ill by beating Striking and Kicking him was Obliged to leave his said Master Says he never was Assigned over to any Person nor ever has done any thing whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Anthony Harris Aged about fifty Years upon Oath Says he Intermarried with Elizabeth his Wife at Cirencester in the County of Dorset about five Years Ago Says he rented and lived in a House in Bermondsey Street in the Parish of Saint Mary Magdalen in the County of Surry for many Years at the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and Paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath Quitted said House about five Years and hath not since rented House paid Taxes or done any other thing whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Martha Brereton Aged about Sixty Seven Years upon Oath Says she is the Widow of John Brereton who has been dead about Twenty four Years with whom she Intermarried at the Fleet London about Thirty Seven Years ago by whom she hath One Son named William aged about Thirty Six Years Says her said Husband was a Native of Ireland and never gained a Settlement in England to her Knowledge or belief And this Examinant further saith that she was born in the Parish of Hampstead in the County of Middlesex and never rented House paid Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizabeth Siffris Aged about forty five Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Joseph Siffris who has been dead about Ten Years with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Brides otherwise Bridget about Twenty Eight Years Ago Says her said Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Captain Dunn in the Parish of Saint George in the East in the County of Middlesex Mariner And that after her said Husband was out of his said Apprenticeship never rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Ware aged about Twenty Years on her Oath Says she never was Married And that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Faulkner a Milliner in Piccadilly in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr. upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about four Months and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or lived as a hired Yearly Servant with any other Person

Hannah Cake aged about Thirty Nine Years on her Oath Says she never was married And that she lived a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. West Attorney in that part of Shire Lane which is in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex for Two Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service upwards of Seven Years ago and hath not since Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Ann Taylor aged about Thirty four Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of James Taylor who has been Dead upwards of Seven Years by whom she hath one Child named Ann Aged about Ten Years Says her Mother Rebecca Miller after this Examinants Fathers Death Rented and lived in a House in Grays Inn Lane in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourne in the County of Middlesex upwards of Eleven Years at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds and paid all Taxes due for the same And further says that since her said Mothers Death this Examinant never Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Margaret Evans on behalf of Thos. Evans her Husband who now lies ill of a Fever on her Oath says she Intermarried with her said Husband in the Parish Church of Saint Mary White Chapel in the County of Middlesex about Twenty Eight Years ago Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Cloth Fair called or known by the Name of the Welch Harp in the Parish of Saint Bartholomew the Great London of the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds lived therein upwards of Six Years and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same and quitted same about Twenty Years ago and hath not since Rented any House of Ten Pounds by the Year paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Frances Hazzard aged about 61 years on behalf of Martha Hallem and Edward Hallem Infants Vizth. Martha Aged about Thirteen Years and Edward aged about 12 years says she knew and was well acquainted with their Father and Mother Benjamin and Jane Hallem to the time of their Deaths and that she hath often heard their Father say that he severed Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Samuel Summer a Wool- Comber in the Borrough of Leicester and that after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he rented and lived in a House in the Parish of Saint Marys in the said Borough of Leicester for some Years at the Yearly Rent of £12. or thereabouts but this Examinant cannot set forth the Particulars how long he rented the same or what Yearly Rent he paid But Says that after he came to reside in London he never rented House paid taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year he always living in Lodgings and follg. the Business of a Porter.
