Mary Palmer Aged about Twenty four Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Edmund Palmer (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Mary Hill near Billings gate London in the Month of April One Thousand Seven hundred and Sixty Six by whom she hath one Child living named John Aged about fifteen Months Says that before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Shellito deceased at the Sun at Billingsgate for Two Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds or thereabouts Says that after he quitted his said Service he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Fowke Hussey aged about forty Eight Years On his Oath Says he never was married and that he Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Benion a Surgeon and Appothecary in Bow Street in the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Field aged about forty Years on her Oath says she never was married nor ever Rented Ten pounds a year or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Merigot late of Skinner Street in the Parish of Saint Botolph London Clockmaker deceased upwards of Two Years and an half at the Yearly Wages of five pounds hath quitted her said Service about five Years ago and hath not since Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

John Bratt aged Eighty Two Years and upwards on his Oath says he Intermarried with Ann his Wife at the Parish Church of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster about Thirty Years ago Says he Rented and lived in a house in Tooley Street in the Parish of Saint John Southwark in the County of Surry for Ten Years or thereabouts of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and Paid all Parish Taxes due for the same Says he has quitted the said House near Thirty Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented Ten pounds a year paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly servant for one year.

Ann Eggier Aged about Twenty Six Years on her Oath says she never was married nor ever Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired yearly servant with Mr. John Christian a Jeweller in Leaden hall Street in the Parish of Saint Mary Ax in the City of London one year and half at the yearly Wages of Six pounds hath quitted her said service about Twelve Months and hath not since she quitted her said Service never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year

Elizth. Dunn Aged about Sixty Eight Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Richard Dunn who has been dead about Twenty Eight Years Says her said Husband whilst living Rented and lived in a house the Corner of Phoenix Street in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex of the Yearly Rent of Eleven Pounds but how long he lived therein she cannot at this Distance of time recollect Says her said late Husband and this Examinant were both Passed upon the said Parish of Saint Giles and were in the Workhouse there sometime and where her said Husband died Says that after her said Husbands Death she never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly servant for one year

Thomas Ward Aged about Fifty five years on on his Oath says he Intermarried with Sarah his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Luke Chelsea in the County of Middlesex on the 4th day of Septr. 1768 says before his Intermarriage & whilst he was a Single man he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Miles Cotton a Farmer in the Parish of Childerley in ye County of Cambridge for 2 Years at the Yearly wages of Six Pounds hath Quitted his said Service about Twenty Seven Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same Ever rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Sarah Wilson Aged about Twenty Eight years on her Oath says she never was married nor ever Rented Ten Pounds a year or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired yearly servant with one William Archer who kept the Flying Horse in Grubb Street in the Parish of Saint Giles Cripplegate for Two years at the yearly Wages of Five Pounds hath quitted her said service about Eight years ago Etc hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one year.

Mary Gard Aged about 27 years on her Oath says she is the Widow of Samuel Gard who has been Dead about 23 Weeks and by whom she hath one Child Named Jane aged about Four years Says her said Husband before his Inter- marriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Single Man lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Sutton Esqr. in Broad Street in the Parish of Saint Botolph Bishopgate London upwards of Twelve Months at the Yearly Wages of Fourteen Pounds and Quitted his said Service about Sixteen Years ago and after he Quitted the same never Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Robert Gibbeson aged about 30 years on his Oath says he never was Married or Ever rented House or Paid Taxes Says he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Richard Gammon Esqr . in Lawrence Poultney Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin Orgars in the City of London upwards of one Year and a half at the Yearly Wages of Fourteen Pounds hath Quitted his said Service about Two Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Jane Hashton Aged about forty years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Thos. Hashton who has been Dead about Seven Years & with whom she Intermarried at the Fleet London about Seventeen Years ago Says her said late Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman lived as a Covenanted Clerk with one Mr. Johnson Attorney at Law in Warwick Court in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn in the County of Middlesex for sevl. Years at the Yearly sallary of forty Pounds besides Diet and after he quitted his said Place he never afterwards Rented House paid Taxes or lived as a Covenanted Clerk for one Year to the knowledge or beleif of this Examinant neither has this Examinant since her said Husbands Death ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Johanna Hoare Aged about Thirty Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of John Hoare who has been dead about Three Months with whom she Intermarried at the Fleet London in the Year 1753 Says her said late Husband was Partner with his Father John Hoare and one Mr. Shugden Taylors who rented and Lived in a House in that Part of Duke Street which is in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex upwards of Two Years and an half at the Yearly Rent of Thirty Pounds or upwards and paid all parish Taxes due for the same Says that her said late Husband on quitting such Partnership went to Sea in the Year 1756 and never after Rented House or paid Taxes neither has this Examinant since her said late Husbands Death Rented House or paid Taxes.

Vagt. Middlesex Lawrence Power Aged about Sixty five Years on his Oath Says he served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one John young a Taylor in the Parish of Warkworth in the County of Northumberland and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

John Richards aged about Fifty Three Years on his Oath says he was bound Apprentice to and Served upwards of two Years and an half of his said Apprenticeship with one John Oakly a Weaver in Olde Cock Lane in the Parish of Saint Matthew Bethnall Green in the County of Middlesex when this Exami- nant Parted with his said Master by Consent And after he Parted with his said Master he never afterwds. Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Elizabeth Jackson aged about Thirty Years on her Oath says she never was married nor ever Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Hawkes a Brazier in Long Acre upwards of a Year and an half at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said Service about two Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Elizth. Lawes Aged about 28 Years on her her Oath Says she is the Wife of George Lawes gone from her with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Margt. Westmr . about 12 Years Ago Says her said Husband served seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Jackson a Grocer in College Street in the said Parish of Saint Margarets Westmr as her said Husband has often Informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year neither has this Examinant done any Act since her said Husbands leaving her whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

John Cater on behalf of Mary Brown Aged abt. Sixteen Years on his Oath Says that John Brown Father of the said Mary Brown Rented and lived in a House in Brassey Lane in the Parish of Isleworth in the County of Middlesex for sevl. Years at the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds or thereabouts and where the said Mary Brown was born as he believes And Says that the said Mary Brown was bound out apprentice to Frances Allen a Milliner in the Strand by one Mr. Maxwell belonging to the Asylum and served Three Weeks of her said Apprenticeship and was afterwards Discharged therefrom by Two of his Majestys Justices of the Peace for the County of Middlesex as this Examinant has been Informed and verily believes to be true And further says the said Mary Brown never gained any or. Settlement than Thro her Father to the Knowledge or belief of this Examinant

Deborah Burden Aged about fifty Eight Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Ellick Burden who has been dead about fifteen Years Says that being a Widow and without Child or Children she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Doctor Ingram in the Parish of All Hallows Barking in the City of London for one Year and upwards at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Twelve Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Mary Toole aged about 40 Years upon Oath says she is the Widow of Patrick Toole who has been Dead about Four Years and an half By whom she has one Child to wit Susanh . aged 12 Years says her said Husband was a Native of Ireland and never gained a Settlement in England to her knowledge or belief says before her said Intermarriage she was bound an Apprentice for 5 Years to Mrs. Ann Padget Milliner in King Street Westminster in the Parish of Saint Margarett in the City of Westminster and served 4 Years & upwards of her said Apprenticeship with the said Mrs. Padgett & then Intermarried with her said Husband says she hath not since her said Husbands Death Rented Ten Pounds a Year or Paid Taxes.

Mary Perry Aged about 29 Years on her Oath says she never was married nor ever Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Ebden in Cross Street Hatton Garden in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn in the County of Middlesex for One Year and Eight Months at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Nine Months ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House or paid Taxes

Stephen Bagnall Aged about Sixty Years on her Oath says he Rented and lived in a house in Oxford Road in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex for five Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Sixteen Pounds hath quitted the same about Nine Years and hath not since he quitted his said House he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

David Chumbley Aged about Twenty Six Years on his Oath says he never was married nor ever Rented Ten pounds a Year or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says he was bound Apprentice to one William Hawes in Neals Yard in the Parish of Saint Jamess Westmr in the County of Middlesex and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship never rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Joseph Warne Aged about Thirty Years on his Oath Says he never was married nor ever Rented House paid Taxes or was an Apprentice to any person whatever Says that after he came to London he Entered into Articles and lived a Covenanted Servant with one Mr. John Homan a Currier in Trotters Alley in the Parish of St. Mary Magdalen Bermondsey in the County of Surry for One Year and five Months at the Yearly Wages of Six pounds and his said Master & this Examinant disagreeing he quitted his said Service about Eleven Years ago and since he quitted that Service he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizth. Daniel Aged about Twenty Nine Years on her Oath Says she never was married nor ever Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Hugh Stratton a Carpenter in the Parish of Saint Phillip in the City of Bristol upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of fifty Shillings and after she quitted the same she went to live a Second time with the said Mr. Stratton and lived with him at Different times upwards of Three Years and after she quitted the said Mr. Strattons Service she nevr Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year And further upon her Voluntary Oath says she is pregnant with Child or Children which is or are likely to be born a Bastard or Bastards and to become Chargeable to the said Parish of Saint Clement Danes she being poor and unable to Maintain the same when born Says that one Richard Bailey who now lately lived as a Porter to Mr. Const a Taylor in Norfolk Street had Carnal Knowledge of her Body some time the begining of Septr. last but the particular day she does not now Remember and at sevl. different times afterwards at one of Which time he got her with Child of the Child or Children of which she is now Pregnant And this Examinant further says that on the 23d. day of May 1764 she was delivd. of a Female Bastard Child at Shireness in the County of Kent which has since been Baptized Lucy And that the aforesaid Richard Bailey and no other Person is the real and true Father thereof

Joseph Warne Aged about Thirty Years on his Oath Says he never was married nor ever Rented House paid Taxes or was an Apprentice to any person whatever Says that after he came to London he Entered into Articles and lived a Covenanted Servant with one Mr. John Homan a Currier in Trotters Alley in the Parish of St. Mary Magdalen Bermondsey in the County of Surry for One Year and five Months at the Yearly Wages of Six pounds and his said Master & this Examinant disagreeing he quitted his said Service about Eleven Years ago and since he quitted that Service he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Roffee Aged about Sixty Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Henry Roffee who has been Dead about Two Months Says that before his Intermarrd. with this Examinant her said Husband Rented and lived in a house in little Saint James's Street in the Parish of Saint James in the liberty of Westmr . for several Years at the Yearly Rent of Sixteen pounds or upwards & Paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted sd. House about Twenty Years ago and after he quitted the same he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Peter Day Aged about forty Eight Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried Dorothy his late Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Dunstans in the East about Twenty Eight Years ago by whom he hath Two Sons and one Daughter now Provided for Says he Rented and lived in a House in Drury Lane in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex for Two Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds hath quitted the same about Ten Years ago and after he quitted the same he never Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Sarah Wright Aged about Twenty Two Years on her Oath Says she never was married nor ever Rented House or paid Taxes Says she was Bound an Apprentice by the Churchwardens and Overseers of poor of the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. to one Mr. John Price who kept a Chandlers Shop the Corner of Chandlers Street in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex and Served Two Years of her said Apprenticeship and then this Examinant went away from her said Master since which time she never rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizth. Boys Aged about Thirty Two Years Wife of John Boys gone from her with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Mary Le Bone about Nine Years Ago by whom she hath one Child named Mary Aged about Two Years and an half Says her said Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a single Man he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Schooly at the Green Man at Paddington in the said Parish of St. Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex for five Years or there -abouts at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted his said Service about 9 Years ago and after he quitted his said Service he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year neither hath this Examinant since her sd. Husband left her.

Elizabeth Foullon Aged about Sixty Six Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of James Foullon who has been Dead about twenty four Years Says that being a Widow and without Child or Children she lived as hired Yearly Servant with Messrs Mackannon and Granger Cabinet Makers in Fullwoods Rent in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn above the Barrs in the County of Middlesex upwards of one Year at the Yearly Wages of Six Pounds Six Shillings hath Quitted her said Service upwards of Ten Years ago and after she quitted her said Service she never after Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived as a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizabeth Taylor Aged about Twenty Nine Years on her Oath Saith She never was Married nor ever Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr: Jordan at the Red Lyon in Dirty Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for three Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds Ten Shillings hath quitted her said Service about four Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizth. Wyllie Aged about forty Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of James Wyllie with whom she Intermarried at the Parish of St. Clement Danes on the 9th. day of December 1754 by whom she hath One Child named Sarah aged about Ten Years but whether living or not this Examinant does not know Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Change Court in the Parish of St. Clement Danes & lived therein upwards of One Year at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds and then her said Husband quitted the same about Christmas last from whener he removed to a House in Exeter Street in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr where he now lives at the Yearly Rent of Twenty three pounds and hath kept the same about half a Year as she has been Informed by One of the Overseers of the said Parish of St. Martin in the Fields which Information she verily bels. to be True

James Birks and William Gyblett Overseers of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes maketh Oath that Robt Scutt who has now left or deserted his Wife and Three Children Namely Mary Anne aged upwards of Six Years Elizth . Aged about 5 Years and Sarah aged about 12 Months Says that the said Robt. Scutt Rented and lived in a House known by the Sign of the Mitre Alehouse in Chancery Lane in the Parish of St. Dunstans in the West in the City of London for Two Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of of Twenty Pounds and upwards hath quitted his said House about 4 Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year as the said Robt. Scutt hath since Informed this Deponents and which this Informant verily believes to be true

Mary Walton Aged about thirty three Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Thomas Walton (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at Portsmouth in the County of Southampton about Eleven Years ago and by whom she hath three Children now living namely Ann Aged about Seven Years John Aged about Six Years and Thomas Aged about Six Months Says that her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Whites Alley in the Liberty of the Rolls for Six Months or thereabouts at the the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds hath quitted the same about Twelve Months ago and after he quitted the same he never Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Martha Hillton Aged about Twenty Nine Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of William Hillton gone from her with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes upwards of four Years Ago and by whom she hath one Child now living namely John William Aged about two Years Says that her said Husband Served Six Years the latter part of his Apprenticeship with one Mr: Harding a Hatter in little East Cheap in the Parish of Saint Andrew Hubbard in the City of London (as her said Husband has often informed her and which information she this Examinant Verily believes to be true) and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Thomas Aged about Twenty Years on her Oath Says she never was Married nor ever was an Apprentice Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father was a Welchman and never gained a Settlement in England to her knowledge or belief either by Renting Ten Pounds a Year or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says she was born in Warwick Stables in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex as her said Father and Mother has often informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true

Sarah Masters Aged about thirty Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of William Masters (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St: Andrew Holborn about Nine Years ago and by whom she hath three Children now living Namely William Aged about Six Years Sarah Aged about five Years and Elizabeth Aged about one Month Says that her said Husband Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr: Hall a Button Maker in three Fox Court Long Lane in the Parish of Saint Sepulchre in the City of London and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Jane Chapman Aged about Twenty Seven Years on her Oath Says she never was Married and that she lived a hired Yearly Servant with the Bishop of Worcester in Upper Brook Street in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex upwards of two Years at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted her said Service about four Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year And further upon her Oath Says that on the Second day of November One Thousand Seven Hundred and Sixty Nine she was delivered of a Male Bastard Child in the House of Thomas Wilson in Burleigh Court in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster which hath since been Baptized by the Name of Anthony And that Anthony Coleman late a Servant with Mr: Mylne of Arrundel Street in the Strand is the true and real Father of the said Male Bastard Child of which she was so delivered as aforesaid

Jane Massa Aged about Thirty four Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Thomas Massa (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the Parish of Saint Pauls Covent Garden about fourteen Years Ago and by whom she hath five Children now living Vizt: Thomas Aged about thirteen Years William Aged about Eleven Years Muchfruit Aged about Nine Years (the before mentioned three being already provided for) Charlott Aged about Seven Years and Ann Aged about One Year and on half Says that her said Husband Rented three separate Farms in the Parish of South Weal in the County of Essex for several Years at the Yearly Rent of Sixty Pounds and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said Farm about three Years ago and after he quitted the same he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year to this Examinants knowledge or belief

Eleanor Gordon Aged about Forty Six Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Thomas Gordon who has been dead about four Years Says that her said Husband was Bound an Apprentice to Thomas Gordon her said Husband's Father by the Churchwardens and Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster and Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with his said Father who then kept a House in Mays Buildings in the aforesaid Parish of Saint Martin's and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year to her knowledge or belief

Mary Fox Aged about Twenty Years on her Oath says she never was Married nor ever Rented Ten pounds a Year or paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year Says her Father who was is by Trade a Bird Cage maker Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Thomas Greenaway a Bird Cage maker the Corner of Gilt Spur Street in the Parish of St. Sepulchres in the City of London and after her said Father was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year to her knowledge or beleif.

Nicholas Logan Aged about Thirty five Years on his Oath Says he never was Married nor ever Rented House or paid Taxes Says he lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Richard Edwards a Gardiner at the Neat Houses in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex for one Year at the Yearly Wages of Twelve Guineas hath quitted his said Service about fourteen Months ago since which time he never Rented House or paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

William Devald Aged about Sixty One Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Jane his New Wife at the Parish Church of St. George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex about 15 Years Ago by whom he hath no Children now living Says that before his said Intermarriage and whilst he was a Single Man he lived a hired Yearly Servant with the late Major Barton in half Moon Street Piccadilly in the said Parish of Saint George Hanover Square for Two Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of Ten pounds & afterwards married to his said Wife and Continued to live with his said Master for Seven Years longer and to the time of his sd Masters Death and after his said Masters Death he never rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Sarah Masters Aged about Thirty Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of William Masters (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holborn about Nine Years ago and by whom she hath three Two Children now living namely Wm. Aged about Three Six Years & Sarah Aged about five Years Says her said Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Hall a Button Maker in the Parish of St. Sepulchre without in the County of Middlesex and after he was out of his sd Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Ann Lawrence Aged about fifteen Years upon Oath Says she never was married nor ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year; Says she has been Informed and verily believes that she was born in King Street Bloomsbury in the County of Middlesex And Says she has been in the Workhouse in the said Parish of St. Giles for many Years and has not been out from thence above a Week.

Mary Hyslop Aged about fifty Nine Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Wm. Hyslop (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at Dublin in Ireland forty Years ago Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Wardour Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr . for five Years and upwards at the Yearly Rent of Thirty Pounds and paid all parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about five Years ago and after quitting the same her said Husband never Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year neither hath this Examinant since her sd. Husbands having her

Thomas Bradley Aged about 47 Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Ann his late Wife at the Fleet London about twenty four Years ago and who has been Dead about twelve Years Says he was bound Apprentice to and served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one John Hosker a Cabinett maker in the Parish of Saint Mary Islington in the County of Middlesex and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Harris Aged about Twenty Years on her Oath says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Thos. Hughes a Taylor in Piccadilly in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr . for Eighteen Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted her said Service her said Service about four Years and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Celo Sewrey Aged about Twenty Nine Years on her Oath Says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. James Tew Attorney at Law Cliffords Inn Passage in the Parish of Saint Dunstan in the West London upwards of Three Years at the Yearly Wages of Six pounds hath quitted her said Service about Seven Years ago and after quitting her said Service she never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

James Bond one of the Beadles of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex on behalf of Catherine Porter an Infant Aged about fourteen Years upon Oath Says that the said Catherine Porter was bound an Apprentice by the Churchwardens and Overseers of the Poor of the said Parish by Indenture bearing Date the Eighth day of June One Thousand Seven hundred and Seventy to John Pearson of the Parish of Saint Andrew Holborn in the County of Middlesex Teaman untill the said Catherine Porter shod. Attain her full Age of Twenty one Years or day of Marriage according to the Statute in that Ca made and provided as by the sd. Indentures of Apprenticeship relation being thereunto had may Appear And further Says that the said Catherine Porter never was Assigned Over to any other Person nor ever gained any or Subsequent Settlement to the Knowledge or belief of this Examinant

Joseph Cooper Aged about fifteen Years on his Oath Says he never Rented 10 pounds paid Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says his late Father William Cooper served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Knight a Plaisterer in Petty France in the Parish of Saint Margarets Westmr . and after as he has often heard his Mother say and which he verily believes to be true and after his said Fathers Death this Examinant was put into the Workhouse belonging to the said Parish of Saint Margarett where he Continued for Eight Years or thereabout untill he was discharged about a Year and a Quarter ago & has had Three Places since in any one of which he did not live above Seven Months

Mary Whittey Aged about Sixty five Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of John Whittey with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Andrews about Thirty Years Ago Says that her said Husband lived and Rented a House at Hatton Wall in the said Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn in the County of Middx for Three Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Sixteen Pounds hath quitted the said House about Twenty Three Years ago and after her said Husband quitted the same he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year neither hath this Examinant since her sd. Husbands Death ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Dorothy Gey Aged about Sixty Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of John Gey who has been Dead about Six Months and with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew in the County of Middlesex about 27 Years Ago says her said Husband before his said Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived a Hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Wm. Dolley an Iron Monger in Holbourn aforesaid above the Bars Upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Nine Pounds as her said Husband has often informed her And which Information She verily beleives to be true and after he Quitted his said Service he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for One Year.

Susannah Hester Surlant aged about Sixty four Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Anthony Clod Surlant who has been Dead about Thirty five Years ago Says that her said Husband was a Native of France and never gained a Settlement in London to her Knowledge or belief Says that she was born in Grafton Street in the Parish of Saint Anns Westmr . at one Mr. Gregory a Bakers as her Mother has often Informed her and which Information she verily bels. to be true And Says that this Examinant never Rented House Paid Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Murtagh Mc. Avoy Aged about fifty Years on his Oath he is now a Widower and hath no Child or Children Says he Rented and lived in a House in Leg Alley long Acre for several Years in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds and Paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Ten Years ago and after he quitted the same he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Thos. Adams Aged about Twenty Nine Years on his Oath says he Intermarried with Elizabeth his Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the fields about Eight Years ago by whom he hath Two Children now living Vizt. Elizth . Aged about Seven Years and Ann Aged about Three Years Says before his sd Intermarriage and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a Covenanted Servant with Mr. Charles Pearce a Taylor in Castle Street in the said Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr for Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Six pounds for the first Year and Eight Pounds for the last Year hath quitted his sd Service about fourteen Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a Yearly hired Servant for one Year

Elizabeth Goodall Aged about Thirty Years on her Oath Says she never was married nor ever Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Thos. Latter a Staymaker in the Precinct of the Savoy in the Dutchy Liberty of Lancaster upwards of Three Years and an half at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Eight Months ago & hath not since she quitted the same done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement And further upon her Oath Says that on the 13th. day of Decr. last past she was delivered of a Female Bastard Child in the House of Mr. Berry a Pawnbroker in Wych Street in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westmr. which hath since been baptized Elizabeth and that John Hooton late a Partner with Mr. Geeves a Wine Merchant near Craven buildings in the Strand is the true and real Father of the said Female Bastard Child of which she was delivered as aforesaid.

Margaret Farrell Aged about Twenty Two Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of James Farrell (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at Duke Street Chapel in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex about five Years ago Says that her said Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one Patrick Smith a Cowkeeper at Battle Bridge in the Parish of Saint Pancras in the sd County of Middlesex for Two Years or Upwards at the Yearly Wages of Six pounds hath quitted his said Service about five Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented Ten pounds a Year or paid Taxes.

Ann Anthony Aged about Twenty Two Years on her Oath Says she never was Married Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Shipley a Perukemaker in Gutter Lane in the Parish of Saint Michael Woodstreet Vedast London for one Year at the Yearly Wages of Three Pounds Ten Shillings hath quitted her said Service about three Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yrly Servant for one Year

Mary Gordon Aged about Nineteen Year on her Oath Says she never was married nor ever Rented Ten pounds a Year or Paid Taxes was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her late Father Robert Gordon Rented and lived in a House in Charles Court Strand in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Sixteen Years or thereabouts as her Father and Mother has often Informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true

Elizth. Young Aged about Twenty four Years on her Oath Says she never was married nor Ever Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Benjamin Birch a Cloth Drawer in Bell Alley in the Parish of St. Stephen Walbrook in the City of London upwards of four Years at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds Ten Shillings hath quitted her said Service about three Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Gordon Aged about Nineteen Years on her Oath Says she never was married nor ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father Robert Gordon Rented and lived in a House in Beauchamp Street in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn in the County of MIddlesex to the best of this Examts. knowledge of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds lived therein about Nine Months and then quitted the same as her said Father and Mother has often Informed her and which Information she verily bels. to be true hath quitted the said House about Nine Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented Ten pounds a Year or Paid Taxes as this Examinant knows of or believes

Mary Gordon Aged about Nineteen Years on her Oath Says she never was married nor ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father Robert Gordon Rented and lived in a House in Beauchamp Street in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn in the County of Middlesex to the best of this Examts. knowledge of the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds lived therein about Nine Months and then quitted the same as her said Father and Mother has often Informed her and which Information she verily bels. to be true hath quitted the said House about Nine Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented Ten pounds a Year or Paid Taxes as this Examinant knows of or believes

Mary Row Aged about Thirty Years on behalf of Mathew Row her Husband who now lies ill of a Fever on her Oath Says she Intermarried with her said Husband at the Parish Church of Cripplegate London about Three Years & an half ago and by whom she hath Two Children now living Vizt. Francis Aged about Two Years and Charles Aged about One Month Says her said Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman lived a Hired Yearly Servant with Mrs. Fletcher at the Devil Tavern Temple Bar in the Parish of Saint Dunstans in the West London for several Years at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds as her said Husband has often Informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true hath quitted his said Service about five Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Charles Kelly Aged about Twenty Years on behalf of Mary Kelly his Sister an Infant Aged about Eleven Years on his Oath Says the sd Mary Kelly was bound Apprentice by the Churchwardens & Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Christ Church Southwark in the County of Surry by Indenture bearing Date the 30th. of August last past to Jane Nugent of the Parish of St. John Clerkenwell in the sd County of Middlesex untill the said Jane Mary shod Attain the Age of Twenty One Years or day of Marriage (According to the Statute in that Case made and Provided) as by the said Indentures relation being thereunto had may more fully Appear And further says that the said Mary Kelly served four Months of her sd Apprenticeship when her said Mistress run away from her Habitation and knows not what is become of her And lastly Says that the sd Mary Kelly never was Assigned over to any Person whatever or ever gained any or Subsequent Settlement.

Ann Grimes Aged about Twenty Two Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Thos. Grimes Gone from her with whom she Intermarried at Northampton upwards of Three Years ago and by whom she hath One Child named Elizth . Aged about Sixteen Months Says that her said Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Thos. Ogleby a Shoemaker in German Street in the Parish of St. James in ye. Liberty of Westminster upwards of Seventeen Years Ago since which time he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year as her said Husband has often Informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true.

William Bradshaw Aged about Seventy four Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Christiana his late Wife at the Parish Church of St. Anns Aldersgate about forty Seven Years ago and who has been Dead about four Years Says he Rented and lived in a House in Carpenters Court in the Parish of Saint Mary Aldermanbury upwards of Six Years at the Yearly Rent of Eighteen Pounds and Paid all parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted his said House about Thirty four Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same Ever Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Sarah Marsh Aged about Twenty Two Yrs. on her Oath Says she never was married nor ever Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Spencer a Widow Lady in Castle Yard in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn in that Part which is in the City of London upwards of one Year at the Yearly Wages of four Pounds hath quitted her sd Service upwards of four Years ago & hath not since she quitted her said Service she never Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Henrietta Kitchen Aged about 26 Years on her Oath says she never was married nor ever Rented house or Paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Scott a Victualler in Little Russell Street in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for fifteen Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted her said Service about four Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Carolina Rance Aged about Sixty Three Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of John Rance with whom she Intermarried at the Fleet London about Thirty Three Years ago and who has been dead about four Months Says that her said late Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Richd. Lucas of the Parish of Hamersmith in the County of Middlesex Cordwainer as her said Husband has often informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true and as Appears to this Examinant by Indentures bearing date the Eighth day of February 1721. And Says that her said late Husband after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never rented Ten pounds a Year Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year to her knowledge or beleif.

Ann Crick Aged upwards of fifty Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of John Crick who has been dead about fourteen Years Says that being a Widow and without Child or Children she lived a Hired Yearly Servant with one Mr Proudfoot in Gate Street in the Parish of St Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex for Three Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of four Pound hath quitted her said Service about four Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

William Gyblett one of the Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster on behalf of Mary Bedward an Infant aged about fourteen Years upon Oath says that the said Mary Bedward was bound an Apprentice by the Churchwardens and Overseers of the Poor of the said Parish by Indenture bearing Date the 16th. day of October 1770 to Margaret Lebatt of the Parish of of Kensington in the County of Middlesex Widow untill the said Mary Bedward shod. Accomplish her full Age of Twenty One Years or Day of Marriage according to the Statute in that Case made and provided as by the said Indentures of Apprenticeship relation being thereunto had may more fully Appear And further says that the said Mary Bedward never was Assigned to any or person nor ever gained any other Subsequent Settlement to his knowledge or beleif

John Dixon Aged fifty Two Years on his Oath Says that he Rented and lived in a House Known by the Name or Sign of the Feathers in little Newport Street in the Parish of Saint Anns Soho in the Liberty of Westminster for Six Years and upwards at the Yearly Rent of Twenty four pounds hath quitted the same about Ten Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Williams Aged about fifty Nine Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of John Williams who has been dead about Eight Years Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Blue Stile in Greenwich in the County of Kent upwards of five Years at the Yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Ten Years ago and hath not since quitting the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Ann Watkins Aged about fifty Eight Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of John Watkins who has been dead about fifteen Years Says that being a Widow and without Child or Children (except Two who are now provided for) she went to live as a hired Yearly Servant at the Westminster Infermary in the Parish of St. Margarets in the Liberty of Westminster for Two Years and Three Months at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds Ten Shillings hath quitted her said Service about Three Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented Ten pounds a Year Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for One Year.

Jane Plenius Aged about Twenty four Years on her Oath Says she never was married or ever Rented House or Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father Rented and lived in a House in South Audley Street Grosvenor Square in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex for Ten Years and upwards at the Yearly Rent of fifty Pounds hath quitted the said House about Eight Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year or Paid Taxes.

Elizth. Studd Aged about fifty Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Thos. Studd with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Martins about Eight Months ago Says that her said Husband Rented and lived in a House known by the Sign of the White Bear in little Newport Street in the Parish of Saint Anns Soho in the Liberty of Westminster for Six Months at the Yearly Rent of fifty Pounds and Paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Two Months ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House or paid Taxes.

Jane Spickanall Aged about Twenty four Years on her Oath says she never was married nor ever Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived as a Hired Yearly Servant with Sir John Hind Cotton in Charles Street Berkley Square in the Parish of St. George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex for Seventeen Months or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Six pounds Six Shillings hath quitted her said Service about five Years ago and hath not since she quitted her said Service ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Thomas Gent Aged about Thirty five Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Eleanor is now Wife at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the Fields about fifteen Years ago by whom he hath Two Children now living Namely George Aged about Eight Years and Thomas Aged about Six Years Says he was bound an Apprentice to one Thos. Oakill a Stone Mason in Long Acre in the said Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields by Indenture Dated the day of And was by Indenture of Assignment soon afterwards Assigned over to one Jarvis Snape a Goldbeater in the afsd. Parish of St. Martin in the Fields and served the said Mr. Snape under the lastmentd. Indre of Assignment Seven Years and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Jane Finch Aged about forty Nine Years on her Oath says she never was married nor ever Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one William Barrington Esqr . in Little Ormond Street in the Parish in the Parish of St. Andrew Holbourn in the County of Middlesex for Two Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of Eight Pounds or thereabouts hath quitted her said Service about Eleven Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Seth Jeffrreys Aged about Sixty Three Years on his Oath Saith he Intermarried with with Mary his Wife at the Parish Church of Cirencester about forty Years ago and by whom he hath Three Childn Now provided for Says he was bound an Apprentice to one Giles Scott a Cordwainer and served him Seven Years in the said Parish of Cirencester in the County of Gloucester and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never rented Ten pounds a Year Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Jane Tandy Aged about Twenty Three Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Joseph Wilton Esqr . in Great Portland Street in the Parish of Saint Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex for Two Years and an half at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Twelve Months ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizth. Sells Aged about Twenty Three Years on her Oath Says she never was Married was an Apprentice or Rented House Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Barclay at Bray in the Parish of Bray in the County of Berks for Two Years at the Yearly wages of Six Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Three Years ago and hath not since she quitted her said Service ever Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Letitia Gosford Aged about Twenty Three Years on her Oath says she never was Married was an Apprentice Rented or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one William Tomlins a Lighterman at Twickenham in the County of Middlesex as her said Father has often Informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never gained any other Subsequent Settlement to her knowledge or belief

Elizth. Watkins aged about Seventeen Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or was an Apprentice Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Hilliard a Clerk in Goldsmiths Hall for one Year and an half at the Yearly wages of fifty Two Shillings a Year hath quitted her said service about Two Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Margarett Jones Aged about Twenty Two Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Joseph Jones (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of St. Margarets Westmr . about Six Years ago and by whom she hath Two Children now living Sarah Ann Aged about Two Years and Margt . aged about one Month Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Exeter Street in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for One Year & Three Quarters at the Yearly Rent of Twenty four Pounds and Paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House upwards of half a Year ago & hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House or Paid Taxes

Patty Aldridge Aged about Eighteen Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Daniel Sutton a Surgeon at Kensington Gore in the Parish of Saint Margarets in the Liberty of Westminster for One Year and an half at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Six Months ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Elizabeth Powell Aged about Twenty four Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Holbert a Cheesemonger in Great Tower Street in the Parish of Saint Dunstans in the East in the City of London for One Year and an half at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service one Year and an half ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Sarah Boulter Aged about Thirty Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a Hired Yearly Servant with with one John Henry at the Golden Hart in Parkers Lane in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex upwards of one Year at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Ten Months ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented Ten pounds a Year or paid Taxes.

Sarah Smith Aged about Sixteen Years on her Oath Says she never was Married Rented House was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father Alexr. Smith Rented and lived in a House in Little Scotland Yard known by the Name of the Windsor Castle in the Parish of Saint of Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Several Years at Yearly Rent of fifteen Pounds or thereabout & her said Father died Says that since her said Fathers Death she hath done no Act whereby to gain as Subsequent Settlement

Elizth. Lawes Aged about Thirty Two Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of George Lawes who has been dead about Eight Months ago and with when she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Margaretts Westminster above Seventeen Years ago Says her said Husband was bound an Apprentice to one Mr. Jackson a Grocer in College Street in the said Parish of St. Margarets Westminster & Served five Years the first part of his Apprenticeship and then Married to this Examinant and his Master gave him up his Indentures and after his sd. late Husband left his said Master he never Rented House or paid Taxes neither hath this Examinant done Any Act since her said late Husbands Death whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement.

Sarah Patience Aged about Twenty Two Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a Hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Goodwin a Surgeon in Blacks Fields in the Parish of Saint Johns Southwark in the County of surry for one Year & an half or thereabouts at the Yearly Wages of four pounds hath quitted her said Service about Three Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

John Hughes Aged about Sixty Six Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with his late Wife Sarah at Salisbury about forty Years ago and who has been dead near Eighteen Years Says he rented and lived in a House in Little German Street in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster for Eighteen Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Thirty Pounds and paid all parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about fourteen Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Ann Wilson aged about Sixty One Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of John Wilson who has been dead about Sixteen Years as she has been Informed and Verily believes and with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Chalfont about 38 Years ago Says her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in Chancery Lane in the Parish of Saint Dunstans in the West London upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Rent of Ten pounds and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about sixteen Years ago and after quitting the Same neither her said Husband nor this Examinant hath done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent

Elizabeth Powell aged about fifty Seven Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Benjamin Powell who now lives with a Relation at Barnett Says her said Husband Rented a House in Bedford Court Theobalds Row in the parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn above the Barrs in the County of Middlesex for Two Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Twelve Pounds and quitted same about Twelve Years ago and hath not since she quitted the said House ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Taxes

Mary Harreman Aged about forty Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a Hired Yearly Servant with Charles Cartwright at the Sign of the Bibbs in Great Shire Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex for three Years and upwards at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Services upwards of Two Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizabeth Sedgwick Aged about Thirty Eight years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of John Sedgwick (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the Fleet London about 18 Years ago Says that her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in a Court Opposite Seymours Court in little Chandos Street in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Two Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Ten pounds hath quitted the said House about Thirteen Years ago & hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizth. Reeves aged about 40 Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Wm. Reeves gone from her with whom she Intermarried at the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields the 1st. day of April five years last past And by whom she hath one Child now living named Sarah aged about 9 Months Says her said late Husband served Seven years apprenticeship with one Mr. Bellamy a Book binder in Clement Lane in Lombard Street in the Parish of Saint Edmund the Kings in the City of London and After he was out of his said apprentice Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one Year

Edward Harris Aged about forty Eight Years on his Oath Says he never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says he lived a hired yearly Servant with one Thomas Foley Esqr . in the Capacity of a Groom in the Parish of St. Mary Le Bone in the County of Middlesex for five years and an half at the Yearly Wages of Ten Guineas besides Cloaths Diet and Lodging hath Quitted his said Service ever since the Year 1751 and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired yearly Servant for one Year

Elizth. Ransford Aged about Twenty Three Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or served any Apprenticeship Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with John Cooper a Cabinet maker near the quieting place in the Parish of Great Marlow in the Country of Bucks for five Years upwards at the Yearly Wages Thirty Shillings for the first Year forty Shillings for the 2d. fifty Shillings for the 3d. Sixty Shillings for the 4th. & Three pounds Ten Shillings for the last Year hath quitted her said Service about five Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Thos. Hardye Aged about Thirty Years on his Oath Says he never was Married Rented House served any Apprenticeship Says he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one William Johnson a Butcher in Red Lyon Street in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for Two Years at the Yearly Wages for the first Year for Six Pounds and for the Second Year Eight pounds hath quitted his said Service about Three Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Mary Gemson Aged about Twenty one Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she served five Years Apprenticeship with one Thomas Lyon a Turrier in George Street in the Parish of Saint Leonard Foster in the Liberty of Saint Martin Le Grand and after she was out of her said Apprenticeship she never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizth. Plastow Aged about Twenty Nine Years on her Oath Says she never was Married Rented Ten pounds a year Paid Taxes Says she lived as a Covenanted Servant wth. one Mrs. Bowers a Mantua Maker in Craven Buildings Drury Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex to Learn Trade or Business for Two Years and her Aunt Christiana Lestie paid the sum of 10 pounds for that purpose and further Says that on the 5th. day of February 1765 she was delivered of a Female Bastard Child in the House of Mr. Weslim in the Parish of St. Mary Islington in the County of Middlesex which was on the 20th day of Febry. then next following Baptized by the Name of Christiana Pearson and Says that Thos. Tucker Father of the sd. Female Bastard Child died in July 1765 following and that this Examinant being very poor is not able to Maintain the same and that the said Child hath gained no Settlem. whatever otherwise than being Poor in the said Parish of St. Mary Islington

Cath: Foley Aged 26 years on her Oath Says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired yearly Servant wth. one Mr. John Hall at the Sign of the Nags Head in Carnaby Markett in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westminster for 15 Months at the Yearly Wages of £5. hath quitted her said Service about 4 Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same Ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one year And further Says that on the 10th. day of July 1766 she was delivered of a Female Bastard Child in the House of Mr. Check at a Cooks Shop in Hungerford Markett in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster which was soon Afterwards Cristened by the Name of Mary Crossby And Says that one Mick. Crossby a Porter & an Irishman which was Passed as a Vagrant about Twelve Months ago to Ireland is the Father of the said Child & that the said Child hath gained no Settlement since her Birth.

Mary Every aged about 40 Years on her Oath Says she never was Married Rented House or Paid Taxes Says she lived a Hired Yearly Servant with one Lamb Esqr . in Lincolns Inn Fields in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex upwards of fourteen Months at the Yearly Wages of £8. hath quitted her said Service about 11 Years ago & hath not since she quitted the same Ever Rented House pd. Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year And further Says that on the 25th. day of Novr. 1771 she was delivered of a Female Bastard Child in the House of Mr. Fewster at the Hatt & Feather in Milford Lane in the Parish of St. Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex which was soon afterwards baptized Mary Ann Woodward and now aged 16 Months And further Says that one Wm. Woodward who is since dead was the real and true Father of the said Female Bastard Child

Mary Hallier Aged about Twenty Seven Years On her Oath says she never was married Rented House paid Taxes or Served any Apprenticeship whatever says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one James Burns a Taylor in King Street in the Parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster for Eighteen Months at the Yearly Wages of five Guineas hath quitted her said Service about four Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Martha Hodges Aged about Twenty One Years on her Oath Says she never was Married Rented House or ever served any Apprenticeship Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. John Gibbs a Chymist in the Strand in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for one Year at the Yearly Wages of four pounds hath quitted the sd. last mentioned Service about a Year ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Duncan Mc Arthur Aged about forty Three Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Agnes his Wife at the City of Edinburgh about Twenty Years ago and by whom he hath no Children Says that he this Examinant Rented and lived in a House in Lancaster court in the Strand in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Nine Months at the Yearly Rent of Thirty Pounds and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House about Eleven years ago and hath not since he quitted the same Ever Rented House or paid Taxes

Margaret Clinton Aged about fifty Eight Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Robt. Clinton (gone from her) and with whom she Intermarried at the Fleet London about the Year 1737 Says her said late Husband was an Irishman and never gained any. Settlement in England to her knowledge or belief Says that before her Said Intermarriage and which she was a Singlewoman she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. John Horbin a Distiller in Bishopgate Street in the Parish of St. Botolph Bishopgate London upwards of 3 years at the Yearly Wages of £5. and quitted her said Service upwards of 37 Years ago & hath not since she quitted her said service done any Act whereby to gain any Subsequent Settlemt.

Jane Morris Aged about forty five Years on her Oath says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Henry Bullock in Thrift Street in the Parish of Saint Anns Soho in the Liberty of Westminster for three Years at the Yearly Wages of Seven Guineas hath quitted the last mentioned Service upwards of Ten Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year.

Elizabeth Highliant Singlewoman Aged about Nineteen Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House was an Apprentice or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says her Father James Highliant served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Burn a Perukemaker in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr . as her said Mother has often Informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true and further says she never lived a hired Yearly Servant in any place whatever or knows no further or any otherwise of her Settlement than as before mentioned.

Mary Lewis Aged about Thirty Seven Years on her Oath says she never married Rented House or paid Taxes Says her late Father Thomas Lewis Rented and lived in a House in Round Court in the Strand in the parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster for Thirty Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of £14 or thereabouts & where he died Says that since her said Fathers Death this Examinant never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Robert Winter on the behalf of Thomas Watson an Infant Aged about three Years on his Oath says that Wm . & Elizth. Watson the Father & Mother of the said Thomas Watson are run away and does not know what is become of them or either of them And further says that the said Wm. Watson Father of the said Thos. Watson Intermarried with the said Elizth. Watson at the Parish Church of St. Andrew Holbourn about seven Years ago as he has been Credibly Informed and Verily beleves And further Says that before the Intermarriage of the said Wm. Watson with Elizth. his Wife he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Thos. Prowse Esqr. Argyle Buildings in the Parish of St. James Westminster in the County of Middlesex in the Capacity of a Groom upwards of Three Years at the Yearly Wages of 12 Pounds hath quitted his said service about 8 Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House or paid Taxes.

Elenor Sills Aged about Thirty Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Samuel Sills (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at all hallows Staining London about Ten Years ago Says she has One Child by her said Husband now living Vizt. Robert Aged about Twelve Months Says her said Husband Rented and lived in a House in Walkers Court in the Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westmr . for two Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds and paid all parish Taxes due for the same as her said Husband has often Informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true hath quitted his said House about Twenty Years ago and after he quitted the same he never Rented House or paid Taxes to her knowledge or beleif.

John Aylmer Aged about fifty four Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Martha his Wife who is now Aged about Seventy Years at the Parish Church of Saint Botolph Bishopgate London about Twenty five Years ago Says that before his said Intermarriage and whilst he was a Singleman he lived as a Covenanted Servant with one Mr. Lee a Taylor in Whistlers Court Cannon Street in the Parish of Saint Swithen in the City of London for Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Seven pounds hath quitted the said last mentioned Service upwards of Thirty Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented Ten pounds a Year paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

John Kingsley Aged about fifty five Years on his Oath says he never was married Rented House served any Apprenticeship or paid any Taxes whatever Says he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Carter a Hatter on London Bridge in the Parish of Saint Olave Southwark in the County of Surry for Three Years at the Yearly Wages if five pounds besides Diet and Lodings hath quitted his said service about Thirty Seven Years ago hath not Since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Sarah Mansell Aged about Twenty Years on her Oath Says never was married Rented House paid Taxes or served any Apprenticeship whatever Says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Elvey a Watchmaker in the New Buildings Fore Street in the Parish of Saint Giles's Cripplegate London for upwards of Two Years and an half at the Yearly Wages of Twenty Shillings for the first Year forty Shillings for the Second and Three pounds for the Third Year hath quitted the said last mentioned service about Three Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Baker aged about Twenty Nine Years on her Oath says she Intermarried with Christopher Baker her Husband at the Parish Church of St. Georges Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex about Seven Years ago and by whom she hath Two Children now living Vizt. Ann Aged about Six Years and Christopher Aged about five Months Says her said Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a singleman he lived a hired Yearly Servant with The Right Honble The Earl Ferrers in Great George Street in the Parish of Saint Margarets in the Liberty of Westminster upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Twenty five Pounds besides Diet & Lodgings hath quitted his said Service about five Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House or paid Taxes or done any or Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Thos. Harris Aged about Seventy Two Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Mary his late Wife at Fulham Middx about forty Seven Years ago & who has been dead about 29 Years Says he has Two Children by his said late Wife both of which are now provided for Says that before his Intermarriage with his said late Wife & whilst he was a Singleman he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one George Turbin a Farmer at Wormwell Wood Lane in the Parish of Hammersmith in the County of Middlesex upwards of one Year at the Yearly Wages of fifty Shillings besides diet & Lodging Says that after he quitted that Service he bound himself Apprentice to one Edward Crabb a Bargmen but the said Edwd. Crabb being a Certificated Man from Mortlake gained no Settlement thereby as he has been Informed that soon after he had served the said Crabb for seven Years he Intermarried with his late Wife and rented and lived in a House at Hamersmith aforesaid for sevl. Years at the Yearly Rent of four pounds and Paid poors Rate due for the same and after he quitted the said House at Hammersmith he never Rented House of Ten pounds P Ann. or ever was rated to or paid any Taxes Whatever neither hath this Examinant done any Act than as before mentioned whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlemt.

Elinor Pullen Aged about 41 Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of John Pullen (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at St. Mary White Chapell about 18 Years ago by whom she hath 2 Children now living Vizt. John Aged about 12 Years and Edwd . aged about 8 Years says her Husband is an Irishman & never gained any Settlemt. in England to her knowledge or belief Says that before her said Intermarriage with her said Husband and whilst this Examinant was a Singlewoman she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Sowns a Perukemaker in Newgate Street in the Parish of Christs Church London upwds. of 3 Years at the Yearly Wages of £4. hath quitted her said Service about 15 years ago & hath not since she quitted the same Her said Husband never Rented £10 P Ann. paid Taxes (Except Scavenger & Watch) nor done any act where by to gain a Subsequent Settlement.

Joseph Chappellon aged about 88 Years on his Oath says he never was married Rented Ten pounds a Year or Paid Taxes Says he lived as a hired yearly Servant with one Mr. Saml. Norman a Wollen Draper at Henley upon Thames in the County of Oxford upwards of Three Years at the Yearly Wages of Twenty Pounds hath quitted his said Services upwards of 4 years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented Ten Pounds a Year Paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one year.

Elizabeth Broadmeadow Aged about Twenty Nine Year on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a Yearly hired Servant with one Mr. Taylor a Silk Mercer on Little Tower Hill in the Parish of Saint Botolph without Aldgate London upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Seven Pounds hath quitted her said Service about four Months ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House or paid Taxes.

Sarah Avery Aged about Thirty Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Isaac Avery (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at St. James in the City of Bristol about Twelve Years Ago and by whom she hath Three Children now living Namely Maria Aged about Ten Years John Aged about four Years and Isaac Aged about one Year Says that her said Husband Rented Part of a House of one Richard Wilkin in Vino Street near Chandos Street Vizt. a Shop Parlour & Coal Cellar & which had heretofore Seperate Water & Vault & other Conveniences & which was also a Seperate Tenement from Mr. Wilkins House which he lived in and Rented the same for One Year and Three Quaters at the Yearly Rent of Ten Guineas but never paid any Poors Rate due for the same hath quitted the same about Three Years ago and Says that her said Husband never Served any Apprenticeship or lived as any hired Yearly Servant before Marriage to her Knowlege or belief or ever gained any other Settlemt. than as before mentioned

Sarah Collins Aged about Twenty four Years on her Oath Says she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes says she lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Richard Serace the Sign of the Greyhound in Brick Street in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex upwards of One Year at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds Ten Shillings hath quitted her said Service upwards of Two Years ago and hath not since she quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Margaret Peling Aged about Twenty Eight years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of Henry Peling (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the Island of Minorca about Eight years ago and by whom she hath one Child now living named Stephen aged upwards of two years Says her said Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Singleman lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one John Thomas in Pepper Street in the Parish of Wem in the County of Salop for one Year at the Yearly Wages of Three pounds or thereabouts as her said Husband has often Informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true hath quitted his said Service about Fourteen Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or lived a Hired Yearly Servant for one Year.
