Samuel Harrison on or behalf of Mary Harrison on who he looks upon to be a Lunatick Aged about forty four Years on his Oath Says she is the Wife of Thomas Harrison (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at the Abbey Church in the County of Salop about Twelve Years ago and by whom she hath one Child now living as he believes at Edgmount in Shropshire named Thomas aged about Seven Years Says her said Husband served Seven Years Apprenticeship with his Father in the aforesaid in the Parish of Newport has she belonged to Parish of Edgmount in the said County of Salop he being a Certificated Man and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year or paid Taxes or otherwise Gained any other subsequent Settlement than as aforesaid to his knowledge or belief

Mathew Welch aged about Twenty Six Years (on the behalf of Nathan Hart a Lunatick Aged about Twenty Three Years on his Oath says the said Nathan Hart never was married Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year Says that his Father Nathan Hart (who is now dead) Rented and lived in a House known by the Name or Sign of Harts Academy in Chancery Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex for three Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Thirty five Pounds or thereabouts hath quitted the said House upwards of four Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House or Paid Taxes to his knowl or beleif And further saith that after the Death of the said Nathan Hart the Father this Examinant and the said Nathan Hart the Son Rented Lodgings or Appartments of one Henry Pars in the Strand in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex for four Years or thereabouts at the Yearly Rent of Thirty Pounds and upwards but was never Rated to or paid Taxes due for the same and therefore cannot set forth whr. this Examinant or the said Nathan Hart his partner gained any Settlemt. thereby.

Andrew Durand aged about Twenty Eight Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Arm his late Wife Ann at the Parish Church of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex about five Years ago and by whom he hath three Children now living Vizt. Andrew aged about three Years Judith Aged about one Years & an half & Mary Ann aged about fourteen Days Says he served 7 Years Apprenticeship with one Lazarus Desbois Cabinet and Clock base Maker in Monmouth Court Earl Street in the Parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex and after he was out of his said Apprentice- -ship he never Rented House or paid Taxes or done any other act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Ralph Miers aged about fifty Nine Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with his late Wife at the Parish Church of St. Martin in the Fields upwards of thirty Years ago and who has been dead about Seven Months and by whom he hath no Children livings Says he rented and lived in a House the Corner of Little Wyld Street in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex upwards of One Year & an half at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the same upwards of Twenty Eight Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Jane Bucham Aged about Thirty Six Years on her Oath Say she never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she lived a Hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Ann Guy who kept a House in Northumbland Street Charing Cross in the Parish of St. Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westmr. & County of Middx for Two Years or upwards at the Yearly Wages of five Pounds hath quitted her said Service about Six Months ago and hath not since she quitted her said Service done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Dorothy Gey Aged about Sixty one Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of John Gey who has been dead about Eighteen Months ago with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew in the County of Middlesex about Twenty Eight Years ago Says her said Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst he was a Single man he lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mr. Dolley an Ironmonger in Holbourn above the Bars in the Sd. County of Middlesex upwards of Two Years at the Yearly Wages of Nine Pounds as her said Husband has often Informed her and which Information she verily believes to be true and after he quitted his said Service he never Rented House or paid Taxes or otherwise gained any other Subsequent Settlement neither hath this Examinant since her sd. Husband Death

William English Aged about Forty Three Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Margaret his Wife gone from him at the Parish Church of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr . upwards of 20 Years ago and by whom he hath two Children Vizt. William Aged about Twenty Years (now provided for) and Margaret aged about Eight Years Says he served 5 Years Clerkship with one Mr. Newland an Attorney in Castle Yard in the Parish of St. Andrew Holborn London and after he was out of his said Clerkship he never Rented Ten Pounds a Year paid Taxes or hath ever done any other Act whereby to gain a subsequent Settlemt.

James Warner Aged about Thirty Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Mary his Wife at the Parish Church of St. James in the Liberty of West upwards of Six Years ago and by whom he hath Two Children now living namely John Aged about five Years and Elizabeth Aged about Three Months Says he Rented and lived in a House in Richmond Street in the said Parish of Saint James in the Liberty of Westminster for Two Years or thereabout at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Six pounds and paid Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the same about four Years ago & hath not since he quitted the same ever rented House or paid Taxes.

Sarah Valentine Aged about Thirty Three Years on her Oath Says she Intermarried with her late Husband George Valentine at the Parish Church of Saint Clement Danes about a Eleven Years ago and by whom she hath Three Children now living Vizt. Susannah Aged Six Years George Aged upwards of Three Years and Mary Aged Sixteen Months Says her said Husband Served Seven Years Apprenticeship with one Mr. Jones a Taylor in Saint Martins Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster and after he was out of said Apprenticeship he never Rented House or paid Taxes or done any other thing whereby to gain a Subsequent. Settlement.

James Latimer Aged about fifty Three Years on his Oath Says he Intermarried with Temprance his Wife at the Parish of St. Brides otherwise Bridget about Twenty five Years ago and by whom he that Three Children now living (Two of which are now provided for) and the Goundgest of which is named William Aged about Ten Years Says he rented and lived in a House in York Buildings in the Parish of St. Martin in the Field Villers Street, Years about five Years at the Yearly Rent of Twenty four Pounds & paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted his said House near fifteen Years ago & hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or done any or Act where by to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Martha Harrison Aged about Twenty Eight Years on her Oath Says she is the Wife of John Harrison (gone from her) with whom she Intermarried at Croydon in Surry about five Years ago and by whom she hath no Children now living Says that the last House that her said Husband Rented was in Mermaid Court in the Parish of Saint George in the Borough of Southwark in the County of Surry who rented the Same hear half a Year at the Yearly Rent of fourteen Pounds hath quitted the same upwards of Two Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House or paid Taxes to her knowledge or beleif

Tompson Davis Aged about Twenty Years on behalf of his Father Thompson Davis who now lies ill on his Oath Says that his said Father has four Children now living by his late Mother Martha Tompson lately deceased Vizth. this Examinant who never gained any Settlement either by Renting House or serving any Apprenticeship or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year And further say that his said Father has Three other Children unprovided for Namely Elizabeth Aged about Ten Years Thomas Aged about Seven Years & Martha aged about five Years Says his said Father Rented and lived in a House on Holbourn Hill in the Liberty of Saffron Hill Hatton Garden in Ely Rents in the Parish of Saint Andrew Holbourn in the County of Middlesex for sevl. Years at the Yearly Rent of Thirty Pounds and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted his said House about four Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House paid Taxes or done any or Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement as his said Father has often Informed him & believes the same to be true

John Miller Aged about Twenty Eight Years on his Oath saith that he never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with one William North a Baker in Great Wyld Street Lincolns Inn Fields in the Parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex for One Year at the Yearly Wages of five pounds Twelve Shillings besides Diet & Lodging and after he quitted his said Service he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Ann Gray Aged about Twenty Nine Years on her Oath says she is the Wife of Henry Gray gone from her with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Saint Andrew Holbourn about five Years ago and by whom she hath no Children now living says her said Husband before his Intermarriage with this Examinant and whilst she was a Singleman lived a hired Yearly Servant with one Mrs. Austin who keep a Shop in Chick Lane for Ten Years or thereabout at the Yearly Wages of Ten Pounds as her said Husband has often Informed her and which Information she verily bels. to be true hath quitted his said Service upwards of four Years ago and hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House or paid Taxes to her knowledge or belief

Mary Stephenson aged about Ninteen Years on her Oath Says she never was Married Rented House or paid Taxes Says she was bound out an Apprentice by the Churchwardens & Overseers of the Poor of the Parish of Saint Mary White Chappel to one James Lawe a Weaver in High Street in the Hamlet of Mile and New Town in the Parish of St. Dunstan Stepney in the County of Middlesex and served five Years part of her said Apprenticeship and her Mistress Dying and her said Master gave up her Indrentures since which time she has done no Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement Either by Renting House or living a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Thomas Williams Aged about Thirty Four Years on her Oath Says he never was married Rented House or paid Taxes Says he was bound an Apprentice to one James Royle a Horse Girth maker in the Hatton Garden and lived with him upwards of five Years and then his said Master moved to Hogsdon in the Parish of Saint Leonard Shoreditch in the County of Middlesex where he Continued to live with his said Master for Two Years the last part of his Apprenticeship and after he was out of his said Apprenticeship he never Rented House paid Taxes or lived a hired Yearly Servant for one Year

Elizabeth Bucker aged about Thirty Three Years on her Oath Says she is the Widow of Richard Bucker who died about fortnight ago with whom she Intermarried at the Parish Church of Kingston upon Common near Portsmouth in the County of Hants about Eight Years ago by whom she hath Three Children now living Namely John Aged about Seven Years Mary Aged about Three Years and James Aged about Eight Months Says her said late Husbands Father was Born in the Parish of Bishop Stoke in the County of Southampton or otherwise belongs to the said Parish of Bishopstoke he having a Certificate therefrom Says her said late Husband Served Seven Yrs. Apprenticeship with his Father at Petworth in Sussex but he being a Certificated Man gained no Settlement thereby as she is Advised and bels. And further says that her said late Husband has of her Informed her he never gained any Settlement whatever orwise than as aforemd.

Charles Bass one of the Beadles of the Parish of St. Clement Danes maketh Oath that the Examination hereunto Annexed is a true Copy of an Examination taken out of the Examination Book kept by Mr. Tapper Deputy Vestry Clerk of the Parish of Saint Pauls Covent Garden and verily believes that Catherine Lindsey is the Daughter of Mary Lindsey deceased (by John Lindsey now in Scotland) her Husband as by the Examination of the said Mary Lindsey deceased may more fully appear.

Mary Goodall Aged about forty four Years on her Oath says she is the Widow of William Goodall who has been dead about Twelve Years and with whose she Intermarried at May Fair Chappel about Twenty Years ago and by whom she hath no Children now living. Says her said late Husband Rented and lived in a House in Gloucester Court St. James Street in the Parish of St. James in the Liberty of Westmr . upwards of one Year at the Yearly Rent of Twenty Pounds and paid all Parish Taxes due for the same hath quitted the said House upwards of fourteen Years ago & hath not since he quitted the same ever Rented House or paid Taxes neither hath this Examinant done any Act whereby to gain a Subsequent Settlement

Mary Nelson aged twenty one Years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that she lived as an hired Yearly Servant with his Grace the Dahia of Hamilton at the Yearly Wages of ten Guineas for about thirteen Months That she quitted his Service about a fortnight since, that she lived for upwards of forth Days before she quitted her said Service at his Grace House Grafton Street Piccadilly in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in this County of Middlesex and since quitting his Service hath not done any hit whereby to the best of his Knowledge Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement. and that she never has been married

James Edwards Aged about thirty Nine years Upon Oath saith that he Intermarried with his present Wife Elizabeth at the Old Church on Snow Hill Birmingham about twelve years ago by whom he hath now living two Children Namely Sarah Aged Seven years or thereabouts and William Aged One year five Months and upwards. That previous to his Marriage and while he was single not having any Child or Children he lived as an hired yearly Servant in the Capacity of Peter Warehouseman with Mesn. Lloyd of Territt at the Corner of Hart Street & Wood Street in the parish of St. Alphage in the City of London for Six years or thereabouts at the yearly Wages of £20 and since hath not by any means wtsoever acquired any other legal Settlement And Lastly that about Eight years ago being removed from Windsor to the said parish of St. Alphage as his last legal settlement was relieved by the said parish of St. Alphage

Frances Webb Singlewoman Aged 31 years or thereabouts Upon her Oath saith that she never was Married that she lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr. Henry Paul at the Apple Tree in Cold Bath Fields in the parish of St. Clement James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex about. Eight Months at the yearly Wages of £5 that then her said Master beingd Bankrupt and a Commission awarded agst. hired & Assees. appointed she continued a Servant in the same House as the Servant of the said Assees. with any Fresh hiring or Agreement whatsoever about Six Months at the Wages on the like Conditions & in the same capacity as with her said Master Paul that she quitted that Service the 5th. May 1790 that she hath not since lived as an hired yearly servant for a twelve Month together or done any other Act whereby she might obtain any Subsequent legal Settlement to the best of her knowledge or belief.

Ann Granville Aged 44 years or thereabouts Upon her oath saith that she never was Married that she Rented and Resided in an Apartment in Bedford Street Bedford Row in the parish of St. Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for about Seven Months at and under the yearly Rent of £10 for the first Six Months & the Weekly Rent of 4 for the remaining Month that she quitted the same to the best of the her Remembrance about Christmas 1788 and since hath not Rented any House or Lodging of £10 a year, lived as an hired yearly Servant for a twelve Month together nor done any other Act or thing whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement And that she is now Ill & unable to support herself

Elizabeth Tinner Single Woman aged fifty five Years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that she never was married that she lived for twelve Months and upwards with Charles Symonds at the Bedford Head Tavern in Southampton Street Covent Garden in the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden in the County of Middlesex . as his hired Yearly Servant at the Wages of seven Pounds a Year, that she quitted his Service about twenty six Years ago, and since quitting the same hath not lived as an hired Yearly Servant in any one Place nor with any one Person for twelve Months neither hath she rented any House or Tenement of the Yearly Value of ten Pounds, paid any Parochial Rates or Dues or done any Act, Matter or thing whereby to the best of her Knowledge, Information or belief she may have gained any Subsequent Settlement, and that she is poor and unable to Maintain herself

This woman was not removed before she Died in the House N 10 Mr Joshua Johnson one of the Overseers Appreared this day before Sr. Sampson Wright & Underlook that Eleanr Barnwell shod. not be Removed from St. Clement Danes parish to her own untill she was Recovered to that she cod. bel Removed with Safety, Staines Middx (to wit) James Talboys one of the Beadles of the said Parish of St Clement Danes on behalf of Eleanor Barnwell Maketh Oath and saith that she the said Eleanor Barnwell hath Informed this Deponent and which he Verily believes to be true that she is now of the Age of about 25 years that she is the Daughter of John Barnwell & Jane who his Wife that she knows not by Information or otherwise whether her said Father or Mother were intilled unto or acquired any legal Settlement that she the said Eleanor Barnwell hath never gained any Settlement in her own Right nor been Married that she was born in Staines in the Parish of Staines in the County of Middlesex that she was Maintained & be right up by at the Charge of the said Parish of Staines in the Workhouse there, for seven years or thereabouts her Father & Mother dying when She was very young & leaving her destitute & in Want And that she knows of no settlement she is intilled unto save as aforesaid by Birth in Staines And that she is Ill & very Infirm

Sarah Cole aged fourteen years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith That she was bound Apprentice to Mr. Bushton of Woolwich in the County of Kent Cooper and has served with him for between two and three Years, that owing to some Misunderstanding there fore Mother Margaret Cole brought her away this Deponent deserted her said Masters Service and has been for about Three Months from him, and that for the first part namely about five Weeks at the time she has been is absent from her said Master she has been with her Mother in Bartho Womens Hospital but that since then she has been in the Workhouse of Saint Clement Danes and has not served the whole of her Apprenticeship neither has she been discharged there from.

Jane Seedsman aged upwards of 16 Years upon her Oath Saith that she was bound Apprentice to Mr. Rosers of Broad Street Saint Giles in the fields in the County of Middlesex Shoe Maker and has served with him for between 2 & 3 Years that owing to some Misunderstanding or disagreement between her and Mrs. Roger she this Deponent deserted her said Masters Service and has been for about a Year from him that about 10 Months of the time since she left her said Master she lived as a Weekly Servant with Tax Looney in Giant Yard Shoreditch and has lived in several Weekly Places since without the Covent of her said Master but ever since she left her last place which is about 5 Weeks Ago she has been in the Workhouse of Saint Clement Danes and that she has not Served the whole of her Apprenticeship neither has she been discharged there from

Richard Stimpson Aged 33 years or thereabouts upon his Oath saith that he was born in Maid Lane in the parish of Saint Saviours Southwark in the County of Surry That he lived as a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Johnson of Saint Margarets Hill in the said Parish with said Parish of Saint Saviour Southwark between 2 and 3 Years that his Mother who the lived in Maid Lane aforesaid used to receive his Wages therefore he cannot tell how much it was a Year That since he quitted said Service he lived with Mr. Nichols in Gravel Lane as a Weekly Servant And that he has lived in servant Weekly Places since but as a Rented any Tenement or Lodging of £10 a Year lived as a hired Yearly Servant paid Taxes or done any other Act Matter or thing whereby he might have gained any Subsequent Settlement since living with Mr. Johnson in the said Parish of Saint Southwark to the best of this Examinant's Knowledge information or belief

St. Jno the Evangelist Westmr. Mary Purser widow aged forty three Years or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith That she was married to John Purser her late Husband, at Dunkirt in the Kingdom of Marie according to the Eights of the Roman Catholic Church about twenty six Years ago, that both she this Examinant is and her said Husband was of the Roman Catholic Religion that since their Intermarriage her said Husband and herself have rented and lived in a House in Dartmonth Westrminster in the Parish of Saint John the Evangelist Westminster at the Yearly Rent of twenty Six pounds that they quitted the said House (having hired therein for about two Years) about thirteen Years ago that her said Husband died in March last, and that neither her said Husband an his Life time after quitting the said House in Dartmonth Row aforesaid did Rent, nor have this Examinant since his Decease rented any other House or Tenement of the Yearly Value of ten Pounds or do any other Act Matter or Thing whereby to the best of this Examinant Knowledge Information or belief her said Husband Husband in his Life time or this Examinant since his Death may have gained or aquired any other Subsequent Settlement and that she this Examinant is poor & Rich and unable to maintain herself.

Mary Griffiths And 28 Years or thereabouts Upon her Oath Saith that about 3 Years Ago she intermarried with Thomas Griffiths her present Husband at the parish Church of Saint James's in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex by Bans That her said Husband was bound apprentices to a Mr. Griffiths of White Lyon Street seven deals in the parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the sd. County of Middlesex Sawyer but only served five Year and a half of his time that since he quitted said the service of his said Master he has been several times in his Majestys Service at sea And is now pressed from her in the said Service And further saith that since he left his said Master he never Rented any Tenement or Lodging of £10 a Year lived as a hired Yearly Servant paid Taxes or done any other Act Matter or thing whereby he might have gained any Subsequent to the best of this Examinants Knowledge information or belief And further saith that she has One Child living by her said Husband named Thomas 2yrs and is pregnant with another that on accounts of her said Husband being away from her she is totally unable to maintain herself and Child.

Sarah Haley Aged 38 years and upwards Upon her Oath Saith that she never was Married that about 17 Years Ago she lived as a hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Schooler in New Bond in the Parish of Saint George Hanover Square in the County of Street No:127 for one Year and 7 Months that since she quitted said Service she never Rented any Tenement or Lodging of £10 a Year lived as a hired Yearly Servant for One Year any where paid Taxes or done any other Matter or thing whereby she Might have gained any Subsequent Settlement to the best of he Knowledge information or beleif

Jane Fleming Aged about 36 Years upon her Oath Saith that about 15 Years Ago she intermarried with John Heming at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the Fields in the County of Middlesex That her said Husband had been Dead near 3 Years that during his life informed this Examinant that he Served part of his time to his Father in Ireland who was by Trade a Taylor And Ranaway from him before his time was out That during their intermarriage the said John Fleming never Rented any Tenement or Lodging of £10 a Year paid Taxes or did any Act Matter a thing to gain any Settlement in England, And this Examinant further saith that she was Born at the White horse at Parsons Green in the parish of Fulham in the County of Surry where her Father and Mother lived near 20 Years And further Saith that she never lived as a hired yearly Servant either before her intermarriage with the said John Fleming or since his decease nor Rented any Tenement or Lodging of £10 a Year paid Taxes or done any Act Matter or thing whereby she might have gained any other Settlement than by her Birth to the best of this Examinants Knowledge information or Belief.

James Lewis Aged Sixty Years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that he intermarried with his late Wife Ann at the parish Church of St Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster & County of Middlesex about 31 or 32 years ago that then he Rented and lived in an House in New Bedford Court White Hart Yard in the said parish of St Martin in the Fields which he kept about Sixteen years at the Annl. Rent of £16. that he quitted the same about Fifteen years ago and since hath not done any Act or thing whatsoever whereby He might obtain any Subsequent legal settlement that his said Wife has been Dead near 18 Years And that he is now poor & unable to support himself without Assistance

Ann Smith Aged 35 years & upwds. Widow of William Smith Deceased Upon her Oath saith that on or about the twenty second of February 1781. she was Married to her late Husband William Smith at the parish Church of St Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex that Grevens to their said Marriage and while her said Husband was single not having Any Child or Children he lived as Ostler with Mr. Hapton at the Bell Inn Warwick Lane in the parish of St. Faith in the City of London for very near two years that he received as Wages or a Compensation for such his Service a certain Allowance or Sum for every Carriage Waggon Cart & Horse that came into the Inn Yard and stay'd for one Night or More, that such Sums were generally Weekly paid or at least made up & settled that he constantly boarded & Lodged with his said Master at the Inn the whole of his Service and was then always at the Command and Subject to the direction of his said Master And that since such Service he hath not gained any Subsequent legal Settlement neither hath she this Deponent since his Death acquired any settlement in her own Right that she hath two Children by her said Husband now living namely Ann Aged Six years & upwards and Robert Aged one year and Eight Month or thereabouts And this Deponent saith that she is unable to maintain herself and the said Children without some Assistance

Thomas Broadhead Aged forty three years or thereabouts Upon his Oath saith that about Eighteen years ago he was hired as a yearly Servant by Mr. John Coggan of the Cecil Street Coffee House where & with whom he lived as such for a year & upwards And that during all the rest of his continuance there he was only as a Waitor and or no Wages or yearly hiring And that since he do left Serving the said Mr. Coggan as an hired yearly Servant abt. Sixteen years & ten Months ago aforesaid he hath not to his knowledge or belief gained any other legal settlement And this Deponent saith that Cecil Street Coffee House where he served as aforesaid is in the parish of St Martin the fields in the Liberty of Westminster in the said County of Middlesex And that he is now Ill Poor and unable to maintain himself

Jane McCLeland Singlewoman Aged 30 Years and upwards Upon Oath saith that she never was Married that she lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mrs. Wilson in the Strand in the parish of St Mary Le Strand Dealer Manchester Stuffs on Wares for about two years and an half at the Annual Wages of about £5 that she quitted that Service about Six years ago and hath never since quitting it (by any Means whatever) obtained any Subsequent legal Settlement And that she has been supported in the Workhouse belonging to the said parish of St Le Strand at the Expence of the same parish for about three Months and hath been thereout only since the beginning of November last And that she is now Infirm and unable to maintain herself without same Assistance

Ann Egerton Aged Nineteen Years upwards Singlewoman Upon Oath saith that she never was Married that she lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr. Sells an Attorney in Grange Court Carey Street in the parish of St. Clement Danes in the said County of Middlesex and Liberty of Westminster for about One Year & Eleven Months at the Annual Wages of £5, Quitted that serve Served about in the Month of September last And hath never obtained any Subsequent legal Settlement And this Deponent further upon her Oath saith that on the 17th. day of October last she was delivered of a Female Male Bastard Child at the House of Mr. Bain bri N:14 in Denmark Court in the parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster in the said County and which said Child hath since being half Baptized by the Name of Thomas but no Surname whatever now quitted neither hath it ever been called by any And this Depont. saith that one Patrick Neali who is an Articled Clerk with with Mr Sell in Grange Court aforesaid in the only neat true father thereof he having had Carnel Knowlegde Knowledge of this Deponents Body & be gotten the same And that she is Poor and unable to maintain herself & said Child. Witness to this fact by Information Richd. Dobbins

Taken such tie House being in Stepney parish he Husbands Settlmt. As afterwds discovered & the woman & Children remr. there Wide Eleanr. page 48 (to wit) Hannah Pain Aged about & 25 Years Wife of John Pain who hath left her Upon oath Saith that she was married to her Husband John Pain at the Parish Church of Saint Michael Royal & St Martin Vintry in the City of London on the 22d. June 1798 (by Licence) that she knows not nor hath ever heard where her Husband legal Settlement is that she hath frequently asked him to inform her the place of his Settlement but he never gave Answer to such questions that She this Deponent while She was Single and unmarried lived as an hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Mathews at the Cock & Hook in Bakers Row in the parish of Saint Mary Matfolon otherwise White chapel in the County of Middlesex for one year at the Annual Wages of Four Grounds that She quitted that Service about Six or Seven years ago and hath never done any Act. Matter or thing whereby to obtain any Subsequent legal Settlement in her own right as she best knows and believes And this Deponent farther saith that She hath one legitimate Male Child by her said Husband which is now living Named John and was Aged Eight Months on the first day of this Instant March And this Deponent Saith that she is unable to provide for herself Child with Assistance And then her said Husband left her & Child abt. Six Months ago & that she hath not since heard of her in & knows not where he is

Elizth. Kirby aged 22 years and upwds. Singlewoman Upon Oath saith that she never was Married that she rented and resided in an Apartment at No:12 in Berwick Street in the parish of St James in the Liberty of Westminster in the said County of Middlesex for Eight Months or upwards at the Weekly Rent of One Guinea that the said Apartment consisted of two Rooms on the one Pair of Stairs Floor and a back Room on the Floor next above that and the End of the Kitchen that the said Rooms were ready furnished and that she Verily believes the said Premises in which else so resided were unfurnished by the that She quitted that Apartment about Six years ago and hath never since obtained any other legal Settlement And that She is now pregnant & unable to maintain herself

Hannah Pain Aged about 25 Years upon her Oath saith that she was Married to her Husband John Pain at the parish Church of the united Parishes of St Michael Royal & St Martin Vintry in the City of London on 22d Lane 1790 (by Licence) that she hath been informed which she believes to be true that he served 5 years under Indentures duly exted. with Mr. John Wood of the parish of St Nicholas Deptford Black Smith , that her said Husband Lodged with Mr Back at in back Lane in the parish of St Paul Deptford aforesaid in the County of Kent during the last two or three Months of such his Service, and aforesaid at the end of the said 5 Years her said Husband was discharged from his said Apprenticeship And this Deponent saith her said Husband hath never obtained any Subsequent legal Settlement to the best of her knowledge or belief And saith that the hath One ilegitimate Child by her Said Husband which is now living Named John who was Aged Eight Months on the first day of March Instant And this Deponent with her said Child about Six Months ago and She doth not know nor hath heard where he went or now is And that She is unable to maintain herself & Child without Assistance

Sophia Wills Singlewoman Aged Nineteen years & upwards Upon Oath saith that She never was Married, that She served very near two years (under Indentures of Apprenticeship duly executed) with Mrs. Lucy Stephens in Great Portland Street loading Pern John Street Oxford Road within the parish of St Mary le bone in the County of Middlesex that she left her Apprentice said Mistresses service upwards of two years ago, then went abroad and hath not since obtained any other legal Settlement to the best of his knowledge or belief And that she is Ill Poor and unable to provide for herself without assistance

Hammersmith Middx The Pauper brot back & fresh Orders made out to Fulham Mr. Wyndham's Its. be. gsit. witht. the Hamlet of Hammersmith Vide Subseqt. examnt. page No'd (51) (to wit) Charlotte Wickens the Widow of Jonathan Wickens deceased Upon that her Oath says that she was marri'd to her late Husband Jonathan Wickens on the 26th. Day of March 1783 at the parish Church of Saint Ann Soho that her said Husband has been read about 6 Months and that since his Decease she hath not intermarried with any other Person Rented any House or Tenement of the Yearly Value of Ten Pounds paid Parochial or other Rates or Taxes or done any other Act Matter or thing whereby to acquire any Settlement her Own Right. And further this Examinant Saith That her said Husband informed her and which she believes to be true that he did before his Intermarriage with this Examinant Live, as an hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Wyndham at Hammersmith in this County of Middlesex for upwards of 14 Months and that he never often to living with Mr. Wyndham acquire any settlement whatsoever to the best of his knowledge, and Further Saith her Husband always informed her his Settlement was at Accounts with

Elizabeth Robinson Singlewoman Aged forty seven years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that she never was Married that she lived as an hired Yearly Servant with Mr. Bulkley Hatter and Hosier in the Hay market in the parish of St Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex for about three years at the Annual Wages of Nine pounds that She quitted that Service about twenty years ago and never obtained any Subsequent legal Settllement by any way or means whatsoever as She best knows or believes And saith that She is Poor and unable to maintain herself without Assistance

Mary Reed Widow aged 28 years and upwards Upon Oath saith that she was Married to her late Husband Richard Reed at the Parish Church of St. Bridget otherwise St Bride with in the Liberty of the City of London about Fifteen or Sixteen she years ago hath been Informed and believes that Subsequent thereto her said Husband Rented and with this Deponent resided in an House in Goldsmith Street Pemberton Row Gough Square in the parish of St. Bridget otherwise alias St Bride in the Liberty of the City London for about two years and eight Months at the Annual Rent of about Sixteen Guineas and paid all the Taxes for the said House that he quitted the said House about fourteen years ago went immediately to Ireland, and Died about two years after never having obtained any Subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Deponents knowledge or belief And this Deponent saith that since her said Husband's Decease she has never been Married nor acquired any Settlement in her own Right And this Deponent abt. saith that she about Fourteen years ago she this Deponent was removed by Order of Removal from the parish of St Andrew Holborn Middlesex to the said parish of St Bridget otherwise St Bride St Bridget ago and that the said last ever which parish now Appealed against such Order as this Deponent best known and believes and that She is now pregnant and not able to support herself without Assistance

Sarah Hardy aged 29 years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that she never was Married that She lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr John Pearson of Water Street in the parish of St Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex Coal Merchant for one year and ten four Months and upwards or thereabouts at the Annual Annual Wages of Ten Guineas that the last place where she resided for forty days together while she was in such Service was at Rishey Green in the parish of Lewisham in the County of Kent , that she went there with her Master's Mother & sister in or about the Month of July last and continued continued there with them till the beginning of October next following when they together with this Deponent came to her said Master's House & in Water Street aforesaid and that this Deponent left her said Master's Service the second day after their Arrival at his House turn Rich Lewisham parish as aforesaid having had previous warning from her Mistress And that this Examinant is pregnant and unable to support herself without Assistance

Janet Scott Aged 36 years and upwards Wife of Walker Scott Upon Oath saith that she was Married to her present Husband at the West Kirk in Edinburgh in Scotland about ten years ago that her said Husband hath since their said Marriage Rented and lived in an House in Little Moor's Yard in the parish of St Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster in the said County for about Six Years at the yearly Rent of Ten Pounds and paid all the Rates assessed on the Tenant for the same that they quitted that House about Nine Months ago and that her said Husband hath not since acquired any Subsequent legal Settlement by any act or means whatsoever to this Deponents knowledge or belief And this Deponent further saith she hath four Children by her said Husband now living namely Elizabeth aged near Thirteen Years, Robert aged ten years and upwards John Aged Eight years and upwards, and Jane aged two years and upwards, that her said Husband left this Deponent about on the 10th day of April Instant to go to Manchester for Work, and this Deponent hath not since heard from, or any thing of, him And that She is unable to support herself and family any longer without Assistance

Judith Stracey Aged 23 years & upwards Singlewoman Upon Oath saith that she never was Married, that she lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr. Baxter in Great Tower Street in the parish of St Dunstan in the East in the City of London for upwards of a year, at the Annual Wages of £7. that she quitted that Service about 6 Years ago, and hath never obtained any Subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Deponent's knowledge or belief that She is now pregnant unable to support herself without Assistance

Ann Matthews Singlewoman aged 24 years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith That She never was Married, That she was hired as a yearly Servant at the Annual Wages of £7 by Mr. Carter at No: 6 in Tavistock Street in the parish of St Paul Covent Garden , in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middx Middlesex on the 20th. day of July in the year of our Lord 1790, and That he lived with him the said Mr Carter at No: 6 Tavistock Street aforesaid under such hiring from the said 20th July 1790 untill the 20th day of July in the year 1791 & then quitted his Service, That She hath not Since obtained any legal Settlement by any Act or means whatever (to her knowledge or belief) And that She is now Pregnant unable to Support herself without Assistance

Benjamin Newman one of the Beadles of the said parish of St Clement Danes on behalf of her two illegitimate Childrens Rebecca Hughes now Weak & Ill Upon Oath Saith That the said Rebecca Hughes hath Informed him this Deponent and what he verily believes to be true that She is aged about 27 years, was never Married That she lived as an hired Yearly Servant with Mr Haley Lace Maker in Long Acre in the parish of St Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex for about two year at the Annual Wages of £8..8..0 that She quitted that Service the Month of November last and hath not since then Rented any House or Apartments of £10 a year paid parish Taxes or otherwise obtained any other legal Settlement to the best of her knowledge belief And that She is Ill & Poor

David Rogerson Aged about 47 Years Upon Oath saith That he never was Married That he served an was bound Apprentice ship of for seven Years by Indenture (executed) to Mr. Danl. Mareton a Waterman who resided in Stangate in the parish of St. Mary Lambeth in the County of Surry That he served his said Master for about two years & then ran away without his Master's knowledge or consent That during such his Service he lodged in his Master's House in Stangate aforesaid And That since he quitted his Master's Service he hath done no Act or thing whatsoever to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to his Knowledge or belief

Frances Ogilvie Wife of James Ogilvie Aged 34 Years or thereabouts Upon Oath Saith that She was Married to her present at the parish Church of St Lenard Shoreditch on the 23d November 1778. that since their Said Marriage her said Husband Rented and Resided a House in a House Nod. 10 in Swan Yard in the Parish of St Mary le Strand in the Liberty of Westminster in the said County of Middlesex for about two Years at the Annual Rent of £14. That they quitted that House about Four Years ago That her said Husband and Never obtained any Subs. and that since her said Husband hath not obtained any Subsequent legal Settlement to her knowledge or belief And this Deponent further saith that her said Husband went in as she believes now on board The Mary Hard West Indian Indiaman in which out he went out about Christmas last

Ann Quin Aged 36 Years or thereabts. thereabouts Wife of John Quin Upon her Oath Saith that She was Married to her Present present Husband John Quin at the parish Church of St. Mary le bone in the County of Middlesex on or about the 22d day of February in the year 1790. That Since then her Said Husband Rented and with her this Deponent, Resided in an House House in Petty France in the parish of St Margt. Margaret in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex for for about three Months at the Annual Rent of Eighteen Guineas that they quitted the Same about Christmas last and that Since quitting it her said Husband hath not done any Act or thing wtsoever. whereby to obtain any Subsequent legal Settlement to her knowledge Information or belief

Sarah & Robt . leg. Children of Richd. Brimmer Deced & Sarah his Wife St Paul Covent Garden (to wit) Sarah Brimmer Widow Aged 25 Years or thereabouts on behalf of her two Children thereafter Named Maketh Oath and Saith That She this Examinant was Married to her late Husband Richard Brimmer at the parish Church of St Mary le Stand on or about the 12th. day of October 1788 That he hath Informed this Deponent & she Verily believes it to be true That previous thereto her paid Husband Rented and Resided in a House in Jackson's Alley Row Street in the parish of St Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster for about 3 Years at the Annl. Rent of £11. That he quitted the same between 5 and 6 Years ago and never obtained any subsequent legal Settlement to this Deponent's knowledge Information or belief And This Deponent further saith That he Died on or about the 11th. day of June 1791. That She hath two Children now living by her said Husband Namely Sarah aged two Year born on or about the 3d day of September 1789 and Robert born on the 2d day of February last And That they are now in the said parish of St. Clement Danes and likely to become that She is unable to maintain the said Children or either of them And This Deponent herself lives as an hired Yearly Servant with Mrs Holliford in Queen Ann Street West and left her two Children with her Sister in Strand Lane about two Months ago where they have continued till the present time but she being unable to support them or either of the occationed the Application to the this parish for Relief

John Strickland Aged 36 Years and upwards Singleman Upon Oath and saith That he never was Married That he was bound an he served 5 Years of his Apprenticeship under Indentures duly with Mr. Dickonson at the come of a small House then situate next Grays Inn Gate in Holborn in the parish of St Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the said County of Middlesex That he since at the Expiration of the said 5 Years he left his said Master with this Convent And since then hath he this Deponent hath done no Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to acquire any other legal Settlement And that he is Ill Distressed and unable to support himself without Assistance

Jno Strickland Singleman aged 36 Years and upwards Upon Oath saith that he never was Married That he was bound an Apprentice for seven years by Indenture to Mr Dickonson and served his said Master for 5 Years Stations that he this Deponent during the first Year of his Apprenticeship his Slept in his Master's Shop at then situate in Holborn Next to Grays Inn Gate in Holborn in the parish of St Andrew Holborn above The Bars in the County of Middx. That That afterwards at about the Expiration of that year his said Masters took Chambers in Grays Inn where this Deponent Slept during the Remainder of his Service, That at the End of the said 3 Years he left his Master by consent and hath done no Act or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any other Settlement than in the said parish of St Andrew Holborn as aforesaid

Phoebe Dell Wife of Wm: Dell Upon he Oath saith That she is aged about 36 years That she was Married to her present Husband William Dell at the parish Church of Fulham in the County of Middlesex about Nineteen Years ago That she She hath been informed which she verily believes to be true That her said Husband Served his Apprenticeship to a Cabinet Maker in the Parish of St Andrew Wardrobe in the City of London That and & thereby obtained a legal Settlement in that parish And hath never since done any Act or thing whereby to acquire any Subsequent legal Settlement to her the best of her knowledge Information or belief And this Deponent saith That her said Husband left her about Eleven years ago, hath never since lived with her And refuses or neglects to make any Allowance or provision for her And further that She this Deponent (together with her legitimate Son by her said Husband Named William ) was removed from the parish of St Bridget otherwise St Bride London to the said parish of St Andrew Wardrobe about Six Years ago and was by that parish for near three Years allowance the Weekly Sum of 2/6 for the Maintenance of her sd. Child which was afterwards Apprenticed out by the said parish of St Andrew And this Deponent saith that She is Distressed and unable to provide future herself without Assistance

Elizabeth Wood singlewoman aged twenty three Years & upwards Upon Oath and saith That She never was Married That she lived as an hired Yearly Servant with Jno. Mountresore Esqr. at No. 53 Lower It for three Years & upwards that the last place in which she resided during such Service was at his House Nod. 53 Lower Harley Street Cavendish Square in the parish of St. Mary le bone in the County of Middlesex where she lodged from the latter latter end of January 1791 till the begin first or second of June then next following when she quitted such Service since which time she hath not lived as an hired Yearly Servant for twelve months together Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a Year or done any other Act Matter or thing Whatsoever Whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of her knowledge or belief And Saith that she is pregnant and unable to Maintain herself

Maria Taylor aged 24 Years & upwards Upon Oath saith That she never was Married That she was bound an Apprentice by the parish of Edmonton to Mr. Fletcher in Ivy Lane in the City of London about ten Years ago That he after she had served there about two or three Years they removed to No Tottenham Court Road in the parish of Saint Pancras in the County of Middlesex where she this Deponent continued to Serve her said Master as an Apprentice as aforesaid In about two Years that she quitted then quitted the her said Master's Service by their consent & since Leaving her said Master she hath never lived as an hired Yearly Servant for twelve months together or done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever Whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement And that she is pregnant & unable to Maintain herself

St Brides London Joseph Messeldine Aged 50 Years or thereabouts Widower Upon Oath Saith That he never Obtained any legal Settlement in his own Right that he intermarried with his late Wife Ann at the Parish Church of Saint Leonard Shoreditch about 13 13 Years ago who died about 9 or 10 Months ago and by whom and he had no that he has no legitimate Issue that he was informed and verily believes his Father William Messeldine intermarried with Sarah this Deponent Mother at Bath in the County of Somerset in or about the Year 1730 That he this Deponent was born some time in or about August 1744 That his said Father rented and Resided in a House in Goldsmith Street in the Parish of Saint Bridge otherwise Bridget in the City of London on about 8 Years but what he paid for the same this Deponent doth not know by Information or otherwise That his said Father And this Deponent further saith That his said Father & Mother both Died in the Work or Poor House of the said parish of St Bride That his said Wife was removed from St Luke Old Street to the said parish of St Bride otherwise St Bridget and Died in the Workhouse belonging to that parish And That he knows not any of any other legal Settlement that he in entitled unto save as afsd. in the parish of St Bride otherwise St Bridget and that he is poor Ill & unable to support himself without Assistance

Benjamin Poore aged 54 Years and upwards Upon Oath saith That he was Married to his present Wife Susanna formerly Smith Susanna Smith at the parish Church of St James in the City of Bristol on the 27th. day of March 1763 . that since their said Marriage he Rented and with his said Wife resided in a House in a place called Johnson Court at Charing Cross in the parish of St Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster in the said Coun County about two Years at the Annual Rent of forty five Guineas that he quitted it in or about the year 1784 and hath not since obtained any subsequent legal settlement to the best of his knowledge or belief by any way or means whatever And this Deponent further saith that he & his said Wife were was removed by the Order of removal from the parish of St Mary Whitechapel about May or June 1791 to the said parish of St. Martin in the fields against Which Order or removal the said parish of St Martin in the field, have not Appealed to this Deponents information or belief

Benjn Newman one of the Beadles of the parish of St Clement Danes in the said County and Liberty on behalf of Ann Spicer (now Ill and deceased) Maketh and Oath saith That he hath been informed which he verily believes to be true that the said Ann Spicer is aged about 68 Years was Married to her late Husband Matthew Spicer at the parish Church of St Leonard Shoreditch about 24 Years ago that previous thereto and while her said Husband was single he served an Apprenticeship with a Weaver in the parish & St Matthew Bethnal Green in the said County of Middlesex and since the Expiration thereof he never obtained any subsequent legal Settlement that her said Husband Died several Years ago in the Workhouse belonging to the said parish of St Matthew Bethnal Green that he was removed to that parish from the parish of wherein Eagle and Child Alley in Shoe Lane is situate (in which Alley the said Ann Spicer with her said Husband then resided) about 21 Years ago and by Virtue thereof taken into the Workhouse of the said parish of St. Matthew Bethnal Green and maintained therein several Years that since her said Husband's Decease she hath not been Married nor acquired any legal Settlement in her own Right that she has six Children by her said Husband all out of the Kingdom & provided for And this Deponent saith that the said Ann Spicer is now Ill with a fever but may be safely removed to their place of her last legal settlement as he is informed and believes

Rachael Collier Aged 62 Years and upwards Single woman upon Oath Saith that She never was married That She lived as an was Hired as a Yearly Servant with Mr Prince in Wych Street in the parish of Saint Clement Danes in the Liberty of Westminster in the paid County of Middx upwards of forty Years ago that she served under such hiring for about one Year and six Months that during the last 3 or four Months of such her Service she Resided with her said Master at a House situate in the Strand near Durham Yard in the parish of Saint Martin in the Fields in the said Liberty that since she quitted he said Master's Service she hath not lived as an hired Yearly Servant, Rented any House or Tenement of £10 a Year Value paid any parochial Taxes or done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby she might obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of her knowledge information or belief belief, And that she is Poor and unable to maintain herself without Assistance, and is now become chargeable to the said parish of St Clement Danes

James Stone Senr . aged 77 Years or thereabouts and James Stone his Son aged 37 Years or thereabouts severally Make Oath and say And first this Deponent James Stone Senr. for himself saith that he intermarried with Elizabeth his late Wife at the parish Church of St Andrew Holbourn about a Years ago by whom he had only one Child Namely the said James Stone Junr. that this Deponents said Wife Died about 24 Years ago that during his said Marriage he this Deponent with her said Wife Rented and Resided in an Apartment at the House Groom in Red Lyon Street in the parish of St Andrew Holborn above the Bars to the said County of Middlesex for upwards three Months or upward, at the Weekly Rent of six shillings or thereabouts that he quitted the said Lodging several Years ago and hath not since Resided in Rented any House or Lodging of £10 a Year paid any parish Taxes or done any other Act Matter or thing Whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal settlement And this Deponent James Stone the Son for himself saith that he hath never obtained or acquired any legal Settlement in his own right and that the Settlement he is informed and verily believes that the last legal Settlement of this Deponent's father the said James Stone is in the said parish of St Andrew Holbourn above the Bars in the said County of Middx.

Rebecca Hollings Aged 31 Years and upwards Upon her Oath Saith that about 16 Years Ago she intermarried with John Hollings her present Husband at the parish Church of Saint James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex that soon after they were Married they took a House No. 27 Holliday Yard Ludgate Street in the parish of Saint Martin Ludgate in the City of London and Rented and Lived in the said House for Six Months abt. 12 Months at 11 Guineas Pr. Annum that Since she and her said Husband quitted the said House her said Husband has not Rented any Tenemt. or Lodging of £10 a Year pd. Taxes or lived as hired Yearly Servant for One Year or done any or. Act Matter or thing whereby they might have gained any Subsequent Settlement to the best of this Examinants Knowledge information or belief that She has 5 Children by her said Husband, And that he has deserted her and her said Children fr this 6 Weeks past And that she is Poor and unable to Maintain herself & 2 Small Children Viz Wm. Hollings Aged 2 Years and a half and Sarah Hollings Aged 9 Months the other three being out at Service and Provided for,

James Dollett aged 39 Years and upwards Upon Oath saith that he was Married to his present Wife Elizabeth at the Chapel of Gosport in the parish of Alverstoke in the County of Southampton in or about the Month of February 1789 That he this Deponent previous thereto was bound an Apprentice by Indenture to Mr John Fasby at Morris's Causeway in the parish of St Mary Lambeth for Seven Years and duly Served his said Master Five Years and upwards and then left his said Master by consent and went to Sea in his Majesty's Service That during such Service will his said Master he Boarded and lodged in his said Master's House And since discharge from his Apprenticeship he hath not obtained any subsequent legal Settlement and to the best of his knowledge information or belief

John Vendermeulen aged 49 Years and upwards Upon Oath saith That her never was Married, that he lived as an hired as a servant for four lived under a Yearly hiring as Servant or Assistant to Mr John Mondo of New Round Court in the parish of Saint Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster in the said County of Middlesex at the Wages of about 5 Guineas, that his said Master her died & this Deponent left the House being about 28 Years ago and hath not since lived under a Yearly hiring for twelve Months together Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a Year paid parish Taxes or otherwise obtained any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of her knowledge Information or belief, And that he is now distressed Ill and unable to maintain himself without Assistance

John Thorowgood aged 59 Years & upwards Upon Oath saith that he was Married to his present Wife Johanna at the parish Church of St. Mary Aldermanbury in the City of London about 29 30 Years ago that since his said Marriage he Rented & with his said Wife Resided in an Apartment at the House of Mr. Bland in Clement Lane three Fox Court in St Clements Lane in the parish of St Edmund the King in the City of London for about three Months Six Months & upwards at the Annual Rent of £5. & 5s that when he had been there about three Months sometime he hired another Room in the same power and Rented and Resided therein for three Months & upwards at the Yearly Rent of £5 that he quitted that Lodging there Rooms about Eight Years ago And he hath not since Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a Year paid any parish Taxes served any parochial Office & otherwise obtained any subsequent legal Settlement that he hath two Children by his said Wife now living the Youngest of which is 23 Years of Age and both provide for themselves

Ann Higgins Singlewoman Aged 23 Years and upwards Upon Oath saith that she never was Married that she has been informed and Verily believes that her Mother Father Robert Higgins Married to this Deponent's Mother Susanna at the Fleet Prison London according to the Rights and Ceremonies of the Church of England above Forty Years ago The her said Father for Many Years before his Decease Rented and Resided in an House in Angel Street in the parish of Saint Ann and Agnes Aldersgate within Aldersgate London at the Annl. Rent of £12 and Died there about 18 Years ago That after the Decease of her said Father, her said Mother Rented and Resided in the same House for several Years at the said Yearly Rent of £12 and left it about ten Years ago & hath not since been Married or done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtained any subsequent legal settlement to the best of this Deponents Knowledge Information or belief. And this Deponent farther saith that her said Mother hath informed her which she verily believes to be true that she now Receives an Allowance from the said parish of St Ann and Agnes as a parishioner thereof And Lastly she this Deponent hath never been legally bound an Apprentice lived under any Yearly hiring for one Year together he Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a Year Value paid parish Taxes or done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement in her own Right, And that she is now pregnant and unable to support herself without Assistance

Richard Bradford aged 54 Years and or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that that he was Married to his late Wife Mary at the parish Church of St George Bloomsbury abt. 27 Years ago that he Rented and Resided in a Lodging in Grays Inn passage in the parish of St Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for five Years or upwards at the Annual Rent of Ten pounds that when he quitted that he Rented and Resided in an Apartment in Theobald Road in the said parish of St Andrew Holborn about two Years and an half at the Annual Rent of Twelve pounds, that he quitted that Apartment about ten Years ago and hath not since done any Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement And this Deponent further said that his said Wife Died in the Workhouse belonging to the said parish about a Month ago and had been received by the said parish same time before

Jane East Aged 32 year or thereabouts upon Wife of Samuel East Maketh Oath and saith that she was Married to her present Husband Samuel East at the parish Church of Saint Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster about on or about the 27th day of May last that her said Husband hath informed her & she Verily believes that previous thereto her said Husband Rented and Resided in an Apartment at Mr. Rooth's House in Charter house Lane in the parish of St. Sepulchre in the County of Middlesex for about four years at the Annual Rent of £12 that he quitted it about 14 Months ago and hath not since Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year paid any parish Taxes served any parochial office or done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Deponent's knowledge Information or belief That her said Husband is now confined in the New Compter for Bastardy Chid that she is Distressed and and unable to support herself without Assistance

Mary Priest aged 56 years and upwards Upon Wife of Willm. Priest Upon Oath saith that she was Married to her present Husband William Priest about 38 years ago in the City of Dublin according to the Rights and Ceremonies of the Church of England that her said Husband hath Rented and Resided in the House where in he now dwells for several years that she is informed and verily believe that he paid the Annual Rent of £ 24 for the same And this Deponent saith that the said House is situate in Great Chapel Street in the parish of St. Ann in the Liberty of Westminster in the said County that she this Deponent hath been parted from her said Husband many years and that She is now distressed and unable to maintain herself without Assistance

Ann Colvell aged about 54 years upon her Oath (on behalf of her illegitimate Child Ann Scannan ) Saith that she this Deponent was Married to the Father of the said Child William Scannan at Cork in Ireland according to the Rights and Ceremonies of the Church of Rome about 28 years ago that he has been Dead about four or five year ago that her said Child Ann Scannan was born an or about the 13th day of September 1781 at the House of Mr. Dustan in Exeter Street in the parish of St. Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster in the said County of Middlesex , that the said Child was Removed on or about the 8th of July 1789 by Order of Removal from the parish of St. Clement Danes to the said Parish of St Paul Covent Garden and by virtue thereof maintained by the said parish for sometime that there hath been no Appeal against the said Order to the best of this Deponents knowledge information or belief

Mary Hur Sarah Hutchinson Aged 65 years or thereabouts Upon Widow of William Hutchinson Deced Upon Oath saith that she was Married to her late Husband William Hutchinson in a about the Month of February next before the Marriage Act took place at May Flair Chapel according to the Ceremonies of the Church of England that her said Husband Died in or about the year 1760 or 1761 that Subsequent thereto and while she was unmarried having only one Child, as a Daughter Named Elizabeth being then aged about sixteen years and placed as an Apprentice with Mrs. Brown a Child Bed Linen Worker in Hungerford Street in the Strand she this Deponent hired herself as a yearly servant with Mr. Sutton an Attorney in Clements Lane in the parish of St Clement Eastcheap in the City of London with that she continued with him under such hiring for about 4 years (until his Decease) at the yearly Wages of £6 that she quitted that Service about 12 years ago and hath done no Act not since been Married nor done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement and that She is Ill Distressed and incapable of Providing for herself without Assistance

Jane Cook aged 31 years or thereabouts Wife of William Cook (who is now from her) Upon Oath saith that she was Married to her present Husband William Cook at the parish Church of St. Ann within the Liberty of Westminster in the County of of Middlesex on the 18th June 1781 (by Banns) that since then her said Husband Rented and Resided in an House in the parish of Saint John Hackney in the County of Middlesex upwards of Six Months at the Annual Rent of £14 and paid one Quarters Poor Rate of for the same, that she hath one Child and by her said Husband now living with her this Examinant namely John born on the 9th. day of June last that her said Husband hath not (since he quitted the said House in St John's Hackney) Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year paid parish Taxes or otherwise obtained any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Deponent's knowledge information or belief

John Jones singleman aged 27 years and upwards Upon Oath saith that he never was Married that he was bound an Apprentice for seven year (by Indenture) to Mr. Howgate in Portland Street in the parish of St Mary le bone in the County of Middlesex Sadler and served him under such Indentures for about a year and an half when his said Master Died he this Deponent went abroad and Returned about a Fortnight ago to this Kingdom consequently hath not obtained any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of his knowledge information or belief That he is Distressed and hath become Chargeable to the said Parish of St Clement Danes

Frances Layton Widow aged 50 years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that she was Married to William Layton her late Husband in or about the year 1758 at the parish Church of St Andrew Holborn (by Banns) That her said Husband previous thereto and while single served his Apprenticeship with a Mr Gladman Trunkmaker at Charing Crop in the parish of St Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster in the said County as he informed this Deponent and which she verily believes to be true And this Deponent saith that he never obtained any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Deponent's knowledge information or belief That her said Husband died about twenty two years ago and that she hath not since been Married Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year or otherwise obtained any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of her knowledge or belief And that She is distressed ill and is become Chargeable to the parish of St Clement Danes in the said County and Liberty

Mary Wilson aged 43 or thereabouts upon her Oath Saith That she intermarried with David Wilson at the Parish Church of Saint Martin in the Fields about 24 years ago. That her said Husband died about 18 Months ago, That John Elisha Wilson aged about Eleven years is her Son by the said David Wilson That her said Husband Rented a House in Denmark Court for about Two year and an half and paid £28 a year for the same beside Taxes that He died in the said House in Denmark Court which is in the Parish of Saint Paul Covent Garden in the County of Middx That the said John Elisha Wilson her Son has not gained any Settlement in his own Right to the best of her knowledge or belief

Mary Evans aged 40 years or thereabouts Singlewoman upon her Oath saith that she never was married That she lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mrs. Lucas a Fanmaker at No. 44 or 45 Ludgate Hill in the Parish of Saint Bridget otherwise Saint Bride in the City of London for the spare of one year at the annual Wages of Eight Pounds that she quitted the said Service about nine years ago and hath not since lived as an hired yearly Servant Rented any house or Tenement of Ten Pounds a year paid parish Taxes or otherwise obtained any Subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Deponents knowledge information or belief and that she is now very sick poor and distressed and unable to maintain herself.

Mary Evans aged about 40 years (on behalf of her illegitimate Child Elizabeth Evans ) upon her Oath saith That she never was married That her said Child was born at the House of John Taylor of No. 8 Saint Johns Lane in the Parish of Saint James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex Bricklayer between 7 and Eight years ago That the said Child was born on the Body of her this Deponent out of lawful Wedlock That her said Child was christened by the Name of Elizabeth Evans at the Parish Church of Saint Johns Clerkenwell in the said County That her said Child hath never been bound an Apprentice or otherwise obtained or become intilled unto any subsequent legal Settlement and that she this Deponent is unable to provide for the said Child without Assistance

Joseph Howard Aged about 14 years upon his Oath Saith that he was Born at Hatfield in the County of Hertford that on Account of loosing his Father and Mother and not being able to get any Work he was taken into the Workhouse of the sd. Parish of Hatfield as a Parishioner belonging the said Parish And Ran away from them And further Saith that he never lived as a hired Yearly Servant for One Year pd. Taxes or done any other Matter or thing whatsoever whereby he might have gained any Subsequent Settlemt. to the best of this Examinants Knowledge information or belief.

Ann Jones Widow Maketh Oath and saith that she is aged about 46 years that she intermarried with her late Husband Thomas Jones on or about the 18th March 1763 at the parish Church of St Giles in the fields Middlesex that he died about 15 years ago leaving only one Child surviving him Namely Ann aged about Eleven years who died abt. 14 years ago that since the Decease of her said Husband and Child and during her Widowhood not having any Child or Children living she this Deponent being unmarried lived as an hired yearly servant with Mrs Harris at No. 4 Martletts Court Bow Street in the parish of St. Martin in the fields in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex for about Six years at the Annual Wages of six pounds that she quitted that service about Seven Months ago and hath not since been Married or obtained any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of her knowledge information or belief

William Hasgood aged near 49 years year and upwards Upon Oath (on behalf of Joel Sparks singleman aged fifty Nine years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that that the said Joel Sparks he hath been informed and says verily believes that the said Joel Sparks was Married to Ann his late Wife at the parish Church of St. Andrew Holborn about 22 years ago that his said Wife died about Nine years ago that he hath a Son aged abt. 20 years who maintains himself that the said Joel Sparks he this Deponent Rented and Resided in an House in Swan yard about two years at the Annual Rent of Fourteen pounds that he quitted that place about five years ago And this Deponent saith that he informed & Verily believes the said Joel Sparks hath not since Rented any House or Apartment of ten pounds a year paid parish Taxes Served any parochial Office or done any Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of his knowledge or belief

Mary Bartlett Wife of Richard Bartlett now Insane Maketh Oath and saith that her said Husband is as She is informed and believes aged about 38 years saith that she was Married to her said Husband at the parish Church of St Andrew Holborn about Michaelmas 1789 that she hath been informed and Verily believes that her said Husband served his Apprenticeship under Indenture with Mr John Adams in a place then called Fans Alley in the parish of St Botolph without Aldersgate London where he lodged during such service that he hath not since the expiration of his Apprenticeship lived as an hired yearly Servant Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year or done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Deponent's knowledge information or belief

Thomas Oglivie Widower aged Sixty years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that he intermarried with Sophia his late Wife at the parish Church of St Andrew Holborn in or about the year 1760 that since then Rented and Resided in an House in King Street Drury Lane in the parish of St Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex about five years at the yearly Rent of £20 for the Service two years and £18 a year during the Remainder of the Term that his said Wife Died about fifteen years ago that he quitted that House about fourteen years ago and hath never since done any Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement that he hath a Daughter by his said wife born in lawful Wedlock who provides for herself and that he this Examinant is poor Aged and unable to maintain himself without Assistance

Alice Sidaway Singlewoman aged 30 years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that she never was Married that she lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr. Buckley at the in the Strand in the parish of St. Clement Saint Mary le Strand in the Liberty of Westminster and County of Middlesex for fourteen Months at the Annual Wages of £7. that she quitted that service several years ago and hath never since lived as an hired yearly Servant for a twelve month together Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year paid parish Taxes or done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Deponent's knowledge information or belief

George Robertson Gardiner of the Workhouse of the parish of St Clement Danes on behalf of Deborah Whaling Widow where since's are deranged Maketh Oath and saith that she is he hath been informed which he Verily believes to be true that the said Deborah Whaling was Married to her late Husband Patrick Whaling at the parish Church of Saint Ann Westminster several years ago (by Banns) that previous thereto her said Husband Rented and Resided in an House in a place called Maid Lane Beckside in the Parish St Saviour South wark in the County of Surry for upwards of six Months at the yearly Rent of £10. that he quitted paid the Rates for the same and quitted it some time before his Marriage with this Examinant and that her said Husband Died about Nine year ago and never after obtained any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of her knowledge information or belief And that She the said Deborah Whaling hath not since obtained any legal Settlement in her own Right

Elizabeth Newton commonly called Elizabeth Douglas aged Eighty years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that She never was Married according to the Rights and Ceremonies of the Church of England but according to the Rights and Ceremonies of the Church of Rome that she lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr Morton in Great Wild Street in the parish of St Giles in the Fields for about fourteen years at the Annual Wages of £4:10s that she quitted that Service about 30 years ago and hath never since lived as an hired yearly Servant with for a twelvemonth together Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year paid parish Taxes or done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of her knowledge information or belief

Sarah Cox aged 67 years or thereabouts Upon Oath said that she was Married to her late Husband John Cox at the parish Church of South Collingham near Newark upon Trent in the County of Nottingham about 41 years ago saith that subsequent thereto her said Husband Rented and Resided in and Apartment in High Holborn nearly facing Dean Street in the Parish of St Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex unfurrnised at the yearly Rent of £10 for about 2 years that She quitted the same about 33 years ago and and did not afterwards Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year pay parish Taxes or do any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Deponents knowledge or belief saith that he died about 25 years ago and she hath not since obtained any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of her knowledge or belief

John Carrier aged 40 years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that he never was Married nor obtained any legal Settlement in his own Right that he hath been informed which he verily believes to be true that he was born in lawful Wedlock that his father Rented and Resided in a House in Drury Lane in the parish of Saint Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex above twenty years at the annual Rent of £30 or thereabouts that he quitted the same about 12 or 15 years ago and never afterwards Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year paid parish Taxes or did any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Examinants knowledge information or belief

Mary Holmes Widow aged 32 years and upwards Upon Oath saith that She was Married to her late Husband John Holmes at the parish Church of St..
