Martin in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster (by Licence) on or about the 21st.. day of May March 1785 or thereabouts that she hath three Children by her said Husband born in lawful Wedlock Namely John born aged 8 years seven years on or about the 21st.. day of May last Mary Jane aged 5 years on or about the 19th.. day of October last and James aged 3 years on or about about the 10th.. day of December last all of whom of are now living and neither of them settled in his to or her own right that her said Husband Since their said Marriage Rented & resided in an House in Upper Thames Street in the parish of St Andrew Wardrobe London for a year & six five Months & upwards at the Yearly Rent of £14 that he quitted it abt. Christmas 1790 and never after obtained Any subsequent legal Settlement during his life to the best of this Examinants knowledge information or belief And this Deponent saith that her said Husband died abt. on or about the twelfth day of January instant and this left her this Deponent distressed and unable to maintain herself and Children without assistance

Edward Stone aged 61 years and upwards Upon Oath saith that he was Married to his present Wife Ann formerly Ann Ballard Spinster at the Fleet in the year 1753 or then that previous thereto and while he served the latter part of his Apprenticeship & for about the last two years und under Indentures with Mr William Stone Sawyer Cannon Row in the parish of St Margaret Westminster and lodged there at the House of Mr Cooper where his said Master lived that since the expiration of his Apprenticeship he never lived as an hired yearly Servant for a year together while Single Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year paid parish Taxes or otherwise obtained any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Examinant's knowledge information or belief

Hannah Burtles commonly called Hannah Fitzpatrick Singlewoman aged 60 years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that She never was Married according to the Rites and Ceremonies of the Church of England but was Married on or about the 2d. day of January in the Year of our Lord 1748 or 1749 at the Roman Catholic Chapel in Warwick Street Golden Square according to the rites and Ceremonies of the Church of Rome that previous thereto and while she was single not having Child or Children she lived as an hired yearly Servant for two years and an half or thereabouts with Mr Shephard in Quality Court Chancery Lane in the parish of St Andrew Holborn above the Barrs in the County of Middlesex at the annual Wages of £5:10 that she quitted the same about two Months before her said Marriage and never after obtained Any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of her knowledge or belief

Mary Pinnell aged 50 years or therea thereabouts Widow Maketh Oath and saith that she was Married to her late Husband James Pinnell at the parish Church of Saint Andrew Holborn by License about 30 years ago that since their said Marriage her said Husband Rented and Resided in an House in North Row Battle Bridge in the parish of St James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex for about 3 years at the Annual Rent of £12 that he quitted it about 18 years ago & never after during his Life Rented any House House or Apartment of £10 a year paid parish Taxes or did any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Examinants knowledge information or belief And this Examinant further said that he Died about 3 years ago and that she hath not Since been Married nor obtained or become intitled unto any other legal Settlement than in Right of her said Husband as aforesaid

Ann Stubbs aged eighteen years and upwards Upon Oath saith that She never was Married that she lived as an hired yearly Servant with John Thompson in Hungerford Market in the parish of St Martin in the fields Westminster upwards of a year at the Annual Wages of £3 that she quitted the same in or about the Month of March 1791. and hath not since done any Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Examinants knowledge information or belief

Mary Woodyer singlewoman aged 26 Years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that she never was Married nor obtained any legal Settlement in her own Right that she hath been informed and verily believes that she was born in lawful Wedlock Saith that her Father Rented and resided in an House in Tufton Street in the parish of Saint John the Evanlegis t in the City and Liberty of Westminster in the Said County of Middlesex for upwards of 3 years at the Annual Rent of £18 that since he quitted the same about 4 years ago and hath since never Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year paid parish Taxes or otherwise acquired any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Examinants knowledge or belief

William Robson Robertson aged forty years and upwards Widower Upon Oath saith that he intermarried with his first Wife Ann at the little Trinity Church Minories by Banns about 18 years ago that she Died about Seven years ago that he hath a Son now living by that Wife and bound out an Apprentice to Mr Rippon Undertaker Corner of Cannon Street Ratcliffe Highway St George's in the East and now legally settled in that parish that he this Examinant hath since been Married to Jane his second Wife who is also Dead by whom he had no Children And this Examinant further saith that he Rented and resided in an House facing the Sign of Sir John Falstaff in Houndsditch in the parish of St Botolph without Aldgate London for three years or upwards at the Annual Rent of £10 or upwards that he quitted that House about Eleven years ago and hath not Since Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year paid parish Taxes or otherwise obtained any subsequent legal Settlemt to the best of this Examinant's knowledge or belief that he is Poor Lame and unable to maintain himself without Assistance

John Langley aged 28 Years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that he was Married to his present Wife Ann Langley at the Christ Church in the County of Surry on or about the fourth day of June 1786 (by Banns) that previous thereto and (while he was single he served his Apprenticeship under Indentures (duly executed) with Mr Millen Pewterer in little Great Saffron Hill in the Liberty of Saffron Hill or Hatton Garden in the & Ely Rents parish of St Andrew Holborn in the County of Middlesex and since the expiration of his Apprenticeship he hath not done any Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Examinant's knowledge information or belief And saith that he hath 3 Children by his said Wife Namely Ann aged 5 years & upwards Elizabeth aged 2 years & upwds and John aged Eight Months & upwds

George Russell aged Seventy years or thereabouts Widower Upon Oath saith that he was Married to his late Wife Mary formerly Mary Hunt Spinster about 30 years ago that subsequent thereto he Rented and resided in a House in Milk Alley Dean Street in the parish of Saint Ann Westminster for about Eleven years that at the Annual Rent of £15 that he quitted the same about Seven years ago and hath not Since done any Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Examinant's knowledge information or belief Saith that his said Wife died about Seven years ago and hath & that he is distressed and unable to maintain himself without assistance

Elizabeth Lawrence Singlewoman aged forty seven years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that She never was Married that She lived as an hired yearly Servant with Sir Saml Hayes Leicester Square on the West Side of the said Square in the parish of St Ann within the Liberty of Westminster for two years and upwards at the Annl. Wages of ten Guineas that She left there about Nine years ago & hath not Since Rented any House or Apartm Apartment of ten pounds a year paid parish Taxes lived as an hired yearly Servant for a twelve month together or done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Examinant's knowledge information or belief

Mary Smith aged 39 years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that She was Married to her present late Husband Samuel Smith at the parish Church of St. Martin's fields on or about the 8th day of November 1786 (by Banns) that subsequent thereto her said Husband died Rented and Resided in an Apartment at Mr Griffiths's House in Fishers Street in the parish of St George the Martyr Queen Square in the County of Middlesex for three Months and upwards at the Annual Rent of £13 or thirteen Guineas that he quitted the same in or about November 1791 that he never afterwards Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year or did any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Examinants knowledge Information or belief that her said Husband died on or about the 5th day of Nove December 1792 and that She hath not since been Married or obtained any legal Settlement in her own Right Saith that she hath two Children by her said Husband Namely Samuel born the 24th. day of March 1787 and and Lucy Hannah born on or about the 24th. November 1789 and that she is distressed and unable to maintain herself and Children without Assistance and in that they are become chargeable to the said parish of St Clement Danes

Lacton orse Latton Essex but no Settlemt went in Service before Lady day 1791 & quitted after Lady day 1792 Reced more than a years Wages Order Appealed against and quashed Pauper only resided there 10 Months (to wit) Elizabeth Cook Singlewoman aged 12 21 years & upwards Upon Oath saith that She never was Married that She lived as an hired Yearly Servant with Montague Burgoyne Esqr . at their Country Seat called Markhall in the parish of Lacton otherw otherwise Latton near Harlow in the County of Essex for a year or upwards at the annual Wages of Seven Guineas that she quitted that Service in or about the latter end Month of April 1792 and hath not Since lived as an hired yearly Servant for a twelve month together Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year paid parish Taxes or done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Examinants knowledge or belief And that She is pregnant and unable to do pay the Expences of her lying in without assistance

Sarah Lockhart singlewoman aged 34 Years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that she never was Married that she hath never lived as an hired yearly Servant, served an Apprentice Apprenticeship Rented any House or apartment of ten pounds a Year or done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any legal settlement in her own right Saith that She hath been informed and believes She is the legitimate Child Daughter of Alexander Lockhart deceased and Mary his Wife And farther saith that her said father Rented and Resided in an House in Virginia Street in the parish o f Saint George in the East in the County of Middlesex for several years at the annual Rent of ten pounds and quitted Died there and that her said Mother hath not Since he acquired any subsequent legal Settlement House after the Death of this Examinant's father to the best of this Examinant's knowledge information or belief And that her said Mother is now maintained in the Workhouse of the said parish of St George

Mary Gray singlewoman aged 43 years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that She never was Married that She lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr.. Boughton in Fleet Market at No 72 in the parish of St Bridget otherwise St Bride in the City London for a year and upwards at the Annual Wages of four pounds that She quitted that Service about two years ago and hath not Since obtained any other legal Settlement to the best of this Examinant's knowledge or belief

Mary Tayler Widow aged 45 years and upwards Upon Oath saith that she was Married to her late Husband Robert Tayler at the parish Church of Saint John the Baptist in the City of Gloucester about 27 years ago (by License) that her said Husband died about Eighteen years ago that She hath two Children by her said Husband who both provided for for themselves that she since her said Husband's Decease She this Examinants while she (being a Widow) Rented and Resided in a House then Numbered 80 in Fetter Lane in the parish of St Andrew Holborn below the Bars London for upwards of a year at the Annual Rent of £25 that She quitted that House about 16 or 17 years ago and hath not since been Married or otherwise obtained or become intitled unto any subsequent legal settlement to the best of this Examinant's knowledge or belief

George Clarke aged 15 years and upwards Upon Oath saith that he served three years five Months and upwards under as an Apprentice (under Indenture) with Mr James Murrell Hair dresser of the in the parish of St. Mary le bone in the County of Middlesex and Lodged in his said Masters House within the same parish during such service that he was disharged from his Apprenticeship on or about the twentieth day of App April last and hath not obtained any subsequent legal Settlement

Mary Newinn Singlewoman aged eighteen years and upwards Upon Oath saith that She never was Married that She lived as an hired Servant with Mr Bennett of Walot Walcot Terrace in the parish of Saint Mary Lambeth in the County of Surry for two years and two Months or thereabouts that her said Master provided her with Meat Drink Washing Lodging and Cloaths and he or her Mistress occasionally gave her Money for her non private use that She left her said Master's Service without his knowledge or consent about four years ago and hath not Since lived as an hired Servant for a twelve month together Rented any House or Apartment of ten pounds a year or done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal settlement to the best of this this Examinant's knowledge information or belief

William Stocker aged 43 years or thereabts. Upon Oath saith that he was Married to Jane his present Wife at the parish Church of St Leonard Shoreditch on or abt about the 22d. day of December 177 1776 (by Banns) that he this Deponent Rented and Resided in an house in Little Drury Lane in the parish of St Mary le Strand in the Liberty of Westminster for about six years at the Annual Rent of £20 that he quitted the same about seven years ago and that he hath not obtained any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Examinant's knowledge information or belief And this Deponent further saith that he hath two Children now living by his said Wife Namely Ann aged fourteen years or thereabouts and John aged about Eight Years now with this Deponent And that he is unable to maintain himself and family without assistance

Sarah Creed Singlewoman aged 19 years & upwards Upon Oath saith that she never was Married that she was bound an Apprentice to Mr William Rogers then of Griffith's Rents Bermondsey Street Taylor and Served her said Master there for about four years, that he then removed to a Butcher's in Bermondsey Street in the parish of Saint John in the Southwark in the County of Surry that she served him and lodged then at the Butcher's in Bermondsey Street aforesaid for about a year and an half and that she then removed with her said Master to Hand Court Bermondsey Street in the said parish of Saint John and served him there for about seven Weeks that he then died that about a Month after she was taken into the Workhouse of the said parish of Saint John and was there provided for til she could procure a situation for herself and hath not Since done any Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal settlement

George Dove Widower aged twenty two years and upwards Upon Oath saith that he was Married to his late Wife Charlotte formerly Charlotte Kennedy Spinster at the parish Church of Saint Andrew Holborn (by Banns) on or about the fifth day of April 1790 that he rented and resided in a House in Drury Lane in the parish of St. Mary le Strand in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex for three Months and upwards at the Weekly Rent of eight Shillings (being at the Rate of £20:16s a year) that he quitted the same in or about the Month of November or December 1793 and hath not since done any Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Examinant's knowledge information or belief, that his said Wife Charlotte died on or about the 11th day of January last that he hath two Children by has said Wife both now liv living Namely John Benjamin aged two years four Months & upwards and Charlotte aged Seven Months & upwards and that he is unable to maintain himself & family without assistance

Ann Smith singlewoman aged fifty years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that she never was Married that she lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr Dyas at a House then called the Kings Arms Tavern in Catherine Street in the parish of Saint Clement Danes Mary le Strand in the Liberty of Westmr. in the County of Middlesex for about three years at the Annual Wages of Five pounds that She quitted that service about eighteen or twenty years ago and hath never since lived as an hired yearly Servant for a year together Rented any House or Apartment of ten pounds a year or done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Examinant's knowledge or belief

Mary Gray Widow aged sixty two years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that she was Married to Robert Gray her present Husband at the parish Church of Saint George Southwark in the County of Surry on or about the 22d day of April 1782 (by Banns) that subsequent thereto her said Husband rented and an Apartment and resided in part thereof at the House of Mr Thompson in the parish of St Paul Covent Garden in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex and resided in part of the said for about a year and an half that they quitted the same about Nine years ago and that her said Husband hath not Since done any Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subseqt. legal Settlement to the best of this Examinant's knowledge information or belief that her said Husband hath left her sometime, and that she is Aged Ill and unable to provide for herself

Ann Groves singlewoman aged 34 years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that She lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr Jones at the sign of the Sun in Addle Hill in the parish of Saint Andrew Wardrobe in the City of London for eighteen Months or thereabouts at the annual Wages of £5 that she quitted that Service about fifteen years ago and hath not obtained any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of her knowledge information or belief

Sarah Stevens aged 51 years & upwards singlewoman Upon Oath saith that she never was Married that She lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr. Campbell Taylor No 3 in Great Shire Lane in the Liberty of the Rolls in the County of Middlesex for two years & upwards at the annual Wages of seven Guineas that she quitted that Service about six years about six years ago and hath never since lived as an hired yearly Servant for a year together under one hiring or done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Examinant's knowledge information or belief

Benjamin Newman one of the Beadles of the parish of St Clement Danes on behalf of Sarah Mann Widow aged sixty years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that she hath was Married to been informed by the said Sarah Mann which he verily believes to be true that She was Married to John Mann in or about the Month of August 1775 at the parish Church of St Mary le bone Middlesex that Subsequent thereto her said Husband Rented and with this Examinant Resided in a House in Little Chelsea in the parish of Kensington in the County of Middlesex for about several years at the annual Rent of Ten Guineas that they th quitted that House about eight years ago and her said Husband never after during his Life obtained any subsequent legal Settlement that he is now Dead and that since his Decease she the Said Sarah Mann hath not been since Married nor otherwise acquired or become intitled unto any legal Settlement in her own Right

Mary Ballard (Wife of Edward Ballard a private Soldier in Colonel Johnson's Company of the third Regiment of Fleet Guards now abroad) aged thirty years and upwards Upon Oath saith that she was Married to her present said Husband Edward Ballard at the parish Church of St Andrew Holborn London on or about the seventh day of March 1791 (by Banns) that her said Husband hath informed which she believes to be true that previous thereto her said Husband served his Apprenticeship under Indenture with Mr. John Dearne Shoemaker that during the last three Months thereof had lodged the three last Months with his said Master at No 8 in King Street Drury Lane in the parish of St Giles in the Fields in the said County of Middlesex and saith that he hath never since the expiration of his Apprenticeship he hath done any Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal to the best of this Examinant's knowledge information or belief And this Examinant further saith that She hath one Child by her said Husband & now living with her namely Edward born on the or about the 29th Day of December 1791 And that She is Poor distressed and unable to maintain herself without assistance

St Bennett Pauls Wharf no Settlemt this Pauper passed Wrong was taken back and removed to the Parish of Saint Gregory by Saint Paul London vide Examn 6th- May 1793 page 231 this Book wch being also wrong she was after removed to St Mary White chapel & no Appeal vide proper Settlemt page 245 this Book to wit Mary Hughes Aged 49 Years and upwards Upon Oath saith that she was Married to her Husband George Hughes at the Parish Church of Saint Bennett Paul Wharf about 12 Years ago that before her said Marriage with the said George Hughes she lived as an hired Yearly Servant with Mr Gosling of G Knight Rider Street Doctors Commons in the sd parish of Saint Bennetts for upwards of 2 years for 2 Years at the Annual Wages of 9 Guineas from whose Service she married with the said George Hughes And this deponent further Saith that the sd George Hughes left this deponent about 6 Months Ago and that this deponent has never heard any thing of him since And this deponent saith that since her Marriage with the said George Hughes she has never acquired any subsequent legal settlement to the best of this Deponents Information or belief and that she is quite unable to maintain herself without assistance

St George Hanover Square ye this a Right Settlemt as a Man & Woman of this Name Davis settlemt in St James Vide Entry page 78 this Book Joseph Baker aged 37 Years & upward Upon his Oath saith that he intermarried with Margaret Baker his present Wife at the parish Church of St James in the Liberty of Westminster (by Banns) that him and his said Wife since their intermarriage (that is to say) th about two years ago they took a House No 1 in Lecs Mews North Audley Street in the parish of St George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex and lived there upwards of one year at the yearly Rent of £15 that since they left the said House they have been Weekly Lodgings and have never Since Rented Any Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes that he never lived As An hired Yearly Servant for one year nor Sai has done Any other Act Matter or thing whereby he might have gained any subsequent Settlement to the best of this Examinant's knowledge information or belief

Mary Hurlston singlewoman aged about forty eight years Upon Oath saith That she never was Married That she lived as an hired yearly Servant wit Dyer Esquire in Queen Ann Street East in the parish of St. Mary le bone otherwise Mary bone in the County of Middlesex for two years at the Annual Wages of Eight Guineas That she quitted That service about Ten years ago and hath not since (leaving her said Master) done any Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal settlement to the best of this Deponent's knowledge Information or belief and that she is Poor and incapable to maintain herself without Assistance

Sarah Saunders Widow of John Saunders Aged about 44 years on behalf of her Daughter Mary Saunders now Ill Weak Upon Oath saith That she this Deponent was Married to her late Husband John Saunders at Carfax Church in the City of Oxford about 23 years ago That her said Husband hath informed her which she verily believes to be true That he served his Apprenticeship with his father William Saunders a Stonemason in Windmill Street in the parish of St James in the Liberty of Westminster And That since the expiration of his said Apprenticeship he never obtained any subsequent legal settlement That she hath one Child named Mary aged Nineteen years & upwards who hath never obtained any settlement in her own Right That her said Daughter is now ill with a Fever and unable to maintain herself And further saith that her said Husband was removed from the parish of St Clement Danes to St James Westminster aforesaid on or about the 19th October 1789 and that there has been no Ippert agst. the order of his removal to her knowledge or Relief

St George Westmr Joseph Baker Aged 37 years and upwards Upon his Oath saith That he intermarrd. with Margaret Baker his present Wife at the parish Church of St James in the Liberty of Westminster by Bans That him and his said Wife since their intermarrige (that is to say) about two years ago they took a House No.1 in Lees. Mews North Audley Street in the parish of St George Hanover Square in the County of Middlesex and lived there upwards of one year at the yearly Rent of £15, that since they left the said House they have been in Weekly Lodging and have never since rented any Tenement or Lodging of £10 a year paid Taxes that he never lived as a hired yearly Servant for one year nor has done any other Act Matter or thing whereby he might have gained any subsequent Settlement to the best of this Examinants knowledge information or belief

Martha Turtel Singlewoman aged six year and upwards Upon her Oath (on behalf of her illegitimate Child Martha Bower ) saith the she this Deponent never was Married that her said Child Martha Bower was born of the Body of her this Deponent out of lawful Wedlock on or about the 25th. day of January 1780 in Cumberland Street in the parish of St Pancras in the County of Middlesex at the a House of then occupied by a Mr Armstrong a Journeyman Carpenter That her said Child hath been Christened by the Names of Martha Bowar in the parish Church of St Mary le bone in the said County That her said Child hath never been bound an Apprentice or otherwise obtained or become intilled rents any subsequent legal settlement and that she this Deponent is unable to provide for the said Child without Assistance

Benjamin Beckett aged about 42 years upon Oath saith that he intermarried with his late Wife Ann at the parish Church of St Leonard Shoreditch about 20 years ago that his said Died on the second instant That since his said Marriage he this Deponent Rented and Resided in a House situate near Basnige Wells in the parish of St Pancras in the County of Middlesex about a year, at the Annual Rent of £10 that he quitted that House about fourteen years ago and then Rented and Resided in an unfurnished Apartment of the House near the same and with in the same Parish of St Pancras about a year at the Annual Rent of £15 that he quitted that Apartment about thirteen years ago and hath not since rented any House or Lodging of ten pounds a year paid parish Taxes served any parochial office or otherwise obtained any subsequent legal settlement and this Deponent father saith that he hath four Children by his said Wife now living Namely Sarah aged Eleven years or thereabouts Benjamin William aged Eight years and upwards Ann aged six years and upwards and Deborah aged two years and upwards all with this Deponent That he this Deponent is Ill and unable to maintain himself and family without Assistance

Mary Taylor aged 21 years and upwards singlewoman Upon Oath saith that she never was Married, that she lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr Evans No. 5 Dean Street Red Lion Square in the parish of St Andrew Holborn above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for one year and upwards at the Annual Wages of £4, that she quitted that service about 5 years and three Months ago and hath not since lived as an hired yearly servant for one year together in any one place, Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year, paid parish Taxes or done any other Act or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal settlement

Jane Sale Widow aged 54 years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that she was Married to her late Husband George Sale at the parish Church of St George Bloomsbury on or about the 23d day of March 1769 (by License) that since their said Marriage her said Husband Rented and Resided in an House in Great Wild Street in the parish of St Giles in Fields in the County of Middlesex one year & upwards at the Annual Rent of £32 or thereabouts that they quitted that House about Christmas 1779 and her said Husband then went to Jamaica and Died there about 20th March 1781 (as this Deponent hath been informed and verily believes And that she this Deponent hath not since been Married neither hath she since her said Husband Quitted the said House in Wild Street Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year or otherw obtained any subsequent legal Settlement

Mary Antt Widow aged about fifty years Upon Oath saith that she was Married to James Antt her late Husband at the parish Church of Aston alias Alston near she Field in the County of York on or about the 2d day of June 1761. that since their said Marriage her said Husband Rented and Resided in an House in Cloth Fair in the parish of St Bartholomew Great London for about one year and a Quarter at the Annual Rent of Twelve pounds twelve Shillings that he Died there on or about the 2d day of Janury 1789 and this Deponent quitted the said House about a Month after and hath not since Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year paid any parish Taxes been Married or done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal settlement to the best of this Deponents knowledge Information or belief and this Deponent further saith that she hath four Children by her said Husband now living the Eldest of whom is aged 23 years or thereabouts and provided for the second hath been apprenticed out and obtained a settlement in his own right and the Remaining two are now living with this Deponent Namely Sally Aged Fifteen years and upwards and Samuel Aged thirteen years and upwards neither of whom hath obtained any legal settlement in her or his own Right

St Mary le bone Nathaniel Whitcomb Aged 42 years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith That he never was Married that he lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr Bray No 48. in Mortimer Street Cavendish Square for about two years at the yearly Wages of about 18 Guineas for the first year and £20 for the second that he quitted that service abt nine years ago and hath not obtained any subsequent legal settlement to the best of this Deponent's knowledge or belief And this Deponent further that the House of the said Mrs Bray No. 48 an Mortimer Street aforesaid was and is situate in the parish of St Mary le bone in the said County

John Vaillant aged 43 years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that he never was Married that he Rented and resided in an House in Eyre Street in the parish of St Andrew Holbor above the Bars in the County of Middlesex for about Eight years at the Annual Rent of 12 Guineas and paid all parochial rate for the same that he quitted that House about Midsummer 1792 and hath not since Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year paid any parish Taxes served any parochial office or done any other Act or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal settlement

Elizabeth Braffett aged thirty Years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith that she was married to William Braffett her present Husband at the parish Church of Saint Dunstan the West in the City of London about the Month of April 1787 That her said Husband was bound an Apprentice to Thomas Hathing in Creed Lane London Bookbinder and afterwar assigned to Ann Waller of Prujean Square in the Old Bailey in the Parish of Saint Martin Ludgate in the City of London with whom he served about two years and an half the Remainder of his Apprenticeship That since her said Husband has been out of his Apprenticsh he hath not to the best of this Deponents Knowledge Information or belief done any act wherby to acquire a Subsequent settlement and this Examinant for the Saith that for Oath one Child non living namely George Braffett aged seven Months thereabouts and that her said Husband is now in Clerkenwell New Prison and she this Examinant is in Distress and unable to Maintain herself and her said Child

St Martin in the fields Isabella Simpson Singlewoman aged Thirty Seven years or thereabouts upon her Oath saith That she never was married That she lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mrs. Sky who kept an Haberdashers Shop in Saint Martin's Lane in the Parish of Saint Martin in the Fields within the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex for upwards of one year and two Months at the yearly Wages of Ten Guineas That she quitted her Service about Fifteen years ago and hath not since obtained any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of her knowledge or belief That she this Deponent in poo and is in great distress and unable to maintain herself.

Wrong no settlemt and removed St Andrews Middx Catherine Roberts aged 45 and upwards upon her Oath saith, That she was married at St Lukes about 26 years ago to John Roberts , That during her husbands life she rented and resided in a house in Tothill St. in the parish of Saint Andrew Holborn about the bars , at the yearly rent of 12-12-0 about 12 years Ago, that during her husband life, nor since his decease, she has not lived as an hired yearly servant paid any parochial Taxes or done any Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of her knowledge or belief

Jonathan Woods aged 18 years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that he served for about the space of one year as an Apprentice under Indentures of Apprenticeship with Mr Knolt a Peruke Maker or Hair Dresser that he lived with his said Master during the last 3 Months of his service in Shernard Street in the parish of St James in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex and that his Master then left him with & giving up his Indentures or assigning him ever that since such service he hath never lived as an hired yearly Servant or done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal settlement

William Freeman Aged forty years or thereabouts upon Oath saith that he intermarried with Ann Carter Spinster at the parish Church of St George Bloomsbury about 22 years ago (by Banns) that his said Wife left this Examinant about 10 years ago that he had then a Child by his said Wife Named Ann aged about two years which she took with her and this Deponent hath not seen the said Child since: that since their said Marriage he this Deponent Rented resided in an Apartm in Rupert Street in the parish of St James in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex for three years & upwards at the Annual Rent of £12 that he quitted that House about Nine or ten years ago and hath not since Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year paid parish Taxes or otherwise obtained any subsequent legal settlement to the best of this Deponents knowledge or belief

Hannah Pattifor Wife of John Pattifor aged 36 years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that she was Married to her present Husband John Pattifor at the parish Church of St. Ann Westminster (by Baners) on or about the Ninth day of June in the year of our Lord 1787 that since their said Marriage her said Husband rented and resided in an House in Mansfield place in St George's Fields in the parish of St George the Martyr in the Borough of Southwark in this County of Surry for 3 Months and upwards at the Annual Rent of Seventeen pounds that they quitted that House about three Months ago and he hath not since Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year or done any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Deponents knowledge information or belief And this Deponent further with that she hath three Children by her said Husband Namely Sarah aged 4 years & upwards Louisa aged three years on or about the 21st. day of December last and Harriet aged fifteen Months & upwards And that her said Husband left her on or about the 12th day of November last with intention to go abroad and she hath not since heard form him And this Deponent saith that she is now pregnant distressed and unable to maintain herself without assistance

Susan Cremer or Heyser aged 50 years or thereabts. Upon Oath saith that she never was Married according to the Rights & Ceremonies of the Church of England that she this Deponent never acquired any settlement in her own right that she hath been informed which she verily believes to be true that her Father Rented and resided in an Apartment in Queen Street of Lincolns Fields in the parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex

Susan Cremer otherwise Heyser aged 50 years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that she never was Married according to the rights and Ceremonies of the Church of England that she this Deponent never acquired any legal Settlement in her own right that she hath been informed and which she verily believes to be true that her father Thos (remer rented and resided in on Apartment at Mr Graydon in Great Queen Street Lincolns Fields in the parish of St. Giles in the Fields in the County of Middlesex at the yearly rent of £11 for several years that since he quitted that Apartment he did not rent any Apartment of £10 a year payd parish Taxes or otherwise obtained any legal settlement to the best of this Deponents knowledge information or belief

Charlotte Keyser Singlewoman aged 19 years & upwards Upon Oath saith that she never was Married that she never lived as an yearly for a twelve month together or otherwise obtained any legal settlement in her own right that she hath been informed which she verily believes to be true that her father and Mother were not legally Married that she this Examinant was born in Duke's Court Broad Court in the parish of St. Martin's in the Fields in the Liberty of Westminster in the County of Middlesex sometime in or about the year eform Lord 1793

Ann Lewis Singlewoman aged 60 years or thereabouts Upon Oath saith that she never was Married that she lived as an hired yearly Servant with Mr Beadam in St Nicholas Lane in the parish of Saint Martin Orgars in the City of London for one year upward at the Annual Wages of Seven Guineas that she quitted that place in or about the year 1764 and hath not since lived as an hired yearly servant for a year together Rented any House or Apartment of £10 a year paid any parish Taxes or otherwise obtained any legal Settlement to the best of this Deponent knowledge information or belief that she is poor distressed

Isabella Young singlewoman aged 25 years and upwards Upon Oath saith that she never was Married never lived as an hired yearly Servant for a twelve month together or did any other Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby he obtain any legal settlement in her own right And this Examinant further saith that she believes she was born in lawful Wedlock that she is informed (and which she believes to be true) that her Father James Young Rents and resides in an house in Old Street Road in the parish of St Leonard Shoreditch in the County of Middlesex and which he has Rented and resided in for several years and that he says the parish Rates for the same

Martha Roberts Widow aged Sixty six years and upwards Upon Oath saith that She was Married to John Roberts at the Fleet about forty four two years ago that her said Husband previous thereto her said House (while he was single and unmarried) lived as an hired yearly Servant with his Brother Mr. Roberts in Featherston Street in the parish of Saint. Luke in the County of Middlesex for a year or upwards at the (as she hath been informed and believes) but what Wages he agreed for or received for such Service this Deponent knows nor And that he quitted the same for sometime before their Marriage and never after acquired any subsequent legal Settlement to the best of this Deponent's know legal or belief that she has been informed & believes he Died at New York in North America about thirty seven years ago And she hath nor Since been Married or done any Act Matter or thing whatsoever whereby to obtain any legal Settlement in her own Right

Mary Gladman aged about 25 years upon her Oath saith that on the Eighth day of Janry. last past she was delivered of a female Bastard Child at the House of a Mr. Novice in Crown Court Butcher Row in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes in the County of Middlesex which hath since been Christened by the Name of Hannah That one Andrew Watson who worked with a Mr- Milcolm near Kennington Green is the Real and true father of such Child he having had carnal Knowledge of this Examinants Body and begotten the same thereon and that he is the only real and true father thereof.

Amy Sidney aged about 28 years upon her Oath saith that on the Fifth day of May last she was delivered of a female Bastard Child at the Warrt Exted. he went to Bridewell Stayd. 6 Wks & disd. Proclamn.

Amy Sidney aged about 28 years upon her Oath saith that on the Fifth day of May last she was delivered of a Female Bastard Child at the house of a Mr. Tully in Alphabet Court Stanhope Street in the Parish of Saint Clement Danes which hath since been Christened by the Name of Ann Harriott That one William Heath a Writer who lately worked with Mr. Bake in Boswell Court and lodged near Rolls Buildings is the father thereof he having had carnal knowledge of this Examinants Body and begotten the same thereon and that the said William Heath is the only real and true father thereof.

Jane Drew aged about 47 years Upon her Oath Saith that about 27 years ago she intermarried with Wm. Drew her present Husband and that she and he said Husband Rented a House in Clerkenwell Green in the Parish of Saint James Clerkenwell in the County of Middlesex at the Yearly Rent of Twelve pounds and that her Husband has deserted her about twelve Months since And that she this Examinant is Poor and unable to Maintain herself

Elizabeth Kirby aged 23 years or thereabouts Singlewoman Upon Oath saith that she never was Married nor gained any settlement in her own right that her Father she hath been informed and verily believes her Father Thomas Kirby intermarried with this Deponents Mother Sarah Burnhill at the parish Church of Saint Clement Danes that her said Father Rented and Resided in an House in Stanhope a Street then called little Stanhope Street but now Newcastle Street in the said parish of St Clement Danes in the County of Middx & Liberty of Westminster about 18 y
